# 2220 "./dpdefs/upstream/dpextensions.qc"
float(float skel, float bonenum, string g1, string g2, string g3, string g4, string g5, string g6) example_skel_findbonegroup =
{
 local string bonename;
 while (bonenum >= 0)
 {
  bonename = skel_get_bonename(skel, bonenum);
  if (bonename == g1) return 1;
  if (bonename == g2) return 2;
  if (bonename == g3) return 3;
  if (bonename == g4) return 4;
  if (bonename == g5) return 5;
  if (bonename == g6) return 6;
  bonenum = skel_get_boneparent(skel, bonenum);
 }
 return 0;
};

{
 self.skeletonindex = skel_create(self.modelindex);
};


void(float animmodelindex, float framegroup, float framegroupstarttime) example_skel_player_update_begin =
{

 self.frame = framegroup;
 self.frame2 = 0;
 self.frame3 = 0;
 self.frame4 = 0;
 self.frame1time = framegroupstarttime;
 self.frame2time = 0;
 self.frame3time = 0;
 self.frame4time = 0;
 self.lerpfrac = 0;
 self.lerpfrac3 = 0;
 self.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 skel_build(self.skeletonindex, self, animmodelindex, 0, 0, 100000);
};

void(float animmodelindex, float framegroup, float framegroupstarttime, float blendalpha, string groupbonename, string excludegroupname1, string excludegroupname2) example_skel_player_update_applyoverride =
{
 local float bonenum;
 local float numbones;
 self.frame = framegroup;
 self.frame2 = 0;
 self.frame3 = 0;
 self.frame4 = 0;
 self.frame1time = framegroupstarttime;
 self.frame2time = 0;
 self.frame3time = 0;
 self.frame4time = 0;
 self.lerpfrac = 0;
 self.lerpfrac3 = 0;
 self.lerpfrac4 = 0;
 bonenum = 0;
 numbones = skel_get_numbones(self.skeletonindex);
 while (bonenum < numbones)
 {
  if (example_skel_findbonegroup(self.skeletonindex, bonenum, groupbonename, excludegroupname1, excludegroupname2, "", "", "") == 1)
   skel_build(self.skeletonindex, self, animmodelindex, 1 - blendalpha, bonenum, bonenum + 1);
  bonenum = bonenum + 1;
 }
};

void(vector eyetarget, string bonename) example_skel_player_update_eyetarget =
{
 local float bonenum;
 local vector ang;
 local vector oldforward, oldright, oldup;
 local vector relforward, relright, relup, relorg;
 local vector boneforward, boneright, boneup, boneorg;
 local vector parentforward, parentright, parentup, parentorg;
 local vector u, v;
 local vector modeleyetarget;
 bonenum = skel_find_bone(self.skeletonindex, bonename) - 1;
 if (bonenum < 0)
  return;
 oldforward = v_forward;
 oldright = v_right;
 oldup = v_up;
 v = eyetarget - self.origin;
 modeleyetarget_x = v * v_forward;
 modeleyetarget_y = 0-v * v_right;
 modeleyetarget_z = v * v_up;


 relorg = skel_get_bonerel(self.skeletonindex, bonenum);
 relforward = v_forward;
 relright = v_right;
 relup = v_up;
 boneorg = skel_get_boneabs(self.skeletonindex, bonenum);
 boneforward = v_forward;
 boneright = v_right;
 boneup = v_up;
 parentorg = skel_get_boneabs(self.skeletonindex, skel_get_boneparent(self.skeletonindex, bonenum));
 parentforward = v_forward;
 parentright = v_right;
 parentup = v_up;

 u = modeleyetarget - boneorg;

 v_x = u * parentforward;
 v_y = u * parentright;
 v_z = u * parentup;
 ang = vectoangles2(v, relup);
 ang_x = 0 - ang_x;
 makevectors(ang);

 skel_set_bone(self.skeletonindex, bonenum, relorg);

 v_forward = oldforward;
 v_right = oldright;
 v_up = oldup;
};


void() example_skel_player_delete =
{
 skel_delete(self.skeletonindex);
 self.skeletonindex = 0;
};

[[eraseable]]
float InterpretBoolean(string input)
{
 switch (strtolower(input))
 {
  case "yes":
  case "true":
  case "on":
   return true;

  case "no":
  case "false":
  case "off":
   return false;

  default: return ((stof(input)) != 0);
 }
}

float fpclassify(float e)
{
 if(isnan(e))
  return FP_NAN;
 if(isinf(e))
  return FP_INFINITE;
 if(e == 0)
  return FP_ZERO;
 return FP_NORMAL;
}
float isfinite(float e)
{
 return !(isnan(e) || isinf(e));
}
float isinf(float e)
{
 return (e != 0) && (e + e == e);
}
float isnan(float e)
{
# 36 "./lib/warpzone/mathlib.qc"
 string s = ftos(e);
 return s == "nan" || s == "-nan";
}
float isnormal(float e)
{
 return isfinite(e);
}
float signbit(float e)
{
 return (e < 0);
}

float acosh(float e)
{
 return log(e + sqrt(e*e - 1));
}
float asinh(float e)
{
 return log(e + sqrt(e*e + 1));
}
float atanh(float e)
{
 return 0.5 * log((1+e) / (1-e));
}

{

 return f;

[[eraseable]]
float randombit(float bits)
{
 if (!(bits & (bits - 1)))
  return bits;

 float r = random();
 float b = 0;
 float n = 0;

 for (float f = 1; f <= bits; f *= 2)
 {
  if (bits & f)
  {
   ++n;
   r *= n;
   if (r <= 1) b = f;
   else r = (r - 1) / (n - 1);
  }
 }
 return b;
}

[[eraseable]]
float randombits(float bits, float k, float error_return)
{
 float r = 0;
 while (k > 0 && bits != r)
 {
  r += randombit(bits - r);
  --k;
 }
 if (error_return)
  if (k > 0) return -1;

 return r;
}

enum {
 OP_SET,
 OP_MIN,
 OP_MAX,
 OP_PLUS,
 OP_MINUS
};

[[eraseable]]
float GiveBit(entity e, .float fld, float bit, float op, float val)
{
 float v0 = (e.(fld) & bit);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) |= bit;
   else e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
  case OP_PLUS:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) |= bit;
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   if (val <= 0) e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   if (val > 0) e.(fld) &= ~bit;
   break;
 }
 float v1 = (e.(fld) & bit);
 return v0 != v1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float GiveValue(entity e, .float fld, float op, float val)
{
 float v0 = e.(fld);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   e.(fld) = val;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
   e.(fld) = max(e.(fld), val);
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   e.(fld) = min(e.(fld), val);
   break;
  case OP_PLUS:
   e.(fld) += val;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   e.(fld) -= val;
   break;
 }
 float v1 = e.(fld);
 return v0 != v1;
}

[[eraseable]]
float days_up_to_date(float Y, float M, float D)
{
 float years = (M <= 2) ? Y - 1 : Y;

 float leap_days = floor(years / 4) - floor(years / 100) + floor(years / 400);


 float months = (M <= 2) ? (M + 9) : (M - 3);
 float leftover_days = (M <= 2) ? (M + 5) : floor(0.58 * M - 1.1);

 float month_days = 30 * months + leftover_days;

 return 365 * years + month_days + D + leap_days;
}

[[eraseable]]
string strftime_s()
{
 string date = strftime(false, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S");
 float i, seconds = 0;
 i =0; float Y = stof(substring(date, i, 4));
 i+=5; float M = stof(substring(date, i, 2));
 i+=3; float D = stof(substring(date, i, 2));

 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2)) * 60 * 60;
 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2)) * 60;
 i+=3; seconds += stof(substring(date, i, 2));





 float days_since_epoch = days_up_to_date(Y, M, D) - 719469;

 float hundreds_of_seconds = days_since_epoch * 24 * 6 * 6;
 hundreds_of_seconds += floor(seconds / 100);


 string seconds_str = ftos(seconds % 100);
 if ((seconds % 100) < 10)
  seconds_str = strcat("0", seconds_str);

 return strcat(ftos(hundreds_of_seconds), seconds_str);
}



[[eraseable]]
string seconds_tostring(float seconds)
{
 float negative = false;
 if (seconds < 0)
 {
  negative = true;
  seconds = -seconds;
  if (floor(seconds) != seconds)
   seconds += 1;
 }
 float minutes = floor(seconds / 60);
 seconds -= minutes * 60;
 if (negative)
  return sprintf("-%d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
 return sprintf("%d:%02d", minutes, seconds);
}





[[eraseable]]
string clockedtime_tostring(float tm, float hundredths, float compact)
{
 if (tm < 0)
 {
  if (compact)
   return strcat("0.0", hundredths ? "0" : "");
  else
   return strcat("0:00.0", hundredths ? "0" : "");
 }
 float acc = hundredths ? 6000 : 600;
 tm = floor(tm + 0.5);
 float minutes = floor(tm / acc);
 float tm_without_minutes = tm - minutes * acc;

 string s = ftos(acc * 10 + tm_without_minutes);
 if (!compact || minutes > 0)
  return strcat(ftos(minutes), ":", substring(s, 1, 2), ".", substring(s, 3, hundredths ? 2 : 1));

 float ofs = 2, digits = 1;
 if (tm_without_minutes >= 10 * (hundredths ? 100 : 10))
 {
  ofs = 1;
  digits = 2;
 }
 return strcat(substring(s, ofs, digits), ".", substring(s, 3, hundredths ? 2 : 1));

}




[[eraseable]]
string format_time(float seconds)
{
 seconds = floor(seconds + 0.5);
 float days = floor(seconds / 864000);
 seconds -= days * 864000;
 float hours = floor(seconds / 36000);
 seconds -= hours * 36000;
 float minutes = floor(seconds / 600);
 seconds -= minutes * 600;
 if (days > 0) return sprintf(_("%d days, %02d:%02d:%02d"), days, hours, minutes, seconds);
 else return sprintf(_("%02d:%02d:%02d"), hours, minutes, seconds);
}

[[eraseable]]
string swapwords(string str, float i, float j)
{
 float n;
 string s1, s2, s3, s4, s5;
 float si, ei, sj, ej, s0, en;
 n = _tokenizebyseparator(str, " ");
 si = _argv_start_index(i);
 sj = _argv_start_index(j);
 ei = _argv_end_index(i);
 ej = _argv_end_index(j);
 s0 = _argv_start_index(0);
 en = _argv_end_index(n - 1);
 s1 = substring_range(str, s0, si);
 s2 = substring_range(str, si, ei);
 s3 = substring_range(str, ei, sj);
 s4 = substring_range(str, sj, ej);
 s5 = substring_range(str, ej, en);
 return strcat(s1, s4, s3, s2, s5);
}

string _shufflewords_str;
[[eraseable]]
void _shufflewords_swapfunc(float i, float j, entity pass)
{
 _shufflewords_str = swapwords(_shufflewords_str, i, j);
}

[[eraseable]]
string shufflewords(string str)
{
 _shufflewords_str = str;
 float n = _tokenizebyseparator(str, " ");
 shuffle(n, _shufflewords_swapfunc, (0, world));
 str = _shufflewords_str;
 _shufflewords_str = nil;
 return str;
}

[[eraseable]]
string unescape(string in)
{
 in = strzone(in);

 float len = _strlen(in);
 string str = "";
 for (float i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  string s = substring(in, i, 1);
  if (s == "\\")
  {
   s = substring(in, i + 1, 1);
   if (s == "n") str = strcat(str, "\n");
   else if (s == "\\") str = strcat(str, "\\");
   else str = strcat(str, substring(in, i, 2));
   ++i;
   continue;
  }
  str = strcat(str, s);
 }
 strunzone(in);
 return str;
}

[[eraseable]]
float u8_strsize(string s)
{
 float l = 0;
 for (float i = 0, c; (c = _str2chr(s, i)) > 0; ++i, ++l)
 {
  l += (c >= 0x80);
  l += (c >= 0x800);
  l += (c >= 0x10000);
 }
 return l;
}


[[eraseable]]
float isInvisibleString(string s)
{
 s = strdecolorize(s);
 float utf8 = cvar("utf8_enable");
 for (float i = 0, n = _strlen(s); i < n; ++i)
 {
  float c = _str2chr(s, i);
  switch (c)
  {
   case 0:
   case 32:
    break;
   case 192:
    if (!utf8) break;
    return false;
   case 0xE000:
   case 0xE00A:
   case 0xE0A0:
   case 0xE020:
   case 0x00A0:
   case 0x180E:
   case 0x2000:
   case 0x2001:
   case 0x2002:
   case 0x2003:
   case 0x2004:
   case 0x2005:
   case 0x2006:
   case 0x2007:
   case 0x2008:
   case 0x2009:
   case 0x200A:
   case 0x200B:
   case 0x202F:
   case 0x205F:
   case 0x3000:
   case 0xFEFF:
   case 0xFFA0:
   case 0x3164:
    if (utf8) break;
   default:
    return false;
  }
 }
 return true;
}

[[eraseable]]
float vercmp_recursive(string v1, string v2)
{
 float dot1 = _strstrofs(v1, ".", 0);
 float dot2 = _strstrofs(v2, ".", 0);
 string s1 = (dot1 == -1) ? v1 : substring(v1, 0, dot1);
 string s2 = (dot2 == -1) ? v2 : substring(v2, 0, dot2);

 float r;
 r = stof(s1) - stof(s2);
 if (r != 0) return r;

 r = _strcasecmp(s1, s2);
 if (r != 0) return r;

 if (dot1 == -1) return (dot2 == -1) ? 0 : -1;
 else return (dot2 == -1) ? 1 : vercmp_recursive(substring(v1, dot1 + 1, 999), substring(v2, dot2 + 1, 999));
}

[[eraseable]]
float vercmp(string v1, string v2)
{
 if (_strcasecmp(v1, v2) == 0) return 0;


 if (v1 == "git") return 1;
 if (v2 == "git") return -1;

 return vercmp_recursive(v1, v2);
}

[[eraseable]]
float isCaretEscaped(string theText, float pos)
{

 float carets = 0;
 while(pos - carets >= 1 && substring(theText, pos - carets - 1, 1) == "^")
  ++carets;

 return (carets & 1);
}

[[eraseable]]
float isValidColorCodeValue(string theText, float cc_len, float tag_start)
{
 if (cc_len == 2)
  return (_strstrofs(DIGITS, (substring(theText, tag_start + 1, 1)), 0) >= 0);
 if (cc_len == 5)
  return ((_strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 2, 1)), 0) >= 0)
   && (_strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 3, 1)), 0) >= 0)
   && (_strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(theText, tag_start + 4, 1)), 0) >= 0));
 return false;
}







[[eraseable]]
vector checkColorCode(string theText, float text_len, float pos, float check_at_the_end)
{
 if (text_len == 0)
  text_len = _strlen(theText);
 string tag_type = "^";
 float cc_len = 2;
 float tag_len = 1;

 :check_color_tag

 float ofs = cc_len;
 if (!check_at_the_end)
  ofs--;
 for (; ofs >= 1; ofs--)
 {
  if (!(pos >= ofs && text_len >= pos + (cc_len - ofs)))
   continue;
  if(substring(theText, pos - ofs, tag_len) == tag_type)
  {
   if (!isCaretEscaped(theText, pos - ofs) && isValidColorCodeValue(theText, cc_len, pos - ofs))
    return eX * cc_len + eY * ofs;
  }
 }
 if (cc_len == 2)
 {
  tag_type = "^x";
  cc_len = 5;
  tag_len = 2;
  goto check_color_tag;
 }
 return '0 0 0';
}

     + '0 1 0' * (0.502 + 0.498 * sin(t / 3.14159265358979323846 + 3.14159265358979323846))
     + '0 0 1' * (0.502 + 0.498 * sin(t / 3.14159265358979323846 + 3.14159265358979323846 * 1 / 3));
  default: return '0.000 0.000 0.000';
 }
}

[[eraseable]]
float rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(vector rgb, float mi, float ma)
{
 if (mi == ma)
 {
  return 0;
 }
 else if (ma == rgb.x)
 {
  if (rgb.y >= rgb.z) return (rgb.y - rgb.z) / (ma - mi);
  else return (rgb.y - rgb.z) / (ma - mi) + 6;
 }
 else if (ma == rgb.y)
 {
  return (rgb.z - rgb.x) / (ma - mi) + 2;
 }
 else
 {
  return (rgb.x - rgb.y) / (ma - mi) + 4;
 }
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(float hue, float mi, float ma)
{
 vector rgb;

 hue -= 6 * floor(hue / 6);



 if (hue <= 1)
 {
  rgb.x = ma;
  rgb.y = hue * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.z = mi;
 }


 else if (hue <= 2)
 {
  rgb.x = (2 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.y = ma;
  rgb.z = mi;
 }
 else if (hue <= 3)
 {
  rgb.x = mi;
  rgb.y = ma;
  rgb.z = (hue - 2) * (ma - mi) + mi;
 }


 else if (hue <= 4)
 {
  rgb.x = mi;
  rgb.y = (4 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.z = ma;
 }
 else if (hue <= 5)
 {
  rgb.x = (hue - 4) * (ma - mi) + mi;
  rgb.y = mi;
  rgb.z = ma;
 }


 else
 {
  rgb.x = ma;
  rgb.y = mi;
  rgb.z = (6 - hue) * (ma - mi) + mi;
 }

 return rgb;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector rgb_to_hsv(vector rgb)
{
 float mi, ma;
 vector hsv;

 mi = min(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);
 ma = max(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);

 hsv.x = rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(rgb, mi, ma);
 hsv.z = ma;

 if (ma == 0) hsv.y = 0;
 else hsv.y = 1 - mi / ma;

 return hsv;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hsv_to_rgb(vector hsv)
{
 return hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(hsv.x, hsv.z * (1 - hsv.y), hsv.z);
}

[[eraseable]]
vector rgb_to_hsl(vector rgb)
{
 float mi, ma;
 vector hsl;

 mi = min(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);
 ma = max(rgb.x, rgb.y, rgb.z);

 hsl.x = rgb_mi_ma_to_hue(rgb, mi, ma);

 hsl.z = 0.5 * (mi + ma);
 if (mi == ma) hsl.y = 0;
 else if (hsl.z <= 0.5) hsl.y = (ma - mi) / (2 * hsl.z);
 else
  hsl.y = (ma - mi) / (2 - 2 * hsl.z);

 return hsl;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector hsl_to_rgb(vector hsl)
{
 float mi, ma, maminusmi;

 if (hsl.z <= 0.5) maminusmi = hsl.y * 2 * hsl.z;
 else maminusmi = hsl.y * (2 - 2 * hsl.z);



 mi = hsl.z - 0.5 * maminusmi;
 ma = hsl.z + 0.5 * maminusmi;

 return hue_mi_ma_to_rgb(hsl.x, mi, ma);
}

  (substring(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (floor(rgb.y * 15 + 0.5)), 1)),
  (substring(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (floor(rgb.z * 15 + 0.5)), 1))
              );
}

 {
  for (float i = 0; (l = fgets(fh)); ++i)
  {
   if (l != "") bufstr_set(db, i, l);
  }

[[eraseable]]
string process_time(float outputtype, float seconds)
{
 float tmp_hours = 0, tmp_minutes = 0, tmp_seconds = 0;
 float tmp_years = 0, tmp_weeks = 0, tmp_days = 0;

 tmp_seconds = floor(seconds);

 if (tmp_seconds)
 {
  tmp_minutes = floor(tmp_seconds / 60);

  if (tmp_minutes)
  {
   tmp_seconds -= (tmp_minutes * 60);
   tmp_hours = floor(tmp_minutes / 60);

   if (tmp_hours)
   {
    tmp_minutes -= (tmp_hours * 60);
    tmp_days = floor(tmp_hours / 24);

    if (tmp_days)
    {
     tmp_hours -= (tmp_days * 24);
     tmp_weeks = floor(tmp_days / 7);

     if (tmp_weeks)
     {
      tmp_days -= (tmp_weeks * 7);
      tmp_years = floor(tmp_weeks / 52);
     }
    }
   }
  }
 }

 switch (outputtype)
 {
  case 1: return sprintf("%02d:%02d:%02d", tmp_hours, tmp_minutes, tmp_seconds);
  case 2:
  {
   string output = "";


   if (tmp_years) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_years, _("CI_ZER^%d years"), _("CI_FIR^%d year"), _("CI_SEC^%d years"), _("CI_THI^%d years"), _("CI_MUL^%d years")));
   if (tmp_weeks) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_weeks, _("CI_ZER^%d weeks"), _("CI_FIR^%d week"), _("CI_SEC^%d weeks"), _("CI_THI^%d weeks"), _("CI_MUL^%d weeks")));
   if (tmp_days) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_days, _("CI_ZER^%d days"), _("CI_FIR^%d day"), _("CI_SEC^%d days"), _("CI_THI^%d days"), _("CI_MUL^%d days")));
   if (tmp_hours) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_hours, _("CI_ZER^%d hours"), _("CI_FIR^%d hour"), _("CI_SEC^%d hours"), _("CI_THI^%d hours"), _("CI_MUL^%d hours")));
   if (tmp_minutes) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_minutes, _("CI_ZER^%d minutes"), _("CI_FIR^%d minute"), _("CI_SEC^%d minutes"), _("CI_THI^%d minutes"), _("CI_MUL^%d minutes")));
   if (tmp_seconds) output = strcat(output, ((output != "") ? ", " : ""), count_fill(tmp_seconds, _("CI_ZER^%d seconds"), _("CI_FIR^%d second"), _("CI_SEC^%d seconds"), _("CI_THI^%d seconds"), _("CI_MUL^%d seconds")));

   if (output == "")
    return count_fill(0, _("CI_ZER^%d seconds"), _("CI_FIR^%d second"), _("CI_SEC^%d seconds"), _("CI_THI^%d seconds"), _("CI_MUL^%d seconds"));
   return output;
  }
  case 3:
  {
   string output = "";

   output = count_fill(tmp_hours, _("CI_ZER^%d hours"), _("CI_FIR^%d hour"), _("CI_SEC^%d hours"), _("CI_THI^%d hours"), _("CI_MUL^%d hours"));

   if (tmp_weeks) tmp_days += (tmp_weeks * 7);
   if (tmp_years) tmp_days += (tmp_years * 365);
   if (tmp_days)
   {
    output = sprintf(
     count_fill(tmp_days, _("CI_ZER^%d days"), _("CI_FIR^%d day"), _("CI_SEC^%d days"), _("CI_THI^%d days"), _("CI_MUL^%d days")),
     ((output != "") ? strcat(", ", output) : ""));
   }

   return output;
  }
 }
 return "";
}

[[eraseable]]
float json_parse(string in, float() func) {
    string trimmed = "";
    :trim {
        float o = _strstrofs(in, "\"", 0);
        if (o >= 0) {
            string part = substring(in, 0, o + 1); in = substring(in, o + 1, -1);
            part = strreplace(" ", "", part);
            part = strreplace("\n", "", part);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim_str;
        } else {
            string part = in;
            part = strreplace(" ", "", part);
            part = strreplace("\n", "", part);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto done;
        }
    }
    :trim_str {
        float o = _strstrofs(in, "\"", 0);
        float esc = _strstrofs(in, "\\\"", 0);
        if (o < esc || esc < 0) {

            string part = substring(in, 0, o + 1); in = substring(in, o + 1, -1);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim;
        } else {

            string part = substring(in, 0, esc + 2); in = substring(in, esc + 2, -1);
            trimmed = strcat(trimmed, part);
            goto trim_str;
        }
    }
    :done;

    if(1){ _json_s = trimmed; _json_i = 0; }else voidfunc();
    _json_buffer = _buf_create();
    float ret = func();
    if (!ret) {
        buf_del(_json_buffer);
        _json_buffer = -1;
    }
    return _json_buffer;
}

[[eraseable]]
string json_get(float buf, string key)
{
    for (float i = 1, n = buf_getsize(buf); i < n; i += 2) {
        if (bufstr_get(buf, i) == key) return bufstr_get(buf, i + 1);
    }
    return nil;
}

[[eraseable]]
void json_del(float buf)
{
    buf_del(buf);
}

[[eraseable]]
void json_dump(float buf)
{
    for (float i = 0, n = buf_getsize(buf); i < n; ++i) {
        print(bufstr_get(buf, i), "\n");
    }
}

[[eraseable]]
void mean_accumulate(entity e, .float a, .float c, float mean, float value, float weight)
{
 if (weight == 0) return;
 if (mean == 0) e.(a) *= (value ** weight);
 else e.(a) += (value ** mean) * weight;
 e.(c) += weight;
}

[[eraseable]]
float mean_evaluate(entity e, .float a, .float c, float mean)
{
 if (e.(c) == 0) return 0;
 if (mean == 0) return (e.(a) ** (1.0 / e.(c)));
 else return ((e.(a) / e.(c)) ** (1.0 / mean));
}

[[eraseable]]
float angc(float a1, float a2)
{
 while (a1 > 180)
  a1 -= 360;
 while (a1 < -179)
  a1 += 360;
 while (a2 > 180)
  a2 -= 360;
 while (a2 < -179)
  a2 += 360;
 float a = a1 - a2;
 while (a > 180)
  a -= 360;
 while (a < -179)
  a += 360;
 return a;
}

vector vsnap(vector point, float fsize)
{

}

[[eraseable]]
float lerpratio(float f0, float f1, float ratio)
{
 return f0 * (1 - ratio) + f1 * ratio;
}

float lerp(float t0, float f0, float t1, float f1, float t)
{

}

[[eraseable]]
float lerp3ratio(float f0, float f1, float f2, float ratio)
{
 float mid = 0.5;
 return ratio < mid ? lerpratio(f0, f1, ratio / mid) : ratio > mid ? lerpratio(f1, f2, (ratio - mid) / mid) : f1;
}

}

[[eraseable]]
float median(float a, float b, float c)
{
 return (a < c) ? bound(a, b, c) : bound(c, b, a);
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_equals(float a, float b)
{
 float eps = (max(a, -a) + max(b, -b)) * 0.001;
 return a - b < eps && b - a < eps;
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_equals_eps(float a, float b, float times_eps)
{
 float eps = max(fabs(a), fabs(b)) * FLOAT_EPSILON * times_eps;
 return a - b < eps && b - a < eps;
}

[[eraseable]]
float almost_in_bounds(float a, float b, float c)
{
 float eps = (max(a, -a) + max(c, -c)) * 0.001;
 if (a > c) eps = -eps;
 return b == median(a - eps, b, c + eps);
}

[[eraseable]]
float ExponentialFalloff(float mindist, float maxdist, float halflifedist, float d)
{
 if (halflifedist > 0) return (0.5 ** ((bound(mindist, d, maxdist) - mindist) / halflifedist));
 else if (halflifedist < 0) return (0.5 ** ((bound(mindist, d, maxdist) - maxdist) / halflifedist));
 else return 1;
}

[[eraseable]]
vector solve_quadratic(float a, float b, float c)
{
 vector v;
 float D;
 v = '0 0 0';
 if (a == 0)
 {
  if (b != 0)
  {
   v.x = v.y = -c / b;
   v.z = 1;
  }
  else
  {
   if (c == 0)
   {

    v.z = 1;
   }
  }
 }
 else
 {
  D = b * b - 4 * a * c;
  if (D >= 0)
  {
   D = sqrt(D);
   if (a > 0)
   {
    v.x = ((-b) - D) / (2 * a);
    v.y = ((-b) + D) / (2 * a);
   }
   else
   {
    v.x = (-b + D) / (2 * a);
    v.y = (-b - D) / (2 * a);
   }
   v.z = 1;
  }
  else
  {

   D = sqrt(-D);
   v.x = -b / (2 * a);
   if (a > 0) v.y = D / (2 * a);
   else v.y = -D / (2 * a);
   v.z = 0;
  }
 }
 return v;
}







[[eraseable]]
float map_ranges(float value, float src_min, float src_max, float dest_min, float dest_max) {
 float src_diff = src_max - src_min;
 float dest_diff = dest_max - dest_min;
 float ratio = (value - src_min) / src_diff;
 return dest_min + dest_diff * ratio;
}


[[eraseable]]
float map_bound_ranges(float value, float src_min, float src_max, float dest_min, float dest_max) {
 if (value <= src_min) return dest_min;
 if (value >= src_max) return dest_max;
 return map_ranges(value, src_min, src_max, dest_min, dest_max);
}

[[eraseable]]

{

 if (random() > (0.7756 ** f)) e.noise_paccum2 = 0.28768 * (2 * random() - 1);

}
[[eraseable]]
float Noise_White(entity e, float dt)
{
 return random() * 2 - 1;
}

{

 return 2 * e.noise_bstate - 1;
}

        );

}

{

 {

  case NUM_TEAM_2: return '0.0625 0.0625 1';

  case NUM_TEAM_4: return '1 0.0625 1';

float Team_ColorToTeam(string team_color)
{
 switch(strtolower(team_color))
 {
  case "red": return NUM_TEAM_1;
  case "blue": return NUM_TEAM_2;
  case "yellow": return NUM_TEAM_3;
  case "pink": return NUM_TEAM_4;
  case "auto": return 0;
 }

 return -1;
}

  case NUM_TEAM_4:

  }

 {

  case 4: return NUM_TEAM_4;

{
 switch (team_num)
 {
  case NUM_TEAM_1: return 1;
  case NUM_TEAM_2: return 2;
  case NUM_TEAM_3: return 3;
  case NUM_TEAM_4: return 4;
 }
 return -1;
}




float Team_TeamToBit(float team_num)
{
 if (!Team_IsValidTeam(team_num))
 {
  return 0;
 }
 return (1 << (Team_TeamToIndex(team_num) - 1));
}

{
 return (1 << (index - 1));
}

Sound SND_CTF_CAPTURE(float teamid) {
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_PINK;
        default: return SND_CTF_CAPTURE_NEUTRAL;
    }

float autocvar_bot_sound_monopoly;

.entity realowner;
float sound_allowed(float to, entity e)
{
 if(!e) return true;
 for ( ; ; )
 {
  if (e.classname == "body") e = e.enemy;
  else if (e.realowner && e.realowner != e) e = e.realowner;
  else if (e.owner && e.owner != e) e = e.owner;
  else break;
 }

 if (to == MSG_ONE && e == msg_entity) return true;

 if (autocvar_bot_sound_monopoly && (clienttype(e) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) return false;

 return true;
}


float precache_sound_index(string s) = #19;

const float SVC_SOUND = 6;
const float SVC_STOPSOUND = 16;

const float SND_VOLUME = (1 << (0));
const float SND_ATTENUATION = (1 << (1));
const float SND_LARGEENTITY = (1 << (3));
const float SND_LARGESOUND = (1 << (4));
const float SND_SPEEDUSHORT4000 = (1 << (5));

void soundtoat(float to, entity e, vector o, float chan, string samp, float vol, float attenu, float _pitch)
{
 if (!sound_allowed(to, e)) return;
 float entno = num_for_edict(e);
 float idx = precache_sound_index(samp);
 attenu = floor(attenu * 64);
 vol = floor(vol * 255);
 float sflags = 0;
 float speed4000 = floor((_pitch * 0.01) * 4000 + 0.5);
 if (vol != 255) sflags |= SND_VOLUME;
 if (attenu != 64) sflags |= SND_ATTENUATION;
 if (entno >= 8192 || chan < 0 || chan > 7) sflags |= SND_LARGEENTITY;
 if (idx >= 256) sflags |= SND_LARGESOUND;
 if (speed4000 && speed4000 != 4000) sflags |= SND_SPEEDUSHORT4000;
 WriteByte(to, SVC_SOUND);
 WriteByte(to, sflags);
 if (sflags & SND_VOLUME) WriteByte(to, vol);
 if (sflags & SND_ATTENUATION) WriteByte(to, attenu);
 if (sflags & SND_SPEEDUSHORT4000) WriteShort(to, speed4000);
 if (sflags & SND_LARGEENTITY)
 {
  WriteShort(to, entno);
  WriteByte(to, chan);
 }
 else
 {
  WriteShort(to, (entno << 3) | chan);
 }
 if (sflags & SND_LARGESOUND) WriteShort(to, idx);
 else WriteByte(to, idx);
 WriteCoord(to, o.x);
 WriteCoord(to, o.y);
 WriteCoord(to, o.z);
}

void soundto(float _dest, entity e, float chan, string samp, float vol, float _atten, float _pitch)
{
 if (!sound_allowed(_dest, e)) return;
 vector o = e.origin + 0.5 * (e.mins + e.maxs);
 soundtoat(_dest, e, o, chan, samp, vol, _atten, _pitch);
}
void soundat(entity e, vector o, float chan, string samp, float vol, float _atten)
{
 soundtoat(((chan & 8) ? MSG_ALL : MSG_BROADCAST), e, o, chan, samp, vol, _atten, 0);
}
void stopsoundto(float _dest, entity e, float chan)
{
 if (!sound_allowed(_dest, e)) return;
 float entno = num_for_edict(e);
 if (entno >= 8192 || chan < 0 || chan > 7)
 {
  float idx = precache_sound_index(( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_Null), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ));
  float sflags = SND_LARGEENTITY;
  if (idx >= 256) sflags |= SND_LARGESOUND;
  WriteByte(_dest, SVC_SOUND);
  WriteByte(_dest, sflags);
  WriteShort(_dest, entno);
  WriteByte(_dest, chan);
  if (sflags & SND_LARGESOUND) WriteShort(_dest, idx);
  else WriteByte(_dest, idx);
  WriteCoord(_dest, e.origin.x);
  WriteCoord(_dest, e.origin.y);
  WriteCoord(_dest, e.origin.z);
 }
 else
 {
  WriteByte(_dest, SVC_STOPSOUND);
  WriteShort(_dest, entno * 8 + chan);
 }
}
void stopsound(entity e, float chan)
{
 if (!sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, e)) return;
 stopsoundto(MSG_BROADCAST, e, chan);
 stopsoundto(MSG_ALL, e, chan);
}

{
    if(1){ }else voidfunc();

    switch (this.classname) {
        case "Observer":
            if(1){ if (this.instanceOfSpectator) { Spectator_dtorimpl(this); } }else voidfunc();
            if(1){ if (this.instanceOfPlayer) { Player_dtorimpl(this); } }else voidfunc();
            return true;
        case "Spectator":
            if(1){ if (this.instanceOfObserver) { Observer_dtorimpl(this); } }else voidfunc();
            if(1){ if (this.instanceOfPlayer) { Player_dtorimpl(this); } }else voidfunc();
            return true;
        case "Player":
            if(1){ if (this.instanceOfObserver) { Observer_dtorimpl(this); } }else voidfunc();
            if(1){ if (this.instanceOfSpectator) { Spectator_dtorimpl(this); } }else voidfunc();
            return true;
    }

    return false;
}

entity EFFECT_VAPORIZER(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_NEUTRAL;
    }
}
entity EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_VAPORIZER_HIT_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

entity EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_SPAWNPOINT_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

entity EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER(float teamid)
{
    entity e;
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_RED; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_BLUE; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_YELLOW; break;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_PINK; break;
        default: e = EFFECT_ROCKETMINSTA_LASER_NEUTRAL; break;
    }
    if (_particleeffectnum(e.eent_eff_name) < 0 || !Team_IsValidTeam(teamid)) { e = EFFECT_TR_NEXUIZPLASMA; }
    return e;
}

float movement_oddity(vector m0, vector m1)
{
 float cosangle = normalize(m0) * normalize(m1);
 if(cosangle >= 0)
  return 0;
 return 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(cosangle * cosangle * 4 * 3.14159265358979323846);

}

void anticheat_physics(entity this)
{
 float f;


 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./server/anticheat.qc", 72, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
 if((this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_offset == 0)
 {
  f = fabs(anticheat_div0_evade_evasion_delta - floor(anticheat_div0_evade_evasion_delta) - 0.5) * 2;
  (this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_offset = servertime + sys_frametime * (3 * f - 1);
  (this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_v_angle = this.v_angle;
  (this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_forward_initial = v_forward;
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_div0_evade_accumulator, anticheat_div0_evade_count, anticheat_div0_evade_mean, 0, 1);
 }
 else
 {
  if(time < (this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_offset)
   (this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_v_angle = this.v_angle;
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_div0_evade_accumulator, anticheat_div0_evade_count, anticheat_div0_evade_mean, 0.5 - 0.5 * ((this._cs).anticheat_div0_evade_forward_initial * v_forward), 1);
 }

 mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_div0_strafebot_old_accumulator, anticheat_div0_strafebot_old_count, anticheat_div0_strafebot_old_mean, movement_oddity((this._cs).movement, (this._cs).anticheat_div0_strafebot_movement_prev), 1);
 (this._cs).anticheat_div0_strafebot_movement_prev = (this._cs).movement;


 if((this._cs).anticheat_div0_strafebot_forward_prev && time > (this._cs).anticheat_fixangle_endtime) {
  float cosangle = (this._cs).anticheat_div0_strafebot_forward_prev * v_forward;
  float angle = cosangle < -1 ? 3.14159265358979323846 : cosangle > 1 ? 0 : acos(cosangle);




  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_div0_strafebot_new_accumulator, anticheat_div0_strafebot_new_count, anticheat_div0_strafebot_new_mean, angle / 3.14159265358979323846, 1);

  if (cvar("slowmo") > 0) {



   float dt = max(0.001, frametime) / cvar("slowmo");

   float anglespeed = angle / dt;
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_signal_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_signal_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_signal_mean, anglespeed, dt);
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_noise_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_noise_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_noise_mean, anglespeed, dt);
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_m2_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m2_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m2_mean, anglespeed, dt);
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_m3_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m3_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m3_mean, anglespeed, dt);
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_m4_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m4_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m4_mean, anglespeed, dt);
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_m7_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m7_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m7_mean, anglespeed, dt);
   mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_idle_snapaim_m10_accumulator, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m10_count, anticheat_idle_snapaim_m10_mean, anglespeed, dt);


   float f = bound(0, dt * 4, 1);
   vector aim_move = v_forward - (this._cs).anticheat_div0_strafebot_forward_prev;
   vector snapback_prev = (this._cs).anticheat_div0_snapback_prev;
   float snapback_len = vlen(snapback_prev);
   if (snapback_len != 0) {
    float aim_snap = max(0, (aim_move * snapback_prev) / -snapback_len);

    mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_div0_snapback_accumulator, anticheat_div0_snapback_count, anticheat_div0_snapback_mean, aim_snap, dt);
   }
   (this._cs).anticheat_div0_snapback_prev = snapback_prev * (1 - f) + aim_move * f;
  }
 }
 (this._cs).anticheat_div0_strafebot_forward_prev = v_forward;


 (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime_frac += frametime;
 f = floor((this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime_frac);
 (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime_frac -= f;
 (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime_count += f;
 (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime = (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime_frac + (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime_count;
 f = (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_movetime - servertime;
 if((this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_offset == 0)
  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_offset = f;
 else
 {
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_speedhack_accumulator, anticheat_speedhack_count, anticheat_speedhack_mean, max(0, f - (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_offset), 1);
  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_offset += (f - (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_offset) * frametime * 0.1;
 }


 if ((this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_lasttime > 0) {
  float dt = servertime - (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_lasttime;
  const float falloff = 0.2;
  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu *= exp(-dt * falloff);
  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu += frametime * falloff;


  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_lasttime = servertime;
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_speedhack_m1_accumulator, anticheat_speedhack_m1_count, anticheat_speedhack_m1_mean, (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu, frametime);
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_speedhack_m2_accumulator, anticheat_speedhack_m2_count, anticheat_speedhack_m2_mean, (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu, frametime);
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_speedhack_m3_accumulator, anticheat_speedhack_m3_count, anticheat_speedhack_m3_mean, (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu, frametime);
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_speedhack_m4_accumulator, anticheat_speedhack_m4_count, anticheat_speedhack_m4_mean, (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu, frametime);
  mean_accumulate((this._cs), anticheat_speedhack_m5_accumulator, anticheat_speedhack_m5_count, anticheat_speedhack_m5_mean, (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu, frametime);
 } else {
  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_accu = 1;
  (this._cs).anticheat_speedhack_lasttime = servertime;
 }
}

string anticheat_display(float f, float t, float tmin, float mi, float ma)
{
 string s;
 s = ftos(f);
 if (t >= tmin) {
  if(f <= mi)
   return strcat(s, ":N");
  if(f >= ma)
   return strcat(s, ":Y");
 }
 return strcat(s, ":-");
}

{

}

{
 (this._cs).anticheat_fixangle_endtime = servertime + min(0.4, (this._cs).ping * 0.001) + 0.2;
}

void anticheat_endframe()
{
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (it.fixangle)) { { { anticheat_fixangle(it); }; } } } }else voidfunc();
 anticheat_div0_evade_evasion_delta += frametime * (0.5 + random());
}

{
    switch(request)
    {
        case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
        {

            tur_config_file = -1;
            tur_config_alsoprint = -1;
            string filename = argv(1);

            if(filename == "")
            {
                filename = "turrets_dump.cfg";
                tur_config_alsoprint = false;
            }
            else if(filename == "-")
            {
                filename = "turrets_dump.cfg";
                tur_config_alsoprint = true;
            }
            tur_config_file = fopen(filename, FILE_WRITE);

            if(tur_config_file >= 0)
            {
                Dump_Turret_Settings();
                if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/turrets/all.qh", "87")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Dumping turrets...                 fclose(tur_config_file);
                tur_config_file = -1;
                tur_config_alsoprint = -1;
            }
            else
            {
                if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/turrets/all.qh", "94")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("^1Error: ^7Could not open file '%s'!", filename); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
            }



            return;
        }

        default:
        case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
        {
            if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 ", "sv_cmd", " dumpturrets [<filename>]"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
            if(1){ string __s = sprintf("  Where <filename> is the file to write (default is %s),", "turrets_dump.cfg"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
            if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  if supplied with '-' output to console as well as default,"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
            if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  if left blank, it will only write to default."); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
            return;
        }
    }
}

# 9 "./server/antilag.qc" 2



const float ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS = 64;
.vector antilag_origins[ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS];
.float antilag_times[ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS];
.float antilag_index;
.vector antilag_saved_origin;
.float antilag_takenback;

.float antilag_debug;

void antilag_record(entity e, entity store, float t)
{
 if (e.vehicle) {
  if (e.vehicle.vehicle_flags == VHF_PLAYERSLOT) return;
  antilag_record(e.vehicle, e.vehicle, t);
 }

 if (time < store.antilag_times[store.antilag_index]) return;
 store.antilag_index += 1;
 if (store.antilag_index >= ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS)
  store.antilag_index = 0;
 store.antilag_times[store.antilag_index] = t;
 store.antilag_origins[store.antilag_index] = e.origin;

 if (store.antilag_debug)
  te_spark(antilag_takebackorigin(e, store, t - store.antilag_debug), '0 0 0', 32);
}


float antilag_find(entity e, entity store, float t)
{
 for(float i = store.antilag_index; i > 0; --i)
  if(store.antilag_times[i] >= t)
   if(store.antilag_times[i - 1] < t)
    return i - 1;

 if(store.antilag_times[0] >= t)
  if(store.antilag_times[ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS - 1] < t)
   return ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS - 1;

 for(float i = ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS - 1; i > store.antilag_index + 1; --i)
  if(store.antilag_times[i] >= t)
   if(store.antilag_times[i - 1] < t)
    return i - 1;


 return -1;
}

vector antilag_takebackorigin(entity e, entity store, float t)
{
 float i0 = antilag_find(e, store, t);
 if (i0 < 0)
 {

  if(store.antilag_takenback)
   return store.antilag_saved_origin;
  else
   return e.origin;
 }
 float i1 = i0 + 1;
 if (i1 >= ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS)
  i1 = 0;

 return lerpv(store.antilag_times[i0], store.antilag_origins[i0], store.antilag_times[i1], store.antilag_origins[i1], t);
}

vector antilag_takebackavgvelocity(entity e, entity store, float t0, float t1)
{
 if (t0 >= t1) return '0 0 0';
 vector o0 = antilag_takebackorigin(e, store, t0);
 vector o1 = antilag_takebackorigin(e, store, t1);
 return (o1 - o0) * (1 / (t1 - t0));
}

void antilag_takeback(entity e, entity store, float t)
{
 if (e.vehicle) {
  if (e.vehicle.vehicle_flags == VHF_PLAYERSLOT) return;
  antilag_takeback(e.vehicle, e.vehicle, t);
 }

 if (!store.antilag_takenback)
  store.antilag_saved_origin = e.origin;

 vector org = antilag_takebackorigin(e, store, t);
 setorigin(e, org);
 store.antilag_takenback = true;
}

void antilag_restore(entity e, entity store)
{
 if (e.vehicle) {
  if (e.vehicle.vehicle_flags == VHF_PLAYERSLOT) return;
  antilag_restore(e.vehicle, e.vehicle);
 }

 if (!store.antilag_takenback) return;

 setorigin(e, store.antilag_saved_origin);
 store.antilag_takenback = false;
}

void antilag_clear(entity e, entity store)
{
 antilag_restore(e, store);
 for (float i = 0; i < ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS; ++i) {
  store.antilag_times[i] = -2342;
  store.antilag_origins[i] = e.origin;
 }
 store.antilag_index = ANTILAG_MAX_ORIGINS - 1;
}

float antilag_getlag(entity e)
{
 float lag = (((clienttype(e) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) ? min(0.4, (e._cs).ping * 0.001) : 0);
 float noantilag = (((e.flags & FL_CLIENT)) ? (e).cvar_cl_noantilag : false);
 if(autocvar_g_antilag == 0 || noantilag || lag < 0.001)
  lag = 0;

 return lag;
}

void tracebox_antilag_force_wz (entity source, vector v1, vector mi, vector ma, vector v2, float nomonst, entity forent, float lag, float wz)
{

 if (lag < 0.001)
  lag = 0;
 if (!(clienttype(forent) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
  lag = 0;


 float oldsolid = source.dphitcontentsmask;
 if(source)
  source.dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;

 if (lag)
  antilag_takeback_all(forent, lag);


 if(wz)
  WarpZone_TraceBox (v1, mi, ma, v2, nomonst, forent);
 else
  tracebox (v1, mi, ma, v2, nomonst, forent);


 if (lag)
  antilag_restore_all(forent);


 if(source)
  source.dphitcontentsmask = oldsolid;
}

float Campaign_Invalid()
{
 string thismapname, wantedmapname;
 thismapname = GetMapname();
 wantedmapname = campaign_gametype[0];
 if(MapInfo_CurrentGametype() != MapInfo_Type_FromString(wantedmapname, false, false))
  return CampaignBailout("wrong game type!");
 wantedmapname = campaign_mapname[0];
 if(wantedmapname != thismapname)
  return CampaignBailout(strcat("wrong map: ", wantedmapname, " != ", thismapname));
 return 0;
}

void CampaignPreInit()
{
 float baseskill;
 campaign_level = autocvar__campaign_index;
 campaign_name = strzone(autocvar__campaign_name);
 campaign_index_var = strzone(strcat("g_campaign", campaign_name, "_index"));
 CampaignFile_Load(campaign_level, 2);

 if(campaign_entries < 1)
 {
  CampaignBailout("unknown map");
  return;
 }

 if(autocvar_sv_cheats)
 {
  MapInfo_SwitchGameType(MapInfo_Type_FromString(campaign_gametype[0], false, false));
  CampaignFile_Unload();
  CampaignBailout("JOLLY CHEATS AHAHAHAHAHAHAH))");
  return;
 }

 baseskill = max(0, autocvar_g_campaign_skill + campaign_botskill[0]);
 campaign_forcewin = false;

 cvar_set("sv_public", "0");
 cvar_set("pausable", "1");

 string cvar_campaignwrapper_list = strcat("; ", campaign_mutators[0], "; ");
 float argc = _tokenizebyseparator(cvar_campaignwrapper_list, "; ");
 if(argc > 0)
 {
  for(float j = 0; j < argc; ++j)
  {
   string arg = argv(j);
   if(arg == "") continue;
   _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(mapname, cvar_string("g_mapinfo_settemp_acl"), 0, arg, 1);
  }
 }

 cvar_settemp("g_campaign", "1");
 cvar_settemp("g_dm", "0");
 cvar_settemp("skill", ftos(baseskill));
 cvar_settemp("bot_number", ftos(campaign_bots[0]));

 MapInfo_SwitchGameType(MapInfo_Type_FromString(campaign_gametype[0], false, false));

 if(Campaign_Invalid())
  return;
}

void CampaignPostInit()
{

 if(Campaign_Invalid())
  return;
 if(autocvar__campaign_testrun)
 {
  cvar_set("fraglimit", "0");
  cvar_set("leadlimit", "0");
  cvar_set("timelimit", "0.01");
 }
 else
 {

  _tokenizebyseparator(campaign_fraglimit[0], "+");
  if(argv(0) != "default") {
   cvar_set("fraglimit", argv(0));
  }
  if(argv(1) != "default") {
   cvar_set("leadlimit", argv(1));
  }
  if(campaign_timelimit[0] != "default") {
   cvar_set("timelimit", campaign_timelimit[0]);
  }
 }
}

void CampaignSaveCvar(string cvarname, float value)
{
 float fh;
 float len;
 string contents;
 string l;

 registercvar(cvarname, ftos(value));
 cvar_set(cvarname, ftos(value));


 fh = fopen("campaign.cfg", FILE_READ);
 contents = "";
 if(fh >= 0)
 {
  while((l = fgets(fh)))
  {
   len = _tokenize_console(l);
   if(len != 3)
    continue;
   if(argv(0) != "set")
    continue;
   if(argv(1) == cvarname)
    continue;
   contents = strcat(contents, "set ", argv(1), " ", argv(2), "\n");
  }
  fclose(fh);
 }
 contents = strcat(contents, "set ", cvarname, " ", ftos(value), "\n");
 fh = fopen("campaign.cfg", FILE_WRITE);
 if(fh >= 0)
 {
  fputs(fh, contents);
 }
 else
 {
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Cannot write to campaign file"));
 }
}

  campaign_won = 1;
  bprint("Campaign test run, advancing level.\n");

 else if(campaign_forcewin)
 {
  campaign_won = 1;
  bprint("The current level has been WON.\n");
 }
 else if(won == 1 && lost == 0 && checkrules_equality == 0)
 {
  if(cvar("timelimit") != 0 && cvar("fraglimit") != 0 && time > cvar("timelimit") * 60)
  {
   campaign_won = 0;
   bprint("Time's up! The current level has been LOST.\n");

  }
  else
  {
   campaign_won = 1;
   bprint("The current level has been WON.\n");

  }
 }
 else if(cvar("timelimit") != 0 && time > cvar("timelimit") * 60)
 {
  campaign_won = 0;
  bprint("Time's up! The current level has been LOST.\n");

 }
 else
 {
  campaign_won = 0;
  bprint("The current level has been LOST.\n");

 }

 if(campaign_won && cheatcount_total == 0 && !autocvar__campaign_testrun)
 {
  if(campaign_level == cvar(campaign_index_var))
  {
   if(campaign_entries < 2)
   {

    savevar = strcat("g_campaign", campaign_name, "_won");
    CampaignSaveCvar(savevar, 1);

    CampaignSaveCvar(campaign_index_var, campaign_level + 1);
   }
   else
   {

    CampaignSaveCvar(campaign_index_var, campaign_level + 1);
   }
  }
 }
}

{

 {
  case MSG_ANNCE: return "MSG_ANNCE";
  case MSG_INFO: return "MSG_INFO";
  case MSG_CENTER: return "MSG_CENTER";
  case MSG_MULTI: return "MSG_MULTI";
  case MSG_CHOICE: return "MSG_CHOICE";
  case MSG_CENTER_KILL: return "MSG_CENTER_KILL";

 return "";
}

{

 {
  case 1:
  {


   if(autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info & 2)
   {





    string spree_newline =
     (autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info_newline ? "\n" : "");


    if(spree > 1)
    {



     switch(spree)
     {
      case 3: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made a TRIPLE SCORE! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made a TRIPLE SCORE! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 made a TRIPLE FRAG! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 5: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 unlocked RAGE! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 10: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made TEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made TEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 started a MASSACRE! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 15: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made FIFTEEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made FIFTEEN SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 executed MAYHEM! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 20: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made TWENTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made TWENTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 is a BERSERKER! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 25: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made TWENTY FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made TWENTY FIVE SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 inflicts CARNAGE! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); } case 30: { return sprintf(CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made THIRTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made THIRTY SCORES IN A ROW! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 unleashes ARMAGEDDON! %s^BG"))), player, spree_newline); }
      default:
      {
       if (!autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info_specialonly)
       {
        return
         sprintf(
          CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 made %d scores in a row! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 made %d scores in a row! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 has %d frags in a row! %s^BG"))


           ),
          player,
          spree,
          spree_newline
         );
       }
       else { return ""; }
      }
     }


    }
    else if(spree == -1)
    {
     return
      sprintf(
       CCR(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_("%s^K1 got the first score! %s^BG") != "")) ? _("%s^K1 got the first score! %s^BG") : _("%s^K1 drew first blood! %s^BG"))


        ),
       player,
       spree_newline
      );
    }
   }
   break;
  }

  case -1:
  {
   if((spree > 1) && (autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info & 1))
   {
    return
     sprintf(((autocvar_sv_gentle && (_(", ending their %d score spree") != "")) ? _(", ending their %d score spree") : _(", ending their %d frag spree"))


       ,
      spree
     );
   }
   break;
  }

  case -2:
  {
   if((spree > 1) && (autocvar_notification_show_sprees_info & 1))
   {
    return

       ,
      spree
     );
   }
   break;
  }
 }
 return "";
}

string notif_arg_item_wepammo(float f1, float f2)
{
 string ammoitems = "";
 Weapon wep = Weapons_from(f1);

 switch (wep.ammo_type)
 {
  case RES_SHELLS: ammoitems = ITEM_Shells.m_name; break;
  case RES_BULLETS: ammoitems = ITEM_Bullets.m_name; break;
  case RES_ROCKETS: ammoitems = ITEM_Rockets.m_name; break;
  case RES_CELLS: ammoitems = ITEM_Cells.m_name; break;
  case RES_PLASMA: ammoitems = ITEM_Plasma.m_name; break;
  case RES_FUEL: ammoitems = ITEM_JetpackFuel.m_name; break;
  default: return "";
 }
 return sprintf(_(" with %d %s"), f2, strtolower(ammoitems));
}

Notification Get_Notif_Ent(MSG net_type, float net_name)
{
 Notification it = Notifications_from(net_name);
 if (it.nent_type != net_type) {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/notifications/all.qh", "751")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Get_Notif_Ent(%s (%d), %s (%d)): Improper net type '%s'!", Get_Notif_TypeName(net_type), net_type, it.registered_id, net_name, Get_Notif_TypeName(it.nent_type)), "\n")); }else voidfunc()



   ;
  return (0, world);
 }
 return it;
}

string NearestLocation(vector p)
{
    string ret = "somewhere";
    entity loc = findnearest(p, false, '1 1 1');
    if (loc)
        ret = loc.message;
    else
    {
        loc = findnearest(p, true, '1 1 4');
        if (loc)
            ret = loc.netname;
    }
    return ret;
}

string PlayerHealth(entity this)
{
 float myhealth = floor(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH));
 if(myhealth == -666)
  return "spectating";
 else if(myhealth == -2342 || (myhealth == 2342 && mapvote_initialized))
  return "observing";
 else if(myhealth <= 0 || ((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return "dead";
 return ftos(myhealth);
}

string WeaponNameFromWeaponentity(entity this, .entity weaponentity)
{
 entity wepent = this.(weaponentity);
 if(!wepent)
  return "none";
 else if(wepent.m_weapon != WEP_Null)
  return wepent.m_weapon.m_name;
 else if(wepent.m_switchweapon != WEP_Null)
  return wepent.m_switchweapon.m_name;
 return "none";
}

string formatmessage(entity this, string msg)
{
 float p, p1, p2;
 float n;
 vector cursor = '0 0 0';
 entity cursor_ent = (0, world);
 string escape;
 string replacement;
 p = 0;
 n = 7;
 float traced = false;

 __Mutator_Send_PreFormatMessage(0 , this, msg);
 msg = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_string;

 while (1) {
  if (n < 1)
   break;

  n = n - 1;
  p1 = _strstrofs(msg, "%", p);
  p2 = _strstrofs(msg, "\\", p);

  if (p1 < 0)
   p1 = p2;

  if (p2 < 0)
   p2 = p1;

  p = min(p1, p2);

  if (p < 0)
   break;

  if(!traced)
  {
   WarpZone_crosshair_trace_plusvisibletriggers(this);
   cursor = trace_endpos;
   cursor_ent = trace_ent;
   traced = true;
  }

  replacement = substring(msg, p, 2);
  escape = substring(msg, p + 1, 1);

  .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[0];

  switch(escape)
  {
   case "%": replacement = "%"; break;
   case "\\":replacement = "\\"; break;
   case "n": replacement = "\n"; break;
   case "a": replacement = ftos(floor(GetResource(this, RES_ARMOR))); break;
   case "h": replacement = PlayerHealth(this); break;
   case "l": replacement = NearestLocation(this.origin); break;
   case "y": replacement = NearestLocation(cursor); break;
   case "d": replacement = NearestLocation(this.death_origin); break;
   case "o": replacement = vtos(this.origin); break;
   case "O": replacement = sprintf("'%f %f %f'", this.origin.x, this.origin.y, this.origin.z); break;
   case "w": replacement = WeaponNameFromWeaponentity(this, weaponentity); break;
   case "W": replacement = GetAmmoName(this.(weaponentity).m_weapon.ammo_type); break;
   case "x": replacement = ((cursor_ent.netname == "" || !cursor_ent) ? "nothing" : cursor_ent.netname); break;
   case "s": replacement = ftos(vlen(this.velocity - this.velocity_z * '0 0 1')); break;
   case "S": replacement = ftos(vlen(this.velocity)); break;
   case "t": replacement = seconds_tostring(ceil(max(0, cvar("timelimit") * 60 + game_starttime - time))); break;
   case "T": replacement = seconds_tostring(floor(time - game_starttime)); break;
   default:
   {
    __Mutator_Send_FormatMessage(0 , this, escape, replacement, msg);
    replacement = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_string;
    break;
   }
  }

  msg = strcat(substring(msg, 0, p), replacement, substring(msg, p+2, _strlen(msg) - (p+2)));
  p = p + _strlen(replacement);
 }
 return msg;
}

.float maycheat;

void CheatInit()
{
 gamestart_sv_cheats = autocvar_sv_cheats;
}

void CheatShutdown()
{
}

float CheatsAllowed(entity this, float i, float argc, float fr)
{
 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return 0;
 if(gamestart_sv_cheats < 2 && !((this).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return 0;

 if(i == CHIMPULSE_CLONE_MOVING.impulse || i == CHIMPULSE_CLONE_STANDING.impulse)
  if(this.lip < autocvar_sv_clones)
   return 1;


 if(this.maycheat)
  return 1;

 if(gamestart_sv_cheats && autocvar_sv_cheats)
  return 1;


 if(i)
  bprint(sprintf("Player %s^7 tried to use cheat 'impulse %d'\n", playername(this.netname, this.team, false), i));
 else if(argc)
  bprint(sprintf("Player %s^7 tried to use cheat '%s'\n", playername(this.netname, this.team, false), argv(0)));
 else if(fr)
  bprint(sprintf("Player %s^7 tried to use cheat frame %d\n", playername(this.netname, this.team, false), fr));
 else
  bprint(sprintf("Player %s^7 tried to use an unknown cheat\n", playername(this.netname, this.team, false)));

 return 0;
}

void Drag_Begin(entity dragger, entity draggee, vector touchpoint)
{
 float tagscale;

 draggee.dragmovetype = draggee.move_movetype;
 draggee.draggravity = draggee.gravity;
 set_movetype(draggee, MOVETYPE_WALK);
 draggee.gravity = 0.00001;
 ((draggee).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
 draggee.draggedby = dragger;

 dragger.dragentity = draggee;

 dragger.dragdistance = vlen(touchpoint - dragger.origin - dragger.view_ofs);
 dragger.draglocalangle = draggee.angles.y - dragger.v_angle.y;

 dragger.draglocalvector_x = touchpoint * v_forward * tagscale;
 dragger.draglocalvector_y = touchpoint * v_right * tagscale;
 dragger.draglocalvector_z = touchpoint * v_up * tagscale;

 dragger.dragspeed = 64;
}

}

{

  return false;

 {
  dragger.dragentity = (0, world);

entity EFFECT_NADE_TRAIL_BURN(float teamid)
{
    switch (teamid) {
        case NUM_TEAM_1: return EFFECT_NADE_TRAIL_BURN_RED;
        case NUM_TEAM_2: return EFFECT_NADE_TRAIL_BURN_BLUE;
        case NUM_TEAM_3: return EFFECT_NADE_TRAIL_BURN_YELLOW;
        case NUM_TEAM_4: return EFFECT_NADE_TRAIL_BURN_PINK;
        default: return EFFECT_NADE_TRAIL_BURN_NEUTRAL;
    }
}

string CheckPlayerModel(string plyermodel) {
 if(FallbackPlayerModel != cvar_defstring("_cl_playermodel"))
 {



  FallbackPlayerModel = strzone(cvar_defstring("_cl_playermodel"));
 }

 if(substring(plyermodel, 0, 14) != "models/player/")
  return FallbackPlayerModel;

 if(substring(plyermodel, -4, 4) != ".iqm"
  && substring(plyermodel, -4, 4) != ".zym"
  && substring(plyermodel, -4, 4) != ".dpm"
  && substring(plyermodel, -4, 4) != ".md3"
  && substring(plyermodel, -4, 4) != ".psk")
 {
  return FallbackPlayerModel;
 }

 if(substring(plyermodel, -9, 5) == "_lod1" || substring(plyermodel, -9, 5) == "_lod2")
  return FallbackPlayerModel;
 if(plyermodel != strtolower(plyermodel))
  return FallbackPlayerModel;

 if(autocvar_sv_servermodelsonly)
 {
  if(!fexists(plyermodel))
   return FallbackPlayerModel;
 }
 return plyermodel;
}

.float model_randomizer;
void FixPlayermodel(entity player)
{
 string defaultmodel = "";
 float defaultskin = 0;
 if(autocvar_sv_defaultcharacter)
 {
  if(teamplay)
  {
   switch(player.team)
   {
    case NUM_TEAM_1: defaultmodel = autocvar_sv_defaultplayermodel_red; defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_red; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_2: defaultmodel = autocvar_sv_defaultplayermodel_blue; defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_blue; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_3: defaultmodel = autocvar_sv_defaultplayermodel_yellow; defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_yellow; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_4: defaultmodel = autocvar_sv_defaultplayermodel_pink; defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_pink; break;
   }
  }

  if(defaultmodel == "")
  {
   defaultmodel = autocvar_sv_defaultplayermodel;
   defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin;
  }

  float n = _tokenize_console(defaultmodel);
  if(n > 0)
  {
   defaultmodel = argv(floor(n * (player._cs).model_randomizer));

   for (float i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    if ((argv(i) == player.playermodel && defaultskin == stof(player.playerskin)) || argv(i) == strcat(player.playermodel, ":", player.playerskin))
     defaultmodel = argv(i);
  }

  float i = _strstrofs(defaultmodel, ":", 0);
  if(i >= 0)
  {
   defaultskin = stof(substring(defaultmodel, i+1, -1));
   defaultmodel = substring(defaultmodel, 0, i);
  }
 }
 if(autocvar_sv_defaultcharacterskin && !defaultskin)
 {
  if(teamplay)
  {
   switch(player.team)
   {
    case NUM_TEAM_1: defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_red; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_2: defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_blue; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_3: defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_yellow; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_4: defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin_pink; break;
   }
  }

  if(!defaultskin)
   defaultskin = autocvar_sv_defaultplayerskin;
 }

 __Mutator_Send_FixPlayermodel(0 , defaultmodel, defaultskin, player);
 defaultmodel = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_string;
 defaultskin = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_int;

 float chmdl = false;
 float oldskin;
 if(defaultmodel != "")
 {
  if (defaultmodel != player.model)
  {
   vector m1 = player.mins;
   vector m2 = player.maxs;
   setplayermodel (player, defaultmodel);
   setsize (player, m1, m2);
   chmdl = true;
  }

  oldskin = player.skin;
  player.skin = defaultskin;
 } else {
  if (player.playermodel != player.model || player.playermodel == "")
  {
   player.playermodel = CheckPlayerModel(player.playermodel);
   vector m1 = player.mins;
   vector m2 = player.maxs;
   setplayermodel (player, player.playermodel);
   setsize (player, m1, m2);
   chmdl = true;
  }

  if(!autocvar_sv_defaultcharacterskin)
  {
   oldskin = player.skin;
   player.skin = stof(player.playerskin);
  }
  else
  {
   oldskin = player.skin;
   player.skin = defaultskin;
  }
 }

 if(chmdl || oldskin != player.skin)
 {
  player.species = player_getspecies(player);
  if(!autocvar_g_debug_globalsounds)
   UpdatePlayerSounds(player);
 }

 if(!teamplay)
  if(_strlen(autocvar_sv_defaultplayercolors))
   if(player.clientcolors != stof(autocvar_sv_defaultplayercolors))
    setcolor(player, stof(autocvar_sv_defaultplayercolors));
}

float CalcRegen(float current, float stable, float regenfactor, float regenframetime)
{
 if(current > stable)
  return current;
 else if(current > stable - 0.25)
  return stable;
 else
  return min(stable, current + (stable - current) * regenfactor * regenframetime);
}

float CalcRot(float current, float stable, float rotfactor, float rotframetime)
{
 if(current < stable)
  return current;
 else if(current < stable + 0.25)
  return stable;
 else
  return max(stable, current + (stable - current) * rotfactor * rotframetime);
}

void RotRegen(entity this, Resource res, float limit_mod,
 float regenstable, float regenfactor, float regenlinear, float regenframetime,
 float rotstable, float rotfactor, float rotlinear, float rotframetime)
{
 float old = GetResource(this, res);
 float current = old;
 if(current > rotstable)
 {
  if(rotframetime > 0)
  {
   current = CalcRot(current, rotstable, rotfactor, rotframetime);
   current = max(rotstable, current - rotlinear * rotframetime);
  }
 }
 else if(current < regenstable)
 {
  if(regenframetime > 0)
  {
   current = CalcRegen(current, regenstable, regenfactor, regenframetime);
   current = min(regenstable, current + regenlinear * regenframetime);
  }
 }

 float limit = GetResourceLimit(this, res) * limit_mod;
 if(current > limit)
  current = limit;

 if (current != old)
  SetResource(this, res, current);
}

{

  return;

   if(old_spectatee.(weaponentity).arc_beam)
    old_spectatee.(weaponentity).arc_beam.SendFlags |= ARC_SF_SETTINGS;
  }
 }
 if(spectatee)

}

float Spectate(entity this, entity pl)
{
 if(__Mutator_Send_SpectateSet(0 , this, pl))
  return false;
 pl = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;

 SetSpectatee(this, pl);
 return SpectateSet(this);
}

float SpectateNext(entity this)
{
 entity ent = find(this.enemy, classname, STR_PLAYER);

 if (__Mutator_Send_SpectateNext(0 , this, ent))
  ent = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;
 else if (!ent)
  ent = find(ent, classname, STR_PLAYER);

 if(ent) { SetSpectatee(this, ent); }

 return SpectateSet(this);
}

float SpectatePrev(entity this)
{

 entity ent = findchain(classname, STR_PLAYER);
 if (!ent)
  return false;

 entity first = ent;

 if(this.enemy)
 while(ent && ent != this.enemy)
  ent = ent.chain;

 switch (__Mutator_Send_SpectatePrev(0 , this, ent, first))
 {
  case MUT_SPECPREV_FOUND:
   ent = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;
   break;
  case MUT_SPECPREV_RETURN:
   return true;
  case MUT_SPECPREV_CONTINUE:
  default:
  {
   if(ent.chain)
    ent = ent.chain;
   else
    ent = first;
   break;
  }
 }

 SetSpectatee(this, ent);
 return SpectateSet(this);
}

void ShowRespawnCountdown(entity this)
{
 float number;
 if(!((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return;
 else
 {
  number = ceil(this.respawn_time - time);
  if(number <= 0)
   return;
  if(number <= this.respawn_countdown)
  {
   this.respawn_countdown = number - 1;
   if(ceil(this.respawn_time - (time + 0.5)) == number)
    { Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, this, MSG_ANNCE, Announcer_PickNumber(CNT_RESPAWN, number)); }
  }
 }
}

float GetPlayerLimit()
{
 if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_DUEL))
  return 2;

 float player_limit = (autocvar_g_maxplayers >= 0 || intermission_running) ? autocvar_g_maxplayers : map_maxplayers;
 __Mutator_Send_GetPlayerLimit(0 , player_limit);

float nJoinAllowed(entity this, entity ignore)
{
 if(!ignore)


 {
  if(autocvar_g_forced_team_otherwise == "spectate")
   return 0;
  if(autocvar_g_forced_team_otherwise == "spectator")
   return 0;
 }

 if(this && (Player_GetForcedTeamIndex(this) == TEAM_FORCE_SPECTATOR))
  return 0;

 static float msg_time = 0;
 if(this && !((this).ingame) && ignore && PlayerInList(this, autocvar_g_playban_list))
 {
  if(time > msg_time)
  {
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, this, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_JOIN_PLAYBAN);
   msg_time = time + 0.5;
  }
  return 0;
 }


 float totalClients = 0;
 float currentlyPlaying = 0;
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { if(it != ignore) ++totalClients; if((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((it).ingame))) ++currentlyPlaying; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




   ;

 float player_limit = GetPlayerLimit();

 float free_slots = 0;
 if (!player_limit)
  free_slots = maxclients - totalClients;
 else if(player_limit > 0 && currentlyPlaying < player_limit)
  free_slots = min(maxclients - totalClients, player_limit - currentlyPlaying);

 if(this && !((this).ingame) && ignore && !free_slots && time > msg_time)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, this, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_JOIN_PREVENT, player_limit);
  msg_time = time + 0.5;
 }

 return free_slots;
}

float PlayerThink(entity this)
{
 if (game_stopped || intermission_running) {
  this.modelflags &= ~MF_ROCKET;
  if(intermission_running)
   IntermissionThink(this);
  return false;
 }

 if (timeout_status == TIMEOUT_ACTIVE) {


  this.v_angle = this.lastV_angle;
  this.angles = this.lastV_angle;
  this.fixangle = true;
 }

 if (frametime) player_powerups(this);

 if (frametime && autocvar_sv_show_entnum) show_entnum(this);

 if (((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO)) {
  if (this.personal && g_race_qualifying) {
   if (time > this.respawn_time) {
    (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME = this.respawn_time = time + 1;
    respawn(this);
    (this._cs).impulse = CHIMPULSE_SPEEDRUN.impulse;
   }
  } else {
   if (frametime) player_anim(this);

   if (this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_DENY)
   {
    (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME = 0;
    return false;
   }

   float button_pressed = (((this._cs).button0) || ((this._cs).button2) || ((this._cs).button3) || ((this._cs).button6) || ((this._cs).buttonuse));

   switch(this.deadflag)
   {
    case DEAD_DYING:
    {
     if ((this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_FORCE) && !(this.respawn_time < this.respawn_time_max))
      this.deadflag = DEAD_RESPAWNING;
     else if (!button_pressed || (time >= this.respawn_time_max && (this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_FORCE)))
      this.deadflag = DEAD_DEAD;
     break;
    }
    case DEAD_DEAD:
    {
     if (button_pressed)
      this.deadflag = DEAD_RESPAWNABLE;
     else if (time >= this.respawn_time_max && (this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_FORCE))
      this.deadflag = DEAD_RESPAWNING;
     break;
    }
    case DEAD_RESPAWNABLE:
    {
     if (!button_pressed || (this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_FORCE))
      this.deadflag = DEAD_RESPAWNING;
     break;
    }
    case DEAD_RESPAWNING:
    {
     if (time > this.respawn_time)
     {
      this.respawn_time = time + 1;
      this.respawn_time_max = this.respawn_time;
      respawn(this);
     }
     break;
    }
   }

   ShowRespawnCountdown(this);

   if (this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_SILENT)
    (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME = 0;
   else if ((this.respawn_flags & RESPAWN_FORCE) && this.respawn_time < this.respawn_time_max)
   {
    if (time < this.respawn_time)
     (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME = this.respawn_time;
    else if (this.deadflag != DEAD_RESPAWNING)
     (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME = -this.respawn_time_max;
   }
   else
    (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME = this.respawn_time;
  }


  if (this.deadflag == DEAD_RESPAWNING && (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME > 0)
   (this).stat_RESPAWN_TIME *= -1;

  return false;
 }

 FixPlayermodel(this);

 if (this.shootfromfixedorigin != autocvar_g_shootfromfixedorigin) {
  this.shootfromfixedorigin = autocvar_g_shootfromfixedorigin;
  if(1){ entity _cl = (this); if ((clienttype(_cl) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) stuffcmd(_cl, sprintf("\ncl_shootfromfixedorigin \"%s\"\n", autocvar_g_shootfromfixedorigin)); }else voidfunc();
 }



 float dualwielding = W_DualWielding(this);
 if(this.dualwielding_prev != dualwielding)
 {
  W_ResetGunAlign(this, (this).cvar_cl_gunalign);
  this.dualwielding_prev = dualwielding;
 }



 {
  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   if((_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_always))
    W_Vortex_Charge(this, weaponentity, frametime);
   W_WeaponFrame(this, weaponentity);
  }
 }

 if (frametime)
 {


  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   if ((_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_rot_rate) && this.(weaponentity).vortex_charge > (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_limit) && this.(weaponentity).vortex_charge_rottime < time)
    this.(weaponentity).vortex_charge = bound((_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_limit), this.(weaponentity).vortex_charge - (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_rot_rate) * frametime / W_TICSPERFRAME, 1);
  }

  player_regen(this);
  player_anim(this);
  this.dmg_team = max(0, this.dmg_team - autocvar_g_teamdamage_resetspeed * frametime);
 }

 monsters_setstatus(this);

 return true;
}

   this.flags &= ~FL_JUMPRELEASED;
   if(SpectateNext(this)) {
    if(1){ entity _e = (this); if (_e.vtblbase != Spectator_vtbl) { _e.transmute = true; _e.classname = "Spectator"; spawnSpectator_1(_e ); } }else voidfunc();
   } else if (is_spec) {

    _PutClientInServer(this);
   }
   else
    this.would_spectate = false;
   if (is_spec)
    (this._cs).impulse = 0;
  } else if (is_spec) {
   if((this._cs).impulse == 12 || (this._cs).impulse == 16 || (this._cs).impulse == 19 || ((this._cs).impulse >= 220 && (this._cs).impulse <= 229)) {
    this.flags &= ~FL_JUMPRELEASED;

    } else {

     _PutClientInServer(this);

    (this._cs).impulse = 0;

   }

void PlayerUseKey(entity this)
{
 if (!((this).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return;

 if(this.vehicle)
 {
  if(!game_stopped)
  {
   vehicles_exit(this.vehicle, VHEF_NORMAL);
   return;
  }
 }
 else if(autocvar_g_vehicles_enter)
 {
  if(!game_stopped && !(this).stat_FROZEN && !((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !((this).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER))
  {
   entity head, closest_target = (0, world);
   head = WarpZone_FindRadius(this.origin, autocvar_g_vehicles_enter_radius, true);

   while(head)
   {
    if((head.vehicle_flags & VHF_ISVEHICLE) && !((head).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && head.takedamage != DAMAGE_NO)
    if(!head.owner || ((head.vehicle_flags & VHF_MULTISLOT) && (teamplay ? (head.owner.team == this.team) : (head.owner == this))))
    {
     if(closest_target)
     {
      if((_vlen2 = (this.origin - head.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (this.origin - closest_target.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))))
      { closest_target = head; }
     }
     else { closest_target = head; }
    }

    head = head.chain;
   }

   if(closest_target) { vehicles_enter(this, closest_target); return; }
  }
 }


 __Mutator_Send_PlayerUseKey(0 , this);
}

string Buff_CompatName(string buffname)
{
    switch(buffname)
    {
        case "ammoregen": return "ammo";
        case "doubler": return "inferno";
        case "scout": return "bash";
        case "guard": return "resistance";
        case "revival": case "regen": return "medic";
        case "jumper": return "jump";
        case "invulnerability": return "vampire";
        case "kamikaze": return "vengeance";
        case "teleporter": return "swapper";
        default: return buffname;
    }
}

void GiveFrags(entity attacker, entity targ, float f, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity)
{

 if(game_stopped) return;

 if(f < 0)
 {
  if(targ == attacker)
  {

   _GameRules_scoring_add(attacker, SP_SUICIDES, 1);
  }
  else
  {

   _GameRules_scoring_add(attacker, SP_TEAMKILLS, 1);
  }
 }
 else
 {

  _GameRules_scoring_add(attacker, SP_KILLS, 1);
  if(!warmup_stage && targ.playerid)
   PlayerStats_GameReport_Event(attacker.playerstats_id, sprintf("kills-%d", targ.playerid), 1);
 }

 _GameRules_scoring_add(targ, SP_DEATHS, 1);


 if(__Mutator_Send_GiveFragsForKill(0 , attacker, targ, f, deathtype, attacker.(weaponentity)))
  f = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_float;

 attacker.totalfrags += f;

 if(f)
  UpdateFrags(attacker, f);
}

{

 if(!autocvar_sv_eventlog)
  return;

  s = AppendItemcodes(s, killed);
 }

}

 return __Mutator_Send_FragCenterMessage(0 , attacker, targ, deathtype, kill_count_to_attacker, kill_count_to_target);
}

void Ice_Think(entity this)
{
 if(!(this.owner).stat_FROZEN || this.owner.iceblock != this)
 {
  if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }
 vector ice_org = this.owner.origin - '0 0 16';
 if (this.origin != ice_org)
  setorigin(this, ice_org);
 this.nextthink = time;
}

void Damage(entity targ, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 float complainteamdamage = 0;
 float mirrordamage = 0;
 float mirrorforce = 0;

 if (game_stopped || ((targ.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (targ._cs).killcount == FRAGS_SPECTATOR))
  return;

 entity attacker_save = attacker;


 if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_HOOK)) || (deathtype & HITTYPE_SOUND))
 {
  if(((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (teamplay ? (targ.team == attacker.team) : (targ == attacker)))
  {
   return;
  }
 }

 if(deathtype == DEATH_KILL.m_id || deathtype == DEATH_TEAMCHANGE.m_id || deathtype == DEATH_AUTOTEAMCHANGE.m_id)
 {

   vehicles_exit(targ.vehicle, VHEF_RELEASE);




  if(deathtype == DEATH_TEAMCHANGE.m_id || deathtype == DEATH_AUTOTEAMCHANGE.m_id)
  {

 else
 {

  if(deathtype != DEATH_TELEFRAG.m_id)
  if(((attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  {


   if((((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER) && targ != attacker && (((attacker).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER) || ((targ).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER))) ||
    (targ.realowner && ((targ.realowner).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER) && attacker != targ.realowner))
   {
    damage = 0;
    force = '0 0 0';
   }
   else if(!(targ).stat_FROZEN && (teamplay ? (attacker.team == targ.team) : (attacker == targ)))
   {
    if(autocvar_teamplay_mode == 1)

    else if(attacker != targ)

     if(autocvar_teamplay_mode == 2)
     {
      if(((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((targ).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
      {
       attacker.dmg_team = attacker.dmg_team + damage;
       complainteamdamage = attacker.dmg_team - autocvar_g_teamdamage_threshold;
      }
     }
     else if(autocvar_teamplay_mode == 3)
      damage = 0;
     else if(autocvar_teamplay_mode == 4)
     {
      if(((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((targ).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
      {
       attacker.dmg_team = attacker.dmg_team + damage;
       complainteamdamage = attacker.dmg_team - autocvar_g_teamdamage_threshold;
       if(complainteamdamage > 0)
        mirrordamage = autocvar_g_mirrordamage * complainteamdamage;
       mirrorforce = autocvar_g_mirrordamage * vlen(force);
       damage = autocvar_g_friendlyfire * damage;


       if(autocvar_g_mirrordamage_virtual)
       {
        vector v = healtharmor_applydamage(GetResource(attacker, RES_ARMOR), autocvar_g_balance_armor_blockpercent, deathtype, mirrordamage);
        attacker.dmg_take += v.x;
        attacker.dmg_save += v.y;
        attacker.dmg_inflictor = inflictor;
        mirrordamage = v.z;
        mirrorforce = 0;
       }

       if(autocvar_g_friendlyfire_virtual)
       {
        vector v = healtharmor_applydamage(GetResource(targ, RES_ARMOR), autocvar_g_balance_armor_blockpercent, deathtype, damage);
        targ.dmg_take += v.x;
        targ.dmg_save += v.y;
        targ.dmg_inflictor = inflictor;
        damage = 0;
        if(!autocvar_g_friendlyfire_virtual_force)
         force = '0 0 0';
       }
      }
      else if(!targ.canteamdamage)
       damage = 0;
     }
    }
   }
  }

  if (!(deathtype >= DT_FIRST))
  {
   damage *= autocvar_g_weapondamagefactor;
   mirrordamage *= autocvar_g_weapondamagefactor;
   complainteamdamage *= autocvar_g_weapondamagefactor;
   force = force * autocvar_g_weaponforcefactor;
   mirrorforce *= autocvar_g_weaponforcefactor;
  }


  __Mutator_Send_Damage_Calculate(0 , inflictor, attacker, targ, deathtype, damage, mirrordamage, force, attacker.(weaponentity));

  mirrordamage = MUTATOR_ARGV_5_float;
  force = MUTATOR_ARGV_6_vector;

  {
   for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)

  }

  if (targ == attacker)
   damage = damage * autocvar_g_balance_selfdamagepercent;

  if(targ.takedamage == DAMAGE_AIM)

   else
    victim = targ;

   if(((victim).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((victim.turret_flags & TUR_FLAG_ISTURRET) && victim.active == ACTIVE_ACTIVE) || (victim.flags & FL_MONSTER) || __Mutator_Send_PlayHitsound(0 , victim, attacker))
   {

    {
     if(damage > 0)
     {

      {
       if(((victim._cs).buttonchat))
        attacker.typehitsound += 1;
       else
        attacker.hitsound_damage_dealt += damage;
      }

      impressive_hits += 1;

      if (!(deathtype >= DT_FIRST))
      {
       if(((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER))
       if(IsFlying(victim))
        yoda = 1;
      }
     }

    else if (((attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !(victim).stat_FROZEN)

     }

      {
       (attacker._cs).teamkill_complain = time + 5;
       (attacker._cs).teamkill_soundtime = time + 0.4;
       (attacker._cs).teamkill_soundsource = targ;
      }
    }
   }
  }
 }


 if (targ.damageforcescale)
 if (force)

float Fire_AddDamage(entity e, entity o, float d, float t, float dt)
{
 float dps;
 float maxtime, mintime, maxdamage, mindamage, maxdps, mindps, totaldamage, totaltime;

 if(((e).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 {
  if(((e).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
   return -1;
 }

 t = max(t, 0.1);
 dps = d / t;
 if(StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_Burning, e))
 {
  float fireendtime = StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Burning, e);

  mintime = fireendtime - time;
  maxtime = max(mintime, t);

  mindps = e.fire_damagepersec;
  maxdps = max(mindps, dps);

  if(maxtime > mintime || maxdps > mindps)
  {



   mindamage = mindps * mintime;


   maxdamage = mindamage + d;


   totaldamage = min(maxdamage, maxtime * maxdps);
# 1138 "./server/damage.qc"
   totaltime = min(maxtime, totaldamage / mindps);
# 1160 "./server/damage.qc"
   e.fire_damagepersec = totaldamage / totaltime;
   StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Burning, e, time + totaltime, 0);
   if(totaldamage > 1.2 * mindamage)
   {
    e.fire_deathtype = dt;
    if(e.fire_owner != o)
    {
     e.fire_owner = o;
     e.fire_hitsound = false;
    }
   }
   if(accuracy_isgooddamage(o, e))
    accuracy_add(o, ((dt >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((dt) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)), 0, max(0, totaldamage - mindamage));
   return max(0, totaldamage - mindamage);
  }
  else
   return 0;
 }
 else
 {
  e.fire_damagepersec = dps;
  StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Burning, e, time + t, 0);
  e.fire_deathtype = dt;
  e.fire_owner = o;
  e.fire_hitsound = false;
  if(accuracy_isgooddamage(o, e))
   accuracy_add(o, ((dt >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((dt) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)), 0, d);
  return d;
 }
}

   string fn = ftos(matches);
