 return Team_GetTeamFromIndex(index);
}

void SetPlayerColors(entity player, float _color)
{
 float pants = _color & 0x0F;
 float shirt = _color & 0xF0;
 if (teamplay)
 {
  setcolor(player, 16 * pants + pants);
 }
 else
 {
  setcolor(player, shirt + pants);
 }
}

float Player_SetTeamIndex(entity player, float index)
{
 float new_team = Team_IndexToTeam(index);
 if (player.team == new_team)
 {
  if (new_team != -1)
  {



   SetPlayerColors(player, new_team - 1);
  }
  return true;
 }
 float old_index = Team_TeamToIndex(player.team);
 if (__Mutator_Send_Player_ChangeTeam(0 , player, old_index, index) == true)
 {

  return false;
 }
 if (new_team == -1)
 {
  player.team = -1;
 }
 else
 {
  SetPlayerColors(player, new_team - 1);
 }
 __Mutator_Send_Player_ChangedTeam(0 , player, old_index, index);
 return true;
}

float SetPlayerTeam(entity player, float team_index, float type)
{
 float old_team_index = Entity_GetTeamIndex(player);

 if (!Player_SetTeamIndex(player, team_index))
  return false;

 LogTeamChange(player.playerid, player.team, type);

 if (team_index != old_team_index)
 {
  KillPlayerForTeamChange(player);
  PlayerScore_Clear(player);

  if (!(clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
   TeamBalance_AutoBalanceBots();

  if (team_index != -1)
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((player.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_JOIN_PLAY_TEAM_RED : ((player.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_JOIN_PLAY_TEAM_BLUE : ((player.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_JOIN_PLAY_TEAM_YELLOW : INFO_JOIN_PLAY_TEAM_PINK))), player.netname);
 }

 if (team_index == -1)
 {
  if (autocvar_sv_maxidle_playertospectator > 0 && (player._cs).idlekick_lasttimeleft)
  {

   Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, player, MSG_CENTER, CPID_IDLING);
   (player._cs).idlekick_lasttimeleft = 0;
  }
  else if (!(player._cs).just_joined && player.frags != FRAGS_SPECTATOR)
  {
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_QUIT_SPECTATE, player.netname);
  }
 }

 return true;
}

void Player_SetTeamIndexChecked(entity player, float team_index)
{
 if (!teamplay)
 {
  return;
 }
 if (!Team_IsValidIndex(team_index))
 {
  return;
 }
 if ((autocvar_g_campaign) || (autocvar_g_changeteam_banned &&
  (player._cs).wasplayer))
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_INFO,
   INFO_TEAMCHANGE_NOTALLOWED);
  return;
 }
 entity balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams(player);
 if (team_index == 1 && !TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 1))
 {
  team_index = 4;
 }
 if (team_index == 4 && !TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 4))
 {
  team_index = 3;
 }
 if (team_index == 3 && !TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 3))
 {
  team_index = 2;
 }
 if (team_index == 2 && !TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 2))
 {
  team_index = 1;
 }

 if (autocvar_g_balance_teams && autocvar_g_balance_teams_prevent_imbalance)
 {
  TeamBalance_GetTeamCounts(balance, player);
  if ((Team_IndexToBit(team_index) & TeamBalance_FindBestTeams(balance,
   player, false)) == 0)
  {
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_INFO,
    INFO_TEAMCHANGE_LARGERTEAM);
   TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
   return;
  }
 }
 TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
 SetPlayerTeam(player, team_index, TEAM_CHANGE_MANUAL);
}

float MoveToTeam(entity client, float team_index, float type)
{

 float lockteams_backup = lockteams;
 lockteams = 0;
 if (!SetPlayerTeam(client, team_index, type))
 {
  lockteams = lockteams_backup;
  return false;
 }
 lockteams = lockteams_backup;
 return true;
}

}

   }

void Player_DetermineForcedTeam(entity player)
{
 if (autocvar_g_campaign)
 {
  if ((clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
  {
   if (Team_IsValidIndex(autocvar_g_campaign_forceteam))
   {
    player.team_forced = autocvar_g_campaign_forceteam;
   }
   else
   {
    player.team_forced = TEAM_FORCE_DEFAULT;
   }
  }
 }
 else if (PlayerInList(player, autocvar_g_forced_team_red))
 {
  player.team_forced = 1;
 }
 else if (PlayerInList(player, autocvar_g_forced_team_blue))
 {
  player.team_forced = 2;
 }
 else if (PlayerInList(player, autocvar_g_forced_team_yellow))
 {
  player.team_forced = 3;
 }
 else if (PlayerInList(player, autocvar_g_forced_team_pink))
 {
  player.team_forced = 4;
 }
 else
 {
  switch (autocvar_g_forced_team_otherwise)
  {
   case "red":
   {
    player.team_forced = 1;
    break;
   }
   case "blue":
   {
    player.team_forced = 2;
    break;
   }
   case "yellow":
   {
    player.team_forced = 3;
    break;
   }
   case "pink":
   {
    player.team_forced = 4;
    break;
   }
   case "spectate":
   case "spectator":
   {
    player.team_forced = TEAM_FORCE_SPECTATOR;
    break;
   }
   default:
   {
    player.team_forced = TEAM_FORCE_DEFAULT;
    break;
   }
  }
 }
 if (!teamplay && Player_HasRealForcedTeam(player))
 {
  player.team_forced = TEAM_FORCE_DEFAULT;
 }
}

void TeamBalance_JoinBestTeam(entity player)
{

 if (!teamplay)
 {
  return;
 }
 if (player.bot_forced_team)
 {
  return;
 }
 entity balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams(player);
 if (Player_HasRealForcedTeam(player))
 {
  float forced_team_index = player.team_forced;
  float is_team_allowed = TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance,
   forced_team_index);
  TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
  if (!is_team_allowed)
  {
   return;
  }
  if (!SetPlayerTeam(player, forced_team_index, TEAM_CHANGE_AUTO))
  {
   return;
  }
  return;
 }
 float best_team_index = TeamBalance_FindBestTeam(balance, player, true);
 TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
 if (!SetPlayerTeam(player, best_team_index, TEAM_CHANGE_AUTO))
 {
  return;
 }
}

    if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 4))

     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 4);
    }
    else if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 3))

     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 3);

    else

     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 2);

    }
    else if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 2))
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 2);
    }
    else
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 3);
    }

   }
  }
  else
  {

   if ((clienttype(for_whom) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
   {
    if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 1))
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 1);
    }
    else if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 2))
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 2);
    }
    else
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 3);
    }

   }

   {
    if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 4))
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 4);
    }
    else if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, 3))
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 3);
    }
    else
    {
     TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, 2);
    }

   }
  }
 }

 if (!for_whom)

  balance.m_team_balance_state = TEAM_BALANCE_TEAMS_CHECKED;
  return balance;
 }


 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  if (for_whom.team_forced == i &&
   TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, i))
  {
   TeamBalance_BanTeamsExcept(balance, i);
   break;
  }
 }
 balance.m_team_balance_state = TEAM_BALANCE_TEAMS_CHECKED;
 return balance;
}

float TeamBalance_FindBestTeam(entity balance, entity player, float ignore_player)
{

  TeamBalance_GetTeamCounts(balance, player);

   RandomSelection_Add((0, world), i, nil, '0 0 0', 1, 1);

float TeamBalance_FindBestTeams(entity balance, entity player, float use_score)
{
 if (balance == (0, world))
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^1FATAL""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/teamplay.qc", "823")), "\n"))); (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("TeamBalance_FindBestTeams: Team balance entity is NULL."), "\n"))); }else voidfunc();
 }
 if (balance.m_team_balance_state != TEAM_BALANCE_TEAM_COUNTS_FILLED)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^1FATAL""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/teamplay.qc", "827")), "\n"))); (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("TeamBalance_FindBestTeams: " "TeamBalance_GetTeamCounts has not been called."), "\n"))); }else voidfunc()
                                                    ;
 }
 if (__Mutator_Send_TeamBalance_FindBestTeams(0 , player) == true)
 {
  return MUTATOR_ARGV_1_float;
 }
 float team_bits = 0;
 float previous_team = 0;
 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  if (!TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowedInternal(balance, i))
  {
   continue;
  }
  if (previous_team == 0)
  {
   team_bits = Team_IndexToBit(i);
   previous_team = i;
   continue;
  }
  float compare = TeamBalance_CompareTeams(balance, i, previous_team,
   player, use_score);
  if (compare == TEAMS_COMPARE_LESS)
  {
   team_bits = Team_IndexToBit(i);
   previous_team = i;
   continue;
  }
  if (compare == TEAMS_COMPARE_EQUAL)
  {
   team_bits |= Team_IndexToBit(i);
   previous_team = i;
  }
 }
 return team_bits;
}

void TeamBalance_AutoBalanceBots()
{




 entity balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams((0, world));
 TeamBalance_GetTeamCounts(balance, (0, world));
 float smallest_team_index = 0;
 float smallest_team_player_count = 0;
 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  entity team_ = TeamBalance_GetTeamFromIndex(balance, i);
  if (!TeamBalanceTeam_IsAllowed(team_))
  {
   continue;
  }
  float playercount = TeamBalanceTeam_GetNumberOfPlayers(team_);
  if (smallest_team_index == 0)
  {
   smallest_team_index = i;
   smallest_team_player_count = playercount;
  }
  else if (playercount < smallest_team_player_count)
  {
   smallest_team_index = i;
   smallest_team_player_count = playercount;
  }
 }


 entity switchable_bot = (0, world);
 float teams = ((1 << (NUM_TEAMS)) - 1);
 while (teams != 0)
 {
  float largest_team_index = TeamBalance_GetLargestTeamIndex(balance,
   teams);
  if (smallest_team_index == largest_team_index)
  {
   TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
   return;
  }
  entity largest_team = TeamBalance_GetTeamFromIndex(balance,
   largest_team_index);
  float largest_team_player_count = TeamBalanceTeam_GetNumberOfPlayers(
   largest_team);
  if (largest_team_player_count - smallest_team_player_count < 2)
  {
   TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
   return;
  }


  switchable_bot = TeamBalance_GetPlayerForTeamSwitch(largest_team_index,
   smallest_team_index, true);
  if (switchable_bot != (0, world))
  {
   break;
  }
  teams &= ~Team_IndexToBit(largest_team_index);
 }
 TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
 if (switchable_bot == (0, world))
 {

  return;
 }
 SetPlayerTeam(switchable_bot, smallest_team_index, TEAM_CHANGE_AUTO);
}

float TeamBalance_GetLargestTeamIndex(entity balance, float teams)
{
 float largest_team_index = 0;
 float largest_team_player_count = 0;
 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  if (!(Team_IndexToBit(i) & teams))
  {
   continue;
  }
  entity team_ = TeamBalance_GetTeamFromIndex(balance, i);
  if (!TeamBalanceTeam_IsAllowed(team_))
  {
   continue;
  }
  float playercount = TeamBalanceTeam_GetNumberOfPlayers(team_);
  if (largest_team_index == 0)
  {
   largest_team_index = i;
   largest_team_player_count = playercount;
  }
  else if (playercount > largest_team_player_count)
  {
   largest_team_index = i;
   largest_team_player_count = playercount;
  }
 }
 return largest_team_index;
}

float TeamBalance_CompareTeamsInternal(entity team_a, entity team_b,
 entity player, float use_score)
{
 if (team_a == team_b)
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_EQUAL;
 }
 if (!TeamBalanceTeam_IsAllowed(team_a) ||
  !TeamBalanceTeam_IsAllowed(team_b))
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_INVALID;
 }
 float num_players_team_a = team_a.m_num_players;
 float num_players_team_b = team_b.m_num_players;
 if ((clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL) && bots_would_leave)
 {
  num_players_team_a -= team_a.m_num_bots;
  num_players_team_b -= team_b.m_num_bots;
 }
 if (num_players_team_a < num_players_team_b)
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_LESS;
 }
 if (num_players_team_a > num_players_team_b)
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_GREATER;
 }
 if (!use_score)
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_EQUAL;
 }
 if (team_a.m_team_score < team_b.m_team_score)
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_LESS;
 }
 if (team_a.m_team_score > team_b.m_team_score)
 {
  return TEAMS_COMPARE_GREATER;
 }
 return TEAMS_COMPARE_EQUAL;
}

}

const float LATENCY_THINKRATE = 10;
.float latency_sum;
.float latency_cnt;
.float latency_time;
entity pingplreport;
void PingPLReport_Think(entity this)
{
 float delta;
 entity e;

 delta = 3 / maxclients;
 if(delta < sys_frametime)
  delta = 0;
 this.nextthink = time + delta;

 e = edict_num(this.cnt + 1);
 if((e.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (clienttype(e) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
 {
  if(1){ if (NET_TE_CSQC_PINGPLREPORT_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, NET_TE_CSQC_PINGPLREPORT.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, this.cnt);
  WriteShort(MSG_BROADCAST, bound(1, rint((e._cs).ping), 32767));
  WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, min(ceil((e._cs).ping_packetloss * 255), 255));
  WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, min(ceil((e._cs).ping_movementloss * 255), 255));


  if(time > ((e._cs).latency_time + LATENCY_THINKRATE))
  {
   (e._cs).latency_sum += (e._cs).ping;
   (e._cs).latency_cnt += 1;
   (e._cs).latency_time = time;

  }
 }
 else
 {
  if(1){ if (NET_TE_CSQC_PINGPLREPORT_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, NET_TE_CSQC_PINGPLREPORT.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, this.cnt);
  WriteShort(MSG_BROADCAST, 0);
  WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, 0);
  WriteByte(MSG_BROADCAST, 0);
 }
 this.cnt = (this.cnt + 1) % maxclients;
}
void PingPLReport_Spawn()
{
 pingplreport = __spawn("pingplreport", "./server/world.qc" ":" "96", true);
 (_selftemp = (pingplreport), _selftemp.__think = ((PingPLReport_Think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (PingPLReport_Think));
 pingplreport.nextthink = time;
}

void SetDefaultAlpha()
{
 if (!__Mutator_Send_SetDefaultAlpha(0 ))
 {
  default_player_alpha = autocvar_g_player_alpha;
  if(default_player_alpha == 0)
   default_player_alpha = 1;
  default_weapon_alpha = default_player_alpha;
 }
}

void GotoFirstMap(entity this)
{
 float n;
 if(autocvar__sv_init)
 {




  if(autocvar_g_maplist_shuffle)
   ShuffleMaplist();
  n = _tokenizebyseparator(cvar_string("g_maplist"), " ");
  cvar_set("g_maplist_index", ftos(n - 1));

  MapInfo_Enumerate();
  MapInfo_FilterGametype(MapInfo_CurrentGametype(), MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), MapInfo_RequiredFlags(), MapInfo_ForbiddenFlags(), 0);

  if(!DoNextMapOverride(1))
   GotoNextMap(1);

  return;
 }

 if(time < 5)
 {
  this.nextthink = time;
 }
 else
 {
  this.nextthink = time + 1;
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/world.qc", "144")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Waiting for _sv_init being set to 1 by initialization scripts..."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
 }
}

void GameplayMode_DelayedInit(entity this)
{


 if(!scores_initialized)
  ScoreRules_generic();

 if (warmup_stage >= 0 && autocvar_g_maxplayers >= 0)
  return;
 if (!(MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_DUEL))
  MapReadSizes(mapname);

 if (autocvar_g_maxplayers < 0 && teamplay)
 {

  if (map_maxplayers == 0 || map_maxplayers > maxclients)
   map_maxplayers = maxclients;
  float d = map_maxplayers % teamplay;
  float u = teamplay - d;
  map_maxplayers += (u <= d && u + map_maxplayers <= maxclients) ? u : -d;
 }

 if (warmup_stage < 0)
 {
  float m = GetPlayerLimit();
  if (m <= 0) m = maxclients;
  map_minplayers = bound(max(2, teamplay * 2), map_minplayers, m);
  if (teamplay)
  {

   float d = map_minplayers % teamplay;
   float u = teamplay - d;
   map_minplayers += (u < d && u + map_minplayers <= m) ? u : -d;
  }
 }
 else
  map_minplayers = 0;
}

  && (checkrules_overtimesadded < autocvar_timelimit_overtimes || autocvar_timelimit_overtimes < 0)
  && autocvar_timelimit_overtime && !((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE) && !g_race_qualifying))

 else
 {
  if(!checkrules_suddendeathend)
  {

float fragsleft_last;
float WinningCondition_Scores(float limit, float leadlimit)
{

 WinningConditionHelper((0, world));

 if(teamplay)
 {
  for (float i = 1; i < 5; ++i)
  {
   Team_SetTeamScore(Team_GetTeamFromIndex(i),
    TeamScore_GetCompareValue(Team_IndexToTeam(i)));
  }
 }

 ClearWinners();
 if(WinningConditionHelper_winner)
  WinningConditionHelper_winner.winning = 1;
 if(WinningConditionHelper_winnerteam >= 0)
  SetWinners(team, WinningConditionHelper_winnerteam);

 if(WinningConditionHelper_lowerisbetter)
 {
  WinningConditionHelper_topscore = -WinningConditionHelper_topscore;
  WinningConditionHelper_secondscore = -WinningConditionHelper_secondscore;
  limit = -limit;
 }

 if(WinningConditionHelper_zeroisworst)
  leadlimit = 0;

 if(__Mutator_Send_Scores_CountFragsRemaining(0 ))
 {
  float fragsleft;
  if (checkrules_suddendeathend && time >= checkrules_suddendeathend)
  {
   fragsleft = 1;
  }
  else
  {
   fragsleft = FLOAT_MAX;
   float leadingfragsleft = FLOAT_MAX;
   if (limit)
    fragsleft = limit - WinningConditionHelper_topscore;
   if (leadlimit)
    leadingfragsleft = WinningConditionHelper_secondscore + leadlimit - WinningConditionHelper_topscore;

   if (limit && leadlimit && autocvar_leadlimit_and_fraglimit)
    fragsleft = max(fragsleft, leadingfragsleft);
   else
    fragsleft = min(fragsleft, leadingfragsleft);
  }

  if (fragsleft_last != fragsleft)
  {
   if (fragsleft == 1)
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_REMAINING_FRAG_1);
   else if (fragsleft == 2)
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_REMAINING_FRAG_2);
   else if (fragsleft == 3)
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_REMAINING_FRAG_3);

   fragsleft_last = fragsleft;
  }
 }

 float fraglimit_reached = (limit && WinningConditionHelper_topscore >= limit);
 float leadlimit_reached = (leadlimit && WinningConditionHelper_topscore - WinningConditionHelper_secondscore >= leadlimit);

 float limit_reached;

 if (limit && leadlimit && autocvar_leadlimit_and_fraglimit)
  limit_reached = (fraglimit_reached && leadlimit_reached);
 else
  limit_reached = (fraglimit_reached || leadlimit_reached);

 return GetWinningCode(
  WinningConditionHelper_topscore && limit_reached,
  WinningConditionHelper_equality
 );
}

   checkrules_suddendeathwarning = true;
   if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE) && !g_race_qualifying)
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_RACE_FINISHLAP);
   else
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_OVERTIME_FRAG);
  }
 }
 else
 {
  if (timelimit && time >= timelimit)
  {
   if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE) && (g_race_qualifying == 2) && timelimit > 0)
   {
    float totalplayers;
    float playerswithlaps;
    float readyplayers;
    totalplayers = playerswithlaps = readyplayers = 0;
    if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { ++totalplayers; if(_GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_RACE_FASTEST, 0)) ++playerswithlaps; if(it.ready) ++readyplayers; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()





      ;



    if(readyplayers || playerswithlaps >= 2)
    {
     checkrules_suddendeathend = 0;
     ReadyRestart(true);
     return;
    }
    else
     wantovertime |= InitiateSuddenDeath();
   }
   else
    wantovertime |= InitiateSuddenDeath();
  }
 }

 if (checkrules_suddendeathend && time >= checkrules_suddendeathend)
 {
  NextLevel();
  return;
 }

 float checkrules_status = WinningCondition_RanOutOfSpawns();
 if(checkrules_status == WINNING_YES)
  bprint("Hey! Someone ran out of spawns!\n");
 else if(__Mutator_Send_CheckRules_World(0 , checkrules_status, timelimit, fraglimit))
  checkrules_status = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_float;
 else
  checkrules_status = WinningCondition_Scores(fraglimit, leadlimit);

 if(checkrules_status == WINNING_STARTSUDDENDEATHOVERTIME)
 {
  checkrules_status = WINNING_NEVER;
  checkrules_overtimesadded = -1;
  wantovertime |= InitiateSuddenDeath();
 }

 if(checkrules_status == WINNING_NEVER)

  ClearWinners();

 if(wantovertime)
 {
  if(checkrules_status == WINNING_NEVER)
   InitiateOvertime();
  else
   checkrules_status = WINNING_YES;
 }

 if(checkrules_suddendeathend)
  if(checkrules_status != WINNING_NEVER || time >= checkrules_suddendeathend)
   checkrules_status = WINNING_YES;

 if(checkrules_status == WINNING_YES)
 {
  if (overtimes == -1 && overtimes != overtimes_prev)
  {

   checkrules_suddendeathend = 0;
   overtimes = overtimes_prev;
  }

  NextLevel();
 }
}

float want_weapon(entity weaponinfo, float allguns)
{
 float d = 0;
 float allow_mutatorblocked = false;

 if(!weaponinfo.m_id)
  return 0;

 float mutator_returnvalue = __Mutator_Send_WantWeapon(0 , weaponinfo, d, allguns, allow_mutatorblocked);
 d = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_float;
 allguns = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_bool;
 allow_mutatorblocked = MUTATOR_ARGV_3_bool;

 if(allguns)
  d = (((weaponinfo.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_NORMAL) && !(weaponinfo.spawnflags & (WEP_FLAG_HIDDEN | WEP_FLAG_SPECIALATTACK))) != 0);
 else if(!mutator_returnvalue)
  d = !(!weaponinfo.weaponstart);

 if(!allow_mutatorblocked && (weaponinfo.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_MUTATORBLOCKED))
  d = 0;

 float t = weaponinfo.weaponstartoverride;







 if(t < 0)
  t = 4 | (3 * d);
 else
  t |= (2 * d);

 return t;
}

void InitializeEntity(entity e, void(entity this) func, float order)
{
 entity prev, cur;

 if (!e || e.initialize_entity)
 {

  entity e_old = e;
  e = __spawn("initialize_entity", "./server/world.qc" ":" "2227", false);
  e.enemy = e_old;
 }

 e.initialize_entity = func;
 e.initialize_entity_order = order;

 cur = initialize_entity_first;
 prev = (0, world);
 for (;;)
 {
  if (!cur || cur.initialize_entity_order > order)
  {

   if (prev)
    prev.initialize_entity_next = e;
   else
    initialize_entity_first = e;
   e.initialize_entity_next = cur;
   return;
  }
  prev = cur;
  cur = cur.initialize_entity_next;
 }
}
void InitializeEntitiesRun()
{
 entity startoflist = initialize_entity_first;
 initialize_entity_first = (0, world);
 delete_fn = remove_except_protected;
 for (entity e = startoflist; e; e = e.initialize_entity_next)
 {
  e.remove_except_protected_forbidden = 1;
 }
 for (entity e = startoflist; e; )
 {
  e.remove_except_protected_forbidden = 0;
  e.initialize_entity_order = 0;
  entity next = e.initialize_entity_next;
  e.initialize_entity_next = (0, world);
  var void(entity this) func = e.initialize_entity;
  e.initialize_entity = nil;
  if (e.classname == "initialize_entity")
  {
   entity wrappee = e.enemy;
   builtin_remove(e);
   e = wrappee;
  }

  if (func)
  {
   func(e);
  }
  else
  {
   eprint(e);
   if(1){ float dev = autocvar_developer; float war = autocvar_prvm_backtraceforwarnings; cvar_set("developer", "1"); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", "1"); print("\n--- CUT HERE ---\n", strcat("Null function in: ", e.classname, "\n")); builtin_remove((0, world)); print("\n--- CUT UNTIL HERE ---\n"); cvar_set("developer", ftos(dev)); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", ftos(war)); }else voidfunc();
  }
  e = next;
 }
 delete_fn = remove_unsafely;
}



void DropToFloor_Handler(entity this)
{
 if(!this || wasfreed(this))
 {

  return;
 }

 vector end = this.origin;
 if (autocvar_sv_mapformat_is_quake3)
  end.z -= 4096;
 else if (autocvar_sv_mapformat_is_quake2)

float autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_multiplethinksperframe = true;
void RunThink(entity this, float dt)
{


 if(this.nextthink <= 0 || this.nextthink > time + dt)
  return;

 float oldtime = time;

 for (float iterations = 0; iterations < 128 && !wasfreed(this); iterations++)
 {
  time = max(oldtime, this.nextthink);
  this.nextthink = 0;

  if((0, (this).selfthink))
   (0, (this).selfthink)(this);




  if(this.nextthink <= time || this.nextthink > oldtime + dt || !autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_multiplethinksperframe)
   break;
 }

 time = oldtime;
}

 }
 else

  __init_dedicated_server_shutdown();
 }
}

float findtrajectorywithleading(vector org, vector m1, vector m2, entity targ, float shotspeed, float shotspeedupward, float maxtime, float shotdelay, entity ignore)
{
 float c, savesolid, shottime;
 vector dir, end, v, o;
 if (shotspeed < 1)
  return false;
 if (targ.solid < SOLID_BBOX)
  return false;
 if (!tracetossent)
  tracetossent = __spawn("tracetossent", "./server/bot/default/aim.qc" ":" "25", false);
 tracetossent.owner = ignore;
 setsize(tracetossent, m1, m2);
 savesolid = targ.solid;
 targ.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 o = (targ.absmin + targ.absmax) * 0.5;
 shottime = ((vlen(o - org) / shotspeed) + shotdelay);
 v = targ.velocity * shottime + o;
 tracebox(o, targ.mins, targ.maxs, v, false, targ);
 v = trace_endpos;
 end = v + (targ.mins + targ.maxs) * 0.5;
 if ((vlen(end - org) / shotspeed + 0.2) > maxtime)
 {

  targ.solid = savesolid;
  return false;
 }

 if (!tracetossfaketarget)
  tracetossfaketarget = __spawn("tracetossfaketarget", "./server/bot/default/aim.qc" ":" "44", false);
 tracetossfaketarget.solid = savesolid;
 set_movetype(tracetossfaketarget, targ.move_movetype);
 _setmodel(tracetossfaketarget, targ.model);
 tracetossfaketarget.model = targ.model;
 tracetossfaketarget.modelindex = targ.modelindex;
 setsize(tracetossfaketarget, targ.mins, targ.maxs);
 setorigin(tracetossfaketarget, v);

 c = 0;
 dir = normalize(end - org);
 while (c < 10)
 {
  setorigin(tracetossent, org);
  tracetossent.velocity = findtrajectory_velocity = normalize(dir) * shotspeed + shotspeedupward * '0 0 1';
  tracetoss(tracetossent, ignore);
  if (trace_ent == tracetossfaketarget)
  {
   targ.solid = savesolid;


   tracetossfaketarget.solid = SOLID_NOT;
   set_movetype(tracetossfaketarget, MOVETYPE_NONE);
   tracetossfaketarget.model = "";
   tracetossfaketarget.modelindex = 0;

   setorigin(tracetossfaketarget, v);

   return true;
  }
  dir.z = dir.z + 0.1;
  c = c + 1;
 }
 targ.solid = savesolid;


 tracetossfaketarget.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 set_movetype(tracetossfaketarget, MOVETYPE_NONE);
 tracetossfaketarget.model = "";
 tracetossfaketarget.modelindex = 0;

 setorigin(tracetossfaketarget, v);


 findtrajectory_velocity = normalize(end - org) * shotspeed + shotspeedupward * '0 0 1';
 return false;
}

float bot_shouldattack(entity this, entity targ)
{
 if (targ.team == this.team)
 {
  if (targ == this)
   return false;
  if (teamplay)
  if (targ.team != 0)
   return false;
 }

 if((targ).stat_FROZEN)
  return false;

 if(teamplay)
 {
  if(targ.team==0)
   return false;
 }
 else if (autocvar_bot_ignore_bots && (clienttype(targ) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
  return false;

 if (!targ.takedamage)
  return false;
 if (((targ).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return false;
 if (((targ._cs).buttonchat) && !autocvar_bot_typefrag)
  return false;
 if(targ.flags & FL_NOTARGET)
  return false;
 if(targ.alpha <= 0.1 && targ.alpha != 0)
  return false;

 if(__Mutator_Send_BotShouldAttack(0 , this, targ))
  return false;

 return true;
}




float bot_duel_mutual_fov_allows_fire(entity attacker, entity target)
{
 if (!autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_fire && !autocvar_duel_fire_visibility_debug)
  return true;
 if (!(clienttype(attacker) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT) || !(clienttype(target) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
  return true;

 vector target_eye = target.origin + target.view_ofs;
 vector attacker_eye = attacker.origin + attacker.view_ofs;
 vector to_attacker = attacker_eye - target_eye;
 if (!to_attacker)
  return !autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_fire;

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", 147, __FUNC__, "\"target.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(target.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
 float view_dot = normalize(to_attacker) * v_forward;
 attacker.duel_mutual_fov_last_dot = view_dot;
 if (!autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_fire)
  return true;
 float half_fov = 0.5 * bound(1, autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_degrees, 179);
 if (view_dot < cos(half_fov * DEG2RAD))
  return false;

 traceline(target_eye, attacker_eye, false, target);
 return trace_fraction == 1 || trace_ent == attacker;
}

void bot_aimdir(entity this, vector v, float maxfiredeviation)
{
 float dist, delta_t, blend;
 vector desiredang, diffang;

 this.bot_aimdir_executed = true;



 this.v_angle_y = this.v_angle.y - floor(this.v_angle.y / 360) * 360;
 this.v_angle_z = 0;


 if (this.bot_prevaimtime == time)
  return;


 if ((skill > 100))
 {
  this.v_angle = vectoangles(normalize(v));

  this.v_angle.x *= -1;

  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", 202, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
  shotorg = this.origin + this.view_ofs;
  shotdir = v_forward;


  this.bot_firetimer = time + 0.001;
  return;
 }


 if(!v) return;

 float skill_save = skill;

 if (!this.enemy)
  skill = max(4, skill);





 if (time >= this.bot_badaimtime)
 {
  this.bot_badaimtime = max(this.bot_badaimtime + 0.2 + 0.3 * random(), time);
  float f = bound(0, 1 - 0.1 * (skill + this.bot_offsetskill), 1);
  this.bot_badaimoffset = randomvec() * f * autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_offset;
  this.bot_badaimoffset.x *= 0.7;
 }
 float enemy_factor = ((this.enemy) ? 5 : 2);

 desiredang = vectoangles(v) + this.bot_badaimoffset * enemy_factor;

 if (desiredang.x >= 180)
  desiredang.x = desiredang.x - 360;
 desiredang.x = bound(-90, 0 - desiredang.x, 90);
 desiredang.z = this.v_angle.z;
# 248 "./server/bot/default/aim.qc"
 diffang = (desiredang - this.bot_olddesiredang);

 diffang.y = diffang.y - floor(diffang.y / 360) * 360;
 if (diffang.y >= 180)
  diffang.y = diffang.y - 360;
 this.bot_olddesiredang = desiredang;


 delta_t = time-this.bot_prevaimtime;
 this.bot_prevaimtime = time;

 this.bot_1st_order_aimfilter= this.bot_1st_order_aimfilter
  + (diffang * (1 / delta_t) - this.bot_1st_order_aimfilter) * bound(0, autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_filter_1st,1);
 this.bot_2nd_order_aimfilter= this.bot_2nd_order_aimfilter
  + (this.bot_1st_order_aimfilter - this.bot_2nd_order_aimfilter) * bound(0, autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_filter_2nd,1);
 this.bot_3th_order_aimfilter= this.bot_3th_order_aimfilter
  + (this.bot_2nd_order_aimfilter - this.bot_3th_order_aimfilter) * bound(0, autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_filter_3th,1);
 this.bot_4th_order_aimfilter= this.bot_4th_order_aimfilter
  + (this.bot_3th_order_aimfilter - this.bot_4th_order_aimfilter) * bound(0, autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_filter_4th,1);
 this.bot_5th_order_aimfilter= this.bot_5th_order_aimfilter
  + (this.bot_4th_order_aimfilter - this.bot_5th_order_aimfilter) * bound(0, autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_filter_5th,1);


 blend = bound(0,skill+this.bot_aimskill,10)*0.1;
 desiredang = desiredang + blend *
 (
    this.bot_1st_order_aimfilter * autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_1st
  + this.bot_2nd_order_aimfilter * autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_2nd
  + this.bot_3th_order_aimfilter * autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_3th
  + this.bot_4th_order_aimfilter * autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_4th
  + this.bot_5th_order_aimfilter * autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_order_mix_5th
 );
 desiredang.x = bound(-90, desiredang.x, 90);


 diffang = desiredang - this.bot_mouseaim;

 diffang.y = diffang.y - floor(diffang.y / 360) * 360;
 if (diffang.y >= 180)
  diffang.y = diffang.y - 360;


 if (time >= this.bot_aimthinktime)
 {
  this.bot_aimthinktime = max(this.bot_aimthinktime + 0.5 - 0.05*(skill+this.bot_thinkskill), time);
  this.bot_mouseaim = this.bot_mouseaim + diffang * (1-random()*0.1*bound(1,10-(skill+this.bot_thinkskill),10));
 }



 diffang = this.bot_mouseaim - desiredang;

 diffang.y = diffang.y - floor(diffang.y / 360) * 360;
 if (diffang.y >= 180)
  diffang.y = diffang.y - 360;
 desiredang = desiredang + diffang * bound(0,autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_think,1);


 diffang = desiredang - this.v_angle;

 diffang.y = diffang.y - floor(diffang.y / 360) * 360;
 if (diffang.y >= 180)
  diffang.y = diffang.y - 360;



 dist = vlen(diffang);



 float r, fixedrate, blendrate;
 fixedrate = autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_fixedrate / bound(1,dist,1000);
 blendrate = autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_blendrate;
 r = max(fixedrate, blendrate);

 r = bound(delta_t, r * delta_t * (2 + ((skill + this.bot_mouseskill) ** 3) * 0.005 - random()), 1);
 vector applied_turn = diffang * (r + (1 - r) * bound(0, 1 - autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_mouse, 1));
 if ((clienttype(this) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT)
  && (autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed > 0 || autocvar_duel_max_turn_accel > 0))
 {




  float controller_dt = min(delta_t, frametime);
  vector desired_turn_rate = applied_turn / delta_t;
  if (autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed > 0)
  {
   desired_turn_rate.x = bound(
    -autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed,
    desired_turn_rate.x,
    autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed);
   desired_turn_rate.y = bound(
    -autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed,
    desired_turn_rate.y,
    autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed);
  }
  float max_rate_delta = autocvar_duel_max_turn_accel * controller_dt;
  if (autocvar_duel_max_turn_accel > 0)
  {
  desired_turn_rate.x = bound(
   this.duel_applied_turn_rate.x - max_rate_delta,
   desired_turn_rate.x,
   this.duel_applied_turn_rate.x + max_rate_delta);
  desired_turn_rate.y = bound(
   this.duel_applied_turn_rate.y - max_rate_delta,
   desired_turn_rate.y,
   this.duel_applied_turn_rate.y + max_rate_delta);
  }
  this.duel_applied_turn_rate = desired_turn_rate;
  applied_turn = desired_turn_rate * controller_dt;
 }
 else
  this.duel_applied_turn_rate = applied_turn / delta_t;
 this.v_angle += applied_turn;
 this.v_angle_z = 0;
 this.v_angle_y = this.v_angle.y - floor(this.v_angle.y / 360) * 360;


 skill = skill_save;

 if (maxfiredeviation <= 0)
  return;

 if (!autocvar_bot_ai_aimskill_firetolerance)
 {
  this.bot_firetimer = time + 0.2;
  return;
 }

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", 378, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
 shotorg = this.origin + this.view_ofs;
 shotdir = v_forward;





 vector deviation = vectoangles(v) - vectoangles(shotdir);
 while (deviation.x < -180) deviation.x += 360; while (deviation.x > 180) deviation.x -= 360;
 while (deviation.y < -180) deviation.y += 360; while (deviation.y > 180) deviation.y -= 360;
 if (fabs(deviation.x) < maxfiredeviation && fabs(deviation.y) < maxfiredeviation)
 {
  traceline(shotorg, shotorg + shotdir * 1000, false, (0, world));
  if (((_vlen2 = (trace_endpos - shotorg), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((500 + 500 * bound(0, skill + this.bot_aggresskill, 10)) ** 2))
   || random() * random() > bound(0, (skill + this.bot_aggresskill) * 0.05, 1))
  {
   this.bot_firetimer = time + bound(0.1, 0.5 - (skill + this.bot_aggresskill) * 0.05, 0.5);
  }
 }
}

vector bot_shotlead(vector targorigin, vector targvelocity, float shotspeed, float shotdelay)
{

 return targorigin + targvelocity * (shotdelay + vlen(targorigin - shotorg) / shotspeed);
}

{
 float hf, distanceratio;
 vector v;
 hf = this.dphitcontentsmask;
 this.dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;

 if (!bot_duel_mutual_fov_allows_fire(this, this.enemy))
 {
  if (autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_debug && time >= this.duel_mutual_fov_next_block_log)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", "417")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("duel_fov_gate:block attacker=", this.netname, " target=", this.enemy.netname, " target_view_dot=", ftos(this.duel_mutual_fov_last_dot)); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()

                                                             ;
   this.duel_mutual_fov_next_block_log = time + 1;
  }
  this.dphitcontentsmask = hf;
  return false;
 }

 float speed_factor = W_WeaponSpeedFactor(this);
 shotspeed *= speed_factor;
 shotspeedupward *= speed_factor;
 if (!shotspeed)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", "431")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("bot_aim: WARNING: weapon ", this.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_name, " shotspeed is zero!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  shotspeed = 1000000;
 }
 if (!maxshottime)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", "436")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("bot_aim: WARNING: weapon ", this.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_name, " maxshottime is zero!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  maxshottime = 1;
 }
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", 439, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
 shotorg = this.origin + this.view_ofs;
 shotdir = v_forward;
 vector enemy_org = (this.enemy.absmin + this.enemy.absmax) * 0.5;
 v = bot_shotlead(enemy_org, this.enemy.velocity, shotspeed, this.bot_aimlatency);





 float dist = max(10, vlen(v - shotorg));
 float maxfiredeviation = 1000 / (dist - 9) - 0.35;

 float f = (shot_accurate) ? 1 : 1.6;
 f += bound(0, (10 - (skill + this.bot_aimskill)) * 0.3, 3);
 maxfiredeviation = min(90, maxfiredeviation * f);

 if (applygravity && this.enemy)
 {
  if (!findtrajectorywithleading(shotorg, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', this.enemy, shotspeed, shotspeedupward, maxshottime, 0, this))
  {
   this.dphitcontentsmask = hf;
   return false;
  }

  bot_aimdir(this, findtrajectory_velocity - shotspeedupward * '0 0 1', maxfiredeviation);
 }
 else
 {
  bot_aimdir(this, v - shotorg, maxfiredeviation);






  traceline(shotorg, enemy_org, false, this);
  if (trace_fraction < 1)
  if (trace_ent != this.enemy)
  if (!bot_shouldattack(this, trace_ent))
  {
   this.dphitcontentsmask = hf;
   return false;
  }
 }

 if (time > this.bot_firetimer)
 {
  this.dphitcontentsmask = hf;
  return false;
 }



 if (autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_debug && time >= this.duel_mutual_fov_next_allow_log)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", "495")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("duel_fov_gate:fire_allowed attacker=", this.netname, " target=", this.enemy.netname, " target_view_dot=", ftos(this.duel_mutual_fov_last_dot)); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()

                                                            ;
  this.duel_mutual_fov_next_allow_log = time + 1;
 }
 if (autocvar_duel_fire_visibility_debug && time >= this.duel_fire_visibility_next_log)
 {
  float view_threshold = cos(0.5 * bound(1, autocvar_duel_mutual_fov_degrees, 179) * DEG2RAD);
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/aim.qc", "503")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("duel_fire_visibility:attacker=%s target=%s target_view_dot=%.6f outside_view=%d behind=%d", this.netname, this.enemy.netname, this.duel_mutual_fov_last_dot, this.duel_mutual_fov_last_dot < view_threshold, this.duel_mutual_fov_last_dot < 0); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()


                                     ;
  this.duel_fire_visibility_next_log = time + 0.25;
 }
 this.dphitcontentsmask = hf;
 return true;
}

void bot_think(entity this)
{
 if (this.bot_nextthink > time)
  return;

 this.flags &= ~FL_GODMODE;
 if(autocvar_bot_god)
  this.flags |= FL_GODMODE;


 if ((skill > 100))
  this.bot_nextthink = max(time, this.bot_nextthink) + 0.005;
 else
  this.bot_nextthink = max(time, this.bot_nextthink) + max(0.01, autocvar_bot_ai_thinkinterval * min(14 / (skill + this.bot_aiskill + 14), 1));

 if (!((this).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (autocvar_g_campaign && !campaign_bots_may_start))
 {
  (this._cs).movement = '0 0 0';
  this.bot_nextthink = time + 0.5;
  return;
 }

 if (this.fixangle)
 {
  this.v_angle = this.angles;
  this.v_angle_z = 0;
  this.fixangle = false;
 }

 this.dmg_take = 0;
 this.dmg_save = 0;
 this.dmg_inflictor = (0, world);


 if ((skill > 100))
  (this._cs).ping = 0;
 else
 {




  (this._cs).ping = bound(0,0.07 - bound(0, (skill + this.bot_pingskill) * 0.005,0.05)+random()*0.01,0.65);


 }


 ((this._cs).button0) = false;

 ((this._cs).button2) = (!((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && time < this.bot_jump_time + 0.2);
 ((this._cs).button3) = false;
 ((this._cs).button4) = false;
 ((this._cs).button5) = false;
 ((this._cs).button6) = false;

   bot_waypoint_queue_owner = (0, world);
  this.aistatus = 0;

   return;

  {
   if (!navigation_goalrating_timeout(this))
    navigation_goalrating_timeout_force(this);

    ((this._cs).button2) = false;

  }

  navigation_unstuck(this);

  this.ready = true;
  ReadyCount();

  && (autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed > 0 || autocvar_duel_max_turn_accel > 0))
 {



  vector turn_delta = this.v_angle - duel_view_before_ai;
  turn_delta.y = turn_delta.y - floor(turn_delta.y / 360) * 360;
  if (turn_delta.y >= 180)
   turn_delta.y -= 360;
  vector desired_rate = turn_delta / frametime;
  if (autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed > 0)
  {
   desired_rate.x = bound(
    -autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed,
    desired_rate.x,
    autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed);
   desired_rate.y = bound(
    -autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed,
    desired_rate.y,
    autocvar_duel_max_turn_speed);
  }
  if (autocvar_duel_max_turn_accel > 0)
  {
   float max_rate_delta = autocvar_duel_max_turn_accel * frametime;
   desired_rate.x = bound(
    this.duel_final_turn_rate.x - max_rate_delta,
    desired_rate.x,
    this.duel_final_turn_rate.x + max_rate_delta);
   desired_rate.y = bound(
    this.duel_final_turn_rate.y - max_rate_delta,
    desired_rate.y,
    this.duel_final_turn_rate.y + max_rate_delta);
  }
  this.duel_final_turn_rate = desired_rate;
  this.v_angle = duel_view_before_ai + desired_rate * frametime;
  this.v_angle_z = 0;
  this.v_angle_y = this.v_angle.y - floor(this.v_angle.y / 360) * 360;
 }
 if (autocvar_duel_move_input_scale > 0 && autocvar_duel_move_input_scale < 1)
 {



  (this._cs).movement.x *= autocvar_duel_move_input_scale;
  (this._cs).movement.y *= autocvar_duel_move_input_scale;
 }
 if (autocvar_duel_move_input_limit > 0)
 {
  vector horizontal_move =
   (this._cs).movement.x * '1 0 0' + (this._cs).movement.y * '0 1 0';
  float horizontal_length = vlen(horizontal_move);
  if (horizontal_length > autocvar_duel_move_input_limit)
  {
   float move_ratio = autocvar_duel_move_input_limit / horizontal_length;
   (this._cs).movement.x *= move_ratio;
   (this._cs).movement.y *= move_ratio;
  }
 }
 if (autocvar_duel_clean_bot_controls)
 {



  ((this._cs).button3) = false;
  ((this._cs).button4) = false;
  ((this._cs).button5) = false;
  ((this._cs).button6) = false;
  ((this._cs).button7) = false;
  ((this._cs).button8) = false;
  ((this._cs).buttonchat) = false;
  ((this._cs).buttonuse) = false;
  ((this._cs).button9) = false;
  ((this._cs).button10) = false;
  ((this._cs).button11) = false;
  ((this._cs).button12) = false;
  ((this._cs).cursor_active) = false;
  (this._cs).button13 = false;
  (this._cs).button14 = false;
  (this._cs).button15 = false;
  (this._cs).button16 = false;


  (this._cs).movement.z = 0;
  (this._cs).impulse = 0;

void autoskill(float factor)
{
 float bestbot = -1;
 float bestplayer = -1;
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { if((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) bestplayer = max(bestplayer, it.totalfrags - it.totalfrags_lastcheck); else bestbot = max(bestbot, it.totalfrags - it.totalfrags_lastcheck); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




   ;

 string msg = strcat("autoskill: best player got ", ftos(bestplayer), ", ""best bot got ", ftos(bestbot), "; ");
 if(bestbot < 0 || bestplayer < 0)
 {
  msg = strcat(msg, "not doing anything");

 }
 else if(bestbot <= bestplayer * factor - 2)
 {
  if(cvar("skill") < 17)
  {
   msg = strcat(msg, "2 frags difference, increasing skill");
   cvar_set("skill", ftos(cvar("skill") + 1));
   bprint("^2BOT SKILL UP!^7 Now at level ", ftos(cvar("skill")), "\n");
  }
 }
 else if(bestbot >= bestplayer * factor + 2)
 {
  if(cvar("skill") > 0)
  {
   msg = strcat(msg, "2 frags difference, decreasing skill");
   cvar_set("skill", ftos(cvar("skill") - 1));
   bprint("^1BOT SKILL DOWN!^7 Now at level ", ftos(cvar("skill")), "\n");
  }
 }
 else
 {
  msg = strcat(msg, "not doing anything");
  return;

 }
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/bot.qc", "693")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(msg), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { it.totalfrags_lastcheck = it.totalfrags; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
}

void bot_calculate_stepheightvec()
{
 stepheightvec = autocvar_sv_stepheight * '0 0 1';
 jumpheight_vec = (autocvar_sv_jumpvelocity ** 2) / (2 * cvar("sv_gravity")) * '0 0 1';
 jumpstepheightvec = stepheightvec + jumpheight_vec * 0.85;
 jumpheight_time = autocvar_sv_jumpvelocity / cvar("sv_gravity");
}

  activerealplayers = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_int;
  realplayers = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_int;

  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { if(((it).classname == STR_PLAYER)) ++activerealplayers; ++realplayers; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()



    ;
 }

 float bots;


 bots_would_leave = false;
 if (autocvar_bot_vs_human && teamplay == 2)
  bots = min(ceil(fabs(autocvar_bot_vs_human) * activerealplayers), maxclients - realplayers);
 else if ((realplayers || autocvar_bot_join_empty || (currentbots > 0 && time < 5)))
 {
  float minplayers = max(0, floor(autocvar_minplayers));
  if (teamplay)
   minplayers = max(0, floor(autocvar_minplayers_per_team) * teamplay);
  float minbots = max(0, floor(autocvar_bot_number));


  bots = max(minbots, minplayers - activerealplayers);

  float player_limit = GetPlayerLimit();
  if(player_limit)
   bots = min(bots, max(player_limit - activerealplayers, 0));
  bots = min(bots, maxclients - realplayers);

  if(bots > minbots)
   bots_would_leave = true;
 }
 else
 {

  bots = 0;
 }


 if(time > botframe_nextthink)
 {
  while (currentbots < bots)
  {
   if (bot_spawn() == (0, world))
   {
    bprint("Can not add bot, server full.\n");
    return false;
   }
   if (!multiple_per_frame)
   {
    break;
   }
  }
  while (currentbots > bots && bots >= 0)
   bot_removenewest();
 }

 return true;
}

void bot_serverframe()
{
 if (intermission_running && currentbots > 0)
 {

  float realplayers = 0;
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { ++realplayers; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
  if (!realplayers)
  {
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))) { { { { dropclient(it); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
   currentbots = 0;
  }
  return;
 }

 if (game_stopped)
  return;






 if (time < 2.5)
 {
  currentbots = -1;
  return;
 }

 if (currentbots == -1)
 {

  currentbots = 0;
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))) { { { { ++currentbots; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

   wpcost_update = true;
  if(skill < autocvar_bot_ai_bunnyhop_skilloffset && cvar("skill") >= autocvar_bot_ai_bunnyhop_skilloffset)

 if(time > autoskill_nextthink)

   autoskill(a);

 if(time > botframe_nextthink)

    waypoint_load_hardwiredlinks();

 if (bot_list)

void navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(entity this)
{
 if(((((this.goalentity).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (this.goalentity.flags & FL_MONSTER)) && !(this.goalentity).stat_FROZEN))
  this.bot_strategytime = time + autocvar_bot_ai_strategyinterval_movingtarget;
 else
  this.bot_strategytime = time + autocvar_bot_ai_strategyinterval;
}


void navigation_goalrating_timeout_force(entity this)
{
 navigation_goalrating_timeout_expire(this, 0);
}



void navigation_goalrating_timeout_expire(entity this, float seconds)
{
 if (seconds <= 0)
  this.bot_strategytime = 0;
 else if (this.bot_strategytime > time + seconds)
  this.bot_strategytime = time + seconds;
}

float navigation_goalrating_timeout(entity this)
{
 return this.bot_strategytime < time;
}

[[eraseable]]
void navigation_goalrating_timeout_extend_if_needed(entity this, float seconds)
{
 this.bot_strategytime = max(this.bot_strategytime, time + seconds);
}


float navigation_goalrating_timeout_can_be_anticipated(entity this)
{
 vector gco = (this.goalentity.absmin + this.goalentity.absmax) * 0.5;
 if (((_vlen2 = (gco - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_sv_maxspeed * 1.5) ** 2))
  && time > this.bot_strategytime - (((((this.goalentity).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (this.goalentity.flags & FL_MONSTER)) && !(this.goalentity).stat_FROZEN) ? 3 : 2))
 {
  return true;
 }

 if (this.goalentity.bot_pickup && time > this.bot_strategytime - 5)
 {
  if(!havocbot_goalrating_item_pickable_check_players(this, this.origin, this.goalentity, gco))
  {
   this.ignoregoal = this.goalentity;
   this.ignoregoaltime = time + autocvar_bot_ai_ignoregoal_timeout;
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}

void navigation_dynamicgoal_init(entity this, float initially_static)
{
 this.navigation_dynamicgoal = true;
 this.bot_basewaypoint = this.nearestwaypoint;
 if(initially_static)
  this.nearestwaypointtimeout = -1;
 else
  this.nearestwaypointtimeout = time;
}

void navigation_dynamicgoal_set(entity this, entity dropper)
{
 this.nearestwaypointtimeout = time;
 if (dropper && dropper.nearestwaypointtimeout && dropper.nearestwaypointtimeout < time + 2)
  this.nearestwaypoint = dropper.nearestwaypoint;
 if (this.nearestwaypoint)
  this.nearestwaypointtimeout += 2;
}

void navigation_dynamicgoal_unset(entity this)
{
 if(this.bot_basewaypoint)
  this.nearestwaypoint = this.bot_basewaypoint;
 this.nearestwaypointtimeout = -1;
}


vector get_closer_dest(entity ent, vector org)
{
 vector dest = '0 0 0';
 if ((ent.classname != "waypoint") || ent.wpisbox)
 {
  vector wm1 = ent.origin + ent.mins;
  vector wm2 = ent.origin + ent.maxs;
  dest.x = bound(wm1.x, org.x, wm2.x);
  dest.y = bound(wm1.y, org.y, wm2.y);
  dest.z = bound(wm1.z, org.z, wm2.z);
 }
 else
  dest = ent.origin;
 return dest;
}

void set_tracewalk_dest(entity ent, vector org, float fix_player_dest)
{
 if ((ent.classname != "waypoint") || ent.wpisbox)
 {
  vector wm1 = ent.origin + ent.mins;
  vector wm2 = ent.origin + ent.maxs;
  if (((ent).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (ent.flags & FL_MONSTER))
  {


   wm1 += (_vec2 = (PL_MIN_CONST), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2) + '-1 -1 0';
   wm2 += (_vec2 = (PL_MAX_CONST), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2) + '1 1 0';
  }


  tracewalk_dest.x = bound(wm1.x, org.x, wm2.x);
  tracewalk_dest.y = bound(wm1.y, org.y, wm2.y);
  if ((((ent).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (ent.flags & FL_MONSTER))
   && org.x == tracewalk_dest.x && org.y == tracewalk_dest.y && org.z > tracewalk_dest.z)
  {
   tracewalk_dest.z = wm2.z - PL_MIN_CONST.z;
   tracewalk_dest_height = 0;
   fix_player_dest = false;
  }
  else
  {
   tracewalk_dest.z = wm1.z;
   tracewalk_dest_height = wm2.z - wm1.z;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  tracewalk_dest = ent.origin;
  tracewalk_dest_height = 0;
 }
 if (fix_player_dest && ((ent).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !(((ent).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
 {

  if (org.x == tracewalk_dest.x && org.y == tracewalk_dest.y)
  {

   tracebox(ent.origin, ent.mins, ent.maxs, ent.origin - '0 0 700', MOVE_NORMAL, ent);
   tracewalk_dest = trace_endpos;
   tracewalk_dest_height = 0;
  }
  else
  {
   tracebox(tracewalk_dest, ent.mins, ent.maxs, tracewalk_dest - '0 0 700', MOVE_NORMAL, ent);
   if (!trace_startsolid && tracewalk_dest.z - trace_endpos.z > 0)
   {
    tracewalk_dest_height = tracewalk_dest.z - trace_endpos.z;
    tracewalk_dest.z = trace_endpos.z;
   }
  }
 }
}

 }

}

vector resurface_limited(vector org, float lim, vector m1)
{
 if ((_content_type = pointcontents(org + eZ * (lim - org.z) + eZ * (m1.z + 1)), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
  org.z = lim;
 else
 {
  float RES_min_h = org.z;
  float RES_max_h = lim;
  do {
   org.z = 0.5 * (RES_min_h + RES_max_h);
   if((_content_type = pointcontents(org + eZ * (m1.z + 1)), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
    RES_min_h = org.z;
   else
    RES_max_h = org.z;
  } while (RES_max_h - RES_min_h >= 1);
  org.z = RES_min_h;
 }
 return org;
}

float tracewalk(entity e, vector start, vector m1, vector m2, vector end, float end_height, float movemode)
{
 if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
 {
  debugresetnodes();
  debugnode(e, start);
 }

 vector org = start;
 vector flatdir = end - start;
 flatdir.z = 0;
 float flatdist = vlen(flatdir);
 flatdir = normalize(flatdir);
 float stepdist = 32;
 float ignorehazards = false;
 float nav_action;


 if ((_content_type = pointcontents(start), (_content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
  ignorehazards = true;

 tracebox(start, m1, m2, start, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, e);
 if (trace_startsolid)
 {

  if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
   debugnodestatus(start, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);


  return false;
 }

 vector end2 = end;
 if(end_height)
  end2.z += end_height;

 vector fixed_end = end;
 vector move;

 if (flatdist > 0 && (_content_type = pointcontents(org + eZ * (m1.z + 1)), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
 {
  if ((_content_type = pointcontents(org + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
   nav_action = 2;
  else
  {


   tracebox(org, m1, m2, org - eZ * (m2.z - m1.z), movemode, e);
   if ((_content_type = pointcontents(trace_endpos + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
   {
    org = trace_endpos;
    nav_action = 2;
   }
   else
    nav_action = 0;
  }
 }
 else
  nav_action = 0;


 while (true)
 {
  if (flatdist <= 0)
  {
   float success = true;
   if (org.z > end2.z + 1)
   {
    tracebox(org, m1, m2, end2, movemode, e);
    org = trace_endpos;
    if (org.z > end2.z + 1)
     success = false;
   }
   else if (org.z < end.z - 1)
   {
    tracebox(org, m1, m2, org - jumpheight_vec, movemode, e);
    if ((_content_type = pointcontents(trace_endpos + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
    {
     vector v = trace_endpos;
     tracebox(v, m1, m2, end, movemode, e);
     if(trace_endpos.z >= end.z - 1)
     {
      v = resurface_limited(v, trace_endpos.z, m1);
      trace_endpos = v;
     }
    }
    else if (trace_endpos.z > org.z - jumpheight_vec.z)
     tracebox(trace_endpos, m1, m2, trace_endpos + jumpheight_vec, movemode, e);
    org = trace_endpos;
    if (org.z < end.z - 1)
     success = false;
   }

   if (success)
   {

    if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
    {
     debugnode(e, org);
     debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_SUCCESS);
    }


    return true;
   }
  }

  if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
   debugnode(e, org);

  if (flatdist <= 0)
   break;

  if (stepdist > flatdist)
   stepdist = flatdist;
  if(nav_action == 2 || (nav_action == 1 && org.z > end2.z))
  {




   fixed_end.z = bound(end.z, org.z, end2.z);
   if (stepdist == flatdist) {
    move = fixed_end;
    flatdist = 0;
   } else {
    move = org + (fixed_end - org) * (stepdist / flatdist);
    flatdist = vlen((_vec2 = (fixed_end - move), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2));
   }
  }
  else
  {
   flatdist -= stepdist;
   move = org + flatdir * stepdist;
  }

  if(nav_action == 1)
  {
   tracebox(org, m1, m2, move, movemode, e);


   if (trace_fraction < 1)
   {

    tracebox(org + stepheightvec, m1, m2, move + stepheightvec, movemode, e);

    if (trace_fraction < 1 || trace_startsolid)
    {
     org = trace_endpos;
     if(navigation_checkladders(e, org, m1, m2, end, end2, movemode))
     {
      if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
      {
       debugnode(e, org);
       debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_SUCCESS);
      }


      return true;
     }

     if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
      debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);

     return false;

    }



    if (flatdist <= 0)
    {
     org = trace_endpos;
     continue;
    }

    if (org.z <= move.z)
    {
     tracebox(trace_endpos, m1, m2, move, movemode, e);
     org = trace_endpos;
     nav_action = 0;
     continue;
    }
   }

   if (org.z <= move.z)
   {
    org = trace_endpos;
    nav_action = 1;
   }
   else
   {
    org = trace_endpos;
    if ((_content_type = pointcontents(org + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
     nav_action = 2;
    else
     nav_action = 1;
   }
  }
  else if(nav_action == 2)
  {
   if (move.z >= org.z)
   {
    tracebox(org, m1, m2, move, movemode, e);

    float stepswum = false;


    if (trace_fraction < 1)
    {

     vector stepswim_move = move + stepheightvec;
     if (flatdist > 0 && stepswim_move.z > end2.z + stepheightvec.z)
      stepswim_move.z = end2.z;

     tracebox(org + stepheightvec, m1, m2, stepswim_move, movemode, e);


     if (trace_startsolid)
     {
      if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
       debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);


      return false;
     }

     if (trace_fraction < 1)
     {
      float org_z_prev = org.z;
      org = resurface_limited(org, end2.z, m1);
      if(org.z == org_z_prev)
      {
       if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
        debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);


       return false;
      }
      if((_content_type = pointcontents(org + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
       nav_action = 2;
      else
       nav_action = 1;



      if (flatdist <= 0)
       flatdist = 1;

      continue;
     }



     if (flatdist <= 0)
     {
      org = trace_endpos;
      continue;
     }

     stepswum = true;
    }

    if (!(_content_type = pointcontents(trace_endpos + eZ * (m1.z + 1)), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
    {
     tracebox(trace_endpos, m1, m2, trace_endpos - eZ * (stepdist + (m2.z - m1.z)), movemode, e);

     if (!stepswum && (_content_type = pointcontents(trace_endpos + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
     {
      trace_endpos = resurface_limited(trace_endpos, end2.z, m1);
      org = trace_endpos;
      nav_action = 1;
      continue;
     }


     org = trace_endpos;
     nav_action = 0;
     continue;
    }


    org = trace_endpos;
    nav_action = 2;
    continue;
   }
   else
   {
    tracebox(org, m1, m2, move, movemode, e);


    if (trace_fraction < 1)
    {

     tracebox(org + stepheightvec, m1, m2, move + stepheightvec, movemode, e);


     if (trace_fraction < 1 || trace_startsolid)
     {
      if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
       debugnodestatus(move, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);


      return false;
     }



     if (flatdist <= 0)
     {
      org = trace_endpos;
      continue;
     }

     if (trace_endpos.z > org.z && !(_content_type = pointcontents(trace_endpos + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
     {

      tracebox(trace_endpos, m1, m2, trace_endpos - stepheightvec, movemode, e);
      if (!(_content_type = pointcontents(trace_endpos + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
      {
       org = trace_endpos;
       nav_action = 0;
       continue;
      }
     }
    }

    org = trace_endpos;
    nav_action = 2;
    continue;
   }
  }
  else if(nav_action == 0)
  {

   tracebox(org, m1, m2, move, movemode, e);

   if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
    debugnode(e, trace_endpos);


   if (trace_fraction < 1)
   {

    tracebox(org + stepheightvec, m1, m2, move + stepheightvec, movemode, e);
    if (trace_fraction < 1 || trace_startsolid)
    {
     if (trace_startsolid)
     {

      tracebox(org, m1, m2, org + stepheightvec, movemode, e);
      tracebox(trace_endpos, m1, m2, move + eZ * (trace_endpos.z - move.z), movemode, e);
     }
     else
     {
      tracebox(org + jumpstepheightvec, m1, m2, move + jumpstepheightvec, movemode, e);
      if (trace_startsolid)
      {

       tracebox(org, m1, m2, org + jumpstepheightvec, movemode, e);
       tracebox(trace_endpos, m1, m2, move + eZ * (trace_endpos.z - move.z), movemode, e);
      }
     }

     if (trace_fraction < 1)
     {
      vector v = trace_endpos;
      v.z = org.z + jumpheight_vec.z;
      if(navigation_checkladders(e, v, m1, m2, end, end2, movemode))
      {
       if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
       {
        debugnode(e, v);
        debugnodestatus(v, DEBUG_NODE_SUCCESS);
       }


       return true;
      }

      if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
       debugnodestatus(trace_endpos, DEBUG_NODE_WARNING);

      traceline( org, move, movemode, e);

      if ( trace_ent.classname == "door_rotating" || trace_ent.classname == "door")
      {
       vector nextmove;
       move = trace_endpos;
       while(trace_ent.classname == "door_rotating" || trace_ent.classname == "door")
       {
        nextmove = move + (flatdir * stepdist);
        traceline( move, nextmove, movemode, e);
        move = nextmove;
       }
       flatdist = vlen((_vec2 = (end - move), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2));
      }
      else
      {
       if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
        debugnodestatus(trace_endpos, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);




       return false;
      }
     }
     else
      move = trace_endpos;
    }
    else
     move = trace_endpos;
   }
   else
    move = trace_endpos;





   tracebox(move, m1, m2, move + '0 0 -65536', movemode, e);

   org = trace_endpos;

   if (!ignorehazards)
   {
    if ((_content_type = pointcontents(org), (_content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
    {
     if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
     {
      debugnode(e, trace_endpos);
      debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);
     }


     return false;
    }
   }

   if (flatdist <= 0)
   {
    if(move.z >= end2.z && org.z < end2.z)
     org.z = end2.z;
    continue;
   }

   if(org.z > move.z - 1 || !(_content_type = pointcontents(org + autocvar_sv_player_viewoffset), (_content_type == CONTENT_WATER || _content_type == CONTENT_LAVA || _content_type == CONTENT_SLIME)))
   {
    nav_action = 0;
    continue;
   }


   if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
    debugnode(e, org);

   org = resurface_limited(org, move.z, m1);
   nav_action = 1;
   continue;
  }
 }




 if(autocvar_bot_debug_tracewalk)
  debugnodestatus(org, DEBUG_NODE_FAIL);

 return false;
}

float navigation_waypoint_will_link(vector v, vector org, entity ent, vector v2, float v2_height, vector o2, float o2_height, float walkfromwp, float bestdist)
{
 if (((_vlen2 = (v - org), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((bestdist) ** 2)))
 {
  traceline(v, org, true, ent);
  if (trace_fraction == 1)
  {
   if (walkfromwp)
   {
    if (tracewalk(ent, v, PL_MIN_CONST, PL_MAX_CONST, v2, v2_height, bot_navigation_movemode))
     return true;
   }
   else
   {
    if (tracewalk(ent, org, PL_MIN_CONST, PL_MAX_CONST, o2, o2_height, bot_navigation_movemode))
     return true;
   }
  }
 }
 return false;
}

void navigation_markroutes_checkwaypoint(entity w, entity wp, float cost, vector p)
{
 vector m1, m2;
 vector v;
 if (wp.wpisbox)
 {
  m1 = wp.origin + wp.mins;
  m2 = wp.origin + wp.maxs;
  v.x = bound(m1_x, p.x, m2_x);
  v.y = bound(m1_y, p.y, m2_y);
  v.z = bound(m1_z, p.z, m2_z);
 }
 else
  v = wp.origin;
 if (w.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT)
  cost += w.wp00mincost;
 else
  cost += waypoint_gettravelcost(p, v, w, wp);
 if (wp.wpcost > cost)
 {
  wp.wpcost = cost;
  wp.enemy = w;
  wp.wpfire = 1;
  wp.wpnearestpoint = v;
 }
}

float navigation_routetogoal(entity this, entity e, vector startposition)
{

 if (!e)
  return false;

 entity teleport_goal = (0, world);

 this.goalentity = e;

 if(e.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT)
 {

  teleport_goal = e;
  navigation_pushroute(this, e.wp00);
  this.goalentity = e.wp00;
 }



 navigation_pushroute(this, e);

 if(teleport_goal)
  e = this.goalentity;

 if(e.classname == "waypoint" && !(e.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_PERSONAL))
 {
  this.wp_goal_prev1 = this.wp_goal_prev0;
  this.wp_goal_prev0 = e;
 }

 if((this.items & IT_JETPACK) && e == this.navigation_jetpack_goal)
  return true;


 set_tracewalk_dest(e, startposition, true);
 if ((!((((this.goalcurrent).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (this.goalcurrent.flags & FL_MONSTER)) && !(this.goalcurrent).stat_FROZEN) || ((_vlen2 = (tracewalk_dest - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((700) ** 2)))
  && (trace_ent == this || tracewalk(this, startposition, (this).stat_PL_MIN, (this).stat_PL_MAX,
  tracewalk_dest, tracewalk_dest_height, bot_navigation_movemode)))
 {
  return true;
 }

 entity nearest_wp = (0, world);

 if(e.classname != "waypoint" || (e.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_PERSONAL))
 {
  e = e.nearestwaypoint;
  nearest_wp = e;
 }
 else if(teleport_goal)
  e = teleport_goal;
 else
  e = e.enemy;

 if(e == (0, world))
  return false;

 if(nearest_wp && nearest_wp.enemy && !(nearest_wp.enemy.wpflags & WPFLAGMASK_NORELINK))
 {

  if (this.goalentity.navigation_dynamicgoal || waypointeditor_enabled)
  {
   if (nearest_wp.enemy.wpcost < autocvar_bot_ai_strategyinterval_movingtarget)
   {
    if (((_vlen2 = ((_vec2 = (this.goalentity.origin - nearest_wp.origin), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((32) ** 2)))
     e = nearest_wp.enemy;
    else
    {
     set_tracewalk_dest(this.goalentity, nearest_wp.enemy.origin, true);
     if (trace_ent == this || (((_vlen2 = (tracewalk_dest - nearest_wp.enemy.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((1050) ** 2))
      && (_vlen2 = (tracewalk_dest - nearest_wp.enemy.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (nearest_wp.origin - nearest_wp.enemy.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2)))
      && tracewalk(this, nearest_wp.enemy.origin, (this).stat_PL_MIN, (this).stat_PL_MAX,
      tracewalk_dest, tracewalk_dest_height, bot_navigation_movemode)))
     {
      e = nearest_wp.enemy;
     }
    }
   }
  }
  else
  {

   if(1){ if (!this.goalentity.wp00) waypoint_clearlinks(this.goalentity); }else voidfunc();
   float link_num = waypoint_getlinknum(this.goalentity, nearest_wp.enemy);
   if (link_num >= 0)
   {
    if ((waypoint_get_assigned_link_cost(this.goalentity, link_num) < 999))
     e = nearest_wp.enemy;
   }
   else
   {
    entity wp = nearest_wp.enemy;
    entity goal = this.goalentity;
    float walkable = false;
    if (checkpvs(wp.origin, goal))
    {
     set_tracewalk_dest(goal, wp.origin, false);
     if (((_vlen2 = (tracewalk_dest - wp.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((1050) ** 2))
      && tracewalk(goal, wp.origin, PL_MIN_CONST, PL_MAX_CONST,
      tracewalk_dest, tracewalk_dest_height, bot_navigation_movemode))
     {
      walkable = true;
      e = nearest_wp.enemy;
     }
    }
    waypoint_addlink_customcost(goal, wp, (walkable ? waypoint_getlinkcost(wp, goal) : 999));
   }
  }
 }

 for (;;)
 {

  navigation_pushroute(this, e);
  e = e.enemy;

  if(e==(0, world))
   break;
 }

 return false;
}


float navigation_shortenpath(entity this)
{
 if (!this.goalstack01 || wasfreed(this.goalstack01))
  return false;
 if (this.bot_tracewalk_time > time)
  return false;
 this.bot_tracewalk_time = max(time, this.bot_tracewalk_time) + 0.25;

 float cut_allowed = false;
 entity next = this.goalentity;


 if (((((next).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (next.flags & FL_MONSTER)) && !(next).stat_FROZEN))
 {
  set_tracewalk_dest(next, this.origin, true);
  if (((_vlen2 = (this.origin - tracewalk_dest), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((200) ** 2)))
   cut_allowed = true;
  else if (((_vlen2 = (tracewalk_dest - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((700) ** 2))
   && ((_vlen2 = (tracewalk_dest - this.goalcurrent.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((200) ** 2))
   && ((_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.goalcurrent.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((100) ** 2))
   && checkpvs(this.origin + this.view_ofs, next))
  {
   if ((_vlen2 = (next.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (this.goalcurrent.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))))
    cut_allowed = true;
   else
   {
    vector deviation = vectoangles(this.goalcurrent.origin - this.origin) - vectoangles(next.origin - this.origin);
    while (deviation.y < -180) deviation.y += 360;
    while (deviation.y > 180) deviation.y -= 360;
    if (fabs(deviation.y) > 25)
     cut_allowed = true;
   }
  }
  if (cut_allowed)
  {
   if (trace_ent == this || tracewalk(this, this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs,
    tracewalk_dest, tracewalk_dest_height, bot_navigation_movemode))
   {
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/bot/default/navigation.qc", "1592")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("path optimized for ", this.netname, ", route cleared"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
    do
    {
     navigation_poproute(this);
    }
    while (this.goalcurrent != next);
    return true;
   }
   return false;
  }
 }

 next = this.goalstack01;

 if (!((((next).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (next.flags & FL_MONSTER)) && !(next).stat_FROZEN) && !(this.goalcurrent.wpflags & (WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT | WAYPOINTFLAG_JUMP))
  && (_vlen2 = (this.goalcurrent.origin - next.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > (_vlen2 = (next.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2)))
  && checkpvs(this.origin + this.view_ofs, next))
 {
  set_tracewalk_dest(next, this.origin, true);
  cut_allowed = true;

float navigation_poptouchedgoals(entity this)
{
 float removed_goals = 0;

 if(!this.goalcurrent)
  return removed_goals;

 if(this.goalcurrent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT)
 {
  if (!this.goalcurrent.wpisbox
   && (_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.goalstack01.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.goalcurrent.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))))
  {

   navigation_poproute(this);
   ++removed_goals;
   navigation_poproute(this);
   ++removed_goals;
   this.lastteleporttime = 0;
  }



  if(this.lastteleporttime > 0 && boxesoverlap(this.goalcurrent.absmin, this.goalcurrent.absmax, this.lastteleport_origin + (this).stat_PL_MIN, this.lastteleport_origin + (this).stat_PL_MAX))
  {
   if(this.aistatus & AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_GOING)
   if((this.goalcurrent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_PERSONAL) && this.goalcurrent.owner==this)
   {
    this.aistatus &= ~AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_GOING;
    this.aistatus |= AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_REACHED;
   }
   if(this.jumppadcount)
   {


    float max_delay = 0.1;
    if (((_vlen2 = ((_vec2 = (this.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((2 * autocvar_sv_maxspeed) ** 2)))
     max_delay = 0.05;
    if (time - this.lastteleporttime < random() * max_delay)
     return removed_goals;
   }
   else if (this.goalcurrent.wpisbox)
   {

    navigation_poproute(this);
    ++removed_goals;
   }
   navigation_poproute(this);
   this.lastteleporttime = 0;
   ++removed_goals;
  }
  return removed_goals;
 }
 else if (this.lastteleporttime > 0)
 {



  entity tele_ent = (0, world);
  if (this.goalstack01 && (this.goalstack01.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT))
   tele_ent = this.goalstack01;
  else if (this.goalstack02 && (this.goalstack02.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT))
   tele_ent = this.goalstack02;
  else if (this.goalstack03 && (this.goalstack03.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT))
   tele_ent = this.goalstack03;
  if (tele_ent && boxesoverlap(tele_ent.absmin, tele_ent.absmax, this.lastteleport_origin + (this).stat_PL_MIN, this.lastteleport_origin + (this).stat_PL_MAX))
  {
   if (this.aistatus & AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_GOING)
   if ((tele_ent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_PERSONAL) && tele_ent.owner == this)
   {
    this.aistatus &= ~AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_GOING;
    this.aistatus |= AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_REACHED;
   }
   while (this.goalcurrent != tele_ent)
   {
    navigation_poproute(this);
    ++removed_goals;
   }
   navigation_poproute(this);
   this.lastteleporttime = 0;
   ++removed_goals;
   return removed_goals;
  }


  this.lastteleporttime = 0;
 }



 if((this.aistatus & AI_STATUS_RUNNING) && this.goalcurrent.classname == "waypoint" && !(this.goalcurrent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_JUMP)
  && this.goalstack01 && !wasfreed(this.goalstack01) && ((_vlen2 = ((_vec2 = (this.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2)), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) >= ((autocvar_sv_maxspeed) ** 2)))

  {

   if(trace_fraction==1)

     this.aistatus |= AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_REACHED;
    }

    navigation_poproute(this);
    ++removed_goals;
    if(this.goalcurrent && this.goalcurrent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT)
     return removed_goals;
   }
  }
 }

 while (this.goalcurrent && !((this.goalcurrent).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 {
  vector gc_min = this.goalcurrent.absmin;
  vector gc_max = this.goalcurrent.absmax;
  if(this.goalcurrent.classname == "waypoint" && !this.goalcurrent.wpisbox)
  {
   gc_min = this.goalcurrent.origin - '1 1 1' * 12;
   gc_max = this.goalcurrent.origin + '1 1 1' * 12 + eZ * (jumpheight_vec.z + (this).stat_PL_MIN.z);
  }
  if (this.ladder_entity)
  {
   if (!boxesoverlap(this.absmin, this.absmax - eZ * (this).stat_PL_MAX.z, gc_min, gc_max))
    break;
  }
  else
  {
   if (!boxesoverlap(this.absmin, this.absmax, gc_min, gc_max))
    break;
  }


  if(this.aistatus & AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_GOING)
  if((this.goalcurrent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_PERSONAL) && this.goalcurrent.owner==this)
  {
   this.aistatus &= ~AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_GOING;
   this.aistatus |= AI_STATUS_WAYPOINT_PERSONAL_REACHED;
  }

  navigation_poproute(this);
  ++removed_goals;
  if(this.goalcurrent && this.goalcurrent.wpflags & WAYPOINTFLAG_TELEPORT)
   return removed_goals;
 }
 return removed_goals;
}

 else if(this.goalcounter==29)goal=this.goalstack29;
 else if(this.goalcounter==30)goal=this.goalstack30;
 else if(this.goalcounter==31)goal=this.goalstack31;
 else goal=(0, world);

 if(goal==(0, world))
 {
  this.goalcounter = 0;
  this.lastposition='0 0 0';
  return;
 }

 if(this.lastposition=='0 0 0')
  org = this.origin;
 else
  org = this.lastposition;


 go = ( goal.absmin + goal.absmax ) * 0.5;
 te_lightning2((0, world), org, go);
 this.lastposition = go;

 this.goalcounter++;
}

{

  return;

void bot_queuecommand(entity bot, string cmdstring)
{
 if(!bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_allocated)
 {
  bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf = _buf_create();
  bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_allocated = true;
  bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start = 0;
  bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end = 0;
 }

 bufstr_set(bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf, bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end, cmdstring);



 {
  float sp;
  string parm;
  string cmdstr;

  sp = _strstrofs(cmdstring, " ", 0);
  if(sp >= 0)
  {
   parm = substring(cmdstring, sp + 1, -1);
   cmdstr = substring(cmdstring, 0, sp);
   if(cmdstr == "sound")
   {

    for (;;)
    {
     sp = _strstrofs(parm, " ", 0);
     if(sp < 0)
      break;
     parm = substring(parm, sp + 1, -1);
    }
    precache_sound(parm);
   }
  }
 }

 bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end += 1;
}

void bot_dequeuecommand(entity bot, float idx)
{
 if(!bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_allocated)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("dequeuecommand but no queue allocated"));
 if(idx < bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("dequeueing a command in the past"));
 if(idx >= bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("dequeueing a command in the future"));
 bufstr_set(bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf, idx, "");
 if(idx == bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start)
  bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start += 1;
 if(bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start >= bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end)
  bot_clearqueue(bot);
}

string bot_readcommand(entity bot, float idx)
{
 if(!bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_allocated)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("readcommand but no queue allocated"));
 if(idx < bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("reading a command in the past"));
 if(idx >= bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("reading a command in the future"));
 return bufstr_get(bot.bot_cmdqueuebuf, idx);
}

float bot_havecommand(entity this, float idx)
{
 if(!this.bot_cmdqueuebuf_allocated)
  return false;
 if(idx < this.bot_cmdqueuebuf_start)
  return false;
 if(idx >= this.bot_cmdqueuebuf_end)
  return false;
 return true;
}
