void GameCommand_bbox(float request)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   vector size_min = '0 0 0';
   vector size_max = '0 0 0';
   tracebox('1 0 0' * world.absmin.x,
    '0 1 0' * world.absmin.y + '0 0 1' * world.absmin.z,
    '0 1 0' * world.absmax.y + '0 0 1' * world.absmax.z,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmax.x,
    MOVE_WORLDONLY,
    (0, world));
   size_min.x = (trace_startsolid) ? world.absmin.x : trace_endpos.x;

   tracebox('0 1 0' * world.absmin.y,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmin.x + '0 0 1' * world.absmin.z,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmax.x + '0 0 1' * world.absmax.z,
    '0 1 0' * world.absmax.y,
    MOVE_WORLDONLY,
    (0, world));
   size_min.y = (trace_startsolid) ? world.absmin.y : trace_endpos.y;

   tracebox('0 0 1' * world.absmin.z,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmin.x + '0 1 0' * world.absmin.y,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmax.x + '0 1 0' * world.absmax.y,
    '0 0 1' * world.absmax.z,
    MOVE_WORLDONLY,
    (0, world));
   size_min.z = (trace_startsolid) ? world.absmin.z : trace_endpos.z;

   tracebox('1 0 0' * world.absmax.x,
    '0 1 0' * world.absmin.y + '0 0 1' * world.absmin.z,
    '0 1 0' * world.absmax.y + '0 0 1' * world.absmax.z,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmin.x,
    MOVE_WORLDONLY,
    (0, world));
   size_max.x = (trace_startsolid) ? world.absmax.x : trace_endpos.x;

   tracebox('0 1 0' * world.absmax.y,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmin.x + '0 0 1' * world.absmin.z,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmax.x + '0 0 1' * world.absmax.z,
    '0 1 0' * world.absmin.y,
    MOVE_WORLDONLY,
    (0, world));
   size_max.y = (trace_startsolid) ? world.absmax.y : trace_endpos.y;

   tracebox('0 0 1' * world.absmax.z,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmin.x + '0 1 0' * world.absmin.y,
    '1 0 0' * world.absmax.x + '0 1 0' * world.absmax.y,
    '0 0 1' * world.absmin.z,
    MOVE_WORLDONLY,
    (0, world));
   size_max.z = (trace_startsolid) ? world.absmax.z : trace_endpos.z;

   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "320")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Original size: %v %v", world.absmin, world.absmax); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "321")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Currently set size: %v %v", world.mins, world.maxs); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

void GameCommand_bot_cmd(float request, float argc, string command)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (!world_initialized)
   {
    if(1){ string __s = sprintf("This command works only when the server is running."); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
    return;
   }
   entity bot;

   if (argv(1) == "reset")
   {
    bot_resetqueues();
    return;
   }
   else if (argv(1) == "setbots")
   {
    cvar_settemp("bot_vs_human", "0");
    cvar_settemp("minplayers", "0");
    cvar_settemp("minplayers_per_team", "0");
    cvar_settemp("bot_number", "0");
    bot_fixcount(false);
    cvar_settemp("bot_number", argv(2));
    if (!bot_fixcount(true)) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "363")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Sorry, could not set requested bot count"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
    return;
   }
   else if (argv(1) == "load" && argc == 3)
   {
    float fh, i;
    string s;
    fh = fopen(argv(2), FILE_READ);
    if (fh < 0)
    {
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "373")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("cannot open the file"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
     return;
    }

    i = 0;
    while ((s = fgets(fh)))
    {
     argc = _tokenize_console(s);

     if (argc >= 3 && argv(0) == "sv_cmd" && argv(1) == "bot_cmd")
     {
      if (argv(2) == "reset")
      {
       bot_resetqueues();
      }
      else if (argv(2) == "setbots")
      {
       cvar_settemp("bot_vs_human", "0");
       cvar_settemp("minplayers", "0");
       cvar_settemp("minplayers_per_team", "0");
       cvar_settemp("bot_number", "0");
       bot_fixcount(false);
       cvar_settemp("bot_number", argv(3));
       if (!bot_fixcount(true)) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "396")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Sorry, could not set requested bot count"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
      }
      else
      {
       if(argv(2) == "*" || argv(2) == "all")
        if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))) { { { { bot_queuecommand(it, substring(s, _argv_start_index(3), -1)); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()

          ;
       else
       {
        bot = find_bot_by_number(stof(argv(2)));
        if (bot == (0, world)) bot = find_bot_by_name(argv(2));
        if (bot) bot_queuecommand(bot, substring(s, _argv_start_index(3), -1));
       }
      }
     }
     else
     {
      localcmd(strcat(s, "\n"));
     }

     ++i;
    }
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "419")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(ftos(i), " commands read"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
    fclose(fh);
    return;
   }
   else if (argv(1) == "help")
   {
    if (argv(2)) bot_cmdhelp(argv(2));
    else bot_list_commands();
    return;
   }
   else if (argc >= 3)
   {
    if(argv(1) == "*" || argv(1) == "all")
    {
     float bot_num = 0;
     if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))) { { { { bot_queuecommand(it, substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), -1)); bot_num++; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


       ;
     if(bot_num)
      if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "439")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Command '", substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), -1), "' sent to all bots (", ftos(bot_num), ")"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
     return;
    }
    else
    {
     bot = find_bot_by_number(stof(argv(1)));
     if (bot == (0, world)) bot = find_bot_by_name(argv(1));
     if (bot)
     {
      if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "448")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Command '", substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), -1), "' sent to bot ", bot.netname); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
      bot_queuecommand(bot, substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), -1));
      return;
     }
     else
     {
      if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "454")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Error: Can't find bot with the name or id '", argv(1), "' - Did you mistype the command?"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
     }
    }
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 sv_cmd bot_cmd <client> <command> [<arguments>]"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  <client> can be either the name of the bot or a progressive number (not the entity number!)"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("           can also be '*' or 'all' to allow sending the command to all the bots"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("  For full list of commands, see bot_cmd help [<command>]."); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Examples: sv_cmd bot_cmd 1 cc say something"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("          sv_cmd bot_cmd 1 presskey jump"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("          sv_cmd bot_cmd * pause"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
 }
}

 {

  }
 }

void GameCommand_database(float request, float argc)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (argc == 3)
   {
    if (argv(1) == "save")
    {
     db_save(ServerProgsDB, argv(2));
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "516")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Copied serverprogs database to '", argv(2), "' in the data directory."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
     return;
    }
    else if (argv(1) == "dump")
    {
     db_dump(ServerProgsDB, argv(2));
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "522")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("DB dumped."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
     return;
    }
    else if (argv(1) == "load")
    {

    if (t)
    {
     MapInfo_SwitchGameType(t);
     MapInfo_FilterGametype(MapInfo_CurrentGametype(), MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), MapInfo_RequiredFlags(), MapInfo_ForbiddenFlags(), 0);
     if (MapInfo_count > 0)
     {

      if (lsmaps_reply != "") strunzone(lsmaps_reply);
      lsmaps_reply = strzone(getlsmaps());
      bprint("Game type successfully switched to ", s, "\n");
     }
     else
     {
      bprint("Cannot use this game type: no map for it found\n");
      MapInfo_SwitchGameType(tsave);
      MapInfo_FilterGametype(MapInfo_CurrentGametype(), MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), MapInfo_RequiredFlags(), MapInfo_ForbiddenFlags(), 0);
     }
    }
    else
    {
     bprint("Failed to switch to ", s, ": this game type does not exist!\n");
    }

    return;
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

void GameCommand_animbench(float request, float argc)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   entity tmp_entity;

   if (argc >= 4)
   {
    tmp_entity = __spawn("entity", "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc" ":" "892", false);
    if (argv(1) == "w")
    {
     .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[0];
     _setmodel(tmp_entity, (nextent((0, world))).(weaponentity).model);
    }
    else
    {
     precache_model(argv(1));
     _setmodel(tmp_entity, argv(1));
    }
    float f1 = stof(argv(2));
    float f2 = stof(argv(3));
    float t0;
    float t1 = 0;
    float t2 = 0;
    float n = 0;

    while (t1 + t2 < 1)
    {
     tmp_entity.frame = f1;
     t0 = gettime(GETTIME_HIRES);
     getsurfacepoint(tmp_entity, 0, 0);
     t1 += gettime(GETTIME_HIRES) - t0;
     tmp_entity.frame = f2;
     t0 = gettime(GETTIME_HIRES);
     getsurfacepoint(tmp_entity, 0, 0);
     t2 += gettime(GETTIME_HIRES) - t0;
     n += 1;
    }
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "922")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("model ", tmp_entity.model, " frame ", ftos(f1), " animtime ", ftos(n / t1), "/s"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "923")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("model ", tmp_entity.model, " frame ", ftos(f2), " animtime ", ftos(n / t2), "/s"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

    if(1){ entity _this = (tmp_entity); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(tmp_entity); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();

   if(1){ string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

void GameCommand_moveplayer(float request, float argc)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (!world_initialized)
   {
    if(1){ string __s = sprintf("This command works only when the server is running."); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
    return;
   }
   float accepted;
   entity client;

   string targets = strreplace(",", " ", argv(1));
   string original_targets = strreplace(" ", ", ", targets);
   string destination = argv(2);
   if (destination == "spec")
    destination = "spectator";

   if ((targets) && (destination))
   {
    string successful = nil;
    string t;
    for ( ; targets; )
    {
     t = car(targets);
     targets = cdr(targets);


     client = GetFilteredEntity(t);
     accepted = VerifyClientEntity(client, false, false);
     string client_num_str = ftos(num_for_edict(client));

     if (accepted <= 0)
     {
      if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1067")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("moveplayer: ", GetClientErrorString_color(accepted, t, "^7"), "."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
     }

      if (!(((client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR) || ((client).classname == STR_OBSERVER)) || ((client).ingame))
      {
       PutObserverInServer(client, true, true);

       successful = strcat(successful, (successful ? ", " : ""), pl_name);
      }
      else
      {
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1080")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Player #", client_num_str, " (", pl_name, ") is already spectating."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

       return;
      }

      string pl_name = playername(client.netname, client.team, false);
      if (((client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR) || ((client).classname == STR_OBSERVER))
      {

       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1095")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Player #", client_num_str, " (", pl_name, ") is not in the game."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
       continue;
      }


      float save = Player_GetForcedTeamIndex(client);
      Player_SetForcedTeamIndex(client, TEAM_FORCE_DEFAULT);


      float team_num = Team_ColorToTeam(destination);
      entity balance;
      if (team_num == client.team)
      {

       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1109")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Player #", client_num_str, " (", pl_name, ") is already on the ", strcat(Team_ColorCode(team_num), Team_ColorName(team_num), " ", _("Team"), "^7"), "^7."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
       continue;
      }
      else if (team_num == 0)
      {
       balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams(client);
       team_num = Team_IndexToTeam(TeamBalance_FindBestTeam(balance, client, false));
      }
      else
      {
       balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams(client);
      }
      Player_SetForcedTeamIndex(client, save);


      float team_id = Team_TeamToIndex(team_num);
      if (team_id == -1)
      {
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1127")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Can't move player to ", destination, " team because it doesn't exist."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
       TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
       return;
      }
      if (!IsTeamAvailable(team_num))
      {
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1133")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Can't move player to ", destination, " team because it isn't available."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
       TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
       return;
      }
      if (!TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowed(balance, team_id))
      {
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1139")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Player #", client_num_str, " (", pl_name, ") is not allowed to join the ", strcat(Team_ColorCode(team_num), Team_ColorName(team_num), " ", _("Team"), "^7"), "^7."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
       TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);
       continue;
      }
      TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);


      Player_SetForcedTeamIndex(client, TEAM_FORCE_DEFAULT);
      if (MoveToTeam(client, team_id, 6))
      {
       successful = strcat(successful, (successful ? ", " : ""), pl_name);
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1150")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Player #", client_num_str, " (", pl_name, ") has been moved to the ", strcat(Team_ColorCode(team_num), Team_ColorName(team_num), " ", _("Team"), "^7"), "^7."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
      }
      else
      {
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1154")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Unable to move player #", client_num_str, " (", pl_name, ")"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
      }
     }
    }

    if (successful) bprint("Successfully moved players ", successful, " to destination ", destination, ".\n");
    else if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1160")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("No players given (", original_targets, ") are able to move."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

    return;
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 sv_cmd moveplayer <clients> <destination>"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

void shuffleteams()
{
 if (!teamplay)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1319")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Can't shuffle teams when currently not playing a team game."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((it).ingame))) { { { { if (Player_HasRealForcedTeam(it)) { if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/sv_cmd.qc", "1328")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Can't shuffle teams because at least one player has a forced team."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc(); return; } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()







   ;

 float number_of_teams = 0;
 entity balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams((0, world));
 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowed(balance, i))
  {
   number_of_teams = max(i, number_of_teams);
  }
 }

void GameCommand(string command)
{
 float argc = _tokenize_console(command);






 if (strtolower(argv(0)) == "help")
 {
  if (argc == 1)
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Server console commands:"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   GameCommand_macro_help();

   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("\nBanning commands:"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   BanCommand_macro_help();

   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("\nCommon networked commands:"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

                                                                    ;

string GetCommandPrefix(entity caller)
{
 if (caller) return "cmd";
 else return "sv_cmd";
}


string GetCallerName(entity caller)
{
 if (caller) return playername(caller.netname, caller.team, false);
 else return ((autocvar_sv_adminnick != "") ? autocvar_sv_adminnick : "SERVER ADMIN");
}


float VerifyKickableEntity(entity client)
{
 if (!(clienttype(client) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) return CLIENT_NOT_REAL;
 return CLIENT_ACCEPTABLE;
}


float VerifyClientEntity(entity client, float must_be_real, float must_be_bots)
{
 if (!(client.flags & FL_CLIENT)) return CLIENT_DOESNT_EXIST;
 else if (must_be_real && !(clienttype(client) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) return CLIENT_NOT_REAL;
 else if (must_be_bots && !(clienttype(client) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT)) return CLIENT_NOT_BOT;

 return CLIENT_ACCEPTABLE;
}


string GetClientErrorString_color(float clienterror, string original_input, string col)
{
 switch (clienterror)
 {
  case CLIENT_DOESNT_EXIST:
  { return strcat(col, "Client '", original_input, col, "' doesn't exist");
  }
  case CLIENT_NOT_REAL:
  { return strcat(col, "Client '", original_input, col, "' is not real");
  }
  case CLIENT_NOT_BOT:
  { return strcat(col, "Client '", original_input, col, "' is not a bot");
  }
  default:
  { return "Incorrect usage of GetClientErrorString";
  }
 }
}


float VerifyClientNumber(float tmp_number)
{
 if ((tmp_number < 1) || (tmp_number > maxclients)) return false;
 else return true;
}

entity GetIndexedEntity(float argc, float start_index)
{
 entity selection;
 float tmp_number, index;
 string tmp_string;

 next_token = -1;
 index = start_index;
 selection = (0, world);

 if (argc > start_index)
 {
  if (substring(argv(index), 0, 1) == "#")
  {
   tmp_string = substring(argv(index), 1, -1);
   ++index;

   if (tmp_string != "")
   {
    tmp_number = stof(tmp_string);
   }
   else if (argc > index)
   {
    tmp_number = stof(argv(index));
    ++index;
   }
   else
   {
    tmp_number = 0;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   tmp_number = stof(argv(index));
   ++index;
  }

  if (VerifyClientNumber(tmp_number))
  {
   selection = edict_num(tmp_number);
  }
  else
  {
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { if(strdecolorize(it.netname) == strdecolorize(argv(start_index))) { selection = it; break; } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()





     ;

   index = (start_index + 1);
  }
 }

 next_token = index;

 return selection;
}


entity GetFilteredEntity(string input)
{
 entity selection;
 float tmp_number;

 if (substring(input, 0, 1) == "#") tmp_number = stof(substring(input, 1, -1));
 else tmp_number = stof(input);

 if (VerifyClientNumber(tmp_number))
 {
  selection = edict_num(tmp_number);
 }
 else
 {
  selection = (0, world);
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { if(strdecolorize(it.netname) == strdecolorize(input)) { selection = it; break; } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()





    ;
 }

 return selection;
}


void print_to(entity to, string input)
{
 if (to) sprint(to, strcat(input, "\n"));
 else print(input, "\n");
}






void timeout_handler_reset(entity this)
{
 timeout_caller = (0, world);
 timeout_time = 0;
 timeout_leadtime = 0;

 if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();



 if (warmup_stage) ReadyCount();
}

void timeout_handler_think(entity this)
{
 switch (timeout_status)
 {
  case TIMEOUT_ACTIVE:
  {
   if (timeout_time > 0)
   {
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_TIMEOUT_ENDING, timeout_time);

    if (timeout_time == autocvar_sv_timeout_resumetime)
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_PREPARE);

    this.nextthink = time + TIMEOUT_SLOWMO_VALUE;
    timeout_time -= 1;
   }
   else
   {
    Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_TIMEIN);
    timeout_status = TIMEOUT_INACTIVE;


    cvar_set("slowmo", ftos(orig_slowmo));


    if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { it.fixangle = false; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()

      ;

    timeout_handler_reset(this);
   }

   return;
  }

  case TIMEOUT_LEADTIME:
  {
   if (timeout_leadtime > 0)
   {
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_TIMEOUT_BEGINNING, timeout_leadtime);

    this.nextthink = time + 1;
    timeout_leadtime -= 1;
   }
   else
   {
    timeout_status = TIMEOUT_ACTIVE;


    cvar_set("slowmo", ftos(TIMEOUT_SLOWMO_VALUE));


    if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { it.nickspamcount = it.nickspamtime = it.floodcontrol_chat = it.floodcontrol_chatteam = it.floodcontrol_chattell = it.floodcontrol_voice = it.floodcontrol_voiceteam = 0; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()



      ;


    if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { it.lastV_angle = it.v_angle; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()

      ;

    this.nextthink = time;
   }

   return;
  }


  case TIMEOUT_INACTIVE:
  default:
  {
   timeout_handler_reset(this);
   return;
  }
 }
}

void CommonCommand_editmob(float request, entity caller, float argc)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (autocvar_g_campaign) { print_to(caller, "Monster editing is disabled in singleplayer"); return; }


   if (caller)
   {
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./server/command/common.qc", 333, __FUNC__, "\"caller.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(caller.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
    WarpZone_TraceLine(caller.origin + caller.view_ofs, caller.origin + caller.view_ofs + v_forward * 100, MOVE_NORMAL, caller);
   }

   entity mon = trace_ent;
   float is_visible = (mon.flags & FL_MONSTER);
   string argument = argv(2);

   switch (argv(1))
   {
    case "name":
    {
     if (!caller) { print_to(caller, "Only players can edit monsters"); return; }
     if (!argument) break;
     if (!autocvar_g_monsters_edit) { print_to(caller, "Monster editing is disabled"); return; }
     if (mon.realowner != caller && autocvar_g_monsters_edit < 2) { print_to(caller, "This monster does not belong to you"); return; }
     if (!is_visible) { print_to(caller, "You must look at your monster to edit it"); return; }

     string mon_oldname = mon.monster_name;

     mon.monster_name = argument;
     if (mon.sprite) WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(mon.sprite, WP_Monster, WP_Null, WP_Null);
     print_to(caller, sprintf("Your pet '%s' is now known as '%s'", mon_oldname, mon.monster_name));
     return;
    }
    case "spawn":
    {
     if (!caller) { print_to(caller, "Only players can spawn monsters"); return; }
     if (!argv(2)) break;

     float moveflag, tmp_moncount = 0;
     string arg_lower = strtolower(argument);
     moveflag = (argv(3)) ? stof(argv(3)) : 1;

     if (arg_lower == "list") { print_to(caller, monsterlist_reply); return; }

     if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_monsters.il_loop_item; g_monsters.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_monsters.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (it.realowner == caller) { { { ++tmp_moncount; }; } } if (g_monsters.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_monsters.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_monsters.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()


       ;

     if (!autocvar_g_monsters) { print_to(caller, "Monsters are disabled"); return; }
     if (autocvar_g_monsters_max <= 0 || autocvar_g_monsters_max_perplayer <= 0) { print_to(caller, "Monster spawning is disabled"); return; }
     if (!((caller).classname == STR_PLAYER)) { print_to(caller, "You must be playing to spawn a monster"); return; }
     if (__Mutator_Send_AllowMobSpawning(0 , caller)) { print_to(caller, MUTATOR_ARGV_1_string); return; }
     if (caller.vehicle) { print_to(caller, "You can't spawn monsters while driving a vehicle"); return; }
     if ((caller).stat_FROZEN) { print_to(caller, "You can't spawn monsters while frozen"); return; }
     if (((caller).deadflag != DEAD_NO)) { print_to(caller, "You can't spawn monsters while dead"); return; }
     if (tmp_moncount >= autocvar_g_monsters_max) { print_to(caller, "The maximum monster count has been reached"); return; }
     if (tmp_moncount >= autocvar_g_monsters_max_perplayer) { print_to(caller, "You can't spawn any more monsters"); return; }

     float found = false;
     if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Monsters_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != MON_Null && it.netname == arg_lower) { { { found = true; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc()



       ;

     if (!found && arg_lower != "random" && arg_lower != "anyrandom") { print_to(caller, "Invalid monster"); return; }

     totalspawned += 1;
     WarpZone_TraceBox((caller.origin + (((caller).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? caller.view_ofs : ((caller.mins + caller.maxs) * 0.5))), caller.mins, caller.maxs, (caller.origin + (((caller).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? caller.view_ofs : ((caller.mins + caller.maxs) * 0.5))) + v_forward * 150, true, caller);
     mon = spawnmonster(__spawn("entity", "./server/command/common.qc" ":" "395", false), arg_lower, MON_Null, caller, caller, trace_endpos, false, false, moveflag);
     print_to(caller, strcat("Spawned ", mon.monster_name));
     return;
    }
    case "kill":
    {
     if (!caller) { print_to(caller, "Only players can kill monsters"); return; }
     if (mon.realowner != caller && autocvar_g_monsters_edit < 2) { print_to(caller, "This monster does not belong to you"); return; }
     if (!is_visible) { print_to(caller, "You must look at your monster to edit it"); return; }

     Damage(mon, (0, world), (0, world), GetResource(mon, RES_HEALTH) + mon.max_health + 200, DEATH_KILL.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), mon.origin, '0 0 0');
     print_to(caller, strcat("Your pet '", mon.monster_name, "' has been brutally mutilated"));
     return;
    }
    case "skin":
    {
     if (!caller) { print_to(caller, "Only players can edit monsters"); return; }
     if (!argument) break;
     if (!autocvar_g_monsters_edit) { print_to(caller, "Monster editing is disabled"); return; }
     if (!is_visible) { print_to(caller, "You must look at your monster to edit it"); return; }
     if (mon.realowner != caller && autocvar_g_monsters_edit < 2) { print_to(caller, "This monster does not belong to you"); return; }
     if (mon.monsterdef == MON_MAGE) { print_to(caller, "Mage skins can't be changed"); return; }

     mon.skin = stof(argument);
     print_to(caller, strcat("Monster skin successfully changed to ", ftos(mon.skin)));
     return;
    }
    case "movetarget":
    {
     if (!caller) { print_to(caller, "Only players can edit monsters"); return; }
     if (!argument) break;
     if (!autocvar_g_monsters_edit) { print_to(caller, "Monster editing is disabled"); return; }
     if (!is_visible) { print_to(caller, "You must look at your monster to edit it"); return; }
     if (mon.realowner != caller && autocvar_g_monsters_edit < 2) { print_to(caller, "This monster does not belong to you"); return; }

     mon.monster_moveflags = stof(argument);
     print_to(caller, strcat("Monster move target successfully changed to ", ftos(mon.monster_moveflags)));
     return;
    }
    case "butcher":
    {
     if (caller) { print_to(caller, "This command is not available to players"); return; }
     if (__Mutator_Send_AllowMobButcher(0 )) { if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/common.qc", "437")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(MUTATOR_ARGV_0_string); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc(); return; }

     float tmp_remcount = 0;

     if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_monsters.il_loop_item; g_monsters.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_monsters.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (true) { { { Monster_Remove(it); ++tmp_remcount; }; } } if (g_monsters.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_monsters.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_monsters.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()



       ;
     if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_prev = _il.il_prevfld; .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { _next = _it.(il_next); _it.(il_next) = _it.(il_prev) = (0, world); } _il.il_head = _il.il_tail = (0, world); }else voidfunc();

     monsters_total = monsters_killed = totalspawned = 0;

     print_to(caller, (tmp_remcount) ? sprintf("Killed %d monster%s", tmp_remcount, (tmp_remcount == 1) ? "" : "s") : "No monsters to kill");
     return;
    }
   }
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " editmob <command> [<arguments>]"));
   print_to(caller, "  Where <command> can be butcher spawn skin movetarget kill name");
   print_to(caller, "  spawn, skin, movetarget and name require <arguments>");
   print_to(caller, "  spawn also takes arguments list and random");
   print_to(caller, "  Monster will follow owner if third argument of spawn command is not defined");
   return;
  }
 }
}

void CommonCommand_info(float request, entity caller, float argc)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   string command = cvar_string(strcat("sv_info_", argv(1)));

   if (command) wordwrap_sprint(caller, command, 1000);
   else print_to(caller, "ERROR: unsupported info command");

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " info <request>"));
   print_to(caller, "  Where <request> is the suffixed string appended onto the request for cvar.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

    print_to(caller, records_reply[num - 1]);

 }

{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("time = ", ftos(time)));
   print_to(caller, strcat("frame start = ", ftos(gettime(GETTIME_FRAMESTART))));

   print_to(caller, strcat("uptime = ", ftos(gettime(GETTIME_UPTIME))));

   print_to(caller, strcat("gmtime = ", strftime(false, "%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Z %Y")));
   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " time"));
   print_to(caller, "  No arguments required.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

void CommonCommand_timein(float request, entity caller)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (!caller || autocvar_sv_timeout)
   {
    if (!timeout_status) { print_to(caller, "^7Error: There is no active timeout called."); }
    else if (caller && (caller != timeout_caller))
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: You are not allowed to stop the active timeout.");
    }

    else
    {
     switch (timeout_status)
     {
      case TIMEOUT_LEADTIME:
      {
       timeout_status = TIMEOUT_INACTIVE;
       timeout_time = 0;
       timeout_handler.nextthink = time;
       Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_TIMEOUT);
       bprint(strcat("^7The timeout was aborted by ", GetCallerName(caller), " !\n"));
       return;
      }

      case TIMEOUT_ACTIVE:
      {
       timeout_time = autocvar_sv_timeout_resumetime;
       timeout_handler.nextthink = time;
       bprint(strcat("^1Attention: ^7", GetCallerName(caller), " resumed the game! Prepare for battle!\n"));
       return;
      }

      default: if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/common.qc", "684")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("timeout status was inactive, but this code was executed anyway?"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
       return;
     }
    }
   }
   else { print_to(caller, "^1Timeins are not allowed to be called, enable them with sv_timeout 1.\n"); }

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " timein"));
   print_to(caller, "  No arguments required.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

void CommonCommand_timeout(float request, entity caller)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (!caller || autocvar_sv_timeout)
   {
    float last_possible_timeout = ((cvar("timelimit") * 60) - autocvar_sv_timeout_leadtime - 1);

    if (timeout_status) { print_to(caller, "^7Error: A timeout is already active."); }
    else if (vote_called)
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: You can not call a timeout while a vote is active.");
    }
    else if (warmup_stage && !autocvar_g_warmup_allow_timeout)
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: You can not call a timeout in warmup-stage.");
    }
    else if (time < game_starttime)
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: You can not call a timeout while the map is being restarted.");
    }
    else if (caller && ((caller._cs).allowed_timeouts < 1))
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: You already used all your timeout calls for this map.");
    }
    else if (caller && !((caller).classname == STR_PLAYER))
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: You must be a player to call a timeout.");
    }
    else if ((cvar("timelimit")) && (last_possible_timeout < time - game_starttime))
    {
     print_to(caller, "^7Error: It is too late to call a timeout now!");
    }

    else
    {
     if (caller) (caller._cs).allowed_timeouts -= 1;

     bprint(GetCallerName(caller), " ^7called a timeout", (caller ? strcat(" (", ftos((caller._cs).allowed_timeouts), " timeout(s) left)") : ""), "!\n");

     timeout_status = TIMEOUT_LEADTIME;
     timeout_caller = caller;
     timeout_time = autocvar_sv_timeout_length;
     timeout_leadtime = autocvar_sv_timeout_leadtime;

     timeout_handler = __spawn("timeout_handler", "./server/command/common.qc" ":" "751", false);
     (_selftemp = (timeout_handler), _selftemp.__think = ((timeout_handler_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (timeout_handler_think));
     timeout_handler.nextthink = time;

     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_TIMEOUT);
    }
   }
   else { print_to(caller, "^1Timeouts are not allowed to be called, enable them with sv_timeout 1.\n"); }

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " timeout"));
   print_to(caller, "  No arguments required.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

string getrankings()
{
 float t, i;
 string n, s, p, map;

 map = GetMapname();

 s = "";
 for (i = 1; i <= RANKINGS_CNT; ++i)
 {
  t = race_readTime(map, i);

  if (t == 0) continue;

  n = race_readName(map, i);
  p = count_ordinal(i);
  s = strcat(s, strpad(8, p), " ", strpad(-8, clockedtime_tostring(t, true, false)), " ", n, "\n");
 }

 MapInfo_ClearTemps();

 if (s == "") return strcat("No records are available for the map: ", map, "\n");
 else return strcat("Records for ", map, ":\n", s);
}

string getmaplist()
{
 string maplist = "", col;
 float i, argc;

 argc = _tokenize_console(cvar_string("g_maplist"));
 for (i = 0; i < argc; ++i)
 {
  if (MapInfo_CheckMap(argv(i)))
  {
   if (i % 2) col = "^2"; else col = "^3";
   maplist = sprintf("%s%s%s ", maplist, col, argv(i));
  }
 }

 MapInfo_ClearTemps();
 return sprintf("^7Maps in list: %s\n", maplist);
}

const float LSMAPS_MAX = 250;
string getlsmaps()
{
 string lsmaps = "", col;
 float newmaps = false;
 float added = 0;

 for (float i = 0; i < MapInfo_count; ++i)
 {
  if ((MapInfo_Get_ByID(i)) && !(MapInfo_Map_flags & MapInfo_ForbiddenFlags()))
  {
   ++added;

   if(added > LSMAPS_MAX)
    continue;


   if(((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE) || (MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS)) && !race_readTime(MapInfo_Map_bspname, 1))
   {
    newmaps = true;
    if (i % 2) col = "^4*"; else col = "^5*";
   }
   else
   {
    if (i % 2) col = "^2"; else col = "^3";
   }

   lsmaps = sprintf("%s%s%s ", lsmaps, col, MapInfo_Map_bspname);
  }
 }

 if(added > LSMAPS_MAX)
  lsmaps = sprintf("%s^7(%d not listed)", lsmaps, added - LSMAPS_MAX);

 MapInfo_ClearTemps();
 return sprintf("^7Maps available (%d)%s: %s\n", added, (newmaps ? " (New maps have asterisks marked in blue)" : ""), lsmaps);
}

float Nagger_SendEntity(entity this, entity to, float sendflags)
{
 float nags = 0;
 if(1){ if (NET_ENT_CLIENT_NAGGER_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, NET_ENT_CLIENT_NAGGER.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
# 52 "./server/command/vote.qc"
 if (warmup_stage)
 {
  if (readycount)
  {
   nags |= (1 << (0));
   if (!to.ready) nags |= (1 << (1));
  }
  nags |= (1 << (4));
 }

 if (vote_called)
 {
  nags |= (1 << (2));
  if (to.vote_selection == 0) nags |= (1 << (3));
  nags |= sendflags & (1 << (6));
  nags |= sendflags & (1 << (7));
 }

 WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, nags);

 if (nags & (1 << (6)))
 {
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, vote_accept_count);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, vote_reject_count);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, vote_needed_overall);
  WriteChar(MSG_ENTITY, to.vote_selection);
 }

 if (nags & (1 << (7))) WriteString(MSG_ENTITY, vote_called_display);

 if (nags & (1 << (0)))
 {
  for (float i = 1; i <= maxclients;)
  {
   float f = 0;
   for (float b = 0; b < 8 && i <= maxclients; ++b, ++i)
    if (edict_num(i).ready)
     f |= (1 << (b));
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, f);
  }
 }

 return true;
}

void Nagger_Init()
{
 Net_LinkEntity(nagger = __spawn("nagger", "./server/command/vote.qc" ":" "99", true), false, 0, Nagger_SendEntity);
}

void Nagger_VoteChanged()
{
 if (nagger) nagger.SendFlags |= (1 << (7));
}

void Nagger_VoteCountChanged()
{
 if (nagger) nagger.SendFlags |= (1 << (6));
}

void Nagger_ReadyCounted()
{
 if (nagger) nagger.SendFlags |= (1 << (0));
}

void VoteStop(entity stopper, float canceled)
{
 if (canceled)
  bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2's vote was canceled\n");
 else
  bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", GetCallerName(stopper), "^2 stopped ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2's vote\n");
 if (autocvar_sv_eventlog) GameLogEcho(strcat(":vote:vstop:", ftos(stopper.playerid)));

 if ((vote_caller) && (stopper == vote_caller)) vote_caller.vote_waittime = time + autocvar_sv_vote_stop;
 VoteReset(false);
}

void VoteAccept()
{
 bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2's vote for ^1", vote_called_display, "^2 was accepted\n");

 if ((vote_called == VOTE_MASTER) && vote_caller) vote_caller.vote_master = true;
 else localcmd(strcat(vote_called_command, "\n"));

 if (vote_caller) vote_caller.vote_waittime = 0;

 VoteReset(false);
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_VOTE_ACCEPT);
}

void VoteReject()
{
 bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2's vote for ", vote_called_display, "^2 was rejected\n");
 VoteReset(false);
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_VOTE_FAIL);
}

void VoteTimeout()
{
 bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2's vote for ", vote_called_display, "^2 timed out\n");
 VoteReset(false);
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_VOTE_FAIL);
}

void VoteSpam(float notvoters, float mincount, string result)
{
 bprint(strcat(
  strcat("\{1}^2* vote results: ^1", ftos(vote_accept_count)),
  strcat("^2:^1", ftos(vote_reject_count)),
  ((mincount >= 0) ? strcat("^2 (^1", ftos(mincount), "^2 needed)") : "^2"),
  strcat(", ^1", ftos(vote_abstain_count), "^2 didn't care"),
  strcat(", ^1", ftos(notvoters), strcat("^2 didn't ", ((mincount >= 0) ? "" : "have to "), "vote\n"))));

 if (autocvar_sv_eventlog)
 {
  GameLogEcho(strcat(
   strcat(":vote:v", result, ":", ftos(vote_accept_count)),
   strcat(":", ftos(vote_reject_count)),
   strcat(":", ftos(vote_abstain_count)),
   strcat(":", ftos(notvoters)),
   strcat(":", ftos(mincount))));
 }
}



void VoteCount(float first_count)
{
 vote_accept_count = vote_reject_count = vote_abstain_count = 0;

 float vote_player_count = 0, notvoters = 0;
 float vote_real_player_count = 0, vote_real_accept_count = 0;
 float vote_real_reject_count = 0, vote_real_abstain_count = 0;
 float vote_needed_of_voted, final_needed_votes;
 float vote_factor_overall, vote_factor_of_voted;

 Nagger_VoteCountChanged();


 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL) || autocvar_sv_vote_debug)) { { { { ++vote_player_count; if (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((it).ingame)) ++vote_real_player_count; switch (it.vote_selection) { case VOTE_SELECT_REJECT: ++vote_reject_count; if (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((it).ingame)) ++vote_real_reject_count; break; case VOTE_SELECT_ACCEPT: ++vote_accept_count; if (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((it).ingame)) ++vote_real_accept_count; break; case VOTE_SELECT_ABSTAIN: ++vote_abstain_count; if (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((it).ingame)) ++vote_real_abstain_count; break; default: break; } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()
# 249 "./server/command/vote.qc"
   ;


 if ((vote_called == VOTE_MASTER) && autocvar_sv_vote_master_playerlimit > vote_player_count)
 {
  if (vote_caller) vote_caller.vote_waittime = 0;
  print_to(vote_caller, "^1There are not enough players on this server to allow you to become vote master.");
  VoteReset(false);
  return;
 }


 if (!(!autocvar_sv_vote_nospectators || (autocvar_sv_vote_nospectators == 1 && (warmup_stage || intermission_running))) && (vote_real_player_count > 0))
 {
  vote_accept_count = vote_real_accept_count;
  vote_reject_count = vote_real_reject_count;
  vote_abstain_count = vote_real_abstain_count;
  vote_player_count = vote_real_player_count;
 }


 notvoters = (vote_player_count - vote_accept_count - vote_reject_count - vote_abstain_count);


 vote_factor_overall = bound(0.5, autocvar_sv_vote_majority_factor, 0.999);
 vote_needed_overall = floor((vote_player_count - vote_abstain_count) * vote_factor_overall) + 1;


 vote_factor_of_voted = bound(0.5, autocvar_sv_vote_majority_factor_of_voted, 0.999);
 vote_needed_of_voted = floor((vote_accept_count + vote_reject_count) * vote_factor_of_voted) + 1;


 if (vote_player_count == 0 && first_count)
 {
  VoteSpam(0, -1, "yes");
  VoteAccept();
  return;
 }


 if (vote_accept_count >= vote_needed_overall)
 {
  VoteSpam(notvoters, -1, "yes");
  VoteAccept();
  return;
 }

 if (vote_reject_count > vote_player_count - vote_abstain_count - vote_needed_overall)
 {
  VoteSpam(notvoters, -1, "no");
  VoteReject();
  return;
 }


 if (time > vote_endtime)
 {
  final_needed_votes = vote_needed_overall;

  if (autocvar_sv_vote_majority_factor_of_voted)
  {
   if (vote_accept_count >= vote_needed_of_voted)
   {
    VoteSpam(notvoters, min(vote_needed_overall, vote_needed_of_voted), "yes");
    VoteAccept();
    return;
   }

   if (vote_accept_count + vote_reject_count > 0)
   {
    VoteSpam(notvoters, min(vote_needed_overall, vote_needed_of_voted), "no");
    VoteReject();
    return;
   }

   final_needed_votes = min(vote_needed_overall, vote_needed_of_voted);
  }


  VoteSpam(notvoters, final_needed_votes, "timeout");
  VoteTimeout();
 }
}

  if (time > vote_endtime)
   VoteCount(false);
 }
}

float Votecommand_check_assignment(entity caller, float assignment)
{
 float from_server = (!caller);

 if ((assignment == VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)
     || ((!from_server && assignment == VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)
     || (from_server && assignment == VC_ASGNMNT_SERVERONLY))) return true;

 return false;
}

string VoteCommand_extractcommand(string input, float startpos, float argc)
{
 string output;

 if ((argc - 1) < startpos) output = "";
 else output = substring(input, _argv_start_index(startpos), _argv_end_index(-1) - _argv_start_index(startpos));

 return output;
}

float VoteCommand_checknasty(string vote_command)
{
 return !((_strstrofs(vote_command, ";", 0) >= 0)
     || (_strstrofs(vote_command, "\n", 0) >= 0)
     || (_strstrofs(vote_command, "\r", 0) >= 0)
     || (_strstrofs(vote_command, "$", 0) >= 0));
}


string VoteCommand_checkreplacements(string input)
{

 string output = strcat(" ", input, " ");

 output = strreplace(" map ", " gotomap ", output);
 output = strreplace(" chmap ", " gotomap ", output);
 return output;
}

float VoteCommand_checkinlist(string vote_command, string list)
{
 if (vote_command == "" || list == "")
  return false;

 string l = VoteCommand_checkreplacements(list);
 return (_strstrofs(l, VoteCommand_checkreplacements(vote_command), 0) >= 0);
}

string ValidateMap(string validated_map, entity caller)
{
 validated_map = MapInfo_FixName(validated_map);

 if (!validated_map)
 {
  print_to(caller, "This map is not available on this server.");
  return nil;
 }

 if (!autocvar_sv_vote_override_mostrecent && caller)
 {
  if (Map_IsRecent(validated_map))
  {
   print_to(caller, "This server does not allow for recent maps to be played again. Please be patient for some rounds.");
   return nil;
  }
 }

 if (!MapInfo_CheckMap(validated_map))
 {
  print_to(caller, strcat("^1Invalid mapname, \"^3", validated_map, "^1\" does not support the current game mode."));
  return nil;
 }

 return validated_map;
}

float VoteCommand_checkargs(float startpos, float argc)
{
 float p, q, check, minargs;
 string cvarname = strcat("sv_vote_command_restriction_", argv(startpos));
 string cmdrestriction = "";
 string charlist, arg;
 float checkmate;

 if(cvar_type(cvarname) & CVAR_TYPEFLAG_EXISTS)
  cmdrestriction = cvar_string(cvarname);
 else
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/command/vote.qc", "672")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("NOTE: ", cvarname, " does not exist, no restrictions will be applied."); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

 if (cmdrestriction == "") return true;

 ++startpos;







 minargs = stof(cmdrestriction);
 if (argc - startpos < minargs) return false;

 p = _strstrofs(cmdrestriction, ";", 0);

 for ( ; ; )
 {





  if (startpos >= argc)
   break;

  if (p < 0)
  {

   if (argc - startpos == minargs) break;


   return false;
  }


  q = _strstrofs(cmdrestriction, ";", p + 1);
  if (q < 0) charlist = substring(cmdrestriction, p + 1, -1);
  else charlist = substring(cmdrestriction, p + 1, q - (p + 1));




  if (charlist != "")
  {

   arg = argv(startpos);
   checkmate = _strlen(arg);
   for (check = 0; check < checkmate; ++check)
    if (_strstrofs(charlist, substring(arg, check, 1), 0) < 0) return false;


  }

  ++startpos;
  --minargs;
  p = q;
 }

 return true;
}

float VoteCommand_parse(entity caller, string vote_command, string vote_list, float startpos, float argc)
{
 string first_command = argv(startpos);
 float missing_chars = _argv_start_index(startpos);

 if (autocvar_sv_vote_limit > 0 && _strlen(vote_command) > autocvar_sv_vote_limit)
  return 0;

 if (!VoteCommand_checkinlist(first_command, vote_list)) return 0;

 if (!VoteCommand_checkargs(startpos, argc)) return 0;

 switch (__Mutator_Send_VoteCommand_Parse(0 , caller, first_command, vote_command, startpos, argc))
 {
  case MUT_VOTEPARSE_CONTINUE: { break; }
  case MUT_VOTEPARSE_SUCCESS: { return 1; }
  case MUT_VOTEPARSE_INVALID: { return -1; }
  case MUT_VOTEPARSE_UNACCEPTABLE: { return 0; }
 }

 switch (first_command)
 {
  case "movetoauto":
  case "movetored":
  case "movetoblue":
  case "movetoyellow":
  case "movetopink":
  case "movetospec":
  {
   entity victim = GetIndexedEntity(argc, (startpos + 1));
   float accepted = VerifyClientEntity(victim, true, false);
   if (accepted > 0)
   {
    vote_parsed_command = vote_command;
    vote_parsed_display = sprintf("^1%s #%d ^7%s", first_command, num_for_edict(victim), victim.netname);
   }
   else
   {
    print_to(caller, strcat("vcall: ", GetClientErrorString_color(accepted, argv(startpos + 1), "^7"), ".\n"));
    return 0;
   }

   break;
  }

  case "kick":
  case "kickban":
  {
   entity victim = GetIndexedEntity(argc, (startpos + 1));
   float accepted = VerifyClientEntity(victim, true, false);

   if (accepted > 0)
   {
    string reason = "No reason provided";
    if(argc > next_token)
     reason = substring(vote_command, _argv_start_index(next_token) - missing_chars, -1);

    string command_arguments = reason;
    if (first_command == "kickban")
     command_arguments = strcat(ftos(autocvar_g_ban_default_bantime), " ", ftos(autocvar_g_ban_default_masksize), " ~");

    vote_parsed_command = strcat(first_command, " # ", ftos(num_for_edict(victim)), " ", command_arguments);
    vote_parsed_display = sprintf("^1%s #%d ^7%s^1 %s", first_command, num_for_edict(victim), victim.netname, reason);
   }
   else
   {
    print_to(caller, strcat("vcall: ", GetClientErrorString_color(accepted, argv(startpos + 1), "^7"), ".\n"));
    return 0;
   }

   break;
  }

  case "map":
  case "chmap":
  case "gotomap":
  {
   vote_command = ValidateMap(argv(startpos + 1), caller);
   if (!vote_command) return -1;
   vote_parsed_command = strcat("gotomap ", vote_command);
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_parsed_command));

   break;
  }



  case "nextmap":
  {
   vote_command = ValidateMap(argv(startpos + 1), caller);
   if (!vote_command) return -1;
   vote_parsed_command = strcat("nextmap ", vote_command);
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_parsed_command));

   break;
  }

  case "fraglimit":
  {
   float fraglimit_vote = stof(argv(startpos + 1));
   float fraglimit_min = 0;
   float fraglimit_max = 999999;
   if(fraglimit_vote > fraglimit_max || fraglimit_vote < fraglimit_min)
   {
    print_to(caller, strcat("Invalid fraglimit vote, accepted values are between ", ftos(fraglimit_min), " and ", ftos(fraglimit_max), "."));
    return -1;
   }
   vote_parsed_command = strcat("fraglimit ", ftos(fraglimit_vote));
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_parsed_command));

   break;
  }

  case "timelimit":
  {
   float timelimit_vote = stof(argv(startpos + 1));
   if(timelimit_vote > autocvar_timelimit_max || timelimit_vote < autocvar_timelimit_min)
   {
    print_to(caller, strcat("Invalid timelimit vote, accepted values are between ", ftos(autocvar_timelimit_min), " and ", ftos(autocvar_timelimit_max), "."));
    return -1;
   }
   vote_parsed_command = strcat("timelimit ", ftos(timelimit_vote));
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_parsed_command));

   break;
  }

  case "restart":
  {


   vote_parsed_command = strcat("defer 1 ", vote_command);
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_command));

   break;
  }

  case "allready":
  {
   if(!warmup_stage) {
    print_to(caller, "Game already started. Use the resetmatch command to restart the match.");
    return -1;
   }

   vote_parsed_command = vote_command;
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_command));
   break;
  }

  default:
  {
   vote_parsed_command = vote_command;
   vote_parsed_display = strzone(strcat("^1", vote_command));

   break;
  }
 }

 return 1;
}






void VoteCommand_abstain(float request, entity caller)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (PlayerInList(caller, autocvar_g_voteban_list))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You are banned from voting.");
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, caller, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_VOTEBANYN);
    return;
   }

   if (!vote_called) { print_to(caller, "^1No vote called."); }
   else if (caller.vote_selection != VOTE_SELECT_NULL && !autocvar_sv_vote_change)
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You have already voted.");
   }

   else
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You abstained from your vote.");
    caller.vote_selection = VOTE_SELECT_ABSTAIN;
    msg_entity = caller;
    if (!autocvar_sv_vote_singlecount)
     VoteCount(false);
   }

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote abstain"));
   print_to(caller, "  No arguments required.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

void print_available_commands_to(entity caller)
{
 print_to(caller, strcat("You can call a vote for or execute these commands: ^3", autocvar_sv_vote_commands, "^7 and maybe further ^3arguments^7"));
}

void VoteCommand_call(float request, entity caller, float argc, string vote_command)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   float tmp_playercount = 0;
   float parse_error;

   if (PlayerInList(caller, autocvar_g_voteban_list))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You are banned from calling a vote.");
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, caller, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_VOTEBAN);
    return;
   }

   vote_command = VoteCommand_extractcommand(vote_command, 2, argc);

   if (!autocvar_sv_vote_call && caller)
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1Vote calling is not allowed.");
   }
   else if (!autocvar_sv_vote_gamestart && time < game_starttime)
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1Vote calling is not allowed before the match has started.");
   }
   else if (vote_called)
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1There is already a vote called.");
   }
   else if (!(!autocvar_sv_vote_nospectators || (autocvar_sv_vote_nospectators == 1 && (warmup_stage || intermission_running))) && (caller && !((caller).classname == STR_PLAYER)))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1Only players can call a vote.");
   }
   else if (caller && !(caller.flags & FL_CLIENT))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1Only connected clients can vote.");
   }
   else if (timeout_status && vote_command != "timein")
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You can not call a vote while a timeout is active.");
   }
   else if (caller && (time < caller.vote_waittime))
   {
    print_to(caller, strcat("^1You have to wait ^2", ftos(ceil(caller.vote_waittime - time)), "^1 seconds before you can again call a vote."));
   }
   else if (!VoteCommand_checknasty(vote_command))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1Syntax error in command.");
   }
   else if ((parse_error = VoteCommand_parse(caller, vote_command, autocvar_sv_vote_commands, 2, argc)) <= 0)
   {
    if(parse_error == 0)
    {
     if (vote_called_command == "")
      VoteCommand_call(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller, argc, vote_command);
     else
      print_to(caller, "^1This command is not acceptable or not available.");
    }
   }
   else
   {
    vote_caller = caller;
    vote_caller_name = strzone(GetCallerName(vote_caller));
    vote_called = VOTE_NORMAL;
    vote_called_command = strzone(vote_parsed_command);
    vote_called_display = strzone(vote_parsed_display);
    vote_endtime = time + autocvar_sv_vote_timeout;

    if (caller)
    {
     caller.vote_selection = VOTE_SELECT_ACCEPT;
     caller.vote_waittime = time + autocvar_sv_vote_wait;
     msg_entity = caller;
    }

    if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { ++tmp_playercount; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

    bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2 calls a vote for ", vote_called_display, "\n");
    if (autocvar_sv_vote_debug)
     bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", "^6DEBUG MODE ACTIVE: bots can vote too\n");
    if (autocvar_sv_eventlog)
     GameLogEcho(strcat(":vote:vcall:", ftos(vote_caller.playerid), ":", vote_called_display));
    Nagger_VoteChanged();
    VoteCount(true);

    if (tmp_playercount > 1 && vote_called != VOTE_NULL)
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_VOTE_CALL);
   }

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote call <command>"));
   print_to(caller, "  Where <command> is the command to request a vote upon.");
   print_to(caller, strcat("Examples: ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote call gotomap dance"));
   print_to(caller, strcat("          ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote call endmatch"));
   print_available_commands_to(caller);
   print_to(caller, "Shortcuts: ^2vcall <command>, vend, vmap, vkick, ...");
   return;
  }
 }
}

void VoteCommand_master(float request, entity caller, float argc, string vote_command)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (autocvar_sv_vote_master)
   {
    switch (strtolower(argv(2)))
    {
     case "do":
     {
      float parse_error;
      vote_command = VoteCommand_extractcommand(vote_command, 3, argc);

      if (!caller.vote_master)
       print_to(caller, "^1You do not have vote master privileges.");
      else if (!VoteCommand_checknasty(vote_command))
      {
       print_to(caller, "^1Syntax error in command.");
      }
      else if ((parse_error = VoteCommand_parse(caller, vote_command, strcat(autocvar_sv_vote_commands, " ", autocvar_sv_vote_master_commands), 3, argc)) <= 0)
      {
       if(parse_error == 0)
       {
        if (vote_called_command == "")
         VoteCommand_master(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller, argc, vote_command);
        else
         print_to(caller, "^1This command is not acceptable or not available.");
       }
      }
      else
      {
       localcmd(strcat(vote_parsed_command, "\n"));
       print_to(caller, strcat("Executing command '", vote_parsed_display, "' on server."));
       bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", GetCallerName(caller), "^2 used their ^3master^2 status to do \"^2", vote_parsed_display, "^2\".\n");
       if (autocvar_sv_eventlog)
        GameLogEcho(strcat(":vote:vdo:", ftos(caller.playerid), ":", vote_parsed_display));
      }

      return;
     }

     case "login":
     {
      if (autocvar_sv_vote_master_password == "") { print_to(caller, "^1Login to vote master is not allowed."); }
      else if (caller.vote_master)
      {
       print_to(caller, "^1You are already logged in as vote master.");
      }
      else if (autocvar_sv_vote_master_password != argv(3))
      {
       print_to(caller, strcat("Rejected vote master login from ", GetCallerName(caller)));
      }
      else
      {
       caller.vote_master = true;
       print_to(caller, strcat("Accepted vote master login from ", GetCallerName(caller)));
       bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", GetCallerName(caller), "^2 logged in as ^3master^2\n");
       if (autocvar_sv_eventlog)
        GameLogEcho(strcat(":vote:vlogin:", ftos(caller.playerid)));
      }

      return;
     }

     default:
     {
      if (!autocvar_sv_vote_master_callable) { print_to(caller, "^1Vote to become vote master is not allowed."); }
      else if (vote_called)
      {
       print_to(caller, "^1There is already a vote called.");
      }
      else if (!(!autocvar_sv_vote_nospectators || (autocvar_sv_vote_nospectators == 1 && (warmup_stage || intermission_running))) && (caller && !((caller).classname == STR_PLAYER)))
      {
       print_to(caller, "^1Only players can call a vote.");
      }
      else if (timeout_status)
      {
       print_to(caller, "^1You can not call a vote while a timeout is active.");
      }
      else
      {
       vote_caller = caller;
       vote_caller_name = strzone(GetCallerName(vote_caller));
       vote_called = VOTE_MASTER;
       vote_called_command = strzone("XXX");
       vote_called_display = strzone("^3master");
       vote_endtime = time + autocvar_sv_vote_timeout;

       caller.vote_selection = VOTE_SELECT_ACCEPT;
       caller.vote_waittime = time + autocvar_sv_vote_wait;

       bprint("\{1}^2* ^3", OriginalCallerName(), "^2 calls a vote to become ^3master^2.\n");
       if (autocvar_sv_eventlog)
        GameLogEcho(strcat(":vote:vcall:", ftos(vote_caller.playerid), ":", vote_called_display));
       Nagger_VoteChanged();
       VoteCount(true);
      }

      return;
     }
    }
   }
   else { print_to(caller, "^1Master control of voting is not allowed."); }

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote master [<action> [<command> | <password>]]"));
   print_to(caller, "  If <action> is left blank, it calls a vote for you to become master.");
   print_to(caller, "  Otherwise it can be either 'do' (to run <command>) or 'login' as master.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

void VoteCommand_no(float request, entity caller)
{
 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (PlayerInList(caller, autocvar_g_voteban_list))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You are banned from voting.");
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, caller, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_VOTEBANYN);
    return;
   }

   if (!vote_called) { print_to(caller, "^1No vote called."); }
   else if (caller.vote_selection != VOTE_SELECT_NULL && !autocvar_sv_vote_change)
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You have already voted.");
   }
   else if (((caller == vote_caller) || caller.vote_master) && autocvar_sv_vote_no_stops_vote)
   {
    VoteStop(caller, true);
   }

   else
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You rejected the vote.");
    caller.vote_selection = VOTE_SELECT_REJECT;
    msg_entity = caller;
    if (!autocvar_sv_vote_singlecount)
     VoteCount(false);
   }

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote no"));
   print_to(caller, "  No arguments required.");
   return;
  }
 }
}

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:

   print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote stop"));
   print_to(caller, "  No arguments required.");
   return;
  }
 }

void VoteCommand_yes(float request, entity caller)

 {

   if (PlayerInList(caller, autocvar_g_voteban_list))
   {
    print_to(caller, "^1You are banned from voting.");

   if (!vote_called) { print_to(caller, "^1No vote called."); }

 }

void VoteCommand_macro_help(entity caller, float argc)
{
 string command_origin = GetCommandPrefix(caller);

 if (argc == 2 || argv(2) == "help")
 {
  print_to(caller, "\nVoting commands:\n");



  { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "abstain", "^7: ", "Abstain your vote in current vote")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "call", "^7: ", "Create a new vote for players to decide on")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "help", "^7: ", "Shows this information")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "master", "^7: ", "Full control over all voting and vote commands")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "no", "^7: ", "Select no in current vote")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "status", "^7: ", "Prints information about current vote")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "stop", "^7: ", "Immediately end a vote")); } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { print_to(caller, strcat("  ^2", "yes", "^7: ", "Select yes in current vote")); } };


  print_to(caller, strcat("\nUsage:^3 ", command_origin, " vote <command>^7, where possible commands are listed above.\n"));
  print_to(caller, strcat("For help about a specific command, type ", command_origin, " vote help <command>"));
  print_available_commands_to(caller);
 }
 else
 {



  { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("abstain" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_abstain(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("call" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_call(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller, argc, ""); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("help" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_macro_help(caller, argc); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("master" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_master(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller, argc, ""); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("no" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_no(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("status" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_status(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("stop" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_stop(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller); return; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("yes" == strtolower(argv(2))) { VoteCommand_yes(CMD_REQUEST_USAGE, caller); return; } } };


  string cvarname = strcat("sv_vote_command_help_", argv(2));
  if(cvar_type(cvarname) & CVAR_TYPEFLAG_EXISTS)
   wordwrap_sprint(caller, cvar_string(cvarname), 1000);
  else if (argv(2) != "")
   print_to(caller, "No documentation exists for this vote");
 }
}

float VoteCommand_macro_command(entity caller, float argc, string vote_command)
{



 { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("abstain" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_abstain(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("call" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_call(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller, argc, vote_command); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("help" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_macro_help(caller, argc); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("master" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_master(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller, argc, vote_command); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("no" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_no(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("status" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_status(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_BOTH)) { if ("stop" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_stop(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller); return true; } } } { if (Votecommand_check_assignment(caller, VC_ASGNMNT_CLIENTONLY)) { if ("yes" == strtolower(argv(1))) { VoteCommand_yes(CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND, caller); return true; } } };


 return false;
}






void VoteCommand(float request, entity caller, float argc, string vote_command)
{





 switch (request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if (VoteCommand_macro_command(caller, argc, vote_command)) return;
  }

  default:
   print_to(caller, strcat(((argv(1) != "") ? strcat("Unknown vote command \"", argv(1), "\"") : "No command provided"), ". For a list of supported commands, try ", GetCommandPrefix(caller), " vote help.\n"));
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   VoteCommand_macro_help(caller, argc);
   return;
  }
 }
}

void target_init_verify(entity this)
{
 entity trigger, targ;
 for(trigger = (0, world); (trigger = find(trigger, classname, "trigger_multiple")); )
  for(targ = (0, world); (targ = find(targ, targetname, trigger.target)); )
   if (targ.classname == "target_init" || targ.classname == "target_give" || targ.classname == "target_items")
   {
    trigger.wait = 0;
    trigger.delay = 0;
    targ.wait = 0;
    targ.delay = 0;




   }
}

void target_init_use(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 if (!(this.spawnflags & 1))
 {
  SetResource(actor, RES_ARMOR, start_armorvalue);
  actor.pauserotarmor_finished = time + autocvar_g_balance_pause_armor_rot;
 }

 if (!(this.spawnflags & 2))
 {
  SetResource(actor, RES_HEALTH, start_health);
  actor.pauserothealth_finished = time + autocvar_g_balance_pause_health_rot;
  actor.pauseregen_finished = time + autocvar_g_balance_pause_health_regen;
 }

 if (!(this.spawnflags & 4))
 {
  if(this.spawnflags & 32)
  {
   SetResource(actor, RES_SHELLS, 0);
   SetResource(actor, RES_BULLETS, 0);

float DoesQ3ARemoveThisEntity(entity this)
{




 if(cvar_string("g_mod_physics") == "Q3")
 {
  if(this.notvq3)
   return true;
 }
 else if(this.notcpm)
  return true;



 if(this.notta)
  return true;


 if(this.notsingle)
  if(maxclients == 1)
   return true;

 if(this.notteam)
  if(teamplay)
   return true;

 if(this.notfree)
  if(!teamplay)
   return true;

 if(this.gametype)
 {
  string gametypename;

  gametypename = "ffa";
  if(teamplay)
   gametypename = "team";
  if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTF))
   gametypename = "ctf";
  if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTF) && ctf_oneflag)
   gametypename = "oneflag";
  if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_DUEL))
   gametypename = "tournament";
  if(maxclients == 1)
   gametypename = "single";

  if(_strstrofs(this.gametype, gametypename, 0) < 0)
   return true;
 }

 return false;
}
