 if(sf & ISF_ANGLES)
 {
  if(1){ WriteAngle(MSG_ENTITY, this.angles.x); WriteAngle(MSG_ENTITY, this.angles.y); WriteAngle(MSG_ENTITY, this.angles.z); }else voidfunc();
 }




 if(sf & ISF_STATUS)
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.ItemStatus);

 if(sf & ISF_MODEL)
 {
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.fade_end, 32767));

  if(this.mdl == "")
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/items/items.qc", "64")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("^1WARNING!^7 this.mdl is unset for item ", this.classname, "expect a crash just about now"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();

  WriteString(MSG_ENTITY, this.mdl);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.skin, 255));
 }

 if(sf & ISF_COLORMAP)
 {
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.colormap);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.glowmod.x * 255.0);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.glowmod.y * 255.0);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.glowmod.z * 255.0);
 }

 if(sf & ISF_DROP)
 {
  if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.z); }else voidfunc();
 }

 return true;
}

void ItemUpdate(entity this)
{
 this.oldorigin = this.origin;
 this.SendFlags |= ISF_LOCATION;
}

void UpdateItemAfterTeleport(entity this)
{
 if((0, (this).selfSendEntity) == ItemSend)
  ItemUpdate(this);
}

float have_pickup_item(entity this)
{
 if (this.itemdef.spawnflags & ITEM_FLAG_MUTATORBLOCKED)
  return false;

 if(this.itemdef.instanceOfPowerup)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_powerups > 0)
   return true;
  if(autocvar_g_powerups == 0)
   return false;
 }
 else
 {
  if(autocvar_g_pickup_items > 0)
   return true;
  if(autocvar_g_pickup_items == 0)
   return false;
  if(g_weaponarena)
   if((this).stat_WEAPONS || this.itemdef.instanceOfAmmo)
    return false;
 }
 return true;
}

void Item_Show(entity e, float mode)
{
 e.effects &= ~(EF_ADDITIVE | EF_STARDUST | EF_FULLBRIGHT | EF_NODEPTHTEST);
 e.ItemStatus &= ~ITS_STAYWEP;
 entity def = e.itemdef;
 if (mode > 0)
 {

  e.model = e.mdl;
  e.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
  e.spawnshieldtime = 1;
  e.ItemStatus |= ITS_AVAILABLE;
 }
 else if (mode < 0)
 {

  e.model = nil;
  e.solid = SOLID_NOT;
  e.spawnshieldtime = 1;
  e.ItemStatus &= ~ITS_AVAILABLE;
 }
 else
 {
  float nostay = def.instanceOfWeaponPickup ? !!(def.m_weapon.m_wepset & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS) : false
   || e.team
   ;
  if(def.instanceOfWeaponPickup && !nostay && g_weapon_stay)
  {

   e.model = e.mdl;
   e.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
   e.effects |= EF_STARDUST;
   e.spawnshieldtime = 0;
   e.ItemStatus |= (ITS_AVAILABLE | ITS_STAYWEP);
  }
  else
  {
   e.solid = SOLID_NOT;
   e.spawnshieldtime = 1;
   e.ItemStatus &= ~ITS_AVAILABLE;
  }
 }

 if (def.m_glow)
  e.ItemStatus |= ITS_GLOW;

 if (autocvar_g_nodepthtestitems)
  e.effects |= EF_NODEPTHTEST;

 if (autocvar_g_fullbrightitems)
  e.ItemStatus |= ITS_ALLOWFB;
 else
  e.ItemStatus &= ~ITS_ALLOWFB;

 if (autocvar_sv_simple_items)
  e.ItemStatus |= ITS_ALLOWSI;


 setorigin(e, e.origin);
 e.SendFlags |= ISF_STATUS;
}

void Item_Think(entity this)
{
 if (Item_IsLoot(this))
 {
  if (time < this.wait - IT_DESPAWNFX_TIME)
   this.nextthink = min(time + IT_UPDATE_INTERVAL, this.wait - IT_DESPAWNFX_TIME);
  else
  {

   this.ItemStatus |= ITS_EXPIRING;
   this.SendFlags |= ISF_STATUS;
   if (time < this.wait - IT_UPDATE_INTERVAL)
    this.nextthink = time + IT_UPDATE_INTERVAL;
   else
   {
    (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((RemoveItem) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (RemoveItem));
    this.nextthink = this.wait;
   }
  }

  if (this.itemdef.instanceOfPowerup)
   powerups_DropItem_Think(this);



  if (this.velocity == '0 0 0' && (((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
   this.gravity = 0;



  ItemUpdate(this);
 }
 else
 {


  this.nextthink = time;

  if(this.origin != this.oldorigin)
   ItemUpdate(this);
 }
}

{
 Item_Show(this, 1);
 if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (this.itemdef.m_respawnsound), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();

 if (Item_ItemsTime_Allow(this.itemdef) || ((this).stat_WEAPONS & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS))

  float t = Item_ItemsTime_UpdateTime(this, 0);
  Item_ItemsTime_SetTime(this, t);
  Item_ItemsTime_SetTimesForAllPlayers();
 }

 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((Item_Think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (Item_Think));
 this.nextthink = time;
}

void Item_RespawnCountdown(entity this)
{
 if(this.item_respawncounter >= ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS)
 {
  if(this.waypointsprite_attached)
   WaypointSprite_Kill(this.waypointsprite_attached);
  Item_Respawn(this);
 }
 else
 {
  this.nextthink = time + 1;
  this.item_respawncounter += 1;
  if(this.item_respawncounter == 1)
  {
   do {
    {
     entity wi = Weapons_from(this.weapon);
     if (wi != WEP_Null) {
      entity wp = WaypointSprite_Spawn(WP_Weapon, 0, 0, this, '0 0 64', (0, world), 0, this, waypointsprite_attached, true, RADARICON_Weapon);
      wp.wp_extra = wi.m_id;
      break;
     }
    }
    {
     entity ii = this.itemdef;
     if (ii != (0, world)) {
      entity wp = WaypointSprite_Spawn(WP_Item, 0, 0, this, '0 0 64', (0, world), 0, this, waypointsprite_attached, true, RADARICON_Item);
      wp.wp_extra = ii.m_id;
      break;
     }
    }
   } while (0);
   float mutator_returnvalue = __Mutator_Send_Item_RespawnCountdown(0 , this);
   if(this.waypointsprite_attached)
   {
    GameItem def = this.itemdef;
    if (Item_ItemsTime_SpectatorOnly(def) && !mutator_returnvalue)
     WaypointSprite_UpdateRule(this.waypointsprite_attached, 0, SPRITERULE_SPECTATOR);
    WaypointSprite_UpdateBuildFinished(this.waypointsprite_attached, time + ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS);
   }
  }

  if(this.waypointsprite_attached)
  {
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { if(this.waypointsprite_attached.waypointsprite_visible_for_player(this.waypointsprite_attached, it, it)) { msg_entity = it; soundto(MSG_ONE, this, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_ITEMRESPAWNCOUNTDOWN), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0); } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()





     ;

   WaypointSprite_Ping(this.waypointsprite_attached);

  }
 }
}

void Item_RespawnThink(entity this)
{
 this.nextthink = time;
 if(this.origin != this.oldorigin)
  ItemUpdate(this);

 if(time >= this.wait)
  Item_Respawn(this);
}

void Item_ScheduleRespawnIn(entity e, float t)
{

 if ((Item_ItemsTime_Allow(e.itemdef) || ((e).stat_WEAPONS & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS) || __Mutator_Send_Item_ScheduleRespawn(0 , e, t)) && (t - ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS) > 0)
 {
  (_selftemp = (e), _selftemp.__think = ((Item_RespawnCountdown) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (Item_RespawnCountdown));
  e.nextthink = time + max(0, t - ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS);
  e.scheduledrespawntime = e.nextthink + ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS;
  e.item_respawncounter = 0;
  if(Item_ItemsTime_Allow(e.itemdef) || ((e).stat_WEAPONS & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS))
  {
   t = Item_ItemsTime_UpdateTime(e, e.scheduledrespawntime);
   Item_ItemsTime_SetTime(e, t);
   Item_ItemsTime_SetTimesForAllPlayers();
  }
 }
 else
 {
  (_selftemp = (e), _selftemp.__think = ((Item_RespawnThink) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (Item_RespawnThink));
  e.nextthink = time;
  e.scheduledrespawntime = time + t;
  e.wait = time + t;

  if(Item_ItemsTime_Allow(e.itemdef) || ((e).stat_WEAPONS & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS))
  {
   t = Item_ItemsTime_UpdateTime(e, e.scheduledrespawntime);
   Item_ItemsTime_SetTime(e, t);
   Item_ItemsTime_SetTimesForAllPlayers();
  }
 }
}

[[accumulate]] void RegisterCvars(void(string, string, string, float, string) f) { f( "g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_reciprocal", (ftos(0.0)), "Multiply respawn time by `reciprocal / (p + offset) + linear` where `p` is the current number of players, takes effect with 2 or more players present, `reciprocal` (with `offset` and `linear` set to 0) can be used to achieve a constant number of items spawned *per player*", false, "./server/items/items.qc"); } float autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_reciprocal = 0.0;
[[accumulate]] void RegisterCvars(void(string, string, string, float, string) f) { f( "g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_offset", (ftos(0.0)), "Multiply respawn time by `reciprocal / (p + offset) + linear` where `p` is the current number of players, takes effect with 2 or more players present, `offset` offsets the curve left or right - the results are not intuitive and I recommend plotting the respawn time and the number of items per player to see what's happening", false, "./server/items/items.qc"); } float autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_offset = 0.0;
[[accumulate]] void RegisterCvars(void(string, string, string, float, string) f) { f( "g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_linear", (ftos(1.0)), "Multiply respawn time by `reciprocal / (p + offset) + linear` where `p` is the current number of players, takes effect with 2 or more players present, `linear` can be used to simply scale the respawn time linearly", false, "./server/items/items.qc"); } float autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_linear = 1.0;


float adjust_respawntime(float normal_respawntime) {
 float r = autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_reciprocal;
 float o = autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_offset;
 float l = autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_scaling_linear;

 if (r == 0 && l == 1) {
  return normal_respawntime;
 }

 entity balance = TeamBalance_CheckAllowedTeams((0, world));
 TeamBalance_GetTeamCounts(balance, (0, world));
 float players = 0;
 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  if (TeamBalance_IsTeamAllowed(balance, i))
  {
   players += TeamBalance_GetNumberOfPlayers(balance, i);
  }
 }
 TeamBalance_Destroy(balance);

 if (players >= 2) {
  return normal_respawntime * (r / (players + o) + l);
 } else {
  return normal_respawntime;
 }
}

void Item_ScheduleRespawn(entity e)
{
 if(e.respawntime > 0)
 {
  Item_Show(e, 0);

  float adjusted_respawntime = adjust_respawntime(e.respawntime);



  float respawn_in = adjusted_respawntime + (2 * (random() - 0.5)) * e.respawntimejitter;
  Item_ScheduleRespawnIn(e, respawn_in);
 }
 else
  Item_Show(e, -1);
}

[[accumulate]] void RegisterCvars(void(string, string, string, float, string) f) { f( "g_pickup_respawntime_initial_random", (ftos(1)), "For items that don't start spawned: 0: spawn after their normal respawntime; 1: spawn after `random * respawntime` with the *same* random; 2: same as 1 but each item has separate random", false, "./server/items/items.qc"); } float autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_initial_random = 1
                                                                                                                                                                                             ;

void Item_ScheduleInitialRespawn(entity e)
{
 Item_Show(e, 0);

 float spawn_in;
 if (autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_initial_random == 0)
 {

  spawn_in = e.respawntime + random() * e.respawntimejitter;
 }
 else
 {
  float rnd;
  if (autocvar_g_pickup_respawntime_initial_random == 1)
  {
   static float shared_random = 0;


   if (!shared_random || floor(time) > shared_random)
    shared_random = floor(time) + random();
   rnd = shared_random - floor(time);
  }
  else
   rnd = random();





  spawn_in = ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS + rnd * (e.respawntime + e.respawntimejitter - ITEM_RESPAWN_TICKS);
 }

 Item_ScheduleRespawnIn(e, max(0, game_starttime - time) + ((e.respawntimestart) ? e.respawntimestart : spawn_in));
}

void GiveRandomWeapons(entity receiver, float num_weapons, string weapon_names,
 entity ammo_entity)
{
 if (num_weapons == 0)
 {
  return;
 }
 float num_potential_weapons = _tokenize_console(weapon_names);
 for (float give_attempt = 0; give_attempt < num_weapons; ++give_attempt)
 {
  RandomSelection_Init();
  for (float weapon_index = 0; weapon_index < num_potential_weapons;
   ++weapon_index)
  {
   string weapon = argv(weapon_index);
   if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Weapons_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != WEP_Null) { { { if (!((receiver).stat_WEAPONS & it.m_wepset) && (it.netname == weapon)) { RandomSelection_Add(it, 0, nil, '0 0 0', 1, 1); break; } }; } } } }else voidfunc()







     ;
  }
  if (RandomSelection_chosen_ent == (0, world))
  {
   return;
  }
  (receiver).stat_WEAPONS |= RandomSelection_chosen_ent.m_wepset;
  if (RandomSelection_chosen_ent.ammo_type == RES_NONE)
  {
   continue;
  }
  if (GetResource(receiver,
   RandomSelection_chosen_ent.ammo_type) != 0)
  {
   continue;
  }
  GiveResource(receiver, RandomSelection_chosen_ent.ammo_type,
   GetResource(ammo_entity,
   RandomSelection_chosen_ent.ammo_type));
 }
}

float Item_GiveAmmoTo(entity item, entity player, Resource res_type, float ammomax)
{
 float amount = GetResource(item, res_type);
 if (amount == 0)
 {
  return false;
 }
 float player_amount = GetResource(player, res_type);
 if (item.spawnshieldtime)
 {
  if ((player_amount >= ammomax) && (item.pickup_anyway <= 0))
   return false;
 }
 else if (g_weapon_stay == 2)
 {
  ammomax = min(amount, ammomax);
  if(player_amount >= ammomax)
   return false;
 }
 else
  return false;
 if (amount < 0)
  TakeResourceWithLimit(player, res_type, -amount, ammomax);
 else
  GiveResourceWithLimit(player, res_type, amount, ammomax);
 return true;
}

   ;

float Item_GiveTo(entity item, entity player)
{

 float _switchweapon = 0;




 if((player).cvar_cl_autoswitch)
 {
  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   if(player.(weaponentity).m_weapon != WEP_Null || slot == 0)
   {
    if(player.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon == Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(player, (player).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity)))
     _switchweapon |= (1 << (slot));

    if(!((player).stat_WEAPONS & ((player.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon).m_wepset)))
     _switchweapon |= (1 << (slot));
   }
  }
 }
 float pickedup = false;
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_HEALTH, item.max_health);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_ARMOR, item.max_armorvalue);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_SHELLS, g_pickup_shells_max);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_BULLETS, g_pickup_nails_max);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_ROCKETS, g_pickup_rockets_max);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_CELLS, g_pickup_cells_max);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_PLASMA, g_pickup_plasma_max);
 pickedup |= Item_GiveAmmoTo(item, player, RES_FUEL, g_pickup_fuel_max);
 if (item.itemdef.instanceOfWeaponPickup)
 {
  WepSet w, wp;
  w = (item).stat_WEAPONS;
  wp = w & ~(player).stat_WEAPONS;

  if (wp || (item.spawnshieldtime && item.pickup_anyway > 0))
  {
   pickedup = true;
   if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Weapons_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != WEP_Null) { { { if(w & (it.m_wepset)) Item_NotifyWeapon(player, it.m_id); if(wp & (it.m_wepset)) { for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot) { .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot]; if(player.(weaponentity).m_weapon != WEP_Null || slot == 0) W_DropEvent(wr_pickup, player, it.m_id, item, weaponentity); } W_GiveWeapon(player, it.m_id); } }; } } } }else voidfunc()
# 575 "./server/items/items.qc"
     ;
  }
 }

 if (item.itemdef.instanceOfPowerup)
 {
  if ((item.itemdef == ITEM_JetpackRegen) && !(player.items & IT_FUEL_REGEN))
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ITEM_FUELREGEN_GOT);
  else if ((item.itemdef == ITEM_Jetpack) && !(player.items & IT_JETPACK))
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ITEM_JETPACK_GOT);
 }

 float its;
 if((its = (item.items - (item.items & player.items)) & IT_PICKUPMASK))
 {
  pickedup = true;
  player.items |= its;


 }

 if (item.strength_finished)
 {
  pickedup = true;
  float t = max(StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Strength, player), time);
  if (autocvar_g_powerups_stack)
   t += item.strength_finished;
  else
   t = max(t, time + item.strength_finished);
  StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Strength, player, t, 0);
 }
 if (item.invincible_finished)
 {
  pickedup = true;
  float t = max(StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Shield, player), time);
  if (autocvar_g_powerups_stack)
   t += item.invincible_finished;
  else
   t = max(t, time + item.invincible_finished);
  StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Shield, player, t, 0);
 }
 if (item.speed_finished)
 {
  pickedup = true;
  float t = max(StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Speed, player), time);
  if (autocvar_g_powerups_stack)
   t += item.speed_finished;
  else
   t = max(t, time + item.speed_finished);
  StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Speed, player, t, 0);
 }
 if (item.invisibility_finished)
 {
  pickedup = true;
  float t = max(StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Invisibility, player), time);
  if (autocvar_g_powerups_stack)
   t += item.invisibility_finished;
  else
   t = max(t, time + item.invisibility_finished);
  StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Invisibility, player, t, 0);
 }
 if (item.superweapons_finished)
 {
  pickedup = true;
  StatusEffects_apply(STATUSEFFECT_Superweapons, player, max(StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Superweapons, player), time) + item.superweapons_finished, 0);
 }


 if(item.team)
  pickedup = true;

 if (!pickedup)
  return false;


 if((MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS) && item.itemdef.instanceOfWeaponPickup && !(player).cvar_cl_cts_noautoswitch)
 {
  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   if(player.(weaponentity).m_weapon != WEP_Null || slot == 0)
    W_SwitchWeapon_Force(player, Weapons_from(item.weapon), weaponentity);
  }
  return true;
 }

 if(_switchweapon)
 {
  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   if(_switchweapon & (1 << (slot)))
   if(player.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon != Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(player, (player).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity)))
    W_SwitchWeapon_Force(player, Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(player, (player).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity)), weaponentity);
  }
 }

 return true;
}

void Item_Touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{

 if (Item_IsLoot(this))
 {
  if ((((trace_dpstartcontents | trace_dphitcontents) & DPCONTENTS_NODROP) || (trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY)))
  {
   RemoveItem(this);
   return;
  }
 }

float healtharmor_pickupevalfunc(entity player, entity item)
{
 float c = 0;
 float rating = item.bot_pickupbasevalue;

 float itemarmor = GetResource(item, RES_ARMOR);
 float itemhealth = GetResource(item, RES_HEALTH);

 if(item.item_group)
 {
  itemarmor *= min(4, item.item_group_count);
  itemhealth *= min(4, item.item_group_count);
 }

 if (itemarmor && (GetResource(player, RES_ARMOR) < item.max_armorvalue))
  c = itemarmor / max(1, GetResource(player, RES_ARMOR) * 2/3 + GetResource(player, RES_HEALTH) * 1/3);

 if (itemhealth && (GetResource(player, RES_HEALTH) < item.max_health))
  c = itemhealth / max(1, GetResource(player, RES_HEALTH));

 rating *= min(2, c);
 return rating;
}

float GiveWeapon(entity e, float wpn, float op, float val)
{
 WepSet v0, v1;
 WepSet s = ((Weapons_from(wpn)).m_wepset);
 v0 = ((e).stat_WEAPONS & s);
 switch(op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   if(val > 0)
    (e).stat_WEAPONS |= s;
   else
    (e).stat_WEAPONS &= ~s;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
  case OP_PLUS:
   if(val > 0)
    (e).stat_WEAPONS |= s;
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   if(val <= 0)
    (e).stat_WEAPONS &= ~s;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   if(val > 0)
    (e).stat_WEAPONS &= ~s;
   break;
 }
 v1 = ((e).stat_WEAPONS & s);
 return (v0 != v1);
}

float GiveBuff(entity e, Buff thebuff, float op, float val)
{
 float had_buff = StatusEffects_active(thebuff, e);
 float new_buff_time = ((had_buff) ? StatusEffects_gettime(thebuff, e) : 0);
 switch (op)
 {
  case OP_SET:
   new_buff_time = val;
   break;
  case OP_MIN:
   new_buff_time = max(new_buff_time, val);
   break;
  case OP_MAX:
   new_buff_time = min(new_buff_time, val);
   break;
  case OP_PLUS:
   new_buff_time += val;
   break;
  case OP_MINUS:
   new_buff_time -= val;
   break;
 }
 if(new_buff_time <= 0)
 {
  if(had_buff)
   StatusEffects_remove(thebuff, e, STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_NORMAL);
 }
 else
 {
  buff_RemoveAll(e, STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_CLEAR);
  StatusEffects_apply(thebuff, e, new_buff_time, 0);
 }
 float have_buff = StatusEffects_active(thebuff, e);
 return (had_buff != have_buff);
}

float pathlib_g_static(entity parent,vector to, float static_cost)
{
    return parent.pathlib_node_g + static_cost;
}

float pathlib_g_static_water(entity parent,vector to, float static_cost)
{
    if((pointcontents(to) == CONTENT_WATER))
        return parent.pathlib_node_g + static_cost * pathlib_movecost_waterfactor;
    else
        return parent.pathlib_node_g + static_cost;
}

float pathlib_g_euclidean(entity parent,vector to, float static_cost)
{
    return parent.pathlib_node_g + vlen(parent.origin - to);
}

float pathlib_g_euclidean_water(entity parent,vector to, float static_cost)
{
    if((pointcontents(to) == CONTENT_WATER))
        return parent.pathlib_node_g + vlen(parent.origin - to) * pathlib_movecost_waterfactor;
    else
        return parent.pathlib_node_g + vlen(parent.origin - to);
}






float pathlib_h_manhattan(vector a, vector b)
{


    float h = fabs(a.x - b.x);
    h += fabs(a.y - b.y);
    h *= pathlib_gridsize;

    return h;
}





float pathlib_h_diagonal(vector a, vector b)
{


    float hx = fabs(a.x - b.x);
    float hy = fabs(a.y - b.y);
    float h = pathlib_movecost * max(hx, hy);

    return h;
}






float pathlib_h_euclidean(vector a, vector b)
{
    return vlen(a - b);
}





float pathlib_h_diagonal2(vector a,vector b)
{






    float hx = fabs(a.x - b.x);
    float hy = fabs(a.y - b.y);

    float h_diag = min(hx,hy);
    float h_str = hx + hy;

    float h = pathlib_movecost_diag * h_diag;
    h += pathlib_movecost * (h_str - 2 * h_diag);

    return h;
}





float pathlib_h_diagonal2sdp(vector preprev, vector prev, vector point, vector end)
{




    float hx = fabs(point.x - end.x);
    float hy = fabs(point.y - end.y);
    float hz = fabs(point.z - end.z);

    float h_diag = min3(hx,hy,hz);
    float h_str = hx + hy + hz;

    float h = pathlib_movecost_diag * h_diag;
    h += pathlib_movecost * (h_str - 2 * h_diag);

    vector d1 = normalize(preprev - point);
    vector d2 = normalize(prev - point);
    float m = vlen(d1 - d2);

    return h * m;
}


float pathlib_h_diagonal3(vector a, vector b)
{
    float hx = fabs(a.x - b.x);
    float hy = fabs(a.y - b.y);
    float hz = fabs(a.z - b.z);

    float h_diag = min3(hx,hy,hz);
    float h_str = hx + hy + hz;

    float h = pathlib_movecost_diag * h_diag;
    h += pathlib_movecost * (h_str - 2 * h_diag);

    return h;
}

float pathlib_expandnode_star(entity node, vector start, vector goal)
{
    vector point;

    vector where = node.origin;

    vector f = PLIB_FORWARD * pathlib_gridsize;
    vector r = PLIB_RIGHT * pathlib_gridsize;

    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags == pathlib_node_edgeflag_unknown)
        node.pathlib_node_edgeflags = tile_check_plus2(node, node.origin);

    if(node.pathlib_node_edgeflags == pathlib_node_edgeflag_none)
    {
        if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/pathlib/expandnode.qc", "110")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Node at ", vtos(node.origin), " not expanable"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
        return pathlib_open_cnt;
    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_forward)
    {
        point = where + f;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost);
    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_back)
    {
        point = where - f;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost);
    }


        if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_right)
    {
        point = where + r;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost);
    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_left)
    {
        point = where - r;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost);

    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_forwardright)
    {
        point = where + f + r;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost_diag);
    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_forwardleft)
    {
        point = where + f - r;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost_diag);

    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_backright)
    {
        point = where - f + r;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost_diag);
    }


    if (node.pathlib_node_edgeflags & pathlib_node_edgeflag_backleft)
    {
        point = where - f - r;
        pathlib_makenode(node, start, point, goal, pathlib_movecost_diag);
    }

    return pathlib_open_cnt;
}
# 224 "./server/pathlib/expandnode.qc"
float pathlib_expandnode_box(entity node, vector start, vector goal)
{
    vector v;

    for(v.z = node.origin.z - pathlib_gridsize; v.z <= node.origin.z + pathlib_gridsize; v.z += pathlib_gridsize)
    for(v.y = node.origin.y - pathlib_gridsize; v.y <= node.origin.y + pathlib_gridsize; v.y += pathlib_gridsize)
    for(v.x = node.origin.x - pathlib_gridsize; v.x <= node.origin.x + pathlib_gridsize; v.x += pathlib_gridsize)
    {

            pathlib_makenode(node,start,v,goal,pathlib_movecost);
    }

    return pathlib_open_cnt;
}

void pathlib_close_node(entity node,vector goal)
{
    if(node.owner == closedlist)
    {
        if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/pathlib/main.qc", "242")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Pathlib: Tried to close a closed node!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
        return;
    }

    if(node == best_open_node)
        best_open_node = (0, world);

    ++pathlib_closed_cnt;
    --pathlib_open_cnt;

    node.owner = closedlist;

    if(((_vlen2 = (node.origin - goal), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((pathlib_gridsize) ** 2)))
    {
        vector goalmove;

        goalmove = pathlib_walknode(node, node.origin, goal, 1);
        if(pathlib_movenode_goodnode)
        {
            goal_node = node;
            pathlib_foundgoal = true;
        }
    }
}

float Cosine_Interpolate(float a, float b, float c)
{
 float ft = c * 3.14159265358979323846;
 float f = (1 - cos(ft)) * 0.5;

 return a*(1-f) + b*f;
}

float buildpath_nodefilter_directional(vector n,vector c,vector p)
{
    vector d2 = normalize(p - c);
    vector d1 = normalize(c - n);

    if(((_vlen2 = (d1 - d2), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((0.25) ** 2)))
    {

        return true;
    }

    return false;
}

entity path_build(entity next, vector where, entity prev, entity start)
{
    if(prev && next)
        if(buildpath_nodefilter)
            if(buildpath_nodefilter(next.origin,where,prev.origin))
                return next;


    entity path = __spawn("entity", "./server/pathlib/main.qc" ":" "334", false);
    path.owner = start;
    path.path_next = next;

    setorigin(path, where);

    if(!next)
        path.classname = "path_end";
    else
    {
        if(!prev)
            path.classname = "path_start";
        else
            path.classname = "path_node";
    }

    return path;
}

vector pathlib_wateroutnode(entity this, vector start, vector end, float doedge)
{
    vector surface;

    pathlib_movenode_goodnode = false;

    end.x = fsnap(end.x, pathlib_gridsize);
    end.y = fsnap(end.y, pathlib_gridsize);

    traceline(end + ('0 0 0.25' * pathlib_gridsize),end - ('0 0 1' * pathlib_gridsize),MOVE_WORLDONLY,this);
    end = trace_endpos;

    if (!(pointcontents(end - '0 0 1') == CONTENT_SOLID))
        return end;

    for(surface = start ; surface.z < (end.z + 32); ++surface.z)
    {
        if(pointcontents(surface) == CONTENT_EMPTY)
            break;
    }

    if(pointcontents(surface + '0 0 1') != CONTENT_EMPTY)
        return end;

    tracebox(start + '0 0 64', movenode_boxmin,movenode_boxmax, end + '0 0 64', MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    if(trace_fraction == 1)
        pathlib_movenode_goodnode = true;

    if(fabs(surface.z - end.z) > 32)
        pathlib_movenode_goodnode = false;

    return end;
}

vector pathlib_swimnode(entity this, vector start, vector end, float doedge)
{
    pathlib_movenode_goodnode = false;

    if(pointcontents(start) != CONTENT_WATER)
        return end;

    end.x = fsnap(end.x, pathlib_gridsize);
    end.y = fsnap(end.y, pathlib_gridsize);

    if(pointcontents(end) == CONTENT_EMPTY)
        return pathlib_wateroutnode(this, start, end, doedge);

    tracebox(start, movenode_boxmin,movenode_boxmax, end, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    if(trace_fraction == 1)
        pathlib_movenode_goodnode = true;

    return end;
}

vector pathlib_flynode(entity this, vector start, vector end, float doedge)
{
    pathlib_movenode_goodnode = false;

    end.x = fsnap(end.x, pathlib_gridsize);
    end.y = fsnap(end.y, pathlib_gridsize);

    tracebox(start, movenode_boxmin,movenode_boxmax, end, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    if(trace_fraction == 1)
        pathlib_movenode_goodnode = true;

    return end;
}

{
    te_lightning1(this,this.origin, this.pos1);
    if(this.cnt < time)
        if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();

}

vector pathlib_walknode(entity this, vector start, vector end, float doedge)
{
    vector point;

    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/pathlib/movenode.qc", "92")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Walking node from ", vtos(start), " to ", vtos(end)), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();

    pathlib_movenode_goodnode = false;

    end.x = fsnap(end.x,pathlib_gridsize);
    end.y = fsnap(end.y,pathlib_gridsize);
    start.x = fsnap(start.x,pathlib_gridsize);
    start.y = fsnap(start.y,pathlib_gridsize);


    traceline(start + movenode_stepup, start - movenode_maxdrop, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    if(trace_fraction == 1.0)
    {
        entity a;
        a = __spawn("entity", "./server/pathlib/movenode.qc" ":" "106", false);
        (_selftemp = (a), _selftemp.__think = ((a_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (a_think));
        a.nextthink = time;
        setorigin(a, start + movenode_stepup);
        a.pos1 = trace_endpos;

        a.cnt = time + 10;

        if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./server/pathlib/movenode.qc", "114")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("I cant walk on air!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
        return trace_endpos;
    }

    start = trace_endpos;


    vector s = start;
    vector e = end;

    vector direction = normalize(e - s);

    float distance = vlen(start - end);
    float steps = rint(distance / movenode_stepsize);

    vector last_point = start;
    for(float i = 1; i < steps; ++i)
    {
        point = last_point + (direction * movenode_stepsize);
        traceline(point + movenode_stepup,point - movenode_maxdrop,MOVE_WORLDONLY,this);
        if(trace_fraction == 1.0)
            return trace_endpos;

        last_point = trace_endpos;
    }

    point = last_point + (direction * movenode_stepsize);
    point.x = fsnap(point.x,pathlib_gridsize);
    point.y = fsnap(point.y,pathlib_gridsize);




    traceline(point + movenode_stepup, point - movenode_maxdrop,MOVE_WORLDONLY,this);
    if(trace_fraction == 1.0)
        return trace_endpos;

    last_point = trace_endpos;

    tracebox(start + movenode_boxup, movenode_boxmin,movenode_boxmax, last_point + movenode_boxup, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
    if(trace_fraction != 1.0)
        return trace_endpos;

    pathlib_movenode_goodnode = true;
    return last_point;
}

var float pathlib_wpp_open(entity wp, entity child, float cost);

void pathlib_wpp_close(entity wp)
{
    --pathlib_open_cnt;
    ++pathlib_closed_cnt;

    wp.pathlib_list = closedlist;

    if(wp == best_open_node)
        best_open_node = (0, world);

    if(wp == goal_node)
        pathlib_foundgoal = true;
}

float pathlib_wpp_opencb(entity wp, entity child, float cost)
{

    if(child.pathlib_list == closedlist)
        return false;


 cost = vlen(child.origin - wp.origin);

    child.path_prev = wp;
    child.pathlib_list = openlist;
    child.pathlib_node_g = wp.pathlib_node_g + cost;
    child.pathlib_node_h = pathlib_heuristic(child.origin, goal_node.origin);
    child.pathlib_node_c = pathlib_wpp_waypointcallback(child, wp);
    child.pathlib_node_f = child.pathlib_node_g + child.pathlib_node_h + child.pathlib_node_c;


    if(child == goal_node)
        pathlib_foundgoal = true;

    ++pathlib_open_cnt;

    if(best_open_node.pathlib_node_f > child.pathlib_node_f)
        best_open_node = child;

    return true;
}

float pathlib_wpp_openncb(entity wp, entity child, float cost)
{

    if(child.pathlib_list == closedlist)
        return false;


 cost = vlen(child.origin - wp.origin);

    child.path_prev = wp;
    child.pathlib_list = openlist;
    child.pathlib_node_g = wp.pathlib_node_g + cost;
    child.pathlib_node_h = pathlib_heuristic(child.origin, goal_node.origin);
    child.pathlib_node_f = child.pathlib_node_g + child.pathlib_node_h;

    if(child == goal_node)
        pathlib_foundgoal = true;

    ++pathlib_open_cnt;

    if(best_open_node.pathlib_node_f > child.pathlib_node_f)
        best_open_node = child;

    return true;
}

  start = path_build((0, world), start_node.origin, (0, world), (0, world));
  end = path_build((0, world), goal_node.origin, (0, world), start);
  ln = end;

        return start;
    }

float location_isok(vector point, float waterok, float air_isok)
{
    if(trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY)
        return false;

    float pc = pointcontents(point);
    float pc2 = pointcontents(point - '0 0 1');

    if(pc == CONTENT_EMPTY && pc2 == CONTENT_SOLID)
        return true;
    if(pc == CONTENT_EMPTY && pc2 == CONTENT_WATER && waterok)
        return true;
    if(pc == CONTENT_EMPTY && pc2 == CONTENT_EMPTY && air_isok)
        return true;
    if(pc == CONTENT_WATER && waterok)
        return true;
    return false;
}

   if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.z); }else voidfunc();
   if(sf & 0x10)
    WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.gravity);
  }

  if(sf & 0x20)
  {
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, ft);
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, fr);
  }

  if(teamplay)
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.realowner.team);
  else
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.realowner.clientcolors);
 }

 if(sf & 2)
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.csqcprojectile_type);

 return true;
}

vector W_HitPlotUnnormalizedUntransform(vector screenforward, vector screenright, vector screenup, vector v)
{
 vector ret;
 ret.x = screenright * v;
 ret.y = screenup * v;
 ret.z = screenforward * v;
 return ret;
}

vector W_HitPlotNormalizedUntransform(vector org, entity targ, vector screenforward, vector screenright, vector screenup, vector v)
{
 float i, j, k;
 vector mi, ma, thisv, myv, ret;

 myv = W_HitPlotUnnormalizedUntransform(screenforward, screenright, screenup, org);



 mi = ma = targ.origin + 0.5 * (targ.mins + targ.maxs);
 for(i = 0; i < 2; ++i) for(j = 0; j < 2; ++j) for(k = 0; k < 2; ++k)
 {
  thisv = targ.origin;
  if(i) thisv.x += targ.maxs.x; else thisv.x += targ.mins.x;
  if(j) thisv.y += targ.maxs.y; else thisv.y += targ.mins.y;
  if(k) thisv.z += targ.maxs.z; else thisv.z += targ.mins.z;
  thisv = W_HitPlotUnnormalizedUntransform(screenforward, screenright, screenup, thisv);
  if(i || j || k)
  {
   if(mi.x > thisv.x) mi.x = thisv.x; if(ma.x < thisv.x) ma.x = thisv.x;
   if(mi.y > thisv.y) mi.y = thisv.y; if(ma.y < thisv.y) ma.y = thisv.y;

  }
  else
  {

   mi = ma = thisv;
  }
 }

 thisv = W_HitPlotUnnormalizedUntransform(screenforward, screenright, screenup, v);
 ret.x = (thisv.x - mi.x) / (ma.x - mi.x);
 ret.y = (thisv.y - mi.y) / (ma.y - mi.y);
 ret.z = thisv.z - myv.z;
 return ret;
}

float W_GetCycleWeapon(entity this, string weaponorder, float dir, float imp, float complain, float skipmissing, .entity weaponentity)
{


 float weaponwant, first_valid, prev_valid, switchtonext, switchtolast;
 WepSet wepset = '0 0 0';
 switchtonext = switchtolast = 0;
 first_valid = prev_valid = 0;
 float weaponcur;
 entity wep;

 if(skipmissing || this.(weaponentity).selectweapon == 0)
  weaponcur = this.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon.m_id;
 else
  weaponcur = this.(weaponentity).selectweapon;

 if(dir == 0)
  switchtonext = 1;

 float c = 0;

 string rest = weaponorder;
 while(rest != "")
 {
  weaponwant = stof(car(rest)); rest = cdr(rest);
  wep = Weapons_from(weaponwant);
  wepset = wep.m_wepset;
  if(imp >= 0)
  if(wep.impulse != imp)
   continue;

  float have_other = false;
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Weapons_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != WEP_Null) { { { if(i != weaponwant) if(it.impulse == imp || imp < 0) if(((this).stat_WEAPONS & (it.m_wepset)) || (weaponsInMap & (it.m_wepset))) have_other = true; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




    ;


  if(!((this).stat_WEAPONS & wepset))
  if(!(weaponsInMap & wepset))
  if((wep.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_MUTATORBLOCKED) || have_other)
   continue;

  ++c;

  if(!skipmissing || client_hasweapon(this, wep, weaponentity, true, false))
  {
   if(switchtonext)
    return weaponwant;
   if(!first_valid)
    first_valid = weaponwant;
   if(weaponwant == weaponcur)
   {
    if(dir >= 0)
     switchtonext = 1;
    else if(prev_valid)
     return prev_valid;
    else
     switchtolast = 1;
   }
   prev_valid = weaponwant;
  }
 }
 if(first_valid)
 {
  if(switchtolast)
   return prev_valid;
  else
   return first_valid;
 }

 if(complain)
 {
  this.weaponcomplainindex += 1;
  c = (this.weaponcomplainindex % c) + 1;
  rest = weaponorder;
  while(rest != "")
  {
   weaponwant = stof(car(rest)); rest = cdr(rest);
   wep = Weapons_from(weaponwant);
   wepset = wep.m_wepset;
   if(imp >= 0)
    if(wep.impulse != imp)
     continue;

   float have_other = false;
   if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Weapons_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != WEP_Null) { { { if(i != weaponwant) if(it.impulse == imp || imp < 0) if(((this).stat_WEAPONS & (it.m_wepset)) || (weaponsInMap & (it.m_wepset))) have_other = true; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




     ;


   if(!((this).stat_WEAPONS & wepset))
   if(!(weaponsInMap & wepset))
   if((wep.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_MUTATORBLOCKED) || have_other)
    continue;

   --c;
   if(c == 0)
   {
    client_hasweapon(this, wep, weaponentity, true, true);
    break;
   }
  }
 }
 return 0;
}

void W_SwitchToOtherWeapon(entity this, .entity weaponentity)
{

 Weapon ww;
 WepSet set = ((this.(weaponentity).m_weapon).m_wepset);
 if ((this).stat_WEAPONS & set)
 {
  (this).stat_WEAPONS &= ~set;
  ww = Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(this, (this).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity));
  (this).stat_WEAPONS |= set;
 }
 else
 {
  ww = Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(this, (this).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity));
 }
 if (ww == WEP_Null) return;
 W_SwitchWeapon_Force(this, ww, weaponentity);
}

float W_SwitchWeapon(entity this, Weapon w, .entity weaponentity)
{
 if(this.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon != w)
 {
  if(client_hasweapon(this, w, weaponentity, true, true))
  {
   W_SwitchWeapon_Force(this, w, weaponentity);
   return true;
  }
  else
  {
   this.(weaponentity).selectweapon = w.m_id;
   return false;
  }
 }
 else if(!weaponLocked(this) && (this).cvar_cl_weapon_switch_reload)
 {
  entity actor = this;
  w.wr_reload(w, actor, weaponentity);
 }

 return true;
}

float W_ThrowNewWeapon(entity own, float wpn, float doreduce, vector org, vector velo, .entity weaponentity)
{
 Weapon info = Weapons_from(wpn);
 Resource ammotype = info.ammo_type;

 entity wep = __spawn("entity", "./server/weapons/throwing.qc" ":" "27", false);
 Item_SetLoot(wep, true);
 setorigin(wep, org);
 wep.velocity = velo;
 wep.owner = wep.enemy = own;
 wep.flags |= FL_TOSSED;
 wep.colormap = own.colormap;

 navigation_dynamicgoal_init(wep, false);

 W_DropEvent(wr_drop,own,wpn,wep,weaponentity);

 if(((Weapons_from(wpn)).m_wepset) & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS)
 {
  Item_SetExpiring(wep, true);
  if(own.items & IT_UNLIMITED_SUPERWEAPONS)
  {
   wep.superweapons_finished = time + autocvar_g_balance_superweapons_time;
  }
  else
  {
   float superweapons = 1;
   if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Weapons_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != WEP_Null) { { { WepSet set = it.m_wepset; if((set & WEPSET_SUPERWEAPONS) && ((own).stat_WEAPONS & set)) ++superweapons; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


     ;
   if(superweapons <= 1)
   {
    wep.superweapons_finished = StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Superweapons, own);
    StatusEffects_remove(STATUSEFFECT_Superweapons, own, STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_CLEAR);
   }
   else
   {
    float timeleft = StatusEffects_gettime(STATUSEFFECT_Superweapons, own) - time;
    float weptimeleft = timeleft / superweapons;
    wep.superweapons_finished = time + weptimeleft;
    if(own.statuseffects)
    {

     own.statuseffects.statuseffect_time[STATUSEFFECT_Superweapons.m_id] -= weptimeleft;
     StatusEffects_update(own);
    }
   }
  }
 }

 weapon_defaultspawnfunc(wep, info);
 if(startitem_failed)
  return -1;

 wep.pickup_anyway = true;


 if(ammotype == RES_NONE)
 {
  return 0;
 }
 else
 {
  if(doreduce && g_weapon_stay == 2)
  {

   float i = own.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id;
   if(own.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[i]) > 0)
   {
    GiveResource(own, ammotype, own.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[i]));
    own.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[i]) = -1;
   }
   SetResource(wep, ammotype, 0);
  }
  else if(doreduce)
  {

   float i = own.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id;
   if(own.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[i]) > 0)
   {
    GiveResource(own, ammotype, own.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[i]));
    own.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[i]) = -1;
   }

   float ownderammo = GetResource(own, ammotype);
   float thisammo = min(ownderammo, GetResource(wep, ammotype));
   SetResource(wep, ammotype, thisammo);
   SetResource(own, ammotype, ownderammo - thisammo);

   return thisammo;
  }
  return 0;
 }
}

float W_IsWeaponThrowable(entity this, float w)
{
 if (__Mutator_Send_ForbidDropCurrentWeapon(0 , this, w))
  return false;
 if (!autocvar_g_pickup_items)
  return false;
 if (g_weaponarena)
  return false;
 if (w == WEP_Null.m_id)
  return false;

 return (Weapons_from(w)).weaponthrowable;
}


void W_ThrowWeapon(entity this, .entity weaponentity, vector velo, vector delta, float doreduce)
{
 Weapon w = this.(weaponentity).m_weapon;
 if (w == WEP_Null)
  return;
 if (time < game_starttime)
  return;
 if(__Mutator_Send_ForbidThrowCurrentWeapon(0 , this, this.(weaponentity)))
  return;
 if(!autocvar_g_weapon_throwable)
  return;
 if(this.(weaponentity).state != WS_READY)
  return;
 if(!W_IsWeaponThrowable(this, w.m_id))
  return;

 WepSet set = ((w).m_wepset);
 if(!((this).stat_WEAPONS & set)) return;
 (this).stat_WEAPONS &= ~set;

 W_SwitchWeapon_Force(this, Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(this, (this).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity)), weaponentity);
 float a = W_ThrowNewWeapon(this, w.m_id, doreduce, this.origin + delta, velo, weaponentity);

 if(a < 0) return;
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, this, MSG_MULTI, ITEM_WEAPON_DROP, w.m_id, a);
}

   W_ThrowNewWeapon(this, wep.m_id, false, org, randomvec() * 125 + '0 0 200', weaponentity);
}

vector W_CalculateProjectileVelocity(entity actor, vector pvelocity, vector mvelocity, float forceAbsolute)
{
 vector mdirection;
 float mspeed;
 vector outvelocity;

 mvelocity = mvelocity * W_WeaponSpeedFactor(actor);

 mdirection = normalize(mvelocity);
 mspeed = vlen(mvelocity);

 outvelocity = get_shotvelocity(pvelocity, mdirection, mspeed, (forceAbsolute ? 0 : autocvar_g_projectiles_newton_style), autocvar_g_projectiles_newton_style_2_minfactor, autocvar_g_projectiles_newton_style_2_maxfactor);

 return outvelocity;
}

{
 if(!((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((targ).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || (targ).stat_FROZEN || !targ.takedamage)
  return false;

 vector headmaxs = org + '0.6 0 0' * targ.maxs_x + '0 0.6 0' * targ.maxs_y + '0 0 1' * targ.maxs_z;

 return trace_hits_box(start, end, headmins, headmaxs);
}

void fireBullet_antilag(entity this, .entity weaponentity, vector start, vector dir, float spread, float max_solid_penetration, float damage, float headshot_multiplier, float force, float dtype, entity tracer_effect, float do_antilag)
{
 dir = normalize(dir + randomvec() * spread);
 vector end = start + dir * max_shot_distance;

 fireBullet_last_hit = (0, world);
 fireBullet_trace_callback_eff = tracer_effect;

 float solid_penetration_fraction = 1;
 float damage_fraction = 1;
 float total_damage = 0;

 float lag = ((do_antilag) ? antilag_getlag(this) : 0);
 if(lag)
  antilag_takeback_all(this, lag);


 float oldsolid = this.dphitcontentsmask;
 if(this)
  this.dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;

 WarpZone_trace_forent = this;

 float headshot = false;
 for (;;)
 {
  WarpZone_TraceBox_ThroughZone(start, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', end, false, WarpZone_trace_forent, (0, world), fireBullet_trace_callback);
  dir = WarpZone_TransformVelocity(WarpZone_trace_transform, dir);
  end = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, end);
  start = trace_endpos;
  entity hit = trace_ent;


  if (trace_fraction == 1.0)
   break;


  if (trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY)
   break;
# 413 "./server/weapons/tracing.qc"
  float is_weapclip = false;
  if(trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_NODRAW)
  if (!(trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_NONSOLID))
  if (!(trace_dphitcontents & DPCONTENTS_OPAQUE))
   is_weapclip = true;

  if(!hit || hit.solid == SOLID_BSP || hit.solid == SOLID_SLIDEBOX)

  {

   yoda = 0;

   damage = MUTATOR_ARGV_4_float;
   if(headshot_multiplier && Headshot(hit, this, start, end))
   {
    damage *= headshot_multiplier;
    headshot = true;
   }
   float gooddamage = accuracy_isgooddamage(this, hit);
   Damage(hit, this, this, damage * damage_fraction, dtype, weaponentity, start, force * dir * damage_fraction);

   if(gooddamage)
   {

    float added_damage = min(damage - total_damage, damage * damage_fraction);
    total_damage += damage * damage_fraction;
    accuracy_add(this, this.(weaponentity).m_weapon, 0, added_damage);
   }
  }

  if (is_weapclip && !autocvar_g_ballistics_penetrate_clips)
   break;



  if(start.x > world.maxs.x || start.y > world.maxs.y || start.z > world.maxs.z || start.x < world.mins.x || start.y < world.mins.y || start.z < world.mins.z)
   break;

  entity hitstore = ((hit).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? ((hit)._ps) : hit;
  if(max_solid_penetration < 0)

  else if(hitstore.ballistics_density < -1)
   break;
  else if(hitstore.ballistics_density < 0)
   maxdist = vlen(hit.maxs - hit.mins) + 1;
  else if(hitstore.ballistics_density == 0)
   maxdist = max_solid_penetration * solid_penetration_fraction;
  else
   maxdist = max_solid_penetration * solid_penetration_fraction / hitstore.ballistics_density;

  if(maxdist <= autocvar_g_ballistics_mindistance)
   break;



  traceline_inverted (start, start + dir * maxdist, MOVE_NORMAL, WarpZone_trace_forent, true, hit);
  if(trace_fraction == 1)
   break;

  float dist_taken = max(autocvar_g_ballistics_mindistance, vlen(trace_endpos - start));
  float fraction_used_of_what_is_left = dist_taken / maxdist;
  solid_penetration_fraction -= solid_penetration_fraction * fraction_used_of_what_is_left;
  solid_penetration_fraction = max(solid_penetration_fraction, 0);
  damage_fraction = ((solid_penetration_fraction) ** (autocvar_g_ballistics_solidpenetration_exponent));


  if (hit && (hit.solid != SOLID_BSP))
   if(((_vlen2 = (trace_endpos - start), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((4) ** 2)))
    ((!this) ? Send_Effect(fireBullet_trace_callback_eff, start, trace_endpos, 0) : __trailparticles(this, _particleeffectnum(fireBullet_trace_callback_eff.eent_eff_name), start, trace_endpos));

  start = trace_endpos;

  if(hit.solid == SOLID_BSP)
   Damage_DamageInfo(start, 0, 0, 0, max(1, force) * normalize(dir) * -damage_fraction, dtype, 0, this);
 }

 if(headshot)
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, this, MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_HEADSHOT);

 if(lag)
  antilag_restore_all(this);


 if(this)
  this.dphitcontentsmask = oldsolid;
}

}

 if (time < game_starttime || time < actor.race_penalty) return false;

 if (timeout_status == TIMEOUT_ACTIVE)
  return false;


 if (actor.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon != actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon) return false;

 if (attacktime >= 0)
 {

  if (((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(weaponentity))])) > time + actor.(weaponentity).weapon_frametime * 0.5) return false;
  entity this = actor.(weaponentity);

  if (!actor.vehicle && this.state != WS_READY) return false;
 }
 return true;
}

void weapon_prepareattack_do(entity actor, .entity weaponentity, float secondary, float attacktime)
{
 entity this = actor.(weaponentity);
 if (this == (0, world)) return;
 this.state = WS_INUSE;

 if(StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_SpawnShield, actor))
  StatusEffects_remove(STATUSEFFECT_SpawnShield, actor, STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_CLEAR);


 if (attacktime >= 0)
 {
  if (((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(weaponentity))])) < time - this.weapon_frametime * 1.5)
  {
   ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(weaponentity))])) = time;

  }
  float arate = W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);
  ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(weaponentity))])) = ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(weaponentity))])) + attacktime * arate;

  if(autocvar_g_weaponswitch_debug_alternate && W_DualWielding(actor))
  {
   float slot = weaponslot(weaponentity);
   for(float wepslot = 0; wepslot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++wepslot)
   {
    if(slot == wepslot)
     continue;
    .entity wepent = weaponentities[wepslot];
    if(actor.(wepent) && actor.(wepent).m_weapon != WEP_Null)
    {
     if(((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(wepent).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(wepent))])) > time + actor.(wepent).weapon_frametime * 0.5)
      continue;
     if (((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(wepent).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(wepent))])) < time - actor.(wepent).weapon_frametime * 1.5)
      ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(wepent).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(wepent))])) = time;
     ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(wepent).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(wepent))])) = ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(wepent).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(wepent))])) + (attacktime * arate) / MAX_WEAPONSLOTS;
    }
   }
  }
 }
 this.bulletcounter += 1;

}

float weapon_prepareattack(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity, float secondary, float attacktime)
{
 if (weapon_prepareattack_check(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, secondary, attacktime))
 {
  weapon_prepareattack_do(actor, weaponentity, secondary, attacktime);
  return true;
 }
 return false;
}

 .entity weaponentity, float fire) func)
{

 float restartanim;

   this.wframe = WFRAME_IDLE;
  fr = this.wframe;
  restartanim = false;
 }
 else

  restartanim = fr != WFRAME_IDLE;
 }

 this.wframe = fr;

 if (this.weapon_think == w_ready && func != w_ready && this.state == WS_RAISE)
  if(1){ float dev = autocvar_developer; float war = autocvar_prvm_backtraceforwarnings; cvar_set("developer", "1"); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", "1"); print("\n--- CUT HERE ---\n", "Tried to override initial weapon think function - should this really happen?"); builtin_remove((0, world)); print("\n--- CUT UNTIL HERE ---\n"); cvar_set("developer", ftos(dev)); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", ftos(war)); }else voidfunc();

 t *= W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);


 if (this.weapon_think == w_ready)
 {
  this.weapon_nextthink = time;

 }
 float w_frametime_limit = this.weapon_frametime * 1.5;
 if (this.weapon_nextthink < time - w_frametime_limit || this.weapon_nextthink > time + w_frametime_limit)
 {
  this.weapon_nextthink = time;

 }
 this.weapon_nextthink += t;
 this.weapon_think = func;


 if (this)
 {
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { if(it == actor || (((it).classname == STR_SPECTATOR) && it.enemy == actor)) wframe_send(it, this, fr, autocvar_g_weaponratefactor, restartanim); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()

  float secondary_melee = ((fr == WFRAME_FIRE2 && (this.m_weapon.spawnflags & WEP_TYPE_MELEE_SEC)) != 0);

float weaponUseForbidden(entity player)
{
 if ((round_handler != (0, world)) && !(!round_handler.wait && !round_handler.cnt)) return true;

float weaponLocked(entity player)
{
 if (time < game_starttime && !sv_ready_restart_after_countdown) return true;
 if (player.player_blocked) return true;
 if (game_stopped) return true;
 if ((player).stat_FROZEN) return true;
 if (__Mutator_Send_LockWeapon(0 , player)) return true;
 return false;
}

void W_DecreaseAmmo(Weapon wep, entity actor, float ammo_use, .entity weaponentity)
{
 if (__Mutator_Send_W_DecreaseAmmo(0 , actor, actor.(weaponentity), ammo_use)) return;
 if ((actor.items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO) && !wep.reloading_ammo) return;

 ammo_use = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_float;

 entity w_ent = actor.(weaponentity);


 if (wep.reloading_ammo)
 {
  w_ent.clip_load -= ammo_use;
  w_ent.(weapon_load[w_ent.m_weapon.m_id]) = w_ent.clip_load;
 }
 else if (wep.ammo_type != RES_NONE)
 {
  float ammo = GetResource(actor, wep.ammo_type);
  if (ammo < ammo_use)
  {
   if(1){ float dev = autocvar_developer; float war = autocvar_prvm_backtraceforwarnings; cvar_set("developer", "1"); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", "1"); print("\n--- CUT HERE ---\n", sprintf( "W_DecreaseAmmo(%.2f): '%s' subtracted too much %s from '%s', resulting with '%.2f' left...                                                                                ;
  }
  SetResource(actor, wep.ammo_type, ammo - ammo_use);
 }
}

void anim_set(entity e, vector anim, float looping, float override, float restart)
{
 if (!anim) return;

 if (anim.x == e.animstate_startframe)
 {
  if (anim.y == e.animstate_numframes)
  {
   if (anim.z == e.animstate_framerate)
   {
    if (!restart) return;
    if (anim.y == 1)
     ((e.effects) = ((e.effects) | (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)) - ((e.effects) & (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)));
   }
  }
 }
 e.animstate_startframe = anim.x;
 e.animstate_numframes = anim.y;
 e.animstate_framerate = anim.z;
 e.animstate_starttime = time - 0.1 * frametime;
 e.animstate_endtime = e.animstate_starttime + e.animstate_numframes / e.animstate_framerate;
 e.animstate_looping = looping;
 e.animstate_override = override;
 e.frame = e.animstate_startframe;
 e.frame1time = time;
}




void anim_update(entity e)
{
 if (time >= e.animstate_endtime)
 {
  if (e.animstate_looping)
  {
   e.animstate_starttime = e.animstate_endtime;
   e.animstate_endtime = e.animstate_starttime + e.animstate_numframes / e.animstate_framerate;
  }
  e.animstate_override = false;
 }
 float frameofs = bound(0, (time - e.animstate_starttime) * e.animstate_framerate, e.animstate_numframes - 1);
 e.frame = e.animstate_startframe + frameofs;
}

float monsters_animoverride(entity this)
{
 Monster monster_id = (0, world);
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Monsters_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != MON_Null && it.m_model.model_str() == this.model) { { { monster_id = it; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


   ;

 if(!monster_id) { return false; }

 monster_id.mr_anim(monster_id, this);

 vector none = '0 0 0';
 this.anim_duckwalk = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckjump = animfixfps(this, '5 1 10', none);
 this.anim_duckidle = this.anim_idle;
 this.anim_jump = animfixfps(this, '8 1 10', none);
 this.anim_taunt = animfixfps(this, '12 1 0.33', none);
 this.anim_runbackwards = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_strafeleft = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_straferight = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_forwardright = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_forwardleft = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_backright = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_backleft = this.anim_run;
 this.anim_duckwalkbackwards = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkstrafeleft = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkstraferight = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkforwardright = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkforwardleft = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkbackright = this.anim_walk;
 this.anim_duckwalkbackleft = this.anim_walk;


 this.anim_shoot_z = 0.001;
 this.anim_melee_z = 0.001;

 return true;
}

void animdecide_load_if_needed(entity e)
{
 float mdlidx = e.modelindex;
 if (mdlidx == e.animdecide_modelindex) return;
 e.animdecide_modelindex = mdlidx;

 if(substring(e.model, 0, 16) == "models/monsters/")
 {
  if(monsters_animoverride(e))
   return;
 }



 vector none = '0 0 0';
 e.anim_die1 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_die1, mdlidx, 1, 0.5), none);
 e.anim_die2 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_die2, mdlidx, 1, 0.5), none);
 e.anim_draw = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_draw, mdlidx, 1, 3), none);
 e.anim_duckwalk = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckwalk, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_duckjump = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckjump, mdlidx, 1, 10), none);
 e.anim_duckidle = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_duckidle, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_idle = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_idle, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_jump = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_jump, mdlidx, 1, 10), none);
 e.anim_pain1 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_pain1, mdlidx, 1, 2), none);
 e.anim_pain2 = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_pain2, mdlidx, 1, 2), none);
 e.anim_shoot = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_shoot, mdlidx, 1, 5), none);
 e.anim_taunt = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_taunt, mdlidx, 1, 0.33), none);
 e.anim_run = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_run, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);
 e.anim_runbackwards = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_runbackwards, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);

 e.anim_straferight = animfixfps(e, anim_vec(ANIM_straferight, mdlidx, 1, 1), none);

const float ANIMPRIO_IDLE = 0;
const float ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE = 1;
const float ANIMPRIO_CROUCH = 2;
const float ANIMPRIO_DEAD = 3;

vector animdecide_getupperanim(entity e)
{

 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_FROZEN)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD1)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die1_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD2)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die2_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);


 vector outframe = '-1 0 0';
 float t, a;
 if(e.anim_upper_time >= e.anim_upper_implicit_time)
 {
  a = e.anim_upper_action;
  t = e.anim_upper_time;
 }
 else
 {
  a = e.anim_upper_implicit_action;
  t = e.anim_upper_implicit_time;
 }
 switch(a)
 {
  case ANIMACTION_DRAW: outframe = e.anim_draw; break;
  case ANIMACTION_PAIN1: outframe = e.anim_pain1; break;
  case ANIMACTION_PAIN2: outframe = e.anim_pain2; break;
  case ANIMACTION_SHOOT: outframe = e.anim_shoot; break;
  case ANIMACTION_TAUNT: outframe = e.anim_taunt; break;
  case ANIMACTION_MELEE: outframe = e.anim_melee; break;
 }
 if(outframe.x >= 0)
 {
  if(time <= t + outframe.y / outframe.z)
  {

   return (_vec3.x = (outframe.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  }
 }

 t = max(e.anim_time, e.anim_implicit_time);

 return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_IDLE), _vec3);
}

vector animdecide_getloweranim(entity e)
{

 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_FOLLOW)
  return (_vec3.x = (((e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK) ? e.anim_duckidle_x : e.anim_idle_x)), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_FROZEN)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD1)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die1_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DEAD2)
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_die2_x), _vec3.y = (e.anim_time), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_DEAD), _vec3);


 vector outframe = '-1 0 0';
 float t, a;
 if(e.anim_lower_time >= e.anim_lower_implicit_time)
 {
  a = e.anim_lower_action;
  t = e.anim_lower_time;
 }
 else
 {
  a = e.anim_lower_implicit_action;
  t = e.anim_lower_implicit_time;
 }
 switch(a)
 {
  case ANIMACTION_JUMP: if(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR) { if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK) outframe = e.anim_duckjump; else outframe = e.anim_jump; } break;
 }
 if(outframe.x >= 0)
 {
  if(time <= t + outframe.y / outframe.z)
  {

   return (_vec3.x = (outframe.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  }
 }

 t = max(e.anim_time, e.anim_implicit_time);
 if(e.anim_state & ANIMSTATE_DUCK)
 {
  if(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR)
   return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckjump.x), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
  else switch(e.anim_implicit_state & (ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT))
  {
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalk.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkbackwards.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkstraferight.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkstrafeleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkforwardright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkforwardleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkbackright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckwalkbackleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
  }
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_duckidle.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_CROUCH), _vec3);
 }
 else
 {
  if(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR)
   return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_jump.x), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  else switch(e.anim_implicit_state & (ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT))
  {
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_run.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_runbackwards.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_straferight.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_strafeleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_forwardright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_forwardleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_backright.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
   case ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS | ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT:
    return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_backleft.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_ACTIVE), _vec3);
  }
  return (_vec3.x = (e.anim_idle.x), _vec3.y = (t), _vec3.z = (ANIMPRIO_IDLE), _vec3);
 }


}

void animdecide_setimplicitstate(entity e, float onground)
{
 float s = 0;

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/animdecide.qc", 252, __FUNC__, "\"e.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(e.angles); }else voidfunc();
 vector v;
 v.x = e.velocity * v_forward;
 v.y = e.velocity * v_right;
 v.z = 0;
# 268 "./common/animdecide.qc"
 if(((_vlen2 = (v), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((10) ** 2)))
 {
  if(v.x > fabs(v.y) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_FORWARD;
  if(v.x < -fabs(v.y) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_BACKWARDS;
  if(v.y > fabs(v.x) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_RIGHT;
  if(v.y < -fabs(v.x) * 0.5)
   s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_LEFT;
 }
 if(!onground)
  s |= ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR;



 if(!(e.anim_implicit_state & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR) && (s & ANIMIMPLICITSTATE_INAIR))
 {
  e.anim_lower_implicit_action = ANIMACTION_JUMP;
  e.anim_lower_implicit_time = time;
 }

 if(s != e.anim_implicit_state)
 {
  e.anim_implicit_state = s;
  e.anim_implicit_time = time;
 }
}
void animdecide_setframes(entity e, float support_blending, .float fld_frame, .float fld_frame1time, .float fld_frame2, .float fld_frame2time)
{



 vector upper = animdecide_getupperanim(e);
 vector lower = animdecide_getloweranim(e);

 if(support_blending)
 {
  if(upper.z && !lower.z)
   lower = upper;
  else if(lower.z && !upper.z)
   upper = lower;
  if(e.frame1time != upper.y || e.frame2time != lower.y)
   ((e.effects) = ((e.effects) | (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)) - ((e.effects) & (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)));
  e.(fld_frame) = upper.x;
  e.(fld_frame1time) = upper.y;
  e.(fld_frame2) = lower.x;
  e.(fld_frame2time) = lower.y;
 }
 else
 {
  if(upper.z > lower.z)
   lower = upper;
  else if(lower.z > upper.z)
   upper = lower;
  if(e.frame1time != upper.y)
   ((e.effects) = ((e.effects) | (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)) - ((e.effects) & (EF_RESTARTANIM_BIT)));
  e.(fld_frame) = upper.x;
  e.(fld_frame1time) = upper.y;
 }
}

void animdecide_setstate(entity e, float newstate, float restart)
{
 if(!restart)
  if(newstate == e.anim_state)
   return;
 e.anim_state = newstate;
 e.anim_time = time;
}
void animdecide_setaction(entity e, float action, float restart)
{
 if(action < 0)
 {
  if(!restart)
   if(action == e.anim_lower_action)
    return;
  e.anim_lower_action = action;
  e.anim_lower_time = time;
 }
 else
 {
  if(!restart)
   if(action == e.anim_upper_action)
    return;
  e.anim_upper_action = action;
  e.anim_upper_time = time;
 }
}

 float _entcs_send(entity this, entity to, float sf, float chan)
 {
  entity player = this.owner;
  sf |= (1 << (ENTCS_PROP_ENTNUM_id));
  do {
   if (((player).classname == STR_PLAYER))
   {
    if (radar_showenemies) break;
    if ((teamplay ? (to.team == player.team) : (to == player))) break;
    if (!(((to).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((to).ingame))) break;
   }
   sf &= ENTCS_PUBLICMASK;
  } while (0);

  sf |= this.m_forceupdate;
  this.m_forceupdate = 0;
  if (chan == MSG_ENTITY)

 }
 MapInfo_count = j + 1;
 MapInfo_ClearTemps();


 heapsort(MapInfo_count, _MapInfo_FilterList_swap, _MapInfo_FilterList_cmp, (0, world));
}

 if(_MapInfo_filtered_allocated)
 {
  buf_del(_MapInfo_filtered);
  _MapInfo_filtered_allocated = 0;
 }
}


string MapInfo_BSPName_ByID(float i)

 return _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(i));
}

string unquote(string s)
{
 float l = _strlen(s);
 for(float i = 0; i < l; ++i)
 {
  string ch = substring(s, i, 1);
  if((ch != " ") && (ch != "\""))
  {
   for(float j = l - i - 1; j > 0; --j)
   {
    ch = substring(s, i+j, 1);
    if(ch != " ") if(ch != "\"")
     return substring(s, i, j+1);
   }
   return substring(s, i, 1);
  }
 }
 return "";
}

float MapInfo_Get_ByID(float i)
{
 return MapInfo_Get_ByName(MapInfo_BSPName_ByID(i), 0, (0, world)) ? true : false;
}

string _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music;

float _MapInfo_Generate(string pFilename)
{
 string fn;
 float fh;
 string s, k, v;
 vector o;
 float i;
 float inWorldspawn;
 float r;
 float diameter, spawnpoints;
 float spawnplaces;
 float is_q3df_map = false;

 vector mapMins, mapMaxs;

 r = 1;
 fn = strcat("maps/", pFilename, ".ent");
 fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
 {
  r = 2;
  fn = strcat("maps/", pFilename, ".bsp");
  fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
 }
 if(fh < 0)
  return 0;
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "291")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Analyzing ", fn, " to generate initial mapinfo"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

 inWorldspawn = 2;
 MapInfo_Map_flags = 0;
 MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes = 0;
 spawnpoints = 0;
 spawnplaces = 0;
 _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music = "";
 mapMins = '0 0 0';
 mapMaxs = '0 0 0';

 if(autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat == 2)
 {

  float isdefi = false;
  float arena_fh = -1;
  string arena_fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".arena");
  if(arena_fn != "")
   arena_fh = fopen(arena_fn, FILE_READ);
  if(arena_fh < 0)
  {
   isdefi = true;
   arena_fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".defi");
   if(arena_fn != "")
    arena_fh = fopen(arena_fn, FILE_READ);
  }
  if(arena_fh >= 0)
  {
   _MapInfo_ParseArena(arena_fn, arena_fh, pFilename, (0, world), isdefi, true);
   fclose(arena_fh);
  }
 }

 for (;;)
 {
  if (!((s = fgets(fh))))
   break;
  if(inWorldspawn == 1)
   if((_strstrofs(s, "}", 0) == 0))
    inWorldspawn = 0;
  k = unquote(car(s));
  v = unquote(cdr(s));
  if(inWorldspawn)
  {
   if(k == "classname" && v == "worldspawn")
    inWorldspawn = 1;
   else if(k == "author")
    MapInfo_Map_author = v;
   else if(k == "_description")
    MapInfo_Map_description = v;
   else if(k == "music")
    _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music = v;
   else if(k == "noise")
    _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music = v;
   else if(k == "message" && (!MapInfo_Map_title || MapInfo_Map_title == "<TITLE>"))
   {
    i = _strstrofs(v, " by ", 0);
    if(MapInfo_Map_author == "<AUTHOR>" && i >= 0)
    {
     MapInfo_Map_title = substring(v, 0, i);
     MapInfo_Map_author = substring(v, i + 4, _strlen(v) - (i + 4));
    }
    else
     MapInfo_Map_title = v;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   if(k == "origin")
   {
    o = stov(strcat("'", v, "'"));
    mapMins.x = min(mapMins.x, o.x);
    mapMins.y = min(mapMins.y, o.y);
    mapMins.z = min(mapMins.z, o.z);
    mapMaxs.x = max(mapMaxs.x, o.x);
    mapMaxs.y = max(mapMaxs.y, o.y);
    mapMaxs.z = max(mapMaxs.z, o.z);
   }
   else if(k == "race_place")
   {
    if(stof(v) > 0)
     spawnplaces = 1;
   }
   else if(k == "classname")
   {
    if(v == "info_player_team1")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "info_player_team2")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "info_player_start")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "info_player_deathmatch")
     ++spawnpoints;
    else if(v == "weapon_nex")
     { }
    else if(v == "weapon_railgun")
     { }
    else if((_strstrofs(v, "weapon_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;
    else if((_strstrofs(v, "turret_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_TURRETS;
    else if((_strstrofs(v, "vehicle_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_VEHICLES;
    else if((_strstrofs(v, "monster_", 0) == 0))
     MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_MONSTERS;
    else if(v == "target_music" || v == "trigger_music")
     _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music = nil;
    else if(v == "target_stopTimer")
     is_q3df_map = true;
    else
     if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { it.m_generate_mapinfo(it, v); } } } }else voidfunc();
   }
  }
 }
 if(inWorldspawn)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "407")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(fn, " ended still in worldspawn, BUG"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return 0;
 }
 diameter = vlen(mapMaxs - mapMins);

 float twoBaseModes = 0;
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_isTwoBaseMode()) { { twoBaseModes |= it.m_flags; } } } }else voidfunc();
 if(twoBaseModes && (twoBaseModes &= MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes))
 {

 }
 else if(!is_q3df_map)
 {
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_isAlwaysSupported(it, spawnpoints, diameter)) { { MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= it.m_flags; } } } }else voidfunc();
 }

 if(MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes & MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE.m_flags)
 if(!spawnplaces)
 {
  MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes &= ~MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE.m_flags;
  MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS.m_flags;
 }

 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "430")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("-> diameter ", ftos(diameter)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "431")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(";  spawnpoints ", ftos(spawnpoints)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "432")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(";  modes ", ftos(MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();

 fclose(fh);

 return r;
}

void _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype(string s, Gametype pWantedType, Gametype pThisType, float load_default)
{
 string sa;
 MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= pThisType.m_flags;
 if(!(pThisType.m_flags & pWantedType.m_flags))
  return;

 if(load_default)
  _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype(_MapInfo_GetDefault(pThisType), pWantedType, pThisType, false);

 if(!pWantedType.frags)
 {
  cvar_set("fraglimit", "0");
 }
 else
 {
  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   cvar_set("fraglimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }

 sa = car(s);
 if(sa != "")
  cvar_set("timelimit", sa);
 s = cdr(s);

 if(pWantedType.m_setTeams)
 {
  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   pWantedType.m_setTeams(sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }


 if(pWantedType == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE)
 {
  cvar_set("fraglimit", "0");

  sa = car(s); if(sa == "") sa = cvar_string("timelimit");
  cvar_set("g_race_qualifying_timelimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);

  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   if(cvar("g_race_teams") < 2)
    cvar_set("fraglimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);

  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   if(cvar("g_race_teams") >= 2)
    cvar_set("fraglimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }

 if(!pWantedType.frags)
 {
  cvar_set("leadlimit", "0");
 }
 else
 {
  sa = car(s);
  if(sa != "")
   cvar_set("leadlimit", sa);
  s = cdr(s);
 }
}
