void _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametypeEx(string s, Gametype pWantedType, Gametype pThisType)
{
 MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes |= pThisType.m_flags;
 if (!(pThisType.m_flags & pWantedType.m_flags))
  return;



 cvar_set("timelimit", cvar_defstring("timelimit"));
 cvar_set("leadlimit", cvar_defstring("leadlimit"));
 cvar_set("fraglimit", cvar_defstring("fraglimit"));
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { it.m_parse_mapinfo(nil, nil); } } } }else voidfunc();

 string fraglimit_normal = nil;
 string fraglimit_teams = nil;

 for (s = strcat(_MapInfo_GetDefaultEx(pWantedType), " ", s); s != ""; s = cdr(s)) {
  string sa = car(s);
  if (sa == "") continue;
  float p = _strstrofs(sa, "=", 0);
  if (p < 0) {
   if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "561")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Invalid gametype setting in mapinfo for gametype %s: %s", MapInfo_Type_ToString(pWantedType), sa), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   continue;
  }
  string k = substring(sa, 0, p);
  string v = substring(sa, p + 1, -1);
  float handled = true;
  switch (k) {
   case "timelimit":
   {
    cvar_set("timelimit", v);
    break;
   }
   case "leadlimit":
   {
    cvar_set("leadlimit", v);
    break;
   }
   case "pointlimit":
   case "fraglimit":
   case "lives":
   case "laplimit":
   case "caplimit":
   {
    fraglimit_normal = v;
    break;
   }
   case "teampointlimit":
   case "teamlaplimit":
   {
    fraglimit_teams = v;
    break;
   }
   default:
   {
       handled = false;
       break;
   }
  }
  if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { handled |= it.m_parse_mapinfo(k, v); } } } }else voidfunc();
  if (!handled && (!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
            if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "601")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Invalid gametype setting in mapinfo for gametype %s: %s", MapInfo_Type_ToString(pWantedType), sa), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }

 if (pWantedType == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE && cvar("g_race_teams") >= 2)
 {
  if(fraglimit_teams)
   cvar_set("fraglimit", fraglimit_teams);
 }
 else
 {
  if(fraglimit_normal)
   cvar_set("fraglimit", fraglimit_normal);
 }
}

Gametype MapInfo_Type_FromString(string gtype, float dowarn, float is_q3compat)
{
 string replacement = "";
 float do_warn = true;
 switch (gtype)
 {
  case "nexball": replacement = "nb"; break;
  case "freezetag": replacement = "ft"; break;
  case "keepaway": replacement = "ka"; break;
  case "invasion": replacement = "inv"; break;
  case "assault": replacement = "as"; break;
  case "race": replacement = "rc"; break;

  case "ffa": replacement = "dm"; do_warn = false; break;
  case "cctf":
  case "oneflag": replacement = "ctf"; do_warn = false; break;
  case "tournament":
  case "tourney": replacement = "duel"; do_warn = false; break;
  case "arena": if(is_q3compat) { replacement = "ca"; do_warn = false; } break;
 }
 if (replacement != "")
 {
  if (dowarn && (!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "639")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("MapInfo_Type_FromString (probably %s): using deprecated name '%s'. Should use '%s'.", MapInfo_Map_bspname, gtype, replacement), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  gtype = replacement;
 }
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.mdl == gtype) { { return it; } } } }else voidfunc();
 return (0, world);
}

 return t ? t.mdl : "";

void _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(string pFilename, string acl, float type, string s, float recurse)
{
 string t;
 float o;

 s = strreplace("\t", "", s);

 t = car(s); s = cdr(s);



 if(substring(t, 0, 1) == "\"")
 {
  if(substring(t, -1, 1) == "\"")
   t = substring(t, 1, -2);
 }


 if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "\"")
 {
  s = substring(s, 1, -1);
 }

 o = _strstrofs(s, "\"", 0);
 if(o >= 0)
  s = substring(s, 0, o);


 o = _strstrofs(s, "//", 0);
 if(o >= 0)
  s = substring(s, 0, o);


 while(substring(s, -1, 1) == " ")
  s = substring(s, 0, -2);

 if(t == "#include")
 {
  if(recurse > 0)
  {
   float fh = fopen(s, FILE_READ);
   if(fh < 0)
   {
    if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "706")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " references not existing config file ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   }
   else
   {
    while((s = fgets(fh)))
    {
     s = strreplace("\t", "", s);

     if(s == "")
      continue;
     if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "#")
      continue;
     if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
      continue;
     if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "_")
      continue;

     if(substring(s, 0, 4) == "set ")
      s = substring(s, 4, -1);
     if(substring(s, 0, 5) == "seta ")
      s = substring(s, 5, -1);

     _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(pFilename, acl, type, s, recurse - 1);
    }
    fclose(fh);
   }
  }
  else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "734")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " uses too many levels of inclusion"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else if(t == ""
  || !cvar_value_issafe(t)
  || !cvar_value_issafe(s)
  || matchacl("-g_mapinfo_* -rcon_* -_* -g_ban* +*", t) <= 0)
 {
  if ((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "742")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a potentially harmful setting, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else if(matchacl(acl, t) <= 0)
 {
  if ((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "747")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a denied setting, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else
 {
  if(type == 0)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "753")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Applying temporary setting ", t, " := ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();





    cvar_settemp(t, s);
  }
  else
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "763")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Applying temporary client setting ", t, " := ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   MapInfo_Map_clientstuff = strcat(
     MapInfo_Map_clientstuff, "cl_cmd settemp \"", t, "\" \"", s, "\"\n"
     );
  }
 }
}

float MapInfo_isRedundant(string fn, string t)
{

 fn = strreplace("_", "", fn);
 fn = strreplace("-", "", fn);


 t = strreplace(":", "", t);
 t = strreplace(" ", "", t);
 t = strreplace("_", "", t);
 t = strreplace("-", "", t);
 t = strreplace("'", "", t);
 t = strdecolorize(t);



 if(!_strcasecmp(fn, t))
  return true;

 return false;
}

float _MapInfo_ParseArena(string arena_filename, float fh, string pFilename, Gametype pGametypeToSet, float isdefi, float isgenerator)
{


 float in_brackets = false;
 float dosave = false;
 string stored_Map_description = "";
 string stored_Map_title = "";
 string stored_Map_author = "";
 float stored_supportedGametypes = 0;
 float stored_supportedFeatures = 0;
 float stored_flags = 0;
 string t, s;
 for (;;)
 {
  if (!((s = fgets(fh))))
   break;


  if(s == "")
   continue;
  if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
   continue;
  if(_strstrofs(s, "{", 0) >= 0)
  {
   if(in_brackets)
    return false;
   in_brackets = true;
   continue;
  }
  else if(!in_brackets)
  {

   continue;
  }
  if(_strstrofs(s, "}", 0) >= 0)
  {
   if(!in_brackets)
    return false;
   in_brackets = false;
   if(dosave)
   {
    MapInfo_Map_description = stored_Map_description;
    if(stored_Map_title != "")
     MapInfo_Map_title = stored_Map_title;
    MapInfo_Map_author = stored_Map_author;
    if(isgenerator)
     MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes = stored_supportedGametypes;
    else
    {
     if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_flags & stored_supportedGametypes) { { { _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype ("", pGametypeToSet, it, true); }; } } } }else voidfunc()


       ;
    }
    MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures = stored_supportedFeatures;
    MapInfo_Map_flags = stored_flags;
    return true;
   }
   else
   {

    stored_Map_description = "";
    stored_Map_title = "";
    stored_Map_author = "";
    stored_supportedGametypes = 0;
    stored_supportedFeatures = 0;
    stored_flags = 0;
    continue;
   }
  }

  s = strreplace("\t", " ", s);

  float p = _strstrofs(s, "//", 0);
  if(p >= 0)
   s = substring(s, 0, p);



  while(substring(s, 0, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 1, -1);

  t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
  t = strtolower(t);


  while(substring(t, -1, 1) == " ")
   t = substring(t, 0, -2);


  while(substring(s, -1, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 0, -2);

  while(substring(s, 0, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 1, -1);


  if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "\"")
  {
   if(substring(s, -1, 1) == "\"")
    s = substring(s, 1, -2);
  }
  if(t == "longname")
   stored_Map_title = s;
  else if(t == "author")
   stored_Map_author = s;
  else if(t == "type")
  {

   stored_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;


   string types = s;
   types = strreplace("team", "tdm ft", types);
   types = strreplace("ffa", "dm lms ka", types);
   if(_strstrofs(types, "tournament", 0) < 0 && _strstrofs(types, "tdm", 0) >= 0)
    types = cons(types, "ca kh");
   if(1){ string _words = types; float _i = 0; for (string _it; (_it = car(_words)); (_words = cdr(_words), ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref string it = _it; if (true) { { { Gametype f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(it, false, true); if(f) stored_supportedGametypes |= f.m_flags; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




     ;
  }
  else if(t == "style" && isdefi)
  {


   stored_supportedGametypes |= MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS.m_flags;
  }
  else if(t == "map")
  {
   if(strtolower(s) == strtolower(pFilename))
    dosave = true;
  }
  else if(t == "quote")
   stored_Map_description = s;

 }


 return false;
}

string _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(string pFilename, string pMapname)
{


 float fh = fopen(pFilename, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
  return "";
 for(string s; (s = fgets(fh)); )
 {
  s = strreplace("\t", "", s);
  while(substring(s, 0, 1) == " ")
   s = substring(s, 1, -1);
  if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
   continue;
  if(s == "")
   continue;
  float offset = _strstrofs(s, "map", 0);
  if(offset >= 0)
  {
   if(_strstrofs(strtolower(s), strcat("\"", strtolower(pMapname), "\""), offset) >= 0)
   {
    fclose(fh);
    return pFilename;
   }
  }
 }
 fclose(fh);
 return "";
}

string _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(string pFilename, string extension)
{
 string fallback = strcat("scripts/", pFilename, extension);
 if(!checkextension("DP_QC_FS_SEARCH_PACKFILE"))
  return _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(fallback, pFilename);
 string base_pack = whichpack(strcat("maps/", pFilename, ".bsp"));
 if(base_pack == "")
  return _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(fallback, pFilename);

 float glob = search_packfile_begin(strcat("scripts/*", extension), true, true, base_pack);
 if(glob < 0)
  return _MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(fallback, pFilename);
 float n = search_getsize(glob);
 for(float j = 0; j < n; ++j)
 {
  string file = search_getfilename(glob, j);
  if(_MapInfo_CheckArenaFile(file, pFilename) != "")
  {
   search_end(glob);
   return file;
  }
 }

 search_end(glob);
 return "";
}


float MapInfo_Get_ByName_NoFallbacks(string pFilename, float pAllowGenerate, Gametype pGametypeToSet)
{
 string fn;
 string s, t;
 float fh;
 float f, i;
 float r, n;
 string acl;

 acl = cvar_string("g_mapinfo_settemp_acl");

 if(_strstrofs(pFilename, "/", 0) >= 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1009")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Invalid character in map name, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return 0;
 }

 if(pGametypeToSet == (0, world))
  if(MapInfo_Cache_Retrieve(pFilename))
   return 1;

 r = 1;

 MapInfo_Map_bspname = pFilename;


 fn = strcat("maps/", pFilename, ".mapinfo");
 fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat)
  {
   float isdefi = false;
   if(autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat == 1)
   {
    fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".arena");
    if(fn != "")
     fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
   }
   if(fh < 0 || autocvar_g_mapinfo_q3compat == 2)
   {
    isdefi = true;
    fn = _MapInfo_FindArenaFile(pFilename, ".defi");
    if(fn != "")
     fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
   }
   if(fh >= 0)
   {
    _MapInfo_Map_Reset();
    if(_MapInfo_ParseArena(fn, fh, pFilename, pGametypeToSet, isdefi, false))
     goto mapinfo_handled;
   }
  }

  fn = strcat("maps/autogenerated/", pFilename, ".mapinfo");
  fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
  if(fh < 0)
  {
   if(!pAllowGenerate)
    return 0;
   _MapInfo_Map_Reset();
   r = _MapInfo_Generate(pFilename);
   if(!r)
    return 0;
   fh = fopen(fn, FILE_WRITE);
   fputs(fh, strcat("title ", MapInfo_Map_title, "\n"));
   fputs(fh, strcat("description ", MapInfo_Map_description, "\n"));
   fputs(fh, strcat("author ", MapInfo_Map_author, "\n"));
   if(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music != "")
   {
    if(_strcasecmp(substring(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, -4, 4), ".wav") == 0 || _strcasecmp(substring(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, -4, 4), ".ogg") == 0)
     fputs(fh, strcat("cdtrack ", substring(_MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, 0, -4), "\n"));
    else
     fputs(fh, strcat("cdtrack ", _MapInfo_Map_worldspawn_music, "\n"));
   }
   else
   {
    n = _tokenize_console(cvar_string("g_cdtracks_remaplist"));
    s = strcat(" ", cvar_string("g_cdtracks_dontusebydefault"), " ");
    for (;;)
    {
     i = floor(random() * n);
     if(_strstrofs(s, strcat(" ", argv(i), " "), 0) < 0)
      break;
    }
    fputs(fh, strcat("cdtrack ", ftos(i + 1), "\n"));
   }
   if(MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS)
    fputs(fh, "has weapons\n");
   else
    fputs(fh, "// uncomment this if you added weapon pickups: has weapons\n");
   if(MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MAPINFO_FEATURE_TURRETS)
    fputs(fh, "has turrets\n");
   else
    fputs(fh, "// uncomment this if you added turrets: has turrets\n");
   if(MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures & MAPINFO_FEATURE_VEHICLES)
    fputs(fh, "has vehicles\n");
   else
    fputs(fh, "// uncomment this if you added vehicles: has vehicles\n");
   if(MapInfo_Map_flags & MAPINFO_FLAG_FRUSTRATING)
    fputs(fh, "frustrating\n");

   if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes & it.m_flags) { { { fputs(fh, sprintf("gametype %s // defaults: %s\n", MapInfo_Type_ToString(it), _MapInfo_GetDefaultEx(it))); }; } } } }else voidfunc()

     ;

   fputs(fh, "// optional: fog density red green blue alpha mindist maxdist\n");
   fputs(fh, "// optional: settemp_for_type (all|gametypename) cvarname value\n");
   fputs(fh, "// optional: clientsettemp_for_type (all|gametypename) cvarname value\n");
   fputs(fh, "// optional: size mins_x mins_y mins_z maxs_x maxs_y maxs_z\n");
   fputs(fh, "// optional: hidden\n");

   fclose(fh);
   r = 2;

   fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
   if(fh < 0)
    (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("... but I just wrote it!"));
  }

  if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1117")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("autogenerated mapinfo file ", fn, " has been loaded; please edit that file and move it to maps/", pFilename, ".mapinfo"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }

 _MapInfo_Map_Reset();
 for (;;)
 {
  if (!((s = fgets(fh))))
   break;


  if(s == "")
   continue;
  if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "#")
   continue;
  if(substring(s, 0, 2) == "//")
   continue;
  if(substring(s, 0, 1) == "_")
   continue;

  float p = _strstrofs(s, "//", 0);
  if(p >= 0)
   s = substring(s, 0, p);

  t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
  if(t == "title")
   MapInfo_Map_title = s;
  else if(t == "description")
   MapInfo_Map_description = s;
  else if(t == "author")
   MapInfo_Map_author = s;
  else if(t == "has")
  {
   t = car(s);
   if (t == "weapons") MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;
   else if(t == "turrets") MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_TURRETS;
   else if(t == "vehicles") MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_VEHICLES;
   else if(t == "monsters") MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_MONSTERS;
   else if(t == "new_toys") MapInfo_Map_supportedFeatures |= MAPINFO_FEATURE_WEAPONS;
   else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1156")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " supports unknown feature ", t, ", ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  }
  else if(t == "hidden")
  {
   MapInfo_Map_flags |= MAPINFO_FLAG_HIDDEN;
  }
  else if(t == "forbidden")
  {
   MapInfo_Map_flags |= MAPINFO_FLAG_FORBIDDEN;
  }
  else if(t == "frustrating")
  {
   MapInfo_Map_flags |= MAPINFO_FLAG_FRUSTRATING;
  }
  else if(t == "noautomaplist")
  {
   MapInfo_Map_flags |= MAPINFO_FLAG_NOAUTOMAPLIST;
  }
  else if(t == "gameversion_min")
  {
   if (cvar("gameversion") < stof(s))
    MapInfo_Map_flags |= MAPINFO_FLAG_NOAUTOMAPLIST;
  }
  else if(t == "type")
  {
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
   Gametype f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(t, true, false);


   if(f)
    _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametype (s, pGametypeToSet, f, true);
   else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1188")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " supports unknown game type ", t, ", ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  }
  else if(t == "gametype")
  {
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
   Gametype f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(t, true, false);
   if(f)
    _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametypeEx (s, pGametypeToSet, f);
   else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1197")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " supports unknown game type ", t, ", ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  }
  else if(t == "size")
  {
   float a, b, c, d, e;
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s); a = stof(t);
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s); b = stof(t);
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s); c = stof(t);
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s); d = stof(t);
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s); e = stof(t);
   if(s == "")
   {
    if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1210")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains an incorrect size line (not enough params), syntax: size mins_x mins_y mins_z maxs_x maxs_y maxs_z"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   }
   else
   {
    t = car(s); s = cdr(s); f = stof(t);
    if(s != "")
    {
     if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
      if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1218")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains an incorrect size line (too many params), syntax: size mins_x mins_y mins_z maxs_x maxs_y maxs_z"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
    }
    else
    {
     if(a >= d || b >= e || c >= f)
     {
      if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1225")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains an incorrect size line, mins have to be < maxs"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
     }
     else
     {
      MapInfo_Map_mins.x = a;
      MapInfo_Map_mins.y = b;
      MapInfo_Map_mins.z = c;
      MapInfo_Map_maxs.x = d;
      MapInfo_Map_maxs.y = e;
      MapInfo_Map_maxs.z = f;
     }
    }
   }
  }
  else if(t == "settemp_for_type")
  {
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
   float all = t == "all";
   Gametype f = (0, world);
   if(all || (f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(t, true, false)))
   {
    if((all ? MAPINFO_TYPE_ALL : f.m_flags) & pGametypeToSet.m_flags)
    {
     _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(pFilename, acl, 0, s, 1);
    }
   }
   else
   {
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1253")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " has a setting for unknown game type ", t, ", ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   }
  }
  else if(t == "clientsettemp_for_type")
  {
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s);
   float all = t == "all";
   Gametype f = (0, world);
   if(all || (f = MapInfo_Type_FromString(t, true, false)))
   {
    if((all ? MAPINFO_TYPE_ALL : f.m_flags) & pGametypeToSet.m_flags)
    {
     _MapInfo_Parse_Settemp(pFilename, acl, 1, s, 1);
    }
   }
   else
   {
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1270")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " has a client setting for unknown game type ", t, ", ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   }
  }
  else if(t == "fog")
  {
   if (!cvar_value_issafe(s))
   {
    if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
     if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1278")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a potentially harmful fog setting, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   }
   else
    MapInfo_Map_fog = s;
  }
  else if(t == "cdtrack")
  {
   t = car(s); s = cdr(s);






   if(pGametypeToSet)
   {
    if (!cvar_value_issafe(t))
    {
     if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
      if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1297")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " contains a potentially harmful cdtrack, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
    }
    else
     MapInfo_Map_clientstuff = strcat(
      MapInfo_Map_clientstuff, "cd loop \"", t, "\"\n"
     );
   }
  }
  else if((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1306")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " provides unknown info item ", t, ", ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 :mapinfo_handled
 fclose(fh);

 if(MapInfo_Map_title == "<TITLE>")
  MapInfo_Map_titlestring = MapInfo_Map_bspname;
 else if(MapInfo_isRedundant(MapInfo_Map_bspname, MapInfo_Map_title))
  MapInfo_Map_titlestring = MapInfo_Map_title;
 else
  MapInfo_Map_titlestring = sprintf("%s: %s", MapInfo_Map_bspname, MapInfo_Map_title);

 MapInfo_Cache_Store();
 if(MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes != 0)
  return r;
 if ((!autocvar_g_mapinfo_ignore_warnings && MapInfo_Map_bspname == mi_shortname))
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) print(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^3WARNING""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1322")), "\n")); print(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Map ", pFilename, " supports no game types, ignored"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 return 0;
}
float MapInfo_Get_ByName(string pFilename, float pAllowGenerate, Gametype pGametypeToSet)
{
 float r = MapInfo_Get_ByName_NoFallbacks(pFilename, pAllowGenerate, pGametypeToSet);

 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Gametypes_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.m_isForcedSupported(it)) { { _MapInfo_Map_ApplyGametypeEx("", pGametypeToSet, it); } } } }else voidfunc();

 if(pGametypeToSet)
 {
  if(!(MapInfo_Map_supportedGametypes & pGametypeToSet.m_flags))
  {
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Can't select the requested game type. This should never happen as the caller should prevent it!\n"));


  }
 }

 return r;
}

float MapReadSizes(string map)
{

 string readsize_msg = strcat("MapReadSizes ", map);
 float fh = fopen(strcat("maps/", map, ".sizes"), FILE_READ);
 if(fh >= 0)
 {
  map_minplayers = stof(fgets(fh));
  map_maxplayers = stof(fgets(fh));
  fclose(fh);
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1354")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf(readsize_msg, ": ok, min %d max %d", map_minplayers, map_maxplayers), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return true;
 }
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mapinfo.qc", "1357")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(readsize_msg, ": not found"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 return false;
}

float MapInfo_FindName(string s)
{



 float l, r, m, cmp;
 l = 0;
 r = MapInfo_count;

 while(l != r)
 {
  m = floor((l + r) / 2);
  MapInfo_FindName_match = _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(m));
  cmp = _strcasecmp(MapInfo_FindName_match, s);
  if(cmp == 0)
   return m;
  if(cmp < 0)
   l = m + 1;
  else
   r = m;
 }
 MapInfo_FindName_match = _MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(l));
 MapInfo_FindName_firstResult = l;



 if(l == MapInfo_count)
 {
  MapInfo_FindName_match = nil;
  MapInfo_FindName_firstResult = -1;
  return -1;
 }
 if(!startsWithNocase(MapInfo_FindName_match, s))
 {
  MapInfo_FindName_match = nil;
  MapInfo_FindName_firstResult = -1;
  return -1;
 }
 if(l == MapInfo_count - 1)
  return l;
 if(startsWithNocase(_MapInfo_GlobItem(MapInfo_FilterList_Lookup(l + 1)), s))
 {
  MapInfo_FindName_match = nil;
  return -1;
 }
 return l;
}

string MapInfo_FixName(string s)
{
 MapInfo_FindName(s);
 return MapInfo_FindName_match;
}

 return req;
}

float _MapInfo_CheckMap(string s, float gametype_only)
{

  return 0;

  return 0;
 if (gametype_only)
  return 1;

  return 0;
 return 1;
}

{

  { s = e.crypto_idfp; }
 else if((clienttype(e) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
  { s = sprintf("bot#%g#%s", skill, e.cleanname); }

 if((s == "") || find((0, world), playerstats_id, s))
 {
  if((clienttype(e) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
   { s = sprintf("bot#%d", e.playerid); }
  else
   { s = sprintf("player#%d", e.playerid); }
 }

 e.playerstats_id = strzone(s);


 string key = sprintf("%s:*", e.playerstats_id);
 string p = db_get(PS_GR_OUT_DB, key);

 if(p == "")
 {
  if(PS_GR_OUT_PL)
  {
   db_put(PS_GR_OUT_DB, key, PS_GR_OUT_PL);
   strunzone(PS_GR_OUT_PL);
  }
  else { db_put(PS_GR_OUT_DB, key, "#"); }
  PS_GR_OUT_PL = strzone(e.playerstats_id);
 }
}

void PlayerStats_GameReport_FinalizePlayer(entity p)
{
 if((p.playerstats_id == "") || PS_GR_OUT_DB < 0) { return; }


 if(p.alivetime)
 {
  PlayerStats_GameReport_Event(p.playerstats_id, PLAYERSTATS_ALIVETIME, time - p.alivetime);
  p.alivetime = 0;
 }

 db_put(PS_GR_OUT_DB, sprintf("%s:_playerid", p.playerstats_id), ftos(p.playerid));

 if((p).cvar_cl_allow_uid2name == 1 || (clienttype(p) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
  db_put(PS_GR_OUT_DB, sprintf("%s:_netname", p.playerstats_id), playername(p.netname, p.team, false));

 if(teamplay)
  db_put(PS_GR_OUT_DB, sprintf("%s:_team", p.playerstats_id), ftos(p.team));

 if(stof(db_get(PS_GR_OUT_DB, sprintf("%s:%s", p.playerstats_id, PLAYERSTATS_ALIVETIME))) > 0)
  PlayerStats_GameReport_Event(p.playerstats_id, PLAYERSTATS_JOINS, 1);

 PlayerStats_GameReport_Accuracy(p);
 anticheat_report_to_playerstats(p);

 if((clienttype(p) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
 {
  if((p._cs).latency_cnt)
  {
   float latency = max(0, (p._cs).latency_sum / (p._cs).latency_cnt);
   if(latency)
   {


    float prev_latency = PlayerStats_GameReport_Event(p.playerstats_id, PLAYERSTATS_AVGLATENCY, 0);
    float new_latency = !prev_latency ? latency : (prev_latency + latency) / 2;
    PlayerStats_GameReport_Event(p.playerstats_id, PLAYERSTATS_AVGLATENCY, -prev_latency + new_latency);
   }
  }

  db_put(PS_GR_OUT_DB, sprintf("%s:_ranked", p.playerstats_id), ftos((p).cvar_cl_allow_uidranking));
 }

 if(1){ if (p.playerstats_id) { strunzone(p.playerstats_id); } p.playerstats_id = nil; }else voidfunc();
}

  } else {

   if(PS_B_IN_DB < 0)
    PS_B_IN_DB = db_create();


   uri = strcat(uri, "/player/", uri_escape(uri_escape(uri_escape(joiningplayer.crypto_idfp))), "/elo.txt");

    FILE_APPEND,
    PlayerStats_PlayerBasic_Handler,
    joiningplayer
   );


   if(newrequest)
   {

    joiningplayer.playerstats_basicstatus = PS_B_STATUS_WAITING;
   }
   else
   {

    joiningplayer.playerstats_basicstatus = PS_B_STATUS_UPDATING;
   }
  }
 }
 else
 {

  _GameRules_scoring_add(joiningplayer, SP_ELO, -1);
  if(PS_B_IN_DB >= 0)
  {
   db_close(PS_B_IN_DB);
   PS_B_IN_DB = -1;

   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && ((clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { it.playerstats_basicstatus = PS_B_STATUS_IDLE; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
  }
 }
}

float tracebox_inverted (vector v1, vector mi, vector ma, vector v2, float nomonsters, entity forent, float stopatentity, entity ignorestopatentity)
{
 vector pos, dir, t;
 float nudge;
 entity stopentity;


 nudge = 0.5;

 dir = normalize(v2 - v1);

 pos = v1 + dir * nudge;

 float c;
 c = 0;

 for (;;)
 {
  if(pos * dir >= v2 * dir)
  {

   trace_fraction = 1;
   trace_endpos = v2;
   return c;
  }

  tracebox(pos, mi, ma, v2, nomonsters, forent);
  ++c;

  if(c == 50)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "54")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("When tracing from ", vtos(v1), " to ", vtos(v2)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "55")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("  Nudging gets us nowhere at ", vtos(pos)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "56")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("  trace_endpos is ", vtos(trace_endpos)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "57")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("  trace distance is ", ftos(vlen(pos - trace_endpos))), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  }

  stopentity = trace_ent;

  if(trace_startsolid)
  {


   t = trace_endpos;
   tracebox(t, mi, ma, pos, nomonsters, forent);
   ++c;
   if(trace_startsolid)
   {


    pos = t + dir * nudge;


    if(stopatentity && stopentity && stopentity != ignorestopatentity)
    {
     trace_ent = stopentity;
     trace_endpos = t;
     trace_fraction = ((trace_endpos - v1) * dir) / ((v2 - v1) * dir);
     return c;
    }
   }
   else
   {

    trace_fraction = ((trace_endpos - v1) * dir) / ((v2 - v1) * dir);
    return c;
   }
  }
  else
  {

   trace_endpos = pos;
   trace_fraction = ((trace_endpos - v1) * dir) / ((v2 - v1) * dir);
   return c;
  }
 }
}

void traceline_inverted (vector v1, vector v2, float nomonsters, entity forent, float stopatentity, entity ignorestopatentity)
{
 tracebox_inverted(v1, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', v2, nomonsters, forent, stopatentity, ignorestopatentity);
}
# 117 "./common/util.qc"
vector findbetterlocation (vector org, float mindist)
{
 vector vec = mindist * '1 0 0';
 float c = 0;
 while (c < 6)
 {
  traceline (org, org + vec, true, (0, world));
  vec = vec * -1;
  if (trace_fraction < 1)
  {
   vector loc = trace_endpos;
   traceline (loc, loc + vec, true, (0, world));
   if (trace_fraction >= 1)
    org = loc + vec;
  }
  if (c & 1)
  {
   float h = vec.y;
   vec.y = vec.x;
   vec.x = vec.z;
   vec.z = h;
  }
  c = c + 1;
 }

 return org;
}

}

# 279 "./common/util.qc"
void wordwrap_cb(string s, float l, void(string) callback)
{
 string c;
 float lleft, i, j, wlen;

 s = strzone(s);
 lleft = l;
 float len = _strlen(s);
 for (i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  if (substring(s, i, 2) == "\\n")
  {
   callback("\n");
   lleft = l;
   ++i;
  }
  else if (substring(s, i, 1) == "\n")
  {
   callback("\n");
   lleft = l;
  }
  else if (substring(s, i, 1) == " ")
  {
   if (lleft > 0)
   {
    callback(" ");
    --lleft;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   for (j = i+1; j < len; ++j)







   {
    c = substring(s, j, 1);
    if (c == " ")
     break;
    if (c == "\\")
     break;
    if (c == "\n")
     break;



    callback("");
   }
   wlen = j - i;
   if (lleft < wlen)
   {
    callback("\n");
    lleft = l;
   }
   callback(substring(s, i, wlen));
   lleft -= wlen;
   i = j - 1;
  }
 }
 strunzone(s);
}

void depthfirst(entity start, .entity up, .entity downleft, .entity right, void(entity, entity) funcPre, void(entity, entity) funcPost, entity pass)
{
 entity e;
 e = start;
 funcPre(pass, e);
 while (e.(downleft))
 {
  e = e.(downleft);
  funcPre(pass, e);
 }
 funcPost(pass, e);
 while(e != start)
 {
  if (e.(right))
  {
   e = e.(right);
   funcPre(pass, e);
   while (e.(downleft))
   {
    e = e.(downleft);
    funcPre(pass, e);
   }
  }
  else
   e = e.(up);
  funcPost(pass, e);
 }
}


string ScoreString(float pFlags, float pValue, float rounds_played)
{
 string valstr;
 float l;

 pValue = floor(pValue + 0.5);

 if((pValue == 0) && (pFlags & (SFL_HIDE_ZERO | SFL_RANK | SFL_TIME)))
  valstr = "";
 else if(pFlags & SFL_RANK)
  valstr = (pValue < 256 ? count_ordinal(pValue) : _("N/A"));
 else if(pFlags & SFL_TIME)
  valstr = clockedtime_tostring(pValue, true, true);
 else if (rounds_played)
  valstr = sprintf("%.1f", pValue / rounds_played);
 else
  valstr = ftos(pValue);

 return valstr;
}
# 407 "./common/util.qc"
float lengthLogTable[128];

float invertLengthLog(float dist)
{
 float l, r, m;

 if(dist >= lengthLogTable[127])
  return 127;
 if(dist <= lengthLogTable[0])
  return 0;

 l = 0;
 r = 127;

 while(r - l > 1)
 {
  m = floor((l + r) / 2);
  if(lengthLogTable[m] < dist)
   l = m;
  else
   r = m;
 }


 float lerr = (dist - lengthLogTable[l]);
 float rerr = (lengthLogTable[r] - dist);
 if(lerr < rerr)
  return l;
 return r;
}

vector decompressShortVector(float data)
{
 vector out;
 if(data == 0)
  return '0 0 0';
 float p = (data & 0xF000) / 0x1000;
 float q = (data & 0x0F80) / 0x80;
 float len = (data & 0x007F);



 if(p == 0)
 {
  out.x = 0;
  out.y = 0;
  if(q == 31)
   out.z = -1;
  else
   out.z = +1;
 }
 else
 {
  q = .19634954084936207740 * q;
  p = .19634954084936207740 * p - 1.57079632679489661922;
  out.x = cos(q) * cos(p);
  out.y = sin(q) * cos(p);
  out.z = -sin(p);
 }



 return out * lengthLogTable[len];
}

float compressShortVector(vector vec)
{
 vector ang;
 float p, y, len;
 if(vec == '0 0 0')
  return 0;

 ang = vectoangles(vec);
 ang.x = -ang.x;
 if(ang.x < -90)
  ang.x += 360;
 if(ang.x < -90 && ang.x > +90)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("BOGUS vectoangles"));


 p = floor(0.5 + (ang.x + 90) * 16 / 180) & 15;
 if(p == 0)
 {
  if(vec.z < 0)
   y = 31;
  else
   y = 30;
 }
 else
  y = floor(0.5 + ang.y * 32 / 360) & 31;
 len = invertLengthLog(vlen(vec));



 return (p * 0x1000) + (y * 0x80) + len;
}

string fixPriorityList(string order, float from, float to, float subtract, float complete)
{
 string neworder;
 float i, n, w;

 n = _tokenize_console(order);
 neworder = "";
 for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
 {
  w = stof(argv(i));
  if(w == floor(w))
  {
   if(w >= from && w <= to)
    neworder = strcat(neworder, ftos(w), " ");
   else
   {
    w -= subtract;
    if(w >= from && w <= to)
     neworder = strcat(neworder, ftos(w), " ");
   }
  }
 }

 if(complete)
 {
  n = _tokenize_console(neworder);
  for(w = to; w >= from; --w)
  {
   float wflags = Weapons_from(w).spawnflags;
   if(wflags & WEP_FLAG_SPECIALATTACK)
    continue;
   for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
    if(stof(argv(i)) == w)
     break;
   if(i == n)
    neworder = strcat(neworder, ftos(w), " ");
  }
 }

 return substring(neworder, 0, _strlen(neworder) - 1);
}

string mapPriorityList(string order, string(string) mapfunc)
{
 string neworder;
 float n;

 n = _tokenize_console(order);
 neworder = "";
 for(float i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  neworder = strcat(neworder, mapfunc(argv(i)), " ");

 return substring(neworder, 0, _strlen(neworder) - 1);
}

string swapInPriorityList(string order, float i, float j)
{
 float n = _tokenize_console(order);

 if(i >= 0 && i < n && j >= 0 && j < n && i != j)
 {
  string s = "";
  for(float w = 0; w < n; ++w)
  {
   if(w == i)
    s = strcat(s, argv(j), " ");
   else if(w == j)
    s = strcat(s, argv(i), " ");
   else
    s = strcat(s, argv(w), " ");
  }
  return substring(s, 0, _strlen(s) - 1);
 }

 return order;
}

void get_mi_min_max_texcoords(float mode)
{
 vector extend;

 get_mi_min_max(mode);

 mi_picmin = mi_min;
 mi_picmax = mi_max;



 extend = mi_picmax - mi_picmin;
 if(extend.y > extend.x)
 {
  mi_picmin.x -= (extend.y - extend.x) * 0.5;
  mi_picmax.x += (extend.y - extend.x) * 0.5;
 }
 else
 {
  mi_picmin.y -= (extend.x - extend.y) * 0.5;
  mi_picmax.y += (extend.x - extend.y) * 0.5;
 }


 extend = (mi_picmax - mi_picmin) * (1 / 64.0);
 mi_picmin -= extend;
 mi_picmax += extend;


 mi_pictexcoord0 = mi_pictexcoord1 = mi_pictexcoord2 = mi_pictexcoord3 = '0 0 0';

 mi_pictexcoord0_x = (mi_min.x - mi_picmin.x) / (mi_picmax.x - mi_picmin.x);
 mi_pictexcoord0_y = (mi_min.y - mi_picmin.y) / (mi_picmax.y - mi_picmin.y);
 mi_pictexcoord2_x = (mi_max.x - mi_picmin.x) / (mi_picmax.x - mi_picmin.x);
 mi_pictexcoord2_y = (mi_max.y - mi_picmin.y) / (mi_picmax.y - mi_picmin.y);

 mi_pictexcoord1_x = mi_pictexcoord0_x;
 mi_pictexcoord1_y = mi_pictexcoord2_y;
 mi_pictexcoord3_x = mi_pictexcoord2_x;
 mi_pictexcoord3_y = mi_pictexcoord0_y;
}

float textLengthUpToWidth(string theText, float maxWidth, vector theSize, textLengthUpToWidth_widthFunction_t w)
{





 if(w(theText, theSize) <= maxWidth)
  return _strlen(theText);

 float colors = (w("^7", theSize) == 0);


 float len, left, right, middle;
 left = 0;
 right = len = _strlen(theText);
 float ofs = 0;
 do
 {
  middle = floor((left + right) / 2);
  if(colors)
  {
   vector res = checkColorCode(theText, len, middle, false);
   ofs = (res.x) ? res.x - res.y : 0;
  }

  if(w(substring(theText, 0, middle + ofs), theSize) <= maxWidth)
   left = middle + ofs;
  else
   right = middle;
 }
 while(left < right - 1);

 return left;
}

float textLengthUpToLength(string theText, float maxLength, textLengthUpToLength_lenFunction_t w)
{





 if(w(theText) <= maxLength)
  return _strlen(theText);

 float colors = (w("^7") == 0);


 float len, left, right, middle;
 left = 0;
 right = len = _strlen(theText);
 float ofs = 0;
 do
 {
  middle = floor((left + right) / 2);
  if(colors)
  {
   vector res = checkColorCode(theText, len, middle, true);
   ofs = (!res.x) ? 0 : res.x - res.y;
  }

  if(w(substring(theText, 0, middle + ofs)) <= maxLength)
   left = middle + ofs;
  else
   right = middle;
 }
 while(left < right - 1);

 return left;
}

string find_last_color_code(string s)
{
 float start = _strstrofs(s, "^", 0);
 if (start == -1)
  return "";
 float len = _strlen(s)-1;
 for(float i = len; i >= start; --i)
 {
  if(substring(s, i, 1) != "^")
   continue;

  float carets = 1;
  while (i-carets >= start && substring(s, i-carets, 1) == "^")
   ++carets;


  if (carets & 1)
  {
   if(i+1 <= len)
   if((_strstrofs(DIGITS, (substring(s, i+1, 1)), 0) >= 0))
    return substring(s, i, 2);

   if(i+4 <= len)
   if(substring(s, i+1, 1) == "x")
   if((_strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(s, i + 2, 1)), 0) >= 0))
   if((_strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(s, i + 3, 1)), 0) >= 0))
   if((_strstrofs(HEXDIGITS_MINSET, (substring(s, i + 4, 1)), 0) >= 0))
    return substring(s, i, 5);
  }
  i -= carets;
 }

 return "";
}

string getWrappedLine(float maxWidth, vector theFontSize, textLengthUpToWidth_widthFunction_t tw)
{
 string s = getWrappedLine_remaining;

 if(maxWidth <= 0)
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }

 float take_until = textLengthUpToWidth(s, maxWidth, theFontSize, tw);
 if(take_until > 0 && take_until < _strlen(s))
 {
  float last_word = take_until - 1;
  while(last_word > 0 && substring(s, last_word, 1) != " ")
   --last_word;

  float skip = 0;
  if(last_word != 0)
  {
   take_until = last_word;
   skip = 1;
  }

  getWrappedLine_remaining = substring(s, take_until + skip, _strlen(s) - take_until);
  if(getWrappedLine_remaining == "")
   getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  else if (tw("^7", theFontSize) == 0)
   getWrappedLine_remaining = strcat(find_last_color_code(substring(s, 0, take_until)), getWrappedLine_remaining);
  return substring(s, 0, take_until);
 }
 else
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }
}

{
 string s = getWrappedLine_remaining;

 if(maxLength <= 0)
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }

 float take_until = textLengthUpToLength(s, maxLength, tw);
 if(take_until > 0 && take_until < _strlen(s))
 {
  float last_word = take_until - 1;
  while(last_word > 0 && substring(s, last_word, 1) != " ")
   --last_word;

  float skip = 0;
  if(last_word != 0)
  {
   take_until = last_word;
   skip = 1;
  }

  getWrappedLine_remaining = substring(s, take_until + skip, _strlen(s) - take_until);
  if(getWrappedLine_remaining == "")
   getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  else if (tw("^7") == 0)
   getWrappedLine_remaining = strcat(find_last_color_code(substring(s, 0, take_until)), getWrappedLine_remaining);
  return substring(s, 0, take_until);
 }
 else
 {
  getWrappedLine_remaining = nil;
  return s;
 }
}

float isGametypeInFilter(Gametype gt, float tp, float ts, string pattern)
{
 string subpattern, subpattern2, subpattern3, subpattern4;
 subpattern = strcat(",", MapInfo_Type_ToString(gt), ",");
 if(tp)
  subpattern2 = ",teams,";
 else
  subpattern2 = ",noteams,";
 if(ts)
  subpattern3 = ",teamspawns,";
 else
  subpattern3 = ",noteamspawns,";
 if(gt == MAPINFO_TYPE_RACE || gt == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS)
  subpattern4 = ",race,";
 else
  subpattern4 = nil;

 if(substring(pattern, 0, 1) == "-")
 {
  pattern = substring(pattern, 1, _strlen(pattern) - 1);
  if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
  if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern2, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
  if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern3, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
  if(subpattern4 && _strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern4, 0) >= 0)
   return 0;
 }
 else
 {
  if(substring(pattern, 0, 1) == "+")
   pattern = substring(pattern, 1, _strlen(pattern) - 1);
  if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern, 0) < 0)
  if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern2, 0) < 0)
  if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern3, 0) < 0)
  {
   if (!subpattern4)
    return 0;
   if(_strstrofs(strcat(",", pattern, ","), subpattern4, 0) < 0)
    return 0;
  }
 }
 return 1;
}

vector solve_shotdirection(vector myorg, vector myvel, vector eorg, vector evel, float spd, float newton_style)
{
 vector ret;


 eorg -= myorg;
 if(newton_style)
  evel -= myvel;







 vector solution = solve_quadratic(evel * evel - spd * spd, 2 * (eorg * evel), eorg * eorg);


 if(!solution.z)
 {







  return '0 0 0';
 }
 else if(solution.x > 0)
 {


  ret = normalize(eorg + solution.x * evel);
 }
 else if(solution.y > 0)
 {


  ret = normalize(eorg + solution.y * evel);
 }
 else
 {
# 1136 "./common/util.qc"
  return '0 0 0';
 }



 if(newton_style == 2)
  ret = normalize(ret * spd + myvel);

 return ret;
}

vector get_shotvelocity(vector myvel, vector mydir, float spd, float newton_style, float mi, float ma)
{
 if(!newton_style)
  return spd * mydir;

 if(newton_style == 2)
 {
# 1167 "./common/util.qc"
  vector solution = solve_quadratic(1, -2 * (mydir * myvel), myvel * myvel - spd * spd);

  float outspeed;
  if(solution.z)
   outspeed = solution.y;
  else
  {

   outspeed = solution.x;

  }

  outspeed = bound(spd * mi, outspeed, spd * ma);
  return mydir * outspeed;
 }


 return myvel + spd * mydir;
}

float compressShotOrigin(vector v)
{
 float rx = rint(v.x * 2);
 float ry = rint(v.y * 4) + 128;
 float rz = rint(v.z * 4) + 128;
 if(rx > 255 || rx < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "1194")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("shot origin ", vtos(v), " x out of bounds\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  rx = bound(0, rx, 255);
 }
 if(ry > 255 || ry < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "1199")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("shot origin ", vtos(v), " y out of bounds\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  ry = bound(0, ry, 255);
 }
 if(rz > 255 || rz < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/util.qc", "1204")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("shot origin ", vtos(v), " z out of bounds\n"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
  rz = bound(0, rz, 255);
 }
 return rx * 0x10000 + ry * 0x100 + rz;
}
vector decompressShotOrigin(float f)
{
 vector v;
 v.x = ((f & 0xFF0000) / 0x10000) / 2;
 v.y = ((f & 0xFF00) / 0x100 - 128) / 4;
 v.z = ((f & 0xFF) - 128) / 4;
 return v;
}


vector healtharmor_maxdamage(float h, float a, float armorblock, float deathtype)
{

 float healthdamage, armordamage, armorideal;
 if (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) && (Deathtypes_from(deathtype - DT_FIRST)) == DEATH_DROWN))
  armorblock = 0;
 vector v;
 healthdamage = (h - 1) / (1 - armorblock);
 armordamage = a + (h - 1);
 armorideal = healthdamage * armorblock;
 v.y = armorideal;
 if(armordamage < healthdamage)
 {
  v.x = armordamage;
  v.z = 1;
 }
 else
 {
  v.x = healthdamage;
  v.z = 0;
 }
 return v;
}

vector healtharmor_applydamage(float a, float armorblock, float deathtype, float damage)
{
 vector v;
 if (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) && (Deathtypes_from(deathtype - DT_FIRST)) == DEATH_DROWN))
  armorblock = 0;
 if (deathtype & HITTYPE_ARMORPIERCE)
  armorblock = 0;
 v.y = bound(0, damage * armorblock, a);
 v.x = bound(0, damage - v.y, damage);
 v.z = 0;
 return v;
}

float matchacl(string acl, string str)
{
 string t, s;
 float r, d;
 r = 0;
 while(acl)
 {
  t = car(acl); acl = cdr(acl);

  d = 1;
  if(substring(t, 0, 1) == "-")
  {
   d = -1;
   t = substring(t, 1, _strlen(t) - 1);
  }
  else if(substring(t, 0, 1) == "+")
   t = substring(t, 1, _strlen(t) - 1);

  if(substring(t, -1, 1) == "*")
  {
   t = substring(t, 0, _strlen(t) - 1);
   s = substring(str, 0, _strlen(t));
  }
  else
   s = str;

  if(s == t)
  {
   r = d;
   break;
  }
 }
 return r;
}

float get_model_parameters(string m, float sk)
{
 get_model_parameters_modelname = nil;
 get_model_parameters_modelskin = -1;
 get_model_parameters_name = nil;
 get_model_parameters_species = -1;
 get_model_parameters_sex = nil;
 get_model_parameters_weight = -1;
 get_model_parameters_age = -1;
 get_model_parameters_desc = nil;
 get_model_parameters_bone_upperbody = nil;
 get_model_parameters_bone_weapon = nil;
 for(float i = 0; i < MAX_AIM_BONES; ++i)
 {
  get_model_parameters_bone_aim[i] = nil;
  get_model_parameters_bone_aimweight[i] = 0;
 }
 get_model_parameters_fixbone = 0;
 get_model_parameters_hidden = false;


 __Mutator_Send_ClearModelParams(0 );


 if (!m)
  return 1;

 if(substring(m, -9, 5) == "_lod1" || substring(m, -9, 5) == "_lod2")
  m = strcat(substring(m, 0, -10), substring(m, -4, -1));

 if(sk < 0)
 {
  if(substring(m, -4, -1) != ".txt")
   return 0;
  if(substring(m, -6, 1) != "_")
   return 0;
  sk = stof(substring(m, -5, 1));
  m = substring(m, 0, -7);
 }

 string fn = get_model_datafilename(m, sk, "txt");
 float fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
 if(fh < 0)
 {
  sk = 0;
  fn = get_model_datafilename(m, sk, "txt");
  fh = fopen(fn, FILE_READ);
  if(fh < 0)
   return 0;
 }

 get_model_parameters_modelname = m;
 get_model_parameters_modelskin = sk;
 string s, c;
 while((s = fgets(fh)))
 {
  if(s == "")
   break;
  c = car(s);
  s = cdr(s);
  if(c == "name")
   get_model_parameters_name = s;
  if(c == "species")
   switch(s)
   {
    case "human": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_HUMAN; break;
    case "alien": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ALIEN; break;
    case "robot_shiny": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ROBOT_SHINY; break;
    case "robot_rusty": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ROBOT_RUSTY; break;
    case "robot_solid": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ROBOT_SOLID; break;
    case "animal": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_ANIMAL; break;
    case "reserved": get_model_parameters_species = SPECIES_RESERVED; break;
   }
  if(c == "sex")
  {
   if (s == "Male") s = _("Male");
   else if (s == "Female") s = _("Female");
   else if (s == "Undisclosed") s = _("Undisclosed");
   get_model_parameters_sex = s;
  }
  if(c == "weight")
   get_model_parameters_weight = stof(s);
  if(c == "age")
   get_model_parameters_age = stof(s);
  if(c == "description")
   get_model_parameters_description = s;
  if(c == "bone_upperbody")
   get_model_parameters_bone_upperbody = s;
  if(c == "bone_weapon")
   get_model_parameters_bone_weapon = s;

  __Mutator_Send_GetModelParams(0 , c, s);

  for(float i = 0; i < MAX_AIM_BONES; ++i)
   if(c == strcat("bone_aim", ftos(i)))
   {
    get_model_parameters_bone_aimweight[i] = stof(car(s));
    get_model_parameters_bone_aim[i] = cdr(s);
   }
  if(c == "fixbone")
   get_model_parameters_fixbone = stof(s);
  if(c == "hidden")
   get_model_parameters_hidden = stof(s);
 }

 while((s = fgets(fh)))
 {
  if(get_model_parameters_desc)
   get_model_parameters_desc = strcat(get_model_parameters_desc, "\n");
  if(s != "")
   get_model_parameters_desc = strcat(get_model_parameters_desc, s);
 }

 fclose(fh);

 return 1;
}

const string XENCODE_2 = "xX";
const string XENCODE_22 = "0123456789abcdefABCDEF";
string xencode(float f)
{
 float a, b, c, d;
 d = f % 22; f = floor(f / 22);
 c = f % 22; f = floor(f / 22);
 b = f % 22; f = floor(f / 22);
 a = f % 2;
 return strcat(
  "^",
  substring(XENCODE_2, a, 1),
  substring(XENCODE_22, b, 1),
  substring(XENCODE_22, c, 1),
  substring(XENCODE_22, d, 1)
 );
}
float xdecode(string s)
{
 float a, b, c, d;
 if(substring(s, 0, 1) != "^")
  return -1;
 if(_strlen(s) < 5)
  return -1;
 a = _strstrofs(XENCODE_2, substring(s, 1, 1), 0);
 b = _strstrofs(XENCODE_22, substring(s, 2, 1), 0);
 c = _strstrofs(XENCODE_22, substring(s, 3, 1), 0);
 d = _strstrofs(XENCODE_22, substring(s, 4, 1), 0);
 if(a < 0 || b < 0 || c < 0 || d < 0)
  return -1;
 return ((a * 22 + b) * 22 + c) * 22 + d;
}

.float FindConnectedComponent_processing;
void FindConnectedComponent(entity e, .entity fld, findNextEntityNearFunction_t nxt, isConnectedFunction_t iscon, entity pass)
{
 entity queue_start, queue_end;





 if(e.FindConnectedComponent_processing)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("recursion or broken cleanup"));


 queue_start = queue_end = e;
 queue_end.(fld) = (0, world);
 queue_end.FindConnectedComponent_processing = 1;


 for (; queue_start; queue_start = queue_start.(fld))
 {

  entity t;
  for(t = (0, world); (t = nxt(t, queue_start, pass)); )
  {
   if(t.FindConnectedComponent_processing)
    continue;
   if(iscon(t, queue_start, pass))
   {

    queue_end.(fld) = t;
    queue_end = t;
    queue_end.(fld) = (0, world);
    queue_end.FindConnectedComponent_processing = 1;
   }
  }
 }


 for (queue_start = e; queue_start; queue_start = queue_start.(fld))
  queue_start.FindConnectedComponent_processing = 0;
}

 if(a.y == 1)
 {

  {
   a = b;
   dur = frameduration(e.modelindex, a.x);
  }
  if (dur > 0)
   a.z = 1.0 / dur;
 }
 return a;
}

float Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(float nativecontents)
{
 switch(nativecontents)
 {
  case CONTENT_EMPTY:
   return 0;
  case CONTENT_SOLID:
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_OPAQUE;
  case CONTENT_WATER:
   return DPCONTENTS_WATER;
  case CONTENT_SLIME:
   return DPCONTENTS_SLIME;
  case CONTENT_LAVA:
   return DPCONTENTS_LAVA | DPCONTENTS_NODROP;
  case CONTENT_SKY:
   return DPCONTENTS_SKY | DPCONTENTS_NODROP | DPCONTENTS_OPAQUE;
 }
 return 0;
}

float Mod_Q1BSP_NativeContentsFromSuperContents(float supercontents)
{
 if(supercontents & (DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY))
  return CONTENT_SOLID;
 if(supercontents & DPCONTENTS_SKY)
  return CONTENT_SKY;
 if(supercontents & DPCONTENTS_LAVA)
  return CONTENT_LAVA;
 if(supercontents & DPCONTENTS_SLIME)
  return CONTENT_SLIME;
 if(supercontents & DPCONTENTS_WATER)
  return CONTENT_WATER;
 return CONTENT_EMPTY;
}



void attach_sameorigin(entity e, entity to, string tag)
{
    vector org, t_forward, t_left, t_up, e_forward, e_up;
    float tagscale;

    org = e.origin - ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/util.qc", 1895, __FUNC__, "to" ", " "gettagindex(to, tag)"), _gettaginfo_hidden(to, _gettagindex(to, tag)) );
    tagscale = (vlen(v_forward) ** -2);
    t_forward = v_forward * tagscale;
    t_left = v_right * -tagscale;
    t_up = v_up * tagscale;

    e.origin_x = org * t_forward;
    e.origin_y = org * t_left;
    e.origin_z = org * t_up;


    if (substring(e.model, 0, 1) == "*")
  e.angles = AnglesTransform_FromVAngles(e.angles);
 else
  e.angles = AnglesTransform_FromAngles(e.angles);
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/util.qc", 1910, __FUNC__, "\"e.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(e.angles); }else voidfunc();


    e_forward.x = v_forward * t_forward;
    e_forward.y = v_forward * t_left;
    e_forward.z = v_forward * t_up;
    e_up.x = v_up * t_forward;
    e_up.y = v_up * t_left;
    e_up.z = v_up * t_up;

    e.angles = (_fixedvectoangles2 = vectoangles2(e_forward, e_up), _fixedvectoangles2.x *= -1, _fixedvectoangles2);
    if (substring(e.model, 0, 1) == "*")
  e.angles = AnglesTransform_ToVAngles(e.angles);
 else
  e.angles = AnglesTransform_ToAngles(e.angles);

    setattachment(e, to, tag);
    setorigin(e, e.origin);
}

float trace_hits_box_a0, trace_hits_box_a1;

float trace_hits_box_1d(float end, float thmi, float thma)
{
    if (end == 0)
    {

        if (0 < thmi)
            return false;
        if (0 > thma)
            return false;
    }
    else
    {


        trace_hits_box_a0 = max(trace_hits_box_a0, min(thmi / end, thma / end));
        trace_hits_box_a1 = min(trace_hits_box_a1, max(thmi / end, thma / end));
        if (trace_hits_box_a0 > trace_hits_box_a1)
            return false;
    }
    return true;
}

float trace_hits_box(vector start, vector end, vector thmi, vector thma)
{
    end -= start;
    thmi -= start;
    thma -= start;


    trace_hits_box_a0 = 0;
    trace_hits_box_a1 = 1;

    if (!trace_hits_box_1d(end.x, thmi.x, thma.x))
        return false;
    if (!trace_hits_box_1d(end.y, thmi.y, thma.y))
        return false;
    if (!trace_hits_box_1d(end.z, thmi.z, thma.z))
        return false;

    return true;
}

float tracebox_hits_box(vector start, vector mi, vector ma, vector end, vector thmi, vector thma)
{
    return trace_hits_box(start, end, thmi - ma, thma - mi);
}

[[eraseable]]
float blink_synced(float base, float range, float freq, float start_time, float start_pos)
{






 return base + range * sin((time - start_time - (3.14159265358979323846 / 2) * start_pos) * freq);
}

[[eraseable]]
float blink(float base, float range, float freq)
{
 return blink_synced(base, range, freq, 0, 0);
}

{

 if(fh >= 0)
 {
  for(lineno = 0; (l = fgets(fh)); )
  {
   if(_strlen(l) == 0)
    continue;
   if(substring(l, 0, 11) == "//campaign:")

   if(substring(l, 0, 2) == "//")
    continue;
   if(substring(l, 0, 12) == "\"//campaign:")
    campaign_title = substring(l, 12, _strlen(l) - 13);
   if(substring(l, 0, 3) == "\"//")
    continue;
   if(lineno >= offset)
   {
    entlen = tokenize(l);

     (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("syntax error in campaign file: line has not enough fields"));

float IsMoveInDirection(vector mv, float ang)
{
 if (mv_x == 0 && mv_y == 0)
  return 0;
 ang -= RAD2DEG * atan2(mv_y, mv_x);
 ang = remainder(ang, 360) / 45;
 return ang > 1 ? 0 : ang < -1 ? 0 : 1 - fabs(ang);
}

float GeomLerp(float a, float _lerp, float b)
{
 return a == 0 ? (_lerp < 1 ? 0 : b)
  : b == 0 ? (_lerp > 0 ? 0 : a)
  : a * (fabs(b / a) ** _lerp);
}

void PM_ClientMovement_UpdateStatus(entity this)
{
 if(!((this).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return;

void CPM_PM_Aircontrol(entity this, float dt, vector wishdir, float wishspeed)
{
 float movity = IsMoveInDirection((this._cs).movement, 0);
 if((this).stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_BACKWARDS)
  movity += IsMoveInDirection((this._cs).movement, 180);
 if((this).stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_SIDEWARDS)
 {
  movity += IsMoveInDirection((this._cs).movement, 90);
  movity += IsMoveInDirection((this._cs).movement, -90);
 }

 float k = 32 * (2 * movity - 1);
 if (k <= 0)
  return;

 k *= bound(0, wishspeed / (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSPEED, 1);

 float zspeed = this.velocity_z;
 this.velocity_z = 0;
 float xyspeed = vlen(this.velocity);
 this.velocity = normalize(this.velocity);

 float dot = this.velocity * wishdir;

 if (dot > 0)
 {
  k *= (dot ** (this).stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_POWER) * dt;
  xyspeed = max(0, xyspeed - (this).stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL_PENALTY * sqrt(max(0, 1 - dot*dot)) * k/32);
  k *= (this).stat_MOVEVARS_AIRCONTROL;
  this.velocity = normalize(this.velocity * xyspeed + wishdir * k);
 }

 this.velocity = this.velocity * xyspeed;
 this.velocity_z = zspeed;
}

float AdjustAirAccelQW(float accelqw, float factor)
{
 return copysign(bound(0.000001, 1 - (1 - fabs(accelqw)) * factor, 1), accelqw);
}






void PM_Accelerate(entity this, float dt, vector wishdir, float wishspeed, float wishspeed0, float accel, float accelqw, float stretchfactor, float sidefric, float speedlimit)
{
 float speedclamp = stretchfactor > 0 ? stretchfactor
 : accelqw < 0 ? 1
 : -1;

 accelqw = fabs(accelqw);

 if (autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_q2airaccelerate)
  wishspeed0 = wishspeed;

 float vel_straight = this.velocity * wishdir;
 float vel_z = this.velocity_z;
 vector vel_xy = (_vec2 = (this.velocity), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2);
 vector vel_perpend = vel_xy - vel_straight * wishdir;

 float step = accel * dt * wishspeed0;

 float vel_xy_current = vlen(vel_xy);
 if (speedlimit)
  accelqw = AdjustAirAccelQW(accelqw, (speedlimit - bound(wishspeed, vel_xy_current, speedlimit)) / max(1, speedlimit - wishspeed));
 float vel_xy_forward = vel_xy_current + bound(0, wishspeed - vel_xy_current, step) * accelqw + step * (1 - accelqw);
 float vel_xy_backward = vel_xy_current - bound(0, wishspeed + vel_xy_current, step) * accelqw - step * (1 - accelqw);
 vel_xy_backward = max(0, vel_xy_backward);
 vel_straight = vel_straight + bound(0, wishspeed - vel_straight, step) * accelqw + step * (1 - accelqw);

 if (sidefric < 0 && (vel_perpend*vel_perpend))

 {
  float f = max(0, 1 + dt * wishspeed * sidefric);
  float themin = (vel_xy_backward * vel_xy_backward - vel_straight * vel_straight) / (vel_perpend * vel_perpend);





  if (themin <= 0)
   vel_perpend *= f;
  else
  {
   themin = sqrt(themin);
   vel_perpend *= max(themin, f);
  }
 }
 else
  vel_perpend *= max(0, 1 - dt * wishspeed * sidefric);

 vel_xy = vel_straight * wishdir + vel_perpend;

 if (speedclamp >= 0)
 {
  float vel_xy_preclamp;
  vel_xy_preclamp = vlen(vel_xy);
  if (vel_xy_preclamp > 0)
  {
   vel_xy_current += (vel_xy_forward - vel_xy_current) * speedclamp;
   if (vel_xy_current < vel_xy_preclamp)
    vel_xy *= (vel_xy_current / vel_xy_preclamp);
  }
 }

 this.velocity = vel_xy + vel_z * '0 0 1';
}

void PM_AirAccelerate(entity this, float dt, vector wishdir, float wishspeed)
{
 if (wishspeed == 0)
  return;

 vector curvel = this.velocity;
 curvel_z = 0;
 float curspeed = vlen(curvel);

 if (wishspeed > curspeed * 1.01)
  wishspeed = min(wishspeed, curspeed + (this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_AIRFORWARDACCEL * (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED * dt);
 else
 {
  float f = max(0, ((this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TOPSPEED - curspeed) / ((this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TOPSPEED - (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED));
  wishspeed = max(curspeed, (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED) + (this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_ACCEL * f * (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED * dt;
 }
 vector wishvel = wishdir * wishspeed;
 vector acceldir = wishvel - curvel;
 float addspeed = vlen(acceldir);
 acceldir = normalize(acceldir);

 float accelspeed = min(addspeed, (this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_TURNACCEL * (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED * dt);

 if ((this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_BACKTOSIDERATIO < 1)
 {
  vector curdir = normalize(curvel);
  float dot = acceldir * curdir;
  if (dot < 0)
   acceldir -= (1 - (this).stat_MOVEVARS_WARSOWBUNNY_BACKTOSIDERATIO) * dot * curdir;
 }

 this.velocity += accelspeed * acceldir;
}

float PM_check_specialcommand(entity this, float buttons)
{

 string c;
 switch (buttons)
 {

  case 0: c = "x"; break;
  case (1 << (0)): c = "1"; break;
  case (1 << (2)): c = " "; break;
  case (1 << (7)): c = "s"; break;
  case (1 << (8)): c = "w"; break;
  case (1 << (9)): c = "a"; break;
  case (1 << (10)): c = "d"; break;
  default: c = "?";
 }

 if (c == substring(specialcommand, (this._cs).specialcommand_pos, 1))
 {
  (this._cs).specialcommand_pos += 1;
  if ((this._cs).specialcommand_pos >= _strlen(specialcommand))
  {
   (this._cs).specialcommand_pos = 0;
   SpecialCommand(this);
   return true;
  }
 }
 else if ((this._cs).specialcommand_pos && (c != substring(specialcommand, (this._cs).specialcommand_pos - 1, 1)))
  (this._cs).specialcommand_pos = 0;

 return false;
}

void PM_jetpack(entity this, float maxspd_mod, float dt)
{

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/physics/player.qc", 711, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
 vector wishvel = v_forward * (this._cs).movement_x
     + v_right * (this._cs).movement_y;

 float maxairspd = (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXAIRSPEED * max(1, maxspd_mod);

 wishvel = normalize(wishvel) * min(1, vlen(wishvel) / maxairspd);

 wishvel_z = 0;


  wishvel_z = sqrt(max(0, 1 - wishvel * wishvel));


 float a_side = (this).stat_JETPACK_ACCEL_SIDE;
 float a_up = (this).stat_JETPACK_ACCEL_UP;
 float a_add = (this).stat_JETPACK_ANTIGRAVITY * cvar("sv_gravity");

 if((this).stat_JETPACK_REVERSE_THRUST && ((this._cs).button5)) { a_up = (this).stat_JETPACK_REVERSE_THRUST; }

 wishvel_x *= a_side;
 wishvel_y *= a_side;
 wishvel_z *= a_up;
 wishvel_z += a_add;

 if((this).stat_JETPACK_REVERSE_THRUST && ((this._cs).button5)) { wishvel_z *= -1; }

 float best = 0;
# 748 "./common/physics/player.qc"
 float a_diff = a_side * a_side - a_up * a_up;
 float f;
 if (a_diff != 0)
 {
  f = a_add * a_up / a_diff;
  if (f > -1 && f < 1)
  {
   best = (a_diff + a_add * a_add) * (a_diff + a_up * a_up) / a_diff;

  }
 }

 f = (a_up + a_add) * (a_up + a_add);
 if (f > best)
 {
  best = f;

 }

 f = (a_up - a_add) * (a_up - a_add);
 if (f > best)
 {
  best = f;

 }
 best = sqrt(best);




 float fxy, fz;
 fxy = bound(0, 1 - (this.velocity * normalize(wishvel_x * '1 0 0' + wishvel_y * '0 1 0')) / (this).stat_JETPACK_MAXSPEED_SIDE, 1);
 if (wishvel_z - cvar("sv_gravity") > 0)
  fz = bound(0, 1 - this.velocity_z / (this).stat_JETPACK_MAXSPEED_UP, 1);
 else
  fz = bound(0, 1 + this.velocity_z / (this).stat_JETPACK_MAXSPEED_UP, 1);

 float fvel;
 fvel = vlen(wishvel);
 wishvel_x *= fxy;
 wishvel_y *= fxy;
 wishvel_z = (wishvel_z - cvar("sv_gravity")) * fz + cvar("sv_gravity");

 fvel = min(1, vlen(wishvel) / best);
 if ((this).stat_JETPACK_FUEL && !(((this).items) & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO))
  f = min(1, (this).stat_FUEL / ((this).stat_JETPACK_FUEL * dt * fvel));
 else
  f = 1;



 if (f > 0 && wishvel != '0 0 0')
 {
  this.velocity = this.velocity + wishvel * f * dt;
  ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);


  if (!(((this).items) & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO))
   TakeResource(this, RES_FUEL, (this).stat_JETPACK_FUEL * dt * fvel * f);

  ((this).items) |= IT_USING_JETPACK;


  this.pauseregen_finished = max(this.pauseregen_finished, time + autocvar_g_balance_pause_fuel_regen);

 }
}

.vector moveto;





vector movelib_dragvec(entity this, float drag, float exp_)
{
    float lspeed,ldrag;

    lspeed = vlen(this.velocity);
    ldrag = lspeed * drag;
    ldrag = ldrag * (drag * exp_);
    ldrag = 1 - (ldrag / lspeed);

    return this.velocity * ldrag;
}





float movelib_dragflt(float fspeed,float drag,float exp_)
{
    float ldrag;

    ldrag = fspeed * drag;
    ldrag = ldrag * ldrag * exp_;
    ldrag = 1 - (ldrag / fspeed);

    return ldrag;
}






vector movelib_inertmove_byspeed(entity this, vector vel_new, float vel_max,float newmin,float oldmax)
{
    float influense;

    influense = vlen(this.velocity) * (1 / vel_max);

    influense = bound(newmin,influense,oldmax);

    return (vel_new * (1 - influense)) + (this.velocity * influense);
}

vector movelib_inertmove(entity this, vector new_vel,float new_bias)
{
    return new_vel * new_bias + this.velocity * (1-new_bias);
}

void movelib_move(entity this, vector force,float max_velocity,float drag,float theMass,float breakforce)
{
    float deltatime;
    float acceleration;
    float mspeed;
    vector breakvec;

    deltatime = time - this.movelib_lastupdate;
    if (deltatime > 0.15) deltatime = 0;
    this.movelib_lastupdate = time;
    if (!deltatime) return;

    mspeed = vlen(this.velocity);

    if (theMass)
        acceleration = vlen(force) / theMass;
    else
        acceleration = vlen(force);

    if ((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
    {
        if (breakforce)
        {
            breakvec = (normalize(this.velocity) * (breakforce / theMass) * deltatime);
            this.velocity = this.velocity - breakvec;
        }

        this.velocity = this.velocity + force * (acceleration * deltatime);
    }

    if (drag)
        this.velocity = movelib_dragvec(this, drag, 1);

    if (this.waterlevel > 1)
    {
        this.velocity = this.velocity + force * (acceleration * deltatime);
        this.velocity = this.velocity + '0 0 0.05' * cvar("sv_gravity") * deltatime;
    }
    else
        this.velocity = this.velocity + '0 0 -1' * cvar("sv_gravity") * deltatime;

    mspeed = vlen(this.velocity);

    if (max_velocity)
        if (mspeed > max_velocity)
            this.velocity = normalize(this.velocity) * (mspeed - 50);
}

void movelib_brake_simple(entity this, float force)
{
    float mspeed;
    vector mdir;
    float vz;

    mspeed = max(0,vlen(this.velocity) - force);
    mdir = normalize(this.velocity);
    vz = this.velocity.z;
    this.velocity = mdir * mspeed;
    this.velocity_z = vz;
}







void movelib_groundalign4point(entity this, float spring_length, float spring_up, float blendrate, float _max)
{
    vector a, b, c, d, e, r, push_angle, ahead, side;

    push_angle.y = 0;
    r = (this.absmax + this.absmin) * 0.5 + (v_up * spring_up);
    e = v_up * spring_length;


    ahead = v_forward * (this.maxs.x * 0.8);
    side = v_right * (this.maxs.y * 0.8);

    a = r + ahead + side;
    b = r + ahead - side;
    c = r - ahead + side;
    d = r - ahead - side;

    traceline(a, a - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    a.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r = trace_endpos;

    traceline(b, b - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    b.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r += trace_endpos;

    traceline(c, c - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    c.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r += trace_endpos;

    traceline(d, d - e,MOVE_NORMAL,this);
    d.z = (1 - trace_fraction);
    r += trace_endpos;

    a.x = r.z;
    r = this.origin;
    r.z = r.z;

    push_angle.x = (a.z - c.z) * _max;
    push_angle.x += (b.z - d.z) * _max;

    push_angle.z = (b.z - a.z) * _max;
    push_angle.z += (d.z - c.z) * _max;




    this.angles_x = ((1-blendrate) * this.angles.x) + (push_angle.x * blendrate);
    this.angles_z = ((1-blendrate) * this.angles.z) + (push_angle.z * blendrate);


    setorigin(this, r);
}

     this.move_suspendedinair = true;
    this.velocity = '0 0 0';
    this.avelocity = '0 0 0';
    movetime = 0;

 if (!(clip & 1))

  if(check.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_PHYSICS)
  {
   check.origin = check.origin + move;
   _Movetype_LinkEdict(check, true);
   continue;
  }


  float savesolid = this.solid;
  this.solid = SOLID_NOT;
  if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(check, move, true))
  {

   check.angles_y += trace_fraction * moveangle.y;
   this.solid = savesolid;
   continue;
  }

  check.angles_y += trace_fraction * moveangle.y;
  this.solid = savesolid;




  if(check.move_movetype != MOVETYPE_WALK && (trace_fraction < 1 || check.groundentity != this))
   ((check).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);


  tracebox(check.origin, check.mins, check.maxs, check.origin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, check);
  if(trace_startsolid)
  {
   if(_Movetype_NudgeOutOfSolid_PivotIsKnownGood(check, pivot))
   {

    _Movetype_PushEntity(check, '0 0 0', true);

    continue;
   }




   if(check.mins_x == check.maxs_x)
    continue;
   if(check.solid == SOLID_NOT || check.solid == SOLID_TRIGGER)
   {

    check.mins_x = check.mins_y = 0;
    check.maxs = check.mins;
    continue;
   }

   this.origin = pushorig;
   this.angles = pushang;
   this.ltime = pushltime;
   _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, false);


   if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_pushmove_moved; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_pushmove_moved.il_loop_item; g_pushmove_moved.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_pushmove_moved.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (true) { { { check.origin = check.moved_from; check.angles = check.moved_fromangles; _Movetype_LinkEdict(check, false); }; } } if (g_pushmove_moved.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_pushmove_moved.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_pushmove_moved.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()




     ;


   if((0, (this).selfblocked))
    (0, (this).selfblocked)(this, check);
   break;
  }
 }
 this.angles_x -= 360.0 * floor(this.angles_x * (1.0 / 360.0));
 this.angles_y -= 360.0 * floor(this.angles_y * (1.0 / 360.0));
 this.angles_z -= 360.0 * floor(this.angles_z * (1.0 / 360.0));

}

void _Movetype_Physics_Push(entity this, float dt)
{
 float oldltime = this.ltime;
 float movetime = dt;
 if(this.nextthink < this.ltime + dt)
 {
  movetime = this.nextthink - this.ltime;
  if(movetime < 0)
   movetime = 0;
 }

 if(movetime)
 {

  _Movetype_PushMove(this, movetime);
 }

 if(this.nextthink > oldltime && this.nextthink <= this.ltime)
 {
  this.nextthink = 0;
  (0, (this).selfthink)(this);
 }
}

void set_movetype(entity this, float mt)
{
 this.move_movetype = mt;

  IL_PUSH(g_moveables, this);

float _Movetype_NudgeOutOfSolid_PivotIsKnownGood(entity this, vector pivot)
{
 vector stuckorigin = this.origin;
 vector goodmins = pivot, goodmaxs = pivot;
 for(float bump = 0; bump < 6; bump++)
 {
  float coord = 2 - (bump >> 1);
  float dir = (bump & 1);

  for(float subbump = 0; ; ++subbump)
  {
   vector testorigin = stuckorigin;
   if(dir)
   {

    switch(coord)
    {
     case 0: testorigin.x += this.maxs_x - goodmaxs.x; break;
     case 1: testorigin.y += this.maxs_y - goodmaxs.y; break;
     case 2: testorigin.z += this.maxs_z - goodmaxs.z; break;
    }
   }
   else
   {

    switch(coord)
    {
     case 0: testorigin.x += this.mins_x - goodmins.x; break;
     case 1: testorigin.y += this.mins_y - goodmins.y; break;
     case 2: testorigin.z += this.mins_z - goodmins.z; break;
    }
   }

   tracebox(stuckorigin, goodmins, goodmaxs, testorigin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
   if(trace_startsolid && trace_ent.solid == SOLID_BSP)
   {

    return false;
   }

   if(trace_fraction >= 1)
    break;

   if(subbump >= 10)
   {

    return false;
   }


   vector move = trace_endpos - testorigin;
   float nudge = (trace_plane_normal * move) + 0.03125;
   stuckorigin = stuckorigin + nudge * trace_plane_normal;
  }

  if(dir)
  {

   switch(coord)
   {
    case 0: goodmaxs.x = this.maxs_x; break;
    case 1: goodmaxs.y = this.maxs_y; break;
    case 2: goodmaxs.z = this.maxs_z; break;
   }
  }
  else
  {

   switch(coord)
   {
    case 0: goodmins.x = this.mins_x; break;
    case 1: goodmins.y = this.mins_y; break;
    case 2: goodmins.z = this.mins_z; break;
   }
  }
 }


 this.origin = stuckorigin;

 return true;
}
