vector planes[MAX_CLIP_PLANES];
float _Movetype_FlyMove(entity this, float dt, float applygravity, float applystepnormal, float stepheight)
{
 move_stepnormal = '0 0 0';

 if(dt <= 0)
  return 0;

 float blockedflag = 0;
 float numplanes = 0;
 float time_left = dt, grav = 0;
 vector push;
 vector primal_velocity, original_velocity;
 vector restore_velocity = this.velocity;

 for(float j = 0; j < MAX_CLIP_PLANES; ++j)
  planes[j] = '0 0 0';

 if(applygravity)
 {
  this.move_didgravity = 1;
  grav = dt * (this.gravity ? this.gravity : 1) * cvar("sv_gravity");

  if(!autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_nogravityonground || !(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
  {
   if(autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_gravityunaffectedbyticrate)
    this.velocity_z -= grav * 0.5;
   else
    this.velocity_z -= grav;
  }
 }

 original_velocity = primal_velocity = this.velocity;

 for(float bumpcount = 0;bumpcount < MAX_CLIP_PLANES;bumpcount++)
 {
  if(this.velocity == '0 0 0')
   break;

  push = this.velocity * time_left;
  if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, push, false))
  {


   blockedflag |= 8;
   break;
  }



  if(trace_startsolid && trace_allsolid)
  {
   this.velocity = restore_velocity;
   return 3;
  }

  if(trace_fraction == 1)
   break;

  time_left *= 1 - trace_fraction;

  float my_trace_fraction = trace_fraction;
  vector my_trace_plane_normal = trace_plane_normal;

  if(trace_plane_normal.z)
  {
   if(trace_plane_normal.z > 0.7)
   {

    blockedflag |= 1;

    if(!trace_ent)
    {

     trace_ent = (0, world);
    }

    ((this).flags |= FL_ONGROUND);
    this.groundentity = trace_ent;
   }
  }
  else if(stepheight)
  {

   vector org = this.origin;
   vector steppush = (_vec3.x = (0), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (stepheight), _vec3);
   push = this.velocity * time_left;

   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, steppush, false))
   {
    blockedflag |= 8;
    break;
   }
   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, push, false))
   {
    blockedflag |= 8;
    break;
   }
   float trace2_fraction = trace_fraction;
   steppush = (_vec3.x = (0), _vec3.y = (0), _vec3.z = (org.z - this.origin_z), _vec3);
   if(!_Movetype_PushEntity(this, steppush, false))
   {
    blockedflag |= 8;
    break;
   }



   if(this.origin_x - org.x || this.origin_y - org.y)
   {
    trace_endpos = this.origin;
    time_left *= 1 - trace2_fraction;
    numplanes = 0;
    continue;
   }
   else
    this.origin = org;
  }
  else
  {

   blockedflag |= 2;

   if(applystepnormal)
    move_stepnormal = trace_plane_normal;
  }

  if(my_trace_fraction >= 0.001)
  {

   original_velocity = this.velocity;
   numplanes = 0;
  }


  if(numplanes >= MAX_CLIP_PLANES)
  {

   this.velocity = '0 0 0';
   blockedflag = 3;
   break;
  }

  planes[numplanes] = my_trace_plane_normal;
  numplanes++;


  vector new_velocity = '0 0 0';
  float plane;
  for (plane = 0;plane < numplanes;plane++)
  {
   float newplane;
   new_velocity = _Movetype_ClipVelocity(original_velocity, planes[plane], 1);
   for (newplane = 0;newplane < numplanes;newplane++)
   {
    if(newplane != plane)
    {

     if((new_velocity * planes[newplane]) < 0)
      break;
    }
   }
   if(newplane == numplanes)
    break;
  }

  if(plane != numplanes)
  {

   this.velocity = new_velocity;
  }
  else
  {

   if(numplanes != 2)
   {
    this.velocity = '0 0 0';
    blockedflag = 7;
    break;
   }
   vector dir = ((planes[0]) >< (planes[1]));

   dir = normalize(dir);
   float d = (dir * this.velocity);
   this.velocity = dir * d;
  }



  if((this.velocity * primal_velocity) <= 0)
  {
   this.velocity = '0 0 0';
   break;
  }
 }


 if((0, (STATS).stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_EASIERWATERJUMP) && (this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP) && !(blockedflag & 8))
  this.velocity = primal_velocity;

 if((0, (STATS).stat_MOVEVARS_WALLCLIP) && this.pm_time && !(this.flags & FL_WATERJUMP) && !(blockedflag & 8))
  this.velocity = primal_velocity;

 if(applygravity)
 {
  if(!autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_nogravityonground || !(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
  {
   if(autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_gravityunaffectedbyticrate)
    this.velocity_z -= grav * 0.5f;
  }
 }

 return blockedflag;
}

float _Movetype_CheckWater(entity this)
{
 vector point = this.origin;
 point.z += this.mins.z + 1;

 float nativecontents = pointcontents(point);
 if(this.watertype && this.watertype != nativecontents)
 {

  if(this.contentstransition)
   this.contentstransition(this.watertype, nativecontents);
 }

 this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_NONE;
 this.watertype = CONTENT_EMPTY;

 float supercontents = Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(nativecontents);
 if(supercontents & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
 {
  this.watertype = nativecontents;
  this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_WETFEET;
  point.z = this.origin.z + (this.mins.z + this.maxs.z) * 0.5;
  if(Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(pointcontents(point)) & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
  {
   this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING;
   point.z = this.origin.z + this.view_ofs.z;
   if(Mod_Q1BSP_SuperContentsFromNativeContents(pointcontents(point)) & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
    this.waterlevel = WATERLEVEL_SUBMERGED;
  }
 }

 return this.waterlevel > 1;
}

void _Movetype_CheckWaterTransition(entity ent)
{
 float contents = pointcontents(ent.origin);

 if(!ent.watertype)
 {

  if(!(0, (STATS).stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_WATERTRANSITION))
  {
   ent.watertype = contents;
   ent.waterlevel = 1;
   return;
  }
 }
 else if(ent.watertype != contents)
 {

  if(ent.contentstransition)
   ent.contentstransition(ent.watertype, contents);
 }

 if(contents <= CONTENT_WATER)
 {
  ent.watertype = contents;
  ent.waterlevel = 1;
 }
 else
 {
  ent.watertype = CONTENT_EMPTY;
  ent.waterlevel = ((0, (STATS).stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_WATERTRANSITION) ? 0 : contents);
 }
}

float autocvar__movetype_debug = false;
void _Movetype_LinkEdict(entity this, float touch_triggers)
{
 if(autocvar__movetype_debug)
 {
  vector mi, ma;
  if(this.solid == SOLID_BSP)
  {

   mi = this.mins;
   ma = this.maxs;
  }
  else
  {
   mi = this.mins;
   ma = this.maxs;
  }
  mi += this.origin;
  ma += this.origin;

  if(this.flags & FL_ITEM)
  {
   mi -= '15 15 1';
   ma += '15 15 1';
  }
  else
  {
   mi -= '1 1 1';
   ma += '1 1 1';
  }

  this.absmin = mi;
  this.absmax = ma;
 }
 else
 {
  setorigin(this, this.origin);





 }

 if(touch_triggers)
  _Movetype_LinkEdict_TouchAreaGrid(this);
}

float _Movetype_ContentsMask(entity this)
{
 if(this)
 {
  if(this.dphitcontentsmask)
   return this.dphitcontentsmask;
  else if(this.solid == SOLID_SLIDEBOX)
  {
   if(this.flags & FL_MONSTER)
    return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_MONSTERCLIP;
   else
    return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP;
  }
  else if(this.solid == SOLID_CORPSE)
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY;
  else if(this.solid == SOLID_TRIGGER)
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY;
  else
   return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;
 }
 else
  return DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;
}

entity _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_ent;
float _Movetype_TestEntityPosition(vector ofs)
{
    entity this = _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_ent;
 vector org = this.origin + ofs;



 tracebox(org, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin, ((this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY) ? MOVE_WORLDONLY : MOVE_NOMONSTERS), this);

 if(trace_dpstartcontents & _Movetype_ContentsMask(this))
  return true;

 if((_vlen2 = (trace_endpos - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) >= 0.0001)
 {
  tracebox(trace_endpos, this.mins, this.maxs, trace_endpos, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
  if(!trace_startsolid)
   this.origin = trace_endpos;
 }
 return false;
}

    for(float j = 2; j <= offset; ++j)
    {
     if(!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('0 0 -1' * j))

     if(!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition('0 0 1' * j))
      return false;
    }

 return true;
}

float _Movetype_UnstickEntity(entity this)
{
    _Movetype_TestEntityPosition_ent = this;
 if (!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(' 0  0  0')) {
     return UNSTICK_FINE;

        {
            if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/physics/movetypes/movetypes.qc", "640")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", sprintf("Can't unstick an entity (edict: %d, classname: %s, origin: %s)", num_for_edict(this), this.classname, vtos(this.origin)), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc()

            return UNSTICK_STUCK;

                                                ;

void _Movetype_CheckStuck(entity this)
{
 float unstick = _Movetype_UnstickEntity(this);
 switch(unstick)
 {
  case UNSTICK_FINE:
   this.oldorigin = this.origin;
   break;
  case UNSTICK_FIXED:
   break;
  case UNSTICK_STUCK:
   vector offset = this.oldorigin - this.origin;
   if(!_Movetype_TestEntityPosition(offset))
    _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, false);

   break;
 }
}

vector _Movetype_ClipVelocity(vector vel, vector norm, float f)
{
 vel -= ((vel * norm) * norm) * f;

 if(vel.x > -0.1 && vel.x < 0.1) vel.x = 0;
 if(vel.y > -0.1 && vel.y < 0.1) vel.y = 0;
 if(vel.z > -0.1 && vel.z < 0.1) vel.z = 0;

 return vel;
}

void _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(entity this, vector push)
{
 vector end = this.origin + push;
 float type;
 if(this.move_nomonsters)
  type = max(0, this.move_nomonsters);
 else if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE)
  type = MOVE_MISSILE;
 else if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY)
  type = MOVE_WORLDONLY;
 else if(this.solid == SOLID_TRIGGER || this.solid == SOLID_NOT)
  type = MOVE_NOMONSTERS;
 else
  type = MOVE_NORMAL;

 tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, end, type, this);
}

float _Movetype_PushEntity(entity this, vector push, float dolink)
{
 _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(this, push);


 if(trace_startsolid)
 {
  float oldtype = this.move_nomonsters;
  this.move_nomonsters = MOVE_WORLDONLY;
  _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(this, push);
  this.move_nomonsters = oldtype;
  if(trace_startsolid)
   return true;
 }

 this.origin = trace_endpos;

 vector last_origin = this.origin;

 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, dolink);

 if((this.solid >= SOLID_TRIGGER && trace_fraction < 1 && (!(((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) || this.groundentity != trace_ent)))
  _Movetype_Impact(this, trace_ent);

 return (this.origin == last_origin);
}

void _Movetype_Physics_Frame(entity this, float movedt)
{
 this.move_didgravity = -1;
 switch (this.move_movetype)
 {
  case MOVETYPE_PUSH:
  case MOVETYPE_FAKEPUSH:
   _Movetype_Physics_Push(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NONE:
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_FOLLOW:
   _Movetype_Physics_Follow(this);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NOCLIP:
   _Movetype_CheckWater(this);
   this.origin = this.origin + movedt * this.velocity;
   this.angles = this.angles + movedt * this.avelocity;
   _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, false);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_STEP:
   _Movetype_Physics_Step(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_WALK:
   _Movetype_Physics_Walk(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_TOSS:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCE:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCEMISSILE:
  case MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY:
   _Movetype_Physics_Toss(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_PHYSICS:
   break;
 }
}

void _Movetype_Physics_ClientFrame(entity this, float movedt)
{
 this.move_didgravity = -1;
 switch (this.move_movetype)
 {
  case MOVETYPE_PUSH:
  case MOVETYPE_FAKEPUSH:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/physics/movetypes/movetypes.qc", "772")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Physics: Lacking QuakeC support for Push movetype, FIX ME by using engine physics!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NONE:
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_FOLLOW:
   _Movetype_Physics_Follow(this);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_NOCLIP:
   _Movetype_CheckWater(this);
   this.origin = this.origin + movedt * this.velocity;
   this.angles = this.angles + movedt * this.avelocity;
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_STEP:
   _Movetype_Physics_Step(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_WALK:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY:
  case MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY:
   _Movetype_Physics_Walk(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_TOSS:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCE:
  case MOVETYPE_BOUNCEMISSILE:
  case MOVETYPE_FLYMISSILE:
   if ((0, (STATS).stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_UNSTICKPLAYERS) == 2)
    _Movetype_CheckStuck(this);
   _Movetype_Physics_Toss(this, movedt);
   break;
  case MOVETYPE_PHYSICS:
   break;
 }



 _Movetype_LinkEdict(this, true);


}

void Movetype_Physics_NoMatchTicrate(entity this, float movedt, float isclient)
{
 float didmove = (this.move_time != 0);
 this.move_time = time;

 if(isclient)
  _Movetype_Physics_ClientFrame(this, movedt);
 else
 {







  if(!didmove && (0, (STATS).stat_GAMEPLAYFIX_DELAYPROJECTILES) > 0)
   return;
  _Movetype_Physics_Frame(this, movedt);
 }
 if(wasfreed(this))
  return;

 setorigin(this, this.origin);
}

void Movetype_Physics_NoMatchServer(entity this)
{
 float movedt = time - this.move_time;
 this.move_time = time;

 _Movetype_Physics_Frame(this, movedt);
 if(wasfreed(this))
  return;

 setorigin(this, this.origin);
}

void Movetype_Physics_MatchServer(entity this, float sloppy)
{
 Movetype_Physics_MatchTicrate(this, sys_frametime, sloppy);
}


.vector tic_origin;
.vector tic_velocity;
.float tic_flags;
.vector tic_avelocity;
.vector tic_angles;


.vector tic_saved_origin;
.vector tic_saved_velocity;

.vector tic_saved_avelocity;
.vector tic_saved_angles;
void Movetype_Physics_MatchTicrate(entity this, float tr, float sloppy)
{






 if(this.(origin) != this.tic_saved_origin) this.tic_origin = this.(origin);
 if(this.(velocity) != this.tic_saved_velocity) this.tic_velocity = this.(velocity);
 if(this.(flags) != this.tic_saved_flags) this.tic_flags = this.(flags);
 if(this.(avelocity) != this.tic_saved_avelocity) this.tic_avelocity = this.(avelocity);
 if(this.(angles) != this.tic_saved_angles) this.tic_angles = this.(angles);


 this.flags = this.tic_flags;
 this.velocity = this.tic_velocity;
 setorigin(this, this.tic_origin);
 this.avelocity = this.tic_avelocity;
 this.angles = this.tic_angles;

 if(tr <= 0)
 {
  Movetype_Physics_NoMatchServer(this);

  this.tic_saved_flags = this.tic_flags = this.flags;
  this.tic_saved_velocity = this.tic_velocity = this.velocity;
  this.tic_saved_origin = this.tic_origin = this.origin;
  this.tic_saved_avelocity = this.tic_avelocity = this.avelocity;
  this.tic_saved_angles = this.tic_angles = this.angles;
  return;
 }

 float dt = time - this.move_time;

 float n = bound(0, floor(dt / tr), 32);
 dt -= n * tr;
 this.move_time += n * tr;

 if(!this.move_didgravity)
  this.move_didgravity = ((this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE || this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_TOSS) && !(this.tic_flags & FL_ONGROUND));

 for (float j = 0; j < n; ++j)
 {
  _Movetype_Physics_Frame(this, tr);
  if(wasfreed(this))
   return;
 }


 this.tic_origin = this.origin;
 this.tic_velocity = this.velocity;
 this.tic_avelocity = this.avelocity;
 this.tic_angles = this.angles;
 this.tic_flags = this.flags;


 this.flags = this.tic_saved_flags;
 this.velocity = this.tic_saved_velocity;
 setorigin(this, this.tic_saved_origin);

 this.angles = this.tic_saved_angles;

 this.avelocity = this.tic_avelocity;

 if(dt > 0 && this.move_movetype != MOVETYPE_NONE && !(this.tic_flags & FL_ONGROUND))
 {

  this.velocity = this.tic_velocity;

  if(this.move_didgravity > 0)
  {
   this.velocity_z -= (autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_gravityunaffectedbyticrate ? 0.5 : 1)
       * dt
       * ((this.gravity) ? this.gravity : 1)
       * cvar("sv_gravity");
  }

  this.angles = this.tic_angles + dt * this.avelocity;

  if(sloppy || this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_NOCLIP)
  {
   setorigin(this, this.tic_origin + dt * this.velocity);
  }
  else
  {
   setorigin(this, this.tic_origin);
   _Movetype_PushEntityTrace(this, dt * this.velocity);
   if(!trace_startsolid)
    setorigin(this, trace_endpos);
   else
    setorigin(this, this.tic_saved_origin);
  }

  if(this.move_didgravity > 0 && autocvar_sv_gameplayfix_gravityunaffectedbyticrate)
   this.velocity_z -= 0.5 * dt * ((this.gravity) ? this.gravity : 1) * cvar("sv_gravity");
 }
 else
 {
  this.velocity = this.tic_velocity;
  this.angles = this.tic_angles;
  setorigin(this, this.tic_origin);
 }

 this.flags = this.tic_flags;

 this.tic_saved_flags = this.flags;
 this.tic_saved_velocity = this.velocity;
 this.tic_saved_origin = this.origin;
 this.tic_saved_avelocity = this.avelocity;
 this.tic_saved_angles = this.angles;
}

void g_model_setcolormaptoactivator(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 if(teamplay)
 {
  if(actor.team)
   this.colormap = (actor.team - 1) * 0x11;
  else
   this.colormap = 0x00;
 }
 else
  this.colormap = floor(random() * 256);
 this.colormap |= (1 << (10));
}

void g_clientmodel_setcolormaptoactivator(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{
 g_model_setcolormaptoactivator(this, actor, trigger);
 this.SendFlags |= ((1 << (3)) | (1 << (0)));
}

void g_clientmodel_use(entity this, entity actor, entity trigger)
{


 if(this.classname == "func_clientwall" || this.classname == "func_clientillusionary")
  this.antiwall_flag = trigger.antiwall_flag;

 if (this.antiwall_flag == 1)
 {
  this.inactive = 1;
  if (this.solid != SOLID_NOT)
  {
   this.solid = SOLID_NOT;
   setorigin(this, this.origin);
  }
 }
 else if (this.antiwall_flag == 2)
 {
  this.inactive = 0;
  if (this.solid != this.default_solid)
  {
   this.solid = this.default_solid;
   setorigin(this, this.origin);
  }
 }
 g_clientmodel_setcolormaptoactivator(this, actor, trigger);
}

void g_model_dropbyspawnflags(entity this)
{
 if((this.spawnflags & 3) == 1)
 {
  traceline(this.origin, this.origin - '0 0 4096', MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
  setorigin(this, trace_endpos);
 }
 else if((this.spawnflags & 3) == 2)
 {
  tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin - '0 0 4096', MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
  setorigin(this, trace_endpos);
 }
 else if((this.spawnflags & 3) == 3)
 {
  traceline(this.origin, this.origin - '0 0 4096', MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
  setorigin(this, trace_endpos - '0 0 1' * this.mins.z);
 }
}

void g_clientmodel_think(entity this)
{
 this.nextthink = time;
 if(this.oldorigin != this.origin)
  this.SendFlags |= (1 << (1));
 this.oldorigin = this.origin;
}

void g_clientmodel_dropbyspawnflags(entity this)
{
 vector o0;
 o0 = this.origin;
 g_model_dropbyspawnflags(this);
 if(this.origin != o0)
  this.SendFlags |= (1 << (1));
}

float g_clientmodel_genericsendentity(entity this, entity to, float sf)
{
 sf = sf & 0x0F;
 if(this.angles != '0 0 0')
  sf |= 0x10;
 if(this.mins != '0 0 0' || this.maxs != '0 0 0')
  sf |= 0x20;
 if(this.colormap != 0)
  sf |= 0x40;
 if(this.lodmodelindex1)
  sf |= 0x80;

 if(1){ if (NET_ENT_CLIENT_WALL_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, NET_ENT_CLIENT_WALL.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, sf);

 if(sf & (1 << (0)))
 {
  if(sf & 0x40)
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.colormap);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.skin);
 }

 if(sf & (1 << (1)))
 {
  if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.z); }else voidfunc();
 }

 if(sf & (1 << (2)))
 {
  if(sf & 0x10)
   if(1){ WriteAngle(MSG_ENTITY, this.angles.x); WriteAngle(MSG_ENTITY, this.angles.y); WriteAngle(MSG_ENTITY, this.angles.z); }else voidfunc();
 }

 if(sf & (1 << (3)))
 {
  if(sf & 0x80)
  {
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.lodmodelindex0);
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.loddistance1, 32767));
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.lodmodelindex1);
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.loddistance2, 32767));
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.lodmodelindex2);
  }
  else
   WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.modelindex);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.solid);
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.scale * 256));
  if(sf & 0x20)
  {
   if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.mins.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.mins.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.mins.z); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.maxs.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.maxs.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.maxs.z); }else voidfunc();
  }
  WriteString(MSG_ENTITY, this.bgmscript);
  if(this.bgmscript != "")
  {
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.bgmscriptattack * 64));
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.bgmscriptdecay * 64));
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.bgmscriptsustain * 255));
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.bgmscriptrelease * 64));
   if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.movedir.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.movedir.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.movedir.z); }else voidfunc();
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.lip * 255));
  }
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.fade_start, 32767));
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.fade_end, 32767));
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.alpha_max * 256));
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, floor(this.alpha_min * 256));
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.inactive);
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.fade_vertical_offset);
 }

 return true;
}

void g_model_init(entity ent, float sol)
{
 if(ent.geomtype && autocvar_physics_ode && checkextension("DP_PHYSICS_ODE")) set_movetype(ent, MOVETYPE_PHYSICS);
 if(!ent.scale) ent.scale = ent.modelscale;

 else if(ent.solid < 0) ent.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 SetBrushEntityModel(ent,true);

 ent.use1 = g_model_setcolormaptoactivator;
 InitializeEntity(ent, g_model_dropbyspawnflags, INITPRIO_DROPTOFLOOR);
}

 else if(ent.bgmscriptsustain < 0) ent.bgmscriptsustain = 0;
 Net_LinkEntity(ent, true, 0, g_clientmodel_genericsendentity);
 ent.default_solid = sol;
}

float isPushable(entity e)
{

  return true;

  return false;

  return true;

  return true;

  case "body":
   return true;
  case "bullet":
   return false;
 }
 if (e.projectiledeathtype)
  return true;







 return false;
}

float item_keys_usekey(entity l, entity p)
{

  return false;
 } else if (l.itemkeys == valid) {

  return true;

string item_keys_keylist(float keylist) {

 if (!keylist)
  return "";


 if ((keylist & (keylist-1)) == 0)
  return strcat("the ", item_keys_names[lowestbit(keylist)]);

 while (keylist) {
  float l = lowestbit(keylist);
  if (n)
   n = strcat(n, ", the ", item_keys_names[base + l]);
  else
   n = strcat("the ", item_keys_names[base + l]);

  keylist = bitshift(keylist, -(l + 1));
  base+= l + 1;
 }

 return n;
}

{

 {
  if(this.spawnflags & LASER_FINITE)
  {
   if(this.enemy.origin != this.mangle)

    this.mangle = this.enemy.origin;
    this.SendFlags |= SF_LASER_UPDATE_TARGET;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   a = vectoangles(this.enemy.origin - this.origin);
   a_x = -a_x;
   if(a != this.mangle)
   {
    this.mangle = a;
    this.SendFlags |= SF_LASER_UPDATE_TARGET;
   }
  }
 }
 else

  if(this.angles != this.mangle)

   this.mangle = this.angles;

  }

vector trigger_push_calculatevelocity(vector org, entity tgt, float ht, entity pushed_entity)
{
 float grav, sdist, zdist, vs, vz, jumpheight;
 vector sdir, torg;

 torg = tgt.origin + (tgt.mins + tgt.maxs) * 0.5;

 grav = cvar("sv_gravity");
 if(pushed_entity && pushed_entity.gravity)
  grav *= pushed_entity.gravity;






 if (q3compat)
  grav /= 750/800;

 zdist = torg.z - org.z;
 sdist = vlen(torg - org - zdist * '0 0 1');
 sdir = normalize(torg - org - zdist * '0 0 1');


 jumpheight = fabs(ht);
 if(zdist > 0)
  jumpheight = jumpheight + zdist;
# 81 "./common/mapobjects/trigger/jumppads.qc"
 vz = sqrt(fabs(2 * grav * jumpheight));


 if(ht < 0)
  if(zdist < 0)
   vz = -vz;

 vector solution;
 solution = solve_quadratic(0.5 * grav, -vz, zdist);

 if(!solution.z)
  solution_y = solution.x;
 if(zdist == 0)
  solution_x = solution.y;

 float flighttime;
 if(zdist < 0)
 {

  if(ht < 0)
  {



   flighttime = solution.y;
  }
  else
  {



   flighttime = solution.y;
  }
 }
 else
 {

  if(ht < 0)
  {



   flighttime = solution.x;
  }
  else
  {



   flighttime = solution.y;
  }
 }
 vs = sdist / flighttime;


 return sdir * vs + '0 0 1' * vz;
}

float magicear_matched;
string trigger_magicear_processmessage(entity ear, entity source, float teamsay, entity privatesay, string msgin)
{
 float domatch, dotrigger, matchstart, l;
 string s, msg;
 string savemessage;

 magicear_matched = false;

 dotrigger = ((((source).classname == STR_PLAYER)) && (!((source).deadflag != DEAD_NO)) && ((ear.radius == 0) || (((_vlen2 = (source.origin - ear.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((ear.radius) ** 2)))));
 domatch = ((ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_REPLACE_OUTSIDE) || dotrigger);

 if (!domatch)
  return msgin;

 if (!msgin)
 {

  if (!(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_TUBA))
   return msgin;

  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   if(!W_Tuba_HasPlayed(source, weaponentity, ear.message, ear.movedir_x, !(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_TUBA_EXACTPITCH), ear.movedir_y, ear.movedir_z))
    return msgin;
  }

  magicear_matched = true;

  if(dotrigger)
  {
   savemessage = ear.message;
   ear.message = nil;
   SUB_UseTargets(ear, source, (0, world));
   ear.message = savemessage;
  }

  if(ear.netname != "")
   return ear.netname;

  return msgin;
 }

 if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_TUBA)
  return msgin;

 if(privatesay)
 {
  if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_IGNORE_TELL)
   return msgin;
 }
 else
 {
  if(!teamsay)
   if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_IGNORE_SAY)
    return msgin;
  if(teamsay > 0)
   if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_IGNORE_TEAMSAY)
    return msgin;
  if(teamsay < 0)
   if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_IGNORE_INVALIDTELL)
    return msgin;
 }

 matchstart = -1;
 l = _strlen(ear.message);

 if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_NODECOLORIZE)
  msg = msgin;
 else
  msg = strdecolorize(msgin);

 if(substring(ear.message, 0, 1) == "*")
 {
  if(substring(ear.message, -1, 1) == "*")
  {


   s = substring(ear.message, 1, -2);
   l -= 2;
   if(_strstrofs(msg, s, 0) >= 0)
    matchstart = -2;
  }
  else
  {

   s = substring(ear.message, 1, -1);
   l -= 1;
   if(substring(msg, -l, l) == s)
    matchstart = _strlen(msg) - l;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  if(substring(ear.message, -1, 1) == "*")
  {

   s = substring(ear.message, 0, -2);
   l -= 1;
   if(substring(msg, 0, l) == s)
    matchstart = 0;
  }
  else
  {

   s = ear.message;
   if(msg == ear.message)
    matchstart = 0;
  }
 }

 if(matchstart == -1)
  return msgin;

 magicear_matched = true;

 if(dotrigger)
 {
  savemessage = ear.message;
  ear.message = nil;
  SUB_UseTargets(ear, source, (0, world));
  ear.message = savemessage;
 }

 if(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_REPLACE_WHOLE_MESSAGE)
 {
  return ear.netname;
 }
 else if(ear.netname != "")
 {
  if(matchstart < 0)
   return strreplace(s, ear.netname, msg);
  else
   return strcat(
    substring(msg, 0, matchstart),
    ear.netname,
    substring(msg, matchstart + l, -1)
   );
 }
 else
  return msgin;
}

entity magicears;
string trigger_magicear_processmessage_forallears(entity source, float teamsay, entity privatesay, string msgin)
{
 entity ear;
 string msgout;
 for(ear = magicears; ear; ear = ear.enemy)
 {
  msgout = trigger_magicear_processmessage(ear, source, teamsay, privatesay, msgin);
  if(!(ear.spawnflags & MAGICEAR_CONTINUE))
  if(magicear_matched)
   return msgout;
  msgin = msgout;
 }

void viewloc_PlayerPhysics(entity this)
{
 if(this.viewloc)
 {
  if(this.viewloc.goalentity == this.viewloc.enemy)
   return;

  vector old_movement = (this._cs).movement;
  (this._cs).movement_x = old_movement_y;
  if((this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEMOVE) && !this.ladder_entity)
   (this._cs).movement_y = old_movement_x;
  else
   (this._cs).movement_y = 0;

  vector level_start, level_end;
  level_start = this.viewloc.enemy.origin;
  level_end = this.viewloc.goalentity.origin;
  vector forward = vectoangles(normalize(level_end - level_start));
  vector backward = vectoangles(normalize(level_start - level_end));

  if((this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEMOVE) && this.angles_y < 0 && !this.ladder_entity)
   (this._cs).movement_y = -(this._cs).movement_y;

  if(this.viewloc.spawnflags & VIEWLOC_FREEAIM)
  {
   if(this.angles_y > 0)
    (this._cs).movement_x = -(this._cs).movement_x;
  }
  else
  {
   if((this._cs).movement_x < 0)
    (this._cs).movement_x = -(this._cs).movement_x;

   if((this._cs).movement_x < 0)
    this.angles_y = backward.y;
   if((this._cs).movement_x > 0)
    this.angles_y = forward.y;
  }
# 69 "./common/viewloc.qc"
 }
}

string nmm_tile_build_hmill(entity tile)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile.netname);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile.netname);
 if ( number == letter || number+letter == 6 )
 {
  float add = letter < 3 ? 1 : -1;
  return strcat(tile.netname," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter+add*tile.nmm_tile_distance,number)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter+add*2*tile.nmm_tile_distance,number) );
 }
 else if ( letter == 3 )
  return strcat(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-tile.nmm_tile_distance,number)," ",
   tile.netname," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter+tile.nmm_tile_distance,number) );
 else if ( letter < 3 )
  return strcat(minigame_tile_buildname(0,number)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(1,number)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(2,number) );
 else
  return strcat(minigame_tile_buildname(4,number)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(5,number)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(6,number) );
}


string nmm_tile_build_vmill(entity tile)
{
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile.netname);
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile.netname);
 if ( letter == number || letter+number == 6 )
 {
  float add = number < 3 ? 1 : -1;
  return strcat(tile.netname," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+add*tile.nmm_tile_distance)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+add*2*tile.nmm_tile_distance) );
 }
 else if ( number == 3 )
  return strcat(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-tile.nmm_tile_distance)," ",
   tile.netname," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+tile.nmm_tile_distance) );
 else if ( number < 3 )
  return strcat(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,0)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,1)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,2) );
 else
  return strcat(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,4)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,5)," ",
   minigame_tile_buildname(letter,6) );
}





void nmm_spawn_tile(string id, entity minig, float distance)
{

 entity e = __spawn("minigame_nmm_tile", "./common/minigames/minigame/nmm.qc" ":" "86", false);
 e.origin = minigame_tile_pos(id,7,7);
 e.netname = id;
 e.owner = minig;
 e.team = 0;
 e.nmm_tile_distance = distance;
 e.nmm_tile_hmill = strzone(nmm_tile_build_hmill(e));
 e.nmm_tile_vmill = strzone(nmm_tile_build_vmill(e));
}





void nmm_spawn_tile_square( entity minig, float offset, float skip )
{
 float letter = offset;
 float number = offset;
 for ( float i = 0; i < 3; i++ )
 {
  number = offset;
  for ( float j = 0; j < 3; j++ )
  {
   if ( i != 1 || j != 1 )
    nmm_spawn_tile(strzone(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number)),minig, skip+1);
   number += skip+1;
  }
  letter += skip+1;
 }

 if ( skip > 0 )
  nmm_spawn_tile_square(minig,offset+1,skip-1);
}

entity nmm_find_tile(entity minig, string id)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_nmm_tile" && e.netname == id )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float nmm_tile_adjacent(entity tile1, entity tile2)
{

 float dnumber = fabs ( minigame_tile_number(tile1.netname) - minigame_tile_number(tile2.netname) );
 float dletter = fabs ( minigame_tile_letter(tile1.netname) - minigame_tile_letter(tile2.netname) );

 return ( dnumber == 0 && ( dletter == 1 || dletter == tile1.nmm_tile_distance ) ) ||
  ( dletter == 0 && ( dnumber == 1 || dnumber == tile1.nmm_tile_distance ) );
}


float nmm_tile_canmove(entity tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,tile.owner) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_nmm_tile" && !e.nmm_tile_piece
    && nmm_tile_adjacent(e,tile) )
  {
   return true;
  }
 return false;
}


float nmm_in_mill_string(entity tile, string s)
{
 float argc = tokenize(s);
 for ( float i = 0; i < argc; i++ )
 {
  entity e = nmm_find_tile(tile.owner,argv(i));
  if ( !e || !e.nmm_tile_piece || e.nmm_tile_piece.team != tile.nmm_tile_piece.team )
   return false;
 }
 return true;
}


float nmm_in_mill(entity tile)
{
 return tile.nmm_tile_piece && (
  nmm_in_mill_string(tile,tile.nmm_tile_hmill) ||
  nmm_in_mill_string(tile,tile.nmm_tile_vmill) );
}




entity nmm_find_piece(entity start, entity minigame, float teamn, float pieceflags)
{
 entity e = start;
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" &&
    (e.minigame_flags & pieceflags) && e.team == teamn )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float nmm_count_pieces(entity minigame, float teamn, float pieceflags)
{
 float n = 0;
 entity e = (0, world);
 while (( e = nmm_find_piece(e,minigame, teamn, pieceflags) ))
  n++;
 return n;
}


float nmm_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 if ( event == "start" )
 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_PLACE|NMM_TURN_TEAM1;
  nmm_init_tiles(minigame);
  entity e;
  for ( float i = 0; i < 7; i++ )
  {
   e = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/nmm.qc" ":" "228", false));
   e.team = 1;
   e.minigame_flags = NMM_PIECE_HOME;
   e = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/nmm.qc" ":" "231", false));
   e.team = 2;
   e.minigame_flags = NMM_PIECE_HOME;
  }

  return 1;
 }
 else if ( event == "end" )
 {
  nmm_kill_tiles(minigame);
 }
 else if ( event == "join" )
 {
  float n = 0;
  entity e;
  for ( e = minigame.minigame_players; e; e = e.list_next )
   n++;
  if ( n >= 2 )
   return NMM_SPECTATOR_TEAM;
  if ( minigame.minigame_players && minigame.minigame_players.team == 1 )
   return 2;
  return 1;
 }
 else if ( event == "cmd" )
 {
  entity e = ...(0,entity);
  float argc = ...(1,float);
  entity tile = (0, world);
  entity piece = (0, world);
  float move_ok = false;

  if ( e && argc >= 2 && argv(0) == "move" &&
   ( minigame.minigame_flags & NMM_TURN_TEAM ) == e.team )
  {
   tile = nmm_find_tile(minigame,argv(1));
   if ( !tile )
   {
    move_ok = false;
   }
   else if ( minigame.minigame_flags & NMM_TURN_PLACE )
   {
    piece = nmm_find_piece((0, world),minigame,e.team,NMM_PIECE_HOME);
    if ( !tile.nmm_tile_piece && piece )
    {
     tile.nmm_tile_piece = piece;
     piece.minigame_flags = NMM_PIECE_BOARD;
     piece.origin = tile.origin;
     piece.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
     move_ok = true;
    }
   }
   else if ( minigame.minigame_flags & NMM_TURN_MOVE )
   {
    if ( tile.nmm_tile_piece && tile.nmm_tile_piece.team == e.team )
    {
     piece = tile.nmm_tile_piece;
     entity tile2 = nmm_find_tile(minigame,argv(2));
     if ( tile2 && nmm_tile_adjacent(tile,tile2) && !tile2.nmm_tile_piece )
     {
      tile.nmm_tile_piece = (0, world);
      tile2.nmm_tile_piece = piece;
      piece.origin = tile2.origin;
      piece.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
      tile = tile2;
      move_ok = true;
     }
    }

   }
   else if ( minigame.minigame_flags & NMM_TURN_FLY )
   {
    if ( tile.nmm_tile_piece && tile.nmm_tile_piece.team == e.team )
    {
     piece = tile.nmm_tile_piece;
     entity tile2 = nmm_find_tile(minigame,argv(2));
     if ( tile2 && !tile2.nmm_tile_piece )
     {
      tile.nmm_tile_piece = (0, world);
      tile2.nmm_tile_piece = piece;
      piece.origin = tile2.origin;
      piece.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
      tile = tile2;
      move_ok = true;
     }
    }

   }
   else if ( minigame.minigame_flags & NMM_TURN_TAKE )
   {
    piece = tile.nmm_tile_piece;
    if ( piece && piece.nmm_tile_piece.team != e.team )
    {
     tile.nmm_tile_piece = (0, world);
     piece.minigame_flags = NMM_PIECE_DEAD;
     piece.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
     move_ok = true;
    }
   }

   float nextteam = e.team % 2 + 1;
   float npieces = nmm_count_pieces(minigame,nextteam,NMM_PIECE_HOME|NMM_PIECE_BOARD);

   if ( npieces < 3 )
   {
    minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_WIN | e.team;
    minigame.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
   }
   else if ( move_ok)
   {
    if ( !(minigame.minigame_flags & NMM_TURN_TAKE) && nmm_in_mill(tile) )
    {
     minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_TAKE|e.team;
     float takemill = NMM_TURN_TAKEANY;
     entity f = (0, world);
     while ( ( f = findentity(f,owner,minigame) ) )
      if ( f.classname == "minigame_nmm_tile" && f.nmm_tile_piece &&
        f.nmm_tile_piece.team == nextteam && !nmm_in_mill(f) )
      {
       takemill = 0;
       break;
      }
     minigame.minigame_flags |= takemill;
    }
    else
    {
     if ( nmm_find_piece((0, world),minigame,nextteam,NMM_PIECE_HOME) )
      minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_PLACE|nextteam;
     else if ( npieces == 3 )
      minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_FLY|nextteam;
     else
     {
      minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_WIN|e.team;
      entity f = (0, world);
      while ( ( f = findentity(f,owner,minigame) ) )
       if ( f.classname == "minigame_nmm_tile" && f.nmm_tile_piece &&
        f.nmm_tile_piece.team == nextteam && nmm_tile_canmove(f) )
       {
        minigame.minigame_flags = NMM_TURN_MOVE|nextteam;
        break;
       }
     }
    }
    minigame.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
   }
   else
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/nmm.qc", "376")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Invalid move: ", ...(2, string)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   return 1;
  }
 }
 return 0;
}

entity MINIGAME_ttt; [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ttt_init(entity this) {} void Register_MINIGAME_ttt() { entity this = MINIGAME_ttt; if (this == (0, world)) { _regCheck(Minigames_COUNT, Minigames_MAX); this = MINIGAME_ttt = __spawn("minigame_descriptor", "./common/minigames/minigame/ttt.qc" ":" "2", true); this.registered_id = "MINIGAME_ttt"; if(1){ this.m_id = Minigames_COUNT; bufstr_set(_Minigames.al_buf, Minigames_COUNT, al_ftos(al_etof(this))); ++Minigames_COUNT; if (!Minigames_first) Minigames_first = this; if (Minigames_last) Minigames_last.enemy = this; Minigames_last = this; }else voidfunc(); } Register_MINIGAME_ttt_init(this); } [[accumulate]] void _RegisterMinigames() { Register_MINIGAME_ttt(); } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ttt_init(entity this); float ttt_server_event(entity, string, ...); [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ttt_init(entity this) { this.netname = strzone(strtolower("ttt")); this.message = _("Tic Tac Toe"); this.minigame_event = ttt_server_event; } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ttt_init(entity this);

const float TTT_TURN_PLACE = 0x0100;
const float TTT_TURN_WIN = 0x0200;
const float TTT_TURN_DRAW = 0x0400;
const float TTT_TURN_NEXT = 0x0800;
const float TTT_TURN_TYPE = 0x0f00;

const float TTT_TURN_TEAM1 = 0x0001;
const float TTT_TURN_TEAM2 = 0x0002;
const float TTT_TURN_TEAM = 0x000f;


const float TTT_SF_PLAYERSCORE = MINIG_SF_CUSTOM;
const float TTT_SF_SINGLEPLAYER = MINIG_SF_CUSTOM<<1;

const float TTT_SPECTATOR_TEAM = 255;

const float TTT_LET_CNT = 3;
const float TTT_NUM_CNT = 3;
const float TTT_TILE_SIZE = 3;

.float ttt_npieces;
.float ttt_nexteam;
.float ttt_ai;


entity ttt_find_piece(entity minig, string tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float ttt_winning_piece(entity piece)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(piece.netname);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(piece.netname);

 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(0,number)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(1,number)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(2,number)).team == piece.team )
  return true;

 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,0)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,1)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,2)).team == piece.team )
  return true;

 if ( number == letter )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(0,0)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(1,1)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(2,2)).team == piece.team )
  return true;

 if ( number == 2-letter )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(0,2)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(1,1)).team == piece.team )
 if ( ttt_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(2,0)).team == piece.team )
  return true;

 return false;
}


float ttt_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return 0;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < TTT_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < TTT_LET_CNT;
}


void ttt_move(entity minigame, entity player, string pos )
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & TTT_TURN_PLACE )
 if ( pos && player.team == (minigame.minigame_flags & TTT_TURN_TEAM) )
 {
  if ( ttt_valid_tile(pos) )
  if ( !ttt_find_piece(minigame,pos) )
  {
   entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/ttt.qc" ":" "88", false));
   piece.team = player.team;
   piece.netname = strzone(pos);
   minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   minigame.ttt_npieces++;
   minigame.ttt_nexteam = minigame_next_team(player.team,2);
   if ( ttt_winning_piece(piece) )
   {
    player.minigame_flags++;
    minigame_server_sendflags(player, TTT_SF_PLAYERSCORE);
    minigame.minigame_flags = TTT_TURN_WIN | player.team;
   }
   else if ( minigame.ttt_npieces >= (TTT_LET_CNT * TTT_NUM_CNT) )
    minigame.minigame_flags = TTT_TURN_DRAW;
   else
    minigame.minigame_flags = TTT_TURN_PLACE | minigame.ttt_nexteam;
  }
 }
}


void ttt_next_match(entity minigame, entity player)
{


 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & (TTT_TURN_WIN|TTT_TURN_DRAW) )
 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = TTT_TURN_NEXT | player.team;
  minigame.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
 }
 else if ( (minigame.minigame_flags & TTT_TURN_NEXT) &&
   !( minigame.minigame_flags & player.team ) )

 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = TTT_TURN_PLACE | minigame.ttt_nexteam;
  minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  minigame.ttt_npieces = 0;
  entity e = (0, world);
  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
   if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }
}





float ttt_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "start":
  {
   minigame.minigame_flags = (TTT_TURN_PLACE | TTT_TURN_TEAM1);
   return true;
  }
  case "end":
  {
   entity e = (0, world);
   while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(1){ if (e.netname) { strunzone(e.netname); } e.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }
   return false;
  }
  case "join":
  {
   float pl_num = minigame_count_players(minigame);


   if ( (minigame.ttt_ai) && pl_num > 0 )
    return false;


   if(pl_num >= 2) { return TTT_SPECTATOR_TEAM; }


   if(minigame.minigame_players)
    return minigame_next_team(minigame.minigame_players.team, 2);


   return 1;
  }
  case "cmd":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float event_blocked = (player.team == TTT_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   switch(argv(0))
   {
    case "move":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     ttt_move(minigame, ...(0,entity), ...(1,float) == 2 ? argv(1) : nil );
     return true;
    case "next":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     ttt_next_match(minigame,...(0,entity));
     return true;
    case "singleplayer":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     if ( minigame_count_players(minigame) == 1 )
     {
      minigame.ttt_ai = minigame_next_team(minigame.minigame_players.team, 2);
      minigame.SendFlags = TTT_SF_SINGLEPLAYER;
     }
     return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "network_send":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame_player" && (sf & TTT_SF_PLAYERSCORE ) )
   {
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.minigame_flags);
   }
   else if ( sent.classname == "minigame" && (sf & TTT_SF_SINGLEPLAYER) )
   {
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.ttt_ai);
   }
   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

entity MINIGAME_c4; [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_c4_init(entity this) {} void Register_MINIGAME_c4() { entity this = MINIGAME_c4; if (this == (0, world)) { _regCheck(Minigames_COUNT, Minigames_MAX); this = MINIGAME_c4 = __spawn("minigame_descriptor", "./common/minigames/minigame/c4.qc" ":" "2", true); this.registered_id = "MINIGAME_c4"; if(1){ this.m_id = Minigames_COUNT; bufstr_set(_Minigames.al_buf, Minigames_COUNT, al_ftos(al_etof(this))); ++Minigames_COUNT; if (!Minigames_first) Minigames_first = this; if (Minigames_last) Minigames_last.enemy = this; Minigames_last = this; }else voidfunc(); } Register_MINIGAME_c4_init(this); } [[accumulate]] void _RegisterMinigames() { Register_MINIGAME_c4(); } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_c4_init(entity this); float c4_server_event(entity, string, ...); [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_c4_init(entity this) { this.netname = strzone(strtolower("c4")); this.message = _("Connect Four"); this.minigame_event = c4_server_event; } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_c4_init(entity this);

const float C4_TURN_PLACE = 0x0100;
const float C4_TURN_WIN = 0x0200;
const float C4_TURN_DRAW = 0x0400;

const float C4_TURN_TEAM1 = 0x0001;
const float C4_TURN_TEAM2 = 0x0002;
const float C4_TURN_TEAM = 0x000f;

const float C4_LET_CNT = 7;
const float C4_NUM_CNT = 6;
const float C4_WIN_CNT = 4;

const float C4_MAX_TILES = 42;

const float C4_TILE_SIZE = 8;

const float C4_TEAMS = 2;
const float C4_SPECTATOR_TEAM = 255;

.float c4_npieces;
.float c4_nexteam;


entity c4_find_piece(entity minig, string tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float c4_winning_piece(entity piece)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(piece.netname);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(piece.netname);

 float i;
 entity top = piece;
 entity left = piece;
 entity topleft = piece;
 entity botleft = piece;
 for(i = number; i < C4_NUM_CNT; ++i)
 {
  entity p = c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter, i));
  if(p.team == piece.team)
   top = p;
  else break;
 }

 for(i = letter; i >= 0; --i)
 {
  entity p = c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(i, number));
  if(p.team == piece.team)
   left = p;
  else break;
 }

 float j;
 for(i = letter, j = number; i >= 0, j >= 0; --i, --j)
 {
  entity p = c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(i, j));
  if(p.team == piece.team)
   botleft = p;
  else break;
 }
 for(i = letter, j = number; i >= 0, j < C4_NUM_CNT; --i, ++j)
 {
  entity p = c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(i, j));
  if(p.team == piece.team)
   topleft = p;
  else break;
 }


 float found = 0;
 for(i = minigame_tile_number(top.netname); i >= 0; --i)
 {
  if(c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter, i)).team == piece.team)
   ++found;
  else break;
 }

 if(found >= C4_WIN_CNT)
  return true;


 found = 0;
 for(i = minigame_tile_letter(left.netname); i < C4_LET_CNT; ++i)
 {
  if(c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(i, number)).team == piece.team)
   ++found;
  else break;
 }

 if(found >= C4_WIN_CNT)
  return true;


 found = 0;
 for(i = minigame_tile_letter(topleft.netname), j = minigame_tile_number(topleft.netname); i < C4_LET_CNT, j >= 0; ++i, --j)
 {
  if(c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(i, j)).team == piece.team)
   ++found;
  else break;
 }

 if(found >= C4_WIN_CNT)
  return true;


 found = 0;
 for(i = minigame_tile_letter(botleft.netname), j = minigame_tile_number(botleft.netname); i < C4_LET_CNT, j < C4_NUM_CNT; ++i, ++j)
 {
  if(c4_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(i, j)).team == piece.team)
   ++found;
  else break;
 }

 if(found >= C4_WIN_CNT)
  return true;

 return false;
}


float c4_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return false;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < C4_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < C4_LET_CNT;
}

string c4_get_lowest_tile(entity minigame, string s)
{
 float i;
 float end = 0;
 for(i = C4_NUM_CNT; i >= 0; --i)
 {
  if(!c4_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(minigame_tile_letter(s), i)))
  if(c4_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(minigame_tile_letter(s), i - 1)))
  {
   end = i;
   break;
  }
 }
 return minigame_tile_buildname(minigame_tile_letter(s), end);
}


void c4_move(entity minigame, entity player, string pos )
{
 pos = c4_get_lowest_tile(minigame, pos);

 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_PLACE )
 if ( pos && player.team == (minigame.minigame_flags & C4_TURN_TEAM) )
 {
  if ( c4_valid_tile(pos) )
  if ( !c4_find_piece(minigame,pos) )
  {
   entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/c4.qc" ":" "167", false));
   piece.team = player.team;
   piece.netname = strzone(pos);
   minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   minigame.c4_npieces++;
   minigame.c4_nexteam = minigame_next_team(player.team,C4_TEAMS);
   if ( c4_winning_piece(piece) )
   {
    minigame.minigame_flags = C4_TURN_WIN | player.team;
   }
   else if ( minigame.c4_npieces >= C4_MAX_TILES )
    minigame.minigame_flags = C4_TURN_DRAW;
   else
    minigame.minigame_flags = C4_TURN_PLACE | minigame.c4_nexteam;
  }
 }
}





float c4_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "start":
  {
   minigame.minigame_flags = (C4_TURN_PLACE | C4_TURN_TEAM1);
   return true;
  }
  case "end":
  {
   entity e = (0, world);
   while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(1){ if (e.netname) { strunzone(e.netname); } e.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }
   return false;
  }
  case "join":
  {
   float pl_num = minigame_count_players(minigame);


   if(pl_num >= C4_TEAMS) { return C4_SPECTATOR_TEAM; }


   if(minigame.minigame_players)
    return minigame_next_team(minigame.minigame_players.team, C4_TEAMS);


   return 1;
  }
  case "cmd":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float event_blocked = (player.team == C4_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   switch(argv(0))
   {
    case "move":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     c4_move(minigame, ...(0,entity), ...(1,float) == 2 ? argv(1) : nil );
     return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

entity MINIGAME_pong; [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pong_init(entity this) {} void Register_MINIGAME_pong() { entity this = MINIGAME_pong; if (this == (0, world)) { _regCheck(Minigames_COUNT, Minigames_MAX); this = MINIGAME_pong = __spawn("minigame_descriptor", "./common/minigames/minigame/pong.qc" ":" "2", true); this.registered_id = "MINIGAME_pong"; if(1){ this.m_id = Minigames_COUNT; bufstr_set(_Minigames.al_buf, Minigames_COUNT, al_ftos(al_etof(this))); ++Minigames_COUNT; if (!Minigames_first) Minigames_first = this; if (Minigames_last) Minigames_last.enemy = this; Minigames_last = this; }else voidfunc(); } Register_MINIGAME_pong_init(this); } [[accumulate]] void _RegisterMinigames() { Register_MINIGAME_pong(); } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pong_init(entity this); float pong_server_event(entity, string, ...); [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pong_init(entity this) { this.netname = strzone(strtolower("pong")); this.message = _("Pong"); this.minigame_event = pong_server_event; } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pong_init(entity this);


const float PONG_STATUS_WAIT = 0x0010;
const float PONG_STATUS_PLAY = 0x0020;



const float PONG_SF_PLAYERSCORE = MINIG_SF_CUSTOM;

const float PONG_SF_BALLTEAM = MINIG_SF_CUSTOM;


const float PONG_KEY_INCREASE = 0x01;
const float PONG_KEY_DECREASE = 0x02;
const float PONG_KEY_BOTH = 0x03;


const float PONG_MAX_PLAYERS = 4;
const float PONG_SPECTATOR_TEAM = 255;
.float pong_score;
.float pong_keys;
.entity pong_paddles[PONG_MAX_PLAYERS];
.float pong_length;
.entity pong_ai_paddle;



float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_paddle_size;
float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_paddle_speed;

float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_wait;
float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_speed;
float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_radius;
float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_number;

float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ai_thinkspeed;
float autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ai_tolerance;

void pong_ball_think(entity this);


void pong_ball_throw(entity ball)
{
 float angle;
 do
  angle = random()*3.14159265358979323846*2;
 while ( fabs(sin(angle)) < 0.17 || fabs(cos(angle)) < 0.17 );
 ball.velocity_x = cos(angle)*autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_speed;
 ball.velocity_y = sin(angle)*autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_speed;
 (_selftemp = (ball), _selftemp.__think = ((pong_ball_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (pong_ball_think));
 ball.nextthink = time;
 ball.team = 0;
 ball.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE|PONG_SF_BALLTEAM;
}


void pong_ball_throwthink(entity this)
{
 pong_ball_throw(this);
}


void pong_ball_reset(entity ball)
{
 ball.velocity = '0 0 0';
 ball.origin = '0.5 0.5 0';
 (_selftemp = (ball), _selftemp.__think = ((SUB_NullThink) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (SUB_NullThink));
 ball.team = 0;
 ball.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE|PONG_SF_BALLTEAM;
 (_selftemp = (ball), _selftemp.__think = ((pong_ball_throwthink) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (pong_ball_throwthink));
 ball.nextthink = time + autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_wait;
}


void pong_add_score(entity minigame, float team_thrower, float team_receiver, float delta)
{
 if ( !minigame )
  return;

 if ( team_thrower == 0 )
  team_thrower = team_receiver;

 if ( team_thrower == team_receiver )
  delta *= -1;

 entity paddle_thrower = minigame.pong_paddles[team_thrower-1];
 if ( paddle_thrower.realowner.minigame_players )
 {
  paddle_thrower.realowner.minigame_players.pong_score += delta;
  paddle_thrower.realowner.minigame_players.SendFlags |= PONG_SF_PLAYERSCORE;
 }
}


vector box_nearest(vector box_min, vector box_max, vector p)
{
 return (_vec2_x = (p.x > box_max.x ? box_max.x : ( p.x < box_min.x ? box_min.x : p.x )), _vec2_y = (p.y > box_max.y ? box_max.y : ( p.y < box_min.y ? box_min.y : p.y )), _vec2)
                                                                         ;
}

void pong_paddle_bounce(entity ball, float pteam)
{
 switch(pteam)
 {
  case 1: ball.velocity_x = -fabs(ball.velocity_x); break;
  case 2: ball.velocity_x = fabs(ball.velocity_x); break;
  case 3: ball.velocity_y = fabs(ball.velocity_y); break;
  case 4: ball.velocity_y = -fabs(ball.velocity_y); break;
 }

 float angle = atan2(ball.velocity_y, ball.velocity_x);
 angle += ( random() - 0.5 ) * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846/6;
 float speed = vlen(ball.velocity);

 ball.velocity_y = speed * sin(angle);
 ball.velocity_x = speed * cos(angle);
}


float pong_paddle_hit(entity ball, float pteam)
{
 entity paddle = ball.owner.pong_paddles[pteam-1];
 if (!paddle)
  return false;


 vector near_point = box_nearest(paddle.m_mins+paddle.origin,
         paddle.m_maxs+paddle.origin, ball.origin);
 return ((_vlen2 = (near_point - ball.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((ball.pong_length) ** 2));



}


float pong_goal(entity ball, float pteam)
{
 entity paddle = ball.owner.pong_paddles[pteam-1];
 if (!paddle)
  return false;

 if ( !pong_paddle_hit(ball, pteam) )
 {
  pong_add_score(ball.owner ,ball.team, pteam, 1);
  pong_ball_reset(ball);
  return true;
 }

 return false;
}


void pong_ball_think(entity this)
{
 float think_speed = autocvar_sys_ticrate;
 this.nextthink = time + think_speed;

 this.origin_x += this.velocity_x * think_speed;
 this.origin_y += this.velocity_y * think_speed;
 this.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;

 float i;
 for ( i = 1; i <= PONG_MAX_PLAYERS; i++ )
  if ( pong_paddle_hit(this, i) )
  {
   pong_paddle_bounce(this,i);
   this.team = i;
   this.SendFlags |= PONG_SF_BALLTEAM;
   return;
  }

 if ( this.origin_y <= this.pong_length )
 {
  if ( !pong_goal(this,3) )
  {
   this.origin_y = this.pong_length;
   this.velocity_y *= -1;
  }
 }
 else if ( this.origin_y >= 1-this.pong_length )
 {
  if ( !pong_goal(this,4) )
  {
   this.origin_y = 1-this.pong_length;
   this.velocity_y *= -1;
  }
 }

 if ( this.origin_x <= this.pong_length )
 {
  if ( !pong_goal(this,2) )
  {
    this.origin_x = this.pong_length;
    this.velocity_x *= -1;
  }
 }
 else if ( this.origin_x >= 1-this.pong_length )
 {
  if ( !pong_goal(this,1) )
  {
    this.origin_x = 1-this.pong_length;
    this.velocity_x *= -1;
  }
 }

}


void pong_ai_think(entity this)
{
 float think_speed = autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ai_thinkspeed;
 this.nextthink = time + think_speed;

 float distance;
 float next_distance;
 float min_distance = 1;
 entity ball = (0, world);
 entity mayball = (0, world);
 while ( ( mayball = findentity(mayball,owner,this.owner) ) )
  if ( mayball.classname == "pong_ball" )
  {
   distance = vlen(mayball.origin-this.pong_ai_paddle.origin);
   next_distance = vlen(mayball.origin+mayball.velocity-this.pong_ai_paddle.origin);
   if ( distance < min_distance && ( distance < 0.5 || next_distance < distance ) )
   {
    min_distance = distance;
    ball = mayball;
   }
  }

 float target = 0.5;
 float my_pos;


 if ( this.team <= 2 )
 {
  if ( ball )
   target = ball.origin_y + ball.velocity_y*think_speed;
  my_pos = this.pong_ai_paddle.origin_y;
 }
 else
 {
  if ( ball )
   target = ball.origin_x + ball.velocity_x*think_speed;
  my_pos = this.pong_ai_paddle.origin_x;
 }

 distance = this.pong_length/2 * autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ai_tolerance
  + autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_paddle_speed * think_speed;

 if (target < my_pos - distance)
  this.pong_keys = PONG_KEY_DECREASE;
 else if (target > my_pos + distance)
  this.pong_keys = PONG_KEY_INCREASE;
 else
  this.pong_keys = 0;
}

entity pong_ai_spawn(entity paddle)
{
 entity ai = msle_spawn(paddle.owner,__spawn("pong_ai", "./common/minigames/minigame/pong.qc" ":" "263", false));
 ai.minigame_players = ai;
 ai.team = paddle.team;
 (_selftemp = (ai), _selftemp.__think = ((pong_ai_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (pong_ai_think));
 ai.nextthink = time;
 ai.pong_ai_paddle = paddle;

 paddle.realowner = ai;

 return ai;
}


void pong_paddle_think(entity this)
{
 float think_speed = autocvar_sys_ticrate;
 this.nextthink = time + think_speed;

 if ( this.realowner.minigame_players.pong_keys == PONG_KEY_INCREASE ||
   this.realowner.minigame_players.pong_keys == PONG_KEY_DECREASE )
 {
  float pmovement = autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_paddle_speed * think_speed;
  float halflen = this.pong_length/2;

  if ( this.realowner.minigame_players.pong_keys == PONG_KEY_DECREASE )
   pmovement *= -1;

  if ( this.team > 2 )
   this.origin_x = bound(halflen, this.origin_x+pmovement, 1-halflen);
  else
   this.origin_y = bound(halflen, this.origin_y+pmovement, 1-halflen);

  this.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
 }
}

vector pong_team_to_box_halfsize(float nteam, float length, float width)
{
 if ( nteam > 2 )
  return (_vec2_x = (length/2), _vec2_y = (width/2), _vec2);
 return (_vec2_x = (width/2), _vec2_y = (length/2), _vec2);
}

vector pong_team_to_paddlepos(float nteam)
{
 switch(nteam)
 {
  case 1: return '0.99 0.5 0';
  case 2: return '0.01 0.5 0';
  case 3: return '0.5 0.01 0';
  case 4: return '0.5 0.99 0';
  default:return '0 0 0';
 }
}



entity pong_paddle_spawn(entity minigame, float pl_team, entity real_player)
{
 entity paddle = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("pong_paddle", "./common/minigames/minigame/pong.qc" ":" "322", false));

 paddle.origin = pong_team_to_paddlepos(pl_team);
 (_selftemp = (paddle), _selftemp.__think = ((pong_paddle_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (pong_paddle_think));
 paddle.nextthink = time;

 else

 minigame.pong_paddles[pl_team-1] = paddle;

float pong_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch (event)
 {
  case "start":
  {
   minigame.minigame_flags |= PONG_STATUS_WAIT;
   return true;
  }
  case "join":
  {

   if ( minigame.minigame_flags & PONG_STATUS_PLAY )
    return PONG_SPECTATOR_TEAM;

   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float i;
   for ( i = 0; i < PONG_MAX_PLAYERS; i++ )
   {
    if ( minigame.pong_paddles[i] == (0, world) )
    {
     pong_paddle_spawn(minigame,i+1,player);
     return i+1;
    }
   }

   return PONG_SPECTATOR_TEAM;
  }
  case "part":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   entity paddle;
   entity ai;
   float i;
   for ( i = 0; i < PONG_MAX_PLAYERS; i++ )
   {
    paddle = minigame.pong_paddles[i];
    if ( paddle != (0, world) && paddle.realowner == player )
    {
     ai = pong_ai_spawn(paddle);
     ai.pong_score = player.minigame_players.pong_score;
     break;
    }

   }
   return false;
  }
  case "cmd":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float event_blocked = (player.team == PONG_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   switch(argv(0))
   {
    case "throw":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     if ( minigame.minigame_flags & PONG_STATUS_WAIT )
     {
      minigame.minigame_flags = PONG_STATUS_PLAY |
       (minigame.minigame_flags & ~PONG_STATUS_WAIT);
      minigame.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;

      entity ball;
      for ( float j = 0; j < autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_number; j++ )
      {
       ball = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("pong_ball", "./common/minigames/minigame/pong.qc" ":" "408", false));
       ball.pong_length = autocvar_sv_minigames_pong_ball_radius;
       ball.m_mins = (_vec2_x = (-ball.pong_length), _vec2_y = (-ball.pong_length), _vec2);
       ball.m_maxs = (_vec2_x = (ball.pong_length), _vec2_y = (ball.pong_length), _vec2);
       pong_ball_reset(ball);
      }
     }
     return true;
    case "+movei":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     player.pong_keys |= PONG_KEY_INCREASE;
     return true;
    case "+moved":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     player.pong_keys |= PONG_KEY_DECREASE;
     return true;
    case "-movei":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     player.pong_keys &= ~PONG_KEY_INCREASE;
     return true;
    case "-moved":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     player.pong_keys &= ~PONG_KEY_DECREASE;
     return true;
    case "move":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     if(argv(1))
      player.pong_keys = stof(argv(1));
     return true;
    case "pong_aimore":
    {
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;


     float j;
     if ( minigame.minigame_flags & PONG_STATUS_WAIT )
      for ( j = 0; j < PONG_MAX_PLAYERS; j++ )

      {
       if ( minigame.pong_paddles[j] == (0, world) )
       {
        pong_paddle_spawn(minigame,j+1,(0, world));
        return true;
       }
      }
     sprint(player.minigame_players,"Cannot spawn AI\n");
     return true;
    }
    case "pong_ailess":
    {
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     if ( minigame.minigame_flags & PONG_STATUS_WAIT )
     {
      entity paddle;
      for ( float j = PONG_MAX_PLAYERS-1; j >= 0; j-- )
      {
       paddle = minigame.pong_paddles[j];
       if ( paddle != (0, world) &&
        paddle.realowner.classname == "pong_ai" )
       {
        minigame.pong_paddles[j] = (0, world);
        if(1){ entity _this = (paddle.realowner); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(paddle.realowner); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
        if(1){ entity _this = (paddle); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(paddle); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
        return true;
       }
      }
     }
     sprint(player.minigame_players,"Cannot remove AI\n");
     return true;
    }

   }
   return false;
  }
  case "network_send":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame_player" && (sf & PONG_SF_PLAYERSCORE ) )
   {
    WriteLong(MSG_ENTITY,sent.pong_score);
   }
   return false;
  }
 }
 return false;
}

entity MINIGAME_ps; [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ps_init(entity this) {} void Register_MINIGAME_ps() { entity this = MINIGAME_ps; if (this == (0, world)) { _regCheck(Minigames_COUNT, Minigames_MAX); this = MINIGAME_ps = __spawn("minigame_descriptor", "./common/minigames/minigame/ps.qc" ":" "2", true); this.registered_id = "MINIGAME_ps"; if(1){ this.m_id = Minigames_COUNT; bufstr_set(_Minigames.al_buf, Minigames_COUNT, al_ftos(al_etof(this))); ++Minigames_COUNT; if (!Minigames_first) Minigames_first = this; if (Minigames_last) Minigames_last.enemy = this; Minigames_last = this; }else voidfunc(); } Register_MINIGAME_ps_init(this); } [[accumulate]] void _RegisterMinigames() { Register_MINIGAME_ps(); } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ps_init(entity this); float ps_server_event(entity, string, ...); [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ps_init(entity this) { this.netname = strzone(strtolower("ps")); this.message = _("Peg Solitaire"); this.minigame_event = ps_server_event; } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_ps_init(entity this);

entity ps_find_piece(entity minig, string tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}

float ps_draw(entity minigame)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   return true;
  }

 return false;
}

float ps_tile_blacklisted(string tile)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 if(letter < 2)
 {
  if(number < 2)
   return true;
  else if(number > PS_NUM_CNT - 3)
   return true;
 }
 if(letter > PS_LET_CNT - 3)
 {
  if(number < 2)
   return true;
  else if(number > PS_NUM_CNT - 3)
   return true;
 }

 return false;
}


float ps_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return false;
 if(ps_tile_blacklisted(tile))
  return false;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < PS_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < PS_LET_CNT;
}


float ps_winning_piece(entity minigame)
{



 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {
   float number = minigame_tile_number(e.netname);
   float letter = minigame_tile_letter(e.netname);
   string try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter - 1, number);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter - 2, number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter + 1, number);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter + 2, number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number - 1);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number - 2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number + 1);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number + 2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && !ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
     return false;
   }
  }

 return true;
}

void ps_setup_pieces(entity minigame)
{
 float i, t;
 for(i = 0; i < PS_NUM_CNT; ++i)
 for(t = 0; t < PS_LET_CNT; ++t)
 {
  string try = minigame_tile_buildname(i,t);
  if(!ps_valid_tile(try))
   continue;
  if(i == floor(PS_NUM_CNT * 0.5) && t == floor(PS_LET_CNT * 0.5))
   continue;
  entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/ps.qc" ":" "128", false));
  piece.team = 1;
  piece.netname = strzone(minigame_tile_buildname(t,i));
  minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
 }

 minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
}

float ps_move_piece(entity minigame, entity piece, string pos, float leti, float numb)
{
 if(!piece)
  return false;
 if(ps_find_piece(minigame, pos))
  return false;
 entity middle = ps_find_piece(minigame, minigame_tile_buildname(leti,numb));
 if(!middle)
  return false;

 if(1){ if (middle.netname) { strunzone(middle.netname); } middle.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ entity _this = (middle); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(middle); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();

 if(1){ if (piece.netname) { strunzone(piece.netname); } piece.netname = strzone(pos); }else voidfunc();

 minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);

 return true;
}


void ps_move(entity minigame, entity player, string thepiece, string pos )
{
 if ( (minigame.minigame_flags & PS_TURN_MOVE) )
 if ( pos )
 {
  if ( ps_valid_tile(pos) )
  if ( !ps_find_piece(minigame, pos) && ps_find_piece(minigame, thepiece) )
  {
   entity piece = ps_find_piece(minigame, thepiece);
   float number = minigame_tile_number(thepiece);
   float letter = minigame_tile_letter(thepiece);
   float done = false;
   string try;

   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number);
   if(ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter-2,number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter - 1, number);
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number);
   if(!done && ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter+2,number);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter + 1, number);
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1);
   if(!done && ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter, number - 1);
   }
   try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1);
   if(!done && ps_find_piece(minigame,try))
   {
    try = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+2);
    if(ps_valid_tile(try) && try == pos)
     done = ps_move_piece(minigame, piece, pos, letter, number + 1);
   }

   if(!done)
    return;

   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);

   if ( ps_winning_piece(minigame) )
   {
    if(ps_draw(minigame))
     minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_DRAW;
    else
     minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_WIN;
   }
   else
    minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_MOVE;
  }
 }
}





float ps_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "start":
  {
   ps_setup_pieces(minigame);
   minigame.minigame_flags = PS_TURN_MOVE;
   return true;
  }
  case "end":
  {
   entity e = (0, world);
   while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(1){ if (e.netname) { strunzone(e.netname); } e.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }
   return false;
  }
  case "join":
  {
   float pl_num = minigame_count_players(minigame);


   if(pl_num >= 1) { return PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM; }


   return 1;
  }
  case "cmd":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float event_blocked = (player.team == PS_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   switch(argv(0))
   {
    case "move":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     ps_move(minigame, ...(0,entity), (...(1,float) == 3 ? argv(1) : nil), (...(1,float) == 3 ? argv(2) : nil));
     return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}
