entity MINIGAME_pp; [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this) {} void Register_MINIGAME_pp() { entity this = MINIGAME_pp; if (this == (0, world)) { _regCheck(Minigames_COUNT, Minigames_MAX); this = MINIGAME_pp = __spawn("minigame_descriptor", "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc" ":" "2", true); this.registered_id = "MINIGAME_pp"; if(1){ this.m_id = Minigames_COUNT; bufstr_set(_Minigames.al_buf, Minigames_COUNT, al_ftos(al_etof(this))); ++Minigames_COUNT; if (!Minigames_first) Minigames_first = this; if (Minigames_last) Minigames_last.enemy = this; Minigames_last = this; }else voidfunc(); } Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(this); } [[accumulate]] void _RegisterMinigames() { Register_MINIGAME_pp(); } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this); float pp_server_event(entity, string, ...); [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this) { this.netname = strzone(strtolower("pp")); this.message = _("Push-Pull"); this.minigame_event = pp_server_event; } [[accumulate]] void Register_MINIGAME_pp_init(entity this);

const float PP_TURN_PLACE = 0x0100;
const float PP_TURN_WIN = 0x0200;
const float PP_TURN_DRAW = 0x0400;
const float PP_TURN_NEXT = 0x0800;
const float PP_TURN_TYPE = 0x0f00;

const float PP_TURN_TEAM1 = 0x0001;
const float PP_TURN_TEAM2 = 0x0002;
const float PP_TURN_TEAM = 0x000f;

const float PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM = 255;

const float PP_LET_CNT = 7;
const float PP_NUM_CNT = 7;

const float PP_TILE_SIZE = 7;

.float cnt;

.float pp_team1_score;
.float pp_team2_score;

.float pp_nexteam;

.entity pp_curr_piece;


entity pp_find_piece(entity minig, string tile)
{
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.netname == tile )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}


float pp_valid_tile(string tile)
{
 if ( !tile )
  return 0;
 float number = minigame_tile_number(tile);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tile);
 return 0 <= number && number < PP_NUM_CNT && 0 <= letter && letter < PP_LET_CNT;
}


float pp_winning_piece(entity piece)
{
 float number = minigame_tile_number(piece.netname);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(piece.netname);


 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number+1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number+1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number-1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number-1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number-1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number-1)).team == 5)
 if(!pp_valid_tile(minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number+1)) || pp_find_piece(piece.owner,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number+1)).team == 5)
  return true;

 return false;
}

float pp_valid_move(entity minigame, string pos)
{
 if(!pp_valid_tile(pos))
  return false;
 if(pp_find_piece(minigame,pos).team == 5)
  return false;

 entity current = minigame.pp_curr_piece;
 if(!current)
  return true;

 float number = minigame_tile_number(pos);
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(pos);

 if( (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number-1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number+1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number+1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number-1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter+1,number-1)) == current)
 || (pp_find_piece(minigame,minigame_tile_buildname(letter-1,number+1)) == current)
 ) { return true; }

 return false;
}


void pp_move(entity minigame, entity player, string pos )
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_PLACE )
 if ( pos && player.team == (minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_TEAM) )
 {
  if ( pp_valid_move(minigame,pos))
  {
   entity existing = pp_find_piece(minigame,pos);

   if(existing && existing.team != 5)
   {
    if(existing.team == 1)
     minigame.pp_team1_score++;
    if(existing.team == 2)
     minigame.pp_team2_score++;
   }

   if(minigame.pp_curr_piece)
   {
    minigame.pp_curr_piece.cnt = 0;
    minigame.pp_curr_piece.team = 5;
    minigame_server_sendflags(minigame.pp_curr_piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   }

   if(existing)
   {
    if(1){ if (existing.netname) { strunzone(existing.netname); } existing.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (existing); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(existing); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }

   entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc" ":" "128", false));
   piece.cnt = 1;
   piece.team = player.team;
   piece.netname = strzone(pos);
   minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   minigame.pp_nexteam = minigame_next_team(player.team,2);
   minigame.pp_curr_piece = piece;
   if ( pp_winning_piece(piece) )
   {
    if(minigame.pp_team1_score == minigame.pp_team2_score)
     minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_DRAW;
    else
     minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_WIN | ((minigame.pp_team1_score > minigame.pp_team2_score) ? 1 : 2);
   }
   else
    minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_PLACE | minigame.pp_nexteam;
  }
 }
}

void pp_setup_pieces(entity minigame)
{
 float i, t;
 for(i = 0; i < PP_LET_CNT; ++i)
 for(t = 0; t < PP_NUM_CNT; ++t)
 {
  float t2_true = ((i == 0 || i == 6) && t > 0 && t < 6);
  float t1_true = (i > 0 && i < 6 && (t == 0 || t == 6));

  if(t1_true || t2_true)
  {
   entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/pp.qc" ":" "160", false));
   piece.team = ((t1_true) ? 1 : 2);
   piece.netname = strzone(minigame_tile_buildname(i,t));
   minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_ALL);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  }
 }

 minigame.pp_curr_piece = (0, world);
}


void pp_next_match(entity minigame, entity player)
{


 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & (PP_TURN_WIN|PP_TURN_DRAW) )
 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_NEXT | player.team;
  minigame.SendFlags |= MINIG_SF_UPDATE;
 }
 else if ( (minigame.minigame_flags & PP_TURN_NEXT) &&
   !( minigame.minigame_flags & player.team ) )

 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = PP_TURN_PLACE | minigame.pp_nexteam;
  minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  entity e = (0, world);
  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
   if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
  minigame.pp_team1_score = 0;
  minigame.pp_team2_score = 0;

  pp_setup_pieces(minigame);
 }
}





float pp_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "start":
  {
   minigame.minigame_flags = (PP_TURN_PLACE | PP_TURN_TEAM1);
   pp_setup_pieces(minigame);
   return true;
  }
  case "end":
  {
   entity e = (0, world);
   while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(1){ if (e.netname) { strunzone(e.netname); } e.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }
   return false;
  }
  case "join":
  {
   float pl_num = minigame_count_players(minigame);


   if(pl_num >= 2) { return PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM; }


   if(minigame.minigame_players)
    return minigame_next_team(minigame.minigame_players.team, 2);


   return 1;
  }
  case "cmd":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float event_blocked = (player.team == PP_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   switch(argv(0))
   {
    case "move":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     pp_move(minigame, ...(0,entity), ...(1,float) == 2 ? argv(1) : nil );
     return true;
    case "next":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     pp_next_match(minigame,...(0,entity));
     return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "network_send":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame" && (sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE ) )
   {
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.pp_team1_score);
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.pp_team2_score);
   }
   else if(sent.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.cnt);
   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

float bd_controller_send(entity this, entity to, float sf)
{
 if(1){ if (NET_ENT_CLIENT_BD_CONTROLLER_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, NET_ENT_CLIENT_BD_CONTROLLER.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 if(sf & BD_SF_UPDATE_ALL)
  sf &= ~BD_SF_UPDATE_SINGLE;

 WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, sf);
 WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.bd_tilelet);
 WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.owner.netname);

 if(sf & BD_SF_UPDATE_SINGLE)
 {
  float number = this.bd_forceupdate;

  float ttype = this.bd_tiletypes[number];
  float dir = this.bd_dirs[number];
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, number);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, ttype);
  WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, dir);
 }

 if(sf & BD_SF_UPDATE_ALL)
 {
  for(float j = 0; j < BD_NUM_CNT; ++j)
  {
   float ttype = this.bd_tiletypes[j];
   float dir = this.bd_dirs[j];
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, ttype);
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, dir);
  }
 }

 return true;
}

void bd_check_winner(entity minig)
{
 float total = 0, valid = 0;
 entity e = (0, world);
 while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minig) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_TARGET )
  {
   ++total;
   if(bd_find_piece(minig, e.netname, false).bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_BOULDER)
    ++valid;
  }

 if(valid >= total)
 {
  minig.minigame_flags = BD_TURN_WIN;
  minigame_server_sendflags(minig,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
 }
}

vector bd_get_dir(float bdir)
{
 switch(bdir)
 {
  case BD_DIR_UP: return '0 1 0';
  default:
  case BD_DIR_DN: return '0 -1 0';
  case BD_DIR_LF: return '-1 0 0';
  case BD_DIR_RT: return '1 0 0';
 }
}

string bd_get_dir_name(float bdir)
{
 switch(bdir)
 {
  case BD_DIR_UP: return "u";
  default:
  case BD_DIR_DN: return "d";
  case BD_DIR_LF: return "l";
  case BD_DIR_RT: return "r";
 }
}

float bd_dir_fromname(string bdir)
{
 if(bdir == "up" || bdir == "u")
  return BD_DIR_UP;
 if(bdir == "down" || bdir == "dn" || bdir == "d")
  return BD_DIR_DN;
 if(bdir == "left" || bdir == "lt" || bdir == "l")
  return BD_DIR_LF;
 if(bdir == "right" || bdir == "rt" || bdir == "r")
  return BD_DIR_RT;

 return BD_DIR_DN;
}

float bd_canfill(float ttype)
{
 switch(ttype)
 {
  case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return true;
 }

 return false;
}

float bd_move_dozer(entity minigame, entity dozer)
{



 float myx = minigame_tile_letter(dozer.netname);
 float myy = minigame_tile_number(dozer.netname);

 vector dir = bd_get_dir(dozer.bd_dir);

 myx += dir.x;
 myy += dir.y;

 string newpos = minigame_tile_buildname(myx, myy);
 if(!bd_valid_tile(newpos))
  return false;

 entity hit = bd_find_piece(minigame, newpos, false);

 if(hit)
 switch(hit.bd_tiletype)
 {
  case BD_TILE_DOZER:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return false;
  case BD_TILE_BOULDER:
  {
   string testpos;
   float tx = minigame_tile_letter(hit.netname);
   float ty = minigame_tile_number(hit.netname);

   tx += dir.x;
   ty += dir.y;

   testpos = minigame_tile_buildname(tx, ty);
   if(!bd_valid_tile(testpos))
    return false;
   entity testhit = bd_find_piece(minigame, testpos, false);
   if(testhit)
    return false;

   entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, minigame_tile_letter(testpos));
   float tnum = minigame_tile_number(testpos);
   switch(controller.bd_tiletypes[tnum])
   {
    case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
    case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return false;
   }

   if(1){ if (hit.netname) { strunzone(hit.netname); } hit.netname = strzone(testpos); }else voidfunc();
   minigame_server_sendflags(hit,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   break;
  }
 }

 entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, minigame_tile_letter(newpos));
 float number = minigame_tile_number(newpos);
 switch(controller.bd_tiletypes[number])
 {
  case BD_TILE_BRICK8:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK7:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK6:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK5:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK4:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK3:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK2:
  case BD_TILE_BRICK1: return false;
 }

 if(1){ if (dozer.netname) { strunzone(dozer.netname); } dozer.netname = strzone(newpos); }else voidfunc();

 return true;
}


void bd_move(entity minigame, entity player, string dir)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_MOVE )
 if ( dir )
 {


  {
   entity dozer = bd_find_dozer(minigame);
   if(!dozer)
   {
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "350")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Dozer wasn't found!"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
    return;
   }

   string thedir = strtolower(dir);
   float bdir = bd_dir_fromname(thedir);

   float moved = 0;
   entity e = (0, world);
   while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
    if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && e.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_DOZER )
    {
     e.bd_dir = bdir;

     if(bd_move_dozer(minigame, e))
      ++moved;

     minigame_server_sendflags(e,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
    }

   if(moved)
    player.bd_moves++;

   bd_check_winner(minigame);

   minigame_server_sendflags(player,BD_SF_PLAYERMOVES);
   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  }
 }
}


void bd_editor_place(entity minigame, entity player, string pos, float thetile, string thedir)
{
 if ( minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT )
 if ( pos && thetile )
 {
  if ( bd_valid_tile(pos) )
  {
   entity found_piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false);
   entity targ = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true);

   if(found_piece.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_DOZER && thedir != "")
   {
    string newdir = strtolower(thedir);
    float bdir = bd_dir_fromname(newdir);

    found_piece.bd_dir = bdir;
    minigame_server_sendflags(found_piece,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
    return;
   }





   float tlet = minigame_tile_letter(pos);
   float tnum = minigame_tile_number(pos);
   entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, tlet);
   if(controller.bd_tiletypes[tnum])
   {
    controller.bd_tiletypes[tnum] = 0;
    controller.bd_dirs[tnum] = 0;
    bd_controller_update(controller, tnum);
    return;
   }

   if(found_piece || (targ && thetile != BD_TILE_BOULDER))
   {
    entity piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false);
    if(!piece) piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true);
    if(!piece)
     return;

    if(1){ if (piece.netname) { strunzone(piece.netname); } piece.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (piece); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(piece); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
    minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
    return;
   }

   if(bd_canfill(thetile))
   {
    float number = minigame_tile_number(pos);
    float letter = minigame_tile_letter(pos);
    entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, letter);
    controller.bd_tiletypes[number] = thetile;
    controller.bd_dirs[number] = 0;
    bd_controller_update(controller, number);
   }
   else
   {
    entity piece = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc" ":" "441", false));
    piece.team = 1;
    piece.netname = strzone(pos);
    piece.bd_tiletype = thetile;
    piece.bd_dir = 0;
    minigame_server_sendflags(piece,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
   }

   minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
  }
 }
}

void bd_do_move(entity minigame, entity player, string dir, string thetile, string thedir)
{
 if(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_MOVE)
  bd_move(minigame, player, dir);

 if(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT)
  bd_editor_place(minigame, player, dir, stof(thetile), thedir);
}

void bd_fill_recurse(entity minigame, entity player, float thetype, float letter, float number)
{
 string pos = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number);
 if(!bd_valid_tile(pos))
  return;
 if(bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false) || bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true))
  return;

 bd_editor_place(minigame, player, pos, thetype, "");

 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter - 1, number);
 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter + 1, number);
 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number - 1);
 bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number + 1);
}

void bd_unfill_recurse(entity minigame, entity player, float thetype, float letter, float number)
{
 string pos = minigame_tile_buildname(letter,number);
 if(!bd_valid_tile(pos))
  return;

 entity targ = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, true);
 entity piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, pos, false);

 if(targ && thetype == targ.bd_tiletype)
 {
  if(1){ if (targ.netname) { strunzone(targ.netname); } targ.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
  if(1){ entity _this = (targ); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(targ); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else if(piece && thetype == piece.bd_tiletype)
 {
  if(1){ if (piece.netname) { strunzone(piece.netname); } piece.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
  if(1){ entity _this = (piece); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(piece); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else return;

 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter - 1, number);
 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter + 1, number);
 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number - 1);
 bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number + 1);
}

void bd_do_fill(entity minigame, entity player, string dir, string thetile)
{

 if(!player.minigame_players.bd_canedit)
 {
  sprint(player.minigame_players, "You're not allowed to edit levels, sorry!\n");
  return;
 }


 if(minigame.minigame_flags & BD_TURN_EDIT)
 {
  float thetype = stof(thetile);

  entity targ = bd_find_piece(minigame, dir, true);
  entity piece = bd_find_piece(minigame, dir, false);

  if(!bd_canfill(thetype) || (piece || targ))
  {
   float killtype = 0;

   if(targ) { killtype = targ.bd_tiletype; }
   if(piece) { killtype = piece.bd_tiletype; }

   if(killtype)
   {
    float letter = minigame_tile_letter(dir);
    float number = minigame_tile_number(dir);
    bd_unfill_recurse(minigame, player, killtype, letter, number);
   }

   return;
  }

  float letter = minigame_tile_letter(dir);
  float number = minigame_tile_number(dir);

  bd_fill_recurse(minigame, player, thetype, letter, number);
 }
}

void bd_reset_moves(entity minigame)
{
 entity e;

 for(e = minigame.minigame_players; e; e = e.list_next)





  {
   e.bd_moves = 0;
   minigame_server_sendflags(e,BD_SF_PLAYERMOVES);
  }
}

 while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )

  {

  }
 e = (0, world);
 while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
  if(e.classname == "bd_controller")
  {
   if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();

string bd_save_controller_piece(entity minigame, entity e, float number)
{
 string bd_string = "";

 string tilename = minigame_tile_buildname(e.bd_tilelet, number);

 bd_string = strcat(bd_string, "\"", tilename, "\" ");
 bd_string = strcat(bd_string, ftos(e.bd_tiletypes[number]), " ");
 bd_string = strcat(bd_string, ftos(e.bd_dirs[number]));

 return bd_string;
}

string bd_save_piece(entity minigame, entity e)
{
 string bd_string = "";

 bd_string = strcat(bd_string, "\"", e.netname, "\" ");
 bd_string = strcat(bd_string, ftos(e.bd_tiletype), " ");
 bd_string = strcat(bd_string, ftos(e.bd_dir));

 return bd_string;
}

void bd_set_nextlevel(entity minigame, string s)
{
 _tokenize_console(s);

 if(1){ if (minigame.bd_nextlevel) { strunzone(minigame.bd_nextlevel); } minigame.bd_nextlevel = strzone(argv(2)); }else voidfunc();
}

float bd_fix_dir(vector dir)
{
 if(dir.x == 0 && dir.y == 1) { return BD_DIR_UP; }
 if(dir.x == 0 && dir.y == -1) { return BD_DIR_DN; }
 if(dir.x == -1 && dir.y == 0) { return BD_DIR_LF; }
 if(dir.x == 1 && dir.y == 0) { return BD_DIR_RT; }

 return BD_DIR_DN;
}

void bd_load_piece(entity minigame, string s)
{

 string bd_string = s;

 _tokenize_console(bd_string);

 float argv_num = 0;
 string tilename = strzone(argv(argv_num)); ++argv_num;
 float tiletype = stof(argv(argv_num)); ++argv_num;
 float dir = stof(argv(argv_num)); ++argv_num;

 if(bd_canfill(tiletype))
 {
  float letter = minigame_tile_letter(tilename);
  float number = minigame_tile_number(tilename);
  entity controller = bd_find_controller(minigame, letter);
  controller.bd_tiletypes[number] = tiletype;
  controller.bd_dirs[number] = dir;

  bd_controller_update(controller, number);
 }
 else
 {
  entity e = msle_spawn(minigame,__spawn("minigame_board_piece", "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc" ":" "715", false));
  e.netname = tilename;
  e.team = 1;
  e.bd_dir = dir;
  e.bd_tiletype = tiletype;
  minigame_server_sendflags(e,MINIG_SF_ALL);
 }
}

float bd_save_level(entity minigame)
{
 if(minigame.bd_levelname && minigame.bd_levelname != "")
 {
  float target_count = 0, boulder_count = 0;
  entity piece = (0, world);
  while((piece = findentity(piece,owner,minigame)))
   if(piece.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(piece.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_BOULDER)
     ++boulder_count;
    else if(piece.bd_tiletype == BD_TILE_TARGET)
     ++target_count;
   }

  if(boulder_count != target_count)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "741")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("Not enough targets or boulders, fix your level!"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }


  string file_name;
  float file_get;

  file_name = strcat("minigames/bulldozer/storage_", minigame.bd_levelname, ".txt");
  file_get = fopen(file_name, FILE_WRITE);
  fputs(file_get, strcat("// bulldozer storage \"", minigame.bd_levelname, "\" last updated ", strftime(true, "%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S"), "\n"));

  if(minigame.bd_nextlevel && minigame.bd_nextlevel != "" && fexists(strcat("minigames/bulldozer/storage_", minigame.bd_nextlevel, ".txt")))
   fputs(file_get, strcat("nextlevel = \"", minigame.bd_nextlevel, "\"\n"));

  entity e = (0, world);
  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "bd_controller" )
  {
   for(float j = 0; j < BD_NUM_CNT; ++j)
   {

    fputs(file_get, strcat(bd_save_controller_piece(minigame, e, j), "\n"));
   }
  }
  e = (0, world);

  while ( ( e = findentity(e,owner,minigame) ) )
  if ( e.classname == "minigame_board_piece" )
  {

   fputs(file_get, strcat(bd_save_piece(minigame, e), "\n"));
  }
  fclose(file_get);

  return true;
 }

 return false;
}

void bd_load_level(entity minigame)
{

 string file_read, file_name;
 float file_get;

 file_name = strcat("minigames/bulldozer/storage_", minigame.bd_levelname, ".txt");
 file_get = fopen(file_name, FILE_READ);
 if(file_get < 0)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "792")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("^3BULLDOZER: ^7could not find storage file ^3", file_name, "^7, no items were loaded"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
 }
 else
 {
  for(;;)
  {
   file_read = fgets(file_get);
   if(file_read == "")
    break;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 2) == "//")
    continue;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 1) == "#")
    continue;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 9) == "nextlevel")
   {
    bd_set_nextlevel(minigame, file_read);
    continue;
   }

   bd_load_piece(minigame, file_read);
  }
 }
 fclose(file_get);
}

void bd_close_editor(entity minigame, entity player)
{

 if(!player.minigame_players.bd_canedit)
 {
  sprint(player.minigame_players, "You're not allowed to edit levels, sorry!\n");
  return;
 }


 entity dozer = bd_find_dozer(minigame);
 if(!dozer)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "830")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("You need to place a bulldozer on the level to save it!"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }

 if(bd_save_level(minigame))
 {
  minigame.minigame_flags = BD_TURN_MOVE;
  minigame_server_sendflags(minigame,MINIG_SF_UPDATE);
 }
 else
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/minigame/bd.qc", "841")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("You need to set the level name!"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }
}




float bd_server_event(entity minigame, string event, ...)
{
 switch(event)
 {
  case "start":
  {
   if(1){ if (minigame.bd_levelname) { strunzone(minigame.bd_levelname); } minigame.bd_levelname = strzone(autocvar_sv_minigames_bulldozer_startlevel); }else voidfunc();
   bd_setup_pieces(minigame);
   minigame.minigame_flags = BD_TURN_MOVE;

   return true;
  }
  case "end":
  {
   entity e = (0, world);
   while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "minigame_board_piece")
   {
    if(1){ if (e.netname) { strunzone(e.netname); } e.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }
   e = (0, world);
   while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame)) )
   if(e.classname == "bd_controller")
   {
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   }

   if(1){ if (minigame.bd_nextlevel) { strunzone(minigame.bd_nextlevel); } minigame.bd_nextlevel = nil; }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ if (minigame.bd_levelname) { strunzone(minigame.bd_levelname); } minigame.bd_levelname = nil; }else voidfunc();
   return false;
  }
  case "join":
  {
   float pl_num = minigame_count_players(minigame);

   if(pl_num >= BD_TEAMS) { return BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM; }

   return 1;
  }
  case "cmd":
  {
   entity player = ...(0,entity);
   float event_blocked = (player.team == BD_SPECTATOR_TEAM);
   switch(argv(0))
   {
    case "move":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     bd_do_move(minigame, ...(0,entity), ((...(1,float)) >= 2 ? argv(1) : nil), ((...(1,float)) >= 3 ? argv(2) : nil), ((...(1,float)) >= 4 ? argv(3) : nil));
     return true;
    case "next":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     bd_next_match(minigame,...(0,entity), ((...(1,float) >= 2 ? argv(1) : nil)));
     return true;
    case "restart":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     bd_restart_match(minigame,...(0,entity));
     return true;
    case "edit":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     bd_activate_editor(minigame,...(0,entity));
     return true;
    case "save":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     bd_close_editor(minigame,...(0,entity));
     return true;
    case "fill":
     if(event_blocked)
      return true;
     bd_do_fill(minigame, ...(0,entity), ((...(1,float)) >= 2 ? argv(1) : nil), ((...(1,float)) >= 3 ? argv(2) : nil));
     return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case "network_send":
  {
   entity sent = ...(0,entity);
   float sf = ...(1,float);
   if ( sent.classname == "minigame_board_piece" && (sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE) )
   {
    float letter = minigame_tile_letter(sent.netname);
    float number = minigame_tile_number(sent.netname);

    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,letter);
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,number);

    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.bd_tiletype);

    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,sent.bd_dir);
   }
   else if(sent.classname == "minigame_player" && (sf & BD_SF_PLAYERMOVES))
    WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY,sent.bd_moves);
   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

float minigame_tile_letter(string id)
{
 return _str2chr(substring(id,0,1),0)-'a';
}





float minigame_tile_number(string id)
{
 return stof(substring(id,1,-1)) -1 ;
}


vector minigame_tile_pos(string id, float rows, float columns)
{
 return (_vec2_x = ((minigame_tile_letter(id) + 0.5) / columns), _vec2_y = ((1 - (minigame_tile_number(id) + 0.5) / rows)), _vec2)
                                                ;
}


string minigame_tile_buildname(float letter, float number)
{
 return strcat(_chr2str('a'+letter),ftos(number+1));
}


string minigame_relative_tile(string start_id, float dx, float dy, float rows, float columns)
{
 float letter = minigame_tile_letter(start_id);
 float number = minigame_tile_number(start_id);
 letter = (letter+dx) % columns;
 number = (number+dy) % rows;
 if ( letter < 0 )
  letter = columns + letter;
 if ( number < 0 )
  number = rows + number;
 return minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number);
}


string minigame_tile_name(vector pos, float rows, float columns)
{
 if ( pos_x < 0 || pos_x > 1 || pos_y < 0 || pos_y > 1 )
  return "";

 float letter = floor(pos_x * columns);
 float number = floor((1-pos_y) * rows);
 return minigame_tile_buildname(letter, number);
}


float minigame_next_team(float curr_team, float n_teams)
{
 return curr_team % n_teams + 1;
}


float minigame_prev_team(float curr_team, float n_teams)
{
 return curr_team % n_teams - 1;
}

const float msle_base_id = 2;
float msle_id(string class_name)
{
 if ( class_name == "minigame" ) return 1;
 if ( class_name == "minigame_player" ) return 2;
 float i = msle_base_id;

 i++; if ( class_name == "minigame_board_piece" ) return i; i++; if ( class_name == "pong_paddle" ) return i; i++; if ( class_name == "pong_ball" ) return i; i++; if ( class_name == "pong_ai" ) return i;

 return 0;
}

string msle_classname(float id)
{
 if ( id == 1 ) return "minigame";
 if ( id == 2 ) return "minigame_player";
 float i = msle_base_id;

 i++; if ( id == i ) return "minigame_board_piece"; i++; if ( id == i ) return "pong_paddle"; i++; if ( id == i ) return "pong_ball"; i++; if ( id == i ) return "pong_ai";

 return "";
}

void player_clear_minigame(entity player)
{
 (player._cs).active_minigame = (0, world);
 player.minigame_players = (0, world);
 if ( ((player).classname == STR_PLAYER) )
  set_movetype(player, MOVETYPE_WALK);
 else
  set_movetype(player, MOVETYPE_FLY_WORLDONLY);

}

void minigame_rmplayer(entity minigame_session, entity player)
{
 entity e;
 entity p = minigame_session.minigame_players;

 if ( p.minigame_players == player )
 {
  if ( p.list_next == (0, world) )
  {
   end_minigame(minigame_session);
   return;
  }
  minigame_session.minigame_event(minigame_session,"part",player);
  GameLogEcho(strcat(":minigame:part:",minigame_session.netname,":",
   ftos(num_for_edict(player)),":",player.netname));
  minigame_session.minigame_players = p.list_next;
  if(1){ entity _this = (p); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(p); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
  player_clear_minigame(player);
 }
 else
 {
  for ( e = p.list_next; e != (0, world); e = e.list_next )
  {
   if ( e.minigame_players == player )
   {
    minigame_session.minigame_event(minigame_session,"part",player);
    GameLogEcho(strcat(":minigame:part:",minigame_session.netname,":",
     ftos(num_for_edict(player)),":",player.netname));
    p.list_next = e.list_next;
    if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
    player_clear_minigame(player);
    return;
   }
   p = e;
  }
 }
}

float minigame_SendEntity(entity this, entity to, float sf)
{
 if(1){ if (NET_ENT_CLIENT_MINIGAME_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, NET_ENT_CLIENT_MINIGAME.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, sf);

 if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE )
 {
  WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY,msle_id(this.classname));
  WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.netname);
 }

 entity minigame_ent = this.owner;

 if ( this.classname == "minigame" )
 {
  minigame_ent = this;

  if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE )
   WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.descriptor.netname);

  if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
   WriteLong(MSG_ENTITY,this.minigame_flags);
 }
 else if ( this.classname == "minigame_player" )
 {
  if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE )
  {
   WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.owner.netname);
   WriteLong(MSG_ENTITY,num_for_edict(this.minigame_players));
  }
  if ( sf & MINIG_SF_UPDATE )
   WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY,this.team);
 }
 else if ( this.classname == "minigame_board_piece" ) { if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE ) WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.owner.netname); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_CREATE) ) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.team); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_UPDATE) ) WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, this.minigame_flags); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_UPDATE) ) if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.y); }else voidfunc(); } else if ( this.classname == "pong_paddle" ) { if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE ) WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.owner.netname); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_CREATE) ) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.team); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_CREATE) ) WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.pong_length); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_UPDATE) ) if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.y); }else voidfunc(); } else if ( this.classname == "pong_ball" ) { if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE ) WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.owner.netname); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_CREATE) ) WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.pong_length); if ( sf & (PONG_SF_BALLTEAM) ) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.team); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_UPDATE) ) if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.velocity.y); }else voidfunc(); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_UPDATE) ) if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.y); }else voidfunc(); } else if ( this.classname == "pong_ai" ) { if ( sf & MINIG_SF_CREATE ) WriteString(MSG_ENTITY,this.owner.netname); if ( sf & (MINIG_SF_CREATE) ) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.team); if ( sf & (PONG_SF_PLAYERSCORE) ) WriteLong(MSG_ENTITY, this.pong_score); }

 minigame_ent.minigame_event(minigame_ent,"network_send",this,sf);

 return true;

}

float minigame_CheckSend(entity this, entity client)
{
 entity e;
 for ( e = this.owner.minigame_players; e != (0, world); e = e.list_next )
  if ( e.minigame_players == client )
   return true;
 return false;
}

float minigame_addplayer(entity minigame_session, entity player)
{
 if ( (player._cs).active_minigame )
 {
  if ( (player._cs).active_minigame == minigame_session )
   return 0;
  minigame_rmplayer((player._cs).active_minigame,player);
 }
 entity player_pointer = __spawn("minigame_player", "./common/minigames/sv_minigames.qc" ":" "135", false);
 float mgteam = minigame_session.minigame_event(minigame_session,"join",player,player_pointer);

 if ( mgteam )
 {
  player_pointer.owner = minigame_session;
  player_pointer.minigame_players = player;
  player_pointer.team = mgteam;
  player_pointer.list_next = minigame_session.minigame_players;
  minigame_session.minigame_players = player_pointer;
  (player._cs).active_minigame = minigame_session;
  player.minigame_players = player_pointer;
  (_selftemp = (player_pointer), _selftemp.__customizeentityforclient = ((minigame_CheckSend) ? customizeentityforclient_self : nil), _selftemp.selfcustomizeentityforclient = (minigame_CheckSend));
  Net_LinkEntity(player_pointer, false, 0, minigame_SendEntity);

  if ( !((player).classname == STR_OBSERVER) && autocvar_sv_minigames_observer )
   PutObserverInServer(player, true, true);
  if ( autocvar_sv_minigames_observer == 2 )
   Player_SetForcedTeamIndex(player, TEAM_FORCE_SPECTATOR);

  minigame_resend(minigame_session);
 }
 else { if(1){ entity _this = (player_pointer); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(player_pointer); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc(); }
 GameLogEcho(strcat(":minigame:join",(mgteam?"":"fail"),":",minigame_session.netname,":",
  ftos(num_for_edict(player)),":",player.netname));

 return mgteam;
}

entity start_minigame(entity player, string minigame )
{
 if ( !autocvar_sv_minigames || !(clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL) )
  return (0, world);

 entity e = minigame_get_descriptor(minigame);
 if ( e )
 {
  entity minig = __spawn("minigame", "./common/minigames/sv_minigames.qc" ":" "172", false);
  minig.netname = strzone(strcat(e.netname,"_",ftos(num_for_edict(minig))));
  minig.descriptor = e;
  minig.minigame_event = e.minigame_event;
  minig.minigame_event(minig,"start");
  GameLogEcho(strcat(":minigame:start:",minig.netname));
  if ( ! minigame_addplayer(minig,player) )
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/sv_minigames.qc", "180")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Minigame ",minig.netname," rejected the first player join!"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   end_minigame(minig);
   return (0, world);
  }
  Net_LinkEntity(minig, false, 0, minigame_SendEntity);

  if ( !minigame_sessions )
   minigame_sessions = minig;
  else
  {
   minigame_sessions.owner = minig;
   minig.list_next = minigame_sessions;
   minigame_sessions = minig;
  }
  return minig;
 }

 return (0, world);
}

entity join_minigame(entity player, string game_id )
{
 if ( !autocvar_sv_minigames || !(clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL) )
  return (0, world);

 entity minig;
 for ( minig = minigame_sessions; minig != (0, world); minig = minig.list_next )
 {
  if ( minig.netname == game_id )
  if ( minigame_addplayer(minig,player) )
   return minig;
 }

 return (0, world);
}

void part_minigame(entity player)
{
 entity minig = (player._cs).active_minigame;

 if ( minig && minig.classname == "minigame" )
  minigame_rmplayer(minig,player);
}

void end_minigame(entity minigame_session)
{
 if ( minigame_session.owner )
  minigame_session.owner.list_next = minigame_session.list_next;
 else
  minigame_sessions = minigame_session.list_next;

 minigame_session.minigame_event(minigame_session,"end");
 GameLogEcho(strcat(":minigame:end:",minigame_session.netname));


 entity e = (0, world);
 while( (e = findentity(e, owner, minigame_session)) )
  if ( e.minigame_autoclean )
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/minigames/sv_minigames.qc", "239")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("SV Auto-cleaned: ",ftos(num_for_edict(e)), " (",e.classname,")"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
  }

 entity p;
 for ( e = minigame_session.minigame_players; e != (0, world); e = p )
 {
  p = e.list_next;
  player_clear_minigame(e.minigame_players);
  if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }

 if(1){ if (minigame_session.netname) { strunzone(minigame_session.netname); } minigame_session.netname = nil; }else voidfunc();
 if(1){ entity _this = (minigame_session); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(minigame_session); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
}

void end_minigames()
{
 while ( minigame_sessions )
 {
  end_minigame(minigame_sessions);
 }
}

string invite_minigame(entity inviter, entity player)
{
 if ( !inviter || !(inviter._cs).active_minigame )
  return "Invalid minigame";
 if ( VerifyClientEntity(player, true, false) <= 0 )
  return "Invalid player";
 if ( inviter == player )
  return "You can't invite yourself";
 if (PlayerInList(player, autocvar_g_playban_list) && autocvar_g_playban_minigames)
  return "You can't invite a banned player";
 if ( (player._cs).active_minigame == (inviter._cs).active_minigame )
  return strcat(player.netname," is already playing");

 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_INFO, INFO_MINIGAME_INVITE,
  (inviter._cs).active_minigame.netname, inviter.netname );

 GameLogEcho(strcat(":minigame:invite:",(inviter._cs).active_minigame.netname,":",
  ftos(num_for_edict(player)),":",player.netname));

 return "";
}

entity minigame_find_player(entity client)
{
 if ( ! (client._cs).active_minigame )
  return (0, world);
 entity e;
 for ( e = (client._cs).active_minigame.minigame_players; e; e = e.list_next )
  if ( e.minigame_players == client )
   return e;
 return (0, world);
}

float MinigameImpulse(entity this, float imp)
{
 if (!(this._cs).active_minigame) return false;
 entity e = minigame_find_player(this);
 if ( imp && (this._cs).active_minigame && e )
 {
  return (this._cs).active_minigame.minigame_event((this._cs).active_minigame,"impulse",e,imp);
 }
 return false;
}



void ClientCommand_minigame(entity caller, float request, float argc, string command)
{
 if ( !autocvar_sv_minigames )
 {
  sprint(caller,"Minigames are not enabled!\n");
  return;
 }

 if (PlayerInList(caller, autocvar_g_playban_list) && autocvar_g_playban_minigames)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, caller, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_JOIN_PLAYBAN);
  sprint(caller, "You aren't allowed to play minigames because you are banned from them in this server.\n");
  return;
 }

 if (request == CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND )
 {
  string minig_cmd = argv(1);
  if ( minig_cmd == "create" && argc > 2 )
  {
   entity minig = start_minigame(caller, argv(2));
   if ( minig )
    sprint(caller,"Created minigame session: ",minig.netname,"\n");
   else
    sprint(caller,"Cannot start minigame session!\n");
   return;
  }
  else if ( minig_cmd == "join" && argc > 2 )
  {
   entity minig = join_minigame(caller, argv(2));
   if ( minig )
    sprint(caller,"Joined: ",minig.netname,"\n");
   else
   {
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, caller, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_JOIN_PREVENT_MINIGAME);
    sprint(caller,"Cannot join given minigame session!\n");
   }
   return;
  }
  else if ( minig_cmd == "list" )
  {
   if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Minigames_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (true) { { sprint(caller, it.netname, " (", it.message, ") ", "\n"); } } } }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
  else if ( minig_cmd == "list-sessions" )
  {
   entity e;
   for ( e = minigame_sessions; e != (0, world); e = e.list_next )
    sprint(caller,e.netname,"\n");
   return;
  }
  else if ( minig_cmd == "end" || minig_cmd == "part" )
  {
   if ( (caller._cs).active_minigame )
   {
    part_minigame(caller);
    sprint(caller,"Left minigame session\n");
   }
   else
    sprint(caller,"You aren't playing any minigame...\n");
   return;
  }
  else if ( minig_cmd == "invite" && argc > 2 )
  {
   if ( (caller._cs).active_minigame )
   {
    entity client = GetIndexedEntity(argc, 2);
    string error = invite_minigame(caller,client);
    if ( error == "" )
    {
     sprint(caller,"You have invited ",client.netname,
      " to join your game of ", (caller._cs).active_minigame.descriptor.message, "\n");
    }
    else
     sprint(caller,"Could not invite: ", error, ".\n");
   }
   else
    sprint(caller,"You aren't playing any minigame...\n");
   return;
  }
  else if ( (caller._cs).active_minigame )
  {
   entity e = minigame_find_player(caller);
   string subcommand = substring(command,_argv_end_index(0),-1);
   float arg_c = _tokenize_console(subcommand);
   if ( (caller._cs).active_minigame.minigame_event((caller._cs).active_minigame,"cmd",e,arg_c,subcommand) )
    return;

  }
  else sprint(caller,strcat("Wrong command:^1 ",command,"\n"));
 }

 sprint(caller, "\nUsage:^3 cmd minigame create <minigame>\n");
 sprint(caller, "  Start a new minigame session\n");
 sprint(caller, "Usage:^3 cmd minigame join <session>\n");
 sprint(caller, "  Join an exising minigame session\n");
 sprint(caller, "Usage:^3 cmd minigame list\n");
 sprint(caller, "  List available minigames\n");
 sprint(caller, "Usage:^3 cmd minigame list-sessions\n");
 sprint(caller, "  List available minigames sessions\n");
 sprint(caller, "Usage:^3 cmd minigame part|end\n");
 sprint(caller, "  Leave the current minigame\n");
 sprint(caller, "Usage:^3 cmd minigame invite <player>\n");
 sprint(caller, "  Invite the given player to join you in a minigame\n");
}

void Curl_URI_Get_Callback(float id, float status, string data)
{
 float i = id - URI_GET_CURL;
 float do_exec = curl_uri_get_exec[i];
 string do_cvar = curl_uri_get_cvar[i];

  if(do_cvar)
   strunzone(do_cvar);
  return;
 }

  localcmd(data);
 if(do_cvar)
 {
  cvar_set(do_cvar, data);
  strunzone(do_cvar);
 }
 if(!do_exec)
  if (!do_cvar)
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/generic.qc", "52")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(data); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

void GenericCommand_qc_curl(float request, float argc)
{
 switch(request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   float do_exec = false;
   string do_cvar = nil;
   float key = -1;
   float i;
   for(i = 1; i+1 < argc; ++i)
   {
    if(argv(i) == "--cvar" && i+2 < argc)
    {
     ++i;
     do_cvar = strzone(argv(i));
     continue;
    }
    if(argv(i) == "--exec")
    {
     do_exec = true;
     continue;
    }
    if(argv(i) == "--key" && i+2 < argc)
    {
     ++i;
     key = stof(argv(i));
     continue;
    }
    break;
   }



   string url = argv(i);
   ++i;
   float buf = _buf_create();
   float j;
   for(j = 0; i+1 < argc; i += 2)
    bufstr_set(buf, ++j, sprintf("%s=%s", uri_escape(argv(i)), uri_escape(argv(i+1))));
   if(i < argc)
    bufstr_set(buf, ++j, sprintf("submit=%s", uri_escape(argv(i))));

   float r;
   if(j == 0)
    r = crypto_uri_postbuf(url, URI_GET_CURL + curl_uri_get_pos, nil, nil, -1, key);
   else
    r = crypto_uri_postbuf(url, URI_GET_CURL + curl_uri_get_pos, "application/x-www-form-urlencoded", "&", buf, key);

   if(r)
   {
    curl_uri_get_exec[curl_uri_get_pos] = do_exec;
    curl_uri_get_cvar[curl_uri_get_pos] = do_cvar;
    curl_uri_get_pos = (curl_uri_get_pos + 1) % (URI_GET_CURL_END - URI_GET_CURL + 1);
   }
   else
    if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/generic.qc", "156")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n(_("error creating curl handle")); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();

   buf_del(buf);

   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 ", "sv_cmd", " qc_curl [--key <n>] [--cvar] [--exec] <url> [<postargs>]"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
 }
}

void GenericCommand_maplist(float request, float argc)
{
 switch(request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   string tmp_string;
   float i;

   switch(argv(1))
   {
    case "add":
    {
     if(argc == 3)
     {
      if (!fexists(strcat("maps/", argv(2), ".bsp")))
      {
       if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/generic.qc", "249")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("maplist: ERROR: ", argv(2), " does not exist!"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
       break;
      }

      if(cvar_string("g_maplist") == "")
       cvar_set("g_maplist", argv(2));
      else
       cvar_set("g_maplist", strcat(argv(2), " ", cvar_string("g_maplist")));

      return;
     }
     break;
    }

    case "cleanup":
    {
     MapInfo_Enumerate();
     MapInfo_FilterGametype(MapInfo_CurrentGametype(), MapInfo_CurrentFeatures(), MapInfo_RequiredFlags(), MapInfo_ForbiddenFlags(), 0);
     string filtered = "";
     if(1){ string _words = cvar_string("g_maplist"); float _i = 0; for (string _it; (_it = car(_words)); (_words = cdr(_words), ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref string it = _it; if (MapInfo_CheckMap(it)) { { filtered = cons(filtered, it); } } } }else voidfunc();
     cvar_set("g_maplist", filtered);
     return;
    }

    case "remove":
    {
     if(argc == 3)
     {

      string del_map_name = argv(2);
      argc = _tokenizebyseparator(cvar_string("g_maplist"), " ");

      tmp_string = "";
      for(i = 0; i < argc; ++i)
       if(argv(i) != del_map_name)
        tmp_string = strcat(tmp_string, " ", argv(i));

      tmp_string = substring(tmp_string, 1, _strlen(tmp_string) - 1);
      cvar_set("g_maplist", tmp_string);

      return;
     }
     break;
    }

    case "shuffle":
    {
     cvar_set("g_maplist", shufflewords(cvar_string("g_maplist")));
     return;
    }

    default: break;
   }
  }

  default:
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/generic.qc", "305")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Incorrect parameters for ^2%s^7", argv(0)); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 ", "sv_cmd", " maplist <action> [<map>]"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();

void GenericCommand_runtest(float request, float argc)
{
 switch(request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   if(argc > 1)
   {
    float i;
    for(i = 1; i < argc; ++i)
     TEST_Run(argv(i));
   }
   else
    RUN_ALL_TESTS();
   return;
  }

  default:
  case CMD_REQUEST_USAGE:
  {
   if(1){ string __s = strcat1n("Usage:^3 ", "sv_cmd", " <function>"); print("^7", __s, (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') ? "\n" : ""); }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
 }
}

float GenericCommand(string command)
{
 float argc = _tokenize_console(command);
 float n, j, f, i;
 string s, s2, c;
 vector rgb;






 if(GenericCommand_macro_command(argc, command))
 {
  return true;
 }
 else if(argc >= 3 && argv(0) == "red")
 {
  s = substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), _argv_end_index(-1) - _argv_start_index(2));
  localcmd(strcat(argv(1), " ", GenericCommand_markup(s)));
  return true;
 }
 else if(argc >= 3 && crc16(0, argv(0)) == 38566 && crc16(0, strcat(argv(0), argv(0), argv(0))) == 59830)
 {

  s = strconv(2, 0, 0, substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), _argv_end_index(-1) - _argv_start_index(2)));

  n = floor(random() * 6 + 2);

  s2 = "";
  for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  {
   s2 = strcat(s2, "AH");
  }

  if(random() < 0.1)
   s2 = strcat(substring(s2, 1, _strlen(s2) - 1), "A");

  if(s == "")
   s = s2;
  else
   if(random() < 0.8)
    s = strcat(s, " ", s2);
   else
    s = strcat(s2, " ", s);

  s2 = substring(s, _strlen(s) - 2, 2);
  if(s2 == "AH" || s2 == "AY")
   s = strcat(s, "))");
  else
   s = strcat(s, " ))");

  if(random() < 0.1)
   s = substring(s, 0, _strlen(s) - 1);

  if(random() < 0.1)
   s = strconv(1, 0, 0, s);

  localcmd(strcat(argv(1), " ", s));

  return true;
 }
 else if(argc >= 3 && crc16(0, argv(0)) == 3826 && crc16(0, strcat(argv(0), argv(0), argv(0))) == 55790)
 {

  s = strdecolorize(substring(command, _argv_start_index(2), _argv_end_index(-1) - _argv_start_index(2)));
  s2 = "";

  n = _strlen(s);
  j = ((6 * max(1, floor(_strlen(s)/32 + random() * 2 - 1))) / n) * (1 - 2 * (random() > 0.5));
  f = random() * 6;

  for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  {
   c = substring(s, i, 1);

   if(c == ";")
    c = ":";
   else if(c == "^")
   {
    c = "^^";
    if(substring(s, i+1, 1) == "^")
     ++i;
   }

   if(c != " ")
   {
    rgb = hsl_to_rgb('1 0 0' * (j * i + f) + '0 1 .5');
    c = strcat(rgb_to_hexcolor(rgb), c);
   }
   s2 = strcat(s2, c);
  }

  localcmd(strcat(argv(1), " ", s2));

  return true;
 }

 return false;
}

string GenericCommand_markup(string s2)
{
 float red, ccase, i, j;
 string s, s3;

 GenericCommand_markup_init();

 s = "";

 red = 0;
 ccase = 0;
 float len = _strlen(s2);
 for (i = 0; i < len; ++i)
 {
  for(j = 0; j < NUM_MARKUPS; ++j)
  {
   s3 = substring(s2, i, _strlen(markup_from[j]));
   if (s3 == markup_from[j])
   {
    s = strcat(s, markup_to[j]);
    i += _strlen(markup_from[j]) - 1;
    break;
   }
  }

  if(j == NUM_MARKUPS)
  {
   if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&&")
   {
    s = strcat(s, strconv(ccase, red, red, "&"));
    ++i;
   }
   else if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&d")
   {
    red = 2;
    ccase = 0;
    ++i;
   }
   else if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&a")
   {
    red = 2;
    ccase = 2;
    ++i;
   }
   else if(substring(s2, i, 2) == "&n")
   {
    red = 0;
    ccase = 0;
    ++i;
   }
   else
    s = strcat(s, strconv(ccase, red, red, substring(s2, i, 1)));
  }
 }

 return s;
}

string rpn_pop()
{
 if(rpn_sp > 0) {
  --rpn_sp;
  return rpn_stack[rpn_sp];
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "17")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: stack underflow"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
  return "";
 }
}
void rpn_push(string s)
{
 if(rpn_sp < MAX_RPN_STACK) {
  rpn_stack[rpn_sp] = s;
  ++rpn_sp;
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "28")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: stack overflow"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
 }
}
string rpn_get()
{
 if(rpn_sp > 0) {
  return rpn_stack[rpn_sp - 1];
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "37")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: empty stack"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
  return "";
 }
}
void rpn_set(string s)
{
 if(rpn_sp > 0) {
  rpn_stack[rpn_sp - 1] = s;
 } else {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/command/rpn.qc", "47")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("rpn: empty stack"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
  rpn_error = true;
 }
}

void GenericCommand_rpn(float request, float argc, string command)
{
 switch(request)
 {
  case CMD_REQUEST_COMMAND:
  {
   float i, j, f, f2, f3, rpnpos;

   string s, s2, rpncmd;

   if(!rpn_db)
   {
    rpn_db = db_create();
    db_put(rpn_db, "stack.pointer", "0");
    db_put(rpn_db, "stack.pos", "-1");
   }

   if(argc >= 2)
   {
    rpn_sp = 0;
    rpn_error = false;
    for(rpnpos = 1; rpnpos < argc; ++rpnpos)
    {
     rpncmd = argv(rpnpos);

string Notification_CheckArgs(
 NOTIF broadcast, entity client)
{

 switch (broadcast)
 {
  case NOTIF_ONE:
  case NOTIF_ONE_ONLY:
  {
   if ((!(client.flags & FL_CLIENT))) {
    return "No client provided!";
   }
   break;
  }

  case NOTIF_ALL_EXCEPT:
  {
   if ((!(client.flags & FL_CLIENT))) {
    return "Exception can't be a non-client!";
   }
   break;
  }

  case NOTIF_ALL:
  {
   if (client) {
    return "Entity provided when NULL was required!";
   }
   break;
  }

  case NOTIF_TEAM:
  {
   if (!teamplay) {
    return "Teamplay not active!";
   } else if (!client.team) {

   }
   break;
  }

  case NOTIF_TEAM_EXCEPT:
  {
   if (!teamplay) {
    return "Teamplay not active!";
   } else if ((!(client.flags & FL_CLIENT))) {
    return "Exception can't be a non-client!";
   }
   break;
  }

  default:
  {
   return sprintf("Improper broadcast: %d!", broadcast);
  }
 }
 return "";
}

float Notification_ShouldSend(NOTIF broadcast, entity to_client, entity other_client)
{
 if(!(clienttype(to_client) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
  return false;

 switch (broadcast)
 {
  case NOTIF_ONE:
   return (
    (to_client == other_client)
    ||
    (((to_client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR) && (to_client.enemy == other_client))
   );
  case NOTIF_ONE_ONLY:
   return (to_client == other_client);
  case NOTIF_TEAM:
   return (
    (to_client.team == other_client.team)
    ||
    (
     ((to_client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR)
     &&
     (to_client.enemy.team == other_client.team)
    )
   );
  case NOTIF_TEAM_EXCEPT:
   return (
    (to_client != other_client)
    &&
    (
     (to_client.team == other_client.team)
     ||
     (
      ((to_client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR)
      &&
      (
       (to_client.enemy != other_client)
       &&
       (to_client.enemy.team == other_client.team)
      )
     )
    )
   );
  case NOTIF_ALL:
   return true;
  case NOTIF_ALL_EXCEPT:
   return (
    (to_client != other_client)
    &&
    !(
     ((to_client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR)
     &&
     (to_client.enemy == other_client)
    )
   );
  default:
   return false;
 }
}

float explosion_calcpush_getmultiplier(vector explosion_v, vector target_v)
{
 float a;
 a = explosion_v * (explosion_v - target_v);

 if(a <= 0)

  return 0;

 a /= (explosion_v * explosion_v);


 return a;
}

  return explosion_f;

vector cliptoplane(vector v, vector p)
{
 return v - (v * p) * p;
}

vector solve_cubic_pq(float p, float q)
{
 float D, u, v, a;
 D = q*q/4.0 + p*p*p/27.0;
 if(D < 0)
 {

  a = 1.0/3.0 * acos(-q/2.0 * sqrt(-27.0/(p*p*p)));
  u = sqrt(-4.0/3.0 * p);




  return u * (_vec3.x = (cos(a + 2.0/3.0*3.14159265358979323846)), _vec3.y = (cos(a + 4.0/3.0*3.14159265358979323846)), _vec3.z = (cos(a)), _vec3)



   ;
 }
 else if(D == 0)
 {

  if(p == 0)
   return '0 0 0';
  u = 3*q/p;
  v = -u/2;
  return (u >= v) ? (_vec3.x = (v), _vec3.y = (v), _vec3.z = (u), _vec3) : (_vec3.x = (u), _vec3.y = (v), _vec3.z = (v), _vec3);
 }
 else
 {



  a = cbrt(-q/2.0 + sqrt(D)) + cbrt(-q/2.0 - sqrt(D));
  return (_vec3.x = (a), _vec3.y = (a), _vec3.z = (a), _vec3);
 }
}
vector solve_cubic_abcd(float a, float b, float c, float d)
{


 float p, q;
 vector v;
 p = (9*a*c - 3*b*b);
 q = (27*a*a*d - 9*a*b*c + 2*b*b*b);
 v = solve_cubic_pq(p, q);
 v = (v - b * '1 1 1') * (1.0 / (3.0 * a));
 if(a < 0)
  v += '1 0 -1' * (v.z - v.x);
 return v;
}

vector findperpendicular(vector v)
{
 return normalize(cliptoplane((_vec3.x = (v.z), _vec3.y = (-v.x), _vec3.z = (v.y), _vec3), v));
}


 float W_GunAlign(entity this, float preferred_align)
 {
  if(this.m_gunalign)
   return this.m_gunalign;

  entity own = this.owner;

  if(preferred_align < 1 || preferred_align > 4)
   preferred_align = 3;

  for(float j = 4; j > 1; --j)
  {
   float taken = 0;
   for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
   {
    .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
    if(own.(weaponentity).m_gunalign == j)
     taken |= (1 << (j));
    if(own.(weaponentity).m_gunalign == preferred_align)
     taken |= (1 << (preferred_align));
   }

   if(!(taken & (1 << (preferred_align))))
    return preferred_align;
   if(!(taken & (1 << (j))))
    return j;
  }

  return preferred_align;
 }

vector W_CalculateSpread(vector forward, float spread, float spreadfactor, float spreadstyle)
{
 float sigma;
 vector v1 = '0 0 0', v2;
 float dx, dy, r;
 spread *= spreadfactor;
 if(spread <= 0)
  return forward;

 switch(spreadstyle)
 {
  case 0:
  {



   return forward + randomvec() * spread;
  }
  case 1:
  {

   return normalize(forward + cliptoplane(randomvec() * spread, forward));
  }
  case 2:
  {

   sigma = spread * 0.89442719099991587855;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = sqrt(r);
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  case 3:
  {
   sigma = spread * 0.44721359549996;

   v1 = forward;
   v1_x += gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_y += gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_z += gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   return v1;
  }
  case 4:
  {
   sigma = spread * 0.44721359549996;

   v1_x = gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_y = gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   v1_z = gsl_ran_gaussian(sigma);
   return normalize(forward + cliptoplane(v1, forward));
  }
  case 5:
  {
   sigma = spread * 1.154700538379252;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = solve_cubic_abcd(-2, 3, 0, -r) * '0 1 0';
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  case 6:
  {
   sigma = spread * 1.095445115010332;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = sqrt(1 - r);
   r = sqrt(1 - r);
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  case 7:
  {
   sigma = spread * 1.224744871391589;
   v1 = findperpendicular(forward);
   v2 = ((forward) >< (v1));

   dx = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
   dy = sin(dx);
   dx = cos(dx);

   r = random();
   r = 1 - sqrt(r);
   r = 1 - sqrt(r);
   return normalize(forward + (v1 * dx + v2 * dy) * r * sigma);
  }
  default:
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("g_projectiles_spread_style must be 0 (sphere), 1 (flattened sphere), 2 (circle), 3 (gauss 3D), 4 (gauss plane), 5 (linear falloff), 6 (quadratic falloff), 7 (stronger falloff)!"));
 }

 return '0 0 0';
# 305 "./common/weapons/calculations.qc"
}

  this.beam_dir = w_shotdir;
  this.beam_initialized = true;

 float segments;
 if(this.beam_dir != w_shotdir)
 {






  float angle = vlen(w_shotdir - this.beam_dir) * RAD2DEG;
  if(angle && (angle > (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_maxangle)))
  {

   float blendfactor = bound(
    0,
    (1 - ((_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_returnspeed) * frametime)),
    min((_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_maxangle) / angle, 1)
   );
   if(((_vlen2 = (this.beam_dir - w_shotdir), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((0.01) ** 2)))
    this.beam_dir = w_shotdir;
   else
    this.beam_dir = normalize((w_shotdir * (1 - blendfactor)) + (this.beam_dir * blendfactor));
  }
  else
  {

   float blendfactor = bound(
    0,
    (1 - ((_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_returnspeed) * frametime)),
    1
   );
   if(((_vlen2 = (this.beam_dir - w_shotdir), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((0.01) ** 2)))
    this.beam_dir = w_shotdir;

  }

  if((_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_distancepersegment))

    ARC_MAX_SEGMENTS,
    1 + (vlen(w_shotdir / (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_distancepersegment)))

  else { max_allowed_segments = ARC_MAX_SEGMENTS; }

    1,
    (
     min(
      angle,
      (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_maxangle)

     (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_degreespersegment)
    ),
    max_allowed_segments
   );
  }

 {

   beam_controlpoint,
   beam_endpos,
   i / segments);
  vector new_dir = normalize(new_origin - last_origin);

  WarpZone_traceline_antilag(
   own,
   last_origin,
   new_origin,
   MOVE_NORMAL,
   own,
   min(0.4, (own._cs).ping * 0.001)
  );

  beam_controlpoint = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, beam_controlpoint);
  beam_endpos = WarpZone_TransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, beam_endpos);
  new_dir = WarpZone_TransformVelocity(WarpZone_trace_transform, new_dir);

  if(trace_ent)
  {
   float is_player = (((trace_ent).classname == STR_PLAYER) || trace_ent.classname == "body" || (trace_ent.flags & FL_MONSTER));
   if((teamplay ? (own.team == trace_ent.team) : (own == trace_ent)))
   {

    float rootarmor = ((burst) ? (_wep_arc.wepvar_burst_healing_aps) : (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_healing_aps));
    float hplimit = ((((trace_ent).classname == STR_PLAYER)) ? (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_healing_hmax) : RES_LIMIT_NONE);

    {
     if(GetResource(trace_ent, RES_ARMOR) <= (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_healing_amax))
     {

       trace_ent.pauserotarmor_finished,
       time + autocvar_g_balance_pause_armor_rot

     }

     new_beam_type = ARC_BT_HEAL;
   }
   else if(trace_ent.takedamage && (is_player || (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_nonplayerdamage)))
   {

    float falloff = ExponentialFalloff(
     (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_falloff_mindist),
     (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_falloff_maxdist),
     (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_falloff_halflifedist),
     vlen(WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, hitorigin) - w_shotorg)
    );

    if(is_player)
    {
     if(burst)
      { rootdamage = (_wep_arc.wepvar_burst_damage); }
     else
      { rootdamage = (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_damage); }
    }
    else
     { rootdamage = (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_nonplayerdamage); }

    if(accuracy_isgooddamage(own, trace_ent))
    {
     accuracy_add(
      own,

      0,
      rootdamage * coefficient * falloff
     );
    }

    Damage(
     trace_ent,
     own,
     own,
     rootdamage * coefficient * falloff,
     WEP_ARC.m_id,
     weaponentity,
     hitorigin,
     (_wep_arc.wepvar_beam_force) * new_dir * coefficient * falloff
    );

    new_beam_type = ARC_BT_HIT;
   }
   break;
  }
  else if(trace_fraction != 1)
  {

   new_beam_type = ARC_BT_WALL;
   break;
  }
 }




 new_beam_type |= burst;


 if(new_beam_type != this.beam_type)
 {
  this.SendFlags |= ARC_SF_BEAMTYPE;

void W_Crylink_CheckLinks(entity e)
{
 float i;
 entity p;

 if(e == (0, world))
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("W_Crylink_CheckLinks: entity is NULL"));
 if(e.classname != "spike" || wasfreed(e))
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error(sprintf("W_Crylink_CheckLinks: entity is not a spike but a %s (freed: %d)", e.classname, wasfreed(e))));

 p = e;
 for(i = 0; i < 1000; ++i)
 {
  if(p.queuenext.queueprev != p || p.queueprev.queuenext != p)
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("W_Crylink_CheckLinks: queue is inconsistent"));
  p = p.queuenext;
  if(p == e)
   break;
 }
 if(i >= 1000)
  (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("W_Crylink_CheckLinks: infinite chain"));
}

void W_Crylink_Dequeue_Raw(entity own, entity prev, entity me, entity next)
{
 W_Crylink_CheckLinks(next);
 .entity weaponentity = me.weaponentity_fld;
 if(me == own.(weaponentity).crylink_lastgroup)
  own.(weaponentity).crylink_lastgroup = ((me == next) ? (0, world) : next);
 prev.queuenext = next;
 next.queueprev = prev;
 me.classname = "spike_oktoremove";
 if(me != next)
  W_Crylink_CheckLinks(next);
}

void W_Crylink_Dequeue(entity e)
{
 W_Crylink_Dequeue_Raw(e.crylink_owner, e.queueprev, e, e.queuenext);
}

void W_Crylink_DeleteLink(entity this)
{
 if(this.classname != "spike_oktoremove")
  W_Crylink_Dequeue(this);
 delete_fn(this);
}

float w_crylink_linkjoin_time;
vector W_Crylink_LinkJoin(entity e, float jspeed)
{
 vector avg_origin, avg_velocity;
 vector targ_origin;
 float avg_dist, n;
 entity p;


 W_Crylink_CheckLinks(e);

 w_crylink_linkjoin_time = 0;

 avg_origin = e.origin;
 avg_velocity = e.velocity;
 n = 1;
 for(p = e; (p = p.queuenext) != e; )
 {
  avg_origin += WarpZone_RefSys_TransformOrigin(p, e, p.origin);
  avg_velocity += WarpZone_RefSys_TransformVelocity(p, e, p.velocity);
  ++n;
 }
 avg_origin *= (1.0 / n);
 avg_velocity *= (1.0 / n);

 if(n < 2)
  return avg_origin;


 avg_dist = (vlen(e.origin - avg_origin) ** 2);
 for(p = e; (p = p.queuenext) != e; )
  avg_dist += (vlen(WarpZone_RefSys_TransformOrigin(p, e, p.origin) - avg_origin) ** 2);
 avg_dist *= (1.0 / n);
 avg_dist = sqrt(avg_dist);

 if(avg_dist == 0)
  return avg_origin;

 if(jspeed == 0)
 {
  e.velocity = avg_velocity;
  UpdateCSQCProjectile(e);
  for(p = e; (p = p.queuenext) != e; )
  {
   p.velocity = WarpZone_RefSys_TransformVelocity(e, p, avg_velocity);
   UpdateCSQCProjectile(p);
  }
  targ_origin = avg_origin + 1000000000 * normalize(avg_velocity);
 }
 else
 {
  w_crylink_linkjoin_time = avg_dist / jspeed;
  targ_origin = avg_origin + w_crylink_linkjoin_time * avg_velocity;

  e.velocity = (targ_origin - e.origin) * (1.0 / w_crylink_linkjoin_time);
  UpdateCSQCProjectile(e);
  for(p = e; (p = p.queuenext) != e; )
  {
   p.velocity = WarpZone_RefSys_TransformVelocity(e, p, (targ_origin - WarpZone_RefSys_TransformOrigin(p, e, p.origin)) * (1.0 / w_crylink_linkjoin_time));
   UpdateCSQCProjectile(p);
  }
# 164 "./common/weapons/weapon/crylink.qc"
 }

 W_Crylink_CheckLinks(e);

 return targ_origin;
}

float W_Crylink_Touch_WouldHitFriendly(entity projectile, float rad)
{

 float hit_friendly = 0;
 float hit_enemy = 0;

 while(head)
 {
  if((head.takedamage != DAMAGE_NO) && (!((head).deadflag != DEAD_NO)))
  {
   if((teamplay ? (head.team == projectile.realowner.team) : (head == projectile.realowner)))
    ++hit_friendly;
   else
    ++hit_enemy;
  }

  head = head.chain;
 }

 return (hit_enemy ? false : hit_friendly);
}

void W_Crylink_Attack(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity)
{
 float counter, shots;
 entity proj, prevproj, firstproj;
 vector s;
 vector forward, right, up;
 float maxdmg;

 W_DecreaseAmmo(thiswep, actor, (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_ammo), weaponentity);

 maxdmg = (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_damage) * (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_shots);
 maxdmg *= 1 + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_bouncedamagefactor) * (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_bounces);
 if((_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_joinexplode))
  maxdmg += (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_joinexplode_damage);

 W_SetupShot_Dir_ProjectileSize_Range(actor, weaponentity, v_forward, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', false, 2, SND_CRYLINK_FIRE, CH_WEAPON_A, maxdmg, max_shot_distance, thiswep.m_id);
 forward = v_forward;
 right = v_right;
 up = v_up;

 shots = (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_shots);
 W_MuzzleFlash(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, w_shotorg, w_shotdir);
 proj = prevproj = firstproj = (0, world);
 for(counter = 0; counter < shots; ++counter)
 {
  proj = __spawn("spike", "./common/weapons/weapon/crylink.qc" ":" "314", false);
  proj.dtor = W_Crylink_DeleteLink;
  proj.reset = W_Crylink_Reset;
  proj.realowner = proj.owner = actor;
  proj.crylink_owner = actor;
  proj.weaponentity_fld = weaponentity;
  proj.bot_dodge = true;
  proj.bot_dodgerating = (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_damage);
  if(shots == 1) {
   proj.queuenext = proj;
   proj.queueprev = proj;
  }
  else if(counter == 0) {
   firstproj = proj;
  }
  else if(counter == shots - 1) {
   prevproj.queuenext = proj;
   firstproj.queueprev = proj;
   proj.queuenext = firstproj;
   proj.queueprev = prevproj;
  }
  else {
   prevproj.queuenext = proj;
   proj.queueprev = prevproj;
  }

  prevproj = proj;

  set_movetype(proj, MOVETYPE_BOUNCEMISSILE);
  (proj).solid = SOLID_CORPSE; (proj).dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;
  proj.projectiledeathtype = thiswep.m_id;


  setorigin(proj, w_shotorg);
  setsize(proj, '0 0 0', '0 0 0');


  s = '0 0 0';
  if(counter == 0)
   s = '0 0 0';
  else
  {
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/weapons/weapon/crylink.qc", 356, __FUNC__, "\"'0 360 0' * (0.75 + (counter - 0.5) / (shots - 1))\""); _makevectors_hidden('0 360 0' * (0.75 + (counter - 0.5) / (shots - 1))); }else voidfunc();
   s.y = v_forward.x;
   s.z = v_forward.y;
  }
  s = s * (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_spread) * autocvar_g_weaponspreadfactor;
  W_SetupProjVelocity_Explicit(proj, w_shotdir + right * s.y + up * s.z, v_up, (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_speed), 0, 0, 0, false);
  (_selftemp = (proj), _selftemp.__touch = ((W_Crylink_Touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (W_Crylink_Touch));

  (_selftemp = (proj), _selftemp.__think = ((W_Crylink_Fadethink) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (W_Crylink_Fadethink));
  if(counter == 0)
  {
   proj.fade_time = time + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_middle_lifetime);
   proj.fade_rate = 1 / (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_middle_fadetime);
   proj.nextthink = time + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_middle_lifetime) + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_middle_fadetime);
  }
  else
  {
   proj.fade_time = time + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_other_lifetime);
   proj.fade_rate = 1 / (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_other_fadetime);
   proj.nextthink = time + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_other_lifetime) + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_other_fadetime);
  }
  proj.teleport_time = time + (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_joindelay);
  proj.cnt = (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_bounces);


  proj.angles = vectoangles(proj.velocity);



  proj.flags = FL_PROJECTILE;
  IL_PUSH(g_projectiles, proj);
  IL_PUSH(g_bot_dodge, proj);
  proj.missile_flags = MIF_SPLASH;

  CSQCProjectile(proj, true, (proj.cnt ? PROJECTILE_CRYLINK_BOUNCING : PROJECTILE_CRYLINK), true);

  __Mutator_Send_EditProjectile(0 , actor, proj);
 }
 if((_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_joinspread) != 0 && (_wep_crylink.wepvar_primary_shots) > 1)
 {
  actor.(weaponentity).crylink_lastgroup = proj;
  W_Crylink_CheckLinks(proj);
  actor.(weaponentity).crylink_waitrelease = 1;
 }
}

vector W_Devastator_SteerTo(vector thisdir, vector goaldir, float maxturn_cos)
{
 if(thisdir * goaldir > maxturn_cos)
  return goaldir;
 if(thisdir * goaldir < -0.9998)
  return thisdir;
 float f, m2;
 vector v;
# 187 "./common/weapons/weapon/devastator.qc"
 f = thisdir * goaldir;


 m2 = maxturn_cos * maxturn_cos;
 v = solve_quadratic(m2 - f * f, 2 * f * (m2 - 1), m2 - 1);
 return normalize(thisdir + goaldir * v.y);
}

void W_Electro_TriggerCombo(vector org, float rad, entity own)
{
 entity e = WarpZone_FindRadius(org, rad, !(_wep_electro.wepvar_combo_comboradius_thruwall));
 while(e)
 {
  if(e.classname == "electro_orb")
  {


   if(((e.realowner).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER) && own != e.realowner)
   {
    e = e.chain;
    continue;
   }

   if((_wep_electro.wepvar_combo_comboradius_thruwall))
   {

    if(((_vlen2 = (e.WarpZone_findradius_dist), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > (((_wep_electro.wepvar_combo_comboradius_thruwall)) ** 2)))
    {
     WarpZone_TraceLine(org, e.origin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, e);
     if(trace_fraction != 1)
     {

      e = e.chain;
      continue;
     }
    }
   }


   e.realowner = own;
   e.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
   e.classname = "electro_orb_chain";


   (_selftemp = (e), _selftemp.__think = ((W_Electro_ExplodeCombo) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (W_Electro_ExplodeCombo));


   float delay = 0;
   if ((_wep_electro.wepvar_combo_speed))
    delay = vlen(e.WarpZone_findradius_dist) / (_wep_electro.wepvar_combo_speed);
   e.nextthink = time + delay;
  }
  e = e.chain;
 }
}

void W_Electro_Bolt_Think(entity this)
{

 if(time >= this.ltime)
 {
  this.use1(this, (0, world), (0, world));
  return;
 }

 if((_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_radius))
 {
  float found = 0;
  entity e = WarpZone_FindRadius(this.origin, (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_radius), true);


  while(e)
  {
   if(e.classname == "electro_orb")
   {


    if(((e.realowner).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER) && this.realowner != e.realowner)
    {
     e = e.chain;
     continue;
    }
    float explode;
    if (this.owner == e.owner)
    {
     explode = (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_own);
    }
    else if ((teamplay ? (this.owner.team == e.owner.team) : (this.owner == e.owner)))
    {
     explode = (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_teammate);
    }
    else
    {
     explode = (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_enemy);
    }

    if (explode)
    {

     e.realowner = this.realowner;
     e.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
     e.classname = "electro_orb_chain";





     (_selftemp = (e), _selftemp.__think = ((W_Electro_ExplodeCombo) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (W_Electro_ExplodeCombo));
     float delay = 0;
     if ((_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_speed))
      delay = vlen(e.WarpZone_findradius_dist) / (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_speed);
     e.nextthink = time + delay;

     ++found;
    }
   }
   e = e.chain;
  }


  if(found && (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_explode))
   { this.use1(this, (0, world), (0, world)); }
  else
   { this.nextthink = min(time + (_wep_electro.wepvar_primary_midaircombo_interval), this.ltime); }
 }
 else { this.nextthink = this.ltime; }

}

   if(!((e).classname == STR_PLAYER) || !this.realowner || (teamplay ? (e.team != this.team) : (e != this)))
   {


    traceline(e.origin + e.view_ofs, this.origin, MOVE_NORMAL, e);
    if( trace_fraction != 1)
     continue;

    traceline(e.origin + e.view_ofs, this.realowner.origin + this.realowner.view_ofs, MOVE_NORMAL, e);
    if(trace_ent != this.realowner)
    if( trace_fraction != 1)
     continue;
    dist = vlen(this.origin - e.origin - e.view_ofs);
    points = (1 - sqrt(dist / (_wep_fireball.wepvar_primary_bfgradius)));
    if(points <= 0)
     continue;
    dir = normalize(e.origin + e.view_ofs - this.origin);

    if(accuracy_isgooddamage(this.realowner, e))
     accuracy_add(this.realowner, WEP_FIREBALL, 0, (_wep_fireball.wepvar_primary_bfgdamage) * points);
