void W_Fireball_LaserPlay(entity this, float dt, float dist, float damage, float edgedamage, float burntime)
{
 entity e;
 float d;
 vector p;

 if(damage <= 0)
  return;

 RandomSelection_Init();
 for(e = WarpZone_FindRadius(this.origin, dist, true); e; e = e.chain)
 {
  if((e).stat_FROZEN) continue;
  if(e == this.realowner) continue;
  if(((e).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER)) continue;
  if(e.takedamage != DAMAGE_AIM) continue;
  if(((e).classname == STR_PLAYER) && this.realowner && (teamplay ? (e.team == this.team) : (e == this))) continue;

  p = e.origin;
  p.x += e.mins.x + random() * (e.maxs.x - e.mins.x);
  p.y += e.mins.y + random() * (e.maxs.y - e.mins.y);
  p.z += e.mins.z + random() * (e.maxs.z - e.mins.z);
  d = vlen(WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(e, this.origin) - p);
  if(d < dist)
  {
   e.fireball_impactvec = p;
   RandomSelection_Add(e, 0, nil, '0 0 0', 1 / (1 + d), !StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_Burning, e));
  }
 }
 if(RandomSelection_chosen_ent)
 {
  d = vlen(WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(RandomSelection_chosen_ent, this.origin) - RandomSelection_chosen_ent.fireball_impactvec);
  d = damage + (edgedamage - damage) * (d / dist);
  Fire_AddDamage(RandomSelection_chosen_ent, this.realowner, d * burntime, burntime, this.projectiledeathtype | HITTYPE_BOUNCE);

  Send_Effect(EFFECT_FIREBALL_LASER, this.origin, RandomSelection_chosen_ent.fireball_impactvec - this.origin, 1);
 }
}

 {
  this.cnt = 1;
  this.projectiledeathtype |= HITTYPE_SPLASH;
  W_Fireball_Explode(this, (0, world));
  return;
 }

 W_Fireball_LaserPlay(this, 0.1, (_wep_fireball.wepvar_primary_laserradius), (_wep_fireball.wepvar_primary_laserdamage), (_wep_fireball.wepvar_primary_laseredgedamage), (_wep_fireball.wepvar_primary_laserburntime));

 this.nextthink = time + 0.1;
}

void W_Hagar_Attack2_Load_Release(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity)
{


 entity missile;
 float counter, shots, spread_pershot;
 vector s;
 vector forward, right, up;

 if(!actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load)
  return;

 weapon_prepareattack_do(actor, weaponentity, true, (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_refire));

 shots = actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load;
 W_SetupShot_Dir_ProjectileSize_Range(actor, weaponentity, v_forward, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', false, 2, SND_HAGAR_FIRE, CH_WEAPON_A, (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_damage) * shots, max_shot_distance, thiswep.m_id | HITTYPE_SECONDARY);
 W_MuzzleFlash(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, w_shotorg, w_shotdir);

 forward = v_forward;
 right = v_right;
 up = v_up;

 missile = (0, world);
 for(counter = 0; counter < shots; ++counter)
 {
  missile = __spawn("missile", "./common/weapons/weapon/hagar.qc" ":" "197", false);
  missile.owner = missile.realowner = actor;
  missile.bot_dodge = true;

  missile.takedamage = DAMAGE_YES;
  SetResourceExplicit(missile, RES_HEALTH, (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_health));
  missile.damageforcescale = (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_damageforcescale);
  missile.event_damage = W_Hagar_Damage;
  missile.damagedbycontents = true;
  IL_PUSH(g_damagedbycontents, missile);

  (_selftemp = (missile), _selftemp.__touch = ((W_Hagar_Touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (W_Hagar_Touch));

  (_selftemp = (missile), _selftemp.__think = ((adaptor_think2use_hittype_splash) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (adaptor_think2use_hittype_splash));
  missile.nextthink = time + (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_lifetime_min) + random() * (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_lifetime_rand);
  (missile).solid = SOLID_CORPSE; (missile).dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE;
  missile.projectiledeathtype = thiswep.m_id | HITTYPE_SECONDARY;
  missile.weaponentity_fld = weaponentity;
  setorigin(missile, w_shotorg);
  setsize(missile, '0 0 0', '0 0 0');
  set_movetype(missile, MOVETYPE_FLY);
  missile.missile_flags = MIF_SPLASH;


  spread_pershot = ((shots - 1) / ((_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_max) - 1));
  spread_pershot = (1 - (spread_pershot * (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_spread_bias)));
  spread_pershot = ((_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_spread) * spread_pershot * autocvar_g_weaponspreadfactor);


  s = '0 0 0';
  if(counter == 0)
   s = '0 0 0';
  else
  {
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/weapons/weapon/hagar.qc", 232, __FUNC__, "\"'0 360 0' * (0.75 + (counter - 0.5) / (shots - 1))\""); _makevectors_hidden('0 360 0' * (0.75 + (counter - 0.5) / (shots - 1))); }else voidfunc();
   s.y = v_forward.x;
   s.z = v_forward.y;
  }
  s = s * (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_spread) * autocvar_g_weaponspreadfactor;

  W_SetupProjVelocity_Explicit(missile, w_shotdir + right * s.y + up * s.z, v_up, (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_speed), 0, 0, spread_pershot, false);

 }

void W_Hagar_Attack2_Load(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity)
{

  return;

  enough_ammo = true;

    actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadstep = time + (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_speed) * W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);


    actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadblock = true;
   }
  }
  else
  {

   if(!stopped)
   {
    if(!actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadblock && actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadstep < time)
    {
     W_DecreaseAmmo(thiswep, actor, (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_ammo), weaponentity);
     actor.(weaponentity).state = WS_INUSE;
     actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load += 1;

     if(actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load >= (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_max))
      stopped = true;
     else
      actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadstep = time + (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_speed) * W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);
    }
   }
   if(stopped && !actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadbeep && actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load)
   {

    if(1){ entity __e = actor; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_WEAPON_A, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_HAGAR_BEEP), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
    actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadbeep = true;
    actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadstep = time + (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_hold) * W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);
   }
  }
 }
 else if(actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadblock)
 {

  actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadblock = false;
 }

 if(actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load)
 {

  if(stopped && actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadstep - 0.5 < time && (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_hold) >= 0)
  {
   if(!actor.(weaponentity).hagar_warning)

   }

  if(!((actor._cs).button3) || (stopped && actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadstep < time && (_wep_hagar.wepvar_secondary_load_hold) >= 0))
  {
   actor.(weaponentity).state = WS_READY;

  }

   return;
  }

void W_Hagar_Attack_Auto(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity, float fire)
{
 if(!(fire & 1) || actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load || actor.(weaponentity).hagar_loadblock || actor.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon != thiswep || !weapon_prepareattack_check(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, false, -1))
 {
  w_ready(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, fire);
  return;
 }

 if(!thiswep.wr_checkammo1(thiswep, actor, weaponentity))
 if(!(actor.items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO))
 {
  W_SwitchWeapon_Force(actor, Weapons_from(W_GetCycleWeapon(actor, (actor).cvar_cl_weaponpriority, 0, -1, false, true, weaponentity)), weaponentity);
  w_ready(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, fire);
  return;
 }

 W_Hagar_Attack(thiswep, actor, weaponentity);

 ((actor).(attack_finished_for[((actor.(weaponentity).m_weapon.m_id) - WEP_FIRST) * MAX_WEAPONSLOTS + (weaponslot(weaponentity))])) = time + (_wep_hagar.wepvar_primary_refire) * W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);
 actor.(weaponentity).wframe = WFRAME_FIRE1;
 weapon_thinkf(actor, weaponentity, WFRAME_DONTCHANGE, (_wep_hagar.wepvar_primary_refire), W_Hagar_Attack_Auto);
}

 dmg_remaining_next = (bound(0, 1 - dt / this.dmg_duration, 1) ** this.dmg_power);

 f = this.dmg_last - dmg_remaining_next;
 this.dmg_last = dmg_remaining_next;

 RadiusDamage(this, this.realowner, this.dmg * f, this.dmg_edge * f, this.dmg_radius, this.realowner, (0, world), this.dmg_force * f, this.projectiledeathtype, this.weaponentity_fld, (0, world));
 this.projectiledeathtype |= HITTYPE_BOUNCE;


 if(dt < this.dmg_duration)
  this.nextthink = time + 0.05;
 else
  if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
}

{

  w_ready(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, fire);
  return;

 fireBullet(actor, weaponentity, w_shotorg, w_shotdir, machinegun_spread, (_wep_machinegun.wepvar_solidpenetration), (_wep_machinegun.wepvar_sustained_damage), 0, (_wep_machinegun.wepvar_sustained_force), thiswep.m_id, EFFECT_BULLET);

void W_MineLayer_ProximityExplode(entity this)
{

}

void W_MineLayer_Think(entity this)
{
 entity head;

 this.nextthink = time;

 if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FOLLOW)
 {
  if(LostMovetypeFollow(this))
  {
   UnsetMovetypeFollow(this);
   set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_NONE);
  }
 }



 if((time > this.cnt) && (!this.mine_time) && (this.cnt > 0))
 {
  if((_wep_minelayer.wepvar_lifetime_countdown) > 0)
   spamsound(this, CH_SHOTS, SND_MINE_TRIGGER, VOL_BASE, ATTN_NORM);
  this.mine_time = time + (_wep_minelayer.wepvar_lifetime_countdown);
  this.mine_explodeanyway = 1;
 }



 if(!((this.realowner).classname == STR_PLAYER) || ((this.realowner).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || (this.realowner).stat_FROZEN)
 {
  this.projectiledeathtype |= HITTYPE_BOUNCE;
  W_MineLayer_Explode(this, (0, world));
  return;
 }


 head = findradius(this.origin, (_wep_minelayer.wepvar_proximityradius));
 while(head)
 {
  if(((head).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((head).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !(head).stat_FROZEN && !((head).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER))
  if(head != this.realowner && (teamplay ? (head.team != this.realowner.team) : (head != this.realowner)))
  if(!this.mine_time)
  {
   spamsound(this, CH_SHOTS, SND_MINE_TRIGGER, VOL_BASE, ATTN_NORM);
   this.mine_time = time + (_wep_minelayer.wepvar_time);
  }
  head = head.chain;
 }


 if(this.mine_time && time >= this.mine_time)
 {
  W_MineLayer_ProximityExplode(this);
  return;
 }


 .entity weaponentity = this.weaponentity_fld;
 if(this.realowner.(weaponentity).m_weapon == WEP_MINE_LAYER)
 if(!((this.realowner).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 if(this.minelayer_detonate)
  W_MineLayer_RemoteExplode(this);
}

void W_MineLayer_Damage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= 0)
  return;

 float is_from_enemy = (inflictor.realowner != this.realowner);

void W_Seeker_Missile_Think(entity this)
{
 entity e;
 vector desireddir, olddir, newdir, eorg;
 float turnrate;
 float dist;
 float spd;

 if(time > this.cnt)
 {
  this.projectiledeathtype |= HITTYPE_SPLASH;
  W_Seeker_Missile_Explode(this, (0, world));
 }

 spd = vlen(this.velocity);
 spd = bound(
  spd - (_wep_seeker.wepvar_missile_decel) * frametime,
  (_wep_seeker.wepvar_missile_speed_max),
  spd + (_wep_seeker.wepvar_missile_accel) * frametime
 );

 if(this.enemy != (0, world))
  if(this.enemy.takedamage != DAMAGE_AIM || ((this.enemy).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
   this.enemy = (0, world);

 if(this.enemy != (0, world))
 {
  e = this.enemy;
  eorg = 0.5 * (e.absmin + e.absmax);
  turnrate = (_wep_seeker.wepvar_missile_turnrate);
  desireddir = normalize(eorg - this.origin);
  olddir = normalize(this.velocity);
  dist = vlen(eorg - this.origin);

float W_Shockwave_Attack_CheckSpread(
 vector targetorg,
 vector nearest_on_line,
 vector sw_shotorg,
 vector attack_endpos)
{
 float spreadlimit;
 float distance_of_attack = vlen(sw_shotorg - attack_endpos);
 float distance_from_line = vlen(targetorg - nearest_on_line);

 spreadlimit = (distance_of_attack ? min(1, (vlen(sw_shotorg - nearest_on_line) / distance_of_attack)) : 1);
 spreadlimit =
  (
   ((_wep_shockwave.wepvar_blast_spread_min) * (1 - spreadlimit))
   +
   ((_wep_shockwave.wepvar_blast_spread_max) * spreadlimit)
  );

 if(
  (spreadlimit && (distance_from_line <= spreadlimit))
  &&
  ((vlen(normalize(targetorg - sw_shotorg) - normalize(attack_endpos - sw_shotorg)) * RAD2DEG) <= 90)
 )
  { return bound(0, (distance_from_line / spreadlimit), 1); }
 else
  { return false; }
}

float W_Shockwave_Attack_IsVisible(
 entity actor,
 entity head,
 vector nearest_on_line,
 vector sw_shotorg,
 vector attack_endpos)
{
 vector nearest_to_attacker = head.WarpZone_findradius_nearest;
 vector center = (head.origin + (head.mins + head.maxs) * 0.5);
 vector corner;
 float i;


 if(W_Shockwave_Attack_CheckSpread(nearest_to_attacker, nearest_on_line, sw_shotorg, attack_endpos))
 {
  WarpZone_TraceLine(sw_shotorg, nearest_to_attacker, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, actor);
  if(trace_fraction == 1) { return true; }
 }


 if(W_Shockwave_Attack_CheckSpread(center, nearest_on_line, sw_shotorg, attack_endpos))
 {
  WarpZone_TraceLine(sw_shotorg, center, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, actor);
  if(trace_fraction == 1) { return true; }
 }


 for(i=1; i<=8; ++i)
 {
  corner = get_corner_position(head, i);
  if(W_Shockwave_Attack_CheckSpread(corner, nearest_on_line, sw_shotorg, attack_endpos))
  {
   WarpZone_TraceLine(sw_shotorg, corner, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, actor);
   if(trace_fraction == 1) { return true; }
  }
 }

 return false;
}

float W_Shockwave_Attack_CheckHit(
 float queue,
 entity head,
 vector final_force,
 float final_damage)
{
 if(!head) { return false; }
 float i;

 for(i = 0; i <= queue; ++i)
 {
  if(shockwave_hit[i] == head)
  {
   if((_vlen2 = (final_force), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > (_vlen2 = (shockwave_hit_force[i]), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2)))) { shockwave_hit_force[i] = final_force; }
   if(final_damage > shockwave_hit_damage[i]) { shockwave_hit_damage[i] = final_damage; }
   return false;
  }
 }

 shockwave_hit[queue] = head;
 shockwave_hit_force[queue] = final_force;
 shockwave_hit_damage[queue] = final_damage;
 return true;
}

float W_Tuba_HasPlayed(entity pl, .entity weaponentity, string melody, float instrument, float ignorepitch, float mintempo, float maxtempo)
{
 float i, j, mmin, mmax, nolength;
 float n = _tokenize_console(melody);
 if(n > pl.(weaponentity).tuba_lastnotes_cnt)
  return false;
 float pitchshift = 0;

 if(instrument >= 0)
  if(pl.(weaponentity).tuba_instrument != instrument)
   return false;


 nolength = false;
 for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
 {
  vector v = pl.(weaponentity).(tuba_lastnotes[(pl.(weaponentity).tuba_lastnotes_last - i + 32) % 32]);
  float ai = stof(argv(n - i - 1));
  float np = floor(ai);
  if(ai == np)
   nolength = true;




  if(ignorepitch && i == 0)
  {
   pitchshift = np - v.z;
  }
  else
  {
   if(v.z + pitchshift != np)
    return false;
  }
 }


 if(!nolength)
 {

  float ti = 0;
  if(maxtempo > 0)
   mmin = 240 / maxtempo;
  else
   mmin = 0;
  if(mintempo > 0)
   mmax = 240 / mintempo;
  else
   mmax = 240;


  for(i = 0; i < n; ++i)
  {
   vector vi = pl.(weaponentity).(tuba_lastnotes[(pl.(weaponentity).tuba_lastnotes_last - i + 32) % 32]);
   float ai = stof(argv(n - i - 1));
   ti -= 1 / (ai - floor(ai));
   float tj = ti;
   for(j = i+1; j < n; ++j)
   {
    vector vj = pl.(weaponentity).(tuba_lastnotes[(pl.(weaponentity).tuba_lastnotes_last - j + 32) % 32]);
    float aj = stof(argv(n - j - 1));
    tj -= (aj - floor(aj));
# 90 "./common/weapons/weapon/tuba.qc"
    mmin = max(mmin, (vi.x - vj.y) / (ti - tj));
    mmax = min(mmax, (vi.y - vj.x) / (ti - tj));
   }
  }

  if(mmin > mmax)
   return false;
 }

 pl.(weaponentity).tuba_lastnotes_cnt = 0;

 return true;
}

{

 if ((pl._cs).movement.x < 0) movestate -= 3;
 else if ((pl._cs).movement.x > 0) movestate += 3;
 if ((pl._cs).movement.y < 0) movestate -= 1;
 else if ((pl._cs).movement.y > 0) movestate += 1;

 float note = 0;
 switch (movestate)
 {
# 161 "./common/weapons/weapon/tuba.qc"
  case 1: note = -6; break;
  case 2: note = -5; break;
  case 3: note = -4; break;
  case 4: note = +5; break;
  default:
  case 5: note = 0; break;
  case 6: note = +2; break;
  case 7: note = +3; break;
  case 8: note = +4; break;
  case 9: note = -1; break;
 }
 if(((pl._cs).button5))
  note -= 12;
 if(((pl._cs).button2))
  note += 12;
 if(hittype & HITTYPE_SECONDARY)
  note += 7;





 if(teamplay)

  if(pl.team == NUM_TEAM_2 || pl.team == NUM_TEAM_4)
   note += 3;
 }
 else
 {
  if(pl.clientcolors & 1)
   note += 3;
 }

 return note;
}

            if(actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval <= time && !actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load)
            {
                if(rapid)
                    actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load = true;
                actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval = time + autocvar_g_rm_laser_refire;
                actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval2 = time + autocvar_g_rm_laser_rapid_delay;
                impressive_hits = 0;
                W_RocketMinsta_Attack(actor, weaponentity, 0);
            }
            else if(rapid && actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval2 <= time && actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load)
            {
                actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval2 = time + autocvar_g_rm_laser_rapid_refire;
                impressive_hits = 0;
                W_RocketMinsta_Attack(actor, weaponentity, 1);

            }
        }
        else if (actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval <= time)
        {

            actor.(weaponentity).jump_interval = time + (_wep_vaporizer.wepvar_secondary_refire) * W_WeaponRateFactor(actor);


            if((_wep_vaporizer.wepvar_secondary_ammo))
                W_DecreaseAmmo(thiswep, actor, (_wep_vaporizer.wepvar_secondary_ammo), weaponentity);

            if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/weapons/weapon/vaporizer.qc", 305, __FUNC__, "\"actor.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(actor.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
            W_Blaster_Attack(actor, weaponentity, WEP_BLASTER.m_id | HITTYPE_SECONDARY);


            weapon_thinkf(actor, weaponentity, WFRAME_FIRE2, (_wep_vaporizer.wepvar_secondary_animtime), w_ready);
        }
    }
    else
        actor.(weaponentity).hagar_load = false;
}

void W_Vortex_Attack(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity, float issecondary)
{
 float mydmg, myforce, mymindist, mymaxdist, myhalflife, myforcehalflife, myammo, charge;

 mydmg = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_damage) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_damage));
 myforce = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_force) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_force));
 mymindist = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_damagefalloff_mindist) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_damagefalloff_mindist));
 mymaxdist = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_damagefalloff_maxdist) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_damagefalloff_maxdist));
 myhalflife = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_damagefalloff_halflife) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_damagefalloff_halflife));
 myforcehalflife = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_damagefalloff_forcehalflife) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_damagefalloff_forcehalflife));
 myammo = ((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_ammo) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_ammo));

 float dtype = thiswep.m_id;
 if(((!issecondary) ? (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_armorpierce) : (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_armorpierce)))
  dtype |= HITTYPE_ARMORPIERCE;

 float flying;
 flying = IsFlying(actor);

 if((_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge))
 {
  charge = (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_mindmg) / mydmg + (1 - (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_mindmg) / mydmg) * actor.(weaponentity).vortex_charge;
  actor.(weaponentity).vortex_charge *= (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_shot_multiplier);


 }
 else
  charge = 1;
 mydmg *= charge;
 myforce *= charge;

 W_SetupShot_Dir_ProjectileSize_Range(actor, weaponentity, v_forward, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', true, 5, SND_NEXFIRE, CH_WEAPON_A, mydmg, max_shot_distance, dtype);
 if(charge > (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_animlimit) && (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_animlimit))
 {
  if(1){ entity __e = actor; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_WEAPON_B, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_NEXCHARGE), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE * (charge - 0.5 * (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_animlimit)) / (1 - 0.5 * (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_animlimit)), ATTN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
 }

 yoda = 0;
 impressive_hits = 0;
 FireRailgunBullet(actor, weaponentity, w_shotorg, w_shotorg + w_shotdir * max_shot_distance, mydmg, false, myforce, mymindist, mymaxdist, myhalflife, myforcehalflife, dtype);

 if(yoda && flying)
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, actor, MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_ACHIEVEMENT_YODA);
 if(impressive_hits && actor.vortex_lasthit)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, actor, MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_ACHIEVEMENT_IMPRESSIVE);
  impressive_hits = 0;
 }

 actor.vortex_lasthit = impressive_hits;


 vector v = WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(WarpZone_trace_transform, trace_endpos);
 W_MuzzleFlash(thiswep, actor, weaponentity, w_shotorg, normalize(v - w_shotorg));
 SendCSQCVortexBeamParticle(charge);

 W_DecreaseAmmo(thiswep, actor, myammo, weaponentity);
}

       actor.vortex_chargepool_pauseregen_finished = time + (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_chargepool_pause_regen);
       dt = min(dt, actor.(weaponentity).vortex_chargepool_ammo);
       dt = max(0, dt);

       actor.(weaponentity).vortex_charge += dt * (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_rate);
      }
     }

     else if((_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_ammo))
     {

      {

       if(!(actor.items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO))
       {

        {
         dt = min(dt, (actor.(weaponentity).clip_load - (_wep_vortex.wepvar_primary_ammo)) / (_wep_vortex.wepvar_secondary_ammo));

         dt = max(0, dt);

         }
        }
       }
       actor.(weaponentity).vortex_charge += dt * (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_rate);
      }
     }

     else
     {
      dt = min(dt, (1 - actor.(weaponentity).vortex_charge) / (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_rate));
      actor.(weaponentity).vortex_charge += dt * (_wep_vortex.wepvar_charge_rate);

WepSet _WepSet_FromWeapon(float a)
{
 a -= WEP_FIRST;
 if (Weapons_MAX > 24)
  if (a >= 24)
  {
   a -= 24;
   if (Weapons_MAX > 48)
    if (a >= 24)
    {
     a -= 24;
     return '0 0 1' * (1 << (a));
    }
   return '0 1 0' * (1 << (a));
  }
 return '1 0 0' * (1 << (a));
}

 void WriteWepSet(float dst, WepSet w)
 {
  if (Weapons_MAX > 48) WriteInt72_t(dst, w);
  else if (Weapons_MAX > 24) WriteInt48_t(dst, w);
  else WriteInt24_t(dst, w.x);
 }

{

{
 switch (algn)
 {
  default:
  case 3:

   break;
  case 4:

   vecs.y = -vecs.y;

  case 2:

   vecs.y = 0;
   vecs.z -= 2;

}

{
 string s;
 if (visual)
 {
  vecs = shotorg_adjustfromclient(vecs, y_is_right, algn);

 else if ((0, (STATS).stat_SHOOTFROMEYE))
 {
  vecs.y = vecs.z = 0;
 }
 else if ((0, (STATS).stat_SHOOTFROMCENTER))
 {
  vecs.y = 0;
  vecs.z -= 2;
 }
 else if ((s = autocvar_g_shootfromfixedorigin) != "")
 {
  vector v = stov(s);
  if (y_is_right) v.y = -v.y;
  if (v.x != 0) vecs.x = v.x;
  vecs.y = v.y;
  vecs.z = v.z;
 }
 else
 {
  vecs = shotorg_adjustfromclient(vecs, y_is_right, algn);
 }

 return vecs;
}

{

 else
  m = "models/monsters/*_";

}

void Monster_Attack_Check(entity this, entity targ, .entity weaponentity)
{
 float slot = weaponslot(weaponentity);

 if((!this || !targ)
 || (!this.monster_attackfunc)
 || (game_stopped)
 || (time < this.attack_finished_single[slot])
 || ((autocvar_g_monsters_target_infront || (this.spawnflags & MONSTERFLAG_INFRONT)) && !monster_facing(this, targ))
 ) { return; }

 if(((_vlen2 = (targ.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((this.attack_range) ** 2)))
 {
  monster_makevectors(this, targ);
  float attack_success = this.monster_attackfunc(MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE, this, targ, weaponentity);
  if(attack_success == 1)
   Monster_Sound(this, monstersound_melee, 0, false, CH_VOICE);
  else if(attack_success > 0)
   return;
 }

 if(((_vlen2 = (targ.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((this.attack_range) ** 2)))
 {
  monster_makevectors(this, targ);
  float attack_success = this.monster_attackfunc(MONSTER_ATTACK_RANGED, this, targ, weaponentity);
  if(attack_success == 1)
   Monster_Sound(this, monstersound_melee, 0, false, CH_VOICE);
  else if(attack_success > 0)
   return;
 }
}

vector Monster_Move_Target(entity this, entity targ)
{

 if(this.enemy)
 {
  vector targ_origin = ((this.enemy.absmin + this.enemy.absmax) * 0.5);
  targ_origin = WarpZone_RefSys_TransformOrigin(this.enemy, this, targ_origin);

  if(this.enemy)
  {





   this.monster_movestate = MONSTER_MOVE_ENEMY;
   this.last_trace = time + 1.2;
   if(this.monster_moveto)
    return this.monster_moveto;
   else
    return targ_origin;
  }





 }

 switch(this.monster_moveflags)
 {
  case MONSTER_MOVE_FOLLOW:
  {
   this.monster_movestate = MONSTER_MOVE_FOLLOW;
   this.last_trace = time + 0.3;
   return (this.monster_follow) ? this.monster_follow.origin : this.origin;
  }
  case MONSTER_MOVE_SPAWNLOC:
  {
   this.monster_movestate = MONSTER_MOVE_SPAWNLOC;
   this.last_trace = time + 2;
   return this.pos1;
  }
  case MONSTER_MOVE_NOMOVE:
  {
   if(this.monster_moveto)
   {
    this.last_trace = time + 0.5;
    return this.monster_moveto;
   }
   else
   {
    this.monster_movestate = MONSTER_MOVE_NOMOVE;
    this.last_trace = time + 2;
   }
   return this.origin;
  }
  default:
  case MONSTER_MOVE_WANDER:
  {
   vector pos;
   this.monster_movestate = MONSTER_MOVE_WANDER;

   if(this.monster_moveto)
   {
    this.last_trace = time + 0.5;
    pos = this.monster_moveto;
   }
   else if(targ)
   {
    this.last_trace = time + 0.5;
    pos = targ.origin;
   }
   else
   {
    this.last_trace = time + this.wander_delay;

    this.angles_y = rint(random() * 500);
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/monsters/sv_monsters.qc", 667, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();
    pos = this.origin + v_forward * this.wander_distance;

    if(((this.flags & FL_FLY) && (this.spawnflags & MONSTERFLAG_FLY_VERTICAL)) || (this.flags & FL_SWIM))
    {
     pos.z = random() * 200;
     if(random() >= 0.5)
      pos.z *= -1;
    }
   }

   return pos;
  }
 }
}

.entity draggedby;

void Monster_Move(entity this, float runspeed, float walkspeed, float stpspeed)
{

 if(this.target2 && this.target2 != "" && this.goalentity.targetname != this.target2)
  this.goalentity = find((0, world), targetname, this.target2);

 if((this).stat_FROZEN)
 {
  movelib_brake_simple(this, stpspeed);
  anim_set(this, this.anim_idle, true, false, false);
  return;
 }

 if(this.flags & FL_SWIM)
 {
  if(this.waterlevel < WATERLEVEL_WETFEET)
  {
   if(time >= this.last_trace)
   {
    this.last_trace = time + 0.4;

    Damage (this, (0, world), (0, world), 2, DEATH_DROWN.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), this.origin, '0 0 0');
    this.angles = '90 90 0';
    if(random() < 0.5)
    {
     this.velocity_y += random() * 50;
     this.velocity_x -= random() * 50;
    }
    else
    {
     this.velocity_y -= random() * 50;
     this.velocity_x += random() * 50;
    }
    this.velocity_z += random() * 150;
   }


   set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_BOUNCE);


   return;
  }
  else if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE)
  {
   this.angles_x = 0;
   set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_WALK);
  }
 }

 entity targ = this.goalentity;

 if (__Mutator_Send_MonsterMove(0 , this, runspeed, walkspeed, targ)
  || game_stopped
  || this.draggedby != (0, world)
  || ((round_handler != (0, world)) && !(!round_handler.wait && !round_handler.cnt))
  || time < game_starttime
  || (autocvar_g_campaign && !campaign_bots_may_start)
  || time < this.spawn_time)
 {
  runspeed = walkspeed = 0;
  if(time >= this.spawn_time)
   anim_set(this, this.anim_idle, true, false, false);
  movelib_brake_simple(this, stpspeed);
  return;
 }

 targ = MUTATOR_ARGV_3_entity;
 runspeed = bound(0, MUTATOR_ARGV_1_float * (0.5 + this.monster_skill * ((1.2 - 0.3) / 10)), runspeed * 2.5);
 walkspeed = bound(0, MUTATOR_ARGV_2_float * (0.5 + this.monster_skill * ((1.2 - 0.3) / 10)), walkspeed * 2.5);

 if(teamplay && autocvar_g_monsters_teams)
 if((teamplay ? (this.monster_follow.team != this.team) : (this.monster_follow != this)))
  this.monster_follow = (0, world);

 if(this.state == MONSTER_ATTACK_RANGED && (((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
 {
  this.state = 0;
  (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__touch = ((Monster_Touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (Monster_Touch));
 }

 if(this.state && time >= this.attack_finished_single[0])
  this.state = 0;

 if(this.state != MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE)
 if(time >= this.last_trace || this.enemy)
  this.moveto = Monster_Move_Target(this, targ);

 if(!this.enemy)
  Monster_Sound(this, monstersound_idle, 7, true, CH_VOICE);

 if(this.state == MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE)
  this.moveto = this.origin;

 if(this.enemy && this.enemy.vehicle)
  runspeed = 0;

 if(!(this.spawnflags & MONSTERFLAG_FLY_VERTICAL) && !(this.flags & FL_SWIM))
  this.moveto_z = this.origin_z;

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/monsters/sv_monsters.qc", 784, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();
 float vz = this.velocity_z;

 if(!turret_closetotarget(this, this.moveto, 16))
 {
  float do_run = (this.enemy || this.monster_moveto);
  this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - 0.4) + (v_forward * 0.4) * ((do_run) ? runspeed : walkspeed);

  if(time > this.pain_finished && time > this.anim_finished)
  if(!this.state)
  {
   if(((_vlen2 = (this.velocity), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((10) ** 2)))
    anim_set(this, ((do_run) ? this.anim_run : this.anim_walk), true, false, false);
   else
    anim_set(this, this.anim_idle, true, false, false);
  }
 }
 else
 {
  entity e = this.goalentity;
  if(e.target2 && e.target2 != "")
   this.target2 = e.target2;
  else if(e.target && e.target != "")
   this.target2 = e.target;

  movelib_brake_simple(this, stpspeed);
  if(time > this.anim_finished && time > this.pain_finished)
  if(!this.state)
  if(((_vlen2 = (this.velocity), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((30) ** 2)))
   anim_set(this, this.anim_idle, true, false, false);
 }

 if(!((this.flags & FL_FLY) || (this.flags & FL_SWIM)))
  this.velocity_z = vz;

 this.steerto = steerlib_attract2(this, ((this.monster_face) ? this.monster_face : this.moveto), 0.5, 500, 0.95);

 vector real_angle = vectoangles(this.steerto) - this.angles;
 float turny = 25;
 if(this.state == MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE)
  turny = 0;
 if(turny)
 {
  turny = bound(turny * -1, shortangle_f(real_angle.y, this.angles.y), turny);
  this.angles_y += turny;
 }
}

  return;

  return;

  return;

  Monster_Sound(this, monstersound_pain, 1.2, true, CH_PAIN);

 if(deathtype != DEATH_DROWN.m_id && take)

  Violence_GibSplash_At(hitloc, force, 2, bound(0, take, 200) / 16, this, attacker);
  if (take > 50)
   Violence_GibSplash_At(hitloc, force * -0.1, 3, 1, this, attacker);
  if (take > 100)
   Violence_GibSplash_At(hitloc, force * -0.2, 3, 1, this, attacker);
 }

 if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= 0)
 {
  if(deathtype == DEATH_KILL.m_id)
   this.candrop = false;


  SUB_UseTargets(this, attacker, this.enemy);
  this.target2 = this.oldtarget2;

  Monster_Dead(this, attacker, (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= -100 || deathtype == DEATH_KILL.m_id));

  WaypointSprite_Kill(this.sprite);

  __Mutator_Send_MonsterDies(0 , this, attacker, deathtype);

  if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= -100 || deathtype == DEATH_KILL.m_id)
  {
   Violence_GibSplash(this, 1, 0.5, attacker);

   (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((SUB_Remove) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (SUB_Remove));
   this.nextthink = time + 0.1;
  }
 }
}

float M_Golem_Attack(float attack_type, entity actor, entity targ, .entity weaponentity)
{
 switch(attack_type)
 {
  case MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE:
  {
   anim_set(actor, ((random() >= 0.5) ? actor.anim_melee2 : actor.anim_melee3), false, true, true);
   float swing_cnt = bound(1, floor(random() * 4), 3);
   Monster_Delay(actor, swing_cnt, 0.5, M_Golem_Attack_Swing);
   actor.anim_finished = actor.attack_finished_single[0] = time + (0.5 * swing_cnt);
   return true;
  }
  case MONSTER_ATTACK_RANGED:
  {
   float randomness = random();

   if(time < actor.golem_lastattack || !(((actor).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
    return false;

   if(randomness <= 0.5 && ((_vlen2 = (actor.enemy.origin - actor.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((autocvar_g_monster_golem_attack_smash_range) ** 2)))
   {
    anim_set(actor, actor.anim_melee1, false, true, true);
    Monster_Delay(actor, 1, 1.1, M_Golem_Attack_Smash);
    if(actor.animstate_endtime > time)
     actor.anim_finished = actor.animstate_endtime;
    else
     actor.anim_finished = time + 1.2;
    actor.attack_finished_single[0] = actor.anim_finished + 0.2;
    actor.state = MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE;
    actor.golem_lastattack = time + 3 + random() * 1.5;
    return true;
   }
   else if(randomness <= 0.1 && ((_vlen2 = (actor.enemy.origin - actor.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) >= ((autocvar_g_monster_golem_attack_smash_range * 1.5) ** 2)))
   {
    anim_set(actor, actor.anim_melee2, true, true, false);
    actor.state = MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE;
    actor.attack_finished_single[0] = time + 1.1;
    actor.anim_finished = 1.1;
    actor.golem_lastattack = time + 3 + random() * 1.5;
    Monster_Delay(actor, 1, 0.6, M_Golem_Attack_Lightning);
    return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

float M_Mage_Defend_Heal_Check(entity this, entity targ)
{
 if(targ == (0, world))
  return false;
 if(GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) <= 0)
  return false;
 if((teamplay ? (targ.team != this.team) : (targ != this)) && targ != this.monster_follow)
  return false;
 if((targ).stat_FROZEN)
  return false;
 if(!((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return ((targ.flags & FL_MONSTER) && GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) < targ.max_health);
 if(StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_Shield, targ))
  return false;

 switch(this.skin)
 {
  case 0: return (GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) < autocvar_g_balance_health_regenstable);
  case 1:
  {
   return ((GetResource(targ, RES_CELLS) && GetResource(targ, RES_CELLS) < g_pickup_cells_max)
    || (GetResource(targ, RES_PLASMA) && GetResource(targ, RES_PLASMA) < g_pickup_plasma_max)
    || (GetResource(targ, RES_ROCKETS) && GetResource(targ, RES_ROCKETS) < g_pickup_rockets_max)
    || (GetResource(targ, RES_BULLETS) && GetResource(targ, RES_BULLETS) < g_pickup_nails_max)
    || (GetResource(targ, RES_SHELLS) && GetResource(targ, RES_SHELLS) < g_pickup_shells_max)
     );
  }
  case 2: return (GetResource(targ, RES_ARMOR) < autocvar_g_balance_armor_regenstable);
 }

 return false;
}

void M_Mage_Attack_Spike_Think(entity this)
{
 if (time > this.ltime || (this.enemy && GetResource(this.enemy, RES_HEALTH) <= 0) || !this.owner || GetResource(this.owner, RES_HEALTH) <= 0) {
  this.projectiledeathtype |= HITTYPE_SPLASH;
  M_Mage_Attack_Spike_Explode(this, (0, world));
 }

 float spd = vlen(this.velocity);
 spd = bound(
  spd - (autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_decel) * frametime,
  (autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_speed_max),
  spd + (autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_accel) * frametime
 );

 if (this.enemy != (0, world))
  if (this.enemy.takedamage != DAMAGE_AIM || ((this.enemy).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
   this.enemy = (0, world);

 if (this.enemy != (0, world))
 {
  entity e = this.enemy;
  vector eorg = 0.5 * (e.absmin + e.absmax);
  float turnrate = (autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_turnrate);
  vector desireddir = normalize(eorg - this.origin);
  vector olddir = normalize(this.velocity);


  if ((autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_smart) && ((_vlen2 = (eorg - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_smart_mindist) ** 2)))
  {

   if ( (_vlen2 = (this.origin + olddir * this.wait), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (eorg - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))))
    traceline(this.origin, this.origin + olddir * this.wait, false, this);
   else
    traceline(this.origin, eorg, false, this);


   this.wait = bound((autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_smart_trace_min), vlen(this.origin - trace_endpos), this.wait = (autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_smart_trace_max));


   desireddir = normalize(((trace_plane_normal * (1 - trace_fraction)) + (desireddir * trace_fraction)) * 0.5);
  }

  vector newdir = normalize(olddir + desireddir * turnrate);
  this.velocity = newdir * spd;
 }




 this.nextthink = time;
 UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
}

float M_Mage_Attack(float attack_type, entity actor, entity targ, .entity weaponentity)
{
 switch(attack_type)
 {
  case MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE:
  {
   if(random() <= autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_push_chance)
   {
    Weapon wep = WEP_MAGE_SPIKE;

    wep.wr_think(wep, actor, weaponentity, 2);
    return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
  case MONSTER_ATTACK_RANGED:
  {
   if(random() <= autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_teleport_chance)
   {
    OffhandWeapon off = OFFHAND_MAGE_TELEPORT;
    actor.OffhandMageTeleport_key_pressed = 0;
    off.offhand_think(off, actor, 1);
    return true;
   }
   else if(!actor.mage_spike && random() <= autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_chance)
   {
    anim_set(actor, actor.anim_shoot, true, true, true);
    actor.attack_finished_single[0] = time + (autocvar_g_monster_mage_attack_spike_delay);
    actor.anim_finished = time + 1;
    actor.state = MONSTER_ATTACK_MELEE;
    Weapon wep = WEP_MAGE_SPIKE;
    wep.wr_think(wep, actor, weaponentity, 1);
    return true;
   }

   return false;
  }
 }

 return false;
}

void T_Config_Queue(string setting)
{
 if (TUR_CONFIG_COUNT <= MAX_CONFIG_SETTINGS - 1)
  config_queue[TUR_CONFIG_COUNT++] = setting;
}

void T_Config_Queue_Swap(float root, float child, entity pass)
{
 string oldroot = config_queue[root];
 config_queue[root] = config_queue[child];
 config_queue[child] = oldroot;
}

float T_Config_Queue_Compare(float root, float child, entity pass)
{
 float i, r, c;

 for(i = 1; i <= 100; ++i)
 {
  r = _str2chr(config_queue[root], i);
  c = _str2chr(config_queue[child], i);
  if(r == c) { continue; }
  else if(c > r) { return -1; }
  else { return 1; }
 }

 return 0;
}

vector turret_aim_generic(entity this)
{

 vector pre_pos, prep;
 float distance, impact_time = 0, i, mintime;

 turret_tag_fire_update(this);

 if(this.aim_flags & TFL_AIM_SIMPLE)
  return real_origin(this.enemy);

 mintime = max(this.attack_finished_single[0] - time,0) + sys_frametime;


 pre_pos = real_origin(this.enemy);


 if (this.aim_flags & TFL_AIM_LEAD)
 {
  if (this.aim_flags & TFL_AIM_SHOTTIMECOMPENSATE)
  {
   prep = pre_pos;

   distance = vlen(prep - this.tur_shotorg);
   impact_time = distance / this.shot_speed;

   prep = pre_pos + (this.enemy.velocity * (impact_time + mintime));

   if(this.aim_flags & TFL_AIM_ZPREDICT)
   if(!(((this.enemy).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0))
   if(this.enemy.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_WALK || this.enemy.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_TOSS || this.enemy.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_BOUNCE)
   {
    float vz;
    prep_z = pre_pos_z;
    vz = this.enemy.velocity_z;
    for(i = 0; i < impact_time; i += sys_frametime)
    {
     vz = vz - (cvar("sv_gravity") * sys_frametime);
     prep_z = prep_z + vz * sys_frametime;
    }
   }
   pre_pos = prep;
  }
  else
   pre_pos = pre_pos + this.enemy.velocity * mintime;
 }

 if(this.aim_flags & TFL_AIM_SPLASH)
 {

  traceline(pre_pos + '0 0 32',pre_pos -'0 0 64',MOVE_WORLDONLY,this.enemy);
  if(trace_fraction != 1.0)
   pre_pos = trace_endpos;
 }

 return pre_pos;
}

{

void turret_damage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector vforce)
{

 if(this.deadflag == DEAD_DEAD)
  return;


 if(!this.active)
  return;

 if((teamplay ? (this.team == attacker.team) : (this == attacker)))
 {
  if(autocvar_g_friendlyfire)
   damage = damage * autocvar_g_friendlyfire;
  else
   return;
 }

 TakeResource(this, RES_HEALTH, damage);


 if (this.damage_flags & TFL_DMG_HEADSHAKE)
 {
  this.tur_head.angles_x = this.tur_head.angles_x + (-0.5 + random()) * damage;
  this.tur_head.angles_y = this.tur_head.angles_y + (-0.5 + random()) * damage;

  this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;
 }

 if (this.turret_flags & TUR_FLAG_MOVE)
  this.velocity = this.velocity + vforce;

 if (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= 0)
 {
  this.event_damage = nil;
  this.tur_head.event_damage = nil;
  this.event_heal = nil;
  this.tur_head.event_heal = nil;
  this.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
  this.nextthink = time;
  (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((turret_die) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (turret_die));
 }

 this.SendFlags |= TNSF_STATUS;
}

float turret_heal(entity targ, entity inflictor, float amount, float limit)
{
 float true_limit = ((limit != RES_LIMIT_NONE) ? limit : targ.max_health);
 if(GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) <= 0 || GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) >= true_limit)
  return false;

 GiveResourceWithLimit(targ, RES_HEALTH, amount, true_limit);
 targ.SendFlags |= TNSF_STATUS;
 return true;
}

void turret_track(entity this)
{
 vector target_angle;
 vector move_angle;
 float f_tmp;
 vector v1, v2;
 v1 = this.tur_head.angles;
 v2 = this.tur_head.avelocity;

 if (this.track_flags == TFL_TRACK_NO)
  return;

 if(!this.active)
  target_angle = this.idle_aim - ('1 0 0' * this.aim_maxpitch);
 else if (this.enemy == (0, world))
 {
  if(time > this.lip)
   target_angle = this.idle_aim + this.angles;
  else
   target_angle = vectoangles(normalize(this.tur_aimpos - this.tur_shotorg));
 }
 else
 {
  target_angle = vectoangles(normalize(this.tur_aimpos - this.tur_shotorg));
 }

 this.tur_head.angles_x = anglemods(this.tur_head.angles_x);
 this.tur_head.angles_y = anglemods(this.tur_head.angles_y);





 move_angle = AnglesTransform_ToAngles(AnglesTransform_LeftDivide(AnglesTransform_FromAngles(this.angles), AnglesTransform_FromAngles(target_angle))) - this.tur_head.angles;
 move_angle = shortangle_vxy(move_angle, this.tur_head.angles);

 switch(this.track_type)
 {
  case TFL_TRACKTYPE_STEPMOTOR:
   f_tmp = this.aim_speed * this.ticrate;
   if (this.track_flags & TFL_TRACK_PITCH)
   {
    this.tur_head.angles_x += bound(-f_tmp,move_angle_x, f_tmp);
    if(this.tur_head.angles_x > this.aim_maxpitch)
     this.tur_head.angles_x = this.aim_maxpitch;

    if(this.tur_head.angles_x < -this.aim_maxpitch)
     this.tur_head.angles_x = this.aim_maxpitch;
   }

   if (this.track_flags & TFL_TRACK_ROTATE)
   {
    this.tur_head.angles_y += bound(-f_tmp, move_angle_y, f_tmp);
    if(this.tur_head.angles_y > this.aim_maxrot)
     this.tur_head.angles_y = this.aim_maxrot;

    if(this.tur_head.angles_y < -this.aim_maxrot)
     this.tur_head.angles_y = this.aim_maxrot;
   }


   this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;

   return;

  case TFL_TRACKTYPE_FLUIDINERTIA:
   f_tmp = this.aim_speed * this.ticrate;
   move_angle_x = bound(-this.aim_speed, move_angle_x * this.track_accel_pitch * f_tmp, this.aim_speed);
   move_angle_y = bound(-this.aim_speed, move_angle_y * this.track_accel_rot * f_tmp, this.aim_speed);
   move_angle = (this.tur_head.avelocity * this.track_blendrate) + (move_angle * (1 - this.track_blendrate));
   break;

  case TFL_TRACKTYPE_FLUIDPRECISE:

   move_angle_y = bound(-this.aim_speed, move_angle_y, this.aim_speed);
   move_angle_x = bound(-this.aim_speed, move_angle_x, this.aim_speed);

   break;
 }


 if (this.track_flags & TFL_TRACK_PITCH)
 {
  this.tur_head.avelocity_x = move_angle_x;
  if((this.tur_head.angles_x + this.tur_head.avelocity_x * this.ticrate) > this.aim_maxpitch)
  {
   this.tur_head.avelocity_x = 0;
   this.tur_head.angles_x = this.aim_maxpitch;

   this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;
  }

  if((this.tur_head.angles_x + this.tur_head.avelocity_x * this.ticrate) < -this.aim_maxpitch)
  {
   this.tur_head.avelocity_x = 0;
   this.tur_head.angles_x = -this.aim_maxpitch;

   this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;
  }
 }


 if (this.track_flags & TFL_TRACK_ROTATE)
 {
  this.tur_head.avelocity_y = move_angle_y;

  if((this.tur_head.angles_y + this.tur_head.avelocity_y * this.ticrate) > this.aim_maxrot)
  {
   this.tur_head.avelocity_y = 0;
   this.tur_head.angles_y = this.aim_maxrot;

   this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;
  }

  if((this.tur_head.angles_y + this.tur_head.avelocity_y * this.ticrate) < -this.aim_maxrot)
  {
   this.tur_head.avelocity_y = 0;
   this.tur_head.angles_y = -this.aim_maxrot;

   this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;
  }
 }

 this.SendFlags |= TNSF_AVEL;


 this.turret_framecounter += 1;
 if(this.turret_framecounter >= 10)
 {
  this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANG;
  this.turret_framecounter = 0;
 }
}

entity turret_select_target(entity this)
{
 entity e;
 float score;
 entity e_enemy;
 float m_score;

 m_score = 0;
 if(this.enemy && this.enemy.takedamage && turret_validate_target(this,this.enemy,this.target_validate_flags) > 0)
 {
  e_enemy = this.enemy;
  m_score = this.turret_score_target(this,e_enemy) * this.target_select_samebias;
 }
 else
  e_enemy = this.enemy = (0, world);

 e = findradius(this.origin, this.target_range);


 if (!e)
  return (0, world);

 while (e)
 {
  if(e.takedamage)
  {
   float f = turret_validate_target(this, e, this.target_select_flags);

   if ( f > 0)
   {
    score = this.turret_score_target(this,e);
    if ((score > m_score) && (score > 0))
    {
     e_enemy = e;
     m_score = score;
    }
   }
  }
  e = e.chain;
 }

 return e_enemy;
}

float turret_firecheck(entity this)
{

 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_NO)
  return true;

 if (this.enemy == (0, world))
  return false;


 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_REFIRE)
  if (this.attack_finished_single[0] > time) return false;


 if (this.shoot_flags & TFL_SHOOT_VOLLYALWAYS)
  if (this.volly_counter != this.shot_volly)
   if(this.ammo >= this.shot_dmg)
    return true;


 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_DEAD)
  if (((this.enemy).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
   return false;


 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_AMMO_OWN)
  if (this.ammo < this.shot_dmg)
   return false;


 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_AMMO_OTHER)
  if (this.enemy.ammo >= this.enemy.ammo_max)
   return false;


 if(turret_validate_target(this, this.tur_impactent, this.target_validate_flags) > 0)
 {
  this.enemy = this.tur_impactent;
  return true;
 }

 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_DISTANCES)
 {

  if (this.tur_dist_aimpos < this.target_range_min)
  {
   if(turret_validate_target(this, this.tur_impactent, this.target_validate_flags) > 0)
    return true;
   return false;
  }
 }


 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_AFF)
  if (this.tur_impactent.team == this.team)
   return false;


 if (this.firecheck_flags & TFL_FIRECHECK_AIMDIST)
  if (this.tur_dist_impact_to_aimpos > this.aim_firetolerance_dist)
   return false;


 if (this.shot_volly > 1)
  if (this.volly_counter == this.shot_volly)
   if (this.ammo < (this.shot_dmg * this.shot_volly))
    return false;





 return true;
}

void turret_fire(entity this)
{
 if (autocvar_g_turrets_nofire != 0)
  return;

 if(__Mutator_Send_TurretFire(0 , this))
  return;

 Turret info = Turrets_from(this.m_id);
 info.tr_attack(info, this);

 this.attack_finished_single[0] = time + this.shot_refire;
 this.ammo -= this.shot_dmg;
 this.volly_counter = this.volly_counter - 1;

 if (this.volly_counter <= 0)
 {
  this.volly_counter = this.shot_volly;

  if (this.shoot_flags & TFL_SHOOT_CLEARTARGET)
   this.enemy = (0, world);

  if (this.shot_volly > 1)
   this.attack_finished_single[0] = time + this.shot_volly_refire;
 }




}

float autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_fast;
float autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_slow;
float autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_slower;
float autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_stop;
float autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_turnrate;

const float ewheel_anim_stop = 0;
const float ewheel_anim_fwd_slow = 1;
const float ewheel_anim_fwd_fast = 2;
const float ewheel_anim_bck_slow = 3;
const float ewheel_anim_bck_fast = 4;

void ewheel_move_path(entity this)
{

    if(turret_closetotarget(this, this.pathcurrent.origin, 64))
    {
# 46 "./common/turrets/turret/ewheel.qc"
        this.pathcurrent = this.pathcurrent.enemy;

    }

    if (this.pathcurrent)
    {
        this.moveto = this.pathcurrent.origin;
        this.steerto = steerlib_attract2(this, this.moveto, 0.5, 500, 0.95);

        this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - 0.4) + (v_forward * 0.4) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_fast);
    }
}

void ewheel_move_enemy(entity this)
{
    float newframe;

    this.steerto = steerlib_arrive(this, this.enemy.origin,this.target_range_optimal);

    this.moveto = this.origin + this.steerto * 128;

    if (this.tur_dist_enemy > this.target_range_optimal)
    {
        if ( this.tur_head.spawnshieldtime < 1 )
        {
            newframe = ewheel_anim_fwd_fast;
            this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - 0.4) + (v_forward * 0.4) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_fast);
        }
        else if (this.tur_head.spawnshieldtime < 2)
        {

            newframe = ewheel_anim_fwd_slow;
            this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - 0.4) + (v_forward * 0.4) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_slow);
       }
        else
        {
            newframe = ewheel_anim_fwd_slow;
            this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - 0.4) + (v_forward * 0.4) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_slower);
        }
    }
    else if (this.tur_dist_enemy < this.target_range_optimal * 0.5)
    {
        newframe = ewheel_anim_bck_slow;
        this.velocity = this.velocity * (1 - 0.4) + (v_forward * -1 * 0.4) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_slow);
    }
    else
    {
        newframe = ewheel_anim_stop;
        movelib_brake_simple(this, (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_stop));
    }

    turrets_setframe(this, newframe, false);
}

void ewheel_move_idle(entity this)
{
    if(this.frame != 0)
    {
        this.SendFlags |= TNSF_ANIM;
        this.anim_start_time = time;
    }

    this.frame = 0;
    if(this.velocity)
        movelib_brake_simple(this, (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_ewheel_speed_stop));
}

{
    vector olddir,newdir;
    vector pre_pos;
    float itime;

    this.nextthink = time + 0.05;

    olddir = normalize(this.velocity);

    if(this.max_health < time)
        turret_projectile_explode(this);


    if ((this.enemy == (0, world)) || (((this.enemy).deadflag != DEAD_NO)))
    {


        this.enemy = (0, world);


        this.angles = vectoangles(this.velocity);

        if(((_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.owner.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > (((this.owner.shot_radius * 5)) ** 2)))

        UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);

        return;
    }


    if(((_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.enemy.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((this.owner.shot_radius * 0.2) ** 2)))
        turret_projectile_explode(this);


    itime = vlen(this.enemy.origin - this.origin) / vlen(this.velocity);
    pre_pos = this.enemy.origin + this.enemy.velocity * itime;

    pre_pos = (pre_pos + this.enemy.origin) * 0.5;


    newdir = normalize(pre_pos - this.origin);


    newdir = normalize(olddir + newdir * 0.35);


    this.angles = vectoangles(this.velocity);


    this.velocity = newdir * min(vlen(this.velocity) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hellion_shot_speed_gain), (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hellion_shot_speed_max));

    if (itime < 0.05)
        (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((turret_projectile_explode) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (turret_projectile_explode));

    UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
}

        {
            turret_projectile_explode(this);

                  min((vlen(this.enemy.origin - this.origin) / vlen(this.velocity)),0.5);

        traceline(this.origin, pre_pos,true,this.enemy);
        ve = normalize(pre_pos - this.origin);
        fe = trace_fraction;

    }
    else

        ve = '0 0 0';
        fe = 0;
    }

    if ((fe != 1) || (this.enemy == (0, world)) || ((_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.enemy.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((1000) ** 2)))
    {
        myspeed = vlen(this.velocity);

        lt_for = myspeed * 3;
        lt_seek = myspeed * 2.95;


        traceline(this.origin, this.origin + v_forward * lt_for,false,this);
        vf = trace_endpos;
        ff = trace_fraction;


        float ad = vlen(vectoangles(normalize(this.enemy.origin - this.origin)) - this.angles);


        if ( ((ff < 0.7) || (ad > 4)) && (myspeed > (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed)) )
            myspeed = max(myspeed * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_decel), (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed));


        if ( (ff > 0.7) && (myspeed < (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_max)) )
            myspeed = min(myspeed * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_accel), (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_max));


        pt_seek = 1 - ff;
        pt_seek = bound(0.15,pt_seek,0.8);
        if (ff < 0.5) pt_seek = 1;


        traceline(this.origin, this.origin + (-1 * (v_right * pt_seek) + (v_forward * ff)) * lt_seek,false,this);
        vl = trace_endpos;
        fl = trace_fraction;


        traceline(this.origin, this.origin + ((v_right * pt_seek) + (v_forward * ff)) * lt_seek ,false,this);
        vr = trace_endpos;
        fr = trace_fraction;


        traceline(this.origin, this.origin + ((v_up * pt_seek) + (v_forward * ff)) * lt_seek ,false,this);
        vu = trace_endpos;
        fu = trace_fraction;

        vd = trace_endpos;
        fd = trace_fraction;

        vl = normalize(vl - this.origin);
        vr = normalize(vr - this.origin);
        vu = normalize(vu - this.origin);
        vd = normalize(vd - this.origin);


        if (pt_seek == 1)
        {
            wishdir = v_right;
            if (fl > fr) wishdir = -1 * v_right;
            if (fu > fl) wishdir = v_up;
            if (fd > fu) wishdir = -1 * v_up;
        }
        else
        {

            wishdir = normalize( (vl * fl) + (vr * fr) + (vu * fu) + (vd * fd) );
        }

        if (this.enemy)
        {
            if (fe < 0.1) fe = 0.1;
            wishdir = (wishdir * (1 - fe)) + (ve * fe);
        }
    }
    else
    {

        wishdir = ve;
    }

    if ((myspeed > (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed)) && (this.cnt > time))
        myspeed = min(myspeed * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_accel2),(autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_max));


    if (this.cnt < time)
    {
        this.cnt = time + 0.25;
        this.nextthink = 0;
        set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_BOUNCE);
        return;
    }


    olddir = normalize(this.velocity);
    newdir = normalize(olddir + wishdir * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_hk_shot_speed_turnrate));


    this.velocity = newdir * myspeed;


    this.angles = vectoangles(this.velocity);

}

float hk_is_valid_target(entity this, entity proj, entity targ)
{
    if (!targ)
        return false;


    if(((targ).pure_data && (targ).solid == SOLID_NOT))
        return false;


    if (targ.flags & FL_NOTARGET)
        return false;


    if ((targ.takedamage == DAMAGE_NO) || (GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) < 0))
        return false;


    if (((targ).classname == STR_PLAYER))
    {
        if (this.target_select_playerbias < 0)
            return false;

        if (((targ).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
            return false;
    }


    if ((targ.flags & FL_PROJECTILE) && (this.target_select_missilebias < 0))
        return false;


    if ((targ.team == this.team) || (this.team == targ.owner.team))
        return false;

    return true;
}

float turret_tesla_firecheck(entity this)
{

    float do_target_scan = 0;

    if((this.target_select_time + autocvar_g_turrets_targetscan_maxdelay) < time)
        do_target_scan = 1;


    if(this.target_validate_time < time)
    if (turret_validate_target(this, this.enemy, this.target_validate_flags) <= 0)
    {
        this.enemy = (0, world);
        this.target_validate_time = time + 0.5;
        do_target_scan = 1;
    }


    if (this.target_select_time + autocvar_g_turrets_targetscan_mindelay > time)
        do_target_scan = 0;

    if(do_target_scan)
    {
        this.enemy = turret_select_target(this);
        this.target_select_time = time;
    }

    if(!turret_firecheck(this))
        return false;

    if(this.enemy)
        return true;

    return false;
}

void walker_rocket_think(entity this)

    float edist;
    float itime;
    float m_speed;

    this.nextthink = time;

    edist = vlen(this.enemy.origin - this.origin);


    if (this.cnt < time)
    {
        if (edist < 1000)
            this.tur_shotorg = randomvec() * min(edist, 64);
        else
            this.tur_shotorg = randomvec() * min(edist, 256);

        this.cnt = time + 0.5;
    }

    if (edist < 128)
        this.tur_shotorg = '0 0 0';

    if (this.max_health < time)
    {
        (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((walker_rocket_explode) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (walker_rocket_explode));
        this.nextthink = time;
        return;
    }

    if (this.shot_dmg != 1337 && random() < 0.01)
    {
        walker_rocket_loop(this);
        return;
    }

    m_speed = vlen(this.velocity);


    if (this.enemy == (0, world) || ((this.enemy).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
        this.enemy = (0, world);

    if (this.enemy)

        itime = max(edist / m_speed, 1);

    }
    else

    (this).velocity = (this).velocity * (1 - (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_rocket_turnrate)) + (newdir * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_rocket_turnrate)) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_rocket_speed); UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);

void walker_move_to(entity this, vector _target, float _dist)
{
    switch (this.waterlevel)
    {
        case WATERLEVEL_NONE:
            if (_dist > 500)
                this.animflag = ANIM_RUN;
            else
                this.animflag = ANIM_WALK;
        case WATERLEVEL_WETFEET:
        case WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING:
            if (this.animflag != ANIM_SWIM)
                this.animflag = ANIM_WALK;
            else
                this.animflag = ANIM_SWIM;
            break;
        case WATERLEVEL_SUBMERGED:
            this.animflag = ANIM_SWIM;
    }

    this.moveto = _target;
    this.steerto = steerlib_attract2(this, this.moveto, 0.5, 500, 0.95);

    if(this.enemy)
    {
        this.enemy_last_loc = _target;
        this.enemy_last_time = time;
    }
}

        float vz;

        real_angle = vectoangles(it.steerto) - it.angles;
        vz = it.velocity_z;

        switch (it.animflag)
        {
            case ANIM_NO:
                movelib_brake_simple(it, (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_stop));
                break;

            case ANIM_TURN:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn);
                movelib_brake_simple(it, (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_stop));
                break;

            case ANIM_WALK:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_walk);
                it.velocity = it.velocity * (1 - 0.6) + (v_forward * 0.6) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_walk);
                break;

            case ANIM_RUN:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_run);
                it.velocity = it.velocity * (1 - 0.6) + (v_forward * 0.6) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_run);
                break;

            case ANIM_STRAFE_L:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_strafe);
                it.velocity = it.velocity * (1 - 0.8) + (v_right * -1 * 0.8) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_walk);
                break;

            case ANIM_STRAFE_R:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_strafe);
                it.velocity = it.velocity * (1 - 0.8) + (v_right * 0.8) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_walk);
                break;

            case ANIM_JUMP:
                it.velocity += '0 0 1' * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_jump);
                break;

            case ANIM_LAND:
                break;

            case ANIM_PAIN:
                if(it.frame != ANIM_PAIN)
                    defer(it, 0.25, walker_setnoanim);

                break;

            case ANIM_MELEE:
                if(it.frame != ANIM_MELEE)
                {
                    defer(it, 0.41, walker_setnoanim);
                    defer(it, 0.21, walker_melee_do_dmg);
                }

                movelib_brake_simple(it, (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_stop));
                break;

            case ANIM_SWIM:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_swim);
                turnx = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_swim);

                it.angles_x += bound(-10, shortangle_f(real_angle_x, it.angles_x), 10);
                it.velocity = it.velocity * (1 - 0.3) + (v_forward * 0.3) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_swim);
                vz = it.velocity_z + sin(time * 4) * 8;
                break;

            case ANIM_ROAM:
                turny = (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_turn_walk);
                it.velocity = it.velocity * (1 - 0.5) + (v_forward * 0.5) * (autocvar_g_turrets_unit_walker_speed_roam);
                break;
        }

        if(turny)
        {
            turny = bound( turny * -1, shortangle_f(real_angle_y, it.angles_y), turny );
            it.angles_y += turny;
        }

        if(turnx)
        {
            turnx = bound( turnx * -1, shortangle_f(real_angle_x, it.angles_x), turnx );
            it.angles_x += turnx;
        }

        it.velocity_z = vz;
    }


    if(it.origin != it.oldorigin)
        it.SendFlags |= TNSF_MOVE;

    it.oldorigin = it.origin;
    turrets_setframe(it, it.animflag, false);
}

   play2(this.owner, "vehicles/locking.wav");
   this.lock_soundtime = time + 0.3;
  }
 }

  if(this.lock_strength == 1)
   this.lock_time = time + _lock_time;

void vehicles_regen(entity this, float timer, .float regen_field, float field_max, float rpause, float regen, float delta_time, float _healthscale)
{
 if(this.(regen_field) < field_max)
 if(timer + rpause < time)
 {
  if(_healthscale)
   regen = regen * (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) / this.max_health);

  this.(regen_field) = min(this.(regen_field) + regen * delta_time, field_max);

  if(this.owner)
   this.owner.(regen_field) = (this.(regen_field) / field_max) * 100;
 }
}

void vehicles_regen_resource(entity this, float timer, .float regen_field, float field_max, float rpause, float regen, float delta_time, float _healthscale, Resource resource)
{
 float resource_amount = GetResource(this, resource);

 if(resource_amount < field_max)
 if(timer + rpause < time)
 {
  if(_healthscale)
   regen = regen * (resource_amount / this.max_health);

  SetResource(this, resource, min(resource_amount + regen * delta_time, field_max));

  if(this.owner)
   this.owner.(regen_field) = (GetResource(this, resource) / field_max) * 100;
 }
}

 {

  this.pain_frame = time + max(0.1, 0.1 + (random() * 0.5 * _ftmp));
  Send_Effect(EFFECT_SMOKE_SMALL, (this.origin + (randomvec() * 80)), '0 0 0', 1);

   this.velocity += randomvec() * 30;

  if(this.vehicle_flags & VHF_DMGROLL)
  {

    this.tur_head.angles += randomvec();
   else
    this.angles += randomvec();
  }
 }

void vehicles_damage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 this.dmg_time = time;


 if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_VORTEX)))
  damage *= autocvar_g_vehicles_vortex_damagerate;
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_MACHINEGUN)))
  damage *= autocvar_g_vehicles_machinegun_damagerate;
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_RIFLE)))
  damage *= autocvar_g_vehicles_rifle_damagerate;
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_VAPORIZER)))
  damage *= autocvar_g_vehicles_vaporizer_damagerate;
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_SEEKER)))
  damage *= autocvar_g_vehicles_tag_damagerate;
 else if(((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) != WEP_Null)
  damage *= autocvar_g_vehicles_weapon_damagerate;

 this.enemy = attacker;

 this.pain_finished = time;

 if((this.vehicle_flags & VHF_HASSHIELD) && (this.vehicle_shield > 0))
 {
  if (wasfreed(this.vehicle_shieldent) || this.vehicle_shieldent == (0, world))
  {
   this.vehicle_shieldent = __spawn("vehicle_shieldent", "./common/vehicles/sv_vehicles.qc" ":" "659", false);
   this.vehicle_shieldent.effects = EF_LOWPRECISION;

   if(1){ Model _setmodel_model = (MDL_VEH_SHIELD); string _setmodel_cached = _setmodel_model.model_str_; _setmodel((this.vehicle_shieldent), _setmodel_cached ? _setmodel_cached : _setmodel_model.model_str()); }else voidfunc();
   setattachment(this.vehicle_shieldent, this, "");
   setorigin(this.vehicle_shieldent, real_origin(this) - this.origin);
   this.vehicle_shieldent.scale = 256 / vlen(this.maxs - this.mins);
   (_selftemp = (this.vehicle_shieldent), _selftemp.__think = ((shieldhit_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (shieldhit_think));
  }

  this.vehicle_shieldent.colormod = '1 1 1';
  this.vehicle_shieldent.alpha = 0.45;
  this.vehicle_shieldent.angles = vectoangles(normalize(hitloc - (this.origin + this.vehicle_shieldent.origin))) - this.angles;
  this.vehicle_shieldent.nextthink = time;
  this.vehicle_shieldent.effects &= ~EF_NODRAW;

  this.vehicle_shield -= damage;

  if(this.vehicle_shield < 0)
  {
   TakeResource(this, RES_HEALTH, fabs(this.vehicle_shield));
   this.vehicle_shieldent.colormod = '2 0 0';
   this.vehicle_shield = 0;
   this.vehicle_shieldent.alpha = 0.75;

   if(sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, attacker))
    spamsound (this, CH_PAIN, SND_ONS_HIT2, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM);
  }
  else
   if(sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, attacker))
    spamsound (this, CH_PAIN, SND_ONS_ELECTRICITY_EXPLODE, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM);

 }
 else
 {
  TakeResource(this, RES_HEALTH, damage);

  if(sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, attacker))
   spamsound (this, CH_PAIN, SND_ONS_HIT2, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM);
 }

 if(this.damageforcescale < 1 && this.damageforcescale > 0)
  this.velocity += force * this.damageforcescale;
 else
  this.velocity += force;

 if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= 0)
 {
  if(this.owner)
  {
   if(this.vehicle_flags & VHF_DEATHEJECT)
    vehicles_exit(this, VHEF_EJECT);
   else
    vehicles_exit(this, VHEF_RELEASE);
  }

  antilag_clear(this, this);

  Vehicle info = this.vehicledef;
  info.vr_death(info, this);
  vehicles_setreturn(this);
 }
}

float vehicles_heal(entity targ, entity inflictor, float amount, float limit)
{
 float true_limit = ((limit != RES_LIMIT_NONE) ? limit : targ.max_health);
 if(GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) <= 0 || GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) >= true_limit)
  return false;

 GiveResourceWithLimit(targ, RES_HEALTH, amount, true_limit);
 if(targ.owner)
  targ.owner.vehicle_health = (GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH) / targ.max_health) * 100;
 return true;
}

float vehicles_crushable(entity e)
{
 if(((e).classname == STR_PLAYER) && time >= e.vehicle_enter_delay)
  return true;

 if((e.flags & FL_MONSTER))
  return true;

 return false;
}

void vehicles_impact(entity this, float _minspeed, float _speedfac, float _maxpain)
{
 if (trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_NOIMPACT)
  return;

 if(this.play_time < time)
 {
  if(((_vlen2 = (this.velocity - this.oldvelocity), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((_minspeed) ** 2)))
  {
   float wc = vlen(this.velocity - this.oldvelocity);
   float take = min(_speedfac * wc, _maxpain);
   Damage(this, (0, world), (0, world), take, DEATH_FALL.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), this.origin, '0 0 0');
   this.play_time = time + 0.25;
  }
 }
}


vector vehicles_findgoodexit(entity this, entity player, vector prefer_spot)
{

 tracebox(this.origin + '0 0 32', PL_MIN_CONST, PL_MAX_CONST, prefer_spot, MOVE_NORMAL, player);
 if(trace_fraction == 1.0 && !trace_startsolid && !trace_allsolid)
  return prefer_spot;

 float mysize = 1.5 * vlen(this.maxs - this.mins);
 vector v;
 vector v2 = 0.5 * (this.absmin + this.absmax);
 for(float i = 0; i < autocvar_g_vehicles_exit_attempts; ++i)
 {
  v = randomvec();
  v_z = 0;
  v = v2 + normalize(v) * mysize;
  tracebox(v2, PL_MIN_CONST, PL_MAX_CONST, v, MOVE_NORMAL, player);
  if(trace_fraction == 1.0 && !trace_startsolid && !trace_allsolid)
   return v;
 }

 return this.origin;
}

void vehicles_exit(entity vehic, float eject)
{
 entity player = vehic.owner;

 if(vehicles_exit_running)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/vehicles/sv_vehicles.qc", "794")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("^1vehicles_exit already running! this is not good..."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  return;
 }

 vehicles_exit_running = true;

 if(vehic.vehicle_flags & VHF_PLAYERSLOT)
 {
  vehic.vehicle_exit(vehic, eject);
  vehicles_exit_running = false;
  return;
 }

 if (player)
 {
  if ((clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
  {
   msg_entity = player;

   WriteEntity( MSG_ONE, player);


   WriteByte (MSG_ONE, SVC_SETVIEWANGLES);

   WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, 0);
  }

  player.takedamage = DAMAGE_AIM;
  player.solid = SOLID_SLIDEBOX;
  set_movetype(player, MOVETYPE_WALK);
  player.effects &= ~EF_NODRAW;

  player.vehicle = (0, world);

  player.event_damage = PlayerDamage;
  (player).stat_HUD = HUD_NORMAL;
  for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++ slot)
  {
   .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
   player.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon = vehic.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon;
   if(1){ entity _this = (vehic.(weaponentity)); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(vehic.(weaponentity)); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
  }
  player.last_vehiclecheck = time + 3;
  player.vehicle_enter_delay = time + 2;
  setsize(player, (player).stat_PL_MIN, (player).stat_PL_MAX);

  CSQCVehicleSetup(player, HUD_NORMAL);

  Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CPID_VEHICLES);
  Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CPID_VEHICLES_OTHER);
 }

 vehic.flags |= FL_NOTARGET;

 if(!((vehic).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  vehic.avelocity = '0 0 0';

 vehic.tur_head.nodrawtoclient = (0, world);

 if(!teamplay)
  vehic.team = 0;

  vehic.vehicle_flags |= VHF_SHIELDREGEN;

 vehic.vehicle_hudmodel.viewmodelforclient = vehic;
 vehic.phase = time + 1;

}

void vehicles_touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 if(__Mutator_Send_VehicleTouch(0 , this, toucher))
  return;


 if(this.owner)
 {
  if(toucher != (0, world))
  if((this.origin_z + this.maxs_z) > (toucher.origin_z))
  if(vehicles_crushable(toucher))
  if(!weaponLocked(this.owner))
  {
   if(((_vlen2 = (this.velocity), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) >= ((autocvar_g_vehicles_crush_minspeed) ** 2)))
    Damage(toucher, this, this.owner, autocvar_g_vehicles_crush_dmg, DEATH_VH_CRUSH.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), '0 0 0', normalize(toucher.origin - this.origin) * autocvar_g_vehicles_crush_force);

   return;
  }

  if(this.play_time < time) {
   Vehicle info = this.vehicledef;
   info.vr_impact(info, this);
  }

  return;
 }

 if(autocvar_g_vehicles_enter)
  return;

 vehicles_enter(toucher, this);
}

float vehicle_impulse(entity this, float imp)
{
 entity v = this.vehicle;
 if (!v) return false;
 if (((v).deadflag != DEAD_NO)) return false;
 float(entity,float) f = v.vehicles_impulse;
 if (f && f(this,imp)) return true;
 switch (imp)
 {
  case IMP_weapon_drop.impulse:
  {
   if(1){ entity _cl = (this); if ((clienttype(_cl) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL)) stuffcmd(_cl, "\ntoggle cl_eventchase_vehicle\nset _vehicles_shownchasemessage 1\n"); }else voidfunc();
   return true;
  }
 }
 return false;
}

float vehicle_initialize(entity this, Vehicle info, float nodrop)
{
 if(!autocvar_g_vehicles)
  return false;

 if(!info.vehicleid)
  return false;

 if(!this.tur_head)
  info.vr_precache(info);

 if(this.targetname && this.targetname != "")
 {
  this.vehicle_controller = find((0, world), target, this.targetname);
  if(!this.vehicle_controller)
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^2DEBUG""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/vehicles/sv_vehicles.qc", "1189")), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("^1WARNING: ^7Vehicle with invalid .targetname"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
   this.active = ACTIVE_ACTIVE;
  }
  else
  {
   this.team = this.vehicle_controller.team;
   this.use1 = vehicle_use;

   if(teamplay)
   {
    if(this.vehicle_controller.team == 0)
     this.active = ACTIVE_NOT;
    else
     this.active = ACTIVE_ACTIVE;
   }
  }
 }
 else { this.active = ACTIVE_ACTIVE; }

 if(this.team && (!teamplay || !autocvar_g_vehicles_teams))
  this.team = 0;

 if(this.mdl == "" || !this.mdl)
  _setmodel(this, info.model);
 else
  _setmodel(this, this.mdl);

 this.vehicle_flags |= VHF_ISVEHICLE;

 this.vehicle_viewport = __spawn("vehicle_viewport", "./common/vehicles/sv_vehicles.qc" ":" "1218", false);
 this.vehicle_hudmodel = __spawn("vehicle_hudmodel", "./common/vehicles/sv_vehicles.qc" ":" "1219", false);
 this.tur_head = __spawn("tur_head", "./common/vehicles/sv_vehicles.qc" ":" "1220", false);
 this.tur_head.owner = this;
 this.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
 this.bot_attack = true;
 IL_PUSH(g_bot_targets, this);
 this.iscreature = true;
 this.teleportable = false;
 this.damagedbycontents = true;
 IL_PUSH(g_damagedbycontents, this);
 this.vehicleid = info.vehicleid;
 this.vehicledef = info;
 this.PlayerPhysplug = info.PlayerPhysplug;
 this.event_damage = nil;
 this.event_heal = nil;
 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__touch = ((vehicles_touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (vehicles_touch));
 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((vehicles_spawn) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (vehicles_spawn));
 this.nextthink = time;
 this.effects = EF_NODRAW;
 this.dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_SOLID;

 if(autocvar_g_playerclip_collisions)
  this.dphitcontentsmask |= DPCONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP;

 if(autocvar_g_nodepthtestplayers)
  this.effects |= EF_NODEPTHTEST;

 if(autocvar_g_fullbrightplayers)
  this.effects |= EF_FULLBRIGHT;

 _setmodel(this.vehicle_hudmodel, info.hud_model);
 if(1){ Model _setmodel_model = (MDL_Null); string _setmodel_cached = _setmodel_model.model_str_; _setmodel((this.vehicle_viewport), _setmodel_cached ? _setmodel_cached : _setmodel_model.model_str()); }else voidfunc();

 if(info.head_model != "")
 {
  _setmodel(this.tur_head, info.head_model);
  setattachment(this.tur_head, this, info.tag_head);
  setattachment(this.vehicle_hudmodel, this.tur_head, info.tag_hud);
  setattachment(this.vehicle_viewport, this.vehicle_hudmodel, info.tag_view);
 }
 else
 {
  setattachment(this.tur_head, this, "");
  setattachment(this.vehicle_hudmodel, this, info.tag_hud);
  setattachment(this.vehicle_viewport, this.vehicle_hudmodel, info.tag_view);
 }

 setsize(this, info.m_mins, info.m_maxs);

 info.vr_setup(info, this);

 if(!nodrop)
 {
  setorigin(this, this.origin);
  tracebox(this.origin + '0 0 100', info.m_mins, info.m_maxs, this.origin - '0 0 10000', MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
  setorigin(this, trace_endpos);
 }

 this.pos1 = this.origin;
 this.pos2 = this.angles;
 this.tur_head.team = this.team;

 if(this.active == ACTIVE_NOT)
  this.nextthink = 0;
 else if(autocvar_g_vehicles_delayspawn)
  this.nextthink = time + this.respawntime + (random() * autocvar_g_vehicles_delayspawn_jitter);
 else
  this.nextthink = time + game_starttime;

 if(__Mutator_Send_VehicleInit(0 , this))
  return false;

 return true;
}
