   {
    gun.enemy = trace_ent;
    gun.lock_time = time + 0.5;
   }
  }
 }

 if(gun.enemy)
 {
  float distance, impact_time;

  vector vf = real_origin(gun.enemy);
  vector _vel = gun.enemy.velocity;
  if(gun.enemy.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_WALK)
   _vel.z *= 0.1;


  ad = vf;
  distance = vlen(ad - this.origin);
  impact_time = distance / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_speed;
  ad = vf + _vel * impact_time;
  trace_endpos = ad;


  UpdateAuxiliaryXhair(this, ad, '1 0 1', 1);
  vehicle_aimturret(vehic, trace_endpos, gun, "fire",
        autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_pitchlimit_down * -1, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_pitchlimit_up,
        _out * -1, _in, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_turnspeed, dt);

 }
 else
  vehicle_aimturret(vehic, _ct, gun, "fire",
        autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_pitchlimit_down * -1, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_pitchlimit_up,
        _out * -1, _in, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_turnspeed, dt);

 if(!weaponLocked(this) && !weaponUseForbidden(this))
 if(((this._cs).button0))
  if(time > gun.attack_finished_single[0])
   if(gun.vehicle_energy >= autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_cost)
   {
    gun.vehicle_energy -= autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_cost;
    bumblebee_fire_cannon(vehic, gun, "fire", this);
    gun.delay = time;
    gun.attack_finished_single[0] = time + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_refire;
   }

 this.vehicle_health = (GetResource(vehic, RES_HEALTH) / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_health) * 100;

 if(vehic.vehicle_flags & VHF_HASSHIELD)
  this.vehicle_shield = (vehic.vehicle_shield / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_shield) * 100;

 ad = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 182, __FUNC__, "gun" ", " "gettagindex(gun, \"fire\")"), _gettaginfo_hidden(gun, _gettagindex(gun, "fire")) );
 traceline(ad, ad + v_forward * max_shot_distance, MOVE_NORMAL, gun);

 UpdateAuxiliaryXhair(this, trace_endpos, ('1 0 0' * this.vehicle_reload1) + ('0 1 0' *(1 - this.vehicle_reload1)), 0);

 if(vehic.owner)
  UpdateAuxiliaryXhair(vehic.owner, trace_endpos, ('1 0 0' * this.vehicle_reload1) + ('0 1 0' *(1 - this.vehicle_reload1)), ((this == vehic.gunner1) ? 1 : 2));

 vehic.solid = SOLID_BBOX;
 ((this._cs).button0) = ((this._cs).button3) = ((this._cs).button5) = false;
 this.vehicle_energy = (gun.vehicle_energy / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo) * 100;
}

vector bumblebee_gunner_findgoodexit(vector prefer_spot, entity gunner, entity player)
{

 float mysize;

 tracebox(gunner.origin + '0 0 32', (player).stat_PL_MIN, (player).stat_PL_MAX, prefer_spot, MOVE_NORMAL, player);
 if(trace_fraction == 1.0 && !trace_startsolid && !trace_allsolid)
  return prefer_spot;

 mysize = 1.5 * vlen((player).stat_PL_MAX - (player).stat_PL_MIN);
 float i;
 vector v, v2;
 v2 = 0.5 * (gunner.absmin + gunner.absmax);
 for(i = 0; i < 100; ++i)
 {
  v = randomvec();
  v_z = 0;
  v = v2 + normalize(v) * mysize;
  tracebox(v2, (player).stat_PL_MIN, (player).stat_PL_MAX, v, MOVE_NORMAL, player);
  if(trace_fraction == 1.0 && !trace_startsolid && !trace_allsolid)
   return v;
 }

 return prefer_spot;
}

void bumblebee_gunner_exit(entity this, float _exitflag)
{
 entity player = ((this.owner.gun1 == this) ? this.owner.gunner1 : this.owner.gunner2);
 entity gunner = this;
 entity vehic = gunner.owner;

 if((clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
 {
  msg_entity = player;
  WriteByte(MSG_ONE, SVC_SETVIEWPORT);
  WriteEntity(MSG_ONE, player);


  WriteByte(MSG_ONE, SVC_SETVIEWANGLES);
  WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, 0);
  WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, vehic.angles.y);
  WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, 0);
 }

 CSQCVehicleSetup(player, HUD_NORMAL);

 player.takedamage = DAMAGE_AIM;
 player.solid = SOLID_SLIDEBOX;
 set_movetype(player, MOVETYPE_WALK);
 player.effects &= ~EF_NODRAW;
 player.alpha = 1;
 player.PlayerPhysplug = nil;
 player.view_ofs = (player).stat_PL_VIEW_OFS;
 player.event_damage = PlayerDamage;
 (player).stat_HUD = HUD_NORMAL;
 player.teleportable = TELEPORT_NORMAL;
 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
  player.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon = gunner.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon;
  if(1){ entity _this = (gunner.(weaponentity)); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(gunner.(weaponentity)); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 }
 player.vehicle_enter_delay = time + 2;
 setsize(player, (player).stat_PL_MIN, (player).stat_PL_MAX);

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 261, __FUNC__, "\"vehic.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(vehic.angles); }else voidfunc();

 if(player == vehic.gunner1) { vehic.gunner1 = (0, world); }
 if(player == vehic.gunner2) { vehic.gunner2 = (0, world); v_right *= -1; }

 vector spot = real_origin(gunner);
 spot = spot + v_up * 128 + v_forward * 300 + v_right * 150;
 spot = bumblebee_gunner_findgoodexit(spot, gunner, player);



 player.velocity = 0.75 * vehic.velocity + normalize(spot - vehic.origin) * 200;
 player.velocity_z += 10;

 gunner.phase = time + 5;
 gunner.vehicle_hudmodel.viewmodelforclient = gunner;

 __Mutator_Send_VehicleExit(0 , player, gunner);

 player.vehicle = (0, world);
}

float bumblebee_gunner_enter(entity this, entity player)
{
 entity vehic = this;
 entity gunner = (0, world);

 if(!vehic.gunner1 && !vehic.gunner2 && ((time >= vehic.gun1.phase) + (time >= vehic.gun2.phase)) == 2)
 {

  vector v1 = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 291, __FUNC__, "vehic" ", " "gettagindex(vehic, \"cannon_right\")"), _gettaginfo_hidden(vehic, _gettagindex(vehic, "cannon_right")) );
  vector v2 = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 292, __FUNC__, "vehic" ", " "gettagindex(vehic, \"cannon_left\")"), _gettaginfo_hidden(vehic, _gettagindex(vehic, "cannon_left")) );
  if((_vlen2 = (player.origin - v1), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (player.origin - v2), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))))
  {
   gunner = vehic.gun1;
   vehic.gunner1 = player;
  }
  else
  {
   gunner = vehic.gun2;
   vehic.gunner2 = player;
  }
 }
 else if(!vehic.gunner1 && time >= vehic.gun1.phase) { gunner = vehic.gun1; vehic.gunner1 = player; }
 else if(!vehic.gunner2 && time >= vehic.gun2.phase) { gunner = vehic.gun2; vehic.gunner2 = player; }
 else { if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", "306")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Vehicle is full, fail"), "\n")); }else voidfunc(); return false; }

 player.vehicle = gunner;
 player.angles = vehic.angles;
 player.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
 player.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 player.alpha = -1;
 set_movetype(player, MOVETYPE_NOCLIP);
 player.event_damage = nil;
 player.view_ofs = '0 0 0';
 (player).stat_HUD = (gunner).stat_HUD;
 player.teleportable = false;
 player.PlayerPhysplug = gunner.PlayerPhysplug;
 player.vehicle_ammo1 = vehic.vehicle_ammo1;
 player.vehicle_ammo2 = vehic.vehicle_ammo2;
 player.vehicle_reload1 = vehic.vehicle_reload1;
 player.vehicle_reload2 = vehic.vehicle_reload2;
 player.vehicle_energy = vehic.vehicle_energy;
 ((player).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);

 RemoveGrapplingHooks(player);

 for(float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];

  gunner.(weaponentity) = __spawn("temp_wepent", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc" ":" "332", false);
  gunner.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon = player.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon;
 }
 gunner.vehicle_exit = bumblebee_gunner_exit;
 gunner.vehicle_hudmodel.viewmodelforclient = player;

 if((clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
 {
  msg_entity = player;
  WriteByte(MSG_ONE, SVC_SETVIEWPORT);
  WriteEntity(MSG_ONE, gunner.vehicle_viewport);


  WriteByte(MSG_ONE, SVC_SETVIEWANGLES);
  WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, gunner.angles_x + vehic.angles_x);
  WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, gunner.angles_y + vehic.angles_y);
  WriteAngle(MSG_ONE, 0);
 }

 CSQCVehicleSetup(player, (player).stat_HUD);

 __Mutator_Send_VehicleEnter(0 , player, gunner);

 return true;
}

float vehicles_valid_pilot(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 if((clienttype(toucher) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT) && !autocvar_g_vehicles_allow_bots)
  return false;

 if((!((toucher).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 || (((toucher).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 || (toucher.vehicle)
 || ((teamplay ? (toucher.team != this.team) : (toucher != this)))
 ) { return false; }

 return true;
}

void bumblebee_touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 if(autocvar_g_vehicles_enter) { return; }

 if(this.gunner1 != (0, world) && this.gunner2 != (0, world))
 {
  vehicles_touch(this, toucher);
  return;
 }

 if(vehicles_valid_pilot(this, toucher))
 {
  float phase_time = (time >= this.gun1.phase) + (time >= this.gun2.phase);

  if(time >= toucher.vehicle_enter_delay && phase_time)
  if(bumblebee_gunner_enter(this, toucher))
   return;
 }

 vehicles_touch(this, toucher);
}

void bumblebee_regen(entity this, float dt)
{
 if(this.gun1.delay + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo_regen_pause < time)
  this.gun1.vehicle_energy = min(autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo,
            this.gun1.vehicle_energy + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo_regen * dt);

 if(this.gun2.delay + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo_regen_pause < time)
  this.gun2.vehicle_energy = min(autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo,
            this.gun2.vehicle_energy + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo_regen * dt);

 if(this.vehicle_flags & VHF_SHIELDREGEN)
  vehicles_regen(this, this.dmg_time, vehicle_shield, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_shield, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_shield_regen_pause, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_shield_regen, dt, true);

 if(this.vehicle_flags & VHF_HEALTHREGEN)
  vehicles_regen_resource(this, this.dmg_time, vehicle_health, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_health, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_health_regen_pause, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_health_regen, dt, false, RES_HEALTH);

 if(this.vehicle_flags & VHF_ENERGYREGEN)
  vehicles_regen(this, this.wait, vehicle_energy, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_energy, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_energy_regen_pause, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_energy_regen, dt, false);

}

float bumblebee_pilot_frame(entity this, float dt)
{
 entity vehic = this.vehicle;
 return = true;

 if(game_stopped)
 {
  vehic.solid = SOLID_NOT;
  vehic.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
  set_movetype(vehic, MOVETYPE_NONE);
  return;
 }

 vehicles_frame(vehic, this);

 if(((vehic).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 {
  ((this._cs).button0) = ((this._cs).button3) = false;
  return;
 }

 bumblebee_regen(vehic, dt);

 crosshair_trace(this);

 vector vang = vehic.angles;
 vector newvel = vectoangles(normalize(trace_endpos - vehic.origin + '0 0 32'));
 vang.x *= -1;
 newvel.x *= -1;
 if(newvel.x > 180) newvel.x -= 360;
 if(newvel.x < -180) newvel.x += 360;
 if(newvel.y > 180) newvel.y -= 360;
 if(newvel.y < -180) newvel.y += 360;

 float ftmp = shortangle_f(this.v_angle.y - vang.y, vang.y);
 if(ftmp > 180) ftmp -= 360;
 if(ftmp < -180) ftmp += 360;
 vehic.avelocity_y = bound(-autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_turnspeed, ftmp + vehic.avelocity.y * 0.9, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_turnspeed);


 ftmp = 0;
 if((this._cs).movement.x > 0 && vang.x < autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchlimit)
  ftmp = 4;
 else if((this._cs).movement.x < 0 && vang.x > -autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchlimit)
  ftmp = -8;

 newvel.x = bound(-autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchlimit, newvel.x , autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchlimit);
 ftmp = vang.x - bound(-autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchlimit, newvel.x + ftmp, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchlimit);
 vehic.avelocity_x = bound(-autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchspeed, ftmp + vehic.avelocity.x * 0.9, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_pitchspeed);

 vehic.angles_x = anglemods(vehic.angles.x);
 vehic.angles_y = anglemods(vehic.angles.y);
 vehic.angles_z = anglemods(vehic.angles.z);

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 469, __FUNC__, "\"'0 1 0' * vehic.angles.y\""); _makevectors_hidden('0 1 0' * vehic.angles.y); }else voidfunc();
 newvel = vehic.velocity * -autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_friction;

 if((this._cs).movement.x != 0)
 {
  if((this._cs).movement.x > 0)
   newvel += v_forward * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_forward;
  else if((this._cs).movement.x < 0)
   newvel -= v_forward * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_forward;
 }

 if((this._cs).movement.y != 0)
 {
  if((this._cs).movement.y < 0)
   newvel -= v_right * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_strafe;
  else if((this._cs).movement.y > 0)
   newvel += v_right * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_strafe;
  ftmp = newvel * v_right;
  ftmp *= dt * 0.1;
  vehic.angles_z = bound(-15, vehic.angles.z + ftmp, 15);
 }
 else
 {
  vehic.angles_z *= 0.95;
  if(vehic.angles.z >= -1 && vehic.angles.z <= -1)
   vehic.angles_z = 0;
 }

 if(((this._cs).button5))
  newvel -= v_up * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_down;
 else if(((this._cs).button2))
  newvel += v_up * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_up;

 vehic.velocity += newvel * dt;
 this.velocity = (this._cs).movement = vehic.velocity;


 if(autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_locktime)
 {
  if(vehic.tur_head.lock_time < time || ((vehic.tur_head.enemy).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || (vehic.tur_head.enemy).stat_FROZEN)
   vehic.tur_head.enemy = (0, world);

  if(trace_ent)
  if(trace_ent.move_movetype)
  if(trace_ent.takedamage)
  if(!((trace_ent).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !(trace_ent).stat_FROZEN)
  {
   if(teamplay)
   {
    if(trace_ent.team == this.team)
    {
     vehic.tur_head.enemy = trace_ent;
     vehic.tur_head.lock_time = time + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_locktime;
    }
   }
   else
   {
    vehic.tur_head.enemy = trace_ent;
    vehic.tur_head.lock_time = time + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_locktime;
   }
  }

  if(vehic.tur_head.enemy)
  {
   trace_endpos = real_origin(vehic.tur_head.enemy);
   UpdateAuxiliaryXhair(this, trace_endpos, '0 0.75 0', 0);
  }
 }

 vang = vehicle_aimturret(vehic, trace_endpos, vehic.gun3, "fire",
       autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_pitchlimit_down * -1, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_pitchlimit_up,
       autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_turnlimit_sides * -1, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_turnlimit_sides, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_turnspeed, dt);

 if(!weaponLocked(this) && !weaponUseForbidden(this))
 if((((this._cs).button0) || ((this._cs).button3)) && (vehic.vehicle_energy > autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_dps * sys_frametime || autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun == 0))
 {
  vehic.gun3.enemy.realowner = this;
  vehic.gun3.enemy.effects &= ~EF_NODRAW;

  vehic.gun3.enemy.hook_start = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 548, __FUNC__, "vehic.gun3" ", " "gettagindex(vehic.gun3, \"fire\")"), _gettaginfo_hidden(vehic.gun3, _gettagindex(vehic.gun3, "fire")) );
  vehic.gun3.enemy.SendFlags |= BRG_START;

  traceline(vehic.gun3.enemy.hook_start, vehic.gun3.enemy.hook_start + v_forward * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_range, MOVE_NORMAL, vehic);

  if(trace_ent)
  {
   if(autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun)
   {
    Damage(trace_ent, vehic, this, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_dps * sys_frametime, DEATH_GENERIC.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), trace_endpos, v_forward * autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_fps * sys_frametime);
    vehic.vehicle_energy -= autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_raygun_aps * sys_frametime;
   }
   else
   {
    if(!((trace_ent).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
    {
     if((teamplay && trace_ent.team == this.team) || !teamplay)
     {
      if(autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_hps)
      {
       float hplimit = ((((trace_ent).classname == STR_PLAYER)) ? autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_hmax : RES_LIMIT_NONE);
       Heal(trace_ent, this, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_hps * dt, hplimit);
      }

      if((trace_ent.vehicle_flags & VHF_ISVEHICLE))
      {
       if(autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_sps && GetResource(trace_ent, RES_HEALTH) <= trace_ent.max_health)
        trace_ent.vehicle_shield = min(trace_ent.vehicle_shield + autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_sps * dt, trace_ent.tur_head.max_health);
      }
      else if((trace_ent.flags & FL_CLIENT))
      {
       float maxarmor = ((MUTATOR_mutator_instagib.mutatorcheck()) ? autocvar_g_instagib_extralives : autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_amax);
       if(GetResource(trace_ent, RES_ARMOR) <= maxarmor && autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_aps)
        GiveResourceWithLimit(trace_ent, RES_ARMOR, autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_healgun_aps * dt, maxarmor);
      }
     }
    }
   }
  }

  vehic.gun3.enemy.hook_end = trace_endpos;
  setorigin(vehic.gun3.enemy, trace_endpos);
  vehic.gun3.enemy.SendFlags |= BRG_END;

  vehic.wait = time + 1;
 }
 else
  vehic.gun3.enemy.effects |= EF_NODRAW;
# 604 "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc"
 this.vehicle_health = (GetResource(vehic, RES_HEALTH) / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_health) * 100;
 this.vehicle_energy = (vehic.vehicle_energy / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_energy) * 100;

 this.vehicle_ammo1 = (vehic.gun1.vehicle_energy / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo) * 100;
 this.vehicle_ammo2 = (vehic.gun2.vehicle_energy / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_cannon_ammo) * 100;

 if(vehic.vehicle_flags & VHF_HASSHIELD)
  this.vehicle_shield = (vehic.vehicle_shield / autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_shield) * 100;

 vehic.angles_x *= -1;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 614, __FUNC__, "\"vehic.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(vehic.angles); }else voidfunc();
 vehic.angles_x *= -1;
 setorigin(this, vehic.origin + v_up * 48 + v_forward * 160);
 this.oldorigin = this.origin;

 ((this._cs).button0) = ((this._cs).button3) = ((this._cs).button5) = false;
}

void bumblebee_land(entity this)
{
 float hgt;

 hgt = vehicle_altitude(this, 512);
 this.velocity = (this.velocity * 0.9) + ('0 0 -1800' * (hgt / 256) * sys_frametime);
 this.angles_x *= 0.95;
 this.angles_z *= 0.95;

 if(hgt < 16)
  (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((vehicles_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (vehicles_think));

 this.nextthink = time;

 CSQCModel_CheckUpdate(this);
}

void bumblebee_exit(entity this, float eject)
{
 if(this.owner.vehicleid == VEH_BUMBLEBEE.vehicleid)
 {
  bumblebee_gunner_exit(this, eject);
  return;
 }

 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__touch = ((vehicles_touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (vehicles_touch));

 if(!((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 {
  (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((bumblebee_land) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (bumblebee_land));
  this.nextthink = time;
 }

 set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_TOSS);

 if(!this.owner)
  return;

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/bumblebee.qc", 660, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();
 vector spot;
 if(((_vlen2 = (this.velocity), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_g_vehicle_bumblebee_speed_forward * 0.5) ** 2)))
  spot = this.origin + v_up * 128 + v_forward * 300;
 else
  spot = this.origin + v_up * 128 - v_forward * 300;

 spot = vehicles_findgoodexit(this, this.owner, spot);


 if(this.gun3.enemy || !wasfreed(this.gun3.enemy))
  this.gun3.enemy.effects |= EF_NODRAW;

 this.owner.velocity = 0.75 * this.vehicle.velocity + normalize(spot - this.vehicle.origin) * 200;
 this.owner.velocity_z += 10;
 setorigin(this.owner, spot);

 antilag_clear(this.owner, (this.owner._cs));
 this.owner = (0, world);
}

void bumblebee_blowup(entity this)

void racer_align4point(entity this, entity player, float _delta)
{
 vector push_vector;
 float fl_push, fr_push, bl_push, br_push;

 push_vector = this.racer_force_from_tag(this, "tag_engine_fr", autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_springlength, autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_hoverpower);
 fr_push = force_fromtag_normpower;


 push_vector += this.racer_force_from_tag(this, "tag_engine_fl", autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_springlength, autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_hoverpower);
 fl_push = force_fromtag_normpower;


 push_vector += this.racer_force_from_tag(this, "tag_engine_br", autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_springlength, autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_hoverpower);
 br_push = force_fromtag_normpower;


 push_vector += this.racer_force_from_tag(this, "tag_engine_bl", autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_springlength, autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_hoverpower);
 bl_push = force_fromtag_normpower;


 this.velocity += push_vector * _delta;

 float uforce = autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_upforcedamper;

 float cont = pointcontents(this.origin - '0 0 64');
 if(cont == CONTENT_WATER || cont == CONTENT_LAVA || cont == CONTENT_SLIME)
 {
  uforce = autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_water_upforcedamper;

  if(((player._cs).button5) && time < this.racer_air_finished)
   this.velocity_z += 30;
  else
   this.velocity_z += 200;
 }



 if(this.velocity_z > 0)
  this.velocity_z *= 1 - uforce * _delta;

 push_vector_x = (fl_push - bl_push);
 push_vector_x += (fr_push - br_push);
 push_vector_x *= 360;

 push_vector_z = (fr_push - fl_push);
 push_vector_z += (br_push - bl_push);
 push_vector_z *= 360;

{

 this.nextthink = time + dt;

 vector df = this.velocity * -autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_friction;
 df_z += (1 - trace_fraction) * autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_hoverpower + sin(time * 2) * (autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_springlength * 2);

 float forced = autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_upforcedamper;


 traceline(this.origin - '0 0 64', this.origin - '0 0 64', MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);

 if(trace_dpstartcontents & DPCONTENTS_LIQUIDSMASK)
 {
  forced = autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_water_upforcedamper;
  this.velocity_z += 200;
 }

 this.velocity += df * dt;
 if(this.velocity_z > 0)
  this.velocity_z *= 1 - forced * dt;

 this.angles_x *= 1 - (autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_anglestabilizer * dt);
 this.angles_z *= 1 - (autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_anglestabilizer * dt);

 CSQCModel_CheckUpdate(this);
}

void racer_rocket_tracker(entity this)
{
    vector olddir, newdir;
    float oldvel, newvel;

    this.nextthink = time;

    if (((this.owner).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || this.cnt < time)
    {
        this.use1(this, (0, world), (0, world));
        return;
    }

    if(!this.realowner.vehicle)
    {
        UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
        return;
    }

    olddir = normalize(this.velocity);
    oldvel = vlen(this.velocity);
    newvel = oldvel + this.lip;
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/racer_weapon.qc", 100, __FUNC__, "\"vectoangles(olddir)\""); _makevectors_hidden(vectoangles(olddir)); }else voidfunc();

    float time_to_impact = min(vlen(this.enemy.origin - this.origin) / vlen(this.velocity), 1);
    vector predicted_origin = this.enemy.origin + this.enemy.velocity * time_to_impact;

    traceline(this.origin, this.origin + v_forward * 64 - '0 0 32', MOVE_NORMAL, this);
    newdir = normalize(predicted_origin - this.origin);


    float height_diff = predicted_origin_z - this.origin_z;

    if(((_vlen2 = (newdir - v_forward), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_rocket_locked_maxangle) ** 2)))
    {


        (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((racer_rocket_groundhugger) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (racer_rocket_groundhugger));
        return;
    }

    if(trace_fraction != 1.0 && trace_ent != this.enemy)
        newdir_z += 16 * sys_frametime;

    this.velocity = normalize(olddir + newdir * autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_rocket_turnrate) * newvel;
    this.velocity_z -= 800 * sys_frametime;
    this.velocity_z += max(height_diff, autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_rocket_climbspeed) * sys_frametime ;

    UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
    return;
}

void racer_rocket_groundhugger(entity this)
{
    vector olddir, newdir;
    float oldvel, newvel;

    this.nextthink = time;

    if(((this.owner).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || this.cnt < time)
    {
        this.use1(this, (0, world), (0, world));
        return;
    }

    if(!this.realowner.vehicle)
    {
        UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
        return;
    }

    olddir = normalize(this.velocity);
    oldvel = vlen(this.velocity);
    newvel = oldvel + this.lip;

    tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin + olddir * 64, MOVE_WORLDONLY,this);
    if(trace_fraction <= 0.5)
    {

        this.velocity = olddir * newvel;
        UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
        return;
    }

    traceline(trace_endpos, trace_endpos - '0 0 64', MOVE_NORMAL, this);
    if(trace_fraction != 1.0)
    {
        newdir = normalize(trace_endpos + '0 0 64' - this.origin) * autocvar_g_vehicle_racer_rocket_turnrate;
        this.velocity = normalize(olddir + newdir) * newvel;
    }
    else
    {
        this.velocity = olddir * newvel;
        this.velocity_z -= 1600 * sys_frametime;
    }

    float cont = pointcontents(this.origin - '0 0 32');
    if(cont == CONTENT_WATER || cont == CONTENT_LAVA || cont == CONTENT_SLIME)
        this.velocity_z += 200;

    UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);
    return;
}

  case IMP_weapon_next_bygroup.impulse:

   if((this.vehicle).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE > SBRM_LAST)
    (this.vehicle).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE = SBRM_FIRST;


   CSQCVehicleSetup(this, 0);
   return true;
  case IMP_weapon_last.impulse:
  case IMP_weapon_prev_byid.impulse:
  case IMP_weapon_prev_bypriority.impulse:
  case IMP_weapon_prev_bygroup.impulse:
   (this.vehicle).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE -= 1;
   if((this.vehicle).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE < SBRM_FIRST)
    (this.vehicle).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE = SBRM_LAST;


   CSQCVehicleSetup(this, 0);
   return true;







 }
 return false;
}

float spiberbot_calcartillery_flighttime;
vector spiberbot_calcartillery(vector org, vector tgt, float ht)
{
    float grav, sdist, zdist, vs, vz, jumpheight;
    vector sdir;

    grav = cvar("sv_gravity");
    zdist = tgt_z - org_z;
    sdist = vlen(tgt - org - zdist * '0 0 1');
    sdir = normalize(tgt - org - zdist * '0 0 1');


    jumpheight = fabs(ht);
    if(zdist > 0)
        jumpheight = jumpheight + zdist;


    vz = sqrt(2 * grav * jumpheight);


    if(ht < 0)
        if(zdist < 0)
            vz = -vz;

    vector solution;
    solution = solve_quadratic(0.5 * grav, -vz, zdist);

    if(!solution_z)
        solution_y = solution_x;
    if(zdist == 0)
        solution_x = solution_y;

    if(zdist < 0)
    {

        if(ht < 0)
        {



            spiberbot_calcartillery_flighttime = solution_y;
        }
        else
        {



            spiberbot_calcartillery_flighttime = solution_y;
        }
    }
    else
    {

        if(ht < 0)
        {



            spiberbot_calcartillery_flighttime = solution_x;
        }
        else
        {



            spiberbot_calcartillery_flighttime = solution_y;
        }
    }
    vs = sdist / spiberbot_calcartillery_flighttime;


    return sdir * vs + '0 0 1' * vz;
}

void spiderbot_rocket_do(entity this)
{
    vector v;
    entity rocket = (0, world);

    if (this.wait != -10)
    {
        if (((this.owner._cs).button3) && (this).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE == SBRM_GUIDE)
        {
            if (this.wait == 1)
            if (this.tur_head.frame == 9 || this.tur_head.frame == 1)
            {
                if(this.gun2.cnt < time && this.tur_head.frame == 9)
                    this.tur_head.frame = 1;

                return;
            }
            this.wait = 1;
        }
        else
        {
            if(this.wait)
                spiderbot_guide_release(this);

            this.wait = 0;
        }
    }

    if(this.gun2.cnt > time)
        return;

    if (this.tur_head.frame >= 9)
    {
        this.tur_head.frame = 1;
        this.wait = 0;
    }

    if(this.wait != -10)
    if(!((this.owner._cs).button3))
        return;

    if(weaponLocked(this.owner) || weaponUseForbidden(this.owner))
        return;

    v = ( deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "gettaginfo", "./common/vehicles/vehicle/spiderbot_weapons.qc", 181, __FUNC__, "this.tur_head" ", " "gettagindex(this.tur_head,\"tag_fire\")"), _gettaginfo_hidden(this.tur_head, _gettagindex(this.tur_head,"tag_fire")) );

    switch((this).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE)
    {
        case SBRM_VOLLY:
            rocket = vehicles_projectile(this, EFFECT_SPIDERBOT_ROCKETLAUNCH, SND_ROCKET_FIRE,
                                   v, normalize(randomvec() * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_spread + v_forward) * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_speed,
                                   autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_damage, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_radius, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_force, 1,
                                   DEATH_VH_SPID_ROCKET.m_id, PROJECTILE_SPIDERROCKET, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_health, false, true, this.owner);
            crosshair_trace(this.owner);
            float _dist = (random() * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_radius) + vlen(v - trace_endpos);
            _dist -= (random() * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_radius) ;
            rocket.nextthink = time + (_dist / autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_speed);
            (_selftemp = (rocket), _selftemp.__think = ((vehicles_projectile_explode_think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (vehicles_projectile_explode_think));

            if(((this.owner._cs).button3) && this.tur_head.frame == 1)
                this.wait = -10;
            break;
        case SBRM_GUIDE:
            rocket = vehicles_projectile(this, EFFECT_SPIDERBOT_ROCKETLAUNCH, SND_ROCKET_FIRE,
                                   v, normalize(v_forward) * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_speed,
                                   autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_damage, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_radius, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_force, 1,
                                   DEATH_VH_SPID_ROCKET.m_id, PROJECTILE_SPIDERROCKET, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_health, false, false, this.owner);
            crosshair_trace(this.owner);
            rocket.pos1 = trace_endpos;
            rocket.nextthink = time;
            (_selftemp = (rocket), _selftemp.__think = ((spiderbot_rocket_guided) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (spiderbot_rocket_guided));


        break;
        case SBRM_ARTILLERY:
            rocket = vehicles_projectile(this, EFFECT_SPIDERBOT_ROCKETLAUNCH, SND_ROCKET_FIRE,
                                   v, normalize(v_forward) * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_speed,
                                   autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_damage, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_radius, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_force, 1,
                                   DEATH_VH_SPID_ROCKET.m_id, PROJECTILE_SPIDERROCKET, autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_health, false, true, this.owner);

            crosshair_trace(this.owner);

            rocket.pos1 = trace_endpos + randomvec() * (0.75 * autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_radius);
            rocket.pos1_z = trace_endpos_z;

            traceline(v, v + '0 0 1' * max_shot_distance, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
            float h1 = 0.75 * vlen(v - trace_endpos);


            traceline(v , rocket.pos1 + '0 0 1' * max_shot_distance, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
            float h2 = 0.75 * vlen(rocket.pos1 - v);

            rocket.velocity = spiberbot_calcartillery(v, rocket.pos1, ((h1 < h2) ? h1 : h2));
            set_movetype(rocket, MOVETYPE_TOSS);
            rocket.gravity = 1;

        break;
    }
    rocket.classname = "spiderbot_rocket";

    rocket.cnt = time + autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_lifetime;

    this.tur_head.frame += 1;
    if (this.tur_head.frame == 9)
        this.attack_finished_single[0] = autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_reload;
    else
        this.attack_finished_single[0] = (((this).stat_VEHICLESTAT_W2MODE == SBRM_VOLLY) ? autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_refire2 : autocvar_g_vehicle_spiderbot_rocket_refire);

    this.gun2.cnt = time + this.attack_finished_single[0];
}

float buffs_BuffModel_Customize(entity this, entity client)
{
 entity player = WaypointSprite_getviewentity(client);
 entity myowner = this.owner;
 entity heldbuff = buff_FirstFromFlags(myowner);

 if(!heldbuff)
  return false;

 if(myowner.alpha <= 0.5 && (teamplay ? (player.team != myowner.team) : (player != myowner)) && myowner.alpha != 0)
  return false;

 if(__Mutator_Send_BuffModel_Customize(0 , this, player))
  return false;

 if(player == myowner)
 {

  this.effects = 0;
  this.alpha = -1;
 }
 else
 {
  this.effects = EF_FULLBRIGHT | EF_LOWPRECISION;
  this.alpha = myowner.alpha;
 }
 return true;
}

 if (this.alpha < 0)
  return;

 if (!this.buff_model)
  buffs_BuffModel_Spawn(this);
}

void buff_Effect(entity player, string eff)
{
 if(!autocvar_g_buffs_effects) { return; }

 if(time >= player.buff_effect_delay)
 {
  Send_Effect_(eff, player.origin + ((player.mins + player.maxs) * 0.5), '0 0 0', 1);
  player.buff_effect_delay = time + 0.05;
 }
}


float buff_Waypoint_visible_for_player(entity this, entity player, entity view)
{
 if(!this.owner.buff_active && !this.owner.buff_activetime || !this.owner.buffdef)
  return false;

 entity heldbuff = buff_FirstFromFlags(view);
 if (heldbuff)
 {
  return (view).cvar_cl_buffs_autoreplace == false || heldbuff != this.owner.buffdef;
 }

 return WaypointSprite_visible_for_player(this, player, view);
}

void buff_Waypoint_Spawn(entity e)
{
 if(autocvar_g_buffs_waypoint_distance <= 0) return;

 entity buff = e.buffdef;
 entity wp = WaypointSprite_Spawn(WP_Buff, 0, autocvar_g_buffs_waypoint_distance, e, '0 0 1' * e.maxs.z, (0, world), e.team_forced, e, buff_waypoint, true, RADARICON_Buff);
 wp.wp_extra = buff.m_id;
 WaypointSprite_UpdateTeamRadar(e.buff_waypoint, RADARICON_Buff, e.glowmod);
 e.buff_waypoint.waypointsprite_visible_for_player = buff_Waypoint_visible_for_player;
}

void buff_SetCooldown(entity this, float cd)
{
 cd = max(0, cd);

 if(!this.buff_waypoint)
  buff_Waypoint_Spawn(this);

 if(this.buff_waypoint)
  WaypointSprite_UpdateBuildFinished(this.buff_waypoint, time + cd);

 this.buff_activetime = cd;
 this.buff_active = !cd;
}

void buff_Respawn(entity this)
{
 if(game_stopped) return;

 vector oldbufforigin = this.origin;
 this.velocity = '0 0 200';

 if(!MoveToRandomMapLocation(this, DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE | DPCONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP, DPCONTENTS_SLIME | DPCONTENTS_LAVA | DPCONTENTS_SKY | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_DONOTENTER, Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY,
  ((autocvar_g_buffs_random_location_attempts > 0) ? autocvar_g_buffs_random_location_attempts : 10), 1024, 256))
 {
  entity spot = SelectSpawnPoint(this, true);
  setorigin(this, spot.origin);
  this.velocity = ((randomvec() * 100) + '0 0 200');
  this.angles = spot.angles;
 }

 tracebox(this.origin, this.mins * 1.5, this.maxs * 1.5, this.origin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);

 setorigin(this, trace_endpos);

 set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_TOSS);

 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/buffs/sv_buffs.qc", 174, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();
 this.angles = '0 0 0';
 if(autocvar_g_buffs_random_lifetime > 0)
  this.lifetime = time + autocvar_g_buffs_random_lifetime;

 Send_Effect(EFFECT_ELECTRO_COMBO, oldbufforigin + ((this.mins + this.maxs) * 0.5), '0 0 0', 1);
 Send_Effect(EFFECT_ELECTRO_COMBO, (this.origin + (((this).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? this.view_ofs : ((this.mins + this.maxs) * 0.5))), '0 0 0', 1);

 WaypointSprite_Ping(this.buff_waypoint);

 if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_KA_RESPAWN), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NONE, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
}

void buff_Touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 if(game_stopped) return;

 if((((trace_dpstartcontents | trace_dphitcontents) & DPCONTENTS_NODROP) || (trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY)))
 {
  buff_Respawn(this);
  return;
 }

 if(!this.buff_active)
  return;

 if(__Mutator_Send_BuffTouch(0 , this, toucher))
  return;
 toucher = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;

 if(!((toucher).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return;

 if((this.team_forced && toucher.team != this.team_forced)
 || ((toucher).stat_FROZEN)
 || (toucher.vehicle)
 || (!this.buffdef)
 || (time < toucher.buff_shield)
 )
 {

  return;
 }

 entity heldbuff = buff_FirstFromFlags(toucher);
 entity thebuff = this.buffdef;

 if (heldbuff)
 {
  if ((toucher).cvar_cl_buffs_autoreplace && heldbuff != thebuff)
  {

   float buffid = heldbuff.m_id;
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_INFO, INFO_ITEM_BUFF_LOST, toucher.netname, buffid);
   if(!((toucher).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER))
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL_EXCEPT, toucher, MSG_INFO, INFO_ITEM_BUFF_LOST, toucher.netname, buffid);


  }
  else { return; }
 }

 this.owner = toucher;
 this.buff_active = false;
 this.lifetime = 0;
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_MULTI, ITEM_BUFF_GOT, thebuff.m_id);
 if(!((toucher).solid == SOLID_TRIGGER))
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL_EXCEPT, toucher, MSG_INFO, INFO_ITEM_BUFF, toucher.netname, thebuff.m_id);

 Send_Effect(EFFECT_ITEM_PICKUP, (this.origin + (((this).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? this.view_ofs : ((this.mins + this.maxs) * 0.5))), '0 0 0', 1);
 if(1){ entity __e = toucher; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_SHIELD_RESPAWN), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
 float oldtime = StatusEffects_gettime(thebuff, toucher);
 float bufftime = ((this.buffs_finished) ? this.buffs_finished : thebuff.m_time(thebuff));

 buff_RemoveAll(toucher, STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_NORMAL);
 if(bufftime)
  StatusEffects_apply(thebuff, toucher, min(time + bufftime, max(oldtime, time) + bufftime), 0);
 else
  StatusEffects_apply(thebuff, toucher, time + 999, 0);

 (toucher).stat_LAST_PICKUP = time;
}

{
 if (!buff)
  return false;
 if (buff == BUFF_AMMO && ((start_items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO) || cvar("g_melee_only")))
  return false;
 if (buff == BUFF_VAMPIRE && cvar("g_vampire"))
  return false;
 return cvar(strcat("g_buffs_", buff.netname));
}

void buff_Think(entity this)
{
 if(this.buff_waypoint && autocvar_g_buffs_waypoint_distance <= 0)
  WaypointSprite_Kill(this.buff_waypoint);

 if(this.buffdef != this.oldbuffs)
 {
  entity buff = this.buffdef;
  this.color = buff.m_color;
  this.glowmod = buff.m_color;
  this.skin = buff.m_skin;

  if(1){ Model _setmodel_model = (MDL_BUFF); string _setmodel_cached = _setmodel_model.model_str_; _setmodel((this), _setmodel_cached ? _setmodel_cached : _setmodel_model.model_str()); }else voidfunc();
  setsize(this, BUFF_MIN, BUFF_MAX);

  if(this.buff_waypoint)
  {

   WaypointSprite_Kill(this.buff_waypoint);
   buff_Waypoint_Spawn(this);
   if(this.buff_activetime)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateBuildFinished(this.buff_waypoint, time + this.buff_activetime - frametime);
  }

  this.oldbuffs = this.buffdef;
 }

 if(!game_stopped)
 if(((round_handler != (0, world)) && (!round_handler.wait && !round_handler.cnt)) || time >= game_starttime)
 if(!this.buff_activetime_updated)
 {
  buff_SetCooldown(this, this.buff_activetime);
  this.buff_activetime_updated = true;
 }

 if(!this.buff_active && !this.buff_activetime)
 if(!this.owner || (this.owner).stat_FROZEN || ((this.owner).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || !this.owner.iscreature || this.owner.vehicle
  || this.pickup_anyway > 0 || (this.pickup_anyway >= 0 && autocvar_g_buffs_pickup_anyway) || this.buffdef != buff_FirstFromFlags(this.owner))
 {
  buff_SetCooldown(this, autocvar_g_buffs_cooldown_respawn + frametime);
  this.owner = (0, world);
  if(autocvar_g_buffs_randomize && (!teamplay || autocvar_g_buffs_randomize_teamplay))
   buff_NewType(this);

  if(autocvar_g_buffs_random_location || (this.spawnflags & 64))
   buff_Respawn(this);
 }

 if(this.buff_activetime)
 if(!game_stopped)
 if(((round_handler != (0, world)) && (!round_handler.wait && !round_handler.cnt)) || time >= game_starttime)
 {
  this.buff_activetime = max(0, this.buff_activetime - frametime);

  if(!this.buff_activetime)
  {
   this.buff_active = true;
   if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_STRENGTH_RESPAWN), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
   Send_Effect(EFFECT_ITEM_RESPAWN, (this.origin + (((this).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? this.view_ofs : ((this.mins + this.maxs) * 0.5))), '0 0 0', 1);
  }
 }

 if(this.buff_active)
 {
  if(this.team_forced && !this.buff_waypoint)
   buff_Waypoint_Spawn(this);

  if(this.lifetime && time >= this.lifetime)
   buff_Respawn(this);
 }

 this.nextthink = time;

}

void buff_Waypoint_Reset(entity this)
{
 WaypointSprite_Kill(this.buff_waypoint);

 if(this.buff_activetime) { buff_Waypoint_Spawn(this); }
}

void buff_Reset(entity this)
{
 if(autocvar_g_buffs_randomize && (!teamplay || autocvar_g_buffs_randomize_teamplay))
  buff_NewType(this);
 this.owner = (0, world);
 buff_SetCooldown(this, autocvar_g_buffs_cooldown_activate);
 buff_Waypoint_Reset(this);
 this.buff_activetime_updated = false;

 if(autocvar_g_buffs_random_location || (this.spawnflags & 64))
  buff_Respawn(this);
}

float buff_Customize(entity this, entity client)
{
 entity player = WaypointSprite_getviewentity(client);
 if((!this.buff_active || !this.buffdef) || (this.team_forced && player.team != this.team_forced))
 {
  this.alpha = 0.3;
  if(this.effects & EF_FULLBRIGHT) { this.effects &= ~(EF_FULLBRIGHT); }
  this.pflags = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  this.alpha = 1;
  if(!(this.effects & EF_FULLBRIGHT)) { this.effects |= EF_FULLBRIGHT; }
  this.light_lev = 220 + 36 * sin(time);
  this.pflags = PFLAGS_FULLDYNAMIC;
 }
 return true;
}

void buff_Delete(entity this)
{
 WaypointSprite_Kill(this.buff_waypoint);
 delete_fn(this);
}

void buff_Init(entity this)
{
 if(!cvar("g_buffs")) { if(1){ entity _this = (this); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc(); return; }

 if(!buff || !buff_Available(buff))
  buff_NewType(this);

 this.classname = "item_buff";
 this.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
 this.flags = FL_ITEM;
 this.bot_pickup = true;
 this.bot_pickupevalfunc = generic_pickupevalfunc;
 this.bot_pickupbasevalue = 1000;
 IL_PUSH(g_items, this);
 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((buff_Think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (buff_Think));
 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__touch = ((buff_Touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (buff_Touch));
 if(1){ Model _setmodel_model = (MDL_BUFF); string _setmodel_cached = _setmodel_model.model_str_; _setmodel((this), _setmodel_cached ? _setmodel_cached : _setmodel_model.model_str()); }else voidfunc();
 setsize(this, BUFF_MIN, BUFF_MAX);
 this.reset = buff_Reset;
 this.nextthink = time + 0.1;
 this.gravity = 1;
 set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_TOSS);
 this.scale = 1;
 this.skin = buff.m_skin;
 this.effects = EF_FULLBRIGHT | EF_STARDUST | EF_NOSHADOW;
 this.dphitcontentsmask = DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_BODY;
 (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__customizeentityforclient = ((buff_Customize) ? customizeentityforclient_self : nil), _selftemp.selfcustomizeentityforclient = (buff_Customize));

 this.color = buff.m_color;
 this.glowmod = buff.m_color;
 buff_SetCooldown(this, autocvar_g_buffs_cooldown_activate + max(0, game_starttime - time));
 this.buff_active = !this.buff_activetime;
 this.pflags = PFLAGS_FULLDYNAMIC;
 this.dtor = buff_Delete;

 if(!this.buffs_finished)
  this.buffs_finished = this.count;

 if(this.spawnflags & 1)
  this.noalign = true;

 if(this.noalign)
  set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_NONE);

 if(cvar("g_buffs_random_location") || (this.spawnflags & 64))
  buff_Respawn(this);
}

   ent.team_forced = NUM_TEAM_1;

   ent.team_forced = NUM_TEAM_2;

 ent.buffdef = replacement;

 buff_Init(ent);
}

 ent.angles = old.angles;
 ent.noalign = Item_ShouldKeepPosition(old);

}

float buff_Inferno_CalculateTime(float damg, float offset_x, float offset_y, float intersect_x, float intersect_y, float base)
{
 return offset_y + (intersect_y - offset_y) * logn(((damg - offset_x) * ((base - 1) / intersect_x)) + 1, base);
}

 g_bugrigs_speed_ref = cvar("g_bugrigs_speed_ref");

float racecar_angle(float forward, float down)
{
 if (forward < 0)
 {
  forward = -forward;
  down = -down;
 }

 float ret = vectoyaw('0 1 0' * down + '1 0 0' * forward);

 float angle_mult = forward / (800 + forward);

 if (ret > 180)
  return ret * angle_mult + 360 * (1 - angle_mult);
 else
  return ret * angle_mult;
}

void RaceCarPhysics(entity this, float dt)
{



 vector rigvel;

 vector angles_save = this.angles;
 float accel = bound(-1, (this._cs).movement.x / (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED, 1);
 float steer = bound(-1, (this._cs).movement.y / (this).stat_MOVEVARS_MAXSPEED, 1);

 if (g_bugrigs_reverse_speeding)
 {
  if (accel < 0)
  {


   if (accel < -0.5)
    accel = -1;
   else
    accel = 0;
  }
 }

 this.angles_x = 0;
 this.angles_z = 0;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/bugrigs/bugrigs.qc", 130, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();

 if ((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) || g_bugrigs_air_steering)
 {
  float myspeed = this.velocity * v_forward;
  float upspeed = this.velocity * v_up;


  float f = 1 / (1 + ((max(-myspeed, myspeed) / g_bugrigs_speed_ref) ** g_bugrigs_speed_pow));


  float steerfactor;
  if (myspeed < 0 && g_bugrigs_reverse_spinning)
   steerfactor = -myspeed * g_bugrigs_steer;
  else
   steerfactor = -myspeed * f * g_bugrigs_steer;

  float accelfactor;
  if (myspeed < 0 && g_bugrigs_reverse_speeding)
   accelfactor = g_bugrigs_accel;
  else
   accelfactor = f * g_bugrigs_accel;


  if (accel < 0)
  {
   if (myspeed > 0)
   {
    myspeed = max(0, myspeed - dt * (g_bugrigs_friction_floor - g_bugrigs_friction_brake * accel));
   }
   else
   {
    if (!g_bugrigs_reverse_speeding)
     myspeed = min(0, myspeed + dt * g_bugrigs_friction_floor);
   }
  }
  else
  {
   if (myspeed >= 0)
   {
    myspeed = max(0, myspeed - dt * g_bugrigs_friction_floor);
   }
   else
   {
    if (g_bugrigs_reverse_stopping)
     myspeed = 0;
    else
     myspeed = min(0, myspeed + dt * (g_bugrigs_friction_floor + g_bugrigs_friction_brake * accel));
   }
  }



  this.angles_y += steer * dt * steerfactor;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/bugrigs/bugrigs.qc", 184, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();

  myspeed += accel * accelfactor * dt;

  rigvel = myspeed * v_forward + '0 0 1' * upspeed;
 }
 else
 {
  float myspeed = vlen(this.velocity);


  float f = 1 / (1 + (max(0, myspeed / g_bugrigs_speed_ref) ** g_bugrigs_speed_pow));
  float steerfactor = -myspeed * f;
  this.angles_y += steer * dt * steerfactor;

  rigvel = this.velocity;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/bugrigs/bugrigs.qc", 200, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();
 }

 rigvel *= max(0, 1 - vlen(rigvel) * g_bugrigs_friction_air * dt);




 if (g_bugrigs_planar_movement)
 {
  vector rigvel_xy, neworigin, up;
  float mt;

  rigvel_z -= dt * cvar("sv_gravity");
  rigvel_xy = (_vec2 = (rigvel), _vec2.z = 0, _vec2);

  if (g_bugrigs_planar_movement_car_jumping)
   mt = MOVE_NORMAL;
  else
   mt = MOVE_NOMONSTERS;

  tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin + '0 0 1024', mt, this);
  up = trace_endpos - this.origin;



  tracebox(trace_endpos, this.mins, this.maxs, trace_endpos + rigvel_xy * dt, mt, this);


  tracebox(trace_endpos, this.mins, this.maxs, trace_endpos - up + '0 0 1' * rigvel_z * dt, mt, this);

  if (trace_fraction < 0.5)
  {
   trace_fraction = 1;
   neworigin = this.origin;
  }
  else
   neworigin = trace_endpos;

  if (trace_fraction < 1)
  {

   this.angles = vectoangles(
     '1 0 0' * v_forward.x * trace_plane_normal.z
     +
     '0 1 0' * v_forward.y * trace_plane_normal.z
     +
     '0 0 1' * -(v_forward.x * trace_plane_normal.x + v_forward.y * trace_plane_normal.y)
     );
   ((this).flags |= FL_ONGROUND);
  }
  else
  {

   ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);
  }

  this.velocity = (neworigin - this.origin) * (1.0 / dt);
  set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_NOCLIP);
 }
 else
 {
  rigvel_z -= dt * cvar("sv_gravity");
  this.velocity = rigvel;
  set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_FLY);
 }

 trace_fraction = 1;
 tracebox(this.origin, this.mins, this.maxs, this.origin - '0 0 4', MOVE_NORMAL, this);
 if (trace_fraction != 1)
 {
  this.angles = vectoangles2(
    '1 0 0' * v_forward.x * trace_plane_normal.z
    +
    '0 1 0' * v_forward.y * trace_plane_normal.z
    +
    '0 0 1' * -(v_forward.x * trace_plane_normal.x + v_forward.y * trace_plane_normal.y),
    trace_plane_normal
    );
 }
 else
 {
  vector vel_local;

  vel_local.x = v_forward * this.velocity;
  vel_local.y = v_right * this.velocity;
  vel_local.z = v_up * this.velocity;

  this.angles_x = racecar_angle(vel_local.x, vel_local.z);
  this.angles_z = racecar_angle(-vel_local.y, vel_local.z);
 }


 vector vf1, vu1, smoothangles;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/bugrigs/bugrigs.qc", 294, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); }else voidfunc();
 float f = bound(0, dt * g_bugrigs_angle_smoothing, 1);
 if (f == 0)
  f = 1;
 vf1 = v_forward * f;
 vu1 = v_up * f;
 if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/bugrigs/bugrigs.qc", 300, __FUNC__, "\"angles_save\""); _makevectors_hidden(angles_save); }else voidfunc();
 vf1 = vf1 + v_forward * (1 - f);
 vu1 = vu1 + v_up * (1 - f);
 smoothangles = vectoangles2(vf1, vu1);
 this.angles_x = -smoothangles.x;
 this.angles_z = smoothangles.z;
}


.vector bugrigs_prevangles;

Callback CB_campcheck__PlayerPreThink; float campcheck__PlayerPreThink(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_campcheck__PlayerPreThink = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/mutators/mutator/campcheck/sv_campcheck.qc" ":" "35", true) , campcheck__PlayerPreThink); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_campcheck_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK__PlayerPreThink, CB_campcheck__PlayerPreThink, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("_PlayerPreThink", "campcheck__PlayerPreThink"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK__PlayerPreThink, CB_campcheck__PlayerPreThink); } }else voidfunc(); } float campcheck__PlayerPreThink() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float campcheck__PlayerPreThink()
{
 entity player = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_entity;
 float checked = false;

 if(autocvar_g_campcheck_interval)
 if(!game_stopped && !warmup_stage && time >= game_starttime)
 if(((player).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((player).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !(player).stat_FROZEN)

  {

   player.campcheck_traveled_distance = 0;
  }

  if(time > player.campcheck_nextcheck)
  {
   if(player.campcheck_traveled_distance < autocvar_g_campcheck_distance)
   {
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CAMPCHECK);
    if(player.vehicle)
     Damage(player.vehicle, (0, world), (0, world), autocvar_g_campcheck_damage * 2, DEATH_CAMP.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), player.vehicle.origin, '0 0 0');
    else
    {

    }
   }
   player.campcheck_nextcheck = time + autocvar_g_campcheck_interval;
   player.campcheck_traveled_distance = 0;
  }

  checked = true;
 }

}

float write_damagetext(entity this, entity client, float sf)
{
    entity attacker = this.realowner;
    entity hit = this.enemy;
    float flags = this.dent_net_flags;
    float deathtype = this.dent_net_deathtype;
    float health = this.dent_net_health;
    float armor = this.dent_net_armor;
    float potential_damage = this.dent_net_potential;
    if (!(
        ((autocvar_sv_damagetext >= 3)) ||
        ((autocvar_sv_damagetext >= 2) && client == attacker) ||
        ((autocvar_sv_damagetext >= 1) && ((client).classname == STR_SPECTATOR) && client.enemy == attacker) ||
        ((autocvar_sv_damagetext >= 1) && ((client).classname == STR_OBSERVER))
    )) return false;

    if(1){ if (NET_damagetext_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, NET_damagetext.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, num_for_edict(hit));
    WriteInt24_t(MSG_ENTITY, deathtype);
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, flags);




    if (flags & DTFLAG_BIG_HEALTH) WriteInt24_t(MSG_ENTITY, health * 128);
    else WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, health * 128);
    if (!(flags & DTFLAG_NO_ARMOR))
    {
        if (flags & DTFLAG_BIG_ARMOR) WriteInt24_t(MSG_ENTITY, armor * 128);
        else WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, armor * 128);
    }
    if (!(flags & DTFLAG_NO_POTENTIAL))
    {
        if (flags & DTFLAG_BIG_POTENTIAL) WriteInt24_t(MSG_ENTITY, potential_damage * 128);
        else WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, potential_damage * 128);
    }
    return true;
}

void PM_dodging(entity this)
{

 if (!this.dodging_action) return;


 float frozen_dodging = ((this).stat_FROZEN && (this).stat_DODGING_FROZEN);
 if (this.waterlevel >= WATERLEVEL_SWIMMING || ((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || (autocvar_sv_dodging_clientselect && !(this).cvar_cl_dodging && !frozen_dodging))
 {
  this.dodging_action = 0;
  this.dodging_direction.x = 0;
  this.dodging_direction.y = 0;
  return;
 }

 vector forward, right, up;
 if(autocvar_sv_dodging_air_dodging)
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./common/mutators/mutator/dodging/sv_dodging.qc", 234, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();
 else
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_WRAPPED, "MAKE_VECTORS", "./common/mutators/mutator/dodging/sv_dodging.qc", 236, __FUNC__, "\"this.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.angles); if(1){ forward = v_forward; right = v_right; up = v_up; }else voidfunc(); if(1){ if (autocvar_debug_deglobalization_clear) { v_forward = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_right = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3);; v_up = (_vec3.x = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.y = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3.z = (FLOAT_NAN), _vec3); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();





 float common_factor = sys_frametime / autocvar_sv_dodging_ramp_time;



 float velocity_increase = min(common_factor * this.dodging_force_total, this.dodging_force_remaining);
 this.dodging_force_remaining -= velocity_increase;
 this.velocity += this.dodging_direction.x * velocity_increase * forward
                + this.dodging_direction.y * velocity_increase * right;


 if (this.dodging_single_action == 1)
 {
  ((this).flags &= ~FL_ONGROUND);

  this.velocity += autocvar_sv_dodging_up_speed * up;


  if (autocvar_sv_dodging_sound)
   _GlobalSound(this, (0, world), playersound_jump, nil, CH_PLAYER, VOL_BASE, VOICETYPE_PLAYERSOUND, false);

  animdecide_setaction(this, ANIMACTION_JUMP, true);


  this.dodging_single_action = 0;
 }

 if(this.dodging_force_remaining <= 0)
 {

  this.dodging_action = 0;
  this.dodging_direction.x = 0;
  this.dodging_direction.y = 0;
 }
}

{

.float instagib_nextthink;
.float instagib_needammo;
void instagib_stop_countdown(entity e)
{
 if (!e.instagib_needammo)
  return;
 Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, e, MSG_CENTER, CPID_INSTAGIB_FINDAMMO);
 e.instagib_needammo = false;
}

void instagib_countdown(entity this)
{
 float hp = GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH);

 float dmg = (hp <= 10) ? 5 : 10;
 Damage(this, this, this, dmg, DEATH_NOAMMO.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), this.origin, '0 0 0');

 entity annce = (hp <= 5) ? ANNCE_INSTAGIB_TERMINATED : Announcer_PickNumber(CNT_NORMAL, ceil(hp / 10));
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, this, MSG_ANNCE, annce);

 if (hp > 80)
 {
  if (hp <= 90)
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, this, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_INSTAGIB_FINDAMMO);
  else
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, this, MSG_MULTI, MULTI_INSTAGIB_FINDAMMO);
 }
}

void instagib_ammocheck(entity this)
{
 if(time < this.instagib_nextthink)
  return;
 if(!((this).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return;

 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || game_stopped)
  instagib_stop_countdown(this);
 else if (GetResource(this, RES_CELLS) > 0 || (this.items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO) || (this.flags & FL_GODMODE))
  instagib_stop_countdown(this);
 else if(autocvar_g_rm && autocvar_g_rm_laser)
 {
  if(!this.instagib_needammo)
  {
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, this, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_INSTAGIB_DOWNGRADE);
   this.instagib_needammo = true;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  this.instagib_needammo = true;
  instagib_countdown(this);
 }
 this.instagib_nextthink = time + 1;
}

Callback CB_mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate; float mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "168", true) , mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_mutator_instagib_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_Damage_Calculate, CB_mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("Damage_Calculate", "mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_Damage_Calculate, CB_mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate); } }else voidfunc(); } float mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float mutator_instagib_Damage_Calculate()
{
 entity frag_attacker = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;
 entity frag_target = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_entity;
 float frag_deathtype = MUTATOR_ARGV_3_float;
 float frag_damage = MUTATOR_ARGV_4_float;
 float frag_mirrordamage = MUTATOR_ARGV_5_float;
 vector frag_force = MUTATOR_ARGV_6_vector;

 if(autocvar_g_friendlyfire == 0 && (teamplay ? (frag_target.team == frag_attacker.team) : (frag_target == frag_attacker)) && ((frag_target).classname == STR_PLAYER) && ((frag_attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  frag_damage = 0;

 if(((frag_target).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 {
  if(frag_deathtype == DEATH_FALL.m_id)
   frag_damage = 0;

  if(!autocvar_g_instagib_damagedbycontents)
  switch(((frag_deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? (Deathtypes_from(frag_deathtype - DT_FIRST)) : (0, world)))
  {
   case DEATH_DROWN:
   case DEATH_SLIME:
   case DEATH_LAVA:
    frag_damage = 0;
    break;
  }

  if(((frag_attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  if((((frag_deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((frag_deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_VAPORIZER)))
  {
   if(!autocvar_g_instagib_friendlypush && (teamplay ? (frag_target.team == frag_attacker.team) : (frag_target == frag_attacker)))
    frag_force = '0 0 0';

   float armor = GetResource(frag_target, RES_ARMOR);
   if(armor)
   {
    armor -= 1;
    SetResource(frag_target, RES_ARMOR, armor);
    frag_damage = 0;
    frag_target.hitsound_damage_dealt += 1;
    frag_attacker.hitsound_damage_dealt += 1;
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, frag_target, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_INSTAGIB_LIVES_REMAINING, armor);
   }
  }

  if(((frag_attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (((frag_deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((frag_deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_BLASTER)))
  {
   if(frag_deathtype & HITTYPE_SECONDARY)
   {
    if(!autocvar_g_instagib_blaster_keepdamage || frag_attacker == frag_target)
    {
     frag_damage = 0;
     if(!autocvar_g_instagib_mirrordamage)
      frag_mirrordamage = 0;
    }

    if(frag_target != frag_attacker)
    {
     if(!autocvar_g_instagib_blaster_keepforce)
      frag_force = '0 0 0';
    }
   }
  }
 }

 if(!autocvar_g_instagib_mirrordamage)
 if(((frag_attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 if(frag_mirrordamage > 0)
 {

  float armor = GetResource(frag_attacker, RES_ARMOR);
  if(armor > 0)
  {
   armor -= 1;
   SetResource(frag_attacker, RES_ARMOR, armor);
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, frag_attacker, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_INSTAGIB_LIVES_REMAINING, armor);
   frag_attacker.hitsound_damage_dealt += frag_mirrordamage;
  }
  frag_mirrordamage = 0;
 }

 if(frag_target.alpha && frag_target.alpha < 1)
 if(((frag_target).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  yoda = 1;

 MUTATOR_ARGV_4_float = frag_damage;
 MUTATOR_ARGV_5_float = frag_mirrordamage;
 MUTATOR_ARGV_6_vector = frag_force;
}

void instagib_replace_item_with(entity this, GameItem def)
{
 entity new_item = (0, world);
 switch (def)
 {
  case ITEM_Invisibility:
   new_item = __spawn("item_invisibility", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "286", false);
   new_item.invisibility_finished = autocvar_g_instagib_invisibility_time;
   break;
  case ITEM_Speed:
   new_item = __spawn("item_speed", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "290", false);
   new_item.speed_finished = autocvar_g_instagib_speed_time;
   break;
  case ITEM_ExtraLife:
   new_item = __spawn("item_extralife", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "294", false);
   break;
  case ITEM_VaporizerCells:
   new_item = __spawn("item_vaporizer_cells", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "297", false);
   break;
  default:
   (__self = ((0, world)), builtin_error("Unhandled replacement item."));
 }
 Item_CopyFields(this, new_item);
 StartItem(new_item, def);
}

const float INSTAGIB_POWERUP_COUNT = 3;
GameItem instagib_remaining_powerups[INSTAGIB_POWERUP_COUNT];


void instagib_replace_item_with_random_powerup(entity item)
{
 static float remaining_powerups_count = INSTAGIB_POWERUP_COUNT;
 if (remaining_powerups_count == 0)
  remaining_powerups_count = INSTAGIB_POWERUP_COUNT;
 if (remaining_powerups_count == INSTAGIB_POWERUP_COUNT)
 {
  instagib_remaining_powerups[0] = ITEM_Invisibility;
  instagib_remaining_powerups[1] = ITEM_ExtraLife;
  instagib_remaining_powerups[2] = ITEM_Speed;
 }

 float r = floor(random() * remaining_powerups_count);
 instagib_replace_item_with(item, instagib_remaining_powerups[r]);
 for(float i = r; i < INSTAGIB_POWERUP_COUNT - 1; ++i)
  instagib_remaining_powerups[i] = instagib_remaining_powerups[i + 1];
 --remaining_powerups_count;
}

Callback CB_mutator_instagib_FilterItem; float mutator_instagib_FilterItem(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_mutator_instagib_FilterItem = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "329", true) , mutator_instagib_FilterItem); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_mutator_instagib_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_FilterItem, CB_mutator_instagib_FilterItem, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("FilterItem", "mutator_instagib_FilterItem"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_FilterItem, CB_mutator_instagib_FilterItem); } }else voidfunc(); } float mutator_instagib_FilterItem() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float mutator_instagib_FilterItem()
{
 entity item = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_entity;
 entity def = item.itemdef;
 if(def == ITEM_Strength || def == ITEM_Shield || def == ITEM_HealthMega || def == ITEM_ArmorMega)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_powerups)
   instagib_replace_item_with_random_powerup(item);
  return true;
 }

 if(def == ITEM_Cells)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_convert_cells)
   instagib_replace_item_with(item, ITEM_VaporizerCells);
  return true;
 }
 else if(def == ITEM_Rockets)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_convert_rockets)
   instagib_replace_item_with(item, ITEM_VaporizerCells);
  return true;
 }
 else if(def == ITEM_Shells)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_convert_shells)
   instagib_replace_item_with(item, ITEM_VaporizerCells);
  return true;
 }
 else if(def == ITEM_Bullets)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_convert_bullets)
   instagib_replace_item_with(item, ITEM_VaporizerCells);
  return true;
 }

 if(item.weapon == WEP_VAPORIZER.m_id && Item_IsLoot(item))
 {
  SetResource(item, RES_CELLS, autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_drop);
  return false;
 }

 if(item.weapon == WEP_DEVASTATOR.m_id || item.weapon == WEP_VORTEX.m_id)
 {
  instagib_replace_item_with(item, ITEM_VaporizerCells);
  return true;
 }

 if(item.itemdef.instanceOfPowerup)
  return false;

 float cells = GetResource(item, RES_CELLS);
 if(cells > autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_drop && item.classname != "item_vaporizer_cells")
  SetResource(item, RES_CELLS, autocvar_g_instagib_ammo_drop);

 if(cells && !item.weapon)
  return false;

 return true;
}

Callback CB_mutator_instagib_ItemTouch; float mutator_instagib_ItemTouch(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_mutator_instagib_ItemTouch = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "398", true) , mutator_instagib_ItemTouch); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_mutator_instagib_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_ItemTouch, CB_mutator_instagib_ItemTouch, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("ItemTouch", "mutator_instagib_ItemTouch"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_ItemTouch, CB_mutator_instagib_ItemTouch); } }else voidfunc(); } float mutator_instagib_ItemTouch() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float mutator_instagib_ItemTouch()
{
 if(CallbackChain_ReturnValue) return false;

 entity item = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_entity;
 entity toucher = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;

 if(GetResource(item, RES_CELLS))
 {

  float hp = GetResource(toucher, RES_HEALTH);
  if ((toucher.flags & FL_CLIENT))
  {
   if(hp <= 5)
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_INSTAGIB_LASTSECOND);
   else if(hp < 50)
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_ANNCE, ANNCE_INSTAGIB_NARROWLY);
  }

  if(hp < 100)
   SetResource(toucher, RES_HEALTH, 100);

  return MUT_ITEMTOUCH_CONTINUE;
 }

 if(item.itemdef == ITEM_ExtraLife)
 {
  GiveResource(toucher, RES_ARMOR, autocvar_g_instagib_extralives);
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_EXTRALIVES, autocvar_g_instagib_extralives);
  Inventory_pickupitem(item.itemdef, toucher);
  return MUT_ITEMTOUCH_PICKUP;
 }

 return MUT_ITEMTOUCH_CONTINUE;
}

Callback CB_mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString; float mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/mutators/mutator/instagib/sv_instagib.qc" ":" "434", true) , mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_mutator_instagib_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_BuildMutatorsString, CB_mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("BuildMutatorsString", "mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_BuildMutatorsString, CB_mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString); } }else voidfunc(); } float mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float mutator_instagib_BuildMutatorsString()

Callback CB_kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies; float kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/mutators/mutator/kick_teamkiller/sv_kick_teamkiller.qc" ":" "11", true) , kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_kick_teamkiller_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_PlayerDies, CB_kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("PlayerDies", "kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_PlayerDies, CB_kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies); } }else voidfunc(); } float kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float kick_teamkiller_PlayerDies()
{
 if (!teamplay)
 {
  return;
 }
 if (warmup_stage)
 {
  return;
 }
 entity attacker = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;
 if (!(clienttype(attacker) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))
 {
  return;
 }

 float masksize = autocvar_g_ban_default_masksize;
 float bantime = autocvar_g_kick_teamkiller_bantime;

 float teamkills = PlayerScore_Add(attacker, SP_TEAMKILLS, 0);

 float playtime = time - (attacker._cs).startplaytime;

 if (teamkills >= autocvar_g_kick_teamkiller_lower_limit &&
  teamkills >= autocvar_g_kick_teamkiller_rate*playtime/60.0)
 {
  switch (autocvar_g_kick_teamkiller_severity)
  {
   case 1:
   {
    if (dropclient_schedule(attacker))
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_QUIT_KICK_TEAMKILL, attacker.netname);
    return;
   }
   case 2:
   {
    attacker.respawn_flags = RESPAWN_SILENT;
    Ban_KickBanClient(attacker, bantime, masksize, "Team Killing");
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_QUIT_KICK_TEAMKILL, attacker.netname);
    return;
   }
   default:
   {
    attacker.respawn_flags = RESPAWN_SILENT;
    string theid = "";

    if(!PlayerInIPList(attacker, autocvar_g_playban_list))
     theid = cons(theid, attacker.netaddress);

void napalm_damage(entity this, float dist, float damage, float edgedamage, float burntime)
{
 entity e;
 float d;
 vector p;

 if ( damage < 0 )
  return;

 RandomSelection_Init();
 for(e = WarpZone_FindRadius(this.origin, dist, true); e; e = e.chain)
  if(e.takedamage == DAMAGE_AIM)
  if(this.realowner != e || autocvar_g_nades_napalm_selfdamage)
  if(!((e).classname == STR_PLAYER) || !this.realowner || (teamplay ? (e.team != this.team) : (e != this)))
  if(!(e).stat_FROZEN)
  {
   p = e.origin;
   p.x += e.mins.x + random() * (e.maxs.x - e.mins.x);
   p.y += e.mins.y + random() * (e.maxs.y - e.mins.y);
   p.z += e.mins.z + random() * (e.maxs.z - e.mins.z);
   d = vlen(WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(e, this.origin) - p);
   if(d < dist)
   {
    e.fireball_impactvec = p;
    RandomSelection_Add(e, 0, nil, '0 0 0', 1 / (1 + d), !StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_Burning, e));
   }
  }
 if(RandomSelection_chosen_ent)
 {
  d = vlen(WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(RandomSelection_chosen_ent, this.origin) - RandomSelection_chosen_ent.fireball_impactvec);
  d = damage + (edgedamage - damage) * (d / dist);
  Fire_AddDamage(RandomSelection_chosen_ent, this.realowner, d * burntime, burntime, this.projectiledeathtype);

  Send_Effect(EFFECT_FIREBALL_LASER, this.origin, RandomSelection_chosen_ent.fireball_impactvec - this.origin, 1);
 }
}

void nade_entrap_touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 if((teamplay ? (toucher.team != this.realowner.team) : (toucher != this.realowner)))
 {
  if (!isPushable(toucher))
   return;

  float pushdeltatime = time - toucher.lastpushtime;
  if (pushdeltatime > 0.15) pushdeltatime = 0;
  toucher.lastpushtime = time;
  if(!pushdeltatime) return;


  toucher.velocity = toucher.velocity * (autocvar_g_nades_entrap_strength ** pushdeltatime);


  UpdateCSQCProjectile(toucher);

 }

 if ( (clienttype(toucher) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL) || ((toucher.vehicle_flags & VHF_ISVEHICLE) && toucher.owner) )
 {
  entity show_tint = ((toucher.vehicle_flags & VHF_ISVEHICLE) && toucher.owner) ? toucher.owner : toucher;
  show_tint.nade_entrap_time = time + 0.1;
 }
}

void nade_heal_touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 float maxhealth;
 float health_factor;
 if(((toucher).classname == STR_PLAYER) || (toucher.flags & FL_MONSTER))
 if(!((toucher).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 if(!(toucher).stat_FROZEN)
 {
  health_factor = autocvar_g_nades_heal_rate*frametime/2;
  if ( toucher != this.realowner )
  {
   if ( (teamplay ? (toucher.team == this.team) : (toucher == this)) )
    health_factor *= autocvar_g_nades_heal_friend;
   else
    health_factor *= autocvar_g_nades_heal_foe;
  }
  if ( health_factor > 0 )
  {
   maxhealth = ((toucher.flags & FL_MONSTER)) ? toucher.max_health : g_pickup_healthmega_max;
   float hp = GetResource(toucher, RES_HEALTH);
   if (hp < maxhealth)
   {
    if (this.nade_show_particles)
    {
     Send_Effect(EFFECT_HEALING, toucher.origin, '0 0 0', 1);
    }
    GiveResourceWithLimit(toucher, RES_HEALTH, health_factor, maxhealth);
   }
  }
  else if ( health_factor < 0 )
  {
   Damage(toucher,this,this.realowner,-health_factor,DEATH_NADE_HEAL.m_id,(weaponentities[0]),toucher.origin,'0 0 0');
  }

 }

void nade_damage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 if((((deathtype) == DEATH_HURTTRIGGER.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_SLIME.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_LAVA.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_SWAMP.m_id)))
 {
  this.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
  nade_boom(this);
  return;
 }

 if((this).stat_NADE_BONUS_TYPE == NADE_TYPE_TRANSLOCATE.m_id || (this).stat_NADE_BONUS_TYPE == NADE_TYPE_SPAWN.m_id)
  return;

 if (__Mutator_Send_Nade_Damage(0 , this, ((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)), force, damage)) {}
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_BLASTER)))
 {
  force *= 1.5;
  damage = 0;
 }
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_VAPORIZER)) && (deathtype & HITTYPE_SECONDARY))
 {
  force *= 0.5;
  damage = 0;
 }
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_VORTEX)) || (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_VAPORIZER)) || (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_OVERKILL_NEX)))
 {
  force *= 6;
  damage = this.max_health * 0.55;
 }
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_MACHINEGUN)) || (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_OVERKILL_MACHINEGUN)))
  damage = this.max_health * 0.1;
 else if((((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_SHOCKWAVE)) || (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_SHOTGUN)) || (((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK)) == (WEP_OVERKILL_SHOTGUN)))
 {
  if(!(deathtype & HITTYPE_SECONDARY))
   damage = this.max_health * 1.15;
 }


 entity death_weapon = ((deathtype >= DT_FIRST) ? WEP_Null : Weapons_from((deathtype) & DEATH_WEAPONMASK));
 if(((deathtype & HITTYPE_SECONDARY) ? (death_weapon.spawnflags & WEP_TYPE_MELEE_SEC) : (death_weapon.spawnflags & WEP_TYPE_MELEE_PRI)))
 {
  damage = this.max_health * 0.1;
  force *= 10;
 }

 this.velocity += force;
 UpdateCSQCProjectile(this);

 if(damage <= 0 || (((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0)) && ((attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER)))
  return;

 float hp = GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH);
 if(hp == this.max_health)
 {
  if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_SHOTS_SINGLE, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_Null), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, 0.5 *(ATTEN_LARGE + ATTEN_MAX), 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
  this.nextthink = max(time + this.nade_lifetime, time);
  (_selftemp = (this), _selftemp.__think = ((nade_beep) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (nade_beep));
 }

 hp -= damage;
 SetResource(this, RES_HEALTH, hp);


 if ( (this).stat_NADE_BONUS_TYPE != NADE_TYPE_HEAL.m_id || ((attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER) )
  this.realowner = attacker;

 if(hp <= 0)
  W_PrepareExplosionByDamage(this, attacker, nade_boom);
 else
  nade_burn_spawn(this);
}

void nade_prime(entity this)
{
 if(autocvar_g_nades_bonus_only && !(this).stat_NADE_BONUS)
  return;


 if(this.nade)
  if(1){ entity _this = (this.nade); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this.nade); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 this.nade = (0, world);

 if(this.fake_nade)
  if(1){ entity _this = (this.fake_nade); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(this.fake_nade); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
 this.fake_nade = (0, world);

 float ntype;
 string pntype = this.pokenade_type;

 if(StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_Strength, this) && autocvar_g_nades_bonus_onstrength)
  ntype = (this).stat_NADE_BONUS_TYPE;
 else if ((this).stat_NADE_BONUS >= 1)
 {
  ntype = (this).stat_NADE_BONUS_TYPE;
  pntype = this.pokenade_type;
  (this).stat_NADE_BONUS -= 1;
 }
 else
 {
  ntype = ((autocvar_g_nades_client_select) ? (this).cvar_cl_nade_type : autocvar_g_nades_nade_type);
  pntype = ((autocvar_g_nades_client_select) ? (this).cvar_cl_pokenade_type : autocvar_g_nades_pokenade_monster_type);
 }

 spawn_held_nade(this, this, autocvar_g_nades_nade_lifetime, ntype, pntype);
}

float CanThrowNade(entity this)
{
 return !(this.vehicle || !autocvar_g_nades || ((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || !((this).classname == STR_PLAYER) || weaponLocked(this));
}

.float nade_altbutton;

void nades_CheckThrow(entity this)
{
 if(!CanThrowNade(this))
  return;

 entity held_nade = this.nade;
 if (!held_nade)
 {
  this.nade_altbutton = true;
  if(time > this.nade_refire)
  {
   nade_prime(this);
   this.nade_refire = time + autocvar_g_nades_nade_refire;
  }
 }
 else
 {
  this.nade_altbutton = false;
  if (time >= held_nade.nade_time_primed + 1) {
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/mutators/mutator/nades/nades.qc", 1171, __FUNC__, "\"this.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(this.v_angle); }else voidfunc();
   float _force = time - held_nade.nade_time_primed;
   _force /= autocvar_g_nades_nade_lifetime;
   _force = autocvar_g_nades_nade_minforce + (_force * (autocvar_g_nades_nade_maxforce - autocvar_g_nades_nade_minforce));
   vector dir = (v_forward * 0.75 + v_up * 0.2 + v_right * 0.05);
   dir = W_CalculateSpread(dir, autocvar_g_nades_spread, autocvar_g_weaponspreadfactor, autocvar_g_projectiles_spread_style);
   toss_nade(this, true, dir * _force, 0);
  }
 }
}
