const float NT_AUTOREPLACE_NEVER = 0;
const float NT_AUTOREPLACE_ALWAYS = 1;
const float NT_AUTOREPLACE_RANDOM = 2;

float nt_IsNewToy(float w)
{
 switch(w)
 {
  case WEP_SEEKER.m_id:
  case WEP_MINE_LAYER.m_id:
  case WEP_HLAC.m_id:
  case WEP_RIFLE.m_id:
  case WEP_SHOCKWAVE.m_id:
   return true;
  default:
   return false;
 }
}

string nt_GetFullReplacement(string w)
{
 switch(w)
 {
  case "hagar": return "seeker";
  case "devastator": return "minelayer";
  case "machinegun": return "hlac";
  case "vortex": return "rifle";

  default: return nil;
 }
}

string nt_GetReplacement(string w, float m)
{
 if(m == NT_AUTOREPLACE_NEVER)
  return w;
 string s = nt_GetFullReplacement(w);
 if (!s)
  return w;
 if(m == NT_AUTOREPLACE_RANDOM)
  s = strcat(w, " ", s);
 return s;
}

float NIX_CanChooseWeapon(float wpn)
{
 entity e = Weapons_from(wpn);
 if (e == WEP_Null) return false;
 if(g_weaponarena)
 {
  if(!(g_weaponarena_weapons & e.m_wepset))
   return false;
 }
 else
 {
  if(wpn == WEP_BLASTER.m_id && g_nix_with_blaster)
   return false;
  if(e.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_MUTATORBLOCKED)
   return false;
  if (!(e.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_NORMAL))
   return false;
 }
 return true;
}
void NIX_ChooseNextWeapon()
{
 RandomSelection_Init();
 if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Weapons_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it != WEP_Null) { { { if(NIX_CanChooseWeapon(it.m_id)) RandomSelection_Add((0, world), it.m_id, nil, '0 0 0', 1, (it.m_id != nix_weapon)); }; } } } }else voidfunc()


   ;
 nix_nextweapon = RandomSelection_chosen_float;
}

void NIX_GiveCurrentWeapon(entity this)
{
 float dt;

 if(!nix_nextweapon)
  NIX_ChooseNextWeapon();

 dt = ceil(nix_nextchange - time);

 if(dt <= 0)
 {
  nix_weapon = nix_nextweapon;
  nix_nextweapon = 0;
  if (!nix_nextchange)
   nix_nextchange = time;
  else
   nix_nextchange = time + autocvar_g_balance_nix_roundtime;


 }


 entity wpn = Weapons_from(nix_weapon);


 if(nix_nextchange != this.nix_lastchange_id)
 {
  SetResource(this, RES_SHELLS, 0);
  SetResource(this, RES_BULLETS, 0);
  SetResource(this, RES_ROCKETS, 0);
  SetResource(this, RES_CELLS, 0);
  SetResource(this, RES_PLASMA, 0);
  SetResource(this, RES_FUEL, 0);
  if(this.items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO)
  {
   switch (wpn.ammo_type)
   {
    case RES_SHELLS: SetResource(this, RES_SHELLS, autocvar_g_pickup_shells_max); break;
    case RES_BULLETS: SetResource(this, RES_BULLETS, autocvar_g_pickup_nails_max); break;
    case RES_ROCKETS: SetResource(this, RES_ROCKETS, autocvar_g_pickup_rockets_max); break;
    case RES_CELLS: SetResource(this, RES_CELLS, autocvar_g_pickup_cells_max); break;
    case RES_PLASMA: SetResource(this, RES_PLASMA, autocvar_g_pickup_plasma_max); break;
    case RES_FUEL: SetResource(this, RES_FUEL, autocvar_g_pickup_fuel_max); break;
   }
  }
  else
  {
   switch (wpn.ammo_type)
   {
    case RES_SHELLS: SetResource(this, RES_SHELLS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammo_shells); break;
    case RES_BULLETS: SetResource(this, RES_BULLETS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammo_nails); break;
    case RES_ROCKETS: SetResource(this, RES_ROCKETS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammo_rockets); break;
    case RES_CELLS: SetResource(this, RES_CELLS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammo_cells); break;
    case RES_PLASMA: SetResource(this, RES_PLASMA, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammo_plasma); break;
    case RES_FUEL: SetResource(this, RES_FUEL, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammo_fuel); break;
   }
  }

  this.nix_nextincr = time + autocvar_g_balance_nix_incrtime;
  if(dt >= 1 && dt <= 5)
   this.nix_lastinfotime = -42;
  else
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, this, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_NIX_NEWWEAPON, nix_weapon);

  wpn.wr_resetplayer(wpn, this);


  if (wpn.spawnflags & WEP_FLAG_RELOADABLE)
  {
   for (float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
   {
    .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
    this.(weaponentity).(weapon_load[nix_weapon]) = wpn.reloading_ammo;
   }
  }


  this.nix_lastchange_id = nix_nextchange;
 }
 if(this.nix_lastinfotime != dt)
 {
  this.nix_lastinfotime = dt;
  if(dt >= 1 && dt <= 5)
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE_ONLY, this, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_NIX_COUNTDOWN, nix_nextweapon, dt);
 }

 if(!(this.items & IT_UNLIMITED_AMMO) && time > this.nix_nextincr)
 {
  switch (wpn.ammo_type)
  {
   case RES_SHELLS: GiveResource(this, RES_SHELLS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammoincr_shells); break;
   case RES_BULLETS: GiveResource(this, RES_BULLETS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammoincr_nails); break;
   case RES_ROCKETS: GiveResource(this, RES_ROCKETS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammoincr_rockets); break;
   case RES_CELLS: GiveResource(this, RES_CELLS, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammoincr_cells); break;
   case RES_PLASMA: GiveResource(this, RES_PLASMA, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammoincr_plasma); break;
   case RES_FUEL: GiveResource(this, RES_FUEL, autocvar_g_balance_nix_ammoincr_fuel); break;
  }

  this.nix_nextincr = time + autocvar_g_balance_nix_incrtime;
 }

 (this).stat_WEAPONS = '0 0 0';
 if(g_nix_with_blaster)
  (this).stat_WEAPONS |= (WEP_BLASTER.m_wepset);
 (this).stat_WEAPONS |= wpn.m_wepset;

 for (float slot = 0; slot < MAX_WEAPONSLOTS; ++slot)
 {
  .entity weaponentity = weaponentities[slot];
  if (this.(weaponentity).m_weapon == WEP_Null && slot != 0)
   continue;

  if (this.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon != wpn)
  if (!client_hasweapon(this, this.(weaponentity).m_switchweapon, weaponentity, true, false))
  {
   if (client_hasweapon(this, wpn, weaponentity, true, false))
    W_SwitchWeapon(this, wpn, weaponentity);
  }
 }
}

void powerups_DropItem_Think(entity this)
{

 if(!GetResource(this, RES_ARMOR))
 {
  float timeleft = floor(this.wait - time);
  if (timeleft)
   WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(this.waypointsprite_attached, timeleft);
  else
   WaypointSprite_Kill(this.waypointsprite_attached);
 }
}

void powerups_DropItem(entity this, StatusEffects effect, float freezeTimer)
{
 entity item = Item_DefinitionFromInternalName(effect.netname);
 float t = StatusEffects_gettime(effect, this);
 float timeleft = t - time;
 float maxtime = 0;

 if(timeleft <= 1 || !item)
  return;
 entity e = __spawn("entity", "./common/mutators/mutator/powerups/sv_powerups.qc" ":" "102", false);




 float finished = (freezeTimer ? timeleft : t);



 float time_to_live = (freezeTimer ? autocvar_g_items_dropped_lifetime : timeleft);


 switch(item)
 {
  case ITEM_Strength: e.strength_finished = finished; maxtime = autocvar_g_balance_powerup_strength_time; break;
  case ITEM_Shield: e.invincible_finished = finished; maxtime = autocvar_g_balance_powerup_invincible_time; break;
  case ITEM_Invisibility: e.invisibility_finished = finished; maxtime = autocvar_g_balance_powerup_invincible_time; break;
  case ITEM_Speed: e.speed_finished = finished; maxtime = autocvar_g_balance_powerup_speed_time; break;
 }
 vector vel = W_CalculateProjectileVelocity(this, this.velocity, v_forward * 750, false);
 if (!Item_InitializeLoot(e, item.m_canonical_spawnfunc, this.origin, vel, time_to_live))
  return;

 if(!freezeTimer)
  Item_SetExpiring(e, true);


 if(freezeTimer)
  SetResourceExplicit(e, RES_ARMOR, 1);


 entity wp = WaypointSprite_Spawn(WP_Item, 0, 0, e, '0 0 1' * e.maxs.z, (0, world), 0, e, waypointsprite_attached, true, RADARICON_Item);
 wp.wp_extra = item.m_id;
 WaypointSprite_UpdateMaxHealth(e.waypointsprite_attached, maxtime);
 WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(e.waypointsprite_attached, timeleft);

}

void(StatusEffects this, entity actor, float removal_type) Invisibility_m_remove; .void(StatusEffects this, entity actor, float removal_type) m_remove; [[accumulate]] void spawnInvisibility_static(Invisibility this) { this.m_remove = Invisibility_m_remove; } void(StatusEffects this, entity actor, float removal_type) Invisibility_m_remove
{
    float wasactive = (actor.statuseffects && (actor.statuseffects.statuseffect_flags[this.m_id] & STATUSEFFECT_FLAG_ACTIVE));
    if(removal_type == STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_TIMEOUT && wasactive && ((actor).classname == STR_PLAYER))
    {

        Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, actor, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_POWERDOWN_INVISIBILITY);
    }
    if(wasactive)
        stopsound(actor, CH_TRIGGER_SINGLE);
    if(!actor.vehicle)
    {
        actor.alpha = default_player_alpha;
        if(actor.exteriorweaponentity)
            actor.exteriorweaponentity.alpha = default_weapon_alpha;
    }
    (Invisibility_vtbl.vtblbase).m_remove(this, actor, removal_type);
}

    if(!wasactive && ((actor).classname == STR_PLAYER))
    {
        if(!(MapInfo_LoadedGametype == MAPINFO_TYPE_CTS))
            Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_POWERUP_INVISIBILITY, actor.netname);
        Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, actor, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_POWERUP_INVISIBILITY);
    }
    (Invisibility_vtbl.vtblbase).m_apply(this, actor, eff_time, eff_flags);
}

entity RandomItems_ReplaceMapItem(entity item)
{

 string new_classnames = RandomItems_GetItemReplacementClassNames(item);
 if (new_classnames == "")
 {
  return (0, world);
 }
 string new_classname;
 if (new_classnames == "random")
 {
  new_classname = RandomItems_GetRandomItemClassName("random_items");
  if (new_classname == "")
  {
   return (0, world);
  }
 }
 else
 {
  float num_new_classnames = _tokenize_console(new_classnames);
  if (num_new_classnames == 1)
  {
   new_classname = new_classnames;
  }
  else
  {
   float classname_index = floor(random() * num_new_classnames);
   new_classname = argv(classname_index);
  }
 }

 if (new_classname == item.classname)
 {
  return (0, world);
 }
 random_items_is_spawning = true;
 entity new_item;
 if (!MUTATOR_ok.mutatorcheck())
 {

  new_item = Item_Create(strzone(new_classname), item.origin,
   Item_ShouldKeepPosition(item));
  random_items_is_spawning = false;
  if (new_item == (0, world))
  {
   return (0, world);
  }
 }
 else
 {
  new_item = __spawn("entity", "./common/mutators/mutator/random_items/sv_random_items.qc" ":" "283", false);
  Item_CopyFields(item, new_item);
  new_item.classname = strzone(new_classname);
  new_item.ok_item = true;
  Item_Initialize(new_item, new_classname);
  random_items_is_spawning = false;
  if (wasfreed(new_item))
  {
   return (0, world);
  }
 }
 if (item.team)
 {
  new_item.team = item.team;
 }
 return new_item;
}




void RandomItems_SpawnLootItem(vector position)
{
 string class_name = RandomItems_GetRandomItemClassName("random_loot");
 if (class_name == "")
 {
  return;
 }
 vector spread = '0 0 0';
 spread.z = autocvar_g_random_loot_spread / 2;
 spread += randomvec() * autocvar_g_random_loot_spread;
 random_items_is_spawning = true;
 if (!MUTATOR_ok.mutatorcheck())
 {
  Item_CreateLoot(class_name, position, spread,
   autocvar_g_random_loot_time);
 }
 else
 {
  entity item = __spawn("entity", "./common/mutators/mutator/random_items/sv_random_items.qc" ":" "322", false);
  item.ok_item = true;
  item.classname = class_name;
  Item_InitializeLoot(item, class_name, position, spread,
   autocvar_g_random_loot_time);
 }
 random_items_is_spawning = false;
}

void sandbox_ObjectFunction_Touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{


 if(!this.material)
  return;
 if(this.touch_timer > time)
  return;
 this.touch_timer = time + 0.1;


 float intensity;
 intensity = vlen(this.velocity) + vlen(toucher.velocity);
 if(intensity)
  intensity /= 2;
 if (!(intensity >= autocvar_g_sandbox_object_material_velocity_min))
  return;

 intensity -= autocvar_g_sandbox_object_material_velocity_min;
 intensity = bound(0, intensity * autocvar_g_sandbox_object_material_velocity_factor, 1);

 if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, strcat("object/impact_", this.material, "_", ftos(ceil(random() * 5)) , ".wav"), VOL_BASE * intensity, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
 Send_Effect_(strcat("impact_", this.material), this.origin, '0 0 0', ceil(intensity * 10));
}

  this.grab = 1;

   ;

 CSQCModel_CheckUpdate(this);
}

void sandbox_Database_Load()
{

 string file_read, file_name;
 float file_get, i;

 file_name = strcat("sandbox/storage_", autocvar_g_sandbox_storage_name, "_", GetMapname(), ".txt");
 file_get = fopen(file_name, FILE_READ);
 if(file_get < 0)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_sandbox_info > 0)
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mutators/mutator/sandbox/sv_sandbox.qc", "420")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("^3SANDBOX - SERVER: ^7could not find storage file ^3", file_name, "^7, no objects were loaded"); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
 }
 else
 {
  for (;;)
  {
   file_read = fgets(file_get);
   if(file_read == "")
    break;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 2) == "//")
    continue;
   if(substring(file_read, 0, 1) == "#")
    continue;

   entity e;
   e = sandbox_ObjectPort_Load((0, world), file_read, true);

   if(e.material)
   {

    for (i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
     precache_sound(strcat("object/impact_", e.material, "_", ftos(i), ".wav"));
   }
  }
  if(autocvar_g_sandbox_info > 0)
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mutators/mutator/sandbox/sv_sandbox.qc", "445")), "\n")); string __s = strcat1n("^3SANDBOX - SERVER: ^7successfully loaded storage file ^3", file_name); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc();
 }
 fclose(file_get);
}

.float x_smneg_weight[Weapons_MAX];

float smneg_multiplier(float weight) {
    float a = autocvar_g_smneg_bonus_asymptote;
    float x = max(
        (!autocvar_g_smneg_bonus ? 0 : (-a + .1)),
        weight / start_health
    );
    float z = (3.14159265358979323846 / 5) * a;
    float f = (x > 0)
        ? (atan(z / x) / (3.14159265358979323846 / 2))
        : (tan(-(x / z)) + 1);
    return f;
}

void superspec_save_client_conf(entity this)
{

 {
  if(this.crypto_idfp == "")
   return;

  fn = sprintf("superspec-%s.options", uri_escape(this.crypto_idfp));

 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/mutators/mutator/superspec/sv_superspec.qc", "52")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("^1ERROR: ^7 superspec can not open ", fn, " for writing."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
 }
 else
 {
  fputs(fh, "SUPERSPEC_OPTIONSFILE_V1");
  fputs(fh, "\n");
  fputs(fh, ftos(this.autospec_flags));
  fputs(fh, "\n");
  fputs(fh, ftos(this.superspec_flags));
  fputs(fh, "\n");
  fputs(fh, this.superspec_itemfilter);
  fputs(fh, "\n");
  fclose(fh);
 }
}

float WaypointSprite_SendEntity(entity this, entity to, float sendflags)
{
    if(1){ if (NET_waypointsprites_istemp) WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, SVC_TEMPENTITY); WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, NET_waypointsprites.m_id); float _net_valid = false; if(1){ if (1) { _net_valid = true; } else { float _de = 0xDE, _ad = 0xAD, _be = 0xBE, _ef = 0xEF; if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _de); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ad); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _be); }else voidfunc(); if(1){ WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, _ef); }else voidfunc(); _net_valid = (_de == 0xDE && _ad == 0xAD && _be == 0xBE && _ef == 0xEF); } }else voidfunc(); }else voidfunc();

    sendflags = sendflags & 0x7F;

    if (this.max_health || (this.pain_finished && (time < this.pain_finished + 0.25)))
        sendflags |= 0x80;

    float hide_flags = 0;
    if(this.currentammo == 1) hide_flags |= 1;
    else if(this.currentammo == 2) hide_flags |= 2;
    if(this.exteriormodeltoclient == to) hide_flags |= 2;

    __Mutator_Send_SendWaypoint(0 , this, to, sendflags, hide_flags);
    sendflags = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_int;
    hide_flags = MUTATOR_ARGV_3_int;

    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, sendflags);
    WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.wp_extra);

    if (sendflags & 0x80)
    {
        if (this.max_health)
        {
            WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, (GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) / this.max_health) * 191.0);
        }
        else
        {
            float dt = this.pain_finished - time;
            dt = bound(0, dt * 32, 16383);
            WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, (dt & 0xFF00) / 256 + 192);
            WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, (dt & 0x00FF));
        }
    }

    if (sendflags & 64)
    {
        if(1){ WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.x); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.y); WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.origin.z); }else voidfunc();
    }

    if (sendflags & 1)
    {
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.team);
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.rule);
    }

    if (sendflags & 2)
        WriteString(MSG_ENTITY, this.model1);

    if (sendflags & 4)
        WriteString(MSG_ENTITY, this.model2);

    if (sendflags & 8)
        WriteString(MSG_ENTITY, this.model3);

    if (sendflags & 16)
    {
        WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.fade_time);
        WriteCoord(MSG_ENTITY, this.teleport_time);
        WriteShort(MSG_ENTITY, bound(0, this.fade_rate, 32767));
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, hide_flags);
    }

    if (sendflags & 32)
    {
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.cnt);
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.colormod.x * 255.0);
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.colormod.y * 255.0);
        WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, this.colormod.z * 255.0);

        if (WaypointSprite_isteammate(this.owner, WaypointSprite_getviewentity(to)))
        {
            float dt = bound(0, (this.waypointsprite_helpmetime - time) / 0.1, 255);
            WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, dt);
        }
        else
            WriteByte(MSG_ENTITY, 0);
    }

    return true;
}
# 804 "./common/mutators/mutator/waypoints/waypointsprites.qc"
void WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(entity e, entity _m1, entity _m2, entity _m3)
{
    string m1 = _m1.netname;
    string m2 = _m2.netname;
    string m3 = _m3.netname;
    if (m1 != e.model1)
    {
        e.model1 = m1;
        e.SendFlags |= 2;
    }
    if (m2 != e.model2)
    {
        e.model2 = m2;
        e.SendFlags |= 4;
    }
    if (m3 != e.model3)
    {
        e.model3 = m3;
        e.SendFlags |= 8;
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(entity e, float f)
{
    f = bound(0, f, e.max_health);
    float step = e.max_health / 40;
    if ((floor(f / step) != floor(GetResource(e, RES_HEALTH) / step)) || e.pain_finished)
    {
        SetResourceExplicit(e, RES_HEALTH, f);
        e.pain_finished = 0;
        e.SendFlags |= 0x80;
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_UpdateMaxHealth(entity e, float f)
{
    if (f != e.max_health || e.pain_finished)
    {
        e.max_health = f;
        e.pain_finished = 0;
        e.SendFlags |= 0x80;
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_UpdateBuildFinished(entity e, float f)
{
    if (f != e.pain_finished || e.max_health)
    {
        e.max_health = 0;
        e.pain_finished = f;
        e.SendFlags |= 0x80;
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_UpdateOrigin(entity e, vector o)
{
    if (o != e.origin)
    {
        setorigin(e, o);
        e.SendFlags |= 64;
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_UpdateRule(entity e, float t, float r)
{

    e.rule = r;
    e.team = t;
    e.SendFlags |= 1;
}

void WaypointSprite_UpdateTeamRadar(entity e, entity icon, vector col)
{

    float i = icon.m_id;
    float new_cnt = (e.cnt & (1 << (7))) | (i & ((1 << (7)) - 1));
    if (new_cnt != e.cnt || col != e.colormod)
    {
     e.cnt = new_cnt;
     e.colormod = col;
     e.SendFlags |= 32;
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_Ping(entity e)
{

    if (time < e.waypointsprite_pingtime) return;
    e.waypointsprite_pingtime = time + 0.3;

    e.cnt |= (1 << (7));
    e.SendFlags |= 32;
}

void WaypointSprite_HelpMePing(entity e)
{
    WaypointSprite_Ping(e);
    e.waypointsprite_helpmetime = time + waypointsprite_deployed_lifetime;
    e.SendFlags |= 32;
}

void WaypointSprite_FadeOutIn(entity e, float t)
{
    if (!e.fade_time)
    {
        e.fade_time = t;
        e.teleport_time = time + t;
    }
    else if (t < (e.teleport_time - time))
    {




        float current_fadetime = e.teleport_time - time;
        e.teleport_time = time + t;
        if (e.fade_time < 0)
         e.fade_time = -e.fade_time;
        e.fade_time = e.fade_time * t / current_fadetime;
    }

    e.SendFlags |= 16;
}

void WaypointSprite_Init()
{
    waypointsprite_limitedrange = autocvar_sv_waypointsprite_limitedrange;
    waypointsprite_deployed_lifetime = autocvar_sv_waypointsprite_deployed_lifetime;
    waypointsprite_deadlifetime = autocvar_sv_waypointsprite_deadlifetime;
}

void WaypointSprite_Kill(entity wp)
{
    if (!wp) return;
    if (wp.owner) wp.owner.(wp.owned_by_field) = (0, world);
    if(1){ entity _this = (wp); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(wp); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
}

void WaypointSprite_Disown(entity wp, float fadetime)
{
    if (!wp) return;
    if (wp.classname != "sprite_waypoint")
    {
        if(1){ float dev = autocvar_developer; float war = autocvar_prvm_backtraceforwarnings; cvar_set("developer", "1"); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", "1"); print("\n--- CUT HERE ---\n", "Trying to disown a non-waypointsprite"); builtin_remove((0, world)); print("\n--- CUT UNTIL HERE ---\n"); cvar_set("developer", ftos(dev)); cvar_set("prvm_backtraceforwarnings", ftos(war)); }else voidfunc();
        return;
    }
    if (wp.owner)
    {
        if (wp.exteriormodeltoclient == wp.owner)
            wp.exteriormodeltoclient = (0, world);
        wp.owner.(wp.owned_by_field) = (0, world);
        wp.owner = (0, world);

        WaypointSprite_FadeOutIn(wp, fadetime);
    }
}

void WaypointSprite_Think(entity this)
{
    float doremove = false;

    if (this.fade_time && time >= this.teleport_time)
    {
        doremove = true;
    }

    if (this.exteriormodeltoclient)
        WaypointSprite_UpdateOrigin(this, this.exteriormodeltoclient.origin + this.view_ofs);

    if (doremove)
        WaypointSprite_Kill(this);
    else
        this.nextthink = time;
}

float WaypointSprite_visible_for_player(entity this, entity player, entity view)
{

    if (this.enemy && this.enemy != view)
        return false;


    if (this.rule == SPRITERULE_SPECTATOR)
    {
        if (!autocvar_sv_itemstime)
            return false;
        if (!warmup_stage && ((view).classname == STR_PLAYER) && autocvar_sv_itemstime != 2)
            return false;
    }
    else if (this.team && this.rule == SPRITERULE_DEFAULT)
    {
        if (this.team != view.team)
            return false;
        if (!((view).classname == STR_PLAYER))
            return false;
    }

    return true;
}

entity WaypointSprite_getviewentity(entity e)
{
    if (((e).classname == STR_SPECTATOR)) e = e.enemy;




    return e;
}

float WaypointSprite_isteammate(entity e, entity e2)
{
    if (teamplay)
        return e2.team == e.team;
    return e2 == e;
}

float WaypointSprite_Customize(entity this, entity client)
{



    entity e = WaypointSprite_getviewentity(client);

    if (__Mutator_Send_CustomizeWaypoint(0 , this, client))
        return false;

    return this.waypointsprite_visible_for_player(this, client, e);
}

void WaypointSprite_Reset(entity this)
{


    if (this.fade_time)
        WaypointSprite_Kill(this);
}

entity WaypointSprite_Spawn(
    entity spr,
    float _lifetime, float maxdistance,
    entity ref, vector ofs,
    entity showto, float t,
    entity own, .entity ownfield,
    float hideable,
    entity icon
)
{
    entity wp = __spawn("sprite_waypoint", "./common/mutators/mutator/waypoints/waypointsprites.qc" ":" "1054", false);
    wp.fade_time = _lifetime;
    if(_lifetime < 0)
     _lifetime = -_lifetime;
    wp.teleport_time = time + _lifetime;
    wp.exteriormodeltoclient = ref;
    if (ref)
    {
        wp.view_ofs = ofs;
        setorigin(wp, ref.origin + ofs);
    }
    else
        setorigin(wp, ofs);
    wp.enemy = showto;
    wp.team = t;
    wp.owner = own;
    wp.currentammo = hideable;
    if (own)
    {
        if (own.(ownfield))
            if(1){ entity _this = (own.(ownfield)); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(own.(ownfield)); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
        own.(ownfield) = wp;
        wp.owned_by_field = ownfield;
    }
    wp.fade_rate = maxdistance;
    (_selftemp = (wp), _selftemp.__think = ((WaypointSprite_Think) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (WaypointSprite_Think));
    wp.nextthink = time;
    wp.model1 = spr.netname;
    (_selftemp = (wp), _selftemp.__customizeentityforclient = ((WaypointSprite_Customize) ? customizeentityforclient_self : nil), _selftemp.selfcustomizeentityforclient = (WaypointSprite_Customize));
    wp.waypointsprite_visible_for_player = WaypointSprite_visible_for_player;
    wp.reset2 = WaypointSprite_Reset;
    wp.cnt = icon.m_id;
    wp.colormod = spr.m_color;
    Net_LinkEntity(wp, false, 0, WaypointSprite_SendEntity);
    return wp;
}

entity WaypointSprite_SpawnFixed(
    entity spr,
    vector ofs,
    entity own,
    .entity ownfield,
    entity icon
)
{

}

entity WaypointSprite_DeployFixed(
    entity spr,
    float limited_range,
    entity player,
    vector ofs,
    entity icon
)
{
    float t;
    if (teamplay)
        t = player.team;
    else
        t = 0;
    float maxdistance;
    if (limited_range)
        maxdistance = waypointsprite_limitedrange;
    else
        maxdistance = 0;
    return WaypointSprite_Spawn(spr, waypointsprite_deployed_lifetime, maxdistance, (0, world), ofs, (0, world), t, player, waypointsprite_deployed_fixed, false, icon);
}

entity WaypointSprite_DeployPersonal(

    vector ofs,
    entity icon
)
{
    return WaypointSprite_Spawn(spr, 0, 0, (0, world), ofs, (0, world), 0, player, waypointsprite_deployed_personal, false, icon);
}

entity WaypointSprite_Attach(
    entity spr,
    entity player,
    float limited_range,
    entity icon
)
{
    float t;
    if (player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier)
        return (0, world);
    if (teamplay)
        t = player.team;
    else
        t = 0;
    float maxdistance;
    if (limited_range)
        maxdistance = waypointsprite_limitedrange;
    else
        maxdistance = 0;
    return WaypointSprite_Spawn(spr, waypointsprite_deployed_lifetime, maxdistance, player, '0 0 64', (0, world), t, player, waypointsprite_attached, false, icon);
}

entity WaypointSprite_AttachCarrier(
    entity spr,
    entity carrier,
    entity icon
)
{
    WaypointSprite_Kill(carrier.waypointsprite_attached);
    entity e = WaypointSprite_Spawn(spr, 0, 0, carrier, '0 0 64', (0, world), carrier.team, carrier, waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, false, icon);
    if (GetResource(carrier, RES_HEALTH))
    {
        WaypointSprite_UpdateMaxHealth(e, 2 * healtharmor_maxdamage(start_health, start_armorvalue, autocvar_g_balance_armor_blockpercent, DEATH_WEAPON.m_id).x);
        WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(e, healtharmor_maxdamage(GetResource(carrier, RES_HEALTH), GetResource(carrier, RES_ARMOR), autocvar_g_balance_armor_blockpercent, DEATH_WEAPON.m_id).x);
    }
    return e;
}

void WaypointSprite_DetachCarrier(entity carrier)
{
    WaypointSprite_Disown(carrier.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, waypointsprite_deadlifetime);
}

void WaypointSprite_ClearPersonal(entity this)
{
    WaypointSprite_Kill(this.waypointsprite_deployed_personal);
}

void WaypointSprite_ClearOwned(entity this)
{
    WaypointSprite_Kill(this.waypointsprite_deployed_fixed);
    WaypointSprite_Kill(this.waypointsprite_deployed_personal);
    WaypointSprite_Kill(this.waypointsprite_attached);
}

void WaypointSprite_PlayerDead(entity this)
{
    WaypointSprite_Disown(this.waypointsprite_attached, waypointsprite_deadlifetime);
    WaypointSprite_DetachCarrier(this);
}

void WaypointSprite_PlayerGone(entity this)
{
    WaypointSprite_Disown(this.waypointsprite_deployed_fixed, waypointsprite_deadlifetime);

void GameRules_teams(float value)
{
    if (value) {
        serverflags |= SERVERFLAG_TEAMPLAY;
        teamplay = 1;
        cvar_set("teamplay", "2");
        Team_InitTeams();
        GameRules_spawning_teams(true);
    } else {
     serverflags &= ~SERVERFLAG_TEAMPLAY;
     teamplay = 0;
     cvar_set("teamplay", "0");
     GameRules_spawning_teams(false);
    }
}

void GameRules_spawning_teams(float value)
{
    have_team_spawns = value ? -1 : 0;
}

float _GameRules_scoring_add_float2int(entity client, entity sp, float value, .float float_field, float score_factor)
{
 client.(float_field) += value;
 float score_counter = client.(float_field) / score_factor;
 if (score_counter >= -0.5 && score_counter < 0.5)
  return 0;


 float points = floor(score_counter + 0.5);
 client.(float_field) -= points * score_factor;
 if (!points)
  return 0;
 return PlayerScore_Add(client, sp, points);
}

float _GameRules_scoring_add(entity client, entity sp, float value)
{
    return PlayerScore_Add(client, sp, value);
}
float _GameRules_scoring_add_team(entity client, entity sp, float st, float value)
{
    return PlayerTeamScore_Add(client, sp, st, value);
}

void havocbot_role_ast_offense(entity this)
{
 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 {
  this.havocbot_attack_time = 0;
  havocbot_ast_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }


 if (!this.havocbot_role_timeout)
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = time + 120;

 if (time > this.havocbot_role_timeout)
 {
  havocbot_ast_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }

 if(this.havocbot_attack_time>time)
  return;

 if (navigation_goalrating_timeout(this))
 {

  navigation_goalrating_start(this);
  havocbot_goalrating_enemyplayers(this, 10000, this.origin, 650);
  havocbot_goalrating_ast_targets(this, 20000);
  havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 30000, this.origin, 10000);
  navigation_goalrating_end(this);

  navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(this);
 }
}

void havocbot_role_ast_setrole(entity this, float role)
{
 switch(role)
 {
  case HAVOCBOT_AST_ROLE_DEFENSE:
   this.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ast_defense;
   this.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
   break;
  case HAVOCBOT_AST_ROLE_OFFENSE:
   this.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ast_offense;
   this.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
   break;
 }
}

float CA_PreventStalemate()
{

 float winnerTeam = 0;
 float secondTeam = 0;

 for(float i = 1; i <= teamplay; i++)
 {
  if(!winnerTeam || Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeamFromIndex(i)) > Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeam(winnerTeam)))
  {
   secondTeam = winnerTeam;
   winnerTeam = Team_IndexToTeam(i);
  }
  else
  {
   if(!secondTeam || Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeamFromIndex(i)) > Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeam(secondTeam)))
    secondTeam = Team_IndexToTeam(i);
  }
 }

 if(Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeam(winnerTeam)) != Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeam(secondTeam)))
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/clanarena/sv_clanarena.qc", "69")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Stalemate broken by alive players. Best team: %s%s (%d)^7 - Trailing team: %s%s (%d)", Team_ColorCode(winnerTeam), Team_ColorName(winnerTeam), Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeam(winnerTeam)), Team_ColorCode(secondTeam), Team_ColorName(secondTeam), Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeam(secondTeam))); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()

                                                                                                                  ;
  return winnerTeam;
 }



 winnerTeam = 0;
 secondTeam = 0;
 float winnerTeamHealth = 0;
 float secondTeamHealth = 0;
 float teamIndex, teamHealth;

 for(float i = 1; i <= teamplay; i++)
 {
  teamIndex = i;
  teamHealth = 0;


  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && Entity_HasValidTeam(it) && it.team == Team_IndexToTeam(teamIndex))) { { { { if (((it).deadflag != DEAD_NO)) continue; teamHealth += GetResource(it, RES_HEALTH) + GetResource(it, RES_ARMOR); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




    ;


  if(!winnerTeam || teamHealth > winnerTeamHealth)
  {
   secondTeam = winnerTeam;
   secondTeamHealth = winnerTeamHealth;
   winnerTeam = Team_IndexToTeam(i);
   winnerTeamHealth = teamHealth;
  }
  else
  {
   if(!secondTeam || teamHealth > secondTeamHealth)
   {
    secondTeam = Team_IndexToTeam(i);
    secondTeamHealth = teamHealth;
   }
  }
 }

 if(winnerTeamHealth != secondTeamHealth)
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 1) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^5INFO""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/clanarena/sv_clanarena.qc", "116")), "\n")); string __s = sprintf("Stalemate broken by team health. Best team: %s%s (%d)^7 - Trailing team: %s%s (%d)", Team_ColorCode(winnerTeam), Team_ColorName(winnerTeam), winnerTeamHealth, Team_ColorCode(secondTeam), Team_ColorName(secondTeam), secondTeamHealth); print("^7", __s); if (_str2chr(__s, _strlen(__s) - 1) != '\n') { print("\n"); } }else voidfunc()

                                                                            ;
  return winnerTeam;
 }
 else
  return -2;
}

float CA_CheckWinner()
{
 float winner_team = 0;

 if((round_handler.round_endtime) > 0 && (round_handler.round_endtime) - time <= 0)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_ca_prevent_stalemate)
   winner_team = CA_PreventStalemate();
  else
   winner_team = -2;
 }

 CA_count_alive_players();
 if (!winner_team)
  winner_team = Team_GetWinnerAliveTeam();
 if (!winner_team)
  return 0;

 if(winner_team > 0)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_RED : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_BLUE : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_YELLOW : CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_PINK))));
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_RED : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_BLUE : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_YELLOW : INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_PINK))));
  TeamScore_AddToTeam(winner_team, ST_CA_ROUNDS, +1);
 }
 else if(winner_team == -1)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ROUND_TIED);
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_ROUND_TIED);
 }
 else if(winner_team == -2)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ROUND_OVER);
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_ROUND_OVER);
 }

 allowed_to_spawn = false;
 game_stopped = true;
 round_handler_Init(5, autocvar_g_ca_warmup, autocvar_g_ca_round_timelimit);

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { nades_Clear(it); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

 return 1;
}

void CA_RoundStart()
{
 allowed_to_spawn = ((warmup_stage) != 0);
}

float CA_CheckTeams()
{
 static float prev_missing_teams_mask;
 allowed_to_spawn = true;
 CA_count_alive_players();
 if (Team_GetNumberOfAliveTeams() == NumTeams(ca_teams))
 {
  if(prev_missing_teams_mask > 0)
   Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_MISSING_TEAMS);
  prev_missing_teams_mask = -1;
  return true;
 }
 if(total_players == 0)
 {
  if(prev_missing_teams_mask > 0)
   Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_MISSING_TEAMS);
  prev_missing_teams_mask = -1;
  return false;
 }
 float missing_teams_mask = 0;
 for (float i = 1; i <= NUM_TEAMS; ++i)
 {
  if ((ca_teams & Team_IndexToBit(i)) &&
   (Team_GetNumberOfAlivePlayers(Team_GetTeamFromIndex(i)) == 0))
  {
   missing_teams_mask |= Team_IndexToBit(i);
  }
 }
 if(prev_missing_teams_mask != missing_teams_mask)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_MISSING_TEAMS, missing_teams_mask);
  prev_missing_teams_mask = missing_teams_mask;
 }
 return false;
}

float ca_isEliminated(entity e)
{
 if(((e).ingame == 1) && (((e).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || e.frags == FRAGS_PLAYER_OUT_OF_GAME))
  return true;
 if(((e).ingame == 0.5))
  return true;
 return false;
}


entity CA_SpectateNext(entity player, entity start)
{
 if ((teamplay ? (start.team == player.team) : (start == player))) return start;

 for (entity e = start; (e = find(e, classname, STR_PLAYER)); )
 {
  if ((teamplay ? (player.team == e.team) : (player == e))) return e;
 }

 for (entity e = (0, world); (e = find(e, classname, STR_PLAYER)); )
 {
  if ((teamplay ? (player.team == e.team) : (player == e))) return e;
 }
 return start;
}

Callback CB_ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor; float ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/clanarena/sv_clanarena.qc" ":" "446", true) , ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_ca_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor, CB_ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor", "ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor, CB_ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor); } }else voidfunc(); } float ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float ca_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor()

  return;

  if ((teamplay ? (frag_target.team != frag_attacker.team) : (frag_target != frag_attacker)))
   scorer_damage = frag_damage - excess;
  else
   scorer_damage = -(frag_damage - excess);

  scorer = frag_attacker;
 }
 else
 {





  if (frag_deathtype == DEATH_KILL.m_id ||
   frag_deathtype == DEATH_DROWN.m_id ||
   frag_deathtype == DEATH_HURTTRIGGER.m_id ||
   frag_deathtype == DEATH_CAMP.m_id ||

   frag_deathtype == DEATH_SLIME.m_id ||

   scorer = frag_target;
  }
 }

  _GameRules_scoring_add_float2int(scorer, SP_SCORE, scorer_damage, ca_damage_counter, autocvar_g_ca_damage2score);
}

void ctf_CalculatePassVelocity(entity flag, vector to, vector from, float turnrate)
{
 float current_distance = vlen((('1 0 0' * to.x) + ('0 1 0' * to.y)) - (('1 0 0' * from.x) + ('0 1 0' * from.y)));
 float initial_height = min(autocvar_g_ctf_pass_arc_max, (flag.pass_distance * tanh(autocvar_g_ctf_pass_arc)));
 float current_height = (initial_height * min(1, (current_distance / flag.pass_distance)));


 vector targpos;
 if(current_height)
 {
  targpos = (to + ('0 0 1' * current_height));
  WarpZone_TraceLine(flag.origin, targpos, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, flag);
  if(trace_fraction < 1)
  {

   WarpZone_TraceLine(to, targpos, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, flag);
   targpos = (trace_endpos + eZ * FLAG_PASS_ARC_OFFSET_Z);
   WarpZone_TraceLine(flag.origin, targpos, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, flag);
   if(trace_fraction < 1) { targpos = to; }

  }
 }
 else { targpos = to; }



 vector desired_direction = normalize(targpos - from);
 if(turnrate) { flag.velocity = (normalize(normalize(flag.velocity) + (desired_direction * autocvar_g_ctf_pass_turnrate)) * autocvar_g_ctf_pass_velocity); }
 else { flag.velocity = (desired_direction * autocvar_g_ctf_pass_velocity); }
}

float ctf_CheckPassDirection(vector head_center, vector passer_center, vector passer_angle, vector nearest_to_passer)
{
 if(autocvar_g_ctf_pass_directional_max || autocvar_g_ctf_pass_directional_min)
 {

  float spreadlimit;
  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", 223, __FUNC__, "\"passer_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(passer_angle); }else voidfunc();


  float h;
  float a;

  h = vlen(head_center - passer_center);
  a = h * (normalize(head_center - passer_center) * v_forward);

  vector nearest_on_line = (passer_center + a * v_forward);
  float distance_from_line = vlen(nearest_to_passer - nearest_on_line);

  spreadlimit = (autocvar_g_ctf_pass_radius ? min(1, (vlen(passer_center - nearest_on_line) / autocvar_g_ctf_pass_radius)) : 1);
  spreadlimit = (autocvar_g_ctf_pass_directional_min * (1 - spreadlimit) + autocvar_g_ctf_pass_directional_max * spreadlimit);

  if(spreadlimit && (distance_from_line <= spreadlimit) && ((vlen(normalize(head_center - passer_center) - v_forward) * RAD2DEG) <= 90))
   { return true; }
  else
   { return false; }
 }
 else { return true; }
}






float ctf_CaptureShield_CheckStatus(entity p)
{
 float s, s2, s3, s4, se, se2, se3, se4, sr, ser;
 float players_worseeq, players_total;

 if(ctf_captureshield_max_ratio <= 0)
  return false;

 s = _GameRules_scoring_add(p, SP_CTF_CAPS, 0);
 s2 = _GameRules_scoring_add(p, SP_CTF_PICKUPS, 0);
 s3 = _GameRules_scoring_add(p, SP_CTF_RETURNS, 0);
 s4 = _GameRules_scoring_add(p, SP_CTF_FCKILLS, 0);

 sr = ((s - s2) + (s3 + s4));

 if(sr >= -ctf_captureshield_min_negscore)
  return false;

 players_total = players_worseeq = 0;
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { if((teamplay ? (it.team != p.team) : (it != p))) continue; se = _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_CTF_CAPS, 0); se2 = _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_CTF_PICKUPS, 0); se3 = _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_CTF_RETURNS, 0); se4 = _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_CTF_FCKILLS, 0); ser = ((se - se2) + (se3 + se4)); if(ser <= sr) ++players_worseeq; ++players_total; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()
# 283 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc"
   ;




 if(players_worseeq >= players_total * ctf_captureshield_max_ratio)
  return false;

 return true;
}

void ctf_CaptureShield_Update(entity player, float wanted_status)
{
 float updated_status = ctf_CaptureShield_CheckStatus(player);
 if((wanted_status == player.ctf_captureshielded) && (updated_status != wanted_status))
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, ((updated_status) ? CENTER_CTF_CAPTURESHIELD_SHIELDED : CENTER_CTF_CAPTURESHIELD_FREE));
  player.ctf_captureshielded = updated_status;
 }
}

 player.throw_antispam = time + autocvar_g_ctf_pass_wait;

 if(droptype == DROP_PASS)
 {
  flag.pass_distance = 0;
  flag.pass_sender = (0, world);
  flag.pass_target = (0, world);
 }
}

void ctf_Handle_Retrieve(entity flag, entity player)
{
 entity sender = flag.pass_sender;


 flag.owner = player;
 flag.owner.flagcarried = flag;
 GameRules_scoring_vip(player, true);


 flag.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 if(player.vehicle)
 {
  setattachment(flag, player.vehicle, "");
  setorigin(flag, VEHICLE_FLAG_OFFSET);
  flag.scale = VEHICLE_FLAG_SCALE;
 }
 else
 {
  setattachment(flag, player, "");
  setorigin(flag, FLAG_CARRY_OFFSET);
 }
 set_movetype(flag, MOVETYPE_NONE);
 flag.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
 flag.angles = '0 0 0';
 flag.ctf_status = FLAG_CARRY;


 if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, flag.snd_flag_pass, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
 ctf_EventLog("receive", flag.team, player);

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { if(it == sender) Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_SENT_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_SENT_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_SENT_YELLOW : CENTER_CTF_PASS_SENT_PINK))) : CENTER_CTF_PASS_SENT_NEUTRAL), player.netname); else if(it == player) Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_RECEIVED_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_RECEIVED_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_RECEIVED_YELLOW : CENTER_CTF_PASS_RECEIVED_PINK))) : CENTER_CTF_PASS_RECEIVED_NEUTRAL), sender.netname); else if((teamplay ? (it.team == sender.team) : (it == sender))) Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_OTHER_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_OTHER_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_CTF_PASS_OTHER_YELLOW : CENTER_CTF_PASS_OTHER_PINK))) : CENTER_CTF_PASS_OTHER_NEUTRAL), sender.netname, player.netname); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()






   ;


 ctf_FlagcarrierWaypoints(player);

 sender.throw_antispam = time + autocvar_g_ctf_pass_wait;
 player.throw_antispam = sender.throw_antispam;

 flag.pass_distance = 0;
 flag.pass_sender = (0, world);
 flag.pass_target = (0, world);
}

void ctf_Handle_Throw(entity player, entity receiver, float droptype)
{
 entity flag = player.flagcarried;
 vector targ_origin, flag_velocity;

 if(!flag) { return; }
 if((droptype == DROP_PASS) && !receiver) { return; }

 if(flag.speedrunning)
 {

  WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_flagcarrier);

  if(player.wps_enemyflagcarrier)
   WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_enemyflagcarrier);

  if(player.wps_flagreturn)
   WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_flagreturn);
  ctf_RespawnFlag(flag);
  return;
 }


 setattachment(flag, (0, world), "");
 tracebox(player.origin - FLAG_DROP_OFFSET, flag.m_mins, flag.m_maxs, player.origin + FLAG_DROP_OFFSET, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, flag);
 flag.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
 setorigin(flag, trace_endpos);
 flag.owner.flagcarried = (0, world);
 GameRules_scoring_vip(flag.owner, false);
 flag.owner = (0, world);
 flag.ctf_dropper = player;
 flag.ctf_droptime = time;
 flag.ctf_landtime = 0;

 flag.flags = FL_ITEM | FL_NOTARGET;

 switch(droptype)
 {
  case DROP_PASS:
  {



   WarpZone_RefSys_Copy(flag, receiver);
   WarpZone_RefSys_AddInverse(flag, receiver);
   targ_origin = WarpZone_RefSys_TransformOrigin(receiver, flag, (0.5 * (receiver.absmin + receiver.absmax)));

   flag.pass_distance = vlen((('1 0 0' * targ_origin.x) + ('0 1 0' * targ_origin.y)) - (('1 0 0' * player.origin.x) + ('0 1 0' * player.origin.y)));
   ctf_CalculatePassVelocity(flag, targ_origin, player.origin, false);


   set_movetype(flag, MOVETYPE_FLY);
   flag.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
   flag.pass_sender = player;
   flag.pass_target = receiver;
   flag.ctf_status = FLAG_PASSING;


   if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, flag.snd_flag_touch, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
   WarpZone_TrailParticles((0, world), _particleeffectnum(flag.passeffect), player.origin, targ_origin);
   ctf_EventLog("pass", flag.team, player);
   break;
  }

  case DROP_THROW:
  {
   if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", 511, __FUNC__, "\"(player.v_angle.y * '0 1 0') + (bound(autocvar_g_ctf_throw_angle_min, player.v_angle.x, autocvar_g_ctf_throw_angle_max) * '1 0 0')\""); _makevectors_hidden((player.v_angle.y * '0 1 0') + (bound(autocvar_g_ctf_throw_angle_min, player.v_angle.x, autocvar_g_ctf_throw_angle_max) * '1 0 0')); }else voidfunc();

   flag_velocity = (('0 0 1' * autocvar_g_ctf_throw_velocity_up) + ((v_forward * autocvar_g_ctf_throw_velocity_forward) * ((StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_Strength, player)) ? autocvar_g_ctf_throw_strengthmultiplier : 1)));
   flag.velocity = W_CalculateProjectileVelocity(player, player.velocity, flag_velocity, false);
   ctf_Handle_Drop(flag, player, droptype);
   navigation_dynamicgoal_set(flag, player);
   break;
  }

  case DROP_RESET:
  {
   flag.velocity = '0 0 0';
   break;
  }

  default:
  case DROP_NORMAL:
  {
   flag.velocity = W_CalculateProjectileVelocity(player, player.velocity, (('0 0 1' * autocvar_g_ctf_drop_velocity_up) + ((('0 1 0' * (2 * (random() - 0.5))) + ('1 0 0' * (2 * (random() - 0.5)))) * autocvar_g_ctf_drop_velocity_side)), false);
   ctf_Handle_Drop(flag, player, droptype);
   navigation_dynamicgoal_set(flag, player);
   break;
  }
 }


 WaypointSprite_Ping(player.wps_flagcarrier);
 WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_flagcarrier);

 if(player.wps_enemyflagcarrier)
  WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_enemyflagcarrier);

 if(player.wps_flagreturn)
  WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_flagreturn);


 ctf_CaptureShield_Update(player, 0);
}

void nades_GiveBonus(entity player, float score);

void ctf_Handle_Capture(entity flag, entity toucher, float capturetype)
{
 entity enemy_flag = ((capturetype == CAPTURE_NORMAL) ? toucher.flagcarried : toucher);
 entity player = ((capturetype == CAPTURE_NORMAL) ? toucher : enemy_flag.ctf_dropper);
 entity player_team_flag = (0, world), tmp_entity;
 float old_time, new_time;

 if(!player) { return; }
 if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (player.team == flag.team) : (player == flag)) : (teamplay ? (player.team != flag.team) : (player != flag)))) { return; }
 if((flag.cnt || enemy_flag.cnt) && flag.cnt != enemy_flag.cnt) { return; }

 if (toucher.goalentity == flag.bot_basewaypoint)
  toucher.goalentity_lock_timeout = 0;

 if(ctf_oneflag)
 for(tmp_entity = ctf_worldflaglist; tmp_entity; tmp_entity = tmp_entity.ctf_worldflagnext)
 if((teamplay ? (tmp_entity.team == player.team) : (tmp_entity == player)))
 {
  player_team_flag = tmp_entity;
  break;
 }

 nades_GiveBonus(player, autocvar_g_nades_bonus_score_high );

 player.throw_prevtime = time;
 player.throw_count = 0;


 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, ((enemy_flag.team) ? ((enemy_flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_CTF_CAPTURE_RED : ((enemy_flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_CTF_CAPTURE_BLUE : ((enemy_flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_CTF_CAPTURE_YELLOW : CENTER_CTF_CAPTURE_PINK))) : CENTER_CTF_CAPTURE_NEUTRAL));
 ctf_CaptureRecord(enemy_flag, player);
 if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ((ctf_oneflag) ? player_team_flag.noise2 : (((teamplay ? (player.team != flag.team) : (player != flag))) ? enemy_flag.noise2 : flag.noise2)), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NONE, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();

 switch(capturetype)
 {
  case CAPTURE_NORMAL: ctf_EventLog("capture", enemy_flag.team, player); break;
  case CAPTURE_DROPPED: ctf_EventLog("droppedcapture", enemy_flag.team, player); break;
  default: break;
 }


 float pscore = 0;
 if(enemy_flag.score_capture || flag.score_capture)
  pscore = floor((max(1, enemy_flag.score_capture) + max(1, flag.score_capture)) * 0.5);
 _GameRules_scoring_add_team(player, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, ((pscore) ? pscore : autocvar_g_ctf_score_capture));
 float capscore = 0;
 if(enemy_flag.score_team_capture || flag.score_team_capture)
  capscore = floor((max(1, enemy_flag.score_team_capture) + max(1, flag.score_team_capture)) * 0.5);
 _GameRules_scoring_add_team(player, SP_CTF_CAPS, ST_CTF_CAPS, ((capscore) ? capscore : 1));

 old_time = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_CTF_CAPTIME, 0);
 new_time = floor((time - enemy_flag.ctf_pickuptime) * (TIME_FACTOR) + 0.5);
 if(!old_time || new_time < old_time)
  _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_CTF_CAPTIME, new_time - old_time);


 Send_Effect_(flag.capeffect, flag.origin, '0 0 0', 1);





 if(capturetype == CAPTURE_NORMAL)
 {
  WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_flagcarrier);
  if(flag.speedrunning) { ctf_FakeTimeLimit(player, -1); }

  if((enemy_flag.ctf_dropper) && (player != enemy_flag.ctf_dropper))
   { _GameRules_scoring_add_team(enemy_flag.ctf_dropper, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, ((enemy_flag.score_assist) ? enemy_flag.score_assist : autocvar_g_ctf_score_capture_assist)); }
 }

 flag.enemy = toucher;


 player.next_take_time = time + autocvar_g_ctf_flag_collect_delay;
 ctf_RespawnFlag(enemy_flag);
}

void ctf_Handle_Return(entity flag, entity player)
{

 if((player.flags & FL_MONSTER))
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_RETURN_MONSTER_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_RETURN_MONSTER_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_RETURN_MONSTER_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_RETURN_MONSTER_PINK))), player.monster_name);
 }
 else if(flag.team)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_CTF_RETURN_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_CTF_RETURN_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_CTF_RETURN_YELLOW : CENTER_CTF_RETURN_PINK))));
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_RETURN_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_RETURN_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_RETURN_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_RETURN_PINK))), player.netname);
 }
 if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, flag.noise1, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NONE, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
 ctf_EventLog("return", flag.team, player);


 if(((player).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 {
  _GameRules_scoring_add_team(player, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, ((flag.score_return) ? flag.score_return : autocvar_g_ctf_score_return));
  _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_CTF_RETURNS, 1);

  nades_GiveBonus(player,autocvar_g_nades_bonus_score_medium);
 }

 TeamScore_AddToTeam(flag.team, ST_SCORE, -autocvar_g_ctf_score_penalty_returned);

 if(flag.ctf_dropper)
 {
  _GameRules_scoring_add(flag.ctf_dropper, SP_SCORE, -autocvar_g_ctf_score_penalty_returned);
  ctf_CaptureShield_Update(flag.ctf_dropper, 0);
  flag.ctf_dropper.next_take_time = time + autocvar_g_ctf_flag_collect_delay;
 }


 if(player.flagcarried == flag)
  WaypointSprite_Kill(player.wps_flagcarrier);

 flag.enemy = player;


 ctf_RespawnFlag(flag);
}

void ctf_Handle_Pickup(entity flag, entity player, float pickuptype)
{

 float pickup_dropped_score;


 flag.owner = player;
 player.flagcarried = flag;
 GameRules_scoring_vip(player, true);
 flag.solid = SOLID_NOT;
 if(player.vehicle)
 {
  setattachment(flag, player.vehicle, "");
  setorigin(flag, VEHICLE_FLAG_OFFSET);
  flag.scale = VEHICLE_FLAG_SCALE;
 }
 else
 {
  setattachment(flag, player, "");
  setorigin(flag, FLAG_CARRY_OFFSET);
 }


 set_movetype(flag, MOVETYPE_NONE);
 flag.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
 flag.angles = '0 0 0';
 flag.ctf_status = FLAG_CARRY;

 switch(pickuptype)
 {
  case PICKUP_BASE: flag.ctf_pickuptime = time; break;
  case PICKUP_DROPPED: SetResourceExplicit(flag, RES_HEALTH, flag.max_health); break;
  default: break;
 }


 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_PICKUP_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_PICKUP_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_PICKUP_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_PICKUP_PINK))) : INFO_CTF_PICKUP_NEUTRAL), player.netname);
 if(ctf_stalemate)
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CTF_STALEMATE_CARRIER);
 if(!flag.team)
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_NEUTRAL);
 else if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (player.team == flag.team) : (player == flag)) : (teamplay ? (player.team != flag.team) : (player != flag))))
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_YELLOW : CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_PINK))));
 else
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, (((teamplay ? (player.team == flag.team) : (player == flag))) ? CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_RETURN : CENTER_CTF_PICKUP_RETURN_ENEMY), Team_ColorCode(flag.team));

 Send_Notification(NOTIF_TEAM_EXCEPT, player, MSG_CHOICE, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_TEAM_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_TEAM_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_TEAM_YELLOW : CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_TEAM_PINK))) : CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_TEAM_NEUTRAL), Team_ColorCode(player.team), player.netname);

 if(!flag.team)
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it != player && (teamplay ? (it.team != player.team) : (it != player)))) { { { { Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CHOICE, CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_NEUTRAL, Team_ColorCode(player.team), player.netname); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

 if(flag.team)
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it != player)) { { { { if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (flag.team != it.team) : (flag != it)) : (teamplay ? (flag.team == it.team) : (flag == it)))) Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CHOICE, (((teamplay ? (flag.team == player.team) : (flag == player))) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_TEAM : CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY), Team_ColorCode(player.team), player.netname); else if((teamplay ? (player.team != it.team) : (player != it))) Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CHOICE, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_OTHER_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_OTHER_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_OTHER_YELLOW : CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_OTHER_PINK))) : CHOICE_CTF_PICKUP_ENEMY_OTHER_NEUTRAL), Team_ColorCode(player.team), player.netname); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




    ;

 if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, flag.noise, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NONE, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();


 _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_CTF_PICKUPS, 1);
 nades_GiveBonus(player, autocvar_g_nades_bonus_score_minor);
 switch(pickuptype)
 {
  case PICKUP_BASE:
  {
   _GameRules_scoring_add_team(player, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, ((flag.score_pickup) ? flag.score_pickup : autocvar_g_ctf_score_pickup_base));
   ctf_EventLog("steal", flag.team, player);
   break;
  }

  case PICKUP_DROPPED:
  {
   pickup_dropped_score = (autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_time ? bound(0, ((flag.ctf_droptime + autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_time) - time) / autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_time, 1) : 1);
   pickup_dropped_score = floor((autocvar_g_ctf_score_pickup_dropped_late * (1 - pickup_dropped_score) + autocvar_g_ctf_score_pickup_dropped_early * pickup_dropped_score) + 0.5);
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", "760")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("pickup_dropped_score is ", ftos(pickup_dropped_score)), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   _GameRules_scoring_add_team(player, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, pickup_dropped_score);
   ctf_EventLog("pickup", flag.team, player);
   break;
  }

  default: break;
 }


 if(pickuptype == PICKUP_BASE)
 {
  flag.speedrunning = player.speedrunning;
  if((player.speedrunning) && (ctf_captimerecord))
   ctf_FakeTimeLimit(player, time + ctf_captimerecord);
 }


 Send_Effect_(flag.toucheffect, player.origin, '0 0 0', 1);


 if(pickuptype == PICKUP_DROPPED) { WaypointSprite_Kill(flag.wps_flagdropped); }
 ctf_FlagcarrierWaypoints(player);
 WaypointSprite_Ping(player.wps_flagcarrier);
}






void ctf_CheckFlagReturn(entity flag, float returntype)
{
 if((flag.ctf_status == FLAG_DROPPED) || (flag.ctf_status == FLAG_PASSING))
 {
  if(flag.wps_flagdropped) { WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(flag.wps_flagdropped, GetResource(flag, RES_HEALTH)); }

  if((GetResource(flag, RES_HEALTH) <= 0) || (time >= flag.ctf_droptime + autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_time))
  {
   switch(returntype)
   {
    case RETURN_DROPPED:
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DROPPED_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DROPPED_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DROPPED_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DROPPED_PINK))) : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DROPPED_NEUTRAL)); break;
    case RETURN_DAMAGE:
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DAMAGED_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DAMAGED_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DAMAGED_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DAMAGED_PINK))) : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_DAMAGED_NEUTRAL)); break;
    case RETURN_SPEEDRUN:
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_SPEEDRUN_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_SPEEDRUN_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_SPEEDRUN_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_SPEEDRUN_PINK))) : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_SPEEDRUN_NEUTRAL), floor((ctf_captimerecord) * (TIME_FACTOR) + 0.5)); break;
    case RETURN_NEEDKILL:
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_NEEDKILL_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_NEEDKILL_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_NEEDKILL_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_NEEDKILL_PINK))) : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_NEEDKILL_NEUTRAL)); break;
    default:
    case RETURN_TIMEOUT:
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((flag.team) ? ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_TIMEOUT_RED : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_TIMEOUT_BLUE : ((flag.team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_TIMEOUT_YELLOW : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_TIMEOUT_PINK))) : INFO_CTF_FLAGRETURN_TIMEOUT_NEUTRAL)); break;
   }
   if(1){ entity __e = flag; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, flag.noise3, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NONE, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
   ctf_EventLog("returned", flag.team, (0, world));
   flag.enemy = (0, world);
   ctf_RespawnFlag(flag);
  }
 }
}

float ctf_Stalemate_Customize(entity this, entity client)
{

 entity e = WaypointSprite_getviewentity(client);
 entity wp_owner = this.owner;



 if((teamplay ? (wp_owner.team == e.team) : (wp_owner == e))) { return false; }
 if(!((e).classname == STR_PLAYER)) { return false; }

 return true;
}

void ctf_CheckStalemate()
{

 float stale_flags = 0, stale_red_flags = 0, stale_blue_flags = 0, stale_yellow_flags = 0, stale_pink_flags = 0, stale_neutral_flags = 0;
 entity tmp_entity;

 entity ctf_staleflaglist = (0, world);


 for(tmp_entity = ctf_worldflaglist; tmp_entity; tmp_entity = tmp_entity.ctf_worldflagnext)
 {
  if(autocvar_g_ctf_stalemate)
  if(tmp_entity.ctf_status != FLAG_BASE)
  if(time >= tmp_entity.ctf_pickuptime + autocvar_g_ctf_stalemate_time || !tmp_entity.team)
  {
   tmp_entity.ctf_staleflagnext = ctf_staleflaglist;
   ctf_staleflaglist = tmp_entity;

   switch(tmp_entity.team)
   {
    case NUM_TEAM_1: ++stale_red_flags; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_2: ++stale_blue_flags; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_3: ++stale_yellow_flags; break;
    case NUM_TEAM_4: ++stale_pink_flags; break;
    default: ++stale_neutral_flags; break;
   }
  }
 }

 if(ctf_oneflag)
  stale_flags = (stale_neutral_flags >= 1);
 else
  stale_flags = (stale_red_flags >= 1) + (stale_blue_flags >= 1) + (stale_yellow_flags >= 1) + (stale_pink_flags >= 1);

 if(ctf_oneflag && stale_flags == 1)
  ctf_stalemate = true;
 else if(stale_flags >= 2)
  ctf_stalemate = true;
 else if(stale_flags == 0 && autocvar_g_ctf_stalemate_endcondition == 2)
  { ctf_stalemate = false; wpforenemy_announced = false; }
 else if(stale_flags < 2 && autocvar_g_ctf_stalemate_endcondition == 1)
  { ctf_stalemate = false; wpforenemy_announced = false; }


 if(ctf_stalemate)
 {
  for(tmp_entity = ctf_staleflaglist; tmp_entity; tmp_entity = tmp_entity.ctf_staleflagnext)
  {
   if((tmp_entity.owner) && (!tmp_entity.owner.wps_enemyflagcarrier))
   {
    entity wp = WaypointSprite_Spawn(((ctf_oneflag) ? WP_FlagCarrier : WP_FlagCarrierEnemy), 0, 0, tmp_entity.owner, FLAG_WAYPOINT_OFFSET, (0, world), 0, tmp_entity.owner, wps_enemyflagcarrier, true, RADARICON_FLAG);
    wp.colormod = ((tmp_entity.owner.team) ? colormapPaletteColor_(tmp_entity.owner.team - 1, false, time) * 0.75 : '1 1 1');
    (_selftemp = (tmp_entity.owner.wps_enemyflagcarrier), _selftemp.__customizeentityforclient = ((ctf_Stalemate_Customize) ? customizeentityforclient_self : nil), _selftemp.selfcustomizeentityforclient = (ctf_Stalemate_Customize));
   }
  }

  if (!wpforenemy_announced)
  {
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (clienttype(it) == CLIENTTYPE_REAL))) { { { { Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, ((it.flagcarried) ? CENTER_CTF_STALEMATE_CARRIER : CENTER_CTF_STALEMATE_OTHER)); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

   wpforenemy_announced = true;
  }
 }
}

void ctf_FlagDamage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 if((((deathtype) == DEATH_HURTTRIGGER.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_SLIME.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_LAVA.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_SWAMP.m_id)))
 {
  if(autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_damage_delay)
   this.ctf_flagdamaged_byworld = true;
  else
  {
   SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, 0);
   ctf_CheckFlagReturn(this, RETURN_NEEDKILL);
  }
  return;
 }
 if(autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_damage)
 {

  TakeResource(this, RES_HEALTH, damage);
  ctf_CheckFlagReturn(this, RETURN_DAMAGE);
  return;
 }
}

void ctf_FlagThink(entity this)
{

 entity tmp_entity;

 this.nextthink = time + FLAG_THINKRATE;


 if(this == ctf_worldflaglist)
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { ctf_CaptureShield_Update(it, 1); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();


 if(this.mins != this.m_mins || this.maxs != this.m_maxs) {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", "935")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("wtf the flag got squashed?"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  tracebox(this.origin, this.m_mins, this.m_maxs, this.origin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
  if(!trace_startsolid || this.noalign)
   setsize(this, this.m_mins, this.m_maxs);
 }


 switch(this.ctf_status)
 {
  case FLAG_BASE:
  {
   if(autocvar_g_ctf_dropped_capture_radius)
   {
    for(tmp_entity = ctf_worldflaglist; tmp_entity; tmp_entity = tmp_entity.ctf_worldflagnext)
     if(tmp_entity.ctf_status == FLAG_DROPPED)
     if(((_vlen2 = (this.origin - tmp_entity.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((autocvar_g_ctf_dropped_capture_radius) ** 2)))
     if((this.noalign || tmp_entity.ctf_landtime) && time > ((this.noalign) ? tmp_entity.ctf_droptime : tmp_entity.ctf_landtime) + autocvar_g_ctf_dropped_capture_delay)
      ctf_Handle_Capture(this, tmp_entity, CAPTURE_DROPPED);
   }
   return;
  }

  case FLAG_DROPPED:
  {
   this.angles = '0 0 0';
   if((((this).flags & FL_ONGROUND) != 0) && !this.ctf_landtime)
    this.ctf_landtime = time;

   if(autocvar_g_ctf_flag_dropped_floatinwater)
   {
    vector midpoint = ((this.absmin + this.absmax) * 0.5);
    if(pointcontents(midpoint) == CONTENT_WATER)
    {
     this.velocity = this.velocity * 0.5;

     if (pointcontents(midpoint + eZ * FLAG_FLOAT_OFFSET_Z) == CONTENT_WATER)
      { this.velocity_z = autocvar_g_ctf_flag_dropped_floatinwater; }
     else
      { set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_FLY); }
    }
    else if(this.move_movetype == MOVETYPE_FLY) { set_movetype(this, MOVETYPE_TOSS); }
   }
   if(autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_dropped)
   {
    if((((_vlen2 = (this.origin - this.dropped_origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_dropped) ** 2))) || (autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_dropped == -1))
    {
     SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, 0);
     ctf_CheckFlagReturn(this, RETURN_DROPPED);
     return;
    }
   }
   if(this.ctf_flagdamaged_byworld)
   {
    TakeResource(this, RES_HEALTH, (this.max_health / autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_damage_delay) * FLAG_THINKRATE);
    ctf_CheckFlagReturn(this, RETURN_NEEDKILL);
    return;
   }
   else if(autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_time)
   {
    TakeResource(this, RES_HEALTH, (this.max_health / autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_time) * FLAG_THINKRATE);
    ctf_CheckFlagReturn(this, RETURN_TIMEOUT);
    return;
   }
   return;
  }

  case FLAG_CARRY:
  {
   if(this.speedrunning && ctf_captimerecord && (time >= this.ctf_pickuptime + ctf_captimerecord))
   {
    SetResourceExplicit(this, RES_HEALTH, 0);
    ctf_CheckFlagReturn(this, RETURN_SPEEDRUN);

    (this.owner._cs).impulse = CHIMPULSE_SPEEDRUN.impulse;
    ImpulseCommands(this.owner);
   }
   if(autocvar_g_ctf_stalemate)
   {
    if(time >= wpforenemy_nextthink)
    {
     ctf_CheckStalemate();
     wpforenemy_nextthink = time + WPFE_THINKRATE;
    }
   }
   if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (this.team != this.owner.team) : (this != this.owner)) : (teamplay ? (this.team == this.owner.team) : (this == this.owner))) && this.team)
   {
    if(autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return)
     ctf_Handle_Throw(this.owner, (0, world), DROP_THROW);
    else if(((_vlen2 = (this.owner.origin - this.dropped_origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((autocvar_g_ctf_flag_return_carried_radius) ** 2)))
     ctf_Handle_Return(this, this.owner);
   }
   return;
  }

  case FLAG_PASSING:
  {
   vector targ_origin = ((this.pass_target.absmin + this.pass_target.absmax) * 0.5);
   targ_origin = WarpZone_RefSys_TransformOrigin(this.pass_target, this, targ_origin);
   WarpZone_TraceLine(this.origin, targ_origin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);

   if((this.pass_target == (0, world))
    || (((this.pass_target).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
    || (this.pass_target.flagcarried)
    || (((_vlen2 = (this.origin - targ_origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_g_ctf_pass_radius) ** 2)))
    || ((trace_fraction < 1) && (trace_ent != this.pass_target))
    || (time > this.ctf_droptime + autocvar_g_ctf_pass_timelimit))
   {

    ctf_Handle_Drop(this, (0, world), DROP_PASS);
   }
   else
   {

    ctf_CalculatePassVelocity(this, targ_origin, this.origin, true);
   }
   return;
  }

  default:
  {
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", "1055")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("ctf_FlagThink(): Flag exists with no status?"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
 }
}

void ctf_RespawnFlag(entity flag)
{
 flag.watertype = CONTENT_EMPTY;


 if((flag.owner) && (flag.owner.flagcarried == flag))
 {
  WaypointSprite_Kill(flag.owner.wps_enemyflagcarrier);
  WaypointSprite_Kill(flag.owner.wps_flagreturn);
  WaypointSprite_Kill(flag.wps_flagcarrier);

  flag.owner.flagcarried = (0, world);
  GameRules_scoring_vip(flag.owner, false);

  if(flag.speedrunning)
   ctf_FakeTimeLimit(flag.owner, -1);
 }

 if((flag.owner) && (flag.owner.vehicle))
  flag.scale = FLAG_SCALE;

 if(flag.ctf_status == FLAG_DROPPED)
  { WaypointSprite_Kill(flag.wps_flagdropped); }


 setattachment(flag, (0, world), "");
 flag.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
 setorigin(flag, flag.dropped_origin);


 set_movetype(flag, MOVETYPE_NONE);
 flag.takedamage = DAMAGE_NO;
 SetResourceExplicit(flag, RES_HEALTH, flag.max_health);
 flag.velocity = '0 0 0';
 flag.angles = flag.mangle;
 flag.flags = FL_ITEM | FL_NOTARGET;

 flag.ctf_status = FLAG_BASE;
 flag.owner = (0, world);
 flag.pass_distance = 0;
 flag.pass_sender = (0, world);
 flag.pass_target = (0, world);
 flag.ctf_dropper = (0, world);
 flag.ctf_pickuptime = 0;
 flag.ctf_droptime = 0;
 flag.ctf_landtime = 0;
 flag.ctf_flagdamaged_byworld = false;
 navigation_dynamicgoal_unset(flag);

 ctf_CheckStalemate();
}

# 1397 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc"
void havocbot_ctf_calculate_middlepoint()
{
 entity f;
 vector s = '0 0 0';
 vector fo = '0 0 0';
 float n = 0;

 f = ctf_worldflaglist;
 while (f)
 {
  fo = f.origin;
  s = s + fo;
  f = f.ctf_worldflagnext;
  n++;
 }
 if(!n)
  return;

 havocbot_middlepoint = s / n;
 havocbot_middlepoint_radius = vlen(fo - havocbot_middlepoint);

 havocbot_symmetry_axis_m = 0;
 havocbot_symmetry_axis_q = 0;
 if(n == 2)
 {

  entity f1 = ctf_worldflaglist;
  entity f2 = f1.ctf_worldflagnext;
  float m = -(f1.origin.y - f2.origin.y) / (max(f1.origin.x - f2.origin.x, FLOAT_EPSILON));
  float q = havocbot_middlepoint.y - m * havocbot_middlepoint.x;
  havocbot_symmetry_axis_m = m;
  havocbot_symmetry_axis_q = q;
 }
 havocbot_symmetry_origin_order = n;
}


entity havocbot_ctf_find_flag(entity bot)
{
 entity f;
 f = ctf_worldflaglist;
 while (f)
 {
  if (((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (bot.team != f.team) : (bot != f)) : (teamplay ? (bot.team == f.team) : (bot == f))))
   return f;
  f = f.ctf_worldflagnext;
 }
 return (0, world);
}

entity havocbot_ctf_find_enemy_flag(entity bot)
{
 entity f;
 f = ctf_worldflaglist;
 while (f)
 {
  if(ctf_oneflag)
  {
   if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (bot.team == f.team) : (bot == f)) : (teamplay ? (bot.team != f.team) : (bot != f))))
   {
    if(f.team)
    {
     if(bot.flagcarried)
      return f;
    }
    else if(!bot.flagcarried)
     return f;
   }
  }
  else if (((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (bot.team == f.team) : (bot == f)) : (teamplay ? (bot.team != f.team) : (bot != f))))
   return f;
  f = f.ctf_worldflagnext;
 }
 return (0, world);
}

{
 if (!teamplay)
  return 0;

 float c = 0;

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { if((teamplay ? (it.team != bot.team) : (it != bot)) || ((it).deadflag != DEAD_NO) || it == bot) continue; if(((_vlen2 = (it.origin - org), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((tc_radius) ** 2))) ++c; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()





   ;

 return c;
}
# 1508 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc"
void havocbot_goalrating_ctf_ourbase(entity this, float ratingscale)
{
 entity head;
 head = ctf_worldflaglist;
 while (head)
 {
  if (((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (this.team != head.team) : (this != head)) : (teamplay ? (this.team == head.team) : (this == head))))
  {
   if (this.flagcarried)
   if ((this.flagcarried.cnt || head.cnt) && this.flagcarried.cnt != head.cnt)
   {
    head = head.ctf_worldflagnext;
    continue;
   }
   break;
  }
  head = head.ctf_worldflagnext;
 }
 if (!head)
  return;

 navigation_routerating(this, head.bot_basewaypoint, ratingscale, 10000);
}

void havocbot_goalrating_ctf_enemyflag(entity this, float ratingscale)
{
 entity head;
 head = ctf_worldflaglist;
 while (head)
 {
  if(ctf_oneflag)
  {
   if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (this.team == head.team) : (this == head)) : (teamplay ? (this.team != head.team) : (this != head))))
   {
    if(head.team)
    {
     if(this.flagcarried)
      break;
    }
    else if(!this.flagcarried)
     break;
   }
  }
  else if(((autocvar_g_ctf_reverse || (ctf_oneflag && autocvar_g_ctf_oneflag_reverse)) ? (teamplay ? (this.team == head.team) : (this == head)) : (teamplay ? (this.team != head.team) : (this != head))))
   break;
  head = head.ctf_worldflagnext;
 }
 if (head)
 {
  if (head.ctf_status == FLAG_CARRY)
  {

   head = head.tag_entity;
   float f = bound(0, (GetResource(head, RES_HEALTH) + GetResource(head, RES_ARMOR)) / 100, 2) - 1;
   ratingscale += ratingscale * f * 0.1;
  }
  navigation_routerating(this, head, ratingscale, 10000);
 }
}

void havocbot_ctf_reset_role(entity this)
{
 float cdefense, cmiddle, coffense;
 entity mf, ef;

 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return;


 if (this.flagcarried)
 {
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_CARRIER);
  return;
 }

 mf = havocbot_ctf_find_flag(this);
 ef = havocbot_ctf_find_enemy_flag(this);


 if(mf.ctf_status!=FLAG_BASE)
 {
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_RETRIEVER);
  return;
 }


 if(ef.ctf_status!=FLAG_BASE)
 {
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_MIDDLE);
  return;
 }


 float count = 0;

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (it != this && ((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && (teamplay ? (it.team == this.team) : (it == this)))) { { { { ++count; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

 if (count == 0)
 {
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_OFFENSE);
  return;
 }
 else if (time < (this._cs).jointime + 1)
 {

  if (count == 1)
  {
   havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_DEFENSE);
   return;
  }
  else if (count == 2)
  {
   havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_MIDDLE);
   return;
  }
 }



 cmiddle = havocbot_ctf_teamcount(this, havocbot_middlepoint, havocbot_middlepoint_radius * 0.5);


 cdefense = havocbot_ctf_teamcount(this, mf.dropped_origin, havocbot_middlepoint_radius * 0.5);


 coffense = havocbot_ctf_teamcount(this, ef.dropped_origin, havocbot_middlepoint_radius);

 if(cdefense<=coffense)
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_DEFENSE);
 else if(coffense<=cmiddle)
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_OFFENSE);
 else
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_MIDDLE);


 if (time < (this._cs).jointime + 1 && count > 2)
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = time + 10 + random() * 10;
}

float havocbot_ctf_is_basewaypoint(entity item)
{
 if (item.classname != "waypoint")
  return false;

 entity head = ctf_worldflaglist;
 while (head)
 {
  if (item == head.bot_basewaypoint)
   return true;
  head = head.ctf_worldflagnext;
 }
 return false;
}
