{
 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 {
  havocbot_ctf_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }

 if (this.flagcarried == (0, world))
 {
  havocbot_ctf_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }

 if (navigation_goalrating_timeout(this))
 {
  navigation_goalrating_start(this);


  entity mf = havocbot_ctf_find_flag(this);
  vector base_org = mf.dropped_origin;
  float base_rating = (mf.ctf_status == FLAG_BASE) ? 10000 : (((_vlen2 = (this.origin - base_org), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((100) ** 2)) ? 2000 : 1000);
  if(ctf_oneflag)
   havocbot_goalrating_ctf_enemybase(this, base_rating);
  else
   havocbot_goalrating_ctf_ourbase(this, base_rating);


  if (((_vlen2 = (this.origin - base_org), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((havocbot_middlepoint_radius) ** 2)))
   havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 15000, this.origin, min(500, havocbot_middlepoint_radius * 0.5));

  havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 10000, base_org, havocbot_middlepoint_radius * 0.5);

  navigation_goalrating_end(this);

  navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(this);

  entity goal = this.goalentity;
  if (havocbot_ctf_is_basewaypoint(goal) && ((_vlen2 = (goal.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((100) ** 2)))
   this.goalentity_lock_timeout = time + ((this.enemy) ? 2 : 3);

  if (goal)
   this.havocbot_cantfindflag = time + 10;
  else if (time > this.havocbot_cantfindflag)
  {


   Damage(this, this, this, 100000, DEATH_KILL.m_id, (weaponentities[0]), this.origin, '0 0 0');
   return;
  }
 }
}

void havocbot_role_ctf_escort(entity this)
{
 entity mf, ef;

 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 {
  havocbot_ctf_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }

 if (this.flagcarried)
 {
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_CARRIER);
  return;
 }


 ef = havocbot_ctf_find_enemy_flag(this);
 if(ef.ctf_status==FLAG_BASE)
 {
  this.havocbot_role = this.havocbot_previous_role;
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
  return;
 }
 if (ef.ctf_status == FLAG_DROPPED)
 {
  navigation_goalrating_timeout_expire(this, 1);
  return;
 }


 mf = havocbot_ctf_find_flag(this);
 if (mf.ctf_status != FLAG_BASE && ((_vlen2 = (ef.origin - mf.dropped_origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((900) ** 2)))
 {
  havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(this, HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_DEFENSE);
  return;
 }


 if (!this.havocbot_role_timeout)
 {
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = time + random() * 30 + 60;
 }


 if (time > this.havocbot_role_timeout)
 {
  this.havocbot_role = this.havocbot_previous_role;
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
  return;
 }


 if (navigation_goalrating_timeout(this))
 {
  navigation_goalrating_start(this);


  havocbot_goalrating_ctf_enemyflag(this, 10000);
  havocbot_goalrating_ctf_ourstolenflag(this, 6000);
  havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 21000, this.origin, 10000);

  navigation_goalrating_end(this);

  navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(this);
 }

    ;


  if(closestplayer)
  if((teamplay ? (closestplayer.team != this.team) : (closestplayer != this)))
  if(((_vlen2 = (org - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((1000) ** 2)))
  if(checkpvs(this.origin,closestplayer)||random()<0.5)
   havocbot_goalrating_ctf_ourbase(this, 10000);

  havocbot_goalrating_ctf_ourstolenflag(this, 5000);
  havocbot_goalrating_ctf_droppedflags(this, 6000, org, havocbot_middlepoint_radius);
  havocbot_goalrating_enemyplayers(this, 25000, org, havocbot_middlepoint_radius);
  havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 25000, org, havocbot_middlepoint_radius);
  havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 18000, this.origin, 10000);

  navigation_goalrating_end(this);

  navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(this);
 }
}

void havocbot_role_ctf_setrole(entity bot, float role)
{
 string s = "(null)";
 switch(role)
 {
  case HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_CARRIER:
   s = "carrier";
   bot.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ctf_carrier;
   bot.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
   bot.havocbot_cantfindflag = time + 10;
   if (bot.havocbot_previous_role != bot.havocbot_role)
    navigation_goalrating_timeout_force(bot);
   break;
  case HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_DEFENSE:
   s = "defense";
   bot.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ctf_defense;
   bot.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
   break;
  case HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_MIDDLE:
   s = "middle";
   bot.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ctf_middle;
   bot.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
   break;
  case HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_OFFENSE:
   s = "offense";
   bot.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ctf_offense;
   bot.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
   break;
  case HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_RETRIEVER:
   s = "retriever";
   bot.havocbot_previous_role = bot.havocbot_role;
   bot.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ctf_retriever;
   bot.havocbot_role_timeout = time + 10;
   if (bot.havocbot_previous_role != bot.havocbot_role)
    navigation_goalrating_timeout_expire(bot, 2);
   break;
  case HAVOCBOT_CTF_ROLE_ESCORT:
   s = "escort";
   bot.havocbot_previous_role = bot.havocbot_role;
   bot.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_ctf_escort;
   bot.havocbot_role_timeout = time + 30;
   if (bot.havocbot_previous_role != bot.havocbot_role)
    navigation_goalrating_timeout_expire(bot, 2);
   break;
 }
 if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", "2148")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n(bot.netname, " switched to ", s), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
}

 {

   case FLAG_PASSING:
   case FLAG_CARRY:
   {
    if((flag.owner == player) || (flag.pass_sender == player))
     (player).stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS |= t;
    else
     (player).stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS |= t2;
    break;
   }
   case FLAG_DROPPED:
   {
    (player).stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS |= t3;
    break;
   }
  }
 }


 if(player.ctf_captureshielded)

  if(flag.ctf_dropper == player) { flag.ctf_dropper = (0, world); }
 }
}

Callback CB_ctf_PlayerUseKey; float ctf_PlayerUseKey(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_ctf_PlayerUseKey = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc" ":" "2327", true) , ctf_PlayerUseKey); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_ctf_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_PlayerUseKey, CB_ctf_PlayerUseKey, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("PlayerUseKey", "ctf_PlayerUseKey"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_PlayerUseKey, CB_ctf_PlayerUseKey); } }else voidfunc(); } float ctf_PlayerUseKey() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float ctf_PlayerUseKey()
{
 if(CallbackChain_ReturnValue || game_stopped) return;

 entity player = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_entity;

 if((time > player.throw_antispam) && !((player).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !player.speedrunning && (!player.vehicle || autocvar_g_ctf_allow_vehicle_touch))
 {

  if(autocvar_g_ctf_pass)
  {
   entity head, closest_target = (0, world);
   head = WarpZone_FindRadius(player.origin, autocvar_g_ctf_pass_radius, true);

   while(head)
   {
    if(((head).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((head).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
    if(head != player && (teamplay ? (head.team == player.team) : (head == player)))
    if(!head.speedrunning && !head.vehicle)
    {

     vector head_center = WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(head, (head.origin + (((head).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? head.view_ofs : ((head.mins + head.maxs) * 0.5))));
     vector passer_center = (player.origin + (((player).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? player.view_ofs : ((player.mins + player.maxs) * 0.5)));

     if(ctf_CheckPassDirection(head_center, passer_center, player.v_angle, head.WarpZone_findradius_nearest))
     {
      if(autocvar_g_ctf_pass_request && !player.flagcarried && head.flagcarried)
      {
       if((clienttype(head) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
       {
        Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CTF_PASS_REQUESTING, head.netname);
        ctf_Handle_Throw(head, player, DROP_PASS);
       }
       else
       {
        Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, head, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CTF_PASS_REQUESTED, player.netname);
        Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CTF_PASS_REQUESTING, head.netname);
       }
       player.throw_antispam = time + autocvar_g_ctf_pass_wait;
       return true;
      }
      else if(player.flagcarried && !head.flagcarried)
      {
       if(closest_target)
       {
        vector closest_target_center = WarpZone_UnTransformOrigin(closest_target, (closest_target.origin + (((closest_target).classname == STR_PLAYER) ? closest_target.view_ofs : ((closest_target.mins + closest_target.maxs) * 0.5))));
        if((_vlen2 = (passer_center - head_center), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < (_vlen2 = (passer_center - closest_target_center), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))))
         { closest_target = head; }
       }
       else { closest_target = head; }
      }
     }
    }
    head = head.chain;
   }

   if(closest_target) { ctf_Handle_Throw(player, closest_target, DROP_PASS); return true; }
  }


  if(autocvar_g_ctf_throw && player.flagcarried)
  {
   if(player.throw_count == -1)
   {
    if(time > player.throw_prevtime + autocvar_g_ctf_throw_punish_delay)
    {
     player.throw_prevtime = time;
     player.throw_count = 1;
     ctf_Handle_Throw(player, (0, world), DROP_THROW);
     return true;
    }
    else
    {
     Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_CTF_FLAG_THROW_PUNISH, rint((player.throw_prevtime + autocvar_g_ctf_throw_punish_delay) - time));
     return false;
    }
   }
   else
   {
    if(time > player.throw_prevtime + autocvar_g_ctf_throw_punish_time) { player.throw_count = 1; }
    else { player.throw_count += 1; }
    if(player.throw_count >= autocvar_g_ctf_throw_punish_count) { player.throw_count = -1; }

    player.throw_prevtime = time;
    ctf_Handle_Throw(player, (0, world), DROP_THROW);
    return true;
   }
  }
 }
}

void ctf_SpawnTeam (string teamname, float teamcolor)
{
 entity this = __spawn("ctf_team", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc" ":" "2766", true);
 this.netname = teamname;
 this.cnt = teamcolor - 1;
 this.spawnfunc_checked = true;
 this.team = teamcolor;
}

void ctf_DelayedInit(entity this)
{
 ctf_teams = 0;

 entity tmp_entity;
 for(tmp_entity = ctf_worldflaglist; tmp_entity; tmp_entity = tmp_entity.ctf_worldflagnext)
 {



  switch(tmp_entity.team)
  {
   case NUM_TEAM_1: ((ctf_teams) |= ((1 << (0)))); break;
   case NUM_TEAM_2: ((ctf_teams) |= ((1 << (1)))); break;
   case NUM_TEAM_3: ((ctf_teams) |= ((1 << (2)))); break;
   case NUM_TEAM_4: ((ctf_teams) |= ((1 << (3)))); break;
  }
  if(tmp_entity.team == 0) { ctf_oneflag = true; }
 }

 havocbot_ctf_calculate_middlepoint();

 if(NumTeams(ctf_teams) < 2)
 {
  ctf_teams = 0;
  ((ctf_teams) |= ((1 << (0))));
  ((ctf_teams) |= ((1 << (1))));
 }




 if(find((0, world), classname, "ctf_team") == (0, world))
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc", "2807")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("No \"ctf_team\" entities found on this map, creating them anyway."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  if(ctf_teams & (1 << (0)))
   ctf_SpawnTeam("Red", NUM_TEAM_1);
  if(ctf_teams & (1 << (1)))
   ctf_SpawnTeam("Blue", NUM_TEAM_2);
  if(ctf_teams & (1 << (2)))
   ctf_SpawnTeam("Yellow", NUM_TEAM_3);
  if(ctf_teams & (1 << (3)))
   ctf_SpawnTeam("Pink", NUM_TEAM_4);
 }

 ctf_ScoreRules(ctf_teams);
}

void ctf_Initialize()
{
 CTF_FLAG = spawnFlag_1(__spawn("Flag", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/ctf/sv_ctf.qc" ":" "2823", true) );
 record_type = "/ctf100record/";
 ctf_captimerecord = stof(db_get(ServerProgsDB, strcat(GetMapname(), "/captimerecord/time")));

 ctf_captureshield_min_negscore = autocvar_g_ctf_shield_min_negscore;
 ctf_captureshield_max_ratio = autocvar_g_ctf_shield_max_ratio;
 ctf_captureshield_force = autocvar_g_ctf_shield_force;

 InitializeEntity((0, world), ctf_DelayedInit, INITPRIO_GAMETYPE);
}

 if(wishvel.x != 0 && wishvel.y != 0 && wishvel.x != wishvel.y)
 {
  wishvel.z = 0;
  wishspeed = vlen(wishvel);
  if(wishvel.x >= 2 * wishvel.y)
  {

   else
    (player._cs).movement_x = -wishspeed;
   (player._cs).movement_y = 0;
  }
  else if(wishvel.y >= 2 * wishvel.x)
  {

   (player._cs).movement_x = 0;
   if((player._cs).movement.y > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_y = wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_y = -wishspeed;
  }
  else
  {

   if((player._cs).movement.x > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_x = M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_x = -M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
   if((player._cs).movement.y > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_y = M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_y = -M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
  }

}

  TeamScore_AddToTeam(this.goalentity.team, ST_SCORE, fragamt);
  TeamScore_AddToTeam(this.goalentity.team, ST_DOM_TICKS, fragamt);

float Domination_CheckWinner()
{
 if((round_handler.round_endtime) > 0 && (round_handler.round_endtime) - time <= 0)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ROUND_OVER);
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_ROUND_OVER);

  game_stopped = true;
  round_handler_Init(5, autocvar_g_domination_warmup, autocvar_g_domination_round_timelimit);
  return true;
 }

 Domination_count_controlpoints();
 float winner_team = Team_GetWinnerTeam_WithOwnedItems(total_control_points);
 if (winner_team == -1)
  return 0;

 if(winner_team > 0)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_RED : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_BLUE : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_YELLOW : CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_PINK))));
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_RED : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_BLUE : ((winner_team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_YELLOW : INFO_ROUND_TEAM_WIN_PINK))));
  TeamScore_AddToTeam(winner_team, ST_DOM_CAPS, +1);
 }

 game_stopped = true;
 round_handler_Init(5, autocvar_g_domination_warmup, autocvar_g_domination_round_timelimit);

 return true;
}

  prev_missing_teams_mask = missing_teams_mask;

}

 freezetag_count_alive_players();

 freezetag_Add_Score(targ, attacker);
}

 if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_invasion_waves; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_invasion_waves.il_loop_item; g_invasion_waves.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_invasion_waves.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (it.cnt <= wavenum) { { { if(!best || it.cnt > best.cnt) best = it; }; } } if (g_invasion_waves.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_invasion_waves.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_invasion_waves.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()

void invasion_SpawnChosenMonster(Monster mon)
{
 entity monster;
 entity spawn_point = invasion_PickSpawn();
 entity wave_ent = invasion_GetWaveEntity(inv_roundcnt);

 string tospawn = "";
 if(wave_ent && wave_ent.spawnmob && wave_ent.spawnmob != "")
 {
  RandomSelection_Init();
  if(1){ string _words = wave_ent.spawnmob; float _i = 0; for (string _it; (_it = car(_words)); (_words = cdr(_words), ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref string it = _it; if (true) { { { RandomSelection_Add((0, world), 0, it, '0 0 0', 1, 1); }; } } } }else voidfunc()


    ;

  tospawn = RandomSelection_chosen_string;
 }

 if(spawn_point == (0, world))
 {
  if(!inv_warning_shown)
  {
   inv_warning_shown = true;
   if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/invasion/sv_invasion.qc", "197")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("Warning: couldn't find any invasion_spawnpoint spawnpoints, attempting to spawn monsters in random locations"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  }
  entity e = __spawn("entity", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/invasion/sv_invasion.qc" ":" "199", false);
  setsize(e, mon.m_mins, mon.m_maxs);

  if(MoveToRandomMapLocation(e, DPCONTENTS_SOLID | DPCONTENTS_CORPSE | DPCONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP, DPCONTENTS_SLIME | DPCONTENTS_LAVA | DPCONTENTS_SKY | DPCONTENTS_BODY | DPCONTENTS_DONOTENTER, Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY, 10, 1024, 256))
  {
   monster = spawnmonster(e, tospawn, mon, (0, world), (0, world), e.origin, false, false, 2);
   monster.angles_x = monster.angles_z = 0;
  }
  else
  {
   if(1){ entity _this = (e); void(entity) _dtor = _this.dtor; ONREMOVE(e); if (_dtor) _dtor(_this); else delete_fn(_this); }else voidfunc();
   return;
  }
 }
 else
  monster = spawnmonster(__spawn("entity", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/invasion/sv_invasion.qc" ":" "214", false), ((spawn_point.spawnmob && spawn_point.spawnmob != "") ? spawn_point.spawnmob : tospawn), mon, spawn_point, spawn_point, spawn_point.origin, false, false, 2);

 if(!monster)
  return;

 StatusEffects_remove(STATUSEFFECT_SpawnShield, monster, STATUSEFFECT_REMOVE_NORMAL);

 if(spawn_point)
 {
  if(spawn_point.target_range)
   monster.target_range = spawn_point.target_range;
  monster.target2 = spawn_point.target2;
 }

 if(monster.monster_attack)
  IL_REMOVE(g_monster_targets, monster);
 monster.monster_attack = false;

 if(inv_roundcnt >= inv_maxrounds)
  monster.spawnflags |= MONSTERFLAG_MINIBOSS;
}

 Monster chosen_monster = invasion_PickMonster(supermonster_count);

 invasion_SpawnChosenMonster(chosen_monster);
}

float Invasion_CheckWinner()
{
 if((round_handler.round_endtime) > 0 && (round_handler.round_endtime) - time <= 0)
 {
  if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_monsters.il_loop_item; g_monsters.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_monsters.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (true) { { { Monster_Remove(it); }; } } if (g_monsters.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_monsters.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_monsters.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()


    ;
  if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_prev = _il.il_prevfld; .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { _next = _it.(il_next); _it.(il_next) = _it.(il_prev) = (0, world); } _il.il_head = _il.il_tail = (0, world); }else voidfunc();

  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ROUND_OVER);
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_ROUND_OVER);
  round_handler_Init(5, autocvar_g_invasion_warmup, autocvar_g_invasion_round_timelimit);
  return 1;
 }

 float total_alive_monsters = 0, supermonster_count = 0;

 if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_monsters.il_loop_item; g_monsters.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_monsters.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (GetResource(it, RES_HEALTH) > 0) { { { if(it.monsterdef.spawnflags & MON_FLAG_SUPERMONSTER) ++supermonster_count; ++total_alive_monsters; }; } } if (g_monsters.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_monsters.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_monsters.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()




   ;

 if((total_alive_monsters + inv_numkilled) < inv_maxspawned && inv_maxcurrent < inv_maxspawned)
 {
  if(time >= inv_lastcheck)
  {
   invasion_SpawnMonsters(supermonster_count);
   inv_lastcheck = time + autocvar_g_invasion_spawn_delay;
  }

  return 0;
 }

 if(inv_numspawned < 1)
  return 0;

 if(inv_numkilled < inv_maxspawned)
  return 0;

 entity winner = (0, world);
 float winning_score = 0;

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { float cs = _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_KILLS, 0); if(cs > winning_score) { winning_score = cs; winner = it; } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()






   ;

 if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; entity il_loop_item_save = g_monsters.il_loop_item; g_monsters.il_loop_item = (0, world); for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { const noref entity it = _it; g_monsters.il_loop_item = it; _next = it.(il_next); if (true) { { { Monster_Remove(it); }; } } if (g_monsters.il_loop_item != it) _next = g_monsters.il_loop_item; else _next = it.(il_next); } g_monsters.il_loop_item = il_loop_item_save; }else voidfunc()


   ;
 if(1){ IntrusiveList _il = g_monsters; if(1){ if (!(_il)) { print_assertfailed_severe("_il"); ; } }else voidfunc(); .entity il_prev = _il.il_prevfld; .entity il_next = _il.il_nextfld; noref float i = 0; for (entity _next, _it = _il.il_head; _it; (_it = _next, ++i)) { _next = _it.(il_next); _it.(il_next) = _it.(il_prev) = (0, world); } _il.il_head = _il.il_tail = (0, world); }else voidfunc();

 if(winner)
 {
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ROUND_PLAYER_WIN, winner.netname);
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_ROUND_PLAYER_WIN, winner.netname);
 }

 return 1;
}

void Invasion_RoundStart()
{
 float numplayers = 0;
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { it.player_blocked = false; ++numplayers; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


   ;

 if(inv_roundcnt < inv_maxrounds)
  inv_roundcnt += 1;

 inv_monsterskill = inv_roundcnt + max(1, numplayers * 0.3);

 inv_maxcurrent = 0;
 inv_numspawned = 0;
 inv_numkilled = 0;

 inv_maxspawned = rint(max(autocvar_g_invasion_monster_count, autocvar_g_invasion_monster_count * (inv_roundcnt * 0.5)));
}

void invasion_DelayedInit(entity this)
{
 if(autocvar_g_invasion_type == INV_TYPE_HUNT || autocvar_g_invasion_type == INV_TYPE_STAGE)
  cvar_set("fraglimit", "0");

 independent_players = 1;

 invasion_ScoreRules();

 independent_players = 0;

 if(autocvar_g_invasion_type == INV_TYPE_ROUND)
 {
  round_handler_Spawn(Invasion_CheckPlayers, Invasion_CheckWinner, Invasion_RoundStart);
  round_handler_Init(5, autocvar_g_invasion_warmup, autocvar_g_invasion_round_timelimit);

  inv_roundcnt = 0;
  inv_maxrounds = 15;
 }
}

void invasion_Initialize()
{
 InitializeEntity((0, world), invasion_DelayedInit, INITPRIO_GAMETYPE);
}

 }
}

void kh_update_state()
{
 entity key;
 float f;
 float s = 0;
 for(key = kh_worldkeylist; key; key = key.kh_worldkeynext )
 {
  if(key.owner)
   f = key.team;
  else
   f = 30;
  s |= (32 ** key.count) * f;
 }

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { { (it).stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS = s; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

 for(key = kh_worldkeylist; key; key = key.kh_worldkeynext )
 {
  if(key.owner)
   (key.owner).stat_OBJECTIVE_STATUS |= (32 ** key.count) * 31;
 }

}

void kh_Controller_Think(entity this)
{
 if(game_stopped)
  return;
 if(this.cnt > 0)
 {
  if((0, (this).selfthink) != kh_WaitForPlayers)
   this.cnt -= 1;
 }
 else if(this.cnt == 0)
 {
  this.cnt -= 1;
  kh_Controller_Thinkfunc();
 }
 this.nextthink = time + 1;
}



void kh_Scores_Event(entity player, entity key, string what, float frags_player, float frags_owner)
{
 string s;
 if(game_stopped)
  return;

 if(frags_player)
  UpdateFrags(player, frags_player);

 if(key && key.owner && frags_owner)
  UpdateFrags(key.owner, frags_owner);

 if(!autocvar_sv_eventlog)
  return;

 s = strcat(":keyhunt:", what, ":", ftos(player.playerid), ":", ftos(frags_player));

 if(key && key.owner)
  s = strcat(s, ":", ftos(key.owner.playerid));
 else
  s = strcat(s, ":0");

 s = strcat(s, ":", ftos(frags_owner), ":");

 if(key)
  s = strcat(s, key.netname);

 GameLogEcho(s);
}

  return e.tag_entity.origin + e.origin.x * v_forward - e.origin.y * v_right + e.origin.z * v_up;
 }
 else
  return e.origin;
}

void kh_Key_Attach(entity key)
{
 key.solid = SOLID_NOT;
# 245 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/keyhunt/sv_keyhunt.qc"
 setattachment(key, key.owner, "");
 setorigin(key, '0 0 1' * KH_KEY_ZSHIFT);
 key.angles_y -= key.owner.angles.y;

 key.flags = 0;
 if(IL_CONTAINS(g_items, key))
  IL_REMOVE(g_items, key);
 set_movetype(key, MOVETYPE_NONE);

{
 key.solid = SOLID_TRIGGER;
# 286 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/keyhunt/sv_keyhunt.qc"
 setorigin(key, key.owner.origin + key.origin.z * '0 0 1');

}

void kh_Key_AssignTo(entity key, entity player)
{
 if(key.owner == player)
  return;

 float ownerteam0 = kh_Key_AllOwnedByWhichTeam();

 if(key.owner)
 {
  kh_Key_Detach(key);


  if(key.kh_next)
   key.kh_next.kh_prev = key.kh_prev;
  key.kh_prev.kh_next = key.kh_next;
  key.kh_next = (0, world);
  key.kh_prev = (0, world);

  if(key.owner.kh_next == (0, world))
  {

   if(!kh_no_radar_circles)
    WaypointSprite_Ping(key.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier);
   WaypointSprite_DetachCarrier(key.owner);
  }
 }

 key.owner = player;

 if(player)
 {

  key.kh_next = player.kh_next;
  key.kh_prev = player;
  player.kh_next = key;
  if(key.kh_next)
   key.kh_next.kh_prev = key;

  kh_Key_Attach(key);

  if(key.kh_next == (0, world))
  {

   entity wp = WaypointSprite_AttachCarrier(WP_Null, player, RADARICON_FLAGCARRIER);
   wp.colormod = colormapPaletteColor_(player.team - 1, 0, time);
   player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier.waypointsprite_visible_for_player = kh_KeyCarrier_waypointsprite_visible_for_player;
   WaypointSprite_UpdateRule(player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, player.team, SPRITERULE_TEAMPLAY);
   if(player.team == NUM_TEAM_1)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, WP_KeyCarrierRed, WP_KeyCarrierFriend, WP_KeyCarrierRed);
   else if(player.team == NUM_TEAM_2)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, WP_KeyCarrierBlue, WP_KeyCarrierFriend, WP_KeyCarrierBlue);
   else if(player.team == NUM_TEAM_3)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, WP_KeyCarrierYellow, WP_KeyCarrierFriend, WP_KeyCarrierYellow);
   else if(player.team == NUM_TEAM_4)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, WP_KeyCarrierPink, WP_KeyCarrierFriend, WP_KeyCarrierPink);
   if(!kh_no_radar_circles)
    WaypointSprite_Ping(player.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier);
  }
 }


 kh_update_state();

 key.pusher = (0, world);

 float ownerteam = kh_Key_AllOwnedByWhichTeam();
 if(ownerteam != ownerteam0)
 {
  entity k;
  if(ownerteam != -1)
  {
   kh_interferemsg_time = time + 0.2;
   kh_interferemsg_team = player.team;


   for(k = kh_worldkeylist; k; k = k.kh_worldkeynext )
   {
    if (!k.owner) continue;
    entity first = WP_Null;
    if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Waypoints_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.netname == k.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier.model1) { { { first = it; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
    entity third = WP_Null;
    if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Waypoints_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.netname == k.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier.model3) { { { third = it; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
    WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(k.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, first, WP_KeyCarrierFinish, third);
   }
  }
  else
  {
   kh_interferemsg_time = 0;


   for(k = kh_worldkeylist; k; k = k.kh_worldkeynext )
   {
    if (!k.owner) continue;
    entity first = WP_Null;
    if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Waypoints_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.netname == k.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier.model1) { { { first = it; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
    entity third = WP_Null;
    if(1){ float _i = 0; for (entity _it = Waypoints_first, _next = (0, world); _it; (_it = _next, ++_i)) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = _it; _next = _it.enemy; if (it.netname == k.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier.model3) { { { third = it; break; }; } } } }else voidfunc();
    WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(k.owner.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier, first, WP_KeyCarrierFriend, third);
   }
  }
 }
}

void kh_Key_Damage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 if(this.owner)
  return;
 if((((deathtype) == DEATH_HURTTRIGGER.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_SLIME.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_LAVA.m_id) || ((deathtype) == DEATH_SWAMP.m_id)))
 {
  this.pain_finished = bound(time, time + autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_damage_return, this.pain_finished);
  return;
 }
 if(force == '0 0 0')
  return;
 if(time > this.pushltime)
  if(((attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
   this.team = attacker.team;
}

void kh_Key_Collect(entity key, entity player)
{
 if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_KH_COLLECT), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();

 if(key.kh_dropperteam != player.team)
 {
  kh_Scores_Event(player, key, "collect", autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_collect, 0);
  _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_KH_PICKUPS, 1);
 }
 key.kh_dropperteam = 0;
 float realteam = kh_Team_ByID(key.count);
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_PICKUP_RED : ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_PICKUP_BLUE : ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_PICKUP_YELLOW : INFO_KEYHUNT_PICKUP_PINK))), player.netname);

 kh_Key_AssignTo(key, player);
}

void kh_Key_Touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 if(game_stopped)
  return;

 if(this.owner)
  return;

 if((((trace_dpstartcontents | trace_dphitcontents) & DPCONTENTS_NODROP) || (trace_dphitq3surfaceflags & Q3SURFACEFLAG_SKY)))
 {
  this.pain_finished = bound(time, time + autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_damage_return, this.pain_finished);
  return;
 }

 if (!((toucher).classname == STR_PLAYER))
  return;
 if(((toucher).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return;
 if(toucher == this.enemy)
  if(time < this.kh_droptime + autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_collect)
   return;
 kh_Key_Collect(this, toucher);
}

void kh_Key_Remove(entity key)
{
 entity o = key.owner;
 kh_Key_AssignTo(key, (0, world));
 if(o)
  WaypointSprite_Kill(key.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier);
 else
  WaypointSprite_DetachCarrier(key);


 if (kh_worldkeylist == key)
  kh_worldkeylist = kh_worldkeylist.kh_worldkeynext;
 else
 {
  o = kh_worldkeylist;
  while (o)
  {
   if (o.kh_worldkeynext == key)
   {
    o.kh_worldkeynext = o.kh_worldkeynext.kh_worldkeynext;
    break;
   }
   o = o.kh_worldkeynext;
  }
 }

 }

 float first = true;

 first = true;

void kh_LoserTeam(float loser_team, entity lostkey)
{
 float f;
 entity attacker = (0, world);
 if(lostkey.pusher)
  if(lostkey.pusher.team != loser_team)
   if(((lostkey.pusher).classname == STR_PLAYER))
    attacker = lostkey.pusher;

 if(attacker)
 {
  if(lostkey.kh_previous_owner)
   kh_Scores_Event(lostkey.kh_previous_owner, (0, world), "pushed", 0, -autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_push);

  kh_Scores_Event(attacker, (0, world), "push", autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_push, 0);
  _GameRules_scoring_add(attacker, SP_KH_PUSHES, 1);

 }
 else
 {
  float players = 0;
  float of = autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_destroyed_ownfactor;

  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it.team != loser_team)) { { { { ++players; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

  entity key;
  float keys = 0;
  for(key = kh_worldkeylist; key; key = key.kh_worldkeynext )
   if(key.owner && key.team != loser_team)
    ++keys;

  if(lostkey.kh_previous_owner)
   kh_Scores_Event(lostkey.kh_previous_owner, (0, world), "destroyed", 0, -autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_destroyed);


  if(lostkey.kh_previous_owner.playerid == lostkey.kh_previous_owner_playerid)
   _GameRules_scoring_add(lostkey.kh_previous_owner, SP_KH_DESTROYS, 1);

  DistributeEvenly_Init(autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_destroyed, keys * of + players);

  for(key = kh_worldkeylist; key; key = key.kh_worldkeynext )
   if(key.owner && key.team != loser_team)
   {
    f = DistributeEvenly_Get(of);
    kh_Scores_Event(key.owner, (0, world), "destroyed_holdingkey", f, 0);
   }

  float fragsleft = DistributeEvenly_Get(players);


  float j = NumTeams(kh_teams) - 1;
  for(float i = 0; i < NumTeams(kh_teams); ++i)
  {
   float thisteam = kh_Team_ByID(i);
   if(thisteam == loser_team)
    continue;

   players = 0;
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it.team == thisteam)) { { { { ++players; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc();

   DistributeEvenly_Init(fragsleft, j);
   fragsleft = DistributeEvenly_Get(j - 1);
   DistributeEvenly_Init(DistributeEvenly_Get(1), players);

   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it.team == thisteam)) { { { { f = DistributeEvenly_Get(1); kh_Scores_Event(it, (0, world), "destroyed", f, 0); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


     ;

   --j;
  }
 }

 float realteam = kh_Team_ByID(lostkey.count);
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, ((loser_team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_LOSS_RED : ((loser_team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_LOSS_BLUE : ((loser_team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_LOSS_YELLOW : CENTER_ROUND_TEAM_LOSS_PINK))));
 if(attacker)
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_PUSHED_RED : ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_PUSHED_BLUE : ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_PUSHED_YELLOW : INFO_KEYHUNT_PUSHED_PINK))), attacker.netname, lostkey.kh_previous_owner.netname);
 else
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_1) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_DESTROYED_RED : ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_2) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_DESTROYED_BLUE : ((realteam == NUM_TEAM_3) ? INFO_KEYHUNT_DESTROYED_YELLOW : INFO_KEYHUNT_DESTROYED_PINK))), lostkey.kh_previous_owner.netname);

 play2all(( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_KH_DESTROY), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ));

void kh_Key_Think(entity this)
{
 if(game_stopped)
  return;

 if(this.owner)
 {

  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/keyhunt/sv_keyhunt.qc", 667, __FUNC__, "\"'0 1 0' * (this.cnt + (time % 360) * KH_KEY_XYSPEED)\""); _makevectors_hidden('0 1 0' * (this.cnt + (time % 360) * KH_KEY_XYSPEED)); }else voidfunc();
  setorigin(this, v_forward * KH_KEY_XYDIST + '0 0 1' * this.origin.z);

 }


 if(!this.owner)
  if(time > this.pain_finished)
   kh_LoserTeam(this.team, this);

 if(this.owner)
 if(kh_Key_AllOwnedByWhichTeam() != -1)
 {
  if(this.siren_time < time)
  {
   if(1){ entity __e = this.owner; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_KH_ALARM), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
   this.siren_time = time + 2.5;
  }

  entity key;
  vector p = this.owner.origin;
  for(key = kh_worldkeylist; key; key = key.kh_worldkeynext )
   if(((_vlen2 = (key.owner.origin - p), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) > ((autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_maxdist) ** 2)))
    goto not_winning;
  kh_WinnerTeam(this.team);
:not_winning
 }

 if(kh_interferemsg_time && time > kh_interferemsg_time)
 {
  kh_interferemsg_time = 0;
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { if(it.team == kh_interferemsg_team) { if(it.kh_next) Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_KEYHUNT_MEET); else Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_KEYHUNT_HELP); } else Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, it, MSG_CENTER, ((kh_interferemsg_team == NUM_TEAM_1) ? CENTER_KEYHUNT_INTERFERE_RED : ((kh_interferemsg_team == NUM_TEAM_2) ? CENTER_KEYHUNT_INTERFERE_BLUE : ((kh_interferemsg_team == NUM_TEAM_3) ? CENTER_KEYHUNT_INTERFERE_YELLOW : CENTER_KEYHUNT_INTERFERE_PINK)))); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()
# 708 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/keyhunt/sv_keyhunt.qc"
    ;
 }

 this.nextthink = time + 0.05;
}

float kh_Key_AllOwnedByWhichTeam()
{
 entity key;
 float teem = -1;
 float keys = NumTeams(kh_teams);
 for(key = kh_worldkeylist; key; key = key.kh_worldkeynext )
 {
  if(!key.owner)
   return -1;
  if(teem == -1)
   teem = key.team;
  else if(teem != key.team)
   return -1;
  --keys;
 }
 if(keys != 0)
  return -1;
 return teem;
}

float kh_GetMissingTeams()
{
 float missing_teams = 0;
 for(float i = 0; i < NumTeams(kh_teams); ++i)
 {
  float teem = kh_Team_ByID(i);
  float players = 0;
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { if(!((it).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !((it._cs).buttonchat) && it.team == teem) ++players; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()


    ;
  if (!players)
   missing_teams |= (1 << (i));
 }
 return missing_teams;
}

void kh_WaitForPlayers()
{
 static float prev_missing_teams_mask;
 if(time < game_starttime)
 {
  if (prev_missing_teams_mask > 0)
   Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_MISSING_TEAMS);
  prev_missing_teams_mask = -1;
  kh_Controller_SetThink(game_starttime - time + 0.1, kh_WaitForPlayers);
  return;
 }

 float missing_teams_mask = kh_GetMissingTeams();
 if(!missing_teams_mask)
 {
  if(prev_missing_teams_mask > 0)
   Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_MISSING_TEAMS);
  prev_missing_teams_mask = -1;
  Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_KEYHUNT_ROUNDSTART, autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_round);
  kh_Controller_SetThink(autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_round, kh_StartRound);
 }
 else
 {
  if(player_count == 0)
  {
   if(prev_missing_teams_mask > 0)
    Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_MISSING_TEAMS);
   prev_missing_teams_mask = -1;
  }
  else
  {
   if(prev_missing_teams_mask != missing_teams_mask)
   {
    Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_MISSING_TEAMS, missing_teams_mask);
    prev_missing_teams_mask = missing_teams_mask;
   }
  }
  kh_Controller_SetThink(1, kh_WaitForPlayers);
 }
}

void kh_EnableTrackingDevice()
{
 Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_KEYHUNT);
 Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_KEYHUNT_OTHER);

 kh_tracking_enabled = true;
}

void kh_StartRound()
{
 if(time < game_starttime)
 {
  kh_Controller_SetThink(game_starttime - time + 0.1, kh_WaitForPlayers);
  return;
 }

 if(kh_GetMissingTeams())
 {
  kh_Controller_SetThink(1, kh_WaitForPlayers);
  return;
 }

 Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_KEYHUNT);
 Kill_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CPID_KEYHUNT_OTHER);

 for(float i = 0; i < NumTeams(kh_teams); ++i)
 {
  float teem = kh_Team_ByID(i);
  float players = 0;
  entity my_player = (0, world);
  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { if(!((it).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && !((it._cs).buttonchat) && it.team == teem) { ++players; if(random() * players <= 1) my_player = it; } }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()






    ;
  kh_Key_Spawn(my_player, 360 * i / NumTeams(kh_teams), i);
 }

 kh_tracking_enabled = false;
 Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_CENTER, CENTER_KEYHUNT_SCAN, autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_tracking);
 kh_Controller_SetThink(autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_delay_tracking, kh_EnableTrackingDevice);
}

float kh_HandleFrags(entity attacker, entity targ, float f)
{
 if(attacker == targ)
  return f;

 if(targ.kh_next)
 {
  if(attacker.team == targ.team)
  {
   float nk = 0;
   for(entity k = targ.kh_next; k != (0, world); k = k.kh_next)
    ++nk;
   kh_Scores_Event(attacker, targ.kh_next, "carrierfrag", -nk * autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_collect, 0);
  }
  else
  {
   kh_Scores_Event(attacker, targ.kh_next, "carrierfrag", autocvar_g_balance_keyhunt_score_carrierfrag-1, 0);
   _GameRules_scoring_add(attacker, SP_KH_KCKILLS, 1);

  }
 }

 return f;
}

void havocbot_goalrating_kh(entity this, float ratingscale_team, float ratingscale_dropped, float ratingscale_enemy)
{
 entity head;
 for (head = kh_worldkeylist; head; head = head.kh_worldkeynext)
 {
  if(head.owner == this)
   continue;
  if(!kh_tracking_enabled)
  {


   if(!head.owner || head.team != this.team)
   {
    traceline(this.origin + this.view_ofs, head.origin, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, this);
    if (trace_fraction < 1 && trace_ent != head)
     continue;
   }
  }
  if(!head.owner)
   navigation_routerating(this, head, ratingscale_dropped * 10000, 100000);
  else if(head.team == this.team)
   navigation_routerating(this, head.owner, ratingscale_team * 10000, 100000);
  else
   navigation_routerating(this, head.owner, ratingscale_enemy * 10000, 100000);
 }

 havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 80000, this.origin, 10000);
}

void havocbot_role_kh_carrier(entity this)
{
 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
  return;

 if (!(this.kh_next))
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/keyhunt/sv_keyhunt.qc", "1056")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("changing role to freelancer"), "\n")); }else voidfunc();
  this.havocbot_role = havocbot_role_kh_freelancer;
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = 0;
  return;
 }

 if (navigation_goalrating_timeout(this))
 {
  navigation_goalrating_start(this);

  if(kh_Key_AllOwnedByWhichTeam() == this.team)
   havocbot_goalrating_kh(this, 10, 0.1, 0.05);
  else
   havocbot_goalrating_kh(this, 4, 4, 0.5);

  navigation_goalrating_end(this);

  navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(this);
 }
}

float LMS_NewPlayerLives()
{
 float fl = floor(cvar("fraglimit"));
 if(fl == 0 || fl > 999)
  fl = 999;


 if(lms_lowest_lives < 1)
  return 0;

 if(!autocvar_g_lms_join_anytime)
  if(lms_lowest_lives < fl - max(0, floor(autocvar_g_lms_last_join)))
   return 0;

 return bound(1, lms_lowest_lives, fl);
}

float WinningCondition_LMS()
{
 if (warmup_stage || time <= game_starttime)
  return WINNING_NO;

 entity first_player = (0, world);

float lms_AddPlayer(entity player)
{
 if (!((player).ingame))
 {
  float lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, LMS_NewPlayerLives());
  if(lives <= 0)
   return false;
  if (time < game_starttime)
   (player).ingame = 1;
  else
   (player).ingame = 0.5;
 }
 if (warmup_stage || time <= game_starttime)
 {
  player.lms_spectate = false;
  _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, -_GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, 0));
  float lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0);
  if(lives <= 0)
   _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, LMS_NewPlayerLives());
 }
 else
 {
  if(_GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0) <= 0)
  {
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, player, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_LMS_NOLIVES);
   return false;
  }
 }
 return true;
}

void lms_RemovePlayer(entity player)
{
 if (warmup_stage || time < game_starttime)
  return;

 float player_rank = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, 0);
 if (!player_rank)
 {
  if (!player.lms_spectate)
  {
   player.frags = FRAGS_PLAYER_OUT_OF_GAME;
   float pl_cnt = 0;
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it.frags == FRAGS_PLAYER)) { { { { pl_cnt++; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()

     ;
   _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, pl_cnt + 1);
  }
  else if (((player).ingame))
  {
   if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (it != player)) { { { { if (it.frags == FRAGS_PLAYER_OUT_OF_GAME) _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_LMS_RANK, -1); }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()



     ;
   float rank = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, 0);
   _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, -rank);
   if(!warmup_stage)
   {
    float pl_lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0);
    float pl_health = ((player).deadflag != DEAD_NO) ? start_health : GetResource(player, RES_HEALTH);
    float pl_armor = ((player).deadflag != DEAD_NO) ? start_armorvalue : GetResource(player, RES_ARMOR);
    if (!last_forfeiter_lives || pl_lives < last_forfeiter_lives)
    {
     last_forfeiter_lives = pl_lives;
     last_forfeiter_health = pl_health;
     last_forfeiter_armorvalue = pl_armor;
    }
    else if (pl_lives == last_forfeiter_lives)
    {

     last_forfeiter_health = min(last_forfeiter_health, pl_health);
     last_forfeiter_armorvalue = min(last_forfeiter_armorvalue, pl_armor);
    }
    _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, -pl_lives);
   }
   player.frags = FRAGS_SPECTATOR;
   if(1){ entity _e = (player); if (_e.vtblbase != Observer_vtbl) { _e.transmute = true; _e.classname = "Observer"; spawnObserver_1(_e ); } }else voidfunc();
   (player).ingame = 0;
   player.lms_spectate = false;
   (player._cs).killcount = FRAGS_SPECTATOR;
  }
  if (autocvar_g_lms_leader_lives_diff > 0)
   lms_UpdateLeaders();
 }

 if ((player._cs).killcount != FRAGS_SPECTATOR)
 {
  if (_GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_RANK, 0) > 0)
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ALL, (0, world), MSG_INFO, INFO_LMS_NOLIVES, player.netname);
 }
}

Callback CB_lms_Damage_Calculate; float lms_Damage_Calculate(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_lms_Damage_Calculate = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/lms/sv_lms.qc" ":" "530", true) , lms_Damage_Calculate); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_lms_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_Damage_Calculate, CB_lms_Damage_Calculate, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("Damage_Calculate", "lms_Damage_Calculate"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_Damage_Calculate, CB_lms_Damage_Calculate); } }else voidfunc(); } float lms_Damage_Calculate() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float lms_Damage_Calculate()
{
 if (!autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_vampire)
  return;

 entity frag_attacker = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;
 entity frag_target = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_entity;
 float frag_damage = MUTATOR_ARGV_4_float;

 if (((frag_attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((frag_attacker).deadflag != DEAD_NO)
  && ((frag_target).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((frag_target).deadflag != DEAD_NO) && frag_attacker != frag_target)
 {
  float vampire_factor = 0;

  float frag_attacker_lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(frag_attacker, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0);
  float frag_target_lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(frag_target, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0);
  float diff = frag_target_lives - frag_attacker_lives - autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_vampire_min_lives_diff;

  if (diff >= 0)
   vampire_factor = autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_vampire_factor_base + diff * autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_vampire_factor_increase;
  if (vampire_factor > 0)
  {
   vampire_factor = min(vampire_factor, autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_vampire_factor_max);
   SetResourceExplicit(frag_attacker, RES_HEALTH,
    min(GetResource(frag_attacker, RES_HEALTH) + frag_damage * vampire_factor, start_health));
  }
 }
}

Callback CB_lms_CalculateRespawnTime; float lms_CalculateRespawnTime(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_lms_CalculateRespawnTime = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/lms/sv_lms.qc" ":" "565", true) , lms_CalculateRespawnTime); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_lms_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_CalculateRespawnTime, CB_lms_CalculateRespawnTime, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("CalculateRespawnTime", "lms_CalculateRespawnTime"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_CalculateRespawnTime, CB_lms_CalculateRespawnTime); } }else voidfunc(); } float lms_CalculateRespawnTime() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float lms_CalculateRespawnTime()
{
 entity player = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_entity;
 player.respawn_flags |= RESPAWN_FORCE;

 float pl_lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(player, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0);
 if (pl_lives <= 0)
 {
  player.respawn_flags = RESPAWN_SILENT;

  player.respawn_time = time + 2;
  return true;
 }

 if (autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_respawn_delay <= 0)
  return false;

 float max_lives = 0;
 float pl_cnt = 0;
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (it != player && ((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && it.frags != FRAGS_PLAYER_OUT_OF_GAME)) { { { { float lives = _GameRules_scoring_add(it, SP_LMS_LIVES, 0); if (lives > max_lives) max_lives = lives; pl_cnt++; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()




   ;


 if (pl_cnt == 1)
  max_lives = 0;

 float dlay = autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_respawn_delay_base +
  autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_respawn_delay_increase * max(0, max_lives - pl_lives);
 player.respawn_time = time + min(autocvar_g_lms_dynamic_respawn_delay_max, dlay);
 return true;
}

void MayhemCalculatePlayerScore(entity scorer)
{
 float scoringmethod = 1;
 float upscaler;
 float frag_weight;
 float damage_weight;





 float disable_selfdamage2score;

 if (teamplay) {

  upscaler = autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_upscaler;
  frag_weight = autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_kill_weight;
  damage_weight = autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_damage_weight;
  disable_selfdamage2score = autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_disable_selfdamage2score;
 } else {

  upscaler = autocvar_g_mayhem_scoring_upscaler;
  frag_weight = autocvar_g_mayhem_scoring_kill_weight;
  damage_weight = autocvar_g_mayhem_scoring_damage_weight;
  disable_selfdamage2score = autocvar_g_mayhem_scoring_disable_selfdamage2score;
 }



 if (frag_weight && damage_weight)
  scoringmethod = 1;
 else if (frag_weight)
  scoringmethod = 2;
 else if (damage_weight)
  scoringmethod = 3;
 else
  return;

 switch (scoringmethod)
 {
  default:
  case 1:
  {



   float suicide_weight = 1 + (disable_selfdamage2score / frag_weight);



   float playerdamagescore = ((scorer.total_damage_dealt / (start_health + start_armorvalue)) * 100) * upscaler * damage_weight;



   float roundedplayerdamagescore = rint(playerdamagescore * 10) / 10;


   float killcount = PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_KILLS, 0) - PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_TEAMKILLS, 0) - (PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_SUICIDES, 0) * suicide_weight);


   float playerkillscore = (killcount * 100) * upscaler * frag_weight;


   float playerscore = roundedplayerdamagescore + playerkillscore;


   float scoretoadd = playerscore - (PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_SCORE, 0) * 100);



   _GameRules_scoring_add_team(scorer, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, floor(scoretoadd / 100));
# 234 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/mayhem/sv_mayhem.qc"
   return;
  }

  case 2:
  {

   float playerkillscore = PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_KILLS, 0) - PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_TEAMKILLS, 0) - PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_SUICIDES, 0);
   float upscaledplayerscore = playerkillscore * upscaler;
   float scoretoadd = upscaledplayerscore - PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_SCORE, 0);
   _GameRules_scoring_add_team(scorer, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, floor(scoretoadd));
# 255 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/mayhem/sv_mayhem.qc"
   return;
  }

  case 3:
  {

   float playerdamagescore = ((scorer.total_damage_dealt / (start_health + start_armorvalue)) * 100);
   float roundedplayerdamagescore = rint(playerdamagescore * 10) / 10;
   float upscaledplayerscore = roundedplayerdamagescore * upscaler;
   float scoretoadd = upscaledplayerscore - (PlayerScore_Add(scorer, SP_SCORE, 0) * 100);
   _GameRules_scoring_add_team(scorer, SP_SCORE, ST_SCORE, floor(scoretoadd / 100));
# 278 "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/mayhem/sv_mayhem.qc"
   return;
  }
 }
}

void football_touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{

 {
  if(time > this.lastground + 0.1)
  {
   if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, this.noise, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
   this.lastground = time;
  }
  if(this.velocity && !this.cnt)
   this.nextthink = time + autocvar_g_nexball_delay_idle;
  return;
 }

  return;

  return;

  this.nextthink = time + autocvar_g_nexball_delay_idle;

  if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/nexball/sv_nexball.qc", 321, __FUNC__, "\"toucher.v_angle\""); _makevectors_hidden(toucher.v_angle); }else voidfunc();

void GoalTouch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 entity ball;
 float isclient, pscore, otherteam;
 string pname;

 if(game_stopped) return;
 if((this.spawnflags & GOAL_TOUCHPLAYER) && toucher.ballcarried)
  ball = toucher.ballcarried;
 else
  ball = toucher;
 if(ball.classname != "nexball_basketball")
  if(ball.classname != "nexball_football")
   return;
 if((!ball.pusher && this.team != GOAL_OUT) || ball.cnt)
  return;
 if(!WarpZoneLib_ExactTrigger_Touch((this), (toucher), true)) return;


 if(NumTeams(nb_teams) == 2)
  otherteam = OtherTeam(ball.team);
 else
  otherteam = 0;

 if((isclient = (ball.pusher.flags & FL_CLIENT)))
  pname = ball.pusher.netname;
 else
  pname = "Someone (?)";

 if(ball.team == this.team)
 {
  LogNB("owngoal", ball.pusher);
  bprint("Boo! ", pname, "^7 scored a goal against their own team!\n");
  pscore = -1;
 }
 else if(this.team == GOAL_FAULT)
 {
  LogNB("fault", ball.pusher);
  if(NumTeams(nb_teams) == 2)
   bprint(strcat(Team_ColorCode(otherteam), Team_ColorName(otherteam), " ", _("Team"), "^7"), " gets a point due to ", pname, "^7's silliness.\n");
  else
   bprint(strcat(Team_ColorCode(ball.team), Team_ColorName(ball.team), " ", _("Team"), "^7"), " loses a point due to ", pname, "^7's silliness.\n");
  pscore = -1;
 }
 else if(this.team == GOAL_OUT)
 {
  LogNB("out", ball.pusher);
  if((this.spawnflags & GOAL_TOUCHPLAYER) && ball.owner)
   bprint(pname, "^7 went out of bounds.\n");
  else
   bprint("The ball was returned.\n");
  pscore = 0;
 }
 else
 {
  LogNB(strcat("goal:", ftos(this.team)), ball.pusher);
  bprint("Goaaaaal! ", pname, "^7 scored a point for the ", strcat(Team_ColorCode(ball.team), Team_ColorName(ball.team), " ", _("Team"), "^7"), ".\n");
  pscore = 1;
 }

 if(1){ entity __e = ball; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, this.noise, VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NONE, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();

 if(ball.team && pscore)
 {
  if(NumTeams(nb_teams) == 2 && pscore < 0)
   TeamScore_AddToTeam(otherteam, ST_NEXBALL_GOALS, -pscore);
  else
   TeamScore_AddToTeam(ball.team, ST_NEXBALL_GOALS, pscore);
 }
 if(isclient)
 {
  if(pscore > 0)
   _GameRules_scoring_add(ball.pusher, SP_NEXBALL_GOALS, pscore);
  else if(pscore < 0)
   _GameRules_scoring_add(ball.pusher, SP_NEXBALL_FAULTS, -pscore);
 }

 if(ball.owner)
  DropBall(ball, ball.owner.origin, ball.owner.velocity);

 WaypointSprite_Ping(ball.waypointsprite_attachedforcarrier);

 ball.cnt = 1;
 (_selftemp = (ball), _selftemp.__think = ((ResetBall) ? think_self : nil), _selftemp.selfthink = (ResetBall));
 if(ball.classname == "nexball_basketball")
  (_selftemp = (ball), _selftemp.__touch = ((football_touch) ? touch_self : nil), _selftemp.selftouch = (football_touch));
 ball.nextthink = time + autocvar_g_nexball_delay_goal * (this.team != GOAL_OUT);
}

 this.nextthink = time;
}

void W_Nexball_Attack(Weapon thiswep, entity actor, .entity weaponentity, float t)
{
 entity ball;
 float mul, mi, ma;
 if(!(ball = actor.ballcarried))
  return;

 W_SetupShot_Dir_ProjectileSize_Range(actor, weaponentity, v_forward, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', false, 4, SND_NB_SHOOT1, CH_WEAPON_A, 0, max_shot_distance, WEP_PORTO.m_id);
 tracebox(w_shotorg, BALL_MINS, BALL_MAXS, w_shotorg, MOVE_WORLDONLY, (0, world));
 if(trace_startsolid)
 {
  if((actor).stat_NB_METERSTART)
   (actor).stat_NB_METERSTART = 0;
  return;
 }


 if(t < 0)
  mul = 1;
 else
 {
  mi = autocvar_g_nexball_basketball_meter_minpower;
  ma = max(mi, autocvar_g_nexball_basketball_meter_maxpower);

  mul = 2 * (t % g_nexball_meter_period) / g_nexball_meter_period;
  if(mul > 1)
   mul = 2 - mul;
  mul = mi + (ma - mi) * mul;
 }

 DropBall(ball, w_shotorg, W_CalculateProjectileVelocity(actor, actor.velocity, w_shotdir * autocvar_g_balance_nexball_primary_speed * mul, false));



}

  DropBall(_ball, w_shotorg, trigger_push_calculatevelocity(_ball.origin, _ball.enemy, 32, _ball));

  _ball.nextthink = time;
  return;
 }

 if(!autocvar_g_nexball_tackling)
  return;

 W_SetupShot_Dir_ProjectileSize_Range(actor, weaponentity, v_forward, '0 0 0', '0 0 0', false, 2, SND_NB_SHOOT2, CH_WEAPON_A, 0, max_shot_distance, WEP_PORTO.m_id);

void ons_Link_CheckUpdate(entity this)
{

 float cc = 0, cc1 = 0, cc2 = 0;

 if(this.goalentity.islinked || this.goalentity.iscaptured) { cc1 = (this.goalentity.team - 1) * 0x01; }
 if(this.enemy.islinked || this.enemy.iscaptured) { cc2 = (this.enemy.team - 1) * 0x10; }

 cc = cc1 + cc2;

 if(cc != this.clientcolors)
 {
  this.clientcolors = cc;
  this.SendFlags |= 4;
 }

 this.nextthink = time;
}

float ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(entity cp, float teamnum)
{
 if(cp.aregensneighbor & (1 << (teamnum))) return 2;
 if(cp.arecpsneighbor & (1 << (teamnum))) return 1;

 return 0;
}

float ons_ControlPoint_Attackable(entity cp, float teamnum)







{
 float a;

 if(cp.isshielded)
 {
  return 0;
 }
 else if(cp.goalentity)
 {

  if(cp.team == teamnum)
  {
   a = ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(cp, teamnum);
   if(a)
    return -2;
   return -1;
  }


  a = ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(cp, teamnum);
  if(a == 2)
   return 3;
  return 1;
 }
 else
 {

  if(ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(cp, teamnum))
  {
   a = ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(cp, teamnum);
   if(a == 2)
    return 4;
   else
    return 2;
  }
 }
 return 0;
}

{
 if(damage <= 0) { return; }

 if (this.owner.isshielded)
 {

  if (time > this.pain_finished)
   if (((attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
   {
    play2(attacker, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_ONS_DAMAGEBLOCKEDBYSHIELD), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ));
    this.pain_finished = time + 1;
    attacker.typehitsound += 1;
   }

 if(time - ons_notification_time[this.team] > 10)
 {
  play2team(this.team, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_ONS_CONTROLPOINT_UNDERATTACK), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ));

 else
  WaypointSprite_UpdateBuildFinished(this.owner.sprite, time + (this.max_health - GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH)) / (this.count / ONS_CP_THINKRATE));
 this.pain_finished = time + 1;

  if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_ONS_HIT1), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE+0.3, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
 else

float ons_ControlPoint_Icon_Heal(entity targ, entity inflictor, float amount, float limit)
{
 float hlth = GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH);
 float true_limit = ((limit != RES_LIMIT_NONE) ? limit : targ.max_health);
 if (hlth <= 0 || hlth >= true_limit)
  return false;

 GiveResourceWithLimit(targ, RES_HEALTH, amount, true_limit);
 hlth = GetResource(targ, RES_HEALTH);
 if(targ.owner.iscaptured)
  WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(targ.owner.sprite, hlth);
 else
  WaypointSprite_UpdateBuildFinished(targ.owner.sprite, time + (targ.max_health - hlth) / (targ.count / ONS_CP_THINKRATE));
 targ.SendFlags |= CPSF_STATUS;
 return true;
}

void ons_ControlPoint_Icon_Think(entity this)
{
 this.nextthink = time + ONS_CP_THINKRATE;

 if(autocvar_g_onslaught_cp_proxydecap)
 {
  float _enemy_count = 0;
  float _friendly_count = 0;

  if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER) && !((it).deadflag != DEAD_NO))) { { { { if(((_vlen2 = (it.origin - this.origin), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((autocvar_g_onslaught_cp_proxydecap_distance) ** 2))) { if((teamplay ?     ;

  _friendly_count = _friendly_count * (autocvar_g_onslaught_cp_proxydecap_dps * ONS_CP_THINKRATE);
  _enemy_count = _enemy_count * (autocvar_g_onslaught_cp_proxydecap_dps * ONS_CP_THINKRATE);

  GiveResourceWithLimit(this, RES_HEALTH, (_friendly_count - _enemy_count), this.max_health);
  this.SendFlags |= CPSF_STATUS;
  if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) <= 0)
  {
   ons_ControlPoint_Icon_Damage(this, this, this, 1, 0, (weaponentities[0]), this.origin, '0 0 0');
   return;
  }
 }

 if (time > this.pain_finished + 5)
 {
  if(GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) < this.max_health)
  {
   GiveResourceWithLimit(this, RES_HEALTH, this.count, this.max_health);
   WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(this.owner.sprite, GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH));
  }
 }

 if(this.owner.islinked != this.owner.waslinked)
 {

  float t = this.owner.team;
  if(!this.owner.islinked)
   this.owner.team = 0;

  SUB_UseTargets(this.owner, this, (0, world));

  this.owner.team = t;

  this.owner.waslinked = this.owner.islinked;
 }


 if(random() < 0.6 - GetResource(this, RES_HEALTH) / this.max_health)
 {
  Send_Effect(EFFECT_ELECTRIC_SPARKS, this.origin + randompos('-10 -10 -20', '10 10 20'), '0 0 0', 1);

   if(1){ entity __e = this; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_PAIN, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_ONS_SPARK1), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
  else if (random() > 0.5)

entity ons_ControlPoint_Waypoint(entity e)
{
 if(e.team)
 {
  float a = ons_ControlPoint_Attackable(e, e.team);

  if(a == -2) { return WP_OnsCPDefend; }
  if(a == -1 || a == 1 || a == 2) { return WP_OnsCP; }
  if(a == 3 || a == 4) { return WP_OnsCPAttack; }
 }
 else
  return WP_OnsCP;

 return WP_Null;
}

void ons_ControlPoint_UpdateSprite(entity e)
{
 entity s1 = ons_ControlPoint_Waypoint(e);
 WaypointSprite_UpdateSprites(e.sprite, s1, s1, s1);

 float sh;
 sh = !(ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(e, NUM_TEAM_1) || ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(e, NUM_TEAM_2) || ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(e, NUM_TEAM_3) || ons_ControlPoint_CanBeLinked(e, NUM_TEAM_4));

 if(e.lastteam != e.team + 2 || e.lastshielded != sh || e.iscaptured != e.lastcaptured)
 {
  if(e.iscaptured)
  {
   if(sh)
   {
    WaypointSprite_UpdateMaxHealth(e.sprite, 0);
   }
   else
   {
    WaypointSprite_UpdateMaxHealth(e.sprite, e.goalentity.max_health);
    WaypointSprite_UpdateHealth(e.sprite, GetResource(e.goalentity, RES_HEALTH));
   }
  }
  if(e.lastshielded)
  {
   if(e.team)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateTeamRadar(e.sprite, RADARICON_CONTROLPOINT, 0.5 * colormapPaletteColor_(e.team - 1, false, time));
   else
    WaypointSprite_UpdateTeamRadar(e.sprite, RADARICON_CONTROLPOINT, '0.5 0.5 0.5');
  }
  else
  {
   if(e.team)
    WaypointSprite_UpdateTeamRadar(e.sprite, RADARICON_CONTROLPOINT, colormapPaletteColor_(e.team - 1, false, time));
   else
    WaypointSprite_UpdateTeamRadar(e.sprite, RADARICON_CONTROLPOINT, '0.75 0.75 0.75');
  }
  WaypointSprite_Ping(e.sprite);

  e.lastteam = e.team + 2;
  e.lastshielded = sh;
  e.lastcaptured = e.iscaptured;
 }
}

void ons_ControlPoint_Touch(entity this, entity toucher)
{
 float attackable;

 if((toucher.vehicle_flags & VHF_ISVEHICLE) && toucher.owner)
 {
  if (!autocvar_g_onslaught_allow_vehicle_touch)
   return;
  toucher = toucher.owner;
 }

 if(!((toucher).classname == STR_PLAYER)) { return; }
 if((toucher).stat_FROZEN) { return; }
 if(((toucher).deadflag != DEAD_NO)) { return; }

 if ( (teamplay ? (this.team == toucher.team) : (this == toucher)) )
 if ( this.iscaptured )
 {
  if(time <= toucher.teleport_antispam)
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ONS_TELEPORT_ANTISPAM, rint(toucher.teleport_antispam - time));
  else
   Send_Notification(NOTIF_ONE, toucher, MSG_CENTER, CENTER_ONS_TELEPORT);
 }

 attackable = ons_ControlPoint_Attackable(this, toucher.team);
 if(attackable != 2 && attackable != 4)
  return;



 ons_ControlPoint_Icon_Spawn(this, toucher);

 this.ons_toucher = toucher;

 onslaught_updatelinks();
}

void ons_camSetup(entity this)
{
 vector dir;
 vector ang = '0 0 0';
 vector best_ang = '0 0 0';
 float best_trace_fraction = 0;
 while(ang.y < 360)
 {
  dir = (_vec2_x = (cos(ang.y * DEG2RAD)), _vec2_y = (sin(ang.y * DEG2RAD)), _vec2);
  dir *= 500;
  traceline(this.origin, this.origin - dir, MOVE_WORLDONLY, this);
  if(trace_fraction > best_trace_fraction)
  {
   best_trace_fraction = trace_fraction;
   best_ang = ang;
   if(trace_fraction == 1)
    break;
  }
  ang.y += 90;
  if(ang.y == 360)
   ang.y = 45;
 }
 cam.origin = this.origin;
 setorigin(cam, cam.origin);
 cam.angles = best_ang;
 Net_LinkEntity(cam, false, 0, clientcamera_send);

 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (true)) { { { it.clientcamera = cam;; }; } } } }else voidfunc();


 WriteByte(MSG_ALL, SVC_SETVIEWANGLES);
 WriteAngle(MSG_ALL, cam.angles_x);
 WriteAngle(MSG_ALL, cam.angles_y);
 WriteAngle(MSG_ALL, cam.angles_z);
}

void ons_GeneratorDamage(entity this, entity inflictor, entity attacker, float damage, float deathtype, .entity weaponentity, vector hitloc, vector force)
{
 if(damage <= 0) return;
 if(warmup_stage || game_stopped) return;
 if(!(!round_handler.wait && !round_handler.cnt)) return;

 if (attacker != this)
 {
  if (this.isshielded)

void havocbot_role_ons_offense(entity this)
{
 if(((this).deadflag != DEAD_NO))
 {
  this.havocbot_attack_time = 0;
  havocbot_ons_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }


 if (!this.havocbot_role_timeout)
  this.havocbot_role_timeout = time + 120;

 if (time > this.havocbot_role_timeout)
 {
  havocbot_ons_reset_role(this);
  return;
 }

 if(this.havocbot_attack_time>time)
  return;

 if (navigation_goalrating_timeout(this))
 {
  navigation_goalrating_start(this);
  havocbot_goalrating_enemyplayers(this, 20000, this.origin, 650);
  if(!havocbot_goalrating_ons_generator_attack(this, 10000))
   havocbot_goalrating_ons_controlpoints_attack(this, 10000);
  havocbot_goalrating_items(this, 25000, this.origin, 10000);
  navigation_goalrating_end(this);

  navigation_goalrating_timeout_set(this);
 }
}

entity ons_Nearest_ControlPoint(entity this, vector pos, float max_dist)
{
 entity closest_target = (0, world);
 for(entity cp = ons_worldcplist; cp; cp = cp.ons_worldcpnext)
 {
  if((teamplay ? (cp.team == this.team) : (cp == this)))
  if(cp.iscaptured)
  if(max_dist <= 0 || ((_vlen2 = (cp.origin - pos), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= ((max_dist) ** 2)))
  if((_vlen2 = (cp.origin - pos), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= (_vlen2 = (closest_target.origin - pos), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) || closest_target == (0, world))
   closest_target = cp;
 }
 for(entity gen = ons_worldgeneratorlist; gen; gen = gen.ons_worldgeneratornext)
 {
  if((teamplay ? (gen.team == this.team) : (gen == this)))
  if(max_dist <= 0 || ((_vlen2 = (gen.origin - pos), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) < ((max_dist) ** 2)))
  if((_vlen2 = (gen.origin - pos), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) <= (_vlen2 = (closest_target.origin - pos), ((_vlen2) * (_vlen2))) || closest_target == (0, world))
   closest_target = gen;
 }

 return closest_target;
}






entity ons_Nearest_ControlPoint_2D(entity this, vector pos, float max_dist)
{
 entity closest_target = (0, world);
 vector delta;
 float smallest_distance = 0, distance;

 for(entity cp = ons_worldcplist; cp; cp = cp.ons_worldcpnext)
 {
  delta = cp.origin - pos;
  delta_z = 0;
  distance = vlen(delta);

  if((teamplay ? (cp.team == this.team) : (cp == this)))
  if(cp.iscaptured)
  if(max_dist <= 0 || distance <= max_dist)
  if(closest_target == (0, world) || distance <= smallest_distance )
  {
   closest_target = cp;
   smallest_distance = distance;
  }
 }
 for(entity gen = ons_worldgeneratorlist; gen; gen = gen.ons_worldgeneratornext)
 {
  delta = gen.origin - pos;
  delta_z = 0;
  distance = vlen(delta);

  if((teamplay ? (gen.team == this.team) : (gen == this)))
  if(max_dist <= 0 || distance <= max_dist)
  if(closest_target == (0, world) || distance <= smallest_distance )
  {
   closest_target = gen;
   smallest_distance = distance;
  }
 }

 return closest_target;
}



float ons_Count_SelfControlPoints(entity this)
{
 float n = 0;
 for(entity cp = ons_worldcplist; cp; cp = cp.ons_worldcpnext)
 {
  if((teamplay ? (cp.team == this.team) : (cp == this)))
  if(cp.iscaptured)
   n++;
 }
 for(entity gen = ons_worldgeneratorlist; gen; gen = gen.ons_worldgeneratornext)
 {
  if((teamplay ? (gen.team == this.team) : (gen == this)))
   n++;
 }
 return n;
}






float ons_Teleport(entity player, entity tele_target, float range, float tele_effects)
{
 if ( !tele_target )
  return false;

 float i;
 vector loc;
 float theta;


 float iteration_scale = 1;
 for(i = 0; i < 16; ++i)
 {
  iteration_scale -= i / 16;
  theta = random() * 2 * 3.14159265358979323846;
  loc_y = sin(theta);
  loc_x = cos(theta);
  loc_z = 0;
  loc *= random() * range * iteration_scale;

  loc += tele_target.origin + '0 0 128' * iteration_scale;

  tracebox(loc, (player).stat_PL_MIN, (player).stat_PL_MAX, loc, MOVE_NORMAL, player);
  if(trace_fraction == 1.0 && !trace_startsolid)
  {
   traceline(tele_target.origin, loc, MOVE_NOMONSTERS, tele_target);
   if(trace_fraction == 1.0 && !trace_startsolid)
   {
    if ( tele_effects )
    {
     Send_Effect(EFFECT_TELEPORT, player.origin, '0 0 0', 1);
     if(1){ entity __e = player; if (sound_allowed(MSG_BROADCAST, __e)) sound7(__e, CH_TRIGGER, ( _Sound_fixpath_this = (SND_TELEPORT), _Sound_fixpath_cached = _Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str_, _Sound_fixpath_cached ? _Sound_fixpath_cached : _Sound_fixpath(_Sound_fixpath_this.sound_str()) ), VOL_BASE, ATTEN_NORM, 0, 0); }else voidfunc();
    }
    setorigin(player, loc);
    player.angles = '0 1 0' * ( theta * RAD2DEG + 180 );
    if(1){ deglob_log(DEGLOB_ORIGINAL, "makevectors", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/onslaught/sv_onslaught.qc", 1615, __FUNC__, "\"player.angles\""); _makevectors_hidden(player.angles); }else voidfunc();
    player.fixangle = true;
    if ((clienttype(player) == CLIENTTYPE_BOT))
    {
     player.v_angle = player.angles;
     bot_aim_reset(player);
    }
    player.teleport_antispam = time + autocvar_g_onslaught_teleport_wait;

    if ( tele_effects )
     Send_Effect(EFFECT_TELEPORT, player.origin + v_forward * 32, '0 0 0', 1);
    return true;
   }
  }
 }

 return false;
}

 float wc;
 float n, c;

 n = 0;
 c = 0;
 if(1){ for(float _i = 1; _i <= maxclients; ++_i) { const noref float i = _i; const noref entity it = edict_num(i); if((it.flags & FL_CLIENT) && (((it).classname == STR_PLAYER))) { { { { ++n; if((it._cs).race_completed) ++c; }; }; } } } }else voidfunc()



   ;
 if(n && (n == c))
  return WINNING_YES;
 wc = WinningCondition_Scores(fraglimit, 0);


 if(wc == WINNING_YES || wc == WINNING_STARTSUDDENDEATHOVERTIME)

  return WINNING_STARTSUDDENDEATHOVERTIME;
 else
  return WINNING_NEVER;
}

float WinningCondition_QualifyingThenRace(float limit)
{
 float wc;
 wc = WinningCondition_Scores(limit, 0);


 if(wc == WINNING_YES || wc == WINNING_STARTSUDDENDEATHOVERTIME)
 {
  return WINNING_YES;
 }

 return wc;
}

Callback CB_rc_PlayerPhysics; float rc_PlayerPhysics(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_rc_PlayerPhysics = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/race/sv_race.qc" ":" "129", true) , rc_PlayerPhysics); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_rc_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_PlayerPhysics, CB_rc_PlayerPhysics, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("PlayerPhysics", "rc_PlayerPhysics"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_PlayerPhysics, CB_rc_PlayerPhysics); } }else voidfunc(); } float rc_PlayerPhysics() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float rc_PlayerPhysics()
{
 entity player = MUTATOR_ARGV_0_entity;
 float dt = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_float;

 player.race_movetime_frac += dt;
 float f = floor(player.race_movetime_frac);
 player.race_movetime_frac -= f;
 player.race_movetime_count += f;
 player.race_movetime = player.race_movetime_frac + player.race_movetime_count;

 if(((player).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 {
  if (player.race_penalty)
   if (time > player.race_penalty)
    player.race_penalty = 0;
  if(player.race_penalty)
  {
   player.velocity = '0 0 0';
   set_movetype(player, MOVETYPE_NONE);
   player.disableclientprediction = 2;
  }
 }


 float wishspeed;
 vector wishvel;





 wishvel.x = fabs((player._cs).movement.x);
 wishvel.y = fabs((player._cs).movement.y);
 if(wishvel.x != 0 && wishvel.y != 0 && wishvel.x != wishvel.y)
 {
  wishvel.z = 0;
  wishspeed = vlen(wishvel);
  if(wishvel.x >= 2 * wishvel.y)
  {

   if((player._cs).movement.x > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_x = wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_x = -wishspeed;
   (player._cs).movement_y = 0;
  }
  else if(wishvel.y >= 2 * wishvel.x)
  {

   (player._cs).movement_x = 0;
   if((player._cs).movement.y > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_y = wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_y = -wishspeed;
  }
  else
  {

   if((player._cs).movement.x > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_x = M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_x = -M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
   if((player._cs).movement.y > 0)
    (player._cs).movement_y = M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
   else
    (player._cs).movement_y = -M_SQRT1_2 * wishspeed;
  }
 }
}

void rc_SetLimits()
{
 float fraglimit_override, leadlimit_override;
 float timelimit_override, qualifying_override;

 if(autocvar_g_race_teams)
 {
  GameRules_teams(true);
  race_teams = ((1 << (bound(2, autocvar_g_race_teams, 4))) - 1);
 }
 else
  race_teams = 0;

 qualifying_override = autocvar_g_race_qualifying_timelimit_override;
 fraglimit_override = cvar("g_race_laps_limit");
 leadlimit_override = 0;
 timelimit_override = cvar("timelimit_override");

 float want_qualifying = ((qualifying_override >= 0) ? qualifying_override : autocvar_g_race_qualifying_timelimit) > 0;

 record_type = "/race100record/";

 if(autocvar_g_campaign)
 {
  g_race_qualifying = 1;
  independent_players = 1;
 }
 else if(want_qualifying)
 {
  g_race_qualifying = 2;
  independent_players = 1;

void tmayhem_DelayedInit(entity this)
{

 if (find((0, world), classname, "tmayhem_team") == (0, world))
 {
  if(1){ if (autocvar_developer > 0) dprint(strcat1n("^9[::^7""SVQC""^9::""^6TRACE""^9] ", (sprintf("^7%s^9(^9%s^7:^9%s^7)", __FUNC__, "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/tmayhem/sv_tmayhem.qc", "47")), "\n")); dprint(strcat1n("^7", strcat1n("No \"tmayhem_team\" entities found on this map, creating them anyway."), "\n")); }else voidfunc();

  float numteams = autocvar_g_tmayhem_teams_override;
  if(numteams < 2) { numteams = autocvar_g_tmayhem_teams; }

  float teams = ((1 << (bound(2, numteams, 4))) - 1);
  if(teams & (1 << (0)))
   tmayhem_SpawnTeam("Red", NUM_TEAM_1);
  if(teams & (1 << (1)))
   tmayhem_SpawnTeam("Blue", NUM_TEAM_2);
  if(teams & (1 << (2)))
   tmayhem_SpawnTeam("Yellow", NUM_TEAM_3);
  if(teams & (1 << (3)))
   tmayhem_SpawnTeam("Pink", NUM_TEAM_4);
 }
}

Callback CB_tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor; float tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor(); [[accumulate]] void RegisterCallbacks() { CB_tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor = spawnCallback_2(__spawn("Callback", "./common/gamemodes/gamemode/tmayhem/sv_tmayhem.qc" ":" "181", true) , tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor); } [[accumulate]] float MUTATORFUNC_tmayhem_hooks(float mode) { if(1){ if (mode == MUTATOR_ADDING) { if (!CallbackChain_Add(HOOK_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor, CB_tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor, CBC_ORDER_ANY)) { _mutPrintFail("PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor", "tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor"); return true; } } if (mode == MUTATOR_REMOVING || mode == MUTATOR_ROLLING_BACK) { CallbackChain_Remove(HOOK_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor, CB_tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor); } }else voidfunc(); } float tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor() { return = false; } [[accumulate]] float tmayhem_PlayerDamage_SplitHealthArmor()
{
 if (!autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_damage_weight) return;

 entity frag_target = MUTATOR_ARGV_2_entity;

 if (StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_SpawnShield, frag_target) && autocvar_g_spawnshield_blockdamage >= 1) return;

 entity frag_attacker = MUTATOR_ARGV_1_entity;
 float frag_deathtype = MUTATOR_ARGV_6_float;
 float frag_damage = MUTATOR_ARGV_7_float;
 float damage_take = bound(0, MUTATOR_ARGV_4_float, GetResource(frag_target, RES_HEALTH));
 float damage_save = bound(0, MUTATOR_ARGV_5_float, GetResource(frag_target, RES_ARMOR));
 float excess = max(0, frag_damage - damage_take - damage_save);
 float total = frag_damage - excess;

 if (total == 0) return;

 if (StatusEffects_active(STATUSEFFECT_SpawnShield, frag_target) && autocvar_g_spawnshield_blockdamage)
  total *= 1 - autocvar_g_spawnshield_blockdamage;

 entity scorer = (0, world);

 if (((frag_attacker).classname == STR_PLAYER))
 {

  if (!(teamplay ? (frag_target.team == frag_attacker.team) : (frag_target == frag_attacker)))
   frag_attacker.total_damage_dealt += total;


  if ((teamplay ? (frag_target.team == frag_attacker.team) : (frag_target == frag_attacker)) || (frag_target == frag_attacker && !autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_disable_selfdamage2score))
   frag_attacker.total_damage_dealt -= total;

  scorer = frag_attacker;
 }
 else
 {







  if (!autocvar_g_tmayhem_scoring_disable_selfdamage2score && (
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_KILL.m_id ||
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_DROWN.m_id ||
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_HURTTRIGGER.m_id ||
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_CAMP.m_id ||
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_LAVA.m_id ||
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_SLIME.m_id ||
    frag_deathtype == DEATH_SWAMP.m_id))
   frag_target.total_damage_dealt -= total;

  scorer = frag_target;
 }

 MayhemCalculatePlayerScore(scorer);
}
